titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 1 the Monkey

dialogue.en: A rock had sat high on top of a mountain
dialogue.ipa: ə rɑk hæd sæt haɪ ɑn tɑp ʌv ə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 一块灵石高踞于山颠之上。

dialogue.en: The sun, the moon, Heaven and Earth all worked their magic on the rock.
dialogue.ipa: ðə sʌn ðə mun ˈhɛvən ænd ɜrθ ɔl wɜrkt ðɛr ˈmæʤɪk ɑn ðə rɑk
dialogue.zh: 日月星辰、天地万物,都在那块石头上施了造化之功。

dialogue.en: One day the rock split open
dialogue.ipa: wʌn deɪ ðə rɑk splɪt ˈoʊpən

dialogue.en: The monkey stood up and stretched
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki stʊd ʌp ænd strɛʧt

dialogue.en: Suddenly powerful light shot from his eyes
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ˈpaʊərfəl laɪt ʃɑt frʌm hɪz aɪz
dialogue.zh: 忽然眼中射出两道金光

dialogue.en: For a moment the light reached the Cloud Palace in Heaven.
dialogue.ipa: fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt ðə laɪt riʧt ðə klaʊd ˈpæləs ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 金光直冲天上的凌霄宝殿

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor, ruler of heaven, sat up
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər ˈrulər ʌv ˈhɛvən sæt ʌp
dialogue.zh: 玉皇大帝,这位天界至尊坐直了身子

dialogue.en: He turned to one of his captains who was standing nearby
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd tu wʌn ʌv hɪz ˈkæptənz hu wʌz ˈstændɪŋ ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 他转向身旁侍立的一位天将

dialogue.en: 'Find out what caused that light', said the Emperor
dialogue.ipa: faɪnd aʊt wɑt kɑzd ðæt laɪt sɛd ði ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 查明那道光是怎么回事,玉帝下令道。

dialogue.ipa: jɛs, jʊər ˈmæʤəsti sɛd ðə ˈkæptən

dialogue.en: The captain rushed out of the hall
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈkæptən rʌʃt aʊt ʌv ðə hɔl

dialogue.en: He looked out the southern gate of Heaven and saw the monkey on earth below
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt aʊt ðə ˈsʌðərn ɡeɪt ʌv ˈhɛvən ænd sɔ ðə ˈmʌŋki ɑn ɜrθ bɪˈloʊ
dialogue.zh: 他望向南天门外,看见了凡间的那只猴子。

dialogue.en: But the captain had magical sight
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈkæptən hæd ˈmæʤɪkəl saɪt

dialogue.en: He could see everything that had just happened
dialogue.ipa: hi kʊd si ˈɛvri ˌθɪŋ ðæt hæd ʤʌst ˈhæpənd
dialogue.zh: 方才发生的一切尽收眼底

dialogue.en: 'Well,' Said the Jade Emperor when the captain returned
dialogue.ipa: wɛl sɛd ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər wɛn ðə ˈkæptən rɪˈtɜrnd
dialogue.zh: “ 嗯, ”, 玉帝在天将回来时说道

dialogue.en: 'It was a monkey,' Said the captain.
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz ə ˈmʌŋki sɛd ðə ˈkæptən
ə ˈmʌŋki æskt ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: “ 一只猴子? ” 玉帝问道

dialogue.en: He's on the Fruit and Flower Mountain down on earth
dialogue.ipa: hiz ɑn ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən daʊn ɑn ɜrθ

dialogue.en: There had been a rock on the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr hæd bɪn ə rɑk ɑn ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: The monkey came from the rock
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki keɪm frʌm ðə rɑk

dialogue.en: The light shone from the monkey's eyes
dialogue.ipa: ðə laɪt ʃoʊn frʌm ðə ˈmʌŋkiz aɪz
dialogue.zh: 金光便是从他眼中射出

dialogue.en: The Emperor thought for a moment and then shrugged
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛmpərər θɔt fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt ænd ðɛn ʃrʌɡd
dialogue.zh: 玉帝沉吟片刻,不以为意

dialogue.en: Amazing things happen when heaven and earth work together
dialogue.ipa: əˈmeɪzɪŋ θɪŋz ˈhæpən wɛn ˈhɛvən ænd ɜrθ wɜrk təˈɡɛðər

dialogue.en: As time passed, Monkey learned to walk, run and climb
dialogue.ipa: æz taɪm pæst ˈmʌŋki lɜrnd tu wɔk rʌn ænd klaɪm
dialogue.zh: 时光流转,猴子学会了走路、跑步和攀爬。

dialogue.en: He drank from streams and ate grasses and leaves
dialogue.ipa: hi dræŋk frʌm strimz ænd eɪt ˈɡræsəz ænd livz

dialogue.en: He gathered fruit and explored caves and mountain tops
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈɡæðərd frut ænd ɪkˈsplɔrd keɪvz ænd ˈmaʊntən tɑps

dialogue.en: He became friends with all the other monkeys and apes
dialogue.ipa: hi bɪ ˈkeɪm frɛndz wɪð ɔl ði ˈʌðər ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps
dialogue.zh: 与山中群猴猿类结为友伴

dialogue.en: At night he slept under a cliff
dialogue.ipa: æt naɪt hi slɛpt ˈʌndər ə klɪf

dialogue.en: One very hot morning , all the monkeys and apes were playing in the shade
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ˈvɛri hɑt ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɔl ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps wɜr ˈpleɪɪŋ ɪn ðə ʃeɪd
dialogue.zh: 某个炎热的清晨,所有的猴子都在树荫下玩耍。

dialogue.en: 'It is so hot today,' cried one monkey
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ɪz soʊ hɑt təˈdeɪ kraɪd wʌn ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 今天真热啊,一只猴子喊道。

dialogue.en: The monkeys and apes ran to the stream
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps ræn tu ðə strim
dialogue.zh: 猴子和猿猴们跑向小溪。

dialogue.en: The water rolled and bounced over the rocks
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔtər roʊld ænd baʊnst ˈoʊvər ðə rɑks
dialogue.zh: 溪水翻滚着,在岩石上跳跃。

dialogue.en: The monkeys jumped into the cool water
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ʤʌmpt ˈɪntu ðə kul ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 猴子们跳进清凉的水中。

dialogue.en: After a few minutes, one monkey scratched her head
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ə fju ˈmɪnəts wʌn ˈmʌŋki skræʧt hɜr hɛd
dialogue.zh: 几分钟后,一只猴子挠了挠头。

dialogue.en: 'We all love this stream,' she said
dialogue.ipa: wi ɔl lʌv ðɪs strim ʃi sɛd
dialogue.zh: “ 我们都爱这条小溪, ” 她说。

dialogue.en: We know that it flows all the way to the ocean
dialogue.ipa: wi noʊ ðæt ɪt floʊz ɔl ðə weɪ tu ði ˈoʊʃən
dialogue.zh: 我们知道它一直流向大海。

dialogue.en: But does anyone know where the stream begins
dialogue.ipa: bʌt dʌz ˈɛniˌwʌn noʊ wɛr ðə strim bɪˈɡɪnz
dialogue.zh: 但有人知道小溪的源头在哪里吗? ”

dialogue.en: They all looked at one another and shook their heads
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ɔl lʊkt æt wʌn əˈnʌðər ænd ʃʊk ðɛr hɛdz
dialogue.zh: 他们面面相觑,摇了摇头。

dialogue.en: 'We have nothing to do today,' the monkey continued
dialogue.ipa: wi hæv ˈnʌθɪŋ tu du təˈdeɪ ðə ˈmʌŋki kənˈtɪnjud
dialogue.zh: 我们今天没什么事做,猴子继续说道。

dialogue.en: Why don't we follow the stream to find its source
dialogue.ipa: waɪ doʊnt wi ˈfɑloʊ ðə strim tu faɪnd ɪts sɔrs
dialogue.zh: 我们为什么不沿着小溪去找它的源头呢? ”

dialogue.en: 'That sounds like fun,' said another monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðæt saʊndz laɪk fʌn sɛd əˈnʌðər ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 另一只猴子说: “ 听起来很有趣。 ”

dialogue.ipa: lɛts ɡoʊ sɛd ə θɜrd ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 咱们走吧 , 第三只猴子说道

dialogue.en: Everyone jumped out of the water
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn ʤʌmpt aʊt ʌv ðə ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: They ran alongside the stream and swung from tree to tree
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ræn əˈlɔŋˈsaɪd ðə strim ænd swʌŋ frʌm tri tu tri
dialogue.zh: 他们沿着小溪奔跑,在树间荡来荡去。

dialogue.en: They jumped over rocks and climbed up steep cliffs
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ʤʌmpt ˈoʊvər rɑks ænd klaɪmd ʌp stip klɪfs
dialogue.zh: 他们跳过岩石,爬上陡峭的悬崖。

dialogue.en: Higher and higher they went up the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ˈhaɪər ænd ˈhaɪər ðeɪ wɛnt ʌp ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 他们越爬越高,向山上进发。

dialogue.en: Until they reached an enormous waterfall. Mist filled the air.
dialogue.ipa: ən ˈtɪl ðeɪ riʧt ən ɪˈnɔrməs ˈwɔtərˌfɔl mɪst fɪld ði ɛr
dialogue.zh: 直到他们来到一个巨大的瀑布前。空气中弥漫着水雾

dialogue.en: The water crashed down roaring like thunder
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔtər kræʃt daʊn ˈrɔrɪŋ laɪk ˈθʌndər
dialogue.zh: 水流轰鸣而下,如同雷声。

dialogue.en: 'I wonder what's behind that waterfall,' said one monkey
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈwʌndər wʌts bɪˈhaɪnd ðæt ˈwɔtərˌfɔl sɛd wʌn ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 一只猴子说: “ 我想知道瀑布后面是什么。 ”

dialogue.ipa: mi tu sɛd ə ˈsɛkənd ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: “ 我也是。 ” 第二只猴子说。

dialogue.en: But nobody could jump through it
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ˈnoʊˌbɑˌdi kʊd ʤʌmp θru ɪt

dialogue.en: Whoever can jump through it and come back alive will be our king
dialogue.ipa: huˈɛvər kæn ʤʌmp θru ɪt ænd kʌm bæk əˈlaɪv wɪl bi ˈaʊər kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 谁能活着跳过去再回来,谁就是我们的王。

dialogue.en: Is anyone brave enough to try
dialogue.ipa: ɪz ˈɛniˌwʌn breɪv ɪˈnʌf tu traɪ

dialogue.en: All the monkeys and apes looked at one another
dialogue.ipa: ɔl ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps lʊkt æt wʌn əˈnʌðər
dialogue.zh: 所有的猴子和猿猴都面面相觑。

dialogue.en: 'I'm not going to try,' said a tall monkey
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu traɪ sɛd ə tɔl ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: “ 我不去试。 ” 一只高个子猴子说。

dialogue.ipa: mi ˈniðər sɛd ə ʃɔrt ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: “ 我也不去。 ” 一只矮猴子说。

dialogue.en: Everyone moved out of the way as the speaker stepped forward
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn muvd aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ æz ðə ˈspikər stɛpt ˈfɔrwərd
dialogue.zh: 讲话者一上前,大家纷纷让开了道。

dialogue.ipa: ɑr ju ʃʊr æskt ðə ˈɡɪbən

dialogue.en: And when I come back, I will be king
dialogue.ipa: ænd wɛn aɪ kʌm bæk aɪ wɪl bi kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 等我回来时,我就是国王了。

dialogue.en: Monkey took a deep breath, and leaped into the waterfall
dialogue.ipa: ˈmʌŋki tʊk ə dip brɛθ ænd lɛpt ˈɪntu ðə ˈwɔtərˌfɔl
dialogue.zh: 猴子深吸一口气,纵身跳进了瀑布。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: A rock had sat high on top of a mountain
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: He turned to one of his captains who was standing nearby
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: A rock had sat high on top of a mountain
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: 'It is so hot today,' cried one monkey
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Whoever can jump through it and come back alive will be our king
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Whoever can jump through it and come back alive will be our king
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: He could see everything that had just happened
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's play in the stream
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There had been a rock on the mountain
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: He turned to one of his captains who was standing nearby
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: 'Well,' Said the Jade Emperor when the captain returned
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: 'It is so hot today,' cried one monkey
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: Why don’t we/you + 动词原形?
grammar.description: 以疑问形式提出建议，意思是“为什么不……呢”。
grammar.source: Why don't we follow the stream to find its source
examples: Why don't we follow the river?
Why don't we ask Wukong?
Why don't you wait here?
Why don't we look inside the cave?
Why don't we take a rest?
Why don't you tell the king?
Why don't we cross the bridge?
Why don't we call the others?
Why don't you bring some food?
Why don't we try another way?

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: 'Find out what caused that light', said the Emperor
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: be + 形容词 + enough + to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示“足够……可以做某事”；enough 放在形容词后面。
grammar.source: Is anyone brave enough to try
examples: Wukong is strong enough to lift the rock.
The rope is long enough to reach the ground.
She is brave enough to enter the cave.
The water is shallow enough to cross.
Bajie is tall enough to reach the branch.
The room is large enough to hold everyone.
He is old enough to travel alone.
The light is bright enough to guide us.
They are careful enough to climb safely.
Are you ready enough to begin?

grammar.pattern: 比较级 + than / 比较级 and 比较级
grammar.description: 比较两者差异，或表达程度不断变化。
grammar.source: Higher and higher they went up the mountain
examples: Wukong is stronger than the demon.
This road is shorter than the other one.
The river is wider than before.
Bajie is hungrier than Wujing.
The mountain is higher than the hill.
The cave became darker and darker.
They walked faster and faster.
The sound grew louder and louder.
This plan is better than the first one.
The journey became more and more difficult.

The captain rushed out of the hall
He looked out the southern gate of Heaven and saw the monkey on earth below
He looked out the southern gate of Heaven and saw the monkey on earth below
The monkey came from the rock
Amazing things happen when heaven and earth work together
As time passed, Monkey learned to walk, run and climb
As time passed, Monkey learned to walk, run and climb
At night he slept under a cliff
'Good idea,' said another monkey
The monkeys jumped into the cool water
We know that it flows all the way to the ocean
They all looked at one another and shook their heads
They all looked at one another and shook their heads
They all looked at one another and shook their heads
'We have nothing to do today,' the monkey continued
They jumped over rocks and climbed up steep cliffs
Higher and higher they went up the mountain
Whoever can jump through it and come back alive will be our king
Whoever can jump through it and come back alive will be our king
Is anyone brave enough to try
A voice called out
Everyone moved out of the way as the speaker stepped forward
Everyone moved out of the way as the speaker stepped forward
Monkey took a deep breath, and leaped into the waterfall

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter2 the Waterfall Cave

dialogue.en: Monkey splashed through the waterfall and landed in a large cave
dialogue.ipa: ˈmʌŋki splæʃt θru ðə ˈwɔtərˌfɔl ænd ˈlændɪd ɪn ə lɑrʤ keɪv
dialogue.zh: 猴子穿过瀑布,落进一个大山洞里

dialogue.en: The cave was filled with bamboo, trees and beautiful flowers
dialogue.ipa: ðə keɪv wʌz fɪld wɪð bæmˈbu triz ænd ˈbjutəfəl ˈflaʊərz
dialogue.zh: 洞穴里长满了竹子、树木和美丽的花朵。

dialogue.en: A stream flowed through the cave and glowing light and mist filled the air
dialogue.ipa: ə strim floʊd θru ðə keɪv ænd ˈɡloʊɪŋ laɪt ænd mɪst fɪld ði ɛr
dialogue.zh: 一条小溪流过洞穴,空气中弥漫着微光和薄雾。

dialogue.en: Monkey found a long table with bowls, cups and plates
dialogue.ipa: ˈmʌŋki faʊnd ə lɔŋ ˈteɪbəl wɪð boʊlz kʌps ænd pleɪts
dialogue.zh: 猴子发现了一张长桌,上面摆着碗、杯子和盘子。

dialogue.en: A fireplace sat against one wall
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈfaɪərˌpleɪs sæt əˈɡɛnst wʌn wɔl

dialogue.en: Deeper in the cave Monkey found bedrooms with cozy beds
dialogue.ipa: ˈdipər ɪn ðə keɪv ˈmʌŋki faʊnd ˈbɛˌdrumz wɪð ˈkoʊzi bɛdz
dialogue.zh: 洞穴深处,猴子发现了几间卧室,里面摆着舒适的床。

dialogue.en: Outside the other monkeys and apes were looking at the waterfall
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ði ˈʌðər ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps wɜr ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ðə ˈwɔtər ˌfɔl
dialogue.zh: 外面,其他猴子们正盯着瀑布看。

dialogue.en: 'Do you think he made it through?' asked one monkey
dialogue.ipa: du ju θɪŋk hi meɪd ɪt θru æskt wʌn ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 你们觉得他成功穿过去了吗?一只猴子问道。

dialogue.en: He probably got washed away down the river
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈprɑbəbli ɡɑt wɑʃt əˈweɪ daʊn ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: Monkey shot out of the waterfall
dialogue.ipa: ˈmʌŋki ʃɑt aʊt ʌv ðə ˈwɔtərˌfɔl
dialogue.zh: 猴子从瀑布里冲了出来

dialogue.en: And landed in front of the group
dialogue.ipa: ænd ˈlændɪd ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə ɡrup

dialogue.zh: 那只猴子说: “ 你还活着。 ”

dialogue.en: Yes, and we are very lucky
dialogue.ipa: jɛs ænd wi ɑr ˈvɛri ˈlʌki
dialogue.zh: 是的,而且我们非常幸运

dialogue.en: I found a perfect home for all of us
dialogue.ipa: aɪ faʊnd ə ˈpɜrˌfɪkt hoʊm fɔr ɔl ʌv ʌs
dialogue.zh: 我为我们大家找到了一个完美的家

dialogue.en: Monkey jumped back through the water
dialogue.ipa: ˈmʌŋki ʤʌmpt bæk θru ðə ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: Some of the monkeys scratched their heads
dialogue.ipa: sʌm ʌv ðə ˈmʌŋkiz skræʧt ðɛr hɛdz

dialogue.en: 'It still looks dangerous,' said one monkey
dialogue.ipa: ɪt stɪl lʊks ˈdeɪnʤərəs sɛd wʌn ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 一只猴子说,看起来还是很危险。
那只长臂猿说,我们走吧。

dialogue.en: After that, another monkey jumped through
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ðæt əˈnʌðər ˈmʌŋki ʤʌmpt θru
dialogue.zh: 之后,又一只猴子跳了过去。
接着更多的猴子跳了过去

dialogue.en: Soon all of the monkeys and apes were in the cave
dialogue.ipa: suːn ɔːl əv ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps wɜːr ɪn ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 很快,所有的猴子和猿都进了山洞

dialogue.en: Everyone ran around to see all the wonderful things
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn ræn əˈraʊnd tu si ɔl ðə ˈwʌndərfəl θɪŋz
dialogue.zh: 大家跑来跑去,看遍了所有奇妙的东西

dialogue.en: 'This cave is beautiful,' said the gibbon
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs keɪv ɪz ˈbjutəfəl sɛd ðə ˈɡɪbən
dialogue.zh: 长臂猿说: “ 这个洞穴真美。 ”

dialogue.en: Some of the monkeys and apes began fighting and arguing
dialogue.ipa: sʌm ʌv ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps bɪˈɡæn ˈfaɪtɪŋ ænd ˈɑrɡjuɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 一些猴子和猿猴开始争吵打斗

dialogue.en: They grabbed plates and bowls from one another
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ɡræbd pleɪts ænd boʊlz frʌm wʌn əˈnʌðər
dialogue.zh: 他们互相抢夺盘子和碗

dialogue.en: 'I saw this bed first,' yelled one monkey
dialogue.ipa: aɪ sɔ ðɪs bɛd fɜrst jɛld wʌn ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 我先看到这张床的!一只猴子喊道。
“ 不! ” 另一只猴子喊道。

dialogue.en: Monkey watched his friends for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ˈmʌŋki wɑʧt hɪz frɛndz fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt
dialogue.zh: 猴子看着他的朋友们片刻

dialogue.en: All the monkeys and apes stopped what they were doing
dialogue.ipa: ɔl ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps stɑpt wɑt ðeɪ wɜr ˈduɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 所有的猴子和猿都停下了手中的事

dialogue.en: 'I found this cave for us,' said Monkey
dialogue.ipa: aɪ faʊnd ðɪs keɪv fɔr ʌs sɛd ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 石猴说: “ 我为我们找到了这个洞穴。 ”

dialogue.en: That means I am now your king
dialogue.ipa: ðæt minz aɪ æm naʊ jʊər kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 这意味着我现在是你们的王

dialogue.en: Why aren't you bowing to me
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ˈɑrənt ju ˈboʊɪŋ tu mi
dialogue.zh: 你们为什么不向我鞠躬
长臂猿说道: “ 他说得对。 ”

dialogue.en: He bowed to Monkey and said
dialogue.ipa: hi baʊd tu ˈmʌŋki ænd sɛd

dialogue.en: 'All hail the Monkey King,' they shouted
dialogue.ipa: ɔl heɪl ðə ˈmʌŋki kɪŋ ðeɪ ˈʃaʊtɪd
dialogue.zh: 他们齐声高呼美猴王万岁。

dialogue.en: During the day,the monkeys and apes played in the forest and the stream
dialogue.ipa: ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə deɪ ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps pleɪd ɪn ðə ˈfɔrəst ænd ðə strim
dialogue.zh: 白天,猴子和猿在森林和小溪里玩耍。

dialogue.en: And every night they slept safely in their cave
dialogue.ipa: ænd ˈɛvəri naɪt ðeɪ slɛpt ˈseɪfli ɪn ðɛr keɪv
dialogue.zh: 每晚他们都在洞穴中安全入睡

dialogue.en: One night, the monkeys and apes had a huge feast
dialogue.ipa: wʌn naɪt ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps hæd ə hjuʤ fist
dialogue.zh: 一天晚上,猴子和猿们举办了一场盛大的宴会。

dialogue.en: Fruits and nuts covered the table
dialogue.ipa: fruts ænd nʌts ˈkʌvərd ðə ˈteɪbəl
dialogue.zh: 水果和坚果摆满了桌子

dialogue.en: Monkeys and apes danced and sang while music played
dialogue.ipa: ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps dænst ænd sæŋ waɪl ˈmjuzɪk pleɪd
dialogue.zh: 猴子和猿随着音乐跳舞唱歌

dialogue.en: Monkey sat on his throne and smiled
dialogue.ipa: ˈmʌŋki sæt ɑn hɪz θroʊn ænd smaɪld
dialogue.zh: 猴子坐在他的王座上微笑
但随后他的笑容消失了

dialogue.en: The gibbon saw Monkey and rushed over
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈɡɪbən sɔ ˈmʌŋki ænd rʌʃt ˈoʊvər
dialogue.zh: 长臂猿看到猴子并冲了过来
你看起来很难过,怎么了?
我们在这里的生活很完美

dialogue.ipa: jɛs ðæts tru sɛd ðə ˈɡɪbən
dialogue.zh: 是的,确实如此,长臂猿说道。

dialogue.en: Monkey was quiet for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ˈmʌŋki wʌz ˈkwaɪət fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt

dialogue.en: Then he said, 'Someday our lives will end.'
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi sɛd ˈsʌmˌdeɪ ˈaʊər lɪvz wɪl ɛnd
dialogue.zh: 然后他说,总有一天我们的生命会走到尽头。

dialogue.en: I wish this perfect life could last forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪʃ ðɪs ˈpɜrˌfɪkt laɪf kʊd læst fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 我希望这完美的生活能永远持续下去
长臂猿的眼睛亮了起来

dialogue.en: Then you must study with a sage
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ju mʌst ˈstʌdi wɪð ə seɪʤ
dialogue.zh: 那你必须向一位智者学习
智者是非常有智慧的人

dialogue.en: They can turn themselves into other animals
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ kæn tɜrn ðɛm ˈsɛlvz ˈɪntu ˈʌðər ˈænəməlz
dialogue.zh: 他们能将自己变成其他动物

dialogue.en: They can fly through the sky
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ kæn flaɪ θru ðə skaɪ

dialogue.en: And they know how to live forever
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðeɪ noʊ haʊ tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 而且他们知道如何长生不老

dialogue.en: 'Where can I find a sage?' he asked.
dialogue.ipa: wɛr kæn aɪ faɪnd ə seɪʤ hi æskt
dialogue.zh: 我在哪里才能找到智者呢,石猴说?

dialogue.en: 'You must find a land with people,' said the gibbon
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst faɪnd ə lænd wɪð ˈpipəl sɛd ðə ˈɡɪbən
dialogue.zh: 长臂猿说,你必须找到有人居住的地方。

dialogue.en: That's where you'll find a sage
dialogue.ipa: ðæts wɛr jul faɪnd ə seɪʤ

dialogue.en: The next morning, Monkey built a raft and loaded food onto it
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈmʌŋki bɪlt ə ræft ænd ˈloʊdɪd fud ˈɑntu ɪt
dialogue.zh: 第二天早上,猴子造了个木筏,把食物搬了上去。

dialogue.en: He pushed the raft into the stream and jumped on
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊʃt ðə ræft ˈɪntu ðə strim ænd ʤʌmpt ɑn
dialogue.zh: 他把木筏推入溪流,然后跳了上去

dialogue.en: As the raft began to float away
dialogue.ipa: æz ðə ræft bɪˈɡæn tu floʊt əˈweɪ

dialogue.zh: 猴子向他的朋友们挥手告别

dialogue.en: After I learn how to live forever, I will return.
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər aɪ lɜrn haʊ tə lɪv fərˈɛvər, aɪ wɪl rɪˈtɜrn.
dialogue.zh: 等我学会长生不老之术,我就会回来的。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: His eyes opened wide
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Outside the other monkeys and apes were looking at the waterfall
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: 'Do you think he made it through?' asked one monkey
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Then he said, 'Someday our lives will end.'
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: The cave was filled with bamboo, trees and beautiful flowers
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: They can turn themselves into other animals
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: I wish this perfect life could last forever
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Then you must study with a sage
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: You want to live forever ?
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: 'Let's go,' said the gibbon
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Follow me
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That means I am now your king
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: Monkeys and apes danced and sang while music played
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So why are you sad
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: And they know how to live forever
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

Monkey watched his friends for a moment

You want to live forever ?
The next morning, Monkey built a raft and loaded food onto it
As the raft began to float away

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 3 Subodhi

dialogue.en: Monkey sailed over the ocean for a long time
dialogue.ipa: ˈmʌŋki seɪld ˈoʊvər ði ˈoʊʃən fɔr ə lɔŋ taɪm
dialogue.zh: 猴子漂洋过海,历经漫长时光

dialogue.en: Finally he arrived at a new land
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪnəli hi əˈraɪvd æt ə nu lænd

dialogue.en: He walked for many years , visiting towns and meeting people.
dialogue.ipa: hi wɔkt fɔr ˈmɛni jɪrz ˈvɪzətɪŋ taʊnz ænd ˈmitɪŋ ˈpipəl
dialogue.zh: 他走了很多年,游历各地城镇,结识了形形色色的人。

dialogue.en: But he didn't find a sage anywhere
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hi ˈdɪdənt faɪnd ə seɪʤ ˈɛni ˌwɛr
dialogue.zh: 却始终未寻得任何高人

dialogue.en: Eventually he came to mountains covered in thick forest
dialogue.ipa: ɪ ˈvɛnʧəwəli hi keɪm tu ˈmaʊntənz ˈkʌvərd ɪn θɪk ˈfɔrəst
dialogue.zh: 最终来到群山环绕、密林覆盖之地

dialogue.en: He headed up a steep mountain trail and soon heard chopping
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈhɛdɪd ʌp ə stip ˈmaʊntən treɪl ænd sun hɜrd ˈʧɑpɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 他沿着陡峭的山路向上走,很快就听到了砍树的声音。

dialogue.en: Are there any sages in these mountains
dialogue.ipa: ɑr ðɛr ˈɛni ˈseɪʤɪz ɪn ðiz ˈmaʊntənz

dialogue.en: And I want to live forever
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ wɑnt tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: Do you know where I can find a sage
dialogue.ipa: du ju noʊ wɛr aɪ kæn faɪnd ə seɪʤ

dialogue.en: A sage named Subodhi lives on this mountain
dialogue.ipa: ə seɪʤ neɪmd Subodhi lɪvz ɑn ðɪs ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 此山住着一位菩提祖师

dialogue.en: Just follow this trail and you will come to his home
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ˈfɑloʊ ðɪs treɪl ænd ju wɪl kʌm tu hɪz hoʊm
dialogue.zh: 沿着这条小路走就能到他家。

dialogue.en: He waved goodbye to the woodcutter and ran up the trail
dialogue.ipa: hi weɪvd ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ tu ðəˈwʊdkʌtər ænd ræn ʌp ðə treɪl
dialogue.zh: 向樵夫挥手道别,沿山路飞奔而上

dialogue.en: Soon he saw a temple built into the side of the mountain
dialogue.ipa: sun hi sɔ ə ˈtɛmpəl bɪlt ˈɪntu ðə saɪd ʌv ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 不久,他看到一座嵌入山壁的道观

dialogue.en: Subodhi was sitting with his students in the main room of his temple
dialogue.ipa: Subodhi wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ wɪð hɪz ˈstudənts ɪn ðə meɪn rum ʌv hɪz ˈtɛmpəl
dialogue.zh: 菩提祖师正和弟子们在观中主殿静坐

dialogue.en: He looked at his oldest student
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt hɪz ˈoʊldəst ˈstudənt

dialogue.en: 'Please go to the door,' said Subodhi
dialogue.ipa: pliz ɡoʊ tu ðə dɔr sɛd Subodhi

dialogue.en: A new student is about to arrive
dialogue.ipa: ə nu ˈstudənt ɪz əˈbaʊt tu əˈraɪv

dialogue.en: The student got up and went to the door of the temple
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈstudənt ɡɑt ʌp ænd wɛnt tu ðə dɔr ʌv ðə ˈtɛmpəl

dialogue.zh: 我来此是为了拜见须菩提。

dialogue.en: A moment later Monkey was standing in front of the sage
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər ˈmʌŋki wʌz ˈstændɪŋ ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə seɪʤ
dialogue.zh: 片刻之后,猴子已站在了这位智者面前。

dialogue.en: 'I want to be your student,' said Monkey.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt tu bi jʊər ˈstudənt sɛd ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 猴子说,我想当你的弟子。

dialogue.en: 'But you're just a monkey,' said Subodhi.
dialogue.ipa: bʌt jʊr ʤʌst ə ˈmʌŋki sɛd Subodhi
dialogue.zh: 但你不过是只猴子,须菩提说道。

dialogue.en: How can you be my student
dialogue.ipa: haʊ kæn ju bi maɪ ˈstudənt

dialogue.en: But I can walk and talk and do many other things
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ kæn wɔk ænd tɔk ænd du ˈmɛni ˈʌðər θɪŋz
dialogue.zh: 但我能行走、说话,还能做许多其他事情。

dialogue.en: I traveled almost 13 years to get here
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈtrævəld ˈɔlˌmoʊst 13 jɪrz tu ɡɛt hir
dialogue.zh: 我花了将近十三年才来到这里。

dialogue.en: I'm sure I can be your student
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʃʊr aɪ kæn bi jʊər ˈstudənt
dialogue.zh: 我相信我能成为您的弟子。

dialogue.en: Subodhi stared at Monkey for a moment
dialogue.ipa: Subodhi stɛrd æt ˈmʌŋki fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt
dialogue.zh: 须菩提凝视了猴子片刻。

dialogue.ipa: hu ɑr jʊər ˈpɛrənts hi æskt
dialogue.zh: “ 你的父母是谁? ” 他问道。

dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt hæv ˈpɛrənts hi sɛd

dialogue.en: I was born from a rock
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz bɔrn frʌm ə rɑk
dialogue.zh: 我是从石头里蹦出来的。

dialogue.en: You are probably created by heaven and earth
dialogue.ipa: ju ɑr ˈprɑbəbli kri ˈeɪtɪd baɪ ˈhɛvən ænd ɜrθ

dialogue.en: I will call you Sun Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl kɔl ju sʌn WuKong

dialogue.en: For the next seven years, Sun Wukong lived in Subodhi's temple
dialogue.ipa: fɔr ðə nɛkst ˈsɛvən jɪrz sʌn Wukong lɪvd in Subodhi's ˈtɛmpəl
dialogue.zh: 接下来的七年,孙悟空就住在须菩提的道观里。

dialogue.en: The monkey spent his days meditating, listening to his teacher's lessons and doing chores.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki spɛnt hɪz deɪz ˈmɛdəˌteɪtɪŋ ˈlɪsənɪŋ tu hɪz ˈtiʧərz ˈlɛsənz ænd ˈduɪŋ ʧɔrz
dialogue.zh: 猴子每天打坐 , 听师父讲经,做杂务。

dialogue.en: One day while Subodhi was giving a lesson, Wukong started to dance
dialogue.ipa: wʌn deɪ waɪl Subodhi wʌz ˈɡɪvɪŋ ə ˈlɛsən WuKong ˈstɑrtɪd tu dæns
dialogue.zh: 有一天须菩提正在讲课时,悟空突然手舞足蹈起来。

dialogue.en: 'How dare you dance while I'm teaching,' he shouted
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju dæns waɪl aɪm ˈtiʧɪŋ hi ˈʃaʊtɪd
dialogue.zh: 你竟敢在我上课的时候跳舞?他吼道。

dialogue.en: But I was so happy, I needed to dance
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ wʌz soʊ ˈhæpi aɪ ˈnidɪd tu dæns
dialogue.zh: 但我高兴得忍不住要跳舞

dialogue.en: Wukong you have been here a long time
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ju hæv bɪn hir ə lɔŋ taɪm
dialogue.zh: 悟空,你在这里已经很久了。

dialogue.en: 'What would you like to learn from me?' asked Subodhi
dialogue.ipa: wɑt wʊd ju laɪk tu lɜrn frʌm mi æskt Subodhi
dialogue.zh: 你想从我这儿学些什么?须菩提问。

dialogue.en: You tell me what I should learn
dialogue.ipa: ju tɛl mi wɑt aɪ ʃʊd lɜrn

dialogue.en: I can teach you how to tell the future
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn tiʧ ju haʊ tu tɛl ðə ˈfjuʧər
dialogue.zh: 我可以教你如何预知未来

dialogue.en: Will it make me live forever
dialogue.ipa: wɪl ɪt meɪk mi lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: How about some magic breathing exercises
dialogue.ipa: haʊ əˈbaʊt sʌm ˈmæʤɪk ˈbriðɪŋ ˈɛksərˌsaɪzəz
dialogue.zh: 学些神奇的呼吸吐纳之术如何

dialogue.en: 'Will they make me live forever?' asked Wukong
dialogue.ipa: wɪl ðeɪ meɪk mi lɪv fəˈrɛvər æskt Wukong
dialogue.zh: 悟空问道: “ 它们能让我长生不老吗? ”
“ 不行, ” 须菩提皱着眉头说道。

dialogue.ipa: ðɛn aɪm nɑt ˈɪntrɪstɪd sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 那我就不感兴趣了,悟空说道。

dialogue.en: He stood up and knocked Wukong on the head three times
dialogue.ipa: hi stʊd ʌp ænd nɑkt Wukong ɑn ðə hɛd θri taɪmz
dialogue.zh: 他站起来,在悟空头上敲了三下

dialogue.en: You were very rude to master
dialogue.ipa: ju wər ˈvɛri rud tu ˈmæstər

dialogue.en: None of the other students knew it
dialogue.ipa: nʌn ʌv ði ˈʌðər ˈstudənts nu ɪt

dialogue.en: But Subodhi had given him a secret message
dialogue.ipa: bʌt Subodhi hæd ˈɡɪvən hɪm ə ˈsikrət ˈmɛsəʤ
dialogue.zh: 但须菩提其实给了他一个秘密暗示

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Finally he arrived at a new land
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: A woodcutter was chopping firewood
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: But Subodhi had given him a secret message
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: 'Yes, I am,' said Monkey
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: Wukong you have been here a long time
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Just follow this trail and you will come to his home
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Monkey was excited
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Do you know where I can find a sage
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: You tell me what I should learn
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: And I want to live forever
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: One day while Subodhi was giving a lesson, Wukong started to dance
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: But I was so happy, I needed to dance
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: Do you know where I can find a sage
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

titleEn: Journey to the West , Chapter 4 Secret Formulas

dialogue.en: When the other students went to bed that night , Wukong stayed awake.
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ði ˈʌðər ˈstudənts wɛnt tu bɛd ðæt naɪt Wukong steɪd əˈweɪk
dialogue.zh: 那天晚上其他学生都去睡觉了,悟空却还醒着。

dialogue.en: At three o'clock in the morning, he crept quietly through the dark temple.
dialogue.ipa: æt θri əˈklɑk ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ hi krɛpt ˈkwaɪətli θru ðə dɑrk ˈtɛmpəl
dialogue.zh: 凌晨三点,他悄悄穿过黑暗的寺庙。

dialogue.en: 'Wukong, what are you doing here?' asked the sage.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wɑt ɑr ju ˈduɪŋ hir æskt ðə seɪʤ
dialogue.zh: 悟空,你在这儿干嘛呢?圣人问道。

dialogue.en: 'I understood your secret message,' said the monkey.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˌʌndər ˈstʊd jʊər ˈsikrət ˈmɛsəʤ sɛd ðə ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 猴子说,我明白你的暗号了。

dialogue.en: You hit me on the head three times.
dialogue.ipa: ju hɪt mi ɑn ðə hɛd θri taɪmz

dialogue.en: That meant you wanted me to visit you at three o'clock
dialogue.ipa: ðæt mɛnt ju ˈwɔntɪd mi tu ˈvɪzət ju æt θri əˈklɑk
dialogue.zh: 那意味着您要我三点钟来见您

dialogue.en: Now will you teach me how to live forever ?
dialogue.ipa: naʊ wɪl ju tiʧ mi haʊ tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 现在您能教我如何长生不老吗 ?

dialogue.en: I knew you were a worthy student.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nu ju wɜr ə ˈwɜrði ˈstudənt
dialogue.zh: 我就知道你是个可造之材。

dialogue.en: ‘Come closer , ’ Subodhi whispered into Wukong's ear.
dialogue.ipa: kʌm ˈkloʊsər Subodhi ˈwɪspərd ˈɪntu Wukong's ir
dialogue.zh: 靠近些,菩提祖师对着悟空的耳朵低语。

dialogue.en: The sage whispered prayers as well as secret formulas about the universe and nature
dialogue.ipa: ðə seɪʤ ˈwɪspərd prɛrz æz wɛl æz ˈsikrət ˈfɔrmjələz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈjunəˌvɜrs ænd ˈneɪʧər
dialogue.zh: 圣人悄声诵咒,兼授天地自然之秘诀

dialogue.en: As the monkey listened to his teacher's words , powerful light filled the room.
dialogue.ipa: æz ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈlɪsənd tu hɪz ˈtiʧərz wɜrdz ˈpaʊərfəl laɪt fɪld ðə rum
dialogue.zh: 当猴子聆听师父的教诲时,整个房间充满了强大的光芒。

dialogue.en: Now Wukong knew how to live forever.
dialogue.ipa: naʊ Wukong nu haʊ tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 如今悟空知道了长生不老之法。

dialogue.en: For the next few years, Wukong meditated and practiced the secret formulas.
dialogue.ipa: fɔr ðə nɛkst fju jɪrz Wukong ˈmɛdəˌteɪtɪd ænd ˈpræktəst ðə ˈsikrət ˈfɔrmjələz
dialogue.zh: 接下来的几年里,悟空一边冥想一边修炼这些秘传法门。

dialogue.en: While the other students slept at night, Wukong stayed up
dialogue.ipa: waɪl ði ˈʌðər ˈstudənts slɛpt æt naɪt Wukong steɪd ʌp
dialogue.zh: 其他学生晚上睡觉时,悟空却彻夜不眠。

dialogue.en: Soon his mind and body were powerful
dialogue.ipa: sun hɪz maɪnd ænd ˈbɑdi wɜr ˈpaʊərfəl
dialogue.zh: 很快他的身心都变得强大

dialogue.en: And he could change shape or size
dialogue.ipa: ænd hi kʊd ʧeɪnʤ ʃeɪp ɔr saɪz
dialogue.zh: 并且能够变化形态或大小

dialogue.en: He could turn into other animals
dialogue.ipa: hi kʊd tɜrn ˈɪntu ˈʌðər ˈænəməlz

dialogue.en: And soar through the sky on clouds
dialogue.ipa: ænd sɔr θru ðə skaɪ ɑn klaʊdz

dialogue.en: One day all the students were sitting outside
dialogue.ipa: wʌn deɪ ɔl ðə ˈstudənts wɜr ˈsɪtɪŋ ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 有一天,所有学生都坐在外面
确实如此,另一个学生说道。

dialogue.en: 'I've been meditating and practicing secret formulas,' said Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: aɪv bɪn ˈmɛdəˌteɪtɪŋ ænd ˈpræktəsɪŋ ˈsikrət ˈfɔrmjələz sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 悟空说,我一直在冥想,修炼秘传法门。

dialogue.ipa: ˈsikrət ˈfɔrmjələz sɛd ðə fɜrst ˈstudənt
dialogue.zh: ' 秘传法门 ?' 第一个学生说道。
大家都显得非常感兴趣

dialogue.en: They leaned in closer to Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ lind ɪn ˈkloʊsər tu Wukong
dialogue.zh: 他们向悟空凑得更近了些

dialogue.en: Our master told them to me
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər ˈmæstər toʊld ðɛm tu mi
dialogue.zh: 我们的师父传授给我的

dialogue.en: He doesn't tell everyone those formulas
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈdʌzənt tɛl ˈɛvriˌwʌn ðoʊz ˈfɔrmjələz
dialogue.zh: 他没有把那些秘诀告诉所有人

dialogue.en: He taught me how to live forever
dialogue.ipa: hi tɔt mi haʊ tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: He also taught me how to change into other things
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈɔlsoʊ tɔt mi haʊ tu ʧeɪnʤ ˈɪntu ˈʌðər θɪŋz
dialogue.zh: 他还教我如何变身成其他东西

dialogue.en: ‘Show us what you can do ! ’ said the student.
dialogue.ipa: ʃoʊ ʌs wɑt ju kæn du sɛd ðə ˈstudənt
dialogue.zh: 给我们看看你的本事,一个弟子说道。

dialogue.en: He muttered a quick spell and made a sign with his hands
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈmʌtərd ə kwɪk spɛl ænd meɪd ə saɪn wɪð hɪz hændz
dialogue.zh: 他低声念了句咒语 同时双手比了个手势

dialogue.en: An enormous pine tree stood in his place
dialogue.ipa: ən ɪˈnɔrməs paɪn tri stʊd ɪn hɪz pleɪs
dialogue.zh: 原地出现了一棵巨大的松树

dialogue.en: Wukong's voice came from the tree
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋz vɔɪs keɪm frʌm ðə tri
dialogue.zh: 悟空的声音从树中传来
太神奇了,一个弟子说道。

dialogue.en: 'The monkey is truly powerful,' said another.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ɪz ˈtruli ˈpaʊərfəl sɛd əˈnʌðər
dialogue.zh: 这猴子真厉害,另一个弟子说道。

dialogue.en: He ran outside and saw the enormous pine tree
dialogue.ipa: hi ræn ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd sɔ ði ɪˈnɔrməs paɪn tri
dialogue.zh: 他跑出来看到了那棵巨大的松树

dialogue.en: ‘What's going on out here ? ’ he shouted.
dialogue.ipa: wʌts ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn aʊt hir hi ˈʃaʊtɪd

dialogue.en: Wukong quickly turned back into himself
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˈkwɪkli tɜrnd bæk ˈɪntu hɪmˈsɛlf

dialogue.en: ‘Everyone but Wukong, go inside , ’ he yelled.
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn bʌt Wukong ɡoʊ ɪnˈsaɪd hi jɛld
dialogue.zh: 除了悟空,其他人都进去,他喊道。

dialogue.en: Subodhi waited for the other students to leave
dialogue.ipa: Subodhi ˈweɪtɪd fɔr ði ˈʌðər ˈstudənts tu liv
dialogue.zh: 须菩提等其他弟子离开

dialogue.en: 'I taught you the secret formula so you could live forever,' said the Sage.
dialogue.ipa: 1 aɪ tɔt ju ðə ˈsikrət ˈfɔrmjələ soʊ ju kʊd lɪv fəˈrɛvər sɛd ðə seɪʤ
dialogue.zh: 圣人说,我教你长生秘诀是为了让你永生。

dialogue.en: Not so you could show off
dialogue.ipa: nɑt soʊ ju kʊd ʃoʊ ɔf

dialogue.en: Now all of the students have seen what you can do
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ɔl ʌv ðə ˈstudənts hæv sin wɑt ju kæn du
dialogue.zh: 现在所有弟子都见识了你的本事

dialogue.en: They will want to know how to do it too
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɪl wɑnt tu noʊ haʊ tu du ɪt tu

dialogue.en: If you don't tell them, They might harm you.
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju doʊnt tɛl ðɛm ðeɪ maɪt hɑrm ju
dialogue.zh: 如果你不告诉他们,他们可能会伤害你。

dialogue.en: It's not safe for you to stay here anymore
dialogue.ipa: ɪts nɑt seɪf fɔr ju tu steɪ hir ˌɛniˈmɔr

dialogue.en: But master, Where will I go?
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ˈmæstər wɛr wɪl aɪ ɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 可是师父,我能去哪儿呢

dialogue.en: 'But you taught me so many things,' said the monkey
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju tɔt mi soʊ ˈmɛni θɪŋz sɛd ðə ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 但您教了我这么多本领,猴子说道。

dialogue.en: 'You don't need to repay me,' said Subodhi.
dialogue.ipa: ju doʊnt nid tu riˈpeɪ mi sɛd Subodhi
dialogue.zh: 你不需要报答我,须菩提说道。

dialogue.en: Just try to stay out of trouble
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst traɪ tu steɪ aʊt ʌv ˈtrʌbəl

dialogue.en: The sage looked at Wukong for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ðə seɪʤ lʊkt æt Wukong fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt

dialogue.en: I can see that you will do evil things someday
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn si ðæt ju wɪl du ˈivəl θɪŋz ˈsʌmˌdeɪ
dialogue.zh: 我看得出你将来必会作恶

dialogue.en: Don't tell anyone you are my student
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt tɛl ˈɛniˌwʌn ju ɑr maɪ ˈstudənt
dialogue.zh: 莫要告诉任何人你是我的弟子

dialogue.en: He leaped onto a cloud and left
dialogue.ipa: hi lɛpt ˈɑntu ə klaʊd ænd lɛft

dialogue.en: After a short journey , Wukong arrived at the Fruit and Flower Mountain.
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ə ʃɔrt ˈʤɜrni Wukong əˈraɪvd æt ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 悟空走了没多远,就到了花果山。

dialogue.en: Your Majesty, something terrible has happened.
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ˈmæʤəsti ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈtɛrəbəl hæz ˈhæpənd

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: When the other students went to bed that night , Wukong stayed awake.
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: One day all the students were sitting outside
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: That meant you wanted me to visit you at three o'clock
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: You have been busy lately
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Now will you teach me how to live forever ?
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: ‘Show us what you can do ! ' said the student.
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: And he could change shape or size
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You must be special
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: They will want to know how to do it too
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: Just try to stay out of trouble
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you don't tell them, They might harm you.
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When the other students went to bed that night , Wukong stayed awake.
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: While the other students slept at night, Wukong stayed up
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: 'I taught you the secret formula so you could live forever,' said the Sage.
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: They will want to know how to do it too
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: The sage whispered prayers as well as secret formulas about the universe and nature
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 5 The Demon of Chaos

dialogue.en: 'What happened here?' Wukong asked the gibbon.
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ˈhæpənd hir Wukong æskt ðə ˈɡɪbən
dialogue.zh: 这里发生了什么事?悟空问那只长臂猿。

dialogue.en: A few more monkeys and apes gathered around Sun Wukong and the gibbon
dialogue.ipa: ə fju mɔr ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps ˈɡæðərd əˈraʊnd sʌn Wukong ænd ðə ˈɡɪbən
dialogue.zh: 又有几只猴子和猿猴围拢到孙悟空和长臂猿身边

dialogue.en: 'A demon attacked us,' said the gibbon.
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈdimən əˈtækt ʌs sɛd ðə ˈɡɪbən
dialogue.zh: 有个妖怪袭击了我们,长臂猿说道。

dialogue.en: We tried to fight him, but he was too powerful
dialogue.ipa: wi traɪd tu faɪt hɪm bʌt hi wʌz tu ˈpaʊərfəl
dialogue.zh: 我们试图反抗他,但他太强大了。

dialogue.en: He stole most of our things and kidnapped many of us
dialogue.ipa: hi stoʊl moʊst ʌv ˈaʊər θɪŋz ænd ˈkɪdˌnæpt ˈmɛni ʌv ʌs
dialogue.zh: 他抢走了我们大部分东西,还抓走了我们许多同伴

dialogue.en: 'He is called the Demon of Chaos,' said the gibbon.
dialogue.ipa: hi ɪz kɔld ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈkeɪɑs sɛd ðə ˈɡɪbən
dialogue.zh: 长臂猿说,他叫混世魔王。
悟空命令道: “ 在这儿等着。 ”

dialogue.en: 'The demon is very powerful,' the gibbon warned.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ɪz ˈvɛri ˈpaʊərfəl ðə ˈɡɪbən wɔrnd
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪非常厉害,长臂猿警告说。

dialogue.en: 'I learned many things from a sage,' Wukong replied.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ lɜrnd ˈmɛni θɪŋz frʌm ə seɪʤ Wukong rɪˈplaɪd
dialogue.zh: 悟空回答说: “ 我从一位仙人那儿学了不少本事。 ”

dialogue.en: I am now as powerful as a god
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm naʊ æz ˈpaʊərfəl æz ə ɡɑd
dialogue.zh: 我现在神通广大,堪比神仙

dialogue.en: I'm not afraid of any demon
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt əˈfreɪd ʌv ˈɛni ˈdimən

dialogue.en: He leaped into the air and flew north
dialogue.ipa: hi lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd flu nɔrθ
dialogue.zh: 他纵身一跃腾空而起,向北飞去

dialogue.ipa: hɪz ˈsʌbʤɪkts stɛrd ɪn ə ˈmeɪzmənt
dialogue.zh: 他的臣民们目瞪口呆地望着

dialogue.en: 'Our king can fly,' said the gibbon.
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər kɪŋ kæn flaɪ sɛd ðə ˈɡɪbən
dialogue.zh: 长臂猿说,我们大王会飞。

dialogue.en: Wukong soon spotted a gloomy mountain
dialogue.ipa: Wukong sun ˈspɑtɪd ə ˈɡlumi ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 悟空很快发现了一座阴森的山

dialogue.en: 'That looks like a demon's home,' he thought.
dialogue.ipa: ðæt lʊks laɪk ə ˈdimənz hoʊm hi θɔt
dialogue.zh: 那看起来像是恶魔的老巢,他心想。

dialogue.en: Wukong landed on the mountain and found a cave
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˈlændɪd ɑn ðə ˈmaʊntən ænd faʊnd ə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 悟空降落在山上,发现了一个山洞

dialogue.en: Two guards stood at the entrance, practicing sword fighting
dialogue.ipa: tuː ɡɑːrdz stʊd æt ði ˈɛntrəns, ˈpræktɪsɪŋ sɔːrd ˈfaɪtɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 两个守卫站在入口处练剑。

dialogue.en: 'I'm king of the Fruit and Flower Mountain,' yelled Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: aɪm kɪŋ ʌv ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən jɛld Wukong
dialogue.zh: 我是花果山大王,悟空喝道。

dialogue.en: The Demon of Chaos attacked my subjects
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈkeɪɑs ə ˈtækt maɪ ˈsʌbʤɪkts
dialogue.zh: 混世魔王袭击了我的臣民

dialogue.en: The guard shrieked and ran into the cave.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑrd ʃrikt ænd ræn ˈɪntu ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 守卫尖叫着跑进了山洞。

dialogue.en: The Demon of Chaos was sitting at a table, eating a meal.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdiːmən əv ˈkeɪɑːs wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ æt ə ˈteɪbəl, ˈiːtɪŋ ə miːl.
dialogue.zh: 混沌魔王正坐在桌边吃饭。
祸事来了,一个守卫喊道。

dialogue.en: 'What sort of disaster?' asked the demon.
dialogue.ipa: wɑt sɔrt ʌv dɪˈzæstər æskt ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: 'There's a monkey outside,' said the other guard.
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz ə ˈmʌŋki ˈaʊtˈsaɪd sɛd ði ˈʌðər ɡɑrd
dialogue.zh: 另一个守卫说,外面有只猴子。

dialogue.en: He said he's king of the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd hiz kɪŋ ʌv ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 他说自己是花果山的国王

dialogue.en: 'The monkeys and apes have spoken of a king,' said the demon.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps ə ˈspoʊkən ʌv ə kɪŋ sɛd ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 妖怪说,猴子们提到了一位国王。

dialogue.en: He left to find a sage
dialogue.ipa: hi lɛft tu faɪnd ə seɪʤ
dialogue.zh: 他离开去寻找一位仙人

dialogue.en: Does the monkey have any weapons
dialogue.ipa: dʌz ðə ˈmʌŋki hæv ˈɛni ˈwɛpənz

dialogue.zh: “ 没有。 ” 一个守卫说道。

dialogue.en: 'Then get me my armor and my sword,' said the demon.
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ɡɛt mi maɪ ˈɑrmər ænd maɪ sɔrd sɛd ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 那就把我的盔甲和剑拿来,妖怪说道。

dialogue.en: A moment later, the Demon of Chaos walked outside.
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈkeɪɑs wɔkt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 片刻后,混世魔王走了出去。

dialogue.en: He looked at Wukong and laughed
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt Wukong ænd læft

dialogue.en: 'You're just a little monkey,' he said.
dialogue.ipa: jʊr ʤʌst ə ˈlɪtəl ˈmʌŋki hi sɛd
dialogue.zh: 你不过是只小猴子,他说道。

dialogue.en: Wukong looked up at the huge demon
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lʊkt ʌp æt ðə hjuʤ ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 悟空抬头看着巨大的妖怪

dialogue.en: But I am more powerful than you can imagine
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ æm mɔr ˈpaʊərfəl ðæn ju kæn ɪˈmæʤən
dialogue.zh: 但我的力量超乎你的想象

dialogue.en: 'I'm not afraid of you,' said the demon.
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt əˈfreɪd ʌv ju sɛd ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: “ 我不怕你, ” 妖怪说道。

dialogue.en: Wukong jumped out of the way, and then flew at the demon. Pow!
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʤʌmpt aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ ænd ðɛn flu æt ðə ˈdimən paʊ
dialogue.zh: 悟空闪身躲开,然后飞扑向妖怪,砰的一声。

dialogue.en: Wukong hit the demon on the nose
dialogue.ipa: Wukong hɪt ðə ˈdimən ɑn ðə noʊz
dialogue.zh: 悟空一拳打在妖怪鼻子上

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out a handful of his own hair and blew on it
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pʊld aʊt ə ˈhændˌfʊl ʌv hɪz oʊn hɛr ænd blu ɑn ɪt
dialogue.zh: 悟空拔下一撮自己的毛发吹了口气

dialogue.en: Each strand of hair turned into a fake monkey, exactly like Wukong
dialogue.ipa: iːtʃ strænd əv hɛr tɜːrnd ˈɪntuː ə feɪk ˈmʌŋki, ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk ˈwuːkɔːŋ
dialogue.zh: 每根头发都变成了假猴子,跟悟空一模一样。

dialogue.en: All at once the fake monkeys attacked the demon, punching and kicking him
dialogue.ipa: ɔl æt wʌns ðə feɪk ˈmʌŋkiz əˈtæk ðə ˈdimən ˈpʌnʧɪŋ ænd ˈkɪkɪŋ hɪm
dialogue.zh: 假猴子们突然一拥而上,对妖怪拳打脚踢。

dialogue.en: 'What... What's going on?' cried the demon, trying to fight all the fake monkeys
dialogue.ipa: wɑt... wʌts ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn kraɪd ðə ˈdimən ˈtraɪɪŋ tu faɪt ɔl ðə feɪk ˈmʌŋkiz
dialogue.zh: “ 什么 ...... 怎么回事? ” 妖怪喊道,拼命抵挡着那些假猴子。

dialogue.ipa: ɪts ə ˈmæʤɪk spɛl sɛd Wukong

dialogue.en: It's called body beyond the body
dialogue.ipa: ɪts kɔld ˈbɑdi bɪˈɑnd ðə ˈbɑdi

dialogue.en: The Demon of Chaos was soon destroyed
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈkeɪɑs wʌz sun dɪˈstrɔɪd
dialogue.zh: 混世魔王很快就被消灭了

dialogue.en: Wukong chased away the guards and then went into the cave
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʧeɪst əˈweɪ ðə ɡɑrdz ænd ðɛn wɛnt ˈɪntu ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 悟空赶走守卫后进了山洞。

dialogue.en: He found all the monkeys and apes that the demon had kidnapped
dialogue.ipa: hi faʊnd ɔl ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps ðæt ðə ˈdimən hæd ˈkɪd ˌnæpt
dialogue.zh: 他找到了所有被妖怪掳走的猴子

dialogue.en: When they saw him, they cheered.
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðeɪ sɔ hɪm ðeɪ ʧɪrd
dialogue.zh: 他们一看到他,就欢呼起来。

dialogue.en: 'Your Majesty,' cried the monkeys and apes.
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ˈmæʤəsti kraɪd ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps
dialogue.zh: 大王!猴子与猿猴们喊道。

dialogue.en: The next morning, Wukong woke up early.
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ Wukong woʊk ʌp ˈɜrli
dialogue.zh: 第二天早上,悟空很早就醒了。

dialogue.en: 'Other demons might attack us,' he thought.
dialogue.ipa: ˈʌðər ˈdimənz maɪt ə ˈtæk ʌs hi θɔt
dialogue.zh: 他想,其他妖怪可能会袭击我们。

dialogue.en: We must be ready to protect ourselves
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst bi ˈrɛdi tu prəˈtɛkt aʊərˈsɛlvz
dialogue.zh: 我们必须准备好保护自己

dialogue.en: Wukong spent the day teaching his subjects how to fight
dialogue.ipa: Wukong spɛnt ðə deɪ ˈtiʧɪŋ hɪz ˈsʌbʤɪkts haʊ tu faɪt
dialogue.zh: 悟空花了一天时间教他的臣民如何战斗

dialogue.en: They practiced with swords and spears
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈpræktəst wɪð sɔrdz ænd spɪrz

dialogue.en: Before long, the monkeys and apes were a fierce army.
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈfɔːr lɔːŋ, ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps wɜːr ə fɪrs ˈɑːrmi.
dialogue.zh: 不久,猴子和猿猴们组成了一支凶猛的军队。

dialogue.en: 'No demon will dare bother us now,' said the gibbon.
dialogue.ipa: noʊ ˈdimən wɪl dɛr ˈbɑðər ʌs naʊ, sɛd ðə ˈɡɪbən.
dialogue.zh: “ 现在没有恶魔敢来打扰我们了, ” 长臂猿说道。

dialogue.en: 'I can't use any of the weapons we have,' said Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt juz ˈɛni ʌv ðə ˈwɛpənz wi hæv sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 悟空说,我们现有的武器我一个都用不了。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: 'What happened here?' Wukong asked the gibbon.
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The Demon of Chaos was sitting at a table, eating a meal.
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: He found all the monkeys and apes that the demon had kidnapped
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: 'He is called the Demon of Chaos,' said the gibbon.
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I will handle the demon
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: 'He is called the Demon of Chaos,' said the gibbon.
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: 'Our king can fly,' said the gibbon.
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We must be ready to protect ourselves
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: We tried to fight him, but he was too powerful
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: 'There's a monkey outside,' said the other guard.
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who is he
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When they saw him, they cheered.
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: I am now as powerful as a god
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.
