titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 6 the Dragon King

dialogue.en: 'What's wrong with our swords and spears?' asked the Gibbon.
dialogue.ipa: wʌts rɔŋ wɪð ˈaʊər sɔrdz ænd spɪrz æskt ðə ˈɡɪbən
dialogue.zh: 我们的刀枪有什么问题吗?猿猴问道。

dialogue.en: 'They're fine for normal monkeys and apes,' said Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr faɪn fɔr ˈnɔrməl ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 对付普通猴子和猿类还行,悟空说。

dialogue.en: I need a much heavier weapon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid ə mʌʧ ˈhɛviər ˈwɛpən

dialogue.en: The Gibbon thought for a minute
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈɡɪbən θɔt fɔr ə ˈmɪnət

dialogue.en: 'A dragon king lives at the bottom of the eastern sea,' he said.
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ lɪvz æt ðə ˈbɑtəm ʌv ði ˈistərn si hi sɛd
dialogue.zh: 东海海底住着一位龙王,他说

dialogue.en: Maybe he has a weapon you can use
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi hi hæz ə ˈwɛpən ju kæn juz
dialogue.zh: 或许他有你能用的兵器

dialogue.ipa: ðæts ə ɡʊd aɪˈdiə sɛd Wukong

dialogue.en: He said a quick spell so he could breathe underwater
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd ə kwɪk spɛl soʊ hi kʊd brið ˈʌndərˌwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 他念了个避水诀以便在水下呼吸

dialogue.en: Then he dived into the stream
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi daɪvd ˈɪntu ðə strim

dialogue.en: He swam to the ocean and went deeper and deeper
dialogue.ipa: hi swæm tu ði ˈoʊʃən ænd wɛnt ˈdipər ænd ˈdipər
dialogue.zh: 他游向大海并不断下潜

dialogue.en: Soon he arrived at a large palace
dialogue.ipa: sun hi əˈraɪvd æt ə lɑrʤ ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 很快便来到一座宏伟的宫殿前

dialogue.en: The Dragon King and the Dragon Queen were sitting at a table, having tea
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ænd ðə ˈdræɡən kwin wɜr ˈsɪtɪŋ æt ə ˈteɪbəl ˈhævɪŋ ti
dialogue.zh: 龙王和龙后正坐在桌边喝茶呢

dialogue.en: The Dragon King looked over when Wukong walked in
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ lʊkt ˈoʊvər wɛn wu kɔŋ wɔkt ɪn
dialogue.zh: 悟空走进来时龙王抬眼望去

dialogue.en: 'Who are you?' asked the Dragon King.
dialogue.ipa: hu ɑr ju æskt ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ

dialogue.en: 'I'm king of the Fruit and Flower Mountain,' said Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: aɪm kɪŋ ʌv ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 我是花果山之王,悟空说。

dialogue.en: 'It's nice to meet you,' said the queen.
dialogue.ipa: ɪts naɪs tu mit ju sɛd ðə kwin

dialogue.zh: “ 不用了,谢谢。 ” 悟空说。

dialogue.en: I need a heavy weapon because I'm as strong as a god
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid ə ˈhɛvi ˈwɛpən bɪˈkɔz aɪm æz strɔŋ æz ə ɡɑd
dialogue.zh: 我力能扛鼎 需要一件重兵器

dialogue.en: I suppose I could find a weapon for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ səˈpoʊz aɪ kʊd faɪnd ə ˈwɛpən fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 我想可以给你找件兵器

dialogue.en: The Dragon King looked at a turtle soldier
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ lʊkt æt ə ˈtɜrtəl ˈsoʊlʤər

dialogue.en: Find a heavy weapon for Sun Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: faɪnd ə ˈhɛvi ˈwɛpən fɔr sʌn Wukong
dialogue.zh: 去给孙悟空找件重兵器。

dialogue.en: The turtle went out of the room.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtɜrtəl wɛnt aʊt ʌv ðə rum

dialogue.en: He soon came back, slowly dragging a huge sword.
dialogue.ipa: hi sun keɪm bæk ˈsloʊli ˈdræɡɪŋ ə hjuʤ sɔrd
dialogue.zh: 他很快回来了,吃力地拖着一柄巨剑。

dialogue.en: He dropped the sword and then fell down, out of breath.
dialogue.ipa: hi drɑpt ðə sɔrd ænd ðɛn fɛl daʊn aʊt ʌv brɛθ
dialogue.zh: 他扔下剑就倒在地上,喘不过气来。

dialogue.en: Wukong picked up the sword with no trouble at all.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pɪkt ʌp ðə sɔrd wɪð noʊ ˈtrʌbəl æt ɔl
dialogue.zh: 悟空毫不费力地提起剑。

dialogue.en: He waved the sword through the air , pretending to fight.
dialogue.ipa: hi weɪvd ðə sɔrd θru ði ɛr priˈtɛndɪŋ tu faɪt
dialogue.zh: 他挥舞着剑,假装在打斗。

dialogue.en: 'This sword is too light,' said Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs sɔrd ɪz tu laɪt sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 这剑太轻了 , 悟空说道

dialogue.en: The Dragon Queen whispered to her husband.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kwin ˈwɪspərd tu hɜr ˈhʌzbənd

dialogue.en: 'You're right, dear,' the Dragon king whispered back.
dialogue.ipa: jʊr raɪt dɪr ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ˈwɪspərd bæk
dialogue.zh: 你说得对,亲爱的,龙王也低声回应。

dialogue.en: Let's find him something quickly so he'll leave.
dialogue.ipa: lɛts faɪnd hɪm ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈkwɪkli soʊ hil liv
dialogue.zh: 咱们赶紧找件东西给他,好让他离开。

dialogue.en: Several turtles and octopuses dragged an enormous spear into the room.
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɛvrəl ˈtɜrtəlz ænd ˈɑktəˌpʊsɪz dræɡd ən ɪˈnɔrməs spɪr ˈɪntu ðə rum
dialogue.zh: 几只海龟和章鱼拖着一柄巨大的长矛进了大殿。

dialogue.en: That looks like a very heavy weapon. Right , Wukong?
dialogue.ipa: ðæt lʊks laɪk ə ˈvɛri ˈhɛvi ˈwɛpən raɪt Wukong
dialogue.zh: 这武器看着可真沉啊,对吧悟空 ?

dialogue.en: Wukong lifted the spear and began stabbing at the air.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˈlɪftɪd ðə spɪr ænd bɪˈɡæn ˈstæbɪŋ æt ði ɛr
dialogue.zh: 悟空提起长矛朝空中刺了几下。

dialogue.en: How can you say it's too light?
dialogue.ipa: haʊ kæn ju seɪ ɪts tu laɪt
tu mi ɪts laɪt sɛd Wukong

dialogue.en: 'We don't have anything else,' said the Dragon King.
dialogue.ipa: wi doʊnt hæv ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls sɛd ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 龙王说,我们没有别的了。

dialogue.en: That's the heaviest weapon we have.
dialogue.ipa: ðæts ðə ˈhɛviəst ˈwɛpən wi hæv
dialogue.zh: 这是我们最重的兵器了。

dialogue.en: I'm not leaving until I get what I want.
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈlivɪŋ ənˈtɪl aɪ ɡɛt wɑt aɪ wɑnt
dialogue.zh: 不拿到称心的兵器我就不走。

dialogue.en: 'This is an outrage,' said the Dragon King.
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ən ˈaʊˌtreɪʤ sɛd ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 真是岂有此理,龙王说道。

dialogue.en: The queen whispered to him again
dialogue.ipa: ðə kwin ˈwɪspərd tu hɪm əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: What about the magical iron bar in the treasury?
dialogue.ipa: wɑt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmæʤɪkəl ˈaɪərn bɑr ɪn ðə ˈtrɛʒəri
dialogue.zh: 宝库里那根定海神针铁如何 ?

dialogue.en: 'We can't give that to him,' said the Dragon King.
dialogue.ipa: wi kænt ɡɪv ðæt tu hɪm sɛd ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 那个可不能给他,龙王说道。

dialogue.en: I just want this monkey out of my palace.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʤʌst wɑnt ðɪs ˈmʌŋki aʊt ʌv maɪ ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 我只想让这猴子离开我的宫殿。

dialogue.en: 'Wukong, we might have something heavy enough for you.'
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wi maɪt hæv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈhɛvi ɪˈnʌf fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 悟空,我们或许有件够重的宝物。

dialogue.ipa: wi kænt sɛd ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ

dialogue.en: It's too heavy for anyone to lift.
dialogue.ipa: ɪts tu ˈhɛvi fɔr ˈɛniˌwʌn tu lɪft
dialogue.zh: 它太重了,没人举得起来。

dialogue.en: 'But if you can lift it, we'll let you have it.'
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ɪf ju kæn lɪft ɪt wil lɛt ju hæv ɪt
dialogue.zh: 但如果你能举起来,我们就把它给你。

dialogue.en: 'Show me where it is.,' said Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: ʃoʊ mi wɛr ɪt ɪz sɛd Wukong

dialogue.en: The group went to the Treasury.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup wɛnt tu ðə ˈtrɛʒəri

dialogue.en: An enormous iron pillar stood in the center of the room.
dialogue.ipa: ən ɪ ˈnɔrməs ˈaɪərn ˈpɪlər stʊd ɪn ðə ˈsɛntər ʌv ðə rum
dialogue.zh: 一根巨大的铁柱矗立在房间中央。

dialogue.en: Beams of golden light shone from it
dialogue.ipa: bimz ʌv ˈɡoʊldən laɪt ʃoʊn frʌm ɪt
dialogue.zh: 柱身正散发着道道金光

dialogue.en: 'That pillar was used to measure all the oceans and rivers,' said the Dragon King.
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈpɪlər wʌz juzd tu ˈmɛʒər ɔl ði ˈoʊʃənz ænd ˈrɪvərz sɛd ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 龙王说,那根柱子曾用来测量所有的海洋与河流。

dialogue.en: Wukong went closer and looked up at the large piece of iron.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wɛnt ˈkloʊsər ænd lʊkt ʌp æt ðə lɑrʤ pis ʌv ˈaɪərn
dialogue.zh: 悟空走近些,抬头望向那块巨大的铁器。

dialogue.en: The Dragon King folded his arms.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ˈfoʊldɪd hɪz ɑrmz

dialogue.en: If you can pick it up, you can have it.
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju kæn pɪk ɪt ʌp ju kæn hæv ɪt
dialogue.zh: 你能拿得动就是你的了

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: 'What's wrong with our swords and spears?' asked the Gibbon.
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The Dragon King and the Dragon Queen were sitting at a table, having tea
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: But I am very powerful
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll be back soon
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: 'That pillar was used to measure all the oceans and rivers,' said the Dragon King.
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Maybe he has a weapon you can use
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: He said a quick spell so he could breathe underwater
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's find him something quickly so he'll leave.
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Find a heavy weapon for Sun Wukong.
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That looks like a very heavy weapon. Right , Wukong?
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: 'But if you can lift it, we'll let you have it.'
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: The Dragon King looked over when Wukong walked in
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: I need a heavy weapon because I'm as strong as a god
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: He said a quick spell so he could breathe underwater
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: I need a heavy weapon because I'm as strong as a god
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.

collocations.context: 'A dragon king lives at the bottom of the eastern sea,' he said.
'That's a good idea,' said Wukong.
'No, thank you.' said Wukong.
The Dragon King looked at a turtle soldier
He soon came back, slowly dragging a huge sword.
Wukong picked up the sword with no trouble at all.

That looks like a very heavy weapon. Right , Wukong?
He shook his head.
'But if you can lift it, we'll let you have it.'
Wukong went closer and looked up at the large piece of iron.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 7 The Land of Darkness

dialogue.en: Sun Wukong put his hand on the iron pillar.
dialogue.ipa: sʌn Wukong pʊt hɪz hænd ɑn ði ˈaɪərn ˈpɪlər
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空把手放在铁柱上。

dialogue.en: 'Hmm,' he thought. 'This piece of iron really is magical.'
dialogue.ipa: həm hi θɔt ðɪs pis əv ˈaɪərn ˈrɪli ɪz ˈmædʒɪkəl
dialogue.zh: “ 嗯, ” 他想。 “ 这块铁真的很神奇。 ”

dialogue.en: I bet it will do whatever I want it to do.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ bɛt ɪt wɪl du ˌwʌˈtɛvər aɪ wɑnt ɪt tu du
dialogue.zh: 我敢说它会随我的心意变化。

dialogue.en: Soon it was just a little taller than Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: sun ɪt wʌz ʤʌst ə ˈlɪtəl ˈtɔlər ðæn Wukong
dialogue.zh: 转眼间只比悟空高一点。

dialogue.en: He picked it up and swung it around.
dialogue.ipa: hi pɪkt ɪt ʌp ænd swʌŋ ɪt ə ˈraʊnd

dialogue.en: ‘This is a perfect weapon for me , ’ he said.
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ə ˈpɜrˌfɪkt ˈwɛpən fɔr mi hi sɛd
dialogue.zh: 这真是件趁手的兵器,他说。

dialogue.en: ‘I can't believe he can lift it , ’ said the Dragon Queen.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt bɪ ˈliv hi kæn lɪft ɪt sɛd ðə ˈdræɡən kwin
dialogue.zh: 真不敢相信他能拿得动,龙母说道。

dialogue.en: Wukong made the bar even smaller.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong meɪd ðə bɑr ˈivɪn ˈsmɔlər
dialogue.zh: 悟空让金箍棒变得更小了。

dialogue.en: Soon it was no bigger than a pin.
dialogue.ipa: sun ɪt wʌz noʊ ˈbɪɡər ðæn ə pɪn
dialogue.zh: 转眼间,那铁柱就变得跟绣花针一样小了。

dialogue.en: He placed it inside his ear.
dialogue.ipa: hi pleɪst ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd hɪz ir
aɪv ɡɑt wɑt aɪ wɑnt sɛd Wukong ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: “ 我要的东西到手了, ” 悟空说道, “ 告辞。 ”

dialogue.en: 'He was very rude,' said the Dragon Queen.
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈvɛri rud sɛd ðə ˈdræɡən kwin
dialogue.zh: 龙母说道: “ 他真是无礼至极。 ”

dialogue.en: The Dragon King clenched his fists.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ klɛnʧt hɪz fɪsts

dialogue.en: I'm going to report him to the Jade Emperor.
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu rɪˈpɔrt hɪm tu ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 我要到玉帝那儿告他一状。

dialogue.en: Back home the others were amazed by Wukong's new weapon.
dialogue.ipa: bæk hoʊm ði ˈʌðərz wɜr əˈmeɪzd baɪ Wukong's nu ˈwɛpən
dialogue.zh: 回到水帘洞,其他猴子都对悟空的新兵器惊叹不已。

dialogue.en: 'Nobody will ever attack us again,' declared Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: ˈnoʊˌbɑˌdi wɪl ˈɛvər əˈtæk ʌs əˈɡɛn dɪˈklɛrd Wukong
dialogue.zh: “ 再也没人敢来侵犯我们了, ” 悟空宣告道。

dialogue.en: They held a big feast that lasted until late at night
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ hɛld ə bɪɡ fist ðæt ˈlæstɪd ənˈtɪl leɪt æt naɪt
dialogue.zh: 他们大摆筵席直到深夜

dialogue.en: But as he fell asleep, two spirits grabbed him.
dialogue.ipa: bʌt æz hi fɛl əˈslip tu ˈspɪrɪts ɡræbd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 但他刚睡着,两个鬼差就抓住了他。

dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɑr ju ˈduɪŋ æskt Wukong
dialogue.zh: 你们在干什么?悟空问道。

dialogue.en: He kicked and struggled as the spirits dragged him out of his cave
dialogue.ipa: hi kɪkt ænd ˈstrʌɡəld æz ðə ˈspɪrɪts dræɡd hɪm aʊt ʌv hɪz keɪv
dialogue.zh: 他踢打着挣扎,却被鬼差拖出了山洞

dialogue.en: They walked toward a dark and creepy city
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɔkt təˈwɔrd ə dɑrk ænd ˈkripi ˈsɪti
dialogue.zh: 他们走向一座阴森恐怖的城池

dialogue.en: A sign on the entrance gate said land of darkness
dialogue.ipa: ə saɪn ɑn ði ˈɛntrəns ɡeɪt sɛd lænd ʌv ˈdɑrknəs
dialogue.zh: 城门上写着 “ 幽冥界 ” 三个大字

dialogue.ipa: ðə lænd ʌv ˈdɑrknəs kraɪd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 幽冥界里,悟空大叫一声。

dialogue.en: That's where people go when they die
dialogue.ipa: ðæts wɛr ˈpipəl ɡoʊ wɛn ðeɪ daɪ
dialogue.zh: 这不是人死后去的地方吗

dialogue.en: 'Grow,' he cried. His iron bar quickly grew.
dialogue.ipa: ɡroʊ hi kraɪd hɪz aɪərn bɑr kwɪkli ɡroʊ
dialogue.zh: “ 大! ” 他喝道。他的金箍棒迅速变大了。

dialogue.en: He knocked out the first spirit
dialogue.ipa: hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ˈkwɪkli ɡru hi nɑkt aʊt ðə fɜrst ˈspɪrət
dialogue.zh: 他把第一个鬼差打倒了。

dialogue.en: Crack! he knocked out the second spirit.
dialogue.ipa: kræk hi nɑkt aʊt ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈspɪrət
dialogue.zh: 咔嚓一声,他打倒了第二个鬼魂。

dialogue.en: Wukong stomped into the land of darkness
dialogue.ipa: Wukong stɑmpt ˈɪntu ðə lænd ʌv ˈdɑrknəs

dialogue.en: He headed toward the Palace of darkness
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈhɛdɪd təˈwɔrd ðə ˈpæləs ʌv ˈdɑrknəs

dialogue.en: As he went, he swung his iron bar back and forth.
dialogue.ipa: æz hi wɛnt, hi swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr bæk ænd fɔrθ.
dialogue.zh: 他一边走,一边来回挥舞着金箍棒。

dialogue.en: A tall spirit stepped out of the palace.
dialogue.ipa: ə tɔl ˈspɪrət stɛpt aʊt ʌv ðə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 一个高大的鬼魂从宫殿里走了出来 .

dialogue.en: 'What's going on out here?' the spirit asked.
dialogue.ipa: wʌts ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn aʊt hir ðə ˈspɪrət æskt
dialogue.zh: 外面怎么回事?鬼魂问道。

dialogue.en: 'I am the judge of the dead,' said the spirit.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ðə ʤʌʤ ʌv ðə dɛd sɛd ðə ˈspɪrət
dialogue.zh: “ 我是死者的判官, ” 那鬼魂答道。

dialogue.en: Why are you causing all this trouble?
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɑr ju ˈkɑzɪŋ ɔl ðɪs ˈtrʌbəl

dialogue.en: 'I want to know why I was brought here,' said Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt tu noʊ waɪ aɪ wʌz brɔt hir sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 悟空说道: “ 我想知道为什么把我带到这里来。 ”

dialogue.en: The judge held up his hands
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤʌʤ hɛld ʌp hɪz hændz

dialogue.en: If you were brought here, it means your time on earth is over.
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju wɜr brɔt hir ɪt minz jʊər taɪm ɑn ɜrθ ɪz ˈoʊvər
dialogue.zh: 你被带到这里,就说明你在阳寿已尽。

dialogue.ipa: lɛts ʧɛk ðə dəˈrɛktəri hi sɛd
dialogue.zh: 让我查查生死簿,他说道。

dialogue.en: The directory contains the name and age of every creature on earth.
dialogue.ipa: ðə dəˈrɛktəri kənˈteɪnz ðə neɪm ænd eɪʤ ʌv ˈɛvəri ˈkriʧər ɑn ɜrθ
dialogue.zh: 这个生死簿上记载着凡间所有生灵的名字和年龄。

dialogue.en: It says when each creature will die
dialogue.ipa: ɪt sɛz wɛn iʧ ˈkriʧər wɪl daɪ
dialogue.zh: 注明了每个生灵的殒命之时

dialogue.en: Inside the palace the judge opened a large book
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈpæləs ðə ʤʌʤ ˈoʊpənd ə lɑrʤ bʊk
dialogue.zh: 判官在殿内翻开一本巨册

dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɪz jʊər neɪm hi æskt
dialogue.zh: ' 你叫什么名字 ?' 他问道。

dialogue.en: The judge flipped through the pages
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤʌʤ flɪpt θru ðə ˈpeɪʤəz
hir ɪt ɪz sɛd ðə ʤʌʤ

dialogue.en: It says Sun Wukong , born from a stone three hundred years ago , died today.
dialogue.ipa: ɪt sɛz sʊn ˈwʊkɔŋ, bɔrn frʌm ə stoʊn θri ˈhʌndrəd jɪrz əˈɡoʊ, daɪd təˈdeɪ.
dialogue.zh: 上面写着孙悟空,三百年前从石头里诞生,今天死了。

dialogue.en: No, I'm going to live forever.
dialogue.ipa: noʊ aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: 'The directory isn't wrong,' said the judge
dialogue.ipa: ðə dəˈrɛktəri ˈɪzənt rɔŋ sɛd ðə ʤʌʤ
dialogue.zh: 判官说,生死簿不会有错。

dialogue.en: You'll have to stay here now
dialogue.ipa: jul hæv tu steɪ hir naʊ

dialogue.en: Wukong raised his iron bar and glared at the judge
dialogue.ipa: Wukong reɪzd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd ɡlɛrd æt ðə ʤʌʤ
dialogue.zh: 悟空举起金箍棒怒视判官

dialogue.en: Shaking, the judge handed the book to Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ðə ʤʌʤ ˈhændɪd ðə bʊk tu Wukong
dialogue.zh: 判官晃了晃,把书递给了悟空。

dialogue.en: Wukong plucked two of his hairs and blew on them
dialogue.ipa: Wukong plʌkt tu ʌv hɪz hɛrz ænd blu ɑn ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 悟空拔下两根毫毛,对着它们吹了口气

dialogue.en: They turned into a brush and a jar of ink
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə brʌʃ ænd ə ʤɑr ʌv ɪŋk
dialogue.zh: 它们变成了一支笔和一瓶墨水

dialogue.en: He drew a line through his name
dialogue.ipa: hi dru ə laɪn θru hɪz neɪm

dialogue.en: 'You can't do that,' said the judge.
dialogue.ipa: ju kænt du ðæt sɛd ðə ʤʌʤ
dialogue.zh: 你不能这么做,判官说道。

dialogue.en: Next, Wukong found the names of all the other monkeys and apes.
dialogue.ipa: nɛkst Wukong faʊnd ðə neɪmz ʌv ɔl ði ˈʌðər ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps
dialogue.zh: 接着悟空找到了所有其他猴子和猿类的名字。

dialogue.en: He crossed out their names too
dialogue.ipa: hi krɔst aʊt ðɛr neɪmz tu
dialogue.zh: 他也划掉了它们的名字

dialogue.en: 'Now I really will live forever,' said Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪ ˈrɪli wɪl lɪv fə ˈrɛvər sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 悟空说道: “ 现在我真的能长生不老了。 ”

dialogue.en: And so will all of my subjects
dialogue.ipa: ænd soʊ wɪl ɔl ʌv maɪ ˈsʌbʤɪkts
dialogue.zh: 我的所有子民也将如此

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: 'Hmm,' he thought. 'This piece of iron really is magical.'
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I bet it will do whatever I want it to do.
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I bet it will do whatever I want it to do.
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Back home the others were amazed by Wukong's new weapon.
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: ‘I can't believe he can lift it , ' said the Dragon Queen.
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: You'll have to stay here now
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: 'I want to know why I was brought here,' said Wukong.
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: 'Let's check the directory,' he said.
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Tell me now.
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: They held a big feast that lasted until late at night
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you were brought here, it means your time on earth is over.
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: That's where people go when they die
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: And so will all of my subjects
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: 'I want to know why I was brought here,' said Wukong.
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: 比较级 + than / 比较级 and 比较级
grammar.description: 比较两者差异，或表达程度不断变化。
grammar.source: Soon it was no bigger than a pin.
examples: Wukong is stronger than the demon.
This road is shorter than the other one.
The river is wider than before.
Bajie is hungrier than Wujing.
The mountain is higher than the hill.
The cave became darker and darker.
They walked faster and faster.
The sound grew louder and louder.
This plan is better than the first one.
The journey became more and more difficult.

He turned around and left.

titleEn: Journey to the West chapter 8 A Job in Heaven

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor was sitting on his throne in the Cloud Palace
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ ɑn hɪz θroʊn ɪn ðə klaʊd ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 玉皇大帝端坐于凌霄宝殿的宝座之上。

dialogue.en: A messenger ran into the court
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmɛsənʤər ræn ˈɪntu ðə kɔrt

dialogue.en: The Dragon King of the Eastern Sea is here to see you.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ʌv ði ˈistərn si ɪz hir tu si ju
lɛt hɪm ɪn sɛd ði ˈɛmpərər

dialogue.en: The Dragon King entered and bowed
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ˈɛntərd ænd baʊd

dialogue.en: Your majesty, I want to make a complaint.
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ˈmæʤəsti aɪ wɑnt tu meɪk ə kəmˈpleɪnt

dialogue.en: Sun Wukong came to my palace and demanded I give him a weapon
dialogue.ipa: sʌn Wukong keɪm tu maɪ ˈpæləs ænd dɪˈmændɪd aɪ ɡɪv hɪm ə ˈwɛpən
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空来到我的龙宫,要求我给他一件兵器

dialogue.en: The Judge of the Dead would like to speak with you, your majesty.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤʌʤ ʌv ðə dɛd wʊd laɪk tu spik wɪð ju jʊər ˈmæʤəsti
dialogue.zh: 地府判官想跟您聊聊,陛下。

dialogue.en: The judge came in and bowed
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤʌʤ keɪm ɪn ænd baʊd

dialogue.en: A monkey named Sun Wukong crossed out his name in the directory
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmʌŋki neɪmd sʌn Wukong krɔst aʊt hɪz neɪm ɪn ðə də ˈrɛktəri
dialogue.zh: 一只名叫孙悟空的猴子在生死簿上划掉了自己的名字

dialogue.en: I beg you to punish him
dialogue.ipa: aɪ bɛɡ ju tu ˈpʌnɪʃ hɪm

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor rubbed his chin.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər rʌbd hɪz ʧɪn

dialogue.en: And how did he become so powerful
dialogue.ipa: ænd haʊ dɪd hi bɪˈkʌm soʊ ˈpaʊərfəl
dialogue.zh: 他怎么会变得如此强大
玉帝的侍卫长走上前来

dialogue.en: Sun Wukong is the monkey who was born from a rock three hundred years ago
dialogue.ipa: sʌn Wukong ɪz ðə ˈmʌŋki hu wʌz bɔrn frʌm ə rɑk θri ˈhʌndrɪd jɪrz əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空就是三百年前从石头里蹦出来的那只猴子

dialogue.en: I don't know how he became so powerful
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ haʊ hi bɪ ˈkeɪm soʊ ˈpaʊərfəl
dialogue.zh: 我不知道他怎么会变得如此强大

dialogue.en: 'I remember him,' said the Jade Emperor.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər hɪm sɛd ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 我记得他,玉皇大帝说道。

dialogue.en: I don't care how powerful he is
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt kɛr haʊ ˈpaʊərfəl hi ɪz

dialogue.en: He is causing too much trouble on Earth.
dialogue.ipa: hi ɪz ˈkɑzɪŋ tu mʌʧ ˈtrʌbəl ɑn ɜrθ
dialogue.zh: 他在人间惹了太多麻烦。

dialogue.en: Gather some troops, and go down to the Fruit and Flower Mountain.
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡæðər sʌm trups ænd ɡoʊ daʊn tu ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 召集一些兵马,去花果山走一趟。

dialogue.en: The spirit of the planet Venus stepped forward
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈspɪrət ʌv ðə ˈplænət ˈvinəs stɛpt ˈfɔrwərd
dialogue.zh: 太白金星向前迈出一步

dialogue.en: Perhaps we could give Wukong a job here in Heaven.
dialogue.ipa: pərˈhæps wi kʊd ɡɪv Wukong ə ʤɑb hir ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 或许我们可以给悟空在天庭安排个差事

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor raised his eyebrows.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər reɪzd hɪz ˈaɪˌbraʊz

dialogue.en: 'If he's here, we can keep an eye on him.' said Venus.
dialogue.ipa: ɪf hiz hir wi kæn kip ən aɪ ɑn hɪm sɛd ˈvinəs
dialogue.zh: 太白金星说,如果他在这儿,我们就能盯着他。

dialogue.en: It will be easy to keep him out of trouble
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wɪl bi ˈizi tu kip hɪm aʊt ʌv ˈtrʌbəl
dialogue.zh: 这样就能轻易防止他惹麻烦

dialogue.en: Invite Wukong to come to live in Heaven.
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈvaɪt Wukong tu kʌm tu lɪv ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 邀请悟空来天庭居住吧。

dialogue.en: He will be in charge of the Royal Peach Garden.
dialogue.ipa: hi wɪl bi ɪn ʧɑrʤ ʌv ðə ˈrɔɪəl piʧ ˈɡɑrdən

dialogue.en: Wukong was telling his subjects about his adventure in the Land of Darkness
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wʌz ˈtɛlɪŋ hɪz ˈsʌbʤɪkts əˈbaʊt hɪz æd ˈvɛnʧər ɪn ðə lænd ʌv ˈdɑrknəs
dialogue.zh: 悟空正向臣民讲述他在幽冥界的冒险

dialogue.en: 'After I crossed out my name,' he said.
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər aɪ krɔst aʊt maɪ neɪm hi sɛd
dialogue.zh: 我划掉自己的名字后,他说道。

dialogue.en: I crossed out all of your names too
dialogue.ipa: aɪ krɔst aʊt ɔl ʌv jʊər neɪmz tu
dialogue.zh: 我把你们的名字也都划掉了

dialogue.en: Wukong noticed a spirit standing nearby
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˈnoʊtəst ə ˈspɪrət ˈstændɪŋ ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 悟空注意到有位神灵站在附近

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr
aɪ æm ˈvinəs sɛd ðə ˈspɪrət
dialogue.zh: “ 我是太白金星, ” 那神仙说道。

dialogue.en: I have an invitation from the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv ən ˌɪnvɪˈteɪʃən frʌm ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər

dialogue.en: He would like you to come to live in Heaven
dialogue.ipa: hi wʊd laɪk ju tu kʌm tu lɪv ɪn ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: At last he has invited me
dialogue.ipa: æt læst hi hæz ɪnˈvaɪtɪd mi

dialogue.en: When Wukong entered the royal court in the Cloud Palace, he didn't bow.
dialogue.ipa: wɛn Wukong ˈɛntərd ðə ˈrɔɪəl kɔrt ɪn ðə klaʊd ˈpæləs hi ˈdɪdənt baʊ
dialogue.zh: 悟空进入云宫宝殿,并未躬身行礼。

dialogue.en: 'You're supposed to bow before the emperor,' whispered Venus.
dialogue.ipa: jʊr səˈpoʊzd tu baʊ bɪˈfɔr ði ˈɛmpərər ˈwɪspərd ˈvinəs
dialogue.zh: 面见玉帝理应行礼,太白金星低声提醒道。

dialogue.en: I'm just as powerful as he is, maybe he should bow before me.
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʤʌst æz ˈpaʊərfəl æz hi ɪz ˈmeɪbi hi ʃʊd baʊ bɪˈfɔr mi
dialogue.zh: 俺老孙跟他一样神通广大,也许该是他向我鞠躬才对。

dialogue.en: Everyone but the Jade Emperor gasped
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn bʌt ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər ɡæspt
dialogue.zh: 满殿仙卿倒吸凉气,唯玉帝神色如常
我很高兴你总算是邀请了我

dialogue.en: I guess you finally realized I should be living up here with all of you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɛs ju ˈfaɪnəli ˈriəˌlaɪzd aɪ ʃʊd bi ˈlɪvɪŋ ʌp hir wɪð ɔl ʌv ju
dialogue.zh: 看来你终于明白我理当与诸位同住这天庭
注意礼数,太白金星说道。

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor looked at Venus and smiled
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər lʊkt æt ˈvinəs ænd smaɪld
dialogue.zh: 玉帝看向太白金星,微微一笑

dialogue.en: He can be excused for not acting the right way
dialogue.ipa: hi kæn bi ɪk ˈskjuzd fɔr nɑt ˈæktɪŋ ðə raɪt weɪ

dialogue.en: I'm putting you in charge of the Royal Peach Garden
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈpʌtɪŋ ju ɪn ʧɑrʤ ʌv ðə ˈrɔɪəl piʧ ˈɡɑrdən
dialogue.zh: 朕命你掌管皇家蟠桃园

dialogue.en: You will have a home here in Heaven
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl hæv ə hoʊm hir ɪn ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: I hope you won't cause any more trouble
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp ju woʊnt kɑz ˈɛni mɔr ˈtrʌbəl

dialogue.zh: 听起来太棒了,悟空说道。

dialogue.en: The next morning, a gardener showed Wukong the peach garden
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ ə ˈɡɑrdənər ʃoʊd Wukong ðə piʧ ˈɡɑrdən
dialogue.zh: 第二天早上,一个园丁带悟空去看了蟠桃园。

dialogue.en: Bright glowing peaches hung from every branch
dialogue.ipa: braɪt ˈɡloʊɪŋ ˈpiʧəz hʌŋ frʌm ˈɛvəri brænʧ
dialogue.zh: 每根树枝上都挂着闪闪发光的鲜亮蟠桃

dialogue.en: 'The peaches in this garden are not like peaches on earth,' said the gardener.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈpiʧəz ɪn ðɪs ˈɡɑrdən ɑr nɑt laɪk ˈpiʧəz ɑn ɜrθ sɛd ðə ˈɡɑrdənər
dialogue.zh: 园丁说,这园里的桃子可跟凡间的桃子不一样。

dialogue.en: These peaches take thousands of years to become ripe
dialogue.ipa: ðiz ˈpiʧəz teɪk ˈθaʊzəndz ʌv jɪrz tu bɪˈkʌm raɪp
dialogue.zh: 这些蟠桃需历经数千年才能成熟

dialogue.en: Anybody who takes a bite of one will live forever
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛnibədi hu teɪks ə baɪt ʌv wʌn wɪl lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 但凡咬上一口,便能长生不老

dialogue.en: Each morning Wukong inspected the trees in the garden.
dialogue.ipa: iʧ ˈmɔrnɪŋ wu kæŋ ɪnˈspɛktɪd ðə triz ɪn ðə ˈɡɑrdən
dialogue.zh: 每天清晨,悟空都会仔细检查园中的桃树。

dialogue.en: He took his job very seriously
dialogue.ipa: hi tʊk hɪz ʤɑb ˈvɛri ˈsɪriəsli
dialogue.zh: 他对这份差事十分认真

dialogue.en: 'These peaches look delicious,' Wukong thought one day.
dialogue.ipa: ðiz ˈpiʧəz lʊk dɪˈlɪʃəs Wukong θɔt wʌn deɪ
dialogue.zh: 这些蟠桃看起来真美味,有一天悟空心想。

dialogue.en: None of the gardeners were in sight
dialogue.ipa: nʌn ʌv ðə ˈɡɑrdənərz wɜr ɪn saɪt
dialogue.zh: 一个园丁的影子都没瞧见

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The Jade Emperor was sitting on his throne in the Cloud Palace
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The Jade Emperor was sitting on his throne in the Cloud Palace
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Your majesty, I want to make a complaint.
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: He is causing too much trouble on Earth.
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: At last he has invited me
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: It will be easy to keep him out of trouble
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: He can be excused for not acting the right way
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: 'If he's here, we can keep an eye on him.' said Venus.
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Perhaps we could give Wukong a job here in Heaven.
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: I'm just as powerful as he is, maybe he should bow before me.
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: Your majesty, I want to make a complaint.
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who is this Sun Wukong
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: 'If he's here, we can keep an eye on him.' said Venus.
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When Wukong entered the royal court in the Cloud Palace, he didn't bow.
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: And how did he become so powerful
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I don't know how he became so powerful
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

collocations.context: A messenger ran into the court
'Let him in,' said the emperor.
Your majesty, I want to make a complaint.

Sun Wukong is the monkey who was born from a rock three hundred years ago

He looked around

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 9 The Peach Garden

dialogue.en: Wukong plucked a peach from a branch and bit into it
dialogue.ipa: Wukong plʌkt ə piʧ frʌm ə brænʧ ænd bɪt ˈɪntu ɪt
dialogue.zh: 悟空从枝头摘下一颗蟠桃咬了一口

dialogue.ipa: ðɪs piʧ teɪsts ˈwʌndərfəl hi sɛd
dialogue.zh: 这桃子味道好极了,他说道。

dialogue.en: And then he ate another one
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn hi eɪt əˈnʌðər wʌn

dialogue.en: Each morning after that, Wukong secretly ate more and more peaches.
dialogue.ipa: iʧ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈæftər ðæt Wukong ˈsikrɪtli eɪt mɔr ænd mɔr ˈpiʧəz
dialogue.zh: 从那以后,每天早上悟空都会偷偷吃掉越来越多的蟠桃。

dialogue.en: After eating he climbed into a tree and took a nap
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ˈitɪŋ hi klaɪmd ˈɪntu ə tri ænd tʊk ə næp
dialogue.zh: 吃完后他便爬上桃树小憩片刻

dialogue.en: Time went by, and Wukong enjoyed his life in Heaven.
dialogue.ipa: taɪm wɛnt baɪ ænd Wukong ɛnˈʤɔɪd hɪz laɪf ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 时光流逝,悟空在天庭过着逍遥快活的日子。

dialogue.en: Meanwhile the queen of Heaven was busy.
dialogue.ipa: ˈminˌwaɪl ðə kwin ʌv ˈhɛvən wʌz ˈbɪzi
dialogue.zh: 与此同时王母娘娘正忙碌着

dialogue.en: It was almost time for the annual Peach Festival
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz ˈɔlˌmoʊst taɪm fɔr ði ˈænjuəl piʧ ˈfɛstəvəl
dialogue.zh: 一年一度的蟠桃盛会即将来临

dialogue.en: She called for her maidens, Red gown and blue gown
dialogue.ipa: ʃi kɔld fɔr hər ˈmeɪdənz rɛd ɡaʊn ænd blu ɡaʊn
dialogue.zh: 她唤来了侍女们,红衣仙女和青衣仙女。

dialogue.en: 'How may we help you?' asked Red Gown.
dialogue.ipa: haʊ meɪ wi hɛlp ju æskt rɛd ɡaʊn
dialogue.zh: 红衣仙女问道:有何吩咐?

dialogue.en: 'The Peach Festival is tomorrow,' said the Queen.
dialogue.ipa: ðə piʧ ˈfɛstəvəl ɪz təˈmɑˌroʊ sɛd ðə kwin
dialogue.zh: 王母娘娘说明天就是蟠桃盛会了。

dialogue.en: All the important gods and spirits in Heaven will be here
dialogue.ipa: ɔl ði ɪmˈpɔrtənt ɡɑdz ænd ˈspɪrɪts ɪn ˈhɛvən wɪl bi hir
dialogue.zh: 天庭所有重要的神仙都将到场

dialogue.en: I also invited the Bodhisattva Guanyin, the goddess of mercy.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɪnˈvaɪtɪd ðə / ˌboʊdɪˈsɑːtvə Guanyin ðə ˈɡɑdəs ʌv ˈmɜrsi
dialogue.zh: 我还邀请了观音菩萨,那位慈悲的女神。

dialogue.en: Go to the Peach Garden now
dialogue.ipa: ɡoʊ tu ðə piʧ ˈɡɑrdən naʊ

dialogue.en: And pick plenty of ripe peaches
dialogue.ipa: ænd pɪk ˈplɛnti ʌv raɪp ˈpiʧəz

dialogue.en: Red gown and Blue gown went to the garden
dialogue.ipa: rɛd ɡaʊn ænd blu ɡaʊn wɛnt tu ðə ˈɡɑrdən
dialogue.zh: 红衣仙女与青衣仙女来到蟠桃园

dialogue.en: As soon as they went through the gate, both maidens gasped.
dialogue.ipa: æz sun æz ðeɪ wɛnt θru ðə ɡeɪt boʊθ ˈmeɪdənz ɡæspt
dialogue.zh: 她们一进大门,两位少女就倒吸了一口凉气。

dialogue.en: 'Where are all the peaches?' cried Red Gown.
dialogue.ipa: wɛr ɑr ɔl ðə ˈpiʧəz kraɪd rɛd ɡaʊn
dialogue.zh: 蟠桃都去哪儿了?红衣仙女惊呼道。
他们都不见了,青衣仙女哭喊道。

dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ˈtɛrəbəl sɛd rɛd ɡaʊn
dialogue.zh: 这下糟了,红衣仙女说道。

dialogue.en: Wukong had been sleeping up on a branch
dialogue.ipa: Wukong hæd bɪn ˈslipɪŋ ʌp ɑn ə brænʧ

dialogue.en: When he heard the maidens, he woke up.
dialogue.ipa: wɛn hi hɜrd ðə ˈmeɪdənz hi woʊk ʌp
dialogue.zh: 他听到侍女们的声音就醒了。

dialogue.en: 'Who's making all this noise?' he asked, jumping down to the ground.
dialogue.ipa: huz ˈmeɪkɪŋ ɔl ðɪs nɔɪz hi æskt ˈʤʌmpɪŋ daʊn tu ðə ɡraʊnd
dialogue.zh: “ 谁在这么吵? ” 他问道,跳到了地上。

dialogue.en: 'We're sorry to wake you, sir,' said Red Gown.
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈsɑri tu weɪk ju sɜr sɛd rɛd ɡaʊn
dialogue.zh: 抱歉吵醒您了,大人,红衣侍女说道。

dialogue.en: We came to pick peaches for the Peach Festival
dialogue.ipa: wi keɪm tu pɪk ˈpiʧəz fɔr ðə piʧ ˈfɛstəvəl
dialogue.zh: 我们来为蟠桃会摘桃子

dialogue.en: Do you know what happened to-- ?
dialogue.ipa: du ju noʊ wɑt ˈhæpənd tu

dialogue.en: 'Oh, it's a wonderful festival,' said Blue Gown.
dialogue.ipa: oʊ ɪts ə ˈwʌndərfəl ˈfɛstəvəl sɛd blu ɡaʊn
dialogue.zh: 哦,那真是个盛大的宴会,青衣侍女说道。

dialogue.en: All the important gods and spirits will be there
dialogue.ipa: ɔl ði ɪmˈpɔrtənt ɡɑdz ænd ˈspɪrɪts wɪl bi ðɛr
dialogue.zh: 所有重要的神仙都会参加

dialogue.ipa: ðæt saʊndz laɪk fʌn sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 听起来挺有意思,悟空说道。
我肯定也被邀请了,对吧

dialogue.en: Red gown bit her lip.' Um, I don't think so.'
dialogue.ipa: rɛd ɡaʊn bɪt hɜr lɪp ʌm aɪ doʊnt θɪŋk soʊ
dialogue.zh: 红衣侍女咬了咬嘴唇,呃,我觉得没有。

dialogue.en: The Queen did not invite me
dialogue.ipa: ðə kwin dɪd nɑt ɪnˈvaɪt mi

dialogue.en: I'm just as important as any other spirit or God
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʤʌst æz ɪm ˈpɔrtənt æz ˈɛni ˈʌðər ˈspɪrət ɔr ɡɑd
dialogue.zh: 我和其他神仙一样重要

dialogue.en: 'Sir,' said Blue Gown. 'Where are the peaches?'
dialogue.ipa: sɜr sɛd blu ɡaʊn wɛr ɑr ðə ˈpiʧəz
dialogue.zh: “ 大人, ” 青衣仙女问道, “ 桃子去哪儿了? ”

dialogue.en: 'No, you're not going to tell the Queen,' said Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: noʊ jʊr nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu tɛl ðə kwin sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 不,你不能去告诉王后,悟空说道。

dialogue.en: Instantly Red Gown and Blue Gown fell asleep
dialogue.ipa: ˈɪnstəntli rɛd ɡaʊn ænd blu ɡaʊn fɛl əˈslip
dialogue.zh: 红衣和青衣仙女立刻昏睡过去

dialogue.en: Wukong looked at all the empty peach trees
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lʊkt æt ɔl ði ˈɛmpti piʧ triz
dialogue.zh: 悟空看着空荡荡的桃树

dialogue.en: When Red Gown and Blue Gown woke up, they ran back to the Cloud Palace.
dialogue.ipa: wɛn rɛd ɡaʊn ænd blu ɡaʊn woʊk ʌp ðeɪ ræn bæk tu ðə klaʊd ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 红衣和青衣仙女醒来后,就跑回了云宫。

dialogue.en: Sun Wukong ate all the peaches
dialogue.ipa: sʌn Wukong eɪt ɔl ðə ˈpiʧəz
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空吃光了所有的桃子

dialogue.en: 'He got very angry and cast a spell on us,' added Blue Gown.
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡɑt ˈvɛri ˈæŋɡri ænd kæst ə spɛl ɑn ʌs ˈædɪd blu ɡaʊn
dialogue.zh: 他勃然大怒,对我们施了咒语,青衣仙女补充道。

dialogue.en: When we woke up, he was gone.
dialogue.ipa: wɛn wi woʊk ʌp hi wʌz ɡɔn
dialogue.zh: 我们醒来时他已经不见了

dialogue.en: The Queen's eyes flashed with anger
dialogue.ipa: ðə kwinz aɪz flæʃt wɪð ˈæŋɡər
dialogue.zh: 王母娘娘眼中闪过怒火

dialogue.en: She went to the royal court and told the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: ʃi wɛnt tu ðə ˈrɔɪəl kɔrt ænd toʊld ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
ðæt ˈhɔrəbəl ˈmʌŋki kraɪd ði ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: “ 那只可恶的猴子! ” 玉帝喊道。

dialogue.en: The captain nodded and then left the palace
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈkæptən ˈnɑdɪd ænd ðɛn lɛft ðə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 将军点头领命,随即离开宫殿

dialogue.en: Meanwhile, the Bodhisattva Guanyin left her home on Mount Potalaka in the South Sea.
dialogue.ipa: ˈminˌwaɪl, ðə ˌboʊdɪˈsɑːtvə ˌgwɑːnˈjɪn lɛft hɜːr hoʊm ɑːn maʊnt ˌpoʊtəˈlɑːkə ɪn ðə saʊθ siː.
dialogue.zh: 与此同时,观音菩萨离开了她在南海普陀山的道场。

dialogue.en: She soon arrived at the Cloud Palace
dialogue.ipa: ʃi sun əˈraɪvd æt ðə klaʊd ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: 'I'm sorry to tell you this,' said the Queen.
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈsɑri tu tɛl ju ðɪs sɛd ðə kwin
dialogue.zh: 王母娘娘说道: “ 很抱歉告诉你这个消息。 ”

dialogue.en: But there won't be a peach festival
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðɛr woʊnt bi ə piʧ ˈfɛstəvəl

dialogue.zh: 为什么办不成?观音问道

dialogue.en: 'A monkey named Sun Wukong ate all the peaches, said the emperor.
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmʌŋki neɪmd sʌn Wukong eɪt ɔl ðə ˈpiʧəz sɛd ði ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 玉帝说 , 一只名叫孙悟空的猴子吃光了所有桃子。

dialogue.en: I sent 100,000 soldiers to arrest him
dialogue.ipa: aɪ sɛnt 100,000 ˈsoʊlʤərz tu əˈrɛst hɪm
dialogue.zh: 我已派十万天兵去捉拿他

dialogue.en: They'll bring him back to Heaven soon.
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪl brɪŋ hɪm bæk tu ˈhɛvən sun
dialogue.zh: 他们很快就能把他押回天庭

dialogue.en: Just then a messenger ran into the court
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn ə ˈmɛsənʤər ræn ˈɪntu ðə kɔrt
dialogue.zh: 就在这时,一名信使冲进大殿

dialogue.en: We need more soldiers, Your Majesty!
dialogue.ipa: wi nid mɔr ˈsoʊldʒərz, jɔr ˈmædʒəsti
dialogue.zh: 我们需要更多士兵,陛下!

dialogue.en: 'Wukong defeated the entire army,' said the messenger.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong dɪˈfitɪd ði ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi sɛd ðə ˈmɛsənʤər
dialogue.zh: 信使回禀道:孙悟空打败了整个天兵军团

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor put his head in his hands
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər pʊt hɪz hɛd ɪn hɪz hændz

dialogue.en: We don't have any more soldiers!
dialogue.ipa: wi doʊnt hæv ˈɛni mɔr ˈsoʊldʒərz!
dialogue.zh: 我们没有更多的士兵了!

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: 'This peach tastes wonderful,' he said.
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: Wukong had been sleeping up on a branch
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Do you know what happened to-- ?
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: Something terrible has happened
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: All the important gods and spirits in Heaven will be here
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: The maidens were startled
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We must tell the Queen
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Go to the Peach Garden now
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: 'That sounds like fun,' said Wukong.
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When he heard the maidens, he woke up.
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: Red gown bit her lip.' Um, I don't think so.'
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: Do you know what happened to-- ?
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: As soon as they went through the gate, both maidens gasped.
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.

collocations.context: Each morning after that, Wukong secretly ate more and more peaches.
Time went by, and Wukong enjoyed his life in Heaven.
'How may we help you?' asked Red Gown.
As soon as they went through the gate, both maidens gasped.
As soon as they went through the gate, both maidens gasped.
When he heard the maidens, he woke up.
'Who's making all this noise?' he asked, jumping down to the ground.
I'm trying to sleep

He shook his head

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 10 The Powerful Sage

dialogue.en: 'How will we defeat Sun Wukong?' moaned the Jade Emperor.
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl wi dɪˈfit sʌn Wukong moʊnd ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 我们该怎么打败孙悟空?玉帝哀叹道。

dialogue.en: 'I sent our entire army, and they couldn't arrest him.'
dialogue.ipa: aɪ sɛnt ˈaʊər ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi ænd ðeɪ ˈkʊdənt əˈrɛst hɪm
dialogue.zh: 我派出了全部军队,他们却没能抓住他。

dialogue.en: 'Perhaps we can ask the sage Erlang to capture him,' said Guanyin.
dialogue.ipa: pərˈhæps wi kæn æsk ðə seɪʤ Erlang tu ˈkæpʧər hɪm sɛd Guanyin
dialogue.zh: 观音说,或许可以请二郎真君来降服他。

dialogue.en: 'Yes,' said the Jade Emperor. 'Erlang is very powerful.'
dialogue.ipa: jɛs sɛd ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər Erlang ɪz ˈvɛri ˈpaʊərfəl
dialogue.zh: 玉帝答道: “ 是的,二郎神法力高强。 ”

dialogue.en: He turned back to the messenger
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd bæk tu ðə ˈmɛsənʤər

dialogue.en: Ask Erlang if he'll help us
dialogue.ipa: æsk Erlang ɪf hil hɛlp ʌs
dialogue.zh: 询问二郎神是否愿意相助

dialogue.en: Wukong stood in front of the waterfall with his cheering subjects
dialogue.ipa: Wukong stʊd ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə ˈwɔtərˌfɔl wɪð hɪz ˈʧɪrɪŋ ˈsʌbʤɪkts
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空与欢呼的猴群站在瀑布前

dialogue.en: 'Our king has just defeated an entire army from Heaven!' said the gibbon.
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər kɪŋ hæz ʤʌst dɪˈfitɪd ən ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi frʌm ˈhɛvən sɛd ðə ˈɡɪbən
dialogue.zh: 我们的大王刚刚打败了整支天兵!长臂猿说道。

dialogue.en: 'I hope the Jade Emperor learned his lesson,' said Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər lɜrnd hɪz ˈlɛsən sɛd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 悟空说希望玉皇大帝能吸取教训。

dialogue.en: He and his army are no match for--
dialogue.ipa: hi ænd hɪz ˈɑrmi ɑr noʊ mæʧ fɔr
dialogue.zh: 他和他的军队根本不是 -- 对手。

dialogue.ipa: sʌn Wukong ə dip vɔɪs bumd
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空,一个低沉的声音响起。

dialogue.en: A large man was coming down from the sky
dialogue.ipa: ə lɑrʤ mæn wʌz ˈkʌmɪŋ daʊn frʌm ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 一个巨人正从天上降下。

dialogue.en: The apes and other monkeys ran and hid
dialogue.ipa: ði eɪps ænd ˈʌðər ˈmʌŋkiz ræn ænd hɪd
dialogue.zh: 猿猴和其他猴子纷纷逃跑躲藏。

dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm Erlang sɛd ðə mæn

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor sent me to arrest you
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər sɛnt mi tu əˈrɛst ju
dialogue.zh: 玉皇大帝派我来捉拿你。

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor's entire army couldn't defeat me
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərərz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi ˈkʊdənt dɪˈfit mi
dialogue.zh: 玉皇大帝的整支军队都打不过我。

dialogue.en: What do you think you're going to do
dialogue.ipa: wɑt du ju θɪŋk jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu du

dialogue.en: 'I am going to take you back to Heaven.' said Erlang.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu teɪk ju bæk tu ˈhɛvən sɛd Erlang
dialogue.zh: 二郎神说,我要把你带回天庭。

dialogue.en: Waving his iron bar, Wukong leaped at Erlang.
dialogue.ipa: ˈweɪvɪŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr Wukong lɛpt æt Erlang
dialogue.zh: 悟空挥舞着铁棒向二郎神扑去。

dialogue.en: Erlang blocked the bar with his sword and then struck back
dialogue.ipa: Erlang blɑkt ðə bɑr wɪð hɪz sɔrd ænd ðɛn strʌk bæk
dialogue.zh: 二郎神用剑挡住铁棒,随即反击。

dialogue.en: Wukong jumped onto a cloud to get out of the way
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʤʌmpt ˈɑntu ə klaʊd tu ɡɛt aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ

dialogue.en: He shook his body and suddenly grew much bigger
dialogue.ipa: hi ʃʊk hɪz ˈbɑdi ænd ˈsʌdənli ɡru mʌʧ ˈbɪɡər
dialogue.zh: 他身形一晃,突然变得巨大无比。

dialogue.en: Wukong laughed, 'I can do that too.'
dialogue.ipa: Wukong læft aɪ kæn du ðæt tu

dialogue.en: He shook his body and grew just as big as Erlang
dialogue.ipa: hi ʃʊk hɪz ˈbɑdi ænd ɡru ʤʌst æz bɪɡ æz Erlang
dialogue.zh: 他摇身一变,变得和二郎神一样高大。

dialogue.en: Clouds swirled and wind blew as the two giants fought in the sky
dialogue.ipa: klaʊdz swɜrld ænd wɪnd blu æz ðə tu ˈʤaɪənts fɔt ɪn ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 两位巨人在空中激战,云卷风啸。

dialogue.en: Their weapons banged together all through the night
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ˈwɛpənz bæŋd təˈɡɛðər ɔl θru ðə naɪt
dialogue.zh: 他们的兵器整夜碰撞作响。

dialogue.en: They were still fighting when the sun rose the next morning
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɜr stɪl ˈfaɪtɪŋ wɛn ðə sʌn roʊz ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 直到次日太阳升起,他们仍在战斗。

dialogue.en: 'This fight could last forever,' thought Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs faɪt kʊd læst fəˈrɛvər θɔt Wukong
dialogue.zh: 这样打下去恐怕没完没了,悟空心想。

dialogue.en: I should try a different plan
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʃʊd traɪ ə ˈdɪfərənt plæn

dialogue.en: Wukong struck at Erlang one last time and then jumped back down to earth.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong strʌk æt ər læŋ wʌn læst taɪm ænd ðɛn ʤʌmpt bæk daʊn tu ɜrθ
dialogue.zh: 悟空向二郎神发出最后一击,随即跳回地面。

dialogue.en: He turned himself into a sparrow and perched on a branch
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd hɪmˈsɛlf ˈɪntu ə ˈspɛroʊ ænd pɜrʧt ɑn ə brænʧ
dialogue.zh: 他变成一只麻雀,停在树枝上。

dialogue.en: 'Erlang will never find me now,' thought Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: Erlang wɪl ˈnɛvər faɪnd mi naʊ θɔt Wukong
dialogue.zh: 悟空暗想,这会儿二郎神绝对找不到我了。

dialogue.en: He looked up and saw a hawk
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt ʌp ænd sɔ ə hɔk
oʊ noʊ θɔt Wukong ðæts Erlang
dialogue.zh: 悟空心想,糟糕,那是二郎神。

dialogue.en: He turned himself into a fish and swam in the water
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd hɪm ˈsɛlf ˈɪntu ə fɪʃ ænd swæm ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 他变成一条鱼在水中游弋。

dialogue.en: But then a crane flew over the stream
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðɛn ə kreɪn flu ˈoʊvər ðə strim
dialogue.zh: 但这时一只鹤飞过溪面。

dialogue.en: The crane swooped down at the water
dialogue.ipa: ðə kreɪn swupt daʊn æt ðə ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: Wukong shot out of the stream
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʃɑt aʊt ʌv ðə strim

dialogue.en: He changed back into himself and ran down a hill
dialogue.ipa: hi ʧeɪnʤd bæk ˈɪntu hɪmˈsɛlf ænd ræn daʊn ə hɪl
dialogue.zh: 他变回原形,向山下奔去。

dialogue.en: 'I'll turn myself into a temple,' he thought.
dialogue.ipa: aɪl tɜrn ˌmaɪˈsɛlf ˈɪntu ə ˈtɛmpəl hi θɔt
dialogue.zh: 他心想,我要把自己变成一座庙。

dialogue.en: Then if Erlang tries to enter, I'll bite him.
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ɪf erlan traɪz tu ˈɛntər aɪl baɪt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 那要是二郎神想进来,我就咬他

dialogue.en: Wukong's eyes became windows and his mouth became a door.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong's aɪz bɪˈkeɪm ˈwɪndoʊz ænd hɪz maʊθ bɪˈkeɪm ə dɔr
dialogue.zh: 悟空的眼睛变成了窗户,嘴巴变成了门。

dialogue.en: He turned his tail into a flagpole
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd hɪz teɪl ˈɪntu ə ˈflæɡˌpoʊl
dialogue.zh: 他把尾巴变成了一根旗杆

dialogue.en: A moment later Erlang came down the hill
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər Erlang keɪm daʊn ðə hɪl
dialogue.zh: 不一会儿,二郎神从山上下来

dialogue.en: When he saw the temple, he scratched his head.
dialogue.ipa: wɛn hi sɔ ðə ˈtɛmpəl hi skræʧt hɪz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 看到这座庙,他挠了挠头。

dialogue.en: 'Hmm,' said Erlang. 'I never saw a temple with a flagpole before.'
dialogue.ipa: Hmm sɛd Erlang aɪ ˈnɛvər sɔ ə ˈtɛmpəl wɪð ə ˈflæɡˌpoʊl bɪˈfɔr
dialogue.zh: 嗯,二郎神说 我从没见过庙后竖旗杆的

dialogue.en: 'Oh! no.' thought Wukong. 'He'll break all my teeth.'
dialogue.ipa: oʊ noʊ θɔt Wukong hil breɪk ɔl maɪ tiθ
dialogue.zh: 糟了,悟空心想 他要把我的牙都踢碎了

dialogue.en: Wukong changed back into himself and ran
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʧeɪnʤd bæk ˈɪntu hɪmˈsɛlf ænd ræn
dialogue.zh: 悟空赶紧变回原形逃跑

dialogue.en: Up in Heaven the Jade Emperor, the Queen and Guan Yin watched the chase.
dialogue.ipa: ʌp ɪn ˈhɛvən ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər ðə kwin ænd Guan jɪn wɑʧt ðə ʧeɪs
dialogue.zh: 在天庭,玉帝、王母娘娘和观音菩萨正看着这场追逐。

dialogue.en: The sage Laozi came over to them
dialogue.ipa: ðə seɪʤ Laozi keɪm ˈoʊvər tu ðɛm

dialogue.en: 'What's going on?' he asked, looking down.
dialogue.ipa: wʌts ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn hi æskt ˈlʊkɪŋ daʊn
dialogue.zh: “ 发生什么事了? ” 他问道,低头看去。

dialogue.en: That monkey Sun Wukong ate all the peaches from the garden.
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈmʌŋki sʌn ˈwuːkɔːŋ eɪt ɔːl ðə ˈpiːtʃɪz frəm ðə ˈɡɑːrdən
dialogue.zh: 那只猴子孙悟空把园里的桃子全吃光了。

dialogue.en: Then he defeated our entire army
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi dɪˈfitɪd ˈaʊər ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 还打败了我们所有天兵天将

dialogue.en: Erlang is trying to catch him now
dialogue.ipa: Erlang ɪz ˈtraɪɪŋ tu kæʧ hɪm naʊ
dialogue.zh: 现在二郎神正设法捉拿他

dialogue.en: He took a metal ring off his arm
dialogue.ipa: hi tʊk ə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ ɔf hɪz ɑrm
dialogue.zh: 他从手臂上取下一个金刚琢

dialogue.en: He aimed carefully and hurled it down to Earth
dialogue.ipa: hi eɪmd ˈkɛrfəli ænd hɜrld ɪt daʊn tu ɜrθ
dialogue.zh: 仔细瞄准后朝人间掷去

dialogue.en: The ring hit Wukong on the head
dialogue.ipa: ðə rɪŋ hɪt Wukong ɑn ðə hɛd
dialogue.zh: 金刚琢正砸在悟空头上

dialogue.en: The monkey looked dizzy for a moment, and then fell to the ground.
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lʊkt ˈdɪzi fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt ænd ðɛn fɛl tu ðə ɡraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 猴子晕了一会儿,然后就摔倒在地上了。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: 'Perhaps we can ask the sage Erlang to capture him,' said Guanyin.
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: A large man was coming down from the sky
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: 'I am Erlang,' said the man.
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: 'I am going to take you back to Heaven.' said Erlang.
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: 'How will we defeat Sun Wukong?' moaned the Jade Emperor.
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: And you will be punished
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: 'Perhaps we can ask the sage Erlang to capture him,' said Guanyin.
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: 'I sent our entire army, and they couldn't arrest him.'
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: This must be Wukong
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: I should try a different plan
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: 'I am going to take you back to Heaven.' said Erlang.
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: Then if Erlang tries to enter, I'll bite him.
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Go to Plum Mountain
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: Ask Erlang if he'll help us
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: They were still fighting when the sun rose the next morning
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: He shook his body and grew just as big as Erlang
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.
