titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 11 Trouble in Heaven

dialogue.en: Erlang quickly tied up Wukong and brought him up to Heaven
dialogue.ipa: Erlang ˈkwɪkli taɪd ʌp Wukong ænd brɔt hɪm ʌp tu ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 二郎神迅速捆住悟空,将他押往天庭

dialogue.en: ‘I want Sun Wukong destroyed , ’ said the Jade Emperor.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt sʌn Wukong dɪˈstrɔɪd sɛd ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 我要将孙悟空处死 玉帝说

dialogue.en: Soldiers tied Wukong to a pillar in a courtyard
dialogue.ipa: ˈsoʊlʤərz taɪd Wukong tu ə ˈpɪlər ɪn ə ˈkɔrˌtjɑrd
dialogue.zh: 天兵们将悟空绑在院中的柱子上

dialogue.en: But his body was as hard as a diamond
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hɪz ˈbɑdi wʌz æz hɑrd æz ə ˈdaɪmənd
dialogue.zh: 但他的身体坚硬如金刚

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor turned to a messenger
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər tɜrnd tu ə ˈmɛsənʤər

dialogue.en: Several fire gods entered the courtyard and threw balls of flame at Wukong.
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɛvrəl ˈfaɪər ɡɑdz ˈɛntərd ðə ˈkɔrˌtjɑrd ænd θru bɔlz ʌv fleɪm æt Wukong
dialogue.zh: 几位火神走进庭院,向悟空投掷火球。

dialogue.en: But when the smoke cleared, not one hair on Wukong's body was burned.
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wɛn ðə smoʊk klɪrd nɑt wʌn hɛr ɑn Wukong's ˈbɑdi wʌz bɜrnd
dialogue.zh: 但当烟雾散去,悟空身上一根毫毛都没被烧着。

dialogue.en: 'Thank you,' Wukong laughed. 'I was feeling a little cold.'
dialogue.ipa: θæŋk ju Wukong læft aɪ wʌz ˈfilɪŋ ə ˈlɪtəl koʊld
dialogue.zh: 多谢了,悟空笑着说道,我刚才还觉得有点冷呢。

dialogue.en: 'Gather the thunder gods,' said the Jade Emperor.
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡæðər ðə ˈθʌndər ɡɑdz sɛd ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər

dialogue.en: Several thunder gods entered the courtyard
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɛvrəl ˈθʌndər ɡɑdz ˈɛntərd ðə ˈkɔrˌtjɑrd

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor smiled as lightning bolts shot toward Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər smaɪld æz ˈlaɪtnɪŋ boʊlts ʃɑt təˈwɔrd Wukong
dialogue.zh: 玉帝微笑着看闪电射向悟空

dialogue.en: But even the lightning couldn't harm the monkey
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ˈivɪn ðə ˈlaɪtnɪŋ ˈkʊdənt hɑrm ðə ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 但就连闪电也伤不了这猴子

dialogue.en: 'That tickled,' said Wukong with a smile.
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈtɪkəld sɛd Wukong wɪð ə smaɪl
dialogue.zh: 那挠得怪痒的,悟空笑着说。

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor shook his head
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər ʃʊk hɪz hɛd

dialogue.en: It seems that Wukong can't be destroyed
dialogue.ipa: ɪt simz ðæt Wukong kænt bi dɪˈstrɔɪd

dialogue.en: 'That's because he ate all the peaches,' said Laozi.
dialogue.ipa: ðæts bɪˈkɔz hi eɪt ɔl ðə ˈpiʧəz sɛd laozi
dialogue.zh: 那是因为他吃光了所有蟠桃 太上老君说道

dialogue.en: Just one peach would make someone live forever
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst wʌn piʧ wʊd meɪk ˈsʌmˌwʌn lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 吃一颗蟠桃就能让人长生不老

dialogue.en: He ate every peach in the garden
dialogue.ipa: hi eɪt ˈɛvəri piʧ ɪn ðə ˈɡɑrdən
dialogue.zh: 他把园子里的蟠桃全吃了

dialogue.en: Then how will we get rid of him
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn haʊ wɪl wi ɡɛt rɪd ʌv hɪm
aɪ hæv ən aɪˈdiə sɛd Laozi
dialogue.zh: 我有个主意 太上老君说道

dialogue.en: I'll put him in the large pot I use for making potions
dialogue.ipa: aɪl pʊt hɪm ɪn ðə lɑrʤ pɑt aɪ juz fɔr ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈpoʊʃənz
dialogue.zh: 我把他放进我炼丹用的大炉子里

dialogue.en: Maybe we can burn him up slowly
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi wi kæn bɜrn hɪm ʌp ˈsloʊli

dialogue.en: Soldiers brought Wukong to a room in Laozi's palace
dialogue.ipa: ˈsoʊlʤərz brɔt Wukong tu ə rum ɪn Laozi's ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 天兵将悟空带到太上老君宫殿的一个房间

dialogue.en: A large pot sat in the middle of the room
dialogue.ipa: ə lɑrʤ pɑt sæt ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl ʌv ðə rum
dialogue.zh: 房间中央放着一口大炉子

dialogue.en: Laozi put Wukong into the pot, and then closed the lid.
dialogue.ipa: Laozi pʊt Wukong ˈɪntu ðə pɑt ænd ðɛn kloʊzd ðə lɪd
dialogue.zh: 太上老君把悟空放进炉中,然后盖上了炉盖。

dialogue.en: Laozi started a fire under the pot
dialogue.ipa: Laozi ˈstɑrtɪd ə ˈfaɪər ˈʌndər ðə pɑt
dialogue.zh: 太上老君在炉下生起火

dialogue.en: Day and night he tended the fire
dialogue.ipa: deɪ ænd naɪt hi ˈtɛndɪd ðə ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 他日夜不停地照看炉火

dialogue.en: He kept it burning for 49 days
dialogue.ipa: hi kɛpt ɪt ˈbɜrnɪŋ fɔr 49 deɪz
dialogue.zh: 让炉火持续燃烧了四十九天

dialogue.en: 'Wukong must have been destroyed by now,' thought Laozi.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong mʌst hæv bɪn dɪˈstrɔɪd baɪ naʊ θɔt Laozi
dialogue.zh: 悟空现在肯定已经被炼化了吧,太上老君心想。

dialogue.en: He slowly took the lid off the pot
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈsloʊli tʊk ðə lɪd ɔf ðə pɑt

dialogue.en: Smoke poured from the opening, and Wukong leaped out.
dialogue.ipa: smoʊk pɔrd frʌm ði ˈoʊpənɪŋ ænd Wukong lɛpt aʊt
dialogue.zh: 浓烟从开口涌出,悟空跳了出来。

dialogue.en: Burning pieces of coal flew everywhere
dialogue.ipa: ˈbɜrnɪŋ ˈpisəz ʌv koʊl flu ˈɛvriˌwɛr

dialogue.en: Wukong's eyes were red, and he was coughing.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong's aɪz wɜr rɛd ænd hi wʌz ˈkɑfɪŋ
ðæt smoʊk wʌz ˈhɔrəbəl hi kraɪd
dialogue.zh: 这烟可真够呛,他喊了出来。

dialogue.en: He pushed Laozi, knocking the sage onto his back
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊʃt Laozi ˈnɑkɪŋ ðə seɪʤ ˈɑntu hɪz bæk
dialogue.zh: 他推了老子一把,并把这位圣人推得仰面摔倒。

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar, and smashed everything in the room.
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd smæʃt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɪn ðə rum
dialogue.zh: 悟空抽出金箍棒,把房间里的东西砸得稀巴烂。
快来人拦住他!太上老君喊道。

dialogue.en: Wukong ran out of Laozi's palace
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ræn aʊt ʌv Laozi's ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 悟空冲出太上老君的宫殿

dialogue.en: Gods and spirits bled as Wukong smashed everything in his path
dialogue.ipa: ɡɑdz ænd ˈspɪrɪts blɛd æz Wukong smæʃt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɪn hɪz pæθ
dialogue.zh: 悟空一路砸去,众神鬼怪纷纷挂彩

dialogue.en: Laozi ran into the Cloud Palace
dialogue.ipa: Laozi ræn ˈɪntu ðə klaʊd ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: 'Your Majesty, Wukong is causing trouble all over Heaven.' he said.
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ˈmæʤəsti Wukong ɪz ˈkɑzɪŋ ˈtrʌbəl ɔl ˈoʊvər ˈhɛvən hi sɛd
dialogue.zh: 陛下,悟空正在天庭四处闹事,他说。

dialogue.ipa: wɑt kraɪd ði ˈɛmpərər hiz ə ˈlaɪv
dialogue.zh: 啥 ! 玉帝惊呼 他还活着 ?

dialogue.en: I took the lid off the pot because I thought he was burned up
dialogue.ipa: aɪ tʊk ðə lɪd ɔf ðə pɑt bɪˈkɔz aɪ θɔt hi wʌz bɜrnd ʌp
dialogue.zh: 我以为他已经被烧成灰了,所以揭开了炉盖

dialogue.en: But the fire didn't hurt him at all
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈfaɪər ˈdɪdənt hɜrt hɪm æt ɔl
dialogue.zh: 但火焰根本没伤到他分毫

dialogue.en: 'This is an outrage,' said the Jade Emperor.
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ən ˈaʊˌtreɪʤ sɛd ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 这简直是无法无天,玉皇大帝说道。

dialogue.en: What are we going to do with that monkey
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɑr wi ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu du wɪð ðæt ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 我们该怎么处置那只猴子

dialogue.en: The emperor thought for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛmpərər θɔt fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt

dialogue.en: 'We must ask Buddha for help,' he said.
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst æsk ˈbudə fɔr hɛlp hi sɛd
dialogue.zh: 我们必须求佛祖帮忙,他说道。

dialogue.en: Go to the Western Paradise quickly.
dialogue.ipa: ɡoʊ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs ˈkwɪkli

dialogue.en: See if Buddha can come to help us
dialogue.ipa: si ɪf ˈbudə kæn kʌm tu hɛlp ʌs
dialogue.zh: 看看佛祖能否前来相助

dialogue.en: Flying as fast as he could, the messenger headed toward the Western Paradise.
dialogue.ipa: ˈflaɪɪŋ æz fæst æz hi kʊd ðə ˈmɛsənʤər ˈhɛdɪd tə ˈwɔrd ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 他拼尽全力飞速飞向西方极乐世界。

dialogue.en: Everybody hid indoors as Wukong ran through Heaven.
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvri ˌbɑdi hɪd ˈɪnˌdɔrz æz Wukong ræn θru ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 悟空在天庭横冲直撞,众仙纷纷躲进屋内

dialogue.en: Using his iron bar, he smashed doors and windows and knocked over statues.
dialogue.ipa: ˈjuzɪŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr hi smæʃt dɔrz ænd ˈwɪndoʊz ænd nɑkt ˈoʊvər ˈstæˌʧuz
dialogue.zh: 他挥舞金箍棒,砸烂门窗,推倒雕像。

dialogue.en: Before him was a huge figure , glowing with golden light.
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈfɔr hɪm wʌz ə hjuʤ ˈfɪɡjər ˈɡloʊɪŋ wɪð ˈɡoʊldən laɪt
dialogue.zh: 眼前出现一个巨大的身影 周身散发着金色光芒

dialogue.ipa: wɑt du ju wɑnt æskt Wukong
dialogue.zh: 你想干什么 悟空问道

dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ˈbudə sɛd ðə ˈfɪɡə
dialogue.zh: 我乃佛祖 那身影说道

dialogue.en: Who are you and why are you causing all this trouble?
dialogue.ipa: hu ɑr ju ænd waɪ ɑr ju ˈkɑzɪŋ ɔl ðɪs ˈtrʌbəl
dialogue.zh: 你是谁,为什么要惹这么多麻烦?

dialogue.en: I am Sun Wukong, king of the Fruit and Flower Mountain.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm sʌn Wukong kɪŋ ʌv ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 我是孙悟空,花果山的大王。

dialogue.en: I should be the king of Heaven too.
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʃʊd bi ðə kɪŋ ʌv ˈhɛvən tu

dialogue.en: I'm going to the Cloud Palace to tell the Jade Emperor to leave
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə klaʊd ˈpæləs tu tɛl ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər tu liv
dialogue.zh: 我正要去云宫叫玉帝让位

dialogue.en: If he doesn't, I'll never stop causing trouble.
dialogue.ipa: ɪf hi ˈdʌzənt aɪl ˈnɛvər stɑp ˈkɑzɪŋ ˈtrʌbəl
dialogue.zh: 他若不肯 我就闹他个天翻地覆

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Erlang quickly tied up Wukong and brought him up to Heaven
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: 'Thank you,' Wukong laughed. 'I was feeling a little cold.'
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: ‘I want Sun Wukong destroyed , ' said the Jade Emperor.
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: 'Your Majesty, Wukong is causing trouble all over Heaven.' he said.
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: 'Wukong must have been destroyed by now,' thought Laozi.
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Then how will we get rid of him
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: But when the smoke cleared, not one hair on Wukong's body was burned.
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Your swords can't hurt me
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: But even the lightning couldn't harm the monkey
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: 'Wukong must have been destroyed by now,' thought Laozi.
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: I should be the king of Heaven too.
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Bring in the fire gods
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: 'That tickled,' said Wukong with a smile.
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: See if Buddha can come to help us
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: But when the smoke cleared, not one hair on Wukong's body was burned.
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: 'That's because he ate all the peaches,' said Laozi.
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

The Jade Emperor shook his head

Wukong pulled out his iron bar, and smashed everything in the room.
Laozi ran into the Cloud Palace
The emperor thought for a moment
See if Buddha can come to help us

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 12: The bet

dialogue.en: How did you get so powerful
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɪd ju ɡɛt soʊ ˈpaʊərfəl

dialogue.en: A sage taught me secret formulas
dialogue.ipa: ə seɪʤ tɔt mi ˈsikrət ˈfɔrmjələz
dialogue.zh: 一位智者传授了我秘法。

dialogue.en: I practiced them for many years
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈpræktəst ðɛm fɔr ˈmɛni jɪrz
dialogue.zh: 我修炼这些秘法已有多年。

dialogue.en: I am now equal to the Jade emperor
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm naʊ ˈikwəl tu ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 如今我的修为已与玉帝相当。

dialogue.en: The Jade emperor has been practicing the same formulas for many lifetimes
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər hæz bɪn ˈpræktəsɪŋ ðə seɪm ˈfɔrmjələz fɔr ˈmɛni ˈlaɪfˌtaɪmz
dialogue.zh: 玉帝修炼同样的秘法已历经多世。

dialogue.en: How can you think you're equal to him
dialogue.ipa: haʊ kæn ju θɪŋk jʊr ˈikwəl tu hɪm
dialogue.zh: 你怎敢自认与他平起平坐?

dialogue.en: Go back to your mountain now and behave yourself
dialogue.ipa: ɡoʊ bæk tu jʊər ˈmaʊntən naʊ ænd bɪˈheɪv jərˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 现在回你的山里去,安分守己吧。

dialogue.en: I'm not leaving until I get to rule heaven
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈlivɪŋ ənˈtɪl aɪ ɡɛt tu rul ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 不让我掌管天庭,我绝不离开。

dialogue.en: Sun Wukong what powers do you have
dialogue.ipa: sʌn Wukong wɑt ˈpaʊərz du ju hæv

dialogue.en: I can change into other animals
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn ʧeɪnʤ ˈɪntu ˈʌðər ˈænəməlz

dialogue.en: I can soar through the sky on clouds
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn sɔr θru ðə skaɪ ɑn klaʊdz
dialogue.zh: 我能腾云驾雾,翱翔天际。

dialogue.en: I can do anything I want
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn du ˈɛniˌθɪŋ aɪ wɑnt
dialogue.zh: 我能随心所欲,无所不能。

dialogue.en: If you win you can rule heaven
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju wɪn ju kæn rul ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 你若赢了,便可掌管天庭。

dialogue.en: The Jade emperor will come to live with me in the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər wɪl kʌm tu lɪv wɪð mi ɪn ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrə ˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 玉帝将随我同住西方极乐世界。

dialogue.en: What do I have to do
dialogue.ipa: wɑt du aɪ hæv tu du

dialogue.en: You just have to jump off my hand
dialogue.ipa: ju ʤʌst hæv tu ʤʌmp ɔf maɪ hænd
dialogue.zh: 你只需从我手掌上跳出去。

dialogue.en: I can jump across entire oceans
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn ʤʌmp əˈkrɔs ɪnˈtaɪər ˈoʊʃənz
dialogue.zh: 我能一跃跨过整个海洋。

dialogue.en: Well then let's see you do it
dialogue.ipa: wɛl ðɛn lɛts si ju du ɪt
dialogue.zh: 那就让我们看看你的本事吧。

dialogue.en: Wukong stepped up onto buddha's palm
dialogue.ipa: Wukong stɛpt ʌp ˈɑntu ˈbudəz pɑm

dialogue.en: I'm going to jump farther than you could ever imagine
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ʤʌmp ˈfɑrðər ðæn ju kʊd ˈɛvər ɪˈmæʤən
dialogue.zh: 我要跳得比你想象的还要远。

dialogue.en: I'll be the ruler of heaven
dialogue.ipa: aɪl bi ðə ˈrulər ʌv ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: Wukong leaped and soared through the air
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lɛpt ænd sɔrd θru ði ɛr
dialogue.zh: 悟空纵身一跃,腾空而起。
他看见五根巨大的柱子。

dialogue.en: He landed in front of them
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈlændɪd ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðɛm

dialogue.en: This must be the end of the world
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs mʌst bi ði ɛnd ʌv ðə wɜrld
dialogue.zh: 这里一定是世界的尽头了。

dialogue.en: I'll go back now and tell Buddha to take the Jade emperor away
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ bæk naʊ ænd tɛl ˈbudə tu teɪk ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 我现在就回去,让佛祖把玉帝带走。

dialogue.en: Wukong was just about to jump back
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wʌz ʤʌst əˈbaʊt tu ʤʌmp bæk

dialogue.en: How will I prove that I was here
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl aɪ pruv ðæt aɪ wʌz hir
dialogue.zh: 我怎么证明我来过这里呢

dialogue.en: I'll write a note on this pillar
dialogue.ipa: aɪl raɪt ə noʊt ɑn ðɪs ˈpɪlər
dialogue.zh: 我要在这根柱子上写个记号

dialogue.en: Buddha can come here and check
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə kæn kʌm hir ænd ʧɛk

dialogue.en: Wukong plucked two hairs and turn them into a brush and a jar of ink
dialogue.ipa: Wukong plʌkt tu hɛr ænd tɜrn ðɛm ˈɪntu ə brʌʃ ænd ə ʤɑr ʌv ɪŋk
dialogue.zh: 悟空拔下两根毫毛,变出一支笔和一瓶墨水

dialogue.en: On one of the pillars he wrote
dialogue.ipa: ɑn wʌn ʌv ðə ˈpɪlərz hi roʊt
dialogue.zh: 他在其中一根柱子上写道

dialogue.en: Now I'll go and tell Buddha how far I jumped
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪl ɡoʊ ænd tɛl ˈbudə haʊ fɑr aɪ ʤʌmpt
dialogue.zh: 现在我要去告诉佛祖我跳了多远

dialogue.en: He landed on buddha's palm again
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈlændɪd ɑn ˈbudəz pɑm ə ˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 他又落回佛祖的手掌上

dialogue.en: Tell the Jade emperor to leave
dialogue.ipa: tɛl ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər tu liv

dialogue.en: How can you say you're back
dialogue.ipa: haʊ kæn ju seɪ jʊr bæk

dialogue.zh: 你压根没离开过我的手掌

dialogue.en: I reached the end of the world
dialogue.ipa: aɪ riʧt ði ɛnd ʌv ðə wɜrld

dialogue.en: Come with me and I'll show you
dialogue.ipa: kʌm wɪð mi ænd aɪl ʃoʊ ju

dialogue.en: There's no need to go anywhere
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz noʊ nid tu ɡoʊ ˈɛniˌwɛr

dialogue.en: Near the bottom of buddha's middle finger was the note
dialogue.ipa: nɪr ðə ˈbɑtəm ʌv ˈbudəz ˈmɪdəl ˈfɪŋɡər wʌz ðə noʊt
dialogue.zh: 佛祖中指根部附近赫然写着那行字

dialogue.en: You use some sort of magic
dialogue.ipa: ju juz sʌm sɔrt ʌv ˈmæʤɪk

dialogue.en: I jumped all the way to
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʤʌmpt ɔl ðə weɪ tu

dialogue.en: You lost the bet Sun Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ju lɔst ðə bɛt sʌn Wukong
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空,这场赌约是你输了

dialogue.en: And now you will be punished
dialogue.ipa: ænd naʊ ju wɪl bi ˈpʌnɪʃt

dialogue.en: His hand turned into a mountain
dialogue.ipa: hɪz hænd tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Which he placed on top of the monkey
dialogue.ipa: wɪʧ hi pleɪst ɑn tɑp ʌv ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: And pushed with all his strength
dialogue.ipa: ænd pʊʃt wɪð ɔl hɪz strɛŋkθ
dialogue.zh: 他使出了全身的力气去推

dialogue.en: Buddha pulled a small sheet of magic paper from his sleeve
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə pʊld ə smɔl ʃit ʌv ˈmæʤɪk ˈpeɪpər frʌm hɪz sliv
dialogue.zh: 佛祖从袖中抽出一张小小的符纸

dialogue.en: He laid the paper on top of the mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi leɪd ðə ˈpeɪpər ɑn tɑp ʌv ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 他将符纸贴在了山顶上

dialogue.en: Buddha turned to the Jade emperor
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə tɜrnd tu ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər

dialogue.en: Sun Wukong can't lift the mountain now
dialogue.ipa: sʌn Wukong kænt lɪft ðə ˈmaʊntən naʊ
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空现在搬不动这座山了

dialogue.en: He will be trapped until his punishment is over
dialogue.ipa: hi wɪl bi træpt ən ˈtɪl hɪz ˈpʌnɪʃmənt ɪz ˈoʊvər
dialogue.zh: 他将一直被压在这里,直到刑期结束

The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: The Jade emperor has been practicing the same formulas for many lifetimes
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has been + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 强调动作从过去开始并持续到现在，或说明眼前结果的原因。
grammar.source: The Jade emperor has been practicing the same formulas for many lifetimes
examples: They have been walking all day.
Wukong has been searching for the demon.
The monk has been waiting by the road.
Bajie has been sleeping under the tree.
We have been following this path.
I have been reading the scripture.
The guards have been watching the gate.
It has been raining since morning.
She has been preparing the meal.
The villagers have been hiding in their homes.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: The Jade emperor will come to live with me in the western paradise
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: You will be punished severely
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: How can you think you're equal to him
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: I'm going to jump farther than you could ever imagine
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: This must be the end of the world
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: What do I have to do
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Then let's make a bet
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Go back to your mountain now and behave yourself
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's nobody around
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you win you can rule heaven
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When I return
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: How did you get so powerful
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

collocations.context: Buddha smiled at Wukong
Go back to your mountain now and behave yourself
I can change into other animals
Then let's make a bet
What do I have to do
He said to Buddha
He landed in front of them
I'll go back now and tell Buddha to take the Jade emperor away
When he thought of something
Just look down
I jumped all the way to
His hand turned into a mountain
Which he placed on top of the monkey
The mountain started to rise
Buddha turned to the Jade emperor

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 13 the true scriptures

dialogue.en: Wukong stayed trapped under the mountain
dialogue.ipa: Wukong steɪd træpt ˈʌndər ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: A thick layer of moss covered the monkey
dialogue.ipa: ə θɪk ˈleɪər ʌv mɔs ˈkʌvərd ðə ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 猴子身上覆盖了厚厚一层青苔

dialogue.en: One day Buddha sat in the Thunderclap monastery in the western Paradise
dialogue.ipa: wʌn deɪ ˈbudə sæt ɪn ðə Thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri ɪn ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 一天,佛祖坐在西方极乐世界的雷音寺中

dialogue.en: He was talking to his students
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈtɔkɪŋ tu hɪz ˈstudənts

dialogue.en: In the Tang Empire need our help
dialogue.ipa: ɪn ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpaɪər nid ˈaʊər hɛlp
dialogue.zh: 大唐帝国需要我们的帮助

dialogue.en: They are greedy and constantly fighting
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ɑr ˈɡridi ænd ˈkɑnstəntli ˈfaɪtɪŋ

dialogue.en: He held up a bundle of scrolls
dialogue.ipa: hi hɛld ʌp ə ˈbʌndəl ʌv skroʊlz

dialogue.en: They will teach the people in the east to act better
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɪl tiʧ ðə ˈpipəl ɪn ði ist tu ækt ˈbɛtər
dialogue.zh: 它们将教导东方的人们行善

dialogue.en: Let's bring the scriptures to the Tang Empire
dialogue.ipa: lɛts brɪŋ ðə ˈskrɪpʧərz tu ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpaɪər
dialogue.zh: 我们把真经送到大唐去吧
必须有一位虔诚的信徒

dialogue.en: A monk needs to come here to get them
dialogue.ipa: ə mʌŋk nidz tu kʌm hir tu ɡɛt ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 一位僧人需要亲自来此取经

dialogue.en: Will anyone go to the east to find a worthy monk
dialogue.ipa: wɪl ˈɛniˌwʌn ɡoʊ tu ði ist tu faɪnd ə ˈwɜrði mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 有谁愿意去东方寻找一位有德的僧人吗

dialogue.en: The Tang emperor smiled as his head monk read to a small group of people
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpərər smaɪld æz hɪz hɛd mʌŋk rid tu ə smɔl ɡrup ʌv ˈpipəl
dialogue.zh: 大唐皇帝微笑着,听他的高僧对一小群人讲经

dialogue.en: The monk was reading old religious texts
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk wʌz ˈrɛdɪŋ oʊld rɪˈlɪʤəs tɛksts
dialogue.zh: 高僧正在诵读古老的经文

dialogue.en: Why are you reading those old texts
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɑr ju ˈrɛdɪŋ ðoʊz oʊld tɛksts
dialogue.zh: 您为何诵读这些陈旧的经文

dialogue.en: Don't you know about the true scriptures
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt ju noʊ əˈbaʊt ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz

dialogue.en: He walked over to the woman
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈwɑftɪd ˈoʊvər tu ðə ˈwʊmən

dialogue.en: The woman looked at the monk carefully
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwʊmən lʊkt æt ðə mʌŋk ˈkɛrfəli

dialogue.en: People who learn the lessons never have to suffer again
dialogue.ipa: ˈpipəl hu lɜrn ðə ˈlɛsənz ˈnɛvər hæv tu ˈsʌfər əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 领悟了这些教义的人将永离苦难

dialogue.en: They are with Buddha in the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ɑr wɪð ˈbudə ɪn ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 它们与佛祖同在西方极乐世界

dialogue.en: Someone must travel to the thunderclap monastery to get them
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌmˌwʌn mʌst ˈtrævəl tu ðə thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri tu ɡɛt ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 必须有人前往雷音寺取回它们

dialogue.en: But only a true believer may make the journey
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ˈoʊnli ə tru bə ˈlivər meɪ meɪk ðə ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 但唯有真正的信徒方能踏上此途

dialogue.en: She took a robe out of her bag
dialogue.ipa: ʃi tʊk ə roʊb aʊt ʌv hɜr bæɡ
dialogue.zh: 她从行囊中取出一件袈裟

dialogue.en: The monk put on the robe
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk pʊt ɑn ðə roʊb

dialogue.en: Beams of light shone from it
dialogue.ipa: bimz ʌv laɪt ʃoʊn frʌm ɪt
dialogue.zh: 袈裟顿时绽放出万丈光芒

dialogue.en: Looking down at the glowing robe
dialogue.ipa: ˈlʊkɪŋ daʊn æt ðə ˈɡloʊɪŋ roʊb
dialogue.zh: 低头凝视着发光的袈裟

dialogue.en: The journey will be very difficult
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈʤɜrni wɪl bi ˈvɛri ˈdɪfəkəlt
dialogue.zh: 这趟旅程将会异常艰难

dialogue.en: Wide rivers and steep mountains will block your path
dialogue.ipa: waɪd ˈrɪvərz ænd stip ˈmaʊntənz wɪl blɑk jʊər pæθ
dialogue.zh: 宽阔的江河与险峻的山峦将阻挡你的去路

dialogue.en: Fierce creatures and evil demons will try to attack you
dialogue.ipa: fɪrs ˈkriʧərz ænd ˈivəl ˈdimənz wɪl traɪ tu əˈtæk ju
dialogue.zh: 凶猛的野兽与邪恶的妖魔会试图袭击你

dialogue.en: You will have help from me
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl hæv hɛlp frʌm mi

dialogue.en: Suddenly the room filled with blinding light
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðə rum fɪld wɪð ˈblaɪndɪŋ laɪt
dialogue.zh: 刹那间屋内充满耀眼光芒

dialogue.en: The woman rose into the air and changed form
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwʊmən roʊz ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd ʧeɪnʤd fɔrm
dialogue.zh: 那女子凌空而起变幻身形

dialogue.en: The emperor and everyone else in the room bowed
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛmpərər ænd ˈɛvriˌwʌn ɛls ɪn ðə rum baʊd
dialogue.zh: 皇帝与满堂众人纷纷躬身行礼

dialogue.en: Guanyin rose higher and then disappeared
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin roʊz ˈhaɪər ænd ðɛn ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd
dialogue.zh: 观音升至高空随即消失不见

dialogue.en: The next morning there was a huge feast
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðɛr wʌz ə hjuʤ fist
dialogue.zh: 次日清晨举行了盛大的宴席

dialogue.en: The Tang emperor sat next to the monk
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpərər sæt nɛkst tu ðə mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Your journey will help our empire greatly
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ˈʤɜrni wɪl hɛlp ˈaʊər ˈɛmpaɪər ˈɡreɪtli
dialogue.zh: 你的旅程将造福大唐江山

dialogue.en: No longer will our people suffer or treat each other badly
dialogue.ipa: noʊ ˈlɔŋɡər wɪl ˈaʊər ˈpipəl ˈsʌfər ɔr trit iʧ ˈʌðər ˈbædli
dialogue.zh: 百姓将不再受苦也不再互相欺凌

dialogue.en: I will think of you as my brother
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl θɪŋk ʌv ju æz maɪ ˈbrʌðər

dialogue.en: You will be called the Tang Monk
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl bi kɔld ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: How long will the journey take
dialogue.ipa: haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ðə ˈʤɜrni teɪk

dialogue.en: I will return in a few years
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl rɪˈtɜrn ɪn ə fju jɪrz

dialogue.en: Later that day the Tang monk got ready for his journey
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪtər ðæt deɪ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɡɑt ˈrɛdi fɔr hɪz ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 当日稍晚时分唐僧整装待发

dialogue.en: He put the special robe into a bag
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊt ðə ˈspɛʃəl roʊb ˈɪntu ə bæɡ
dialogue.zh: 他将那件宝袈裟收进行囊

dialogue.en: He put dried foods into another bag
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊt draɪd fudz ˈɪntu əˈnʌðər bæɡ
dialogue.zh: 又将干粮装入另一个包袱

dialogue.en: A big crowd gathered to say goodbye
dialogue.ipa: ə bɪɡ kraʊd ˈɡæðərd tu seɪ ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ

dialogue.en: The Tang monk climbed onto a horse and rode toward the west
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk klaɪmd ˈɑntu ə hɔrs ænd roʊd təˈwɔrd ðə wɛst

dialogue.en: He had traveled for over a month when he came to a big mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi hæd ˈtrævəld fɔr ˈoʊvər ə mʌnθ wɛn hi keɪm tu ə bɪɡ ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 他走了一个多月,来到一座大山前。

dialogue.en: Slowly his horse walked up a steep trail
dialogue.ipa: ˈsloʊli hɪz hɔrs wɔkt ʌp ə stip treɪl
dialogue.zh: 他的马缓缓走上一条陡峭的小径。

dialogue.en: I hope there aren't any demons here
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp ðɛr ˈɑrənt ˈɛni ˈdimənz hir

dialogue.zh: 突然,一个声音轰然响起。

dialogue.en: Who is walking on my mountain
dialogue.ipa: hu ɪz ˈwɔkɪŋ ɑn maɪ ˈmaʊntən

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: One day Buddha sat in the Thunderclap monastery in the western Paradise
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: He was talking to his students
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: He had traveled for over a month when he came to a big mountain
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: They are greedy and constantly fighting
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Who is walking on my mountain
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: They will teach the people in the east to act better
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: You will be called the Tang Monk
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Someone must travel to the thunderclap monastery to get them
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: People who learn the lessons never have to suffer again
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: Fierce creatures and evil demons will try to attack you
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's bring the scriptures to the Tang Empire
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Put this on
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: The next morning there was a huge feast
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who is walking on my mountain
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: He had traveled for over a month when he came to a big mountain
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 14 a promise to protect

dialogue.en: The tang monk trembled with fear
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈtrɛmbəld wɪð fɪr

dialogue.zh: 那个愤怒的声音再次响起。

dialogue.en: Who is walking on my mountain
dialogue.ipa: hu ɪz ˈwɔkɪŋ ɑn maɪ ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: He fell off his horse and tumbled down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi fɛl ɔf hɪz hɔrs ænd ˈtʌmbəld daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 他从马上摔下来,滚下山去。

dialogue.en: At the bottom he saw a crack between the rocks
dialogue.ipa: æt ðə ˈbɑtəm hi sɔ ə kræk bɪˈtwin ðə rɑks
dialogue.zh: 在山脚下,他看到岩石间有一道裂缝。

dialogue.en: And saw a moss covered monkey peering out at him
dialogue.ipa: ænd sɔ ə mɔs ˈkʌvərd ˈmʌŋki ˈpirɪŋ aʊt æt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 只见一只浑身长满青苔的猴子正盯着他。

dialogue.en: I am king of the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm kɪŋ ʌv ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.zh: 是佛祖把我关在这儿的。

dialogue.en: I am being punished for causing trouble in heaven
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ˈbiɪŋ ˈpʌnɪʃt fɔr ˈkɑzɪŋ ˈtrʌbəl ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 我因为大闹天宫而受罚。

dialogue.en: I'm going to the western paradise to get scriptures from Buddha
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs tu ɡɛt ˈskrɪpʧərz frʌm ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 我要去西天极乐世界向佛祖求取真经。

dialogue.en: I'm supposed to go with you
dialogue.ipa: aɪm səˈpoʊzd tu ɡoʊ wɪð ju

dialogue.en: The Tang monk took a step back
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tʊk ə stɛp bæk

dialogue.en: Was this strange monkey telling the truth
dialogue.ipa: wʌz ðɪs streɪnʤ ˈmʌŋki ˈtɛlɪŋ ðə truθ
dialogue.zh: 这只奇怪的猴子说的是真的吗?

dialogue.en: She said I'd be set free if I promised to protect you on the journey
dialogue.ipa: ʃi sɛd aɪd bi sɛt fri ɪf aɪ ˈprɑməst tu prəˈtɛkt ju ɑn ðə ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 她说,如果我答应在旅途中保护你,就能重获自由。

dialogue.en: Set me free and I'll go with you to the west
dialogue.ipa: sɛt mi fri ænd aɪl ɡoʊ wɪð ju tu ðə wɛst
dialogue.zh: 放我出来,我就跟你一起去西天。

dialogue.en: There's a small piece of paper on top of this mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz ə smɔl pis ʌv ˈpeɪpər ɑn tɑp ʌv ðɪs ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 这山顶上有一张小纸条。

dialogue.en: The Tang monk went back up the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɛnt bæk ʌp ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: He pushed aside shrubs and brambles and pulled himself over large boulders
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊʃt əˈsaɪd ʃrʌbz ænd ˈbræmbəlz ænd pʊld hɪmˈsɛlf ˈoʊvər lɑrʤ ˈboʊldərz
dialogue.zh: 他拨开灌木和荆棘,攀过大岩石。

dialogue.en: Finally he reached the mountain's peak
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪnəli hi riʧt ðə ˈmaʊntənz pik

dialogue.en: The monk picked up the paper
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk pɪkt ʌp ðə ˈpeɪpər

dialogue.en: Right away a breeze swept it from his hand
dialogue.ipa: raɪt əˈweɪ ə briz swɛpt ɪt frʌm hɪz hænd
dialogue.zh: 一阵微风立刻将它从他手中吹走

dialogue.en: The paper floated up and then disappeared among the clouds
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈpeɪpər ˈfloʊtɪd ʌp ænd ðɛn ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd əˈmʌŋ ðə klaʊdz
dialogue.zh: 纸片飘起,随后消失在云层之中

dialogue.en: The monk hurried back down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ˈhɜrid bæk daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: The Tang monk took a step back
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tʊk ə stɛp bæk

dialogue.en: The monk took another step back
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk tʊk əˈnʌðər stɛp bæk

dialogue.en: The Tang monk went far from the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɛnt fɑr frʌm ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: He gasped as the entire mountain rose into the air
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡæspt æz ði ɪnˈtaɪər ˈmaʊntən roʊz ˈɪntu ði ɛr
dialogue.zh: 他倒吸一口气,整座山升到了空中

dialogue.en: Holding it up with his hands
dialogue.ipa: ˈhoʊldɪŋ ɪt ʌp wɪð hɪz hændz

dialogue.en: He jumped out and the mountain crashed down behind him
dialogue.ipa: hi ʤʌmpt aʊt ænd ðə ˈmaʊntən kræʃt daʊn bɪˈhaɪnd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 他跳了出来,山在他身后轰然落下

dialogue.en: Wukong grabbed the Tang monk's hands
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ɡræbd ðə tæŋ mʌŋks hændz

dialogue.en: I will help you reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl hɛlp ju riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我会帮助您到达西方极乐世界

dialogue.en: The Tang monk rode the horse as Wukong walked
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk roʊd ðə hɔrs æz Wukong wɔkt

dialogue.en: The monkey told the monk about himself
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki toʊld ðə mʌŋk əˈbaʊt hɪmˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 猴子向和尚讲述了自己的经历

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor's entire army couldn't defeat me
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərərz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi ˈkʊdənt dɪˈfit mi
dialogue.zh: 玉皇大帝的整个军队都打不过我

dialogue.en: So I said I should be in charge of heaven
dialogue.ipa: soʊ aɪ sɛd aɪ ʃʊd bi ɪn ʧɑrʤ ʌv ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 所以我说我应该掌管天庭

dialogue.en: He quickly changed into a tiger
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkwɪkli ʧeɪnʤd ˈɪntu ə ˈtaɪɡər
dialogue.zh: 他迅速变成了一只老虎

dialogue.en: Wukong changed into a snake a vulture
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʧeɪnʤd ˈɪntu ə sneɪk ə ˈvʌlʧər
dialogue.zh: 悟空变成了一条蛇、一只秃鹫

dialogue.en: The monkey's body grew so big that his head reached the clouds
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ˈbɑdi ɡru soʊ bɪɡ ðæt hɪz hɛd riʧt ðə klaʊdz hɪz hɛd riʧt ðə klaʊdz
dialogue.zh: 猴子的身体变得巨大无比,头都碰到云了。

dialogue.en: He shrank to the size of a bee
dialogue.ipa: hi ʃræŋk tu ðə saɪz ʌv ə bi

dialogue.en: And hopped onto the monk's head
dialogue.ipa: ænd hɑpt ˈɑntu ðə mʌŋks hɛd

dialogue.en: He changed back to his normal size
dialogue.ipa: hi ʧeɪnʤd bæk tu hɪz ˈnɔrməl saɪz

dialogue.en: His iron bar appeared from his ear
dialogue.ipa: hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr əˈpɪrd frʌm hɪz ir
dialogue.zh: 他的铁棒从耳朵里出现了

dialogue.en: The monkey spun it around and then struck a huge boulder
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki spʌn ɪt əˈraʊnd ænd ðɛn strʌk ə hjuʤ ˈboʊldər
dialogue.zh: 猴子将它旋转了几圈,然后猛击一块巨大的岩石

dialogue.en: The boulder exploded into tiny pieces
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈboʊldər ɪkˈsploʊdɪd ˈɪntu ˈtaɪni ˈpisəz

dialogue.en: The Tang monk watched in horror
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɑʧt ɪn ˈhɔrər
dialogue.zh: 唐僧惊恐地看着这一幕

dialogue.en: Wukong laughed. Don't look so scared master
dialogue.ipa: Wukong læft doʊnt lʊk soʊ skɛrd ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 悟空笑道:别这么害怕,师父。

dialogue.en: The two traveled farther until they saw a group of men blocking the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ˈtrævəld ˈfɑrðər ənˈtɪl ðeɪ sɔ ə ɡrup ʌv mɛn ˈblɑkɪŋ ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 两人继续前行,直到看见一群人挡住了去路

dialogue.en: The men looked rough and mean
dialogue.ipa: ðə mɛn lʊkt rʌf ænd min
dialogue.zh: 这些人看起来粗野凶狠

dialogue.en: One man stepped forward and waved a sword
dialogue.ipa: wʌn mæn stɛpt ˈfɔrwərd ænd weɪvd ə sɔrd

dialogue.en: Give us your money or you'll be sorry
dialogue.ipa: ɡɪv ʌs jʊər ˈmʌni ɔr jul bi ˈsɑri
dialogue.zh: 把钱交出来,否则有你们好看

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Cried the Tang monk
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.

The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I am king of the Fruit and Flower Mountain
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Who is walking on my mountain
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Set me free and I'll go with you to the west
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: How can I free you
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: The Jade Emperor's entire army couldn't defeat me
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You must remove it
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: So I said I should be in charge of heaven
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Go farther
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's a small piece of paper on top of this mountain
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who is walking on my mountain
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: She said I'd be set free if I promised to protect you on the journey
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.

If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So I said I should be in charge of heaven
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.

The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 15 Tea with a Dragon

dialogue.en: The Tang monk looked at the robbers
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk lʊkt æt ðə ˈrɑbərz

dialogue.en: Then give us whatever else you have
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ɡɪv ʌs ˌwʌˈtɛvər ɛls ju hæv
dialogue.zh: 那就把其他值钱的东西交出来

dialogue.en: I'll deal with these robbers master
dialogue.ipa: aɪl dil wɪð ðiz ˈrɑbərz ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 师父,这些强盗交给我来处理

dialogue.en: And I am rather small it's true
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ æm ˈræðər smɔl ɪts tru

dialogue.en: He removed the iron bar from his ear
dialogue.ipa: hi riˈmuvd ði ˈaɪərn bɑr frʌm hɪz ir

dialogue.en: But you should be scared of me anyway
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju ʃʊd bi skɛrd ʌv mi ˈɛniˌweɪ

dialogue.en: And his eyes flashed red with anger
dialogue.ipa: ænd hɪz aɪz flæʃt rɛd wɪð ˈæŋɡər
dialogue.zh: 眼中因愤怒而闪过红光

dialogue.en: The robbers tripped over one another
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈrɑbərz trɪpt ˈoʊvər wʌn əˈnʌðər

dialogue.en: Wukong raised the iron bar ready to strike
dialogue.ipa: Wukong reɪzd ði ˈaɪərn bɑr ˈrɛdi tu straɪk
dialogue.zh: 悟空举起铁棒准备攻击

dialogue.en: Wukong turned around as the men ran away
dialogue.ipa: Wukong tɜrnd ə ˈraʊnd æz ðə mɛn ræn əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 悟空转身时那些人已经跑远了

dialogue.en: They were going to hurt us
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɜr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu hɜrt ʌs

dialogue.en: A Buddhist monk never hurts people
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈbudəst mʌŋk ˈnɛvər hɜrts ˈpipəl

dialogue.en: I would rather get hurt than hurt someone else
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʊd ˈræðər ɡɛt hɜrt ðæn hɜrt ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɛls
dialogue.zh: 我宁愿自己受伤,也不愿伤害他人

dialogue.en: We should have beaten them up
dialogue.ipa: wi ʃʊd hæv ˈbitən ðɛm ʌp

dialogue.en: The Tang monk shook his head
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ʃʊk hɪz hɛd

dialogue.en: You are cruel and violent Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ju ɑr ˈkruəl ænd ˈvaɪələnt Wukong

dialogue.en: I don't have to accept this treatment
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt hæv tu ækˈsɛpt ðɪs ˈtritmənt

dialogue.en: Wukong leaped into the air and was gone
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd wʌz ɡɔn
dialogue.zh: 悟空纵身一跃,消失在空中

dialogue.en: The Tang monk sighed and then continued his journey
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk saɪd ænd ðɛn kənˈtɪnjud hɪz ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 唐僧叹了口气,继续赶路

dialogue.en: Later that day he saw an old woman
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪtər ðæt deɪ hi sɔ ən oʊld ˈwʊmən
dialogue.zh: 那天晚些时候,他看见一位老妇人

dialogue.en: I'm going to the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrə ˌdaɪs

dialogue.en: Don't you have anyone with you
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt ju hæv ˈɛniˌwʌn wɪð ju

dialogue.en: But he got angry when I scolded him for being violent
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hi ɡɑt ˈæŋɡri wɛn aɪ ˈskoʊldɪd hɪm fɔr ˈbiɪŋ ˈvaɪələnt
dialogue.zh: 但我因他暴戾而责骂他时,他生气了

dialogue.en: Trick him into putting this on
dialogue.ipa: trɪk hɪm ˈɪntu ˈpʌtɪŋ ðɪs ɑn

dialogue.en: She pulled a metal headband out of her bag
dialogue.ipa: ʃi pʊld ə ˈmɛtəl ˈhɛd ˌbænd aʊt ʌv hɜr bæɡ
dialogue.zh: 她从包里掏出一个金属头箍

dialogue.en: The old woman whispered a magical spell to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ði oʊld ˈwʊmən ˈwɪspərd ə ˈmæʤɪkəl spɛl tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 老妇人向唐僧低声传授了一道咒语

dialogue.en: There was a flash of bright light
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə flæʃ ʌv braɪt laɪt

dialogue.en: And the woman rose into the air
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈwʊmən roʊz ˈɪntu ði ɛr

dialogue.en: The boat is out for Guanyin
dialogue.ipa: ðə boʊt ɪz aʊt fɔr Guanyin

dialogue.en: He got down from his horse and vowed
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡɑt daʊn frʌm hɪz hɔrs ænd vaʊd

dialogue.en: Meanwhile Wukong sat in the palace of the Dragon King of the Eastern Sea
dialogue.ipa: ˈminˌwaɪl wu kæŋ sæt ɪn ðə ˈpæləs ʌv ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ʌv ði ˈistərn si
dialogue.zh: 与此同时,悟空正坐在东海龙王的宫殿里

dialogue.en: He and the Dragon King were drinking tea
dialogue.ipa: hi ænd ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ wɜr ˈdrɪŋkɪŋ ti

dialogue.en: I hope you've learned from your punishment
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp juv lɜrnd frʌm jʊər ˈpʌnɪʃmənt
dialogue.zh: 我希望你已从惩罚中吸取了教训

dialogue.en: I won't cause any more trouble for the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: aɪ woʊnt kɑz ˈɛni mɔr ˈtrʌbəl fɔr ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 我不会再给玉帝惹麻烦了

dialogue.en: The Dragon King sipped his tea
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ sɪpt hɪz ti

dialogue.en: I was traveling west with a monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ˈtrævəlɪŋ wɛst wɪð ə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我原本和一位僧人一同西行

dialogue.en: I promised Guan Yin I would do it
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈprɑməst Guan jɪn aɪ wʊd du ɪt
dialogue.zh: 我向观音菩萨承诺过会完成此事

dialogue.en: The Dragon King put down his teacup
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ pʊt daʊn hɪz ˈtiˌkʌp

dialogue.en: That monk had a bad attitude
dialogue.ipa: ðæt mʌŋk hæd ə bæd ˈætəˌtud

dialogue.en: He said I was cruel and violent
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd aɪ wʌz ˈkruəl ænd ˈvaɪələnt

dialogue.zh: 龙王紧张地咳嗽了一声

dialogue.en: The king hesitated and then said
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ ˈhɛzɪˌteɪtɪd ænd ðɛn sɛd
dialogue.zh: 龙王犹豫了一下,然后说道
你有时候确实挺暴力的

dialogue.en: Wukong folded his arms and looked at the ground
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˈfoʊldɪd hɪz ɑrmz ænd lʊkt æt ðə ɡraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 悟空抱起双臂,低头看着地面

dialogue.en: But you made a promise to Guanyin
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju meɪd ə ˈprɑməs tu Guanyin
dialogue.zh: 你还向观音菩萨许下了承诺

dialogue.en: It is you who has a bad attitude
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ɪz ju hu hæz ə bæd ˈætəˌtud

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The Tang monk looked at the robbers
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: He was shaking
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Then give us whatever else you have
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll deal with these robbers master
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: But you should be scared of me anyway
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You can't go there alone
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: But you should be scared of me anyway
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: I don't have to accept this treatment
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: They were going to hurt us
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Look at the little monkey
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There was a flash of bright light
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: It is you who has a bad attitude
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: But he got angry when I scolded him for being violent
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 16 Wukong gets tricked

dialogue.en: Wukong looked at the dragon king and sighed
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lʊkt æt ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ænd saɪd
dialogue.zh: 悟空看着龙王,叹了口气

dialogue.en: I did make a promise to Guanyin
dialogue.ipa: aɪ dɪd meɪk ə ˈprɑməs tu Guanyin
dialogue.zh: 我确实向观音菩萨许下了承诺

dialogue.en: He put down his tea cup and stood up
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊt daʊn hɪz ti kʌp ænd stʊd ʌp

dialogue.en: The monkey hurried out of the Dragon King's palace
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈhɜrid aʊt ʌv ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋz ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: He found the Tang monk traveling alongside a stream
dialogue.ipa: hi faʊnd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈtrævəlɪŋ əˈlɔŋˈsaɪd ə strim
dialogue.zh: 他发现唐僧正沿着溪流行走

dialogue.en: I'll find a village and beg for some food for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪl faɪnd ə ˈvɪləʤ ænd bɛɡ fɔr sʌm fud fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 我去找个村子,给你讨些吃的

dialogue.en: You don't need to do that
dialogue.ipa: ju doʊnt nid tu du ðæt

dialogue.en: The monk got down from the horse
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ɡɑt daʊn frʌm ðə hɔrs

dialogue.en: He looked at his reflection in the stream
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt hɪz rəˈflɛkʃən ɪn ðə strim

dialogue.en: The monkey grabbed the sides of his head and fell over
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ɡræbd ðə saɪdz ʌv hɪz hɛd ænd fɛl ˈoʊvər
dialogue.zh: 猴子抓住脑袋两侧,倒了下去

dialogue.en: He saw the Tang monk talking quietly
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈtɔkɪŋ ˈkwaɪətli
dialogue.zh: 他看到唐僧在低声念着什么

dialogue.en: The Tang monk stopped talking and the pain stopped
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stɑpt ˈtɔkɪŋ ænd ðə peɪn stɑpt
dialogue.zh: 唐僧停止了念诵,疼痛也随之停止

dialogue.en: The Bodhisattva Guanyin taught me a spell
dialogue.ipa: ðə Bodhisattva Guanyin tɔt mi ə spɛl
dialogue.zh: 观音菩萨教了我一个咒语

dialogue.en: She gave me the headband to force you to be good
dialogue.ipa: ʃi ɡeɪv mi ðə ˈhɛdˌbænd tu fɔrs ju tu bi ɡʊd
dialogue.zh: 她给了我金箍,是为了让你学好

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar and lunged at the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd lʌnʤd æt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 悟空抽出铁棒,朝唐僧扑去

dialogue.en: The monk recited the tight headband spell again
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk rə ˈsaɪtəd ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: Wukong fell to the ground and rolled around in pain
dialogue.ipa: Wukong fɛl tu ðə ɡraʊnd ænd roʊld əˈraʊnd ɪn peɪn
dialogue.zh: 悟空倒在地上,痛苦地翻滚

dialogue.en: I won't try to hurt you again
dialogue.ipa: aɪ woʊnt traɪ tu hɜrt ju əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: Now will you cook some rice
dialogue.ipa: naʊ wɪl ju kʊk sʌm raɪs

dialogue.en: The monkey waited until the Tang monk had turned his back
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈweɪtɪd ənˈtɪl ðə tæŋ mʌŋk hæd tɜrnd hɪz bæk
dialogue.zh: 猴子等到唐僧转过身去

dialogue.en: Again he raised the iron bar
dialogue.ipa: əˈɡɛn hi reɪzd ði ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: But the Tang monk saw Wukong's shadow
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk sɔ Wukong's ˈʃæˌdoʊ
dialogue.zh: 但唐僧看到了悟空的影子

dialogue.en: Once again falling to the ground
dialogue.ipa: wʌns əˈɡɛn ˈfɑlɪŋ tu ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: The Tang monk looked furious as he recited the spell
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk lʊkt ˈfjʊriəs æz hi rəˈsaɪtəd ðə spɛl
dialogue.zh: 唐僧念咒时显得怒不可遏

dialogue.en: The Tang monk stopped reciting the spell
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stɑpt ri ˈsaɪtɪŋ ðə spɛl

dialogue.en: Don't try to hit me again
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt traɪ tu hɪt mi əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: If you do I'll recite the spell until your head really does explode
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju du aɪl rəˈsaɪt ðə spɛl ənˈtɪl jʊər hɛd ˈrɪli dʌz ɪkˈsploʊd
dialogue.zh: 如果你再犯,我就一直念咒,直到你的头真的炸开。

dialogue.en: The two traveled for a few more weeks
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ˈtrævəld fɔr ə fju mɔr wiks

dialogue.en: They arrived at a wide river
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ əˈraɪvd æt ə waɪd ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 他们来到了一条宽阔的河流前

dialogue.en: How will we cross this river
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl wi krɔs ðɪs ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: It's too bad you're not a spirit
dialogue.ipa: ɪts tu bæd jʊr nɑt ə ˈspɪrət

dialogue.en: I can leap over this river
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn lip ˈoʊvər ðɪs ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: But I can't take you with me
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ kænt teɪk ju wɪð mi
dialogue.zh: 但我没法带你一起过去

dialogue.en: So you must make the journey all by yourself
dialogue.ipa: soʊ ju mʌst meɪk ðə ˈʤɜrni ɔl baɪ jərˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 所以你必须靠自己完成这段旅程

dialogue.en: The water swelled and a dragon leaped from it
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔtər swɛld ænd ə ˈdræɡən lɛpt frʌm ɪt
dialogue.zh: 河水翻涌,一条龙从中跃出

dialogue.en: He yanked the Tang monk off the horse as the dragon struck
dialogue.ipa: hi jæŋkt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɔf ðə hɔrs æz ðə ˈdræɡən strʌk
dialogue.zh: 就在龙扑过来时,他一把将唐僧拽下马

dialogue.en: With one bite the dragon swallowed the horse
dialogue.ipa: wɪð wʌn baɪt ðə ˈdræɡən ˈswɑloʊd ðə hɔrs
ænd ðɛn slɪpt bæk ˈʌndər ˌwɔtər

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong looked at the dragon king and sighed
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: The monkey waited until the Tang monk had turned his back
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Master I have returned
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.

We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.

The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: Master I have returned
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I will visit again soon
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You can cook that
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Before Wukang could answer
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You must stop being violent
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: I won't try to hurt you again
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Look out
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's rice in the bag
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you do I'll recite the spell until your head really does explode
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When he looked inside
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So you must make the journey all by yourself
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.

It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.
