titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 17 the Dragon in the river

dialogue.en: How will I ever get to the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl aɪ ˈɛvər ɡɛt tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我如何才能到达西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: There are so many dangers along the way
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ɑr soʊ ˈmɛni ˈdeɪnʤərz əˈlɔŋ ðə weɪ

dialogue.en: There will be many dangers on your journey
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wɪl bi ˈmɛni ˈdeɪnʤərz ɑn jʊər ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 您的旅程中确实会有许多危险

dialogue.en: The Monkey King to protect you
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki kɪŋ tu prəˈtɛkt ju

dialogue.en: All of Heaven's soldiers couldn't defeat me
dialogue.ipa: ɔl ʌv ˈhɛvənz ˈsoʊlʤərz ˈkʊdənt dɪˈfit mi
dialogue.zh: 天兵天将都奈何不了我

dialogue.en: So why worry about a dragon
dialogue.ipa: soʊ waɪ ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt ə ˈdræɡən

dialogue.en: The monkey stepped into the water and pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki stɛpt ˈɪntu ðə ˈwɔtər ænd pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr
dialogue.zh: 猴子踏入水中,抽出他的铁棒

dialogue.en: I'll get the dragon to come out of the water
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡɛt ðə ˈdræɡən tu kʌm aʊt ʌv ðə ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 我要让那条龙从水里出来

dialogue.en: He looked down at the water
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt daʊn æt ðə ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: Dragon get up here right now
dialogue.ipa: ˈdræɡən ɡɛt ʌp hir raɪt naʊ

dialogue.en: The dragon leaped from the water
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən lɛpt frʌm ðə ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: How dare you yell at me
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju jɛl æt mi

dialogue.en: It doesn't matter who I am
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ˈdʌzənt ˈmætər hu aɪ æm

dialogue.en: The monkey attacked the dragon with his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ə ˈtækt ðə ˈdræɡən wɪð hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: The dragon spun around blocking the bar with his tail
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən spʌn əˈraʊnd ˈblɑkɪŋ ðə bɑr wɪð hɪz teɪl
dialogue.zh: 龙转身用尾巴挡住了铁棒

dialogue.en: Wukong stomped his foot and yelled at the river
dialogue.ipa: Wukong stɑmpt hɪz fʊt ænd jɛld æt ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 悟空跺着脚,对着河大喊

dialogue.en: And we can't cross the river with that dragon in there
dialogue.ipa: ænd wi kænt krɔs ðə ˈrɪvər wɪð ðæt ˈdræɡən ɪn ðɛr
dialogue.zh: 而且河里有那条龙,我们也无法过河

dialogue.en: The monkey swirled the water with his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki swɜrld ðə ˈwɔtər wɪð hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: The water dragged up dirt from the River Bottom
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔtər dræɡd ʌp dɜrt frʌm ðə ˈrɪvər ˈbɑtəm
dialogue.zh: 河水卷起了河底的泥沙

dialogue.en: Soon the river was brown and muddy
dialogue.ipa: sun ðə ˈrɪvər wʌz braʊn ænd ˈmʌdi
dialogue.zh: 很快河水变得浑浊泥泞

dialogue.en: What on earth are you doing now
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɑn ɜrθ ɑr ju ˈduɪŋ naʊ

dialogue.en: I'm trying to take a nap
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈtraɪɪŋ tu teɪk ə næp

dialogue.en: The monkey attacked the dragon again
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki əˈtækt ðə ˈdræɡən əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: But once more the dragon disappeared under the water
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wʌns mɔr ðə ˈdræɡən ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd ˈʌndər ðə ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 但龙又一次消失在水下

dialogue.en: He yelled all kinds of insults
dialogue.ipa: hi jɛld ɔl kaɪndz ʌv ɪnˈsʌlts

dialogue.en: But the dragon would not come back up
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈdræɡən wʊd nɑt kʌm bæk ʌp

dialogue.en: Wukong climbed up the river bank
dialogue.ipa: Wukong klaɪmd ʌp ðə ˈrɪvər bæŋk

dialogue.en: And sat down next to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ænd sæt daʊn nɛkst tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: But I can't beat him either
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ kænt bit hɪm ˈiðər

dialogue.en: Guanyin told me I can ask her for help if I need it
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin toʊld mi aɪ kæn æsk hɜr fɔr hɛlp ɪf aɪ nid ɪt
dialogue.zh: 观音告诉我,如果需要可以找她帮忙

dialogue.en: She told me the same thing
dialogue.ipa: ʃi toʊld mi ðə seɪm θɪŋ

dialogue.en: Wukong felt the headband and shot a look at the monk
dialogue.ipa: Wukong fɛlt ðə ˈhɛdˌbænd ænd ʃɑt ə lʊk æt ðə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 悟空摸了摸头箍,瞥了和尚一眼

dialogue.en: She gave you this tight headband
dialogue.ipa: ʃi ɡeɪv ju ðɪs taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd

dialogue.en: Wukong shot into the air and flew south
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʃɑt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd flu saʊθ
dialogue.zh: 悟空腾空而起,向南飞去

dialogue.en: Soon he came to Mount Putalaka in the South Sea
dialogue.ipa: sun hi keɪm tu maʊnt Putalaka ɪn ðə saʊθ si
dialogue.zh: 很快他来到了南海的普陀洛迦山

dialogue.en: Guanyin was in a garden next to her pagoda
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin wʌz ɪn ə ˈɡɑrdən nɛkst tu hɜr pəˈɡoʊdə
dialogue.zh: 观音在她的宝塔旁的花园里

dialogue.en: I see you are wearing the headband
dialogue.ipa: aɪ si ju ɑr ˈwɛrɪŋ ðə ˈhɛd ˌbænd

dialogue.en: Yes thanks to your dirty tricks
dialogue.ipa: jɛs θæŋks tu jʊər ˈdɜrti trɪks

dialogue.en: You are too violent and cruel
dialogue.ipa: ju ɑr tu ˈvaɪələnt ænd ˈkruəl

dialogue.en: I'm here because I have a problem
dialogue.ipa: aɪm hir bɪˈkɔz aɪ hæv ə ˈprɑbləm
dialogue.zh: 我来是因为遇到了麻烦

dialogue.en: We reached a wide river with a dragon in it
dialogue.ipa: wi riʧt ə waɪd ˈrɪvər wɪð ə ˈdræɡən ɪn ɪt
dialogue.zh: 我们遇到一条宽阔的河,里面有条龙

dialogue.en: Did you tell the dragon that you're traveling with the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju tɛl ðə ˈdræɡən ðæt jʊr ˈtrævəlɪŋ wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 你告诉那条龙你是和唐僧一起旅行的吗

dialogue.en: That dragon was waiting for you
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈdræɡən wʌz ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr ju

dialogue.en: He was being punished for setting fire to his father's palace
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈbiɪŋ ˈpʌnɪʃt fɔr ˈsɛtɪŋ ˈfaɪər tu hɪz ˈfɑðərz ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 他因纵火烧毁父亲的宫殿而受罚

dialogue.en: I told him to help the Tang monk reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪ toʊld hɪm tu hɛlp ðə tæŋ mʌŋk riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我让他帮助唐僧前往西天

dialogue.en: That way he can earn forgiveness
dialogue.ipa: ðæt weɪ hi kæn ɜrn fərˈɡɪvnəs

dialogue.en: It's too late for that now
dialogue.ipa: ɪts tu leɪt fɔr ðæt naʊ

dialogue.en: He won't come out of the water
dialogue.ipa: hi woʊnt kʌm aʊt ʌv ðə ˈwɔtər

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句

grammar.source: Who can help you
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: Guanyin told me I can ask her for help if I need it
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.

examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因

grammar.source: I'm here because I have a problem
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果

The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 比较级 + than / 比较级 and 比较级
grammar.description: 比较两者差异，或表达程度不断变化。
grammar.source: For more than three hours
examples: Wukong is stronger than the demon.
This road is shorter than the other one.
The river is wider than before.
Bajie is hungrier than Wujing.
The mountain is higher than the hill.
The cave became darker and darker.
They walked faster and faster.
The sound grew louder and louder.
This plan is better than the first one.
The journey became more and more difficult.

collocations.context: The monkey stepped into the water and pulled out his iron bar
I'll get the dragon to come out of the water
He looked down at the water
Dragon get up here right now
What on earth are you doing now
I'm trying to take a nap
But the dragon would not come back up
Wukong climbed up the river bank
And sat down next to the Tang monk
Who can help you
Wukong thought for a moment
Wukong felt the headband and shot a look at the monk
Yes thanks to your dirty tricks
That dragon was waiting for you
I told him to help the Tang monk reach the western paradise

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 18 the robe

dialogue.en: Wukong and Guanyin flew over the ocean
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd Guanyin flu ˈoʊvər ði ˈoʊʃən

dialogue.en: And back to the wide river
dialogue.ipa: ænd bæk tu ðə waɪd ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: Dragon come out of the river at once
dialogue.ipa: ˈdræɡən kʌm aʊt ʌv ðə ˈrɪvər æt wʌns

dialogue.en: The dragon rose from the river and bowed
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən roʊz frʌm ðə ˈrɪvər ænd baʊd

dialogue.en: I didn't realize the monk had arrived
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈriəˌlaɪz ðə mʌŋk hæd əˈraɪvd
dialogue.zh: 我没意识到和尚已经到了

dialogue.en: The dragon stopped talking when he saw Wukong next to Guanyin
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən stɑpt ˈtɔkɪŋ wɛn hi sɔ Wukong nɛkst tu Guanyin
dialogue.zh: 龙看到悟空在观音身边便住了口

dialogue.en: He is traveling with the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: hi ɪz ˈtrævəlɪŋ wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: The monkey didn't tell me that
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈdɪdənt tɛl mi ðæt

dialogue.en: I even asked him who he was
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈivɪn æskt hɪm hu hi wʌz

dialogue.en: From now on you must tell people who you are
dialogue.ipa: frʌm naʊ ɑn ju mʌst tɛl ˈpipəl hu ju ɑr
dialogue.zh: 从今往后你必须告诉别人你是谁

dialogue.en: There are others waiting for you too
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ɑr ˈʌðərz ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr ju tu

dialogue.en: Guanyin looked back at the dragon
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin lʊkt bæk æt ðə ˈdræɡən

dialogue.en: You will carry the Tang monk to the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl ˈkæri ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 你将驮载唐僧前往西天

dialogue.en: A horse stood where the dragon had been
dialogue.ipa: ə hɔrs stʊd wɛr ðə ˈdræɡən hæd bɪn
dialogue.zh: 龙原先所在之处站着一匹马

dialogue.en: It looked exactly like the Tang monk's horse
dialogue.ipa: ɪt lʊkt ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk ðə tæŋ mʌŋks hɔrs
dialogue.zh: 它看起来和唐僧的马一模一样

dialogue.en: Wukong left the horse to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lɛd ðə hɔrs tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 悟空牵着马来到唐僧面前

dialogue.en: She turned the dragon into a horse
dialogue.ipa: ʃi tɜrnd ðə ˈdræɡən ˈɪntu ə hɔrs
dialogue.zh: 她把那条龙变成了一匹马

dialogue.en: He's supposed to come with us
dialogue.ipa: hiz səˈpoʊzd tu kʌm wɪð ʌs
dialogue.zh: 他本该和我们一起走的

dialogue.en: The Tang monk fell to his knees and bowed
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk fɛl tu hɪz niz ænd baʊd

dialogue.en: The bodhisattva is back on Mount Potalaka by now
dialogue.ipa: ðə boʊt ʌv azafa ɪz bæk ɑn maʊnt Potalaka baɪ naʊ
dialogue.zh: 菩萨此刻已回到普陀山

dialogue.en: A boat had arrived next to the shore
dialogue.ipa: ə boʊt hæd əˈraɪvd nɛkst tu ðə ʃɔr

dialogue.en: I will take you across the river
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl teɪk ju əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: The Tang monks stepped onto the boat
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋks stɛpt ˈɑntu ðə boʊt

dialogue.en: And Wukong followed with the horse
dialogue.ipa: ænd wu kɔŋ ˈfɑloʊd wɪð ðə hɔrs

dialogue.en: The boatman didn't speak as he rowed them across the river
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈboʊtmən ˈdɪdənt spik æz hi roʊd ðɛm əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 船夫划船渡河时一言不发

dialogue.en: On the other side of the river
dialogue.ipa: ɑn ði ˈʌðər saɪd ʌv ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: The monkey led the horse onto the shore
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lɛd ðə hɔrs ˈɑntu ðə ʃɔr

dialogue.en: The Tang monk stepped out of the boat
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stɛpt aʊt ʌv ðə boʊt

dialogue.en: When he turned to thank the boatman
dialogue.ipa: wɛn hi tɜrnd tu θæŋk ðə ˈboʊtmən
dialogue.zh: 当他转身想向船夫道谢时

dialogue.en: Wukong laughed when he saw how confused the monk looked
dialogue.ipa: Wukong læft wɛn hi sɔ haʊ kənˈfjuzd ðə mʌŋk lʊkt
dialogue.zh: 悟空见和尚一脸困惑,不禁笑了起来

dialogue.en: The monk and the monkey continued their journey over hills and across plains
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ænd ðə ˈmʌŋki kənˈtɪnjud ðɛr ˈʤɜrni ˈoʊvər hɪlz ænd əˈkrɔs pleɪnz
dialogue.zh: 僧人与猴子继续翻山越岭的旅程

dialogue.en: How long will it take to reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ɪt teɪk tu riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs

dialogue.en: The Tang monk asked one afternoon
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk æskt wʌn ˌæftərˈnun

dialogue.zh: 我们的旅程才刚刚开始

dialogue.en: They walked some more until they reached a Buddhist monastery
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɔkt sʌm mɔr ənˈtɪl ðeɪ riʧt ə ˈbudəst ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 他们又走了一段路,来到一座佛寺前

dialogue.en: Let's stop here for the night
dialogue.ipa: lɛts stɑp hir fɔr ðə naɪt

dialogue.en: The priests inside will gladly give us some food and a place to sleep
dialogue.ipa: ðə prists ɪnˈsaɪd wɪl ˈɡlædli ɡɪv ʌs sʌm fud ænd ə pleɪs tu slip
dialogue.zh: 寺里的师父会乐意给我们些食物和住处

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and Wukong ate a meal with the priests
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd Wukong eɪt ə mil wɪð ðə prists
dialogue.zh: 唐僧和悟空与僧众共进斋饭

dialogue.en: When the head priest heard where the Tang monk was going
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðə hɛd prist hɜrd wɛr ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 当住持听说唐僧要去往何方时

dialogue.en: You are going to get the true scriptures
dialogue.ipa: ju ɑr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ɡɛt ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz

dialogue.en: How did the Bodhisattva choose you
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɪd ðə Bodhisattva ʧuz ju

dialogue.en: She said that only a true believer could make the journey
dialogue.ipa: ʃi sɛd ðæt ˈoʊnli ə tru bəˈlivər kʊd meɪk ðə ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 她说唯有真信徒方能完成此程

dialogue.en: And she saw that I was a true believer
dialogue.ipa: ænd ʃi sɔ ðæt aɪ wʌz ə tru bəˈlivər

dialogue.en: Do you have the robe with you
dialogue.ipa: du ju hæv ðə roʊb wɪð ju
dialogue.zh: 那件袈裟您带在身边吗

dialogue.en: He reached into his bag and pulled out the robe
dialogue.ipa: hi riʧt ˈɪntu hɪz bæɡ ænd pʊld aʊt ðə roʊb
dialogue.zh: 他伸手入袋,取出那件袈裟
和尚眼中顿时放出光彩
可否容我捧在手中一观

dialogue.en: The Tang monk handed the robe to the priest
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈhændɪd ðə roʊb tu ðə prist

dialogue.en: The priest admired it for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist ədˈmaɪərd ɪt fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt

dialogue.en: May I borrow it just for tonight
dialogue.ipa: meɪ aɪ ˈbɑˌroʊ ɪt ʤʌst fɔr təˈnaɪt
dialogue.zh: 能否借我今晚暂观一夜

dialogue.en: I guess that would be okay
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɛs ðæt wʊd bi ˌoʊˈkeɪ

dialogue.en: Late that night the priest was awake
dialogue.ipa: leɪt ðæt naɪt ðə prist wʌz ə ˈweɪk
dialogue.zh: 夜深时分,那和尚仍未入眠

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong and Guanyin flew over the ocean
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: I was trying to rest
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: I didn't realize the monk had arrived
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: He is traveling with the Tang monk
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: He is traveling with the Tang monk
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: You will carry the Tang monk to the western paradise
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: He was excited
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can't return this robe
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: She said that only a true believer could make the journey
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: From now on you must tell people who you are
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: You are going to get the true scriptures
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's stop here for the night
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There are others waiting for you too
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: A nasty monkey who was
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: The dragon stopped talking when he saw Wukong next to Guanyin
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I even asked him who he was
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

collocations.context: Wukong and Guanyin flew over the ocean
Dragon come out of the river at once
Dragon come out of the river at once
I was trying to rest
From now on you must tell people who you are
There are others waiting for you too
Guanyin looked back at the dragon
Stand up master
The bodhisattva is back on Mount Potalaka by now
When he turned to thank the boatman
How long will it take to reach the western paradise
She said that only a true believer could make the journey
He reached into his bag and pulled out the robe
The priest admired it for a moment

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 19 An Evil Plan

dialogue.en: The head priest called for two other priests
dialogue.ipa: ðə hɛd prist kɔld fɔr tu ˈʌðər prists
dialogue.zh: 住持唤来另外两个和尚

dialogue.en: Who quickly ran into the room
dialogue.ipa: hu ˈkwɪkli ræn ˈɪntu ðə rum

dialogue.en: I can't give this robe back to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt ɡɪv ðɪs roʊb bæk tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 这件袈裟绝不能还给唐僧

dialogue.en: But you must give it back
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju mʌst ɡɪv ɪt bæk

dialogue.en: This robe is a Buddhist treasure
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs roʊb ɪz ə ˈbudəst ˈtrɛʒər

dialogue.en: It comes from the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ɪt kʌmz frʌm ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrə ˌdaɪs

dialogue.en: As Buddhist we must do everything we can to keep it in our monastery
dialogue.ipa: æz ˈbudəst wi mʌst du ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ wi kæn tu kip ɪt ɪn ˈaʊər ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 身为佛门弟子,我们当竭尽全力将此宝留在本寺

dialogue.en: The Tang monk won't let you keep it
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk woʊnt lɛt ju kip ɪt

dialogue.en: There was an evil look in his eye
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ən ˈivəl lʊk ɪn hɪz aɪ

dialogue.en: He looked down and saw two priests walking across the courtyard
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt daʊn ænd sɔ tu prists ˈwɔkɪŋ əˈkrɔs ðə ˈkɔrˌtjɑrd
dialogue.zh: 低头望去,只见两个和尚穿过庭院

dialogue.en: They were carrying bundles of firewood
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɜr ˈkæriɪŋ ˈbʌndəlz ʌv ˈfaɪərˌwʊd

dialogue.en: It's the middle of the night
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ðə ˈmɪdəl ʌv ðə naɪt

dialogue.en: Why are they starting a fire
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɑr ðeɪ ˈstɑrtɪŋ ə ˈfaɪər

dialogue.en: The priest stacked the firewood next to the building the Tang monk was sleeping in
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist stækt ðə ˈfaɪərˌwʊd nɛkst tu ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz ˈslipɪŋ ɪn
dialogue.zh: 和尚将柴火堆在唐僧歇息的屋旁

dialogue.en: I'll bet that head priest wants to keep our robe
dialogue.ipa: aɪl bɛt ðæt hɛd prist wɑnts tu kip ˈaʊər roʊp
dialogue.zh: 定是那住持贪图咱们的袈裟

dialogue.en: Wukong waited until the priest lit the wood on fire
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˈweɪtɪd ənˈtɪl ðə prist lɪt ðə wʊd ɑn ˈfaɪər

dialogue.en: Then he used his magic powers
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi juzd hɪz ˈmæʤɪk ˈpaʊərz

dialogue.en: The priest screamed and ran as the fire shot across the courtyard
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist skrimd ænd ræn æz ðə ˈfaɪər ʃɑt əˈkrɔs ðə ˈkɔr ˌtjɑrd
dialogue.zh: 火焰窜过庭院时,和尚惊叫着逃开

dialogue.en: One building went up in flames
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ˈbɪldɪŋ wɛnt ʌp ɪn fleɪmz
dialogue.zh: 一座建筑燃起了熊熊大火

dialogue.en: Soon most of the monastery's buildings were on fire
dialogue.ipa: sun moʊst ʌv ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛriz ˈbɪldɪŋz wɜr ɑn ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 很快,寺院的大部分建筑都陷入了火海

dialogue.en: Walls crumbled and roofs caved in
dialogue.ipa: wɔlz ˈkrʌmbəld ænd rufs keɪvd ɪn

dialogue.en: However that the fire didn't touch
dialogue.ipa: ˌhaʊˈɛvər ðæt ðə ˈfaɪər ˈdɪdənt tʌʧ

dialogue.en: The Tang monk slept peacefully as the rest of the monastery burned down
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk slɛpt ˈpisfəli æz ðə rɛst ʌv ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri bɜrnd daʊn
dialogue.zh: 当寺院的其他部分燃烧殆尽时,唐僧正安然入睡

dialogue.en: The next morning the Tang monk woke up and opened the door
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk woʊk ʌp ænd ˈoʊpənd ðə dɔr
dialogue.zh: 第二天早上,唐僧醒来打开了门

dialogue.en: Burned pieces of wood lay in heaps
dialogue.ipa: bɜrnd ˈpisəz ʌv wʊd leɪ ɪn hips

dialogue.en: The building's walls were black and crumbled
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈbɪldɪŋz wɔlz wɜr blæk ænd ˈkrʌmbəld
dialogue.zh: 建筑的墙壁焦黑且破碎

dialogue.en: That's when he realized that the building he'd slept in was fine
dialogue.ipa: ðæts wɛn hi ˈriəˌlaɪzd ðæt ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ hid slɛpt ɪn wʌz faɪn
dialogue.zh: 这时他才意识到自己睡的那座建筑完好无损

dialogue.en: The head priest tried to kill you
dialogue.ipa: ðə hɛd prist traɪd tu kɪl ju

dialogue.en: He tried to set the building you were in on fire
dialogue.ipa: hi traɪd tu sɛt ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ju wɜr ɪn ɑn ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 他试图放火烧你所在的建筑

dialogue.en: I used my magic to stop the fire
dialogue.ipa: aɪ juzd maɪ ˈmæʤɪk tu stɑp ðə ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 我用我的法术阻止了火势

dialogue.en: The Tang monk scratched his head
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk skræʧt hɪz hɛd

dialogue.en: The rest of the buildings burned
dialogue.ipa: ðə rɛst ʌv ðə ˈbɪldɪŋz bɜrnd

dialogue.en: I used my magic for that too
dialogue.ipa: aɪ juzd maɪ ˈmæʤɪk fɔr ðæt tu
sɛd wu kæŋ wɪð ə smaɪl

dialogue.en: I used a spell that protected only your building and the robe
dialogue.ipa: aɪ juzd ə spɛl ðæt prəˈtɛktɪd ˈoʊnli jʊər ˈbɪldɪŋ ænd ðə roʊb
dialogue.zh: 我施了一个只保护你所在建筑和袈裟的咒语

dialogue.en: The spell made the fire spread everywhere else though
dialogue.ipa: ðə spɛl meɪd ðə ˈfaɪər sprɛd ˈɛvriˌwɛr ɛls ðoʊ
dialogue.zh: 但这个咒语却让火势蔓延到了其他地方

dialogue.en: The Tang monk's eyes filled with tears
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋks aɪz fɪld wɪð tɛrz
dialogue.zh: 唐僧的眼中充满了泪水

dialogue.en: If you had the power to stop the fire
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju hæd ðə ˈpaʊər tu stɑp ðə ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 如果你有能力阻止火灾

dialogue.en: You should have stopped all of it
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd hæv stɑpt ɔl ʌv ɪt

dialogue.en: Just then they heard a shout
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn ðeɪ hɜrd ə ʃaʊt
dialogue.zh: 就在这时,他们听到一声呼喊

dialogue.en: Two of the priests ran toward them
dialogue.ipa: tu ʌv ðə prists ræn təˈwɔrd ðɛm

dialogue.en: How dare you try to burn my master
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju traɪ tu bɜrn maɪ ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 你们竟敢想烧死我师父

dialogue.en: I should club you with my iron bar
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʃʊd klʌb ju wɪð maɪ ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: The two priests fell to their knees and bowed
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu prists fɛl tu ðɛr niz ænd baʊd
dialogue.zh: 两个道士跪倒在地,连连磕头

dialogue.en: We didn't want to harm you or the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wi ˈdɪdənt wɑnt tu hɑrm ju ɔr ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我们本不想伤害您和唐僧

dialogue.en: It was the head priest's idea
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz ðə hɛd prists aɪˈdiə

dialogue.en: Wukong glared at the two priests for a moment
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ɡlɛrd æt ðə tu prists fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt
dialogue.zh: 悟空瞪了两个道士片刻

dialogue.en: Just bring us the robe so we can continue our journey to the west
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst brɪŋ ʌs ðə roʊb soʊ wi kæn kənˈtɪnju ˈaʊər ˈʤɜrni tu ðə wɛst
dialogue.zh: 快把袈裟拿来,我们好继续西行

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Who quickly ran into the room
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: They were carrying bundles of firewood
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I have a plan
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Is everything OK master
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: You should have stopped all of it
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll bet that head priest wants to keep our robe
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Our monastery is ruined
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can't give this robe back to the Tang monk
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But you must give it back
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: You should have stopped all of it
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: I'll bet that head priest wants to keep our robe
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: The head priest tried to kill you
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Run for your life
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There was an evil look in his eye
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: I used a spell that protected only your building and the robe
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you had the power to stop the fire
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 20 the black bear spirit

dialogue.en: Wukong glared at the two scared priests
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ɡlɛrd æt ðə tu skɛrd prists
dialogue.zh: 悟空瞪着两个惊恐的道士

dialogue.en: The robe was in a room that didn't get burned at all
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊb wʌz ɪn ə rum ðæt ˈdɪdənt ɡɛt bɜrnd æt ɔl
dialogue.zh: 袈裟原本放在根本没着火的屋子里

dialogue.en: His iron bar instantly appeared from inside his ear
dialogue.ipa: hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ˈɪnstəntli əˈpɪrd frʌm ɪnˈsaɪd hɪz ir
dialogue.zh: 金箍棒瞬间从他耳中飞出

dialogue.en: The monkey swung it toward the two priests
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki swʌŋ ɪt tə ˈwɔrd ðə tu prists
dialogue.zh: 猴子抡棒朝两个道士打去

dialogue.en: But before the bar hit them
dialogue.ipa: bʌt bɪˈfɔr ðə bɑr hɪt ðɛm

dialogue.en: It dropped from the monkey's hands
dialogue.ipa: ɪt drɑpt frʌm ðə ˈmʌŋkiz hændz

dialogue.zh: 疼死我了 疼死我了

dialogue.en: The Tang monk was quietly reciting the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz ˈkwaɪətli riˈsaɪtɪŋ ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl

dialogue.en: The two priests jumped up and backed away
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu prists ʤʌmpt ʌp ænd bækt əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 两个道士跳起来连连后退

dialogue.en: Wukong yelled at the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: Wukong jɛld æt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: The monkey took a deep breath
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki tʊk ə dip brɛθ

dialogue.en: And put the iron bar back in his ear
dialogue.ipa: ænd pʊt ði ˈaɪərn bɑr bæk ɪn hɪz ir

dialogue.en: The Tang monk looked at the two priests
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk lʊkt æt ðə tu prists

dialogue.en: You really don't know where the robe is
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈrɪli doʊnt noʊ wɛr ðə roʊb ɪz
dialogue.zh: 你们真不知道袈裟在哪儿吗

dialogue.en: The head priest ran away last night
dialogue.ipa: ðə hɛd prist ræn əˈweɪ læst naɪt

dialogue.en: He didn't have it with him
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈdɪdənt hæv ɪt wɪð hɪm

dialogue.en: A monster or demon might have stolen it
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmɑnstər ɔr ˈdimən maɪt hæv ˈstoʊlən ɪt
dialogue.zh: 可能是妖怪或恶魔偷走了

dialogue.en: Are there any monsters or demons living near here
dialogue.ipa: ɑr ðɛr ˈɛni ˈmɑnstərz ɔr ˈdimənz ˈlɪvɪŋ nɪr hir
dialogue.zh: 这附近有妖怪或恶魔居住吗

dialogue.en: Some people believe there's a monster in the mountains nearby
dialogue.ipa: sʌm ˈpipəl bɪˈliv ðɛrz ə ˈmɑnstər ɪn ðə ˈmaʊntənz ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 有些人相信附近山里有妖怪

dialogue.en: They say it's a black bear spirit
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ seɪ ɪts ə blæk bɛr ˈspɪrət

dialogue.en: I'll go see if the bear took the robe
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ si ɪf ðə bɛr tʊk ðə roʊb
dialogue.zh: 我去看看是不是那熊偷了袈裟

dialogue.en: Wukong leaped into the air and landed up in the mountains
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd ˈlændɪd ʌp ɪn ðə ˈmaʊntənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空纵身跃起,落在山间

dialogue.en: He walked for a bit and then heard voices
dialogue.ipa: hi wɔkt fɔr ə bɪt ænd ðɛn hɜrd ˈvɔɪsəz
dialogue.zh: 他走了一会儿,听到说话声

dialogue.en: He saw a group of spirits talking
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ ə ɡrup ʌv ˈspɪrɪts ˈtɔkɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 他看到一群精怪正在交谈

dialogue.en: One was a large black bear
dialogue.ipa: wʌn wʌz ə lɑrʤ blæk bɛr

dialogue.en: The monastery was on fire last night
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri wʌz ɑn ˈfaɪər læst naɪt

dialogue.en: I went down to check it out and found a wonderful Buddhist robe
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɛnt daʊn tu ʧɛk ɪt aʊt ænd faʊnd ə ˈwʌndərfəl ˈbudəst roʊb
dialogue.zh: 我下去查看,发现了一件绝妙的佛门袈裟

dialogue.en: I think it's a Buddhist treasure
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɪŋk ɪts ə ˈbudəst ˈtrɛʒər

dialogue.en: So tonight I throwing a feast to celebrate
dialogue.ipa: soʊ təˈnaɪt aɪm ˈθroʊɪŋ ə fist tu ˈsɛləˌbreɪt
dialogue.zh: 所以今晚我要设宴庆祝

dialogue.en: When Wukong heard the other spirits laugh
dialogue.ipa: wɛn wu kæŋ hɜrd ði ˈʌðər ˈspɪrɪts læf
dialogue.zh: 悟空听到其他精怪的笑声

dialogue.en: He jumped over the boulder and landed in the middle of the group
dialogue.ipa: hi ʤʌmpt ˈoʊvər ðə ˈboʊldər ænd ˈlændɪd ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl ʌv ðə ɡrup
dialogue.zh: 他跳过巨石,落在群妖中间

dialogue.en: Give back the robe right now
dialogue.ipa: ɡɪv bæk ðə roʊb raɪt naʊ

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Or I'll destroy all of you
dialogue.ipa: ɔr aɪl dɪˈstrɔɪ ɔl ʌv ju

dialogue.en: The spirits all fled in different directions
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈspɪrɪts ɔl flɛd ɪn ˈdɪfərənt dəˈrɛkʃənz

dialogue.en: Wukong chased the bear until they reached a cave entrance
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʧeɪst ðə bɛr ənˈtɪl ðeɪ riʧt ə keɪv ˈɛntrəns
dialogue.zh: 悟空紧追黑熊直到一个洞口

dialogue.en: The bear ran inside and slammed the door shut
dialogue.ipa: ðə bɛr ræn ɪn ˈsaɪd ænd slæmd ðə dɔr ʃʌt
dialogue.zh: 黑熊冲进洞里,砰地关上门

dialogue.en: Wukong pounded on the cave's door
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˈpaʊndɪd ɑn ðə keɪvz dɔr

dialogue.en: Come out here right now or I'll smash this door down
dialogue.ipa: kʌm aʊt hir raɪt naʊ ɔr aɪl smæʃ ðɪs dɔr daʊn
dialogue.zh: 立刻出来,否则我把这门砸烂

dialogue.en: How dare you pound on my door and yell at me
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju paʊnd ɑn maɪ dɔr ænd jɛl æt mi
dialogue.zh: 你竟敢敲我的门还对我大喊大叫

dialogue.en: I can do whatever I want
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn du ˌwʌˈtɛvər aɪ wɑnt

dialogue.en: I am the black wind king
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ

dialogue.en: I'm the most powerful monster in these mountains
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ðə moʊst ˈpaʊərfəl ˈmɑnstər ɪn ðiz ˈmaʊntənz
dialogue.zh: 我是这山里最厉害的妖怪

dialogue.en: King of the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: kɪŋ ʌv ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: I caused lots of trouble in heaven five hundred years ago
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kɑzd lɑts ʌv ˈtrʌbəl ɪn ˈhɛvən faɪv ˈhʌndrɪd jɪrz əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 五百年前我在天庭闹得天翻地覆

dialogue.en: The Jade emperor's entire army couldn't defeat me
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərərz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi ˈkʊdənt dɪˈfit mi
dialogue.zh: 玉皇大帝的千军万马都奈何不了我

dialogue.en: He jabbed his lance at Wukong
dialogue.ipa: hi ʤæbd hɪz læns æt Wukong

dialogue.en: The monkey blocked the lance with his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki blɑkt ðə læns wɪð hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Rocks tumbled and rolled downhill as the two warriors fought
dialogue.ipa: rɑks ˈtʌmbəld ænd roʊld ˈdaʊnˈhɪl æz ðə tu ˈwɔriərz fɔt
dialogue.zh: 两位勇士激战之时,山石滚滚而下

dialogue.en: The black wind king held up a hand
dialogue.ipa: ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ hɛld ʌp ə hænd

dialogue.en: I need to take a break
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid tu teɪk ə breɪk

dialogue.zh: 悟空惊得下巴都快掉了

dialogue.en: Before Wukong could say anything else
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈfɔr Wukong kʊd seɪ ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls

dialogue.en: The bear ran back into his cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə bɛr ræn bæk ˈɪntu hɪz keɪv

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: He cried
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: He was holding a lance
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I think it's a Buddhist treasure
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll go see if the bear took the robe
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can do whatever I want
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: The Jade emperor's entire army couldn't defeat me
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: We tried to find it
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Stop reciting the spell
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: Some people believe there's a monster in the mountains nearby
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: I'll go see if the bear took the robe
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When Wukong heard the other spirits laugh
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So tonight I throwing a feast to celebrate
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: You really don't know where the robe is
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 21 the monster's friend

dialogue.en: He was telling the bodhisattva everything that had happened at the monastery
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈtɛlɪŋ ðə bodhisattva ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ðæt hæd ˈhæpənd æt ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 正向菩萨讲述寺院里发生的一切

dialogue.en: Then a bear spirit called the Klack Wind King stole the robe
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ə bɛr ˈspɪrət kɔld ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ stoʊl ðə roʊb
dialogue.zh: 后来有个叫黑风大王的熊精偷走了袈裟

dialogue.en: I demanded he give it back
dialogue.ipa: aɪ dɪˈmændɪd hi ɡɪv ɪt bæk

dialogue.en: We fought until the bear spirit said it was lunchtime and hid in his cave
dialogue.ipa: wi fɔt ənˈtɪl ðə bɛr ˈspɪrət sɛd ɪt wʌz ˈlʌnʧˌtaɪm ænd hɪd ɪn hɪz keɪv
dialogue.zh: 我们打到那熊精说该吃午饭了,就躲进洞里

dialogue.en: I kicked the door and yelled insults at him for more than an hour
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kɪkt ðə dɔr ænd jɛld ɪnˈsʌlts æt hɪm fɔr mɔr ðæn ən ˈaʊər
dialogue.zh: 我踹门骂了他一个多时辰

dialogue.en: The Tang monk should not have shown that robe to the priest
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ʃʊd nɑt hæv ʃoʊn ðæt roʊb tu ðə prist
dialogue.zh: 唐僧本不该将那袈裟示与老僧

dialogue.en: The robe is a Buddhist treasure
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊb ɪz ə ˈbudəst ˈtrɛʒər

dialogue.en: And as that head priest tried to do
dialogue.ipa: ænd æz ðæt hɛd prist traɪd tu du
dialogue.zh: 就像那住持老僧企图做的

dialogue.en: They might harm the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ maɪt hɑrm ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: I've told the Tang Monk many times not to do dumb things
dialogue.ipa: aɪv toʊld ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈmɛni taɪmz nɑt tu du dʌm θɪŋz
dialogue.zh: 我劝过唐僧多少次别干傻事

dialogue.en: And you should have put out that fire
dialogue.ipa: ænd ju ʃʊd hæv pʊt aʊt ðæt ˈfaɪər

dialogue.en: I'll help you get back the robe
dialogue.ipa: aɪl hɛlp ju ɡɛt bæk ðə roʊb
dialogue.zh: 我会帮你把袈裟拿回来

dialogue.en: Wukong and Guanyin soared over the ocean
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd Guanyin sɔrd ˈoʊvər ði ˈoʊʃən
dialogue.zh: 悟空和观音腾云驾雾飞越海洋

dialogue.en: Soon they landed on the mountain
dialogue.ipa: sun ðeɪ ˈlændɪd ɑn ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Where is the black wind king's cave
dialogue.ipa: wɛr ɪz ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋz keɪv
dialogue.zh: 黑风大王的洞府在哪儿

dialogue.en: We should sneak up to it
dialogue.ipa: wi ʃʊd snik ʌp tu ɪt

dialogue.zh: 他们听到脚步声越来越近

dialogue.en: Wukong and Guanyin hid as a daoist priest walked along the path
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd Guanyin hɪd æz ə ˈdaʊɪst prist wɔkt əˈlɔŋ ðə pæθ
dialogue.zh: 悟空和观音躲藏起来,只见一位道士沿路走来

dialogue.en: The priest was holding a tray
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist wʌz ˈhoʊldɪŋ ə treɪ
dialogue.zh: 道士手里端着一个托盘

dialogue.en: A bright purple pill sat on the tray
dialogue.ipa: ə braɪt ˈpɜrpəl pɪl sæt ɑn ðə treɪ
dialogue.zh: 托盘上放着一颗亮紫色的仙丹

dialogue.en: The priest was talking to himself
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist wʌz ˈtɔkɪŋ tu hɪmˈsɛlf

dialogue.zh: 今天真是令人兴奋的日子

dialogue.en: The black wind king has a new robe that is a Buddhist treasure
dialogue.ipa: ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ hæz ə nu roʊb ðæt ɪz ə ˈbudəst ˈtrɛʒər
dialogue.zh: 黑风大王新得了一件佛门至宝袈裟

dialogue.en: And I hope he likes the pill I made for him
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ hoʊp hi laɪks ðə pɪl aɪ meɪd fɔr hɪm
dialogue.zh: 希望他会喜欢我为他炼制的仙丹

dialogue.en: It will make him live forever
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wɪl meɪk hɪm lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: It's a wolf spirit dressed as a priest
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ə wʊlf ˈspɪrət drɛst æz ə prist

dialogue.en: The priest stood before the black wind king's cave door
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist stʊd bɪˈfɔr ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋz keɪv dɔr
dialogue.zh: 道士站在黑风大王的洞府门前

dialogue.en: He knocked and the door flew open
dialogue.ipa: hi nɑkt ænd ðə dɔr flu ˈoʊpən
dialogue.zh: 他敲了敲门,门应声而开

dialogue.en: Are you still here you little monkey
dialogue.ipa: ɑr ju stɪl hir ju ˈlɪtəl ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 你这小猴子还敢在这儿

dialogue.en: Then he saw the priest and smiled
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi sɔ ðə prist ænd smaɪld
dialogue.zh: 接着他看见道士,露出了笑容

dialogue.en: Oh it's you my old friend
dialogue.ipa: oʊ ɪts ju maɪ oʊld frɛnd

dialogue.en: A pesky monkey spirit was here a little while ago
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈpɛski ˈmʌŋki ˈspɪrət wʌz hir ə ˈlɪtəl waɪl əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 刚才有个讨厌的猴精在这儿

dialogue.en: He kept banging on my door and yelling at me
dialogue.ipa: hi kɛpt ˈbæŋɪŋ ɑn maɪ dɔr ænd ˈjɛlɪŋ æt mi
dialogue.zh: 他不停地砸我的门,还冲我嚷嚷

dialogue.en: The black wind king patted the priest on the shoulder
dialogue.ipa: ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ ˈpætɪd ðə prist ɑn ðə ˈʃoʊldər
dialogue.zh: 黑风大王拍了拍道士的肩膀

dialogue.en: But let's not talk about him
dialogue.ipa: bʌt lɛts nɑt tɔk əˈbaʊt hɪm

dialogue.en: To celebrate your new Buddhist treasure
dialogue.ipa: tu ˈsɛləˌbreɪt jʊər nu ˈbudəst ˈtrɛʒər
dialogue.zh: 为了庆祝你新得的佛宝

dialogue.en: He held up the tray with the pill
dialogue.ipa: hi hɛld ʌp ðə treɪ wɪð ðə pɪl
dialogue.zh: 他托起放着丹药的盘子

dialogue.en: The black wind king looked interested
dialogue.ipa: ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ lʊkt ˈɪntrɪstɪd
dialogue.zh: 黑风大王显出感兴趣的样子

dialogue.en: What kind of pill is that
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kaɪnd ʌv pɪl ɪz ðæt

dialogue.en: It is a very special pill
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ɪz ə ˈvɛri ˈspɛʃəl pɪl
dialogue.zh: 这是一枚非常特别的丹药

dialogue.en: Said the priest with a smile
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə prist wɪð ə smaɪl

dialogue.en: I made it just for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ meɪd ɪt ʤʌst fɔr ju

dialogue.en: It will make you live forever
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wɪl meɪk ju lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: The black wind king stroked his chin
dialogue.ipa: ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ stroʊkt hɪz ʧɪn

dialogue.en: I was just thinking this morning that I would like to live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ʤʌst ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðæt aɪ wʊd laɪk tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 今早我还在想,要是能长生不老该多好

dialogue.en: The bear picked up the pill and opened his mouth wide
dialogue.ipa: ðə bɛr pɪkt ʌp ðə pɪl ænd ˈoʊpənd hɪz maʊθ waɪd
dialogue.zh: 黑熊精拿起丹药,张大了嘴

dialogue.en: As he brought the pill up to his mouth
dialogue.ipa: æz hi brɔt ðə pɪl ʌp tu hɪz maʊθ
dialogue.zh: 正当他把丹药送到嘴边时

dialogue.en: But before the Black Wind King could finish speaking
dialogue.ipa: bʌt bɪˈfɔr ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ kʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈspikɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 但黑风大王话还没说完

dialogue.en: The pill hopped off his hand
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪl hɑpt ɔf hɪz hænd
dialogue.zh: 丹药从他手中跳了起来

dialogue.en: It shot into his mouth and slid down his throat
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ʃɑt ˈɪntu hɪz maʊθ ænd slɪd daʊn hɪz θroʊt
dialogue.zh: 它嗖地射进他嘴里,滑下了喉咙

She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: But before the Black Wind King could finish speaking
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You must help me
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: The Tang monk should not have shown that robe to the priest
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: And as that head priest tried to do
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's go
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: He was telling the bodhisattva everything that had happened at the monastery
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When other people see it
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: A little while later
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 比较级 + than / 比较级 and 比较级
grammar.description: 比较两者差异，或表达程度不断变化。
grammar.source: I kicked the door and yelled insults at him for more than an hour
examples: Wukong is stronger than the demon.
This road is shorter than the other one.
The river is wider than before.

The mountain is higher than the hill.
The cave became darker and darker.
They walked faster and faster.
The sound grew louder and louder.

The journey became more and more difficult.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 22 a Very Strange Pill

dialogue.en: The Black Wind King took a step back
dialogue.ipa: ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ tʊk ə stɛp bæk

dialogue.en: That pill jumped down my throat
dialogue.ipa: ðæt pɪl ʤʌmpt daʊn maɪ θroʊt
dialogue.zh: 那丹药自己跳进我喉咙里了

dialogue.en: The entire cave filled with light
dialogue.ipa: ði ɪnˈtaɪər keɪv fɪld wɪð laɪt
dialogue.zh: 整个洞府顿时光芒四射

dialogue.en: The bear squeezed his eyes shut
dialogue.ipa: ðə bɛr skwizd hɪz aɪz ʃʌt

dialogue.en: You tricked me with a disguise
dialogue.ipa: ju trɪkt mi wɪð ə dɪsˈɡaɪz

dialogue.en: He held his stomach and groaned
dialogue.ipa: hi hɛld hɪz ˈstʌmək ænd ɡroʊnd

dialogue.zh: 黑熊精惊讶地四处张望
我刚才听见那猴子的声音

dialogue.en: He fell to his knees and groaned again
dialogue.ipa: hi fɛl tu hɪz niz ænd ɡroʊnd əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 他跪倒在地,又呻吟了一声

dialogue.en: I changed myself into a pill to trick you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʧeɪnʤd ˌmaɪˈsɛlf ˈɪntu ə pɪl tu trɪk ju

dialogue.en: Now I'm going to practice some of my fighting skills
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ˈpræktəs sʌm ʌv maɪ ˈfaɪtɪŋ skɪlz

dialogue.en: The monkey punched and kicked the bear's insides
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki pʌnʧt ænd kɪkt ðə bɛrz ɪnˈsaɪdz
dialogue.zh: 猴子在黑熊精肚子里拳打脚踢

dialogue.en: Did flips and ran around in circles
dialogue.ipa: dɪd flɪps ænd ræn əˈraʊnd ɪn ˈsɜrkəlz

dialogue.en: I will do anything you say
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl du ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ju seɪ

dialogue.en: Just please tell the monkey to stop
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst pliz tɛl ðə ˈmʌŋki tu stɑp
dialogue.zh: 只求您让那猴子停下来

dialogue.en: Guanyin held up the metal headband
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin hɛld ʌp ðə ˈmɛtəl ˈhɛdˌbænd
dialogue.zh: 观音举起一个金属头箍

dialogue.en: It looked just like the one on Wukong's head
dialogue.ipa: ɪt lʊkt ʤʌst laɪk ðə wʌn ɑn Wukong's hɛd
dialogue.zh: 它看起来和悟空头上的那个一模一样

dialogue.en: She placed it on the bear's head
dialogue.ipa: ʃi pleɪst ɪt ɑn ðə bɛrz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 她把它戴在了熊怪的头上

dialogue.en: A tiny Wukong popped out of the black Wind King's nose
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈtaɪni Wukong pɑpt aʊt ʌv ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋz noʊz
dialogue.zh: 一个小小的悟空从黑风大王的鼻子里蹦了出来

dialogue.en: He quickly grew to his normal size
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkwɪkli ɡru tu hɪz ˈnɔrməl saɪz
dialogue.zh: 他迅速变回了正常大小

dialogue.en: The bear pointed to a dark room in the back of the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə bɛr ˈpɔɪntɪd tu ə dɑrk rum ɪn ðə bæk ʌv ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 熊怪指向山洞后方一个黑暗的房间

dialogue.en: After Wukong left to get the robe
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər wu kɔŋ lɛft tu ɡɛt ðə roʊb

dialogue.en: The Black Wind King charged at Guanyin
dialogue.ipa: ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ ʧɑrʤd æt Guanyin

dialogue.en: But the bear was too slow
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə bɛr wʌz tu sloʊ

dialogue.en: Guanyin threw four more metal bands at him
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin θru fɔr mɔr ˈmɛtəl bændz æt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 观音又朝他扔了四个金属箍

dialogue.en: The other two clamped onto his ankles
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðər tu klæmpt ˈɑntu hɪz ˈæŋkəlz
dialogue.zh: 另外两个箍住了他的脚踝

dialogue.en: When the bodhisattva began reciting a spell
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðə bozazafa bɪ ˈɡæn riˈsaɪtɪŋ ə spɛl

dialogue.en: Do you promise to be good
dialogue.ipa: du ju ˈprɑməs tu bi ɡʊd

dialogue.en: Wukong came back with the robe
dialogue.ipa: Wukong keɪm bæk wɪð ðə roʊb

dialogue.en: You have five of those bands
dialogue.ipa: ju hæv faɪv ʌv ðoʊz bændz

dialogue.en: The Black Wind King looked at the ground and sighed
dialogue.ipa: ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ lʊkt æt ðə ɡraʊnd ænd saɪd
dialogue.zh: 黑风大王看着地面叹了口气

dialogue.en: What should we do with the bear
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ʃʊd wi du wɪð ðə bɛr

dialogue.en: He can be my guardian on Mount Putalaka if he behaves
dialogue.ipa: hi kæn bi maɪ ˈɡɑrdiən ɑn maʊnt Putalaka ɪf hi bɪˈheɪvz
dialogue.zh: 如果他表现好,可以在我普陀山当个守山大神

dialogue.en: The bodhisattva led the bear out of the cave and vanished
dialogue.ipa: ðə bozdaza lɛd ðə bɛr aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv ænd ˈvænɪʃt
dialogue.zh: 菩萨领着熊怪出了山洞,随即消失了

dialogue.en: Wukong flew back to the monastery
dialogue.ipa: Wukong flu bæk tu ðə ˈmɑnə ˌstɛri

dialogue.en: Cried the Tang monk when he saw the monkey
dialogue.ipa: kraɪd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɛn hi sɔ ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: The two travelers headed west again
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ˈtrævələrz ˈhɛdɪd wɛst əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 两位旅人再次向西行进

dialogue.en: Wukong told the monk about his adventure with the Black Wind King
dialogue.ipa: Wukong toʊld ðə mʌŋk əˈbaʊt hɪz ædˈvɛnʧər wɪð ðə blæk wɪnd kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空向和尚讲述了他与黑风大王的冒险经历

dialogue.en: He was really an evil wolf spirit
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈrɪli ən ˈivəl wʊlf ˈspɪrət
dialogue.zh: 他其实是个邪恶的狼精

dialogue.en: Then Guanyin made herself look like him
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn Guanyin meɪd hər ˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk hɪm
dialogue.zh: 于是观音菩萨化作了他的模样

dialogue.en: And you turned yourself into a pill
dialogue.ipa: ænd ju tɜrnd jərˈsɛlf ˈɪntu ə pɪl
dialogue.zh: 而你把自己变成了一颗仙丹

dialogue.en: And I went right into that bear's belly
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ wɛnt raɪt ˈɪntu ðæt bɛrz ˈbɛli
dialogue.zh: 我就直接钻进了那熊的肚子里

dialogue.en: I think we both Learned a valuable lesson Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɪŋk wi boʊθ lɜrnd ə ˈvæljəbəl ˈlɛsən Wukong
dialogue.zh: 悟空,我想我们都学到了宝贵的一课

dialogue.en: I will never show anyone the robe again
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl ˈnɛvər ʃoʊ ˈɛniˌwʌn ðə roʊb əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 我再也不会把袈裟给任何人看了

dialogue.en: The robe is a gift from Buddha
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊb ɪz ə ɡɪft frʌm ˈbudə

dialogue.en: He stopped talking and pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi stɑpt ˈtɔkɪŋ ænd pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: He looked toward a nearby cave
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt təˈwɔrd ə ˈnɪrˈbaɪ keɪv
dialogue.zh: 他望向附近的一个山洞

dialogue.en: The Tang monk shook with fear
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ʃʊk wɪð fɪr

dialogue.en: A pig-like creature leaped from the cave
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈpeɪɡən laɪk ˈkriʧər lɛpt frʌm ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 一个似妖非妖的怪物从洞中跃出
挥舞着一把沉重的钉耙

examples: The monkey opened the door.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Guanyin was standing before him
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
