titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 23 Great Protectors

dialogue.en: The creature had a pig's snout and ears
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈkriʧər hæd ə pɪɡz snaʊt ænd ɪrz

dialogue.en: But he ran on two legs like a person
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hi ræn ɑn tu lɛɡz laɪk ə ˈpɜrsən
dialogue.zh: 但却像人一样用两条腿奔跑

dialogue.en: Wukong blocked the Rake with his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: Wukong blɑkt ðə reɪk wɪð hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Then he swung the bar at the pig's feet
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi swʌŋ ðə bɑr æt ðə pɪɡz fit
dialogue.zh: 接着他抡棒扫向猪妖的双脚

dialogue.en: He fell face down in the dirt
dialogue.ipa: hi fɛl feɪs daʊn ɪn ðə dɜrt

dialogue.en: You'll wish you hadn't done that
dialogue.ipa: jul wɪʃ ju ˈhædənt dʌn ðæt

dialogue.en: Wukong leaped out of the way as the pig's Rake slammed down
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lɛpt aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ æz ðə pɪɡz reɪk slæmd daʊn
dialogue.zh: 猪妖的钉耙砸下时,悟空纵身闪避

dialogue.en: The two fought kicking up dust and rocks
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu fɔt ˈkɪkɪŋ ʌp dʌst ænd rɑks
dialogue.zh: 两人激战,扬起漫天尘土碎石

dialogue.en: The Tang monk hid behind his horse
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk hɪd bɪˈhaɪnd hɪz hɔrs

dialogue.en: Wukong swung his iron bar again
dialogue.ipa: Wukong swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ə ˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: I caused lots of trouble in heaven
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kɑzd lɑts ʌv ˈtrʌbəl ɪn ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor's entire army couldn't stop me
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərərz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi ˈkʊdənt stɑp mi
dialogue.zh: 玉帝的千军万马也奈何不了我

dialogue.en: But you don't seem so powerful to me
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju doʊnt sim soʊ ˈpaʊərfəl tu mi
dialogue.zh: 但在我看来你也没那么厉害

dialogue.en: He lunged at the monkey again
dialogue.ipa: hi lʌnʤd æt ðə ˈmʌŋki əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: Wukong jumped out of the way
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʤʌmpt aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ

dialogue.en: I thought you were being punished
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɔt ju wɜr ˈbiɪŋ ˈpʌnɪʃt

dialogue.en: Weren't you trapped under a mountain
dialogue.ipa: ˈwɜrənt ju træpt ˈʌndər ə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 你不是被压在山下了吗

dialogue.en: I'm going to the west with the Tang monk to
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə wɛst wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tu
dialogue.zh: 我要和唐僧一起去西天

dialogue.en: I'm supposed to go with him too
dialogue.ipa: aɪm səˈpoʊzd tu ɡoʊ wɪð hɪm tu

dialogue.en: I was sent to earth as a punishment
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz sɛnt tu ɜrθ æz ə ˈpʌnɪʃmənt

dialogue.en: I caused trouble in heaven too
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kɑzd ˈtrʌbəl ɪn ˈhɛvən tu

dialogue.en: Guanyin said I would be forgiven if I help protect the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin sɛd aɪ wʊd bi fərˈɡɪvən ɪf aɪ hɛlp prəˈtɛkt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 观音说我若能护佑唐僧就能得到宽恕

dialogue.en: And the three of them continued west
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə θri ʌv ðɛm kən ˈtɪnjud wɛst

dialogue.en: Do we really need to bring them
dialogue.ipa: du wi ˈrɪli nid tu brɪŋ ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 我们真的需要带着它们吗

dialogue.en: Going to the western paradise is supposed to be difficult
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs ɪz səˈpoʊzd tu bi ˈdɪfəkəlt
dialogue.zh: 去西天取经本就该历经磨难

dialogue.en: When are we going to eat lunch
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ɑr wi ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu it lʌnʧ

dialogue.en: We just ate breakfast, how can you be hungry again?
dialogue.ipa: wi ʤʌst eɪt ˈbrɛkfəst, haʊ kæn ju bi ˈhʌŋɡri əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 我们刚吃过早饭 , 你为什么又饿了

dialogue.en: They went to round a bend
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɛnt tu raʊnd ə bɛnd

dialogue.en: Bajie and Wukong quickly pulled out their weapons
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd Wukong ˈkwɪkli pʊld aʊt ðɛr ˈwɛpənz
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟空迅速抽出兵器

dialogue.en: He looked at the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: The Tang monk's face turned pale
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋks feɪs tɜrnd peɪl

dialogue.en: And he fell off his horse
dialogue.ipa: ænd hi fɛl ɔf hɪz hɔrs

dialogue.en: Don't you dare harm our master
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt ju dɛr hɑrm ˈaʊər ˈmæstər

dialogue.en: He's going to the west to get the true scriptures
dialogue.ipa: hiz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə wɛst tu ɡɛt ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz

dialogue.zh: 老虎的眼睛睁得大大的

dialogue.en: I heard that eating the Tang monk will make someone live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hɜrd ðæt ˈitɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɪl meɪk ˈsʌmˌwʌn lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 我听说吃了唐僧肉能让人长生不老

dialogue.en: The pig hit him with the rake
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ hɪt hɪm wɪð ðə reɪk

dialogue.en: Wukong ran toward the tiger with his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ræn tə ˈwɔrd ðə ˈtaɪɡər wɪð hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr
dialogue.zh: 悟空拿着铁棒冲向老虎

dialogue.en: The tiger dodged the bar and then almost got hit by the Rake again
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər dɑʤd ðə bɑr ænd ðɛn ˈɔlˌmoʊst ɡɑt hɪt baɪ ðə reɪk ə ˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 老虎躲开了铁棒,差点又被耙子击中

dialogue.en: Wukong and Bajie ran after the Tiger
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd Bajie ræn ˈæftər ðə ˈtaɪɡər
dialogue.zh: 悟空和八戒追赶着老虎

dialogue.en: For a moment they lost him
dialogue.ipa: fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt ðeɪ lɔst hɪm

dialogue.en: Then they spotted a flash of orange behind some bushes
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ðeɪ ˈspɑtɪd ə flæʃ ʌv ˈɔrənʤ bɪˈhaɪnd sʌm ˈbʊʃəz
dialogue.zh: 然后他们发现灌木丛后闪过一道橙色

dialogue.en: The monkey and pig snuck up to the bushes
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ænd pɪɡ snʌk ʌp tu ðə ˈbʊʃəz
dialogue.zh: 猴子和猪悄悄靠近灌木丛

dialogue.en: Instead a tiger skin lay over a rock
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈstɛd ə ˈtaɪɡər skɪn leɪ ˈoʊvər ə rɑk
dialogue.zh: 反而有一张虎皮盖在石头上

dialogue.en: He ran right out of his skin
dialogue.ipa: hi ræn raɪt aʊt ʌv hɪz skɪn

dialogue.en: He slapped Bajie on the back
dialogue.ipa: hi slæpt Bajie ɑn ðə bæk

dialogue.zh: 我们真是了不起的保护者

dialogue.en: The two friends walked back to the road laughing
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu frɛndz wɔkt bæk tu ðə roʊd ˈlæfɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 两个朋友笑着走回路上
但突然他们的笑声停止了

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: But he ran on two legs like a person
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: I thought you were being punished
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I am Sun Wukong
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Is hosting a feast
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: You'll wish you hadn't done that
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: I was sent to earth as a punishment
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You can carry the bags
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: The Jade Emperor's entire army couldn't stop me
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Stop complaining
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: Guanyin said I would be forgiven if I help protect the Tang monk
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When are we going to eat lunch
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: But you don't seem so powerful to me
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

collocations.context: He fell face down in the dirt
He jumped back up
Wukong leaped out of the way as the pig's Rake slammed down
Five hundred years ago
I caused lots of trouble in heaven
Guanyin said I would be forgiven if I help protect the Tang monk
Bajie and Wukong quickly pulled out their weapons
He looked at the Tang monk
I heard that eating the Tang monk will make someone live forever
For a moment they lost him

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 24 The Great King Yellow Wind

dialogue.en: Wukong and Bajie looked all around
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd Bajie lʊkt ɔl ə ˈraʊnd

dialogue.en: But the Tang monk was gone
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz ɡɔn

dialogue.zh: 那只老虎吃了我们的师父

dialogue.en: I guess we don't have to protect him anymore
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɛs wi doʊnt hæv tu prəˈtɛkt hɪm ˌɛniˈmɔr
dialogue.zh: 我想我们不用再保护他了

dialogue.en: The pig started to walk away
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ ˈstɑrtɪd tu wɔk əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: We have to save our master
dialogue.ipa: wi hæv tu seɪv ˈaʊər ˈmæstər

dialogue.en: That Tiger said he works for a demon
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈtaɪɡər sɛd hi wɜrks fɔr ə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 那只老虎说他为一个妖怪效力

dialogue.en: The king's cave must be nearby
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋz keɪv mʌst bi ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 大王的洞穴一定就在附近

dialogue.en: The tiger entered his master's cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ˈɛntərd hɪz ˈmæstərz keɪv
dialogue.zh: 老虎走进了主人的洞穴

dialogue.en: The Tang monk was slumped over the tiger's shoulder
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz slʌmpt ˈoʊvər ðə ˈtaɪɡərz ˈʃoʊldər
dialogue.zh: 唐僧瘫软在老虎的肩上

dialogue.en: The great King Yellow Wind was sitting on his throne
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt kɪŋ ˈjɛloʊ wɪnd wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ ɑn hɪz θroʊn
dialogue.zh: 黄风大王正坐在他的宝座上

dialogue.en: The demon king looked surprised and happy
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən kɪŋ lʊkt sərˈpraɪzd ænd ˈhæpi

dialogue.en: I have heard that anyone who eats the Tang monk will live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv hɜrd ðæt ˈɛniˌwʌn hu its ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɪl lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 我听说吃了唐僧肉就能长生不老

dialogue.en: The monkey who caused all that trouble in heaven
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki hu kɑzd ɔl ðæt ˈtrʌbəl ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 就是那个在天宫闹得天翻地覆的猴子

dialogue.en: I distracted them with a fake tiger skin
dialogue.ipa: aɪ dɪˈstræktɪd ðɛm wɪð ə feɪk ˈtaɪɡər skɪn
dialogue.zh: 我用一张假虎皮引开了他们

dialogue.en: The tiger patted his stomach and looked at the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ˈpætɪd hɪz ˈstʌmək ænd lʊkt æt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 老虎拍了拍肚子,看着唐僧

dialogue.en: I'll tell the other demons to start a fire and prepare some spices
dialogue.ipa: aɪl tɛl ði ˈʌðər ˈdimənz tu stɑrt ə ˈfaɪər ænd priˈpɛr sʌm ˈspaɪsəz
dialogue.zh: 我去叫其他小妖生火,准备些香料

dialogue.en: Yellow Wind held up his hand
dialogue.ipa: ˈjɛloʊ wɪnd hɛld ʌp hɪz hænd

dialogue.en: He and that pig might come looking for the monk
dialogue.ipa: hi ænd ðæt pɪɡ maɪt kʌm ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔr ðə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 他和那头猪可能会来找这和尚

dialogue.en: They'll be angry if they find out we ate him
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪl bi ˈæŋɡri ɪf ðeɪ faɪnd aʊt wi eɪt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 要是发现我们吃了他,他们肯定会发怒

dialogue.en: Let's wait until they leave the area
dialogue.ipa: lɛts weɪt ənˈtɪl ðeɪ liv ði ˈɛriə
dialogue.zh: 等他们离开这片地界再说

dialogue.en: Then we'll be able to enjoy our meal
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn wil bi ˈeɪbəl tu ɛnˈʤɔɪ ˈaʊər mil
dialogue.zh: 到时候我们就能安心享用美餐了

dialogue.en: A small demon ran into the throne room
dialogue.ipa: ə smɔl ˈdimən ræn ˈɪntu ðə θroʊn rum

dialogue.en: They said to hand over the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ sɛd tu hænd ˈoʊvər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.zh: 他们就要把整座山都掀了

dialogue.en: I will get rid of them
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl ɡɛt rɪd ʌv ðɛm

dialogue.en: The tiger walked out of the throne room
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər wɔkt aʊt ʌv ðə θroʊn rum

dialogue.en: Outside the cave there was some yelling
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ðə keɪv ðɛr wʌz sʌm ˈjɛlɪŋ

dialogue.en: The small demon ran back in
dialogue.ipa: ðə smɔl ˈdimən ræn bæk ɪn

dialogue.en: The pig killed him with his rake
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ kɪld hɪm wɪð hɪz reɪk
dialogue.zh: 那只猪用耙子打死了他

dialogue.en: He stood up and grabbed a trident
dialogue.ipa: hi stʊd ʌp ænd ɡræbd ə ˈtraɪdənt
dialogue.zh: 他站起身,抓起一把三股叉

dialogue.en: He puffed out his chest and stomped out of the cave
dialogue.ipa: hi pʌft aʊt hɪz ʧɛst ænd stɑmpt aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 他挺起胸膛,大步走出山洞

dialogue.en: So you're the monkey who caused all the trouble in heaven
dialogue.ipa: soʊ jʊr ðə ˈmʌŋki hu kɑzd ɔl ðə ˈtrʌbəl ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 原来你就是那个大闹天宫的猴子

dialogue.en: I didn't know you were so small
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈdɪdənt noʊ ju wɜr soʊ smɔl

dialogue.en: Yellow wind knocked the monkey on the head
dialogue.ipa: ˈjɛloʊ wɪnd nɑkt ðə ˈmʌŋki ɑn ðə hɛd

dialogue.en: Crash the Demon King blocked the bar with his trident
dialogue.ipa: kræʃ ðə ˈdimən kɪŋ blɑkt ðə bɑr wɪð hɪz ˈtraɪdənt
dialogue.zh: 咔嚓一声,魔王用三股叉挡住了铁棒

dialogue.en: The two fought up and down the side of the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu fɔt ʌp ænd daʊn ðə saɪd ʌv ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 两人在山边上下翻飞地打斗

dialogue.en: He grabbed a handful of hair and blew on it
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡræbd ə ˈhændˌfʊl ʌv hɛr ænd blu ɑn ɪt
dialogue.zh: 他抓了一把毛,吹了口气

dialogue.en: Dozens of little Wukongs ran toward the Demon King
dialogue.ipa: ˈdʌzənz ʌv ˈlɪtəl wu kɔŋz ræn təˈwɔrd ðə ˈdimən kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 几十个小孙悟空朝魔王跑去

dialogue.en: I know a magic trick too
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ ə ˈmæʤɪk trɪk tu

dialogue.en: He looked down and blew three times
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt daʊn ænd blu θri taɪmz

dialogue.en: A powerful yellow wind whipped across the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈpaʊərfəl ˈjɛloʊ wɪnd wɪpt əˈkrɔs ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 一阵猛烈的黄风席卷山间

dialogue.en: And all the little Wukongs tumbled down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ænd ɔl ðə ˈlɪtəl Wukongs ˈtʌmbəld daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 和所有的小孙悟空都滚下了山

dialogue.en: They landed at the bottom in a cloud of dust
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈlændɪd æt ðə ˈbɑtəm ɪn ə klaʊd ʌv dʌst
dialogue.zh: 他们落在山底,扬起一片尘土

dialogue.en: The Demon King went back into his cave and slammed the door shut
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən kɪŋ wɛnt bæk ˈɪntu hɪz keɪv ænd slæmd ðə dɔr ʃʌt
dialogue.zh: 魔王回到洞里,砰地关上了门

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他

The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。

examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.

The demons were waiting outside.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。

examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.

The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。

examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。

examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。

examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.

Bajie must carry the bags.

The guards must watch the gate.

The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: I guess we don't have to protect him anymore
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's wait until they leave the area
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Go ahead
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。

examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: I have heard that anyone who eats the Tang monk will live forever
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: They'll be angry if they find out we ate him
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So you're the monkey who caused all the trouble in heaven
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 25 powerful Wind Magic

dialogue.en: Wukong jumped to his feet and called back the little Wukongs
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʤʌmpt tu hɪz fit ænd kɔld bæk ðə ˈlɪtəl Wukongs
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空跳起来,收回了小孙悟空们

dialogue.en: We have to save the Tang monk before the demon king eats him
dialogue.ipa: wi hæv tu seɪv ðə tæŋ mʌŋk bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈdimən kɪŋ its hɪm
dialogue.zh: 我们必须在魔王吃掉唐僧之前救出他

dialogue.en: Wukong tapped his chin and thought
dialogue.ipa: Wukong tæpt hɪz ʧɪn ænd θɔt

dialogue.en: I'll sneak into the cave to see what I can find out
dialogue.ipa: aɪl snik ˈɪntu ðə keɪv tu si wɑt aɪ kæn faɪnd aʊt
dialogue.zh: 我溜进洞里打探一下情况

dialogue.en: The monkey changed into a mosquito
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ʧeɪnʤd ˈɪntu ə məˈskitoʊ

dialogue.en: And squeezed through a crack in the cave's door
dialogue.ipa: ænd skwizd θru ə kræk ɪn ðə keɪvz dɔr
dialogue.zh: 从洞门的缝隙里挤了进去

dialogue.en: The monkey found his master tied up in a dark room
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki faʊnd hɪz ˈmæstər taɪd ʌp ɪn ə dɑrk rum
dialogue.zh: 猴子发现师父被绑在一间暗室里

dialogue.en: He landed on the monk's shoulder
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈlændɪd ɑn ðə mʌŋks ˈʃoʊldər
dialogue.zh: 他落在了和尚的肩膀上

dialogue.en: I turned myself into a mosquito
dialogue.ipa: aɪ tɜrnd ˌmaɪˈsɛlf ˈɪntu ə məˈskitoʊ
dialogue.zh: 我把自己变成了一只蚊子

dialogue.en: First I must defeat the Demon King
dialogue.ipa: fɜrst aɪ mʌst dɪˈfit ðə ˈdimən kɪŋ

dialogue.en: Wukong flew down a tunnel and arrived in the throne room
dialogue.ipa: Wukong flu daʊn ə ˈtʌnəl ænd əˈraɪvd ɪn ðə θroʊn rum
dialogue.zh: 悟空沿着一条隧道飞下去,来到了大殿

dialogue.en: Yellow Wind was talking to some other demons
dialogue.ipa: ˈjɛloʊ wɪnd wʌz ˈtɔkɪŋ tu sʌm ˈʌðər ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 黄风怪正在和其他几个妖怪说话

dialogue.en: Your wind magic blew Sun Wukong away
dialogue.ipa: jʊər wɪnd ˈmæʤɪk blu sʌn Wukong əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 你的风魔法把孙悟空吹跑了

dialogue.en: Only the bodhisattva Lingji can stop my wind magic
dialogue.ipa: ˈoʊnli ðə bɜrd ɪz æt fɑr Lingji kæn stɑp maɪ wɪnd ˈmæʤɪk
dialogue.zh: 只有灵吉菩萨才能克制我的风魔法

dialogue.en: The Bodhisattva Valinji lives on Mount Sumeru
dialogue.ipa: ðə Bodhisattva Valinji lɪvz ɑn maʊnt Sumeru
dialogue.zh: 灵吉菩萨住在须弥山上

dialogue.en: I will ask him for help quickly
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl æsk hɪm fɔr hɛlp ˈkwɪkli

dialogue.en: The monkey leaped onto a cloud and raced through the sky
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lɛpt ˈɑntu ə klaʊd ænd reɪst θru ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 猴子跳上云朵,疾驰过天空

dialogue.en: When he arrived on Mount Sumeru
dialogue.ipa: wɛn hi əˈraɪvd ɑn maʊnt Sumeru

dialogue.en: Lingji came out of his pagoda
dialogue.ipa: Lingji keɪm aʊt ʌv hɪz pəˈɡoʊdə

dialogue.en: It's nice to see you Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ɪts naɪs tu si ju Wukong

dialogue.en: He quickly told the bodhisattva everything that had happened
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkwɪkli toʊld ðə boatasafa ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ðæt hæd ˈhæpənd
dialogue.zh: 他迅速把发生的一切都告诉了林吉菩萨

dialogue.en: I tried to fight the demon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ traɪd tu faɪt ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: But then he used powerful wind magic
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðɛn hi juzd ˈpaʊərfəl wɪnd ˈmæʤɪk
dialogue.zh: 但他随后施展了强大的风系法术

dialogue.en: I know who the great King Yellow Wind is
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ hu ðə ɡreɪt kɪŋ ˈjɛloʊ wɪnd ɪz
dialogue.zh: 我知道黄风大王是何方神圣

dialogue.en: Buddha asked me to keep an eye on him
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə æskt mi tu kip ən aɪ ɑn hɪm

dialogue.en: I told the spirit he could live on that mountain if he behaved
dialogue.ipa: aɪ toʊld ðə ˈspɪrət hi kʊd lɪv ɑn ðæt ˈmaʊntən ɪf hi bɪˈheɪvd
dialogue.zh: 我曾告诫那妖精,若安分守己便可居住在那座山上

dialogue.en: I guess he's not behaving anymore
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɛs hiz nɑt bɪˈheɪvɪŋ ˌɛni ˈmɔr
dialogue.zh: 看来他如今又不守规矩了

dialogue.en: They're going to eat the Tang monk tonight
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu it ðə tæŋ mʌŋk təˈnaɪt
dialogue.zh: 他们今晚就要吃了唐僧

dialogue.en: He picked up a staff and put a small object into his robe
dialogue.ipa: hi pɪkt ʌp ə stæf ænd pʊt ə smɔl ˈɑbʤɛkt ˈɪntu hɪz roʊb
dialogue.zh: 他抄起禅杖,又将一件小物件塞进袍袖

dialogue.en: Soon they were in the sky
dialogue.ipa: sun ðeɪ wɜr ɪn ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 转眼间他们已腾云驾雾

dialogue.en: Looking down at the cave door
dialogue.ipa: ˈlʊkɪŋ daʊn æt ðə keɪv dɔr

dialogue.en: Tell the demon to come out
dialogue.ipa: tɛl ðə ˈdimən tu kʌm aʊt

dialogue.en: Wukong went down to the cave door and took out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wɛnt daʊn tu ðə keɪv dɔr ænd tʊk aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr
dialogue.zh: 悟空降落到洞门前,抽出铁棒

dialogue.en: The door turned into a pile of rubble
dialogue.ipa: ðə dɔr tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə paɪl ʌv ˈrʌbəl
dialogue.zh: 石门顿时化作一堆碎石

dialogue.en: Yellow wind rushed outside and yelled
dialogue.ipa: ˈjɛloʊ wɪnd rʌʃt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd jɛld

dialogue.en: He looked up and saw lingji in the sky
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt ʌp ænd sɔ lingji ɪn ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 他抬头望见云端里的灵吉

dialogue.en: The Bodhisattva was holding a pearl in one hand
dialogue.ipa: ðə Bodhisattva wʌz ˈhoʊldɪŋ ə pɜrl ɪn wʌn hænd
dialogue.zh: 菩萨手中托着一颗宝珠

dialogue.en: Which turned into a golden dragon
dialogue.ipa: wɪʧ tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə ˈɡoʊldən ˈdræɡən

dialogue.en: The dragon threw yellow wind against some rocks
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən θru ˈjɛloʊ wɪnd əˈɡɛnst sʌm rɑks
dialogue.zh: 金龙将黄风怪掼在岩壁上

dialogue.en: There was a puff of smoke
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə pʌf ʌv smoʊk

dialogue.en: And the demon turned into a yellow weasel
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈdimən tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə ˈjɛloʊ ˈwizəl
dialogue.zh: 那妖魔现出黄鼠狼原形

dialogue.en: I'll bring him to Buddha to be punished Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪl brɪŋ hɪm tu ˈbudə tu bi ˈpʌnɪʃt Wukong
dialogue.zh: 悟空,我这就带他去佛祖跟前受罚

dialogue.en: You may go find your companions
dialogue.ipa: ju meɪ ɡoʊ faɪnd jʊər kəm ˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: Wukong ran into the cave and chased away the other demons
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ræn ˈɪntu ðə keɪv ænd ʧeɪst əˈweɪ ði ˈʌðər ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空冲进洞府驱散众小妖

dialogue.en: Then he untied the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ənˈtaɪd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: The two of them went back out and found Bajie sleeping
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ʌv ðɛm wɛnt bæk aʊt ænd faʊnd Bajie ˈslipɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 二人出洞时发现八戒正在酣睡

The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: I tried to fight the demon
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's go
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Get up
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There was a puff of smoke
examples: There is a temple on the hill.

There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.

There is some food in the bag.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: He quickly told the bodhisattva everything that had happened
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.

The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: I told the spirit he could live on that mountain if he behaved
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.

If the road is blocked, we must find another way.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 26 The Monster in the river

dialogue.en: I hope we reach the western paradise soon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp wi riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs sun
dialogue.zh: 希望我们能早日抵达西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: Said the Tang monk one morning
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌn ˈmɔrnɪŋ

dialogue.en: Wukong and his companions were eating breakfast
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz wɜr ˈitɪŋ ˈbrɛkfəst
dialogue.zh: 悟空和同伴们正在吃早饭

dialogue.en: The journey will take many years master
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈʤɜrni wɪl teɪk ˈmɛni jɪrz ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 师父,这趟旅程要花好多年

dialogue.en: And you must face many challenges along the way
dialogue.ipa: ænd ju mʌst feɪs ˈmɛni ˈʧælənʤɪz əˈlɔŋ ðə weɪ
dialogue.zh: 而且一路上你们必须面对许多挑战

dialogue.en: Buddha doesn't give the true scriptures to just anyone
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə ˈdʌzənt ɡɪv ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz tu ʤʌst ˈɛniˌwʌn
dialogue.zh: 佛祖不会把真经随便给人

dialogue.en: You must prove you're worthy by surviving a long and difficult journey
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst pruv jʊr ˈwɜrði baɪ sərˈvaɪvɪŋ ə lɔŋ ænd ˈdɪfəkəlt ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 你们必须通过漫长而艰难的旅程证明自己值得

dialogue.en: I'm tired of this journey he cried
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈtaɪərd ʌv ðɪs ˈʤɜrni hi kraɪd
dialogue.zh: 我厌倦这趟旅程了,他喊道

dialogue.en: And we never have enough food
dialogue.ipa: ænd wi ˈnɛvər hæv ɪˈnʌf fud

dialogue.zh: 我们现在是佛门弟子了

dialogue.en: We should think only about reaching the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wi ʃʊd θɪŋk ˈoʊnli əˈbaʊt ˈriʧɪŋ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 应该只想着抵达西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: The three companions headed down the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri kəm ˈpænjənz ˈhɛdɪd daʊn ðə roʊd

dialogue.zh: 他们很快来到一条河边

dialogue.en: And a purple monster leaped from the waves
dialogue.ipa: ænd ə ˈpɜrpəl ˈmɑnstər lɛpt frʌm ðə weɪvz
dialogue.zh: 一个紫色妖怪从浪中跃出

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar and blocked the monster's spear
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd blɑkt ðə ˈmɑnstərz spɪr
dialogue.zh: 他抽出铁棒,挡住了妖怪的长矛

dialogue.en: The monster dived back into the river
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər daɪvd bæk ˈɪntu ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: Bajie my powers aren't strong underwater
dialogue.ipa: Bajie maɪ ˈpaʊərz ˈɑrənt strɔŋ ˈʌndərˌwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 八戒,我在水下的本事不强

dialogue.en: Dive in and get him to chase you out of the river
dialogue.ipa: daɪv ɪn ænd ɡɛt hɪm tu ʧeɪs ju aʊt ʌv ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 你潜下去,引他追你出河

dialogue.en: Let's wait until he comes all the way up on shore though
dialogue.ipa: lɛts weɪt ənˈtɪl hi kʌmz ɔl ðə weɪ ʌp ɑn ʃɔr ðoʊ
dialogue.zh: 不过我们得等他完全上岸

dialogue.en: Then I'll block his path so he can't go back in the river
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn aɪl blɑk hɪz pæθ soʊ hi kænt ɡoʊ bæk ɪn ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 然后我堵住他的退路,让他回不了河里

dialogue.en: A moment later the pig was back with the monster following
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər ðə pɪɡ wʌz bæk wɪð ðə ˈmɑnstər ˈfɑloʊɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 不一会儿,猪回来了,妖怪跟在后面

dialogue.en: The monkey swung his iron bar and missed
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd mɪst
dialogue.zh: 猴子挥动铁棒,却打空了

dialogue.en: You didn't wait until he was on shore
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈdɪdənt weɪt ənˈtɪl hi wʌz ɑn ʃɔr

dialogue.en: Wukong and BaJie yelled at the river for more than an hour
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd BaJie jɛld æt ðə ˈrɪvər fɔr mɔr ðæn ən ˈaʊər
dialogue.zh: 悟空和八戒对着河大喊了一个多小时

dialogue.en: But the monster did not come back
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈmɑnstər dɪd nɑt kʌm bæk

dialogue.en: We can't cross this river with the monster in there
dialogue.ipa: wi kænt krɔs ðɪs ˈrɪvər wɪð ðə ˈmɑnstər ɪn ðɛr
dialogue.zh: 有这妖怪在,我们过不了这条河

dialogue.en: I'll ask Guan Yin for help
dialogue.ipa: aɪl æsk Guan jɪn fɔr hɛlp

dialogue.en: Wukong went to Mount Potalaka and told Guan Yin about the monster
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wɛnt tu maʊnt Potalaka ænd toʊld Guan jɪn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 悟空去了普陀山,向观音菩萨讲述了妖怪的事

dialogue.en: He's going to help the Tang monk reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: hiz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu hɛlp ðə tæŋ mʌŋk riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 他将帮助唐僧到达西天

dialogue.en: Guanyin went back to the river with Wukong
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin wɛnt bæk tu ðə ˈrɪvər wɪð Wukong
dialogue.zh: 观音菩萨和悟空一起回到了河边

dialogue.en: She called the Tang monk is here
dialogue.ipa: ʃi kɔld ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz hir

dialogue.en: The monster jumped out of the river and bowed
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər ʤʌmpt aʊt ʌv ðə ˈrɪvər ænd baʊd
dialogue.zh: 妖怪跳出河面,躬身行礼

dialogue.en: She waved her hand toward Wukong and BaJie
dialogue.ipa: ʃi weɪvd hɜr hænd təˈwɔrd Wukong ænd BaJie
dialogue.zh: 她朝悟空和八戒挥了挥手

dialogue.en: You will help the Tang monk reach the west
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl hɛlp ðə tæŋ mʌŋk riʧ ðə wɛst
dialogue.zh: 你要帮助唐僧到达西天

dialogue.en: And Wu Jing joined the group
dialogue.ipa: ænd wu ʤɪŋ ʤɔɪnd ðə ɡrup

dialogue.en: He led the horse while the Tang monk rode
dialogue.ipa: hi lɛd ðə hɔrs waɪl ðə tæŋ mʌŋk roʊd

dialogue.en: I was being punished for breaking a glass in heaven
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ˈbiɪŋ ˈpʌnɪʃt fɔr ˈbreɪkɪŋ ə ɡlæs ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 我因为在天庭打碎了一个琉璃盏而受罚

dialogue.en: When we reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wɛn wi riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrə ˌdaɪs

dialogue.en: Bajie and I were punished for crimes in heaven too
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd aɪ wɜr ˈpʌnɪʃt fɔr kraɪmz ɪn ˈhɛvən tu
dialogue.zh: 我和八戒也是因为在天庭犯了错而受罚

dialogue.en: Did you know the horse is really a dragon
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju noʊ ðə hɔrs ɪz ˈrɪli ə ˈdræɡən
dialogue.zh: 你知道这匹马其实是条龙吗

dialogue.en: This horse is too slow to be a dragon
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs hɔrs ɪz tu sloʊ tu bi ə ˈdræɡən
dialogue.zh: 这匹马太慢了,不可能是龙

dialogue.en: The horse shot down the road as fast as lightning
dialogue.ipa: ðə hɔrs ʃɑt daʊn ðə roʊd æz fæst æz ˈlaɪtnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 那匹马如闪电般疾驰而去

dialogue.en: Its reins were ripped from Wu Jing's hand
dialogue.ipa: ɪts reɪnz wɜr rɪpt frʌm wu ʤɪŋz hænd
dialogue.zh: 缰绳从吴京手中被猛地扯走

dialogue.en: The Tang monk was in a dark forest
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz ɪn ə dɑrk ˈfɔrəst
dialogue.zh: 唐僧已身处一片幽暗的森林

dialogue.en: The forest was filled with wolves
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈfɔrəst wʌz fɪld wɪð wʊlvz

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said the Tang monk one morning
examples: The monkey opened the door.

The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。

examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.

grammar.source: Did you know the horse is really a dragon
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形

examples: Wukong will protect the monk.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词

examples: The monk was captured by the demon.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: And you must face many challenges along the way
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.

Bajie must carry the bags.

I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: We should think only about reaching the western paradise
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's wait until he comes all the way up on shore though
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.

Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Stop thinking about food Baji
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When we reach the western paradise
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。

examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.

Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.

She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: Then I'll block his path so he can't go back in the river
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.

grammar.pattern: be + too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形

grammar.pattern: 比较级 + than / 比较级 and 比较级

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 27 The Ginseng Fruit

dialogue.en: The Tang monk trembled with fear
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈtrɛmbəld wɪð fɪr

dialogue.en: And the animals ran back into the forest
dialogue.ipa: ænd ði ˈænəməlz ræn bæk ˈɪntu ðə ˈfɔrəst
dialogue.zh: 野兽们便逃回森林深处

dialogue.en: Sorry for making the horse run master
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɑri fɔr ˈmeɪkɪŋ ðə hɔrs rʌn ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 惊了马儿实在对不住,师父

dialogue.en: I thought it would be funny
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɔt ɪt wʊd bi ˈfʌni

dialogue.en: Those beasts were going to attack me
dialogue.ipa: ðoʊz bists wɜr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ə ˈtæk mi
dialogue.zh: 那些猛兽方才险些要扑上来

dialogue.en: You never have to fear any wild animals
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈnɛvər hæv tu fɪr ˈɛni waɪld ˈænəməlz
ju hæv θri ˈpaʊərfəl kəm ˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 您可有三位本领高强的徒弟

dialogue.en: Bajie and Wujing soon caught up to them
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd Wujing sun kɑt ʌp tu ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净很快追了上来

dialogue.en: They all continued along the road
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ɔl kənˈtɪnjud əˈlɔŋ ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: The Tang monk pointed to a building up ahead
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈpɔɪntɪd tu ə ˈbɪldɪŋ ʌp əˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 唐僧指着前方一座建筑

dialogue.en: That looks like a Daoist abbey
dialogue.ipa: ðæt lʊks laɪk ə ˈdaʊɪst ˈæbi

dialogue.en: I'm sure the abbey's priests will let us rest for a while
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʃʊr ði ˈæbiz prists wɪl lɛt ʌs rɛst fɔr ə waɪl
dialogue.zh: 观里的道长定会容我们歇歇脚

dialogue.en: I'm here with the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪm hir wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: The priest looked at the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist lʊkt æt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Our master told us about you
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər ˈmæstər toʊld ʌs əˈbaʊt ju

dialogue.en: He said you would travel past our abbey someday
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd ju wʊd ˈtrævəl pæst ˈaʊər ˈæbi ˈsʌmˌdeɪ
dialogue.zh: 他说您终有一日会途经本观

dialogue.en: How did he know about me
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɪd hi noʊ əˈbaʊt mi

dialogue.en: Our master is the great immortal
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər ˈmæstər ɪz ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl

dialogue.en: He is very wise and powerful
dialogue.ipa: hi ɪz ˈvɛri waɪz ænd ˈpaʊərfəl
dialogue.zh: 他神通广大,能知过去未来
我可从没听说过这号人物

dialogue.en: Our master is visiting friends in heaven right now
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər ˈmæstər ɪz ˈvɪzətɪŋ frɛndz ɪn ˈhɛvən raɪt naʊ
dialogue.zh: 我们师父此刻正在天界访友

dialogue.en: He wouldn't be able to do that
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈwʊdənt bi ˈeɪbəl tu du ðæt

dialogue.en: I used to live in heaven
dialogue.ipa: aɪ juzd tu lɪv ɪn ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: Please go outside and tend the horse
dialogue.ipa: pliz ɡoʊ ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd tɛnd ðə hɔrs
dialogue.zh: 你且去外面照看马匹吧

dialogue.en: Wujing went out to get the bags
dialogue.ipa: Wujing wɛnt aʊt tu ɡɛt ðə bæɡz

dialogue.en: I want to cook some food for the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt tu kʊk sʌm fud fɔr ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: He pointed to a door in the back of the room
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈpɔɪntɪd tu ə dɔr ɪn ðə bæk ʌv ðə rum

dialogue.en: Bajie went into the kitchen while the Tang monk talked to the priests
dialogue.ipa: Bajie wɛnt ˈɪntu ðə ˈkɪʧən waɪl ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tɔkt tu ðə prists
dialogue.zh: 八戒进了厨房,唐僧则与道士们交谈

dialogue.en: There's a ginseng tree behind the abbey
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz ə ˈʤɪŋksɪŋ tri bɪ ˈhaɪnd ði ˈæbi

dialogue.en: Its fruit takes ten thousand years to become ripe
dialogue.ipa: ɪts frut teɪks tɛn ˈθaʊzənd jɪrz tu bɪˈkʌm raɪp
dialogue.zh: 其果实需万年方能成熟

dialogue.en: One bite of the fruit will make you live forever
dialogue.ipa: wʌn baɪt ʌv ðə frut wɪl meɪk ju lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: A fruit like that is a true treasure
dialogue.ipa: ə frut laɪk ðæt ɪz ə tru ˈtrɛʒər
dialogue.zh: 这般果实确是稀世珍宝

dialogue.en: Will your master be upset if I eat it
dialogue.ipa: wɪl jʊər ˈmæstər bi əpˈsɛt ɪf aɪ it ɪt
dialogue.zh: 若我吃了,尊师不会怪罪吗?

dialogue.en: Our master said we could give you one
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər ˈmæstər sɛd wi kʊd ɡɪv ju wʌn
dialogue.zh: 师父吩咐过可赠您一枚

dialogue.en: We'll go and cut one down
dialogue.ipa: wil ɡoʊ ænd kʌt wʌn daʊn

dialogue.en: A moment later they came back in with a tray
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər ðeɪ keɪm bæk ɪn wɪð ə treɪ
dialogue.zh: 片刻后他们端着托盘回来

dialogue.en: On the tray lay a tiny sleeping baby
dialogue.ipa: ɑn ðə treɪ leɪ ə ˈtaɪni ˈslipɪŋ ˈbeɪbi
dialogue.zh: 托盘上竟躺着个酣睡的婴儿

dialogue.en: It only looks like a baby to you because you're a mortal
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ˈoʊnli lʊks laɪk ə ˈbeɪbi tu ju bɪˈkɔz jʊr ə ˈmɔrtəl
dialogue.zh: 您看着像婴儿只因您是凡胎

dialogue.en: The priests tried to convince him that the fruit wasn't a baby
dialogue.ipa: ðə prists traɪd tu kənˈvɪns hɪm ðæt ðə frut ˈwɑzənt ə ˈbeɪbi
dialogue.zh: 道士们竭力说明这并非真婴儿

dialogue.en: But the monk just shook his head
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə mʌŋk ʤʌst ʃʊk hɪz hɛd

dialogue.en: The priest took the ginseng fruit out of the room and into a hallway
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist tʊk ðə ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ frut aʊt ʌv ðə rum ænd ˈɪntu ə ˈhɔl ˌweɪ
dialogue.zh: 道士把人参果从房间里拿了出来,带到了走廊上。

dialogue.en: It is too delicious and valuable
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ɪz tu dɪˈlɪʃəs ænd ˈvæljəbəl

dialogue.en: The two priests shared the ginseng fruit
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu prists ʃɛrd ðə ˈʤɪn ˌsɛŋ frut
dialogue.zh: 两个道士分食了人参果。

dialogue.en: Bajie was in the kitchen nearby
dialogue.ipa: Bajie wʌz ɪn ðə ˈkɪʧən ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 八戒正在附近的厨房里。

dialogue.en: He had heard everything they'd said
dialogue.ipa: hi hæd hɜrd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ðeɪd sɛd
dialogue.zh: 他听到了他们说的每一句话。
他的肚子咕咕叫了起来。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Cried Wukong
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The monkey was running fast
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: He had heard everything they'd said
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: You have three powerful companions
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Our master is visiting friends in heaven right now
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'm sure the abbey's priests will let us rest for a while
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can't eat that
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Our master said we could give you one
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: We shouldn't waste this fruit
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: You never have to fear any wild animals
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: I want to cook some food for the Tang monk
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: Those beasts were going to attack me
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: The priests tried to convince him that the fruit wasn't a baby
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's eat it ourselves
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Show some respect Wukong
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's a ginseng tree behind the abbey
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 28 Wukong leaves his body

dialogue.en: Bajie looked out the kitchen window
dialogue.ipa: Bajie lʊkt aʊt ðə ˈkɪʧən ˈwɪndoʊ
dialogue.zh: 八戒从厨房窗户往外看。

dialogue.en: Wukong and Wujing were outside talking
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd Wujing wɜr ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ˈtɔkɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空和悟净正在外面说话。

dialogue.en: I want to tell you something
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt tu tɛl ju ˈsʌmθɪŋ

dialogue.en: The two companions came over to the window
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu kəm ˈpænjənz keɪm ˈoʊvər tu ðə ˈwɪndoʊ

dialogue.en: I heard the two priests talking
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hɜrd ðə tu prists ˈtɔkɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 我听到那两个道士说话了。

dialogue.en: There's a ginseng tree at this abbey
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz ə ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ tri æt ðɪs ˈæbi
dialogue.zh: 这座道观里有棵人参树。

dialogue.en: They said its fruit is delicious and valuable
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ sɛd ɪts frut ɪz dɪ ˈlɪʃəs ænd ˈvæljəbəl
dialogue.zh: 他们说它的果子又好吃又珍贵。

dialogue.en: I'll go pick some of that fruit
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ pɪk sʌm ʌv ðæt frut

dialogue.en: The monkey went behind the abbey and found the giant ginseng tree
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki wɛnt bɪˈhaɪnd ði ˈæbi ænd faʊnd ðə ˈʤaɪənt ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ tri
dialogue.zh: 猴子走到道观后面,找到了那棵巨大的人参树。

dialogue.en: The fruit sparkled in the sunlight
dialogue.ipa: ðə frut ˈspɑrkəld ɪn ðə ˈsʌnˌlaɪt
dialogue.zh: 果实在阳光下闪闪发光。

dialogue.en: He plucked three pieces from the tree's branches and went back to the kitchen
dialogue.ipa: hi plʌkt θri ˈpisəz frʌm ðə triz ˈbrænʧəz ænd wɛnt bæk tu ðə ˈkɪʧən
dialogue.zh: 他从树枝上摘了三颗,回到了厨房。

dialogue.en: He handed Bajie and Wujing each a ginseng fruit
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈhændɪd Bajie ænd Wujing iʧ ə ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ frut
dialogue.zh: 他递给八戒和悟净每人一颗人参果。

dialogue.en: Bajie opened his mouth wide and threw his ginseng fruit in
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ˈoʊpənd hɪz maʊθ waɪd ænd θru hɪz ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ frut ɪn
dialogue.zh: 八戒张大嘴巴,把他的人参果扔了进去。

dialogue.en: Bajie you should be ashamed of yourself
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ju ʃʊd bi əˈʃeɪmd ʌv jərˈsɛlf

dialogue.en: I was too hungry to chew
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz tu ˈhʌŋɡri tu ʧu

dialogue.en: And now I wish I had another ginseng fruit
dialogue.ipa: ænd naʊ aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd əˈnʌðər ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ frut
dialogue.zh: 现在我真希望再有一颗人参果

dialogue.en: I didn't even taste that one
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈivɪn teɪst ðæt wʌn
dialogue.zh: 我连那颗的味道都没尝出来

dialogue.en: At that moment the two priests were walking past the kitchen
dialogue.ipa: æt ðæt ˈmoʊmənt ðə tu prists wɜr ˈwɔkɪŋ pæst ðə ˈkɪʧən
dialogue.zh: 这时两位道童正从厨房外走过

dialogue.en: Did you hear what the pig said
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju hir wɑt ðə pɪɡ sɛd
dialogue.zh: 你听见那猪说了什么吗

dialogue.en: I think the Tang monk's companions are eating the ginseng fruit
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɪŋk ðə tæŋ mʌŋks kəmˈpænjənz ɑr ˈitɪŋ ðə ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ frut
dialogue.zh: 我看唐僧的徒弟们在偷吃人参果

dialogue.en: The two priests ran outside and searched the ginseng tree
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu prists ræn ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd sɜrʧt ðə ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ tri
dialogue.zh: 两个道童跑到外面查看人参树

dialogue.en: Three pieces of fruit were gone
dialogue.ipa: θri ˈpisəz ʌv frut wɜr ɡɔn

dialogue.en: This is terrible said one priest
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ˈtɛrəbəl sɛd wʌn prist

dialogue.en: The great immortal will be very upset
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl wɪl bi ˈvɛri əpˈsɛt
dialogue.zh: 大仙知道了定会大发雷霆

dialogue.en: They ran inside and found the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ræn ɪnˈsaɪd ænd faʊnd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 他们跑进屋里找到唐僧

dialogue.en: They stole some of our ginseng fruit
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ stoʊl sʌm ʌv ˈaʊər ˈʤɪn ˌsɛŋ frut
dialogue.zh: 他们偷了我们的人参果

dialogue.en: Just then Wukong Bajie and Wujing walked in
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn Wukong Bajie ænd Wujing wɔkt ɪn
dialogue.zh: 就在这时,悟空、八戒和悟净走了进来

dialogue.en: How dare you call us thieves
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju kɔl ʌs θivz

dialogue.en: You ate ginseng fruit from our master's tree
dialogue.ipa: ju eɪt ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ frut frʌm ˈaʊər ˈmæstərz tri
dialogue.zh: 你们偷吃了我师父树上的人参果

dialogue.en: Wujing wipe some juice from the side of his mouth
dialogue.ipa: Wujing waɪp sʌm ʤus frʌm ðə saɪd ʌv hɪz maʊθ
dialogue.zh: 悟净擦了擦嘴角的汁水

dialogue.en: Wukong laughed harder and pointed at Bajie
dialogue.ipa: Wukong læft ˈhɑrdər ænd ˈpɔɪntɪd æt Bajie
dialogue.zh: 悟空笑得更厉害,指着八戒

dialogue.en: You're the one who stole the fruit
dialogue.ipa: jʊr ðə wʌn hu stoʊl ðə frut

dialogue.en: We invited you into our abbey as guests
dialogue.ipa: wi ɪnˈvaɪtɪd ju ˈɪntu ˈaʊər ˈæbi æz ɡɛsts
dialogue.zh: 我们好心留你们在观中做客

dialogue.en: And you repay us by stealing from us
dialogue.ipa: ænd ju riˈpeɪ ʌs baɪ ˈstilɪŋ frʌm ʌs
dialogue.zh: 你们却偷东西来报答我们

dialogue.en: The two priests yelled and yelled
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu prists jɛld ænd jɛld

dialogue.en: They called Wukong and his companions all sorts of terrible names
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ kɔld Wukong ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ɔl sɔrts ʌv ˈtɛrəbəl neɪmz
dialogue.zh: 他们把悟空师徒骂得狗血淋头

dialogue.en: I don't want to listen to this
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tu ˈlɪsən tu ðɪs

dialogue.en: He recited a quick spell and changed into a spirit form
dialogue.ipa: hi rə ˈsaɪtəd ə kwɪk spɛl ænd ʧeɪnʤd ˈɪntu ə ˈspɪrət fɔrm
dialogue.zh: 他念了个快咒,化作灵体

dialogue.en: He left his body standing in the room
dialogue.ipa: hi lɛft hɪz ˈbɑdi ˈstændɪŋ ɪn ðə rum

dialogue.en: And went out behind the abbey
dialogue.ipa: ænd wɛnt aʊt bɪˈhaɪnd ði ˈæbi

dialogue.en: Wukong stood before the ginseng tree
dialogue.ipa: Wukong stʊd bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈʤɪn ˌsɛŋ tri

dialogue.en: So what if we ate some ginseng fruit
dialogue.ipa: soʊ wɑt ɪf wi eɪt sʌm ˈʤɪn ˌsɛŋ frut
dialogue.zh: 我们吃几个人参果又怎样

dialogue.en: They have no right to call us names
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ hæv noʊ raɪt tu kɔl ʌs neɪmz

dialogue.en: Finally he took out his iron bar and struck the tree
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪnəli hi tʊk aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd strʌk ðə tri
dialogue.zh: 最后他抽出铁棒击向果树

dialogue.en: And the entire tree crashed to the ground
dialogue.ipa: ænd ði ɪnˈtaɪər tri kræʃt tu ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: Wukong put the iron bar back in his ear and returned to his body
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pʊt ði ˈaɪərn bɑr bæk ɪn hɪz ir ænd rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz ˈbɑdi
dialogue.zh: 悟空将铁棒收回耳中,然后重新回到自己的肉体里

dialogue.en: The priests stopped yelling and looked at the monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðə prists stɑpt ˈjɛlɪŋ ænd lʊkt æt ðə ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 道士们止住叫嚷,齐看向猴子

dialogue.en: I think you made a mistake
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɪŋk ju meɪd ə mɪsˈteɪk

dialogue.en: Said the monkey with a big smile
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə ˈmʌŋki wɪð ə bɪɡ smaɪl

dialogue.en: Why don't you go outside to your ginseng tree and count the fruit again
dialogue.ipa: waɪ doʊnt ju ɡoʊ ˈaʊtˈsaɪd tu jʊər ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ tri ænd kaʊnt ðə frut əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 何不去外面人参树下再数数果子

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Bajie looked out the kitchen window
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: At that moment the two priests were walking past the kitchen
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I want to tell you something
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: I think the Tang monk's companions are eating the ginseng fruit
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll go pick some of that fruit
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Bajie you should be ashamed of yourself
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: The fruit must taste wonderful
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: We should eat some
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: I want to tell you something
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Come over here
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's a ginseng tree at this abbey
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: So what if we ate some ginseng fruit
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: What is so funny
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: Why don’t we/you + 动词原形?
grammar.description: 以疑问形式提出建议，意思是“为什么不……呢”。
grammar.source: Why don't you go outside to your ginseng tree and count the fruit again
examples: Why don't we follow the river?
Why don't we ask Wukong?
Why don't you wait here?
Why don't we look inside the cave?
Why don't we take a rest?
Why don't you tell the king?
Why don't we cross the bridge?
Why don't we call the others?
Why don't you bring some food?
Why don't we try another way?

grammar.pattern: be + too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示“太……而不能做某事”。
grammar.source: I was too hungry to chew
examples: The box is too heavy to carry.
The river is too deep to cross.
Bajie is too tired to walk.
The cave is too dark to enter.
The wall is too high to climb.
The road is too narrow to ride on.
It is too late to leave.
The demon is too fast to catch.
The water is too cold to swim in.
The noise is too loud to ignore.

collocations.context: Bajie looked out the kitchen window
Come over here
I want to tell you something
He plucked three pieces from the tree's branches and went back to the kitchen
I was too hungry to chew
Just then Wukong Bajie and Wujing walked in
Wukong laughed harder and pointed at Bajie
I don't want to listen to this
He said to himself
Finally he took out his iron bar and struck the tree
The priests stopped yelling and looked at the monkey
I think you made a mistake

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 29 The Magic Sleeve

dialogue.en: I know we counted the fruit correctly
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ wi ˈkaʊntɪd ðə frut kə ˈrɛktli

dialogue.zh: 不过我们可以再数一遍

dialogue.en: The two angry priests went outside and gasped
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ˈæŋɡri prists wɛnt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd ɡæspt
dialogue.zh: 两个怒气冲冲的道士走到外面,倒抽一口凉气

dialogue.en: The ginseng tree was lying on the ground
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ tri wʌz ˈlaɪɪŋ ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: And all its leaves were gone
dialogue.ipa: ænd ɔl ɪts livz wɜr ɡɔn

dialogue.en: That monkey must have done this
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈmʌŋki mʌst hæv dʌn ðɪs

dialogue.en: But the monkey was inside the whole time
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈmʌŋki wʌz ɪn ˈsaɪd ðə hoʊl taɪm

dialogue.en: How could he have been out here also
dialogue.ipa: haʊ kʊd hi hæv bɪn aʊt hir ˈɔlsoʊ

dialogue.en: He looked at the tree and shook his head
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt ðə tri ænd ʃʊk hɪz hɛd

dialogue.en: This tree was older than heaven and earth
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs tri wʌz ˈoʊldər ðæn ˈhɛvən ænd ɜrθ
dialogue.zh: 此树开天辟地时便已存在

dialogue.en: The monkey must be very powerful
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki mʌst bi ˈvɛri ˈpaʊərfəl

dialogue.en: It would be dangerous for us to fight him
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʊd bi ˈdeɪnʤərəs fɔr ʌs tu faɪt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 我们与他争斗恐有危险

dialogue.en: Inside the abbey the Tang monk was scolding his companions
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈsaɪd ði ˈæbi ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz ˈskoʊldɪŋ hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 观内唐僧正在训斥徒弟

dialogue.en: I am very upset you stole fruit from our hosts
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ˈvɛri əpˈsɛt ju stoʊl frut frʌm ˈaʊər hoʊsts
dialogue.zh: 你们偷主家果子,令我羞愧难当

dialogue.en: None of the ginseng fruit is missing after all
dialogue.ipa: nʌn ʌv ðə ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ frut ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ ˈæftər ɔl

dialogue.en: Wukong gave the priests a suspicious look
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ɡeɪv ðə prists ə səˈspɪʃəs lʊk
dialogue.zh: 悟空怀疑地看了道士们一眼

dialogue.en: You're all welcome to spend the night
dialogue.ipa: jʊr ɔl ˈwɛlkəm tu spɛnd ðə naɪt

dialogue.en: The priest led the group to a small room in the abbey
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist lɛd ðə ɡrup tu ə smɔl rum ɪn ði ˈæbi
dialogue.zh: 道士领着众人来到道观里的一间小屋子

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and his companions went inside
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz wɛnt ɪnˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 唐僧和他的同伴们走了进去

dialogue.en: Wukong noticed that the priest didn't come in
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˈnoʊtəst ðæt ðə prist ˈdɪdənt kʌm ɪn
dialogue.zh: 悟空注意到道士没有跟进来

dialogue.en: He was about to say something when one priest slammed the door shut
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz əˈbaʊt tu seɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋ wɛn wʌn prist slæmd ðə dɔr ʃʌt
dialogue.zh: 他正要开口,一个道士猛地关上了门

dialogue.en: What kind of host are you
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kaɪnd ʌv hoʊst ɑr ju
dialogue.zh: 你们这算什么待客之道

dialogue.en: Bajie fell to the floor rubbing his foot
dialogue.ipa: Bajie fɛl tu ðə flɔr ˈrʌbɪŋ hɪz fʊt

dialogue.en: Why did they lock us in here
dialogue.ipa: waɪ dɪd ðeɪ lɑk ʌs ɪn hir
dialogue.zh: 他们为什么要把我们锁在这里

dialogue.en: I knocked down their ginseng tree
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nɑkt daʊn ðɛr ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ tri
dialogue.zh: 我推倒了他们的人参果树

dialogue.en: They're probably planning to keep us locked in here until their master comes back
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ˈprɑbəbli ˈplænɪŋ tu kip ʌs lɑkt ɪn hir ənˈtɪl ðɛr ˈmæstər kʌmz bæk
dialogue.zh: 他们大概打算一直把我们关到师父回来

dialogue.en: The Tang monk glared at his companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɡlɛrd æt hɪz kəmˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: How will I ever reach the western Paradise with companions like you
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl aɪ ˈɛvər riʧ ðə westernparadise wɪð kəmˈpænjənz laɪk ju
dialogue.zh: 带着你们这样的同伴,我何时才能抵达西天

dialogue.en: Wu Jing looked at the ground
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ lʊkt æt ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: I'll get us out of here
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡɛt ʌs aʊt ʌv hir

dialogue.en: When the priests go to sleep
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðə prists ɡoʊ tu slip

dialogue.en: I'll use my lock picking magic
dialogue.ipa: aɪl juz maɪ lɑk ˈpɪkɪŋ ˈmæʤɪk

dialogue.en: Then we'll be on our way
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn wil bi ɑn ˈaʊər weɪ

dialogue.en: The four travelers escaped that night and headed west
dialogue.ipa: ðə fɔr ˈtrævələrz ɪˈskeɪpt ðæt naɪt ænd ˈhɛdɪd wɛst
dialogue.zh: 师徒四人当夜逃脱,继续西行

dialogue.en: The next day they saw an old man on the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst deɪ ðeɪ sɔ ən oʊld mæn ɑn ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 第二天他们在路上遇见一位老者

dialogue.en: Did you come from the abbey
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju kʌm frʌm ði ˈæbi

dialogue.en: The Tang monk glanced nervously at his companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɡlænst ˈnɜrvəsli æt hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 唐僧紧张地瞥了一眼他的同伴们

dialogue.en: You're not going any farther until you give me a new one
dialogue.ipa: jʊr nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈɛni ˈfɑrðər ənˈtɪl ju ɡɪv mi ə nu wʌn
dialogue.zh: 不赔我一棵新的,你们休想再往前走

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Bajie and Wu Jing raised their weapons
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ reɪzd ðɛr ˈwɛpənz
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净也举起了武器

dialogue.en: The great immortal rose into the air and landed on a cloud
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl roʊz ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd ˈlændɪd ɑn ə klaʊd
dialogue.zh: 大仙腾空而起,落在一朵云上

dialogue.en: You think you're special just because you can fly
dialogue.ipa: ju θɪŋk jʊr ˈspɛʃəl ʤʌst bɪˈkɔz ju kæn flaɪ
dialogue.zh: 你以为会飞就了不起了

dialogue.en: The great immortal raised an eyebrow
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl reɪzd ən ˈaɪˌbraʊ

dialogue.en: It's called magic of the cosmos in the sleeve
dialogue.ipa: ɪts kɔld ˈmæʤɪk ʌv ðə ˈkɑzmoʊs ɪn ðə sliv

dialogue.en: The great immortal waved his arm
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl weɪvd hɪz ɑrm

dialogue.en: His sleeve swooped down toward Wukong and his companions
dialogue.ipa: hɪz sliv swupt daʊn təˈwɔrd wu kɔŋ ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 他的袖子朝悟空和他的同伴们罩了下来

dialogue.en: Instantly they were all swept up in it
dialogue.ipa: ˈɪnstəntli ðeɪ wɜr ɔl swɛpt ʌp ɪn ɪt
dialogue.zh: 瞬间他们全被卷了进去

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said one priest
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The ginseng tree was lying on the ground
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I know we counted the fruit correctly
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: None of the ginseng fruit is missing after all
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: That monkey must have done this
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: But we'll count again anyway
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You think you're special just because you can fly
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: How could he have been out here also
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: That monkey must have done this
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's wait for our master
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Follow us
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: He was about to say something when one priest slammed the door shut
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: You think you're special just because you can fly
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: I thought so
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: But he didn't know why
examples: Do you know where the road ends?

Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: 比较级 + than / 比较级 and 比较级
grammar.description: 比较两者差异，或表达程度不断变化。
grammar.source: This tree was older than heaven and earth
examples: Wukong is stronger than the demon.
This road is shorter than the other one.
The river is wider than before.
Bajie is hungrier than Wujing.
The mountain is higher than the hill.
The cave became darker and darker.
They walked faster and faster.
The sound grew louder and louder.
This plan is better than the first one.
The journey became more and more difficult.
