titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 30 the Frying Pan

dialogue.en: Wukong and his companions were tied up in a room in the abbey
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz wɜr taɪd ʌp ɪn ə rum ɪn ði ˈæbi
dialogue.zh: 悟空和他的同伴们被绑在道观的一个房间里

dialogue.en: I will deal with you all in the morning
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl dil wɪð ju ɔl ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ

dialogue.en: He turned around and left the room
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd əˈraʊnd ænd lɛft ðə rum

dialogue.en: The Tang monk began to cry
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk bɪˈɡæn tu kraɪ

dialogue.en: It's bad enough that there are dangers along the journey he said
dialogue.ipa: ɪts bæd ɪˈnʌf ðæt ðɛr ɑr ˈdeɪnʤərz əˈlɔŋ ðə ˈʤɜrni hi sɛd
dialogue.zh: 他说:这一路上危险重重已经够糟了

dialogue.en: But my own companions are causing trouble for me
dialogue.ipa: bʌt maɪ oʊn kəmˈpænjənz ɑr ˈkɑzɪŋ ˈtrʌbəl fɔr mi
dialogue.zh: 可我自己的徒弟还给我惹麻烦

dialogue.en: Master this is all Wukong's fault
dialogue.ipa: ˈmæstər ðɪs ɪz ɔl wu kɔŋz fɔlt

dialogue.en: And he knocked down the tree
dialogue.ipa: ænd hi nɑkt daʊn ðə tri

dialogue.en: Stealing the fruit was your idea
dialogue.ipa: ˈstilɪŋ ðə frut wʌz jʊər aɪˈdiə

dialogue.en: I can't help it if I was hungry
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt hɛlp ɪt ɪf aɪ wʌz ˈhʌŋɡri

dialogue.en: You should have refused to steal it
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd hæv rəˈfjuzd tu stil ɪt
dialogue.zh: 你当时就不该答应去偷

dialogue.en: Let's stop arguing and figure out how to escape
dialogue.ipa: lɛts stɑp ˈɑrɡjuɪŋ ænd ˈfɪɡjər aʊt haʊ tu ɪˈskeɪp
dialogue.zh: 别吵了,想想怎么逃出去吧

dialogue.en: But we must wait until the great immortal is asleep
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wi mʌst weɪt ənˈtɪl ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl ɪz əˈslip
dialogue.zh: 但我们必须等到大仙睡着

dialogue.en: Late that night Wukong recited a spell
dialogue.ipa: leɪt ðæt naɪt wu kæŋ rə ˈsaɪtəd ə spɛl

dialogue.en: He shrank to the size of a pea
dialogue.ipa: hi ʃræŋk tu ðə saɪz ʌv ə pi
dialogue.zh: 他缩成了一颗豌豆大小

dialogue.en: And then slipped out from his ropes
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn slɪpt aʊt frʌm hɪz roʊps
dialogue.zh: 然后他从绳索中滑脱出来
他迅速解开了朋友们的束缚

dialogue.en: The group tiptoed through the dark and silent abbey
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup ˈtɪpˌtoʊd θru ðə dɑrk ænd ˈsaɪlənt ˈæbi
dialogue.zh: 一行人蹑手蹑脚地穿过黑暗寂静的道观

dialogue.en: The sun was beginning to rise
dialogue.ipa: ðə sʌn wʌz bɪˈɡɪnɪŋ tu raɪz

dialogue.en: As they walked down the road
dialogue.ipa: æz ðeɪ wɔkt daʊn ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 当他们沿着大路前行时

dialogue.en: I hope you all Learned a lesson from this
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp ju ɔl lɜrnd ə ˈlɛsən frʌm ðɪs
dialogue.zh: 希望你们都从这件事中吸取了教训
突然一个声音轰鸣般响起
你们逃不出我的手掌心

dialogue.en: The great immortal flew toward them
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl flu təˈwɔrd ðɛm

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar and swung
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd swʌŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空抽出铁棒横扫过去

dialogue.en: The great immortal moved out of the way
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl muvd aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ

dialogue.en: And Wu Jing stabbed with his spear
dialogue.ipa: ænd wu ʤɪŋ stæbd wɪð hɪz spɪr

dialogue.en: But the great immortal was fast
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl wʌz fæst

dialogue.en: And his sleeve shot toward the group
dialogue.ipa: ænd hɪz sliv ʃɑt təˈwɔrd ðə ɡrup

dialogue.en: Once again the travelers were swept up
dialogue.ipa: wʌns əˈɡɛn ðə ˈtrævələrz wɜr swɛpt ʌp
dialogue.zh: 取经人再次被席卷而起

dialogue.en: The Great Immortal told his priests to start a fire
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl toʊld hɪz prists tu stɑrt ə ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 大仙命令道士们生起火来

dialogue.en: Bring out a large frying pan
dialogue.ipa: brɪŋ aʊt ə lɑrʤ ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn

dialogue.en: We're going to fry these criminals
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu fraɪ ðiz ˈkrɪmənəlz

dialogue.en: The priests carried an enormous frying pan into the room
dialogue.ipa: ðə prists ˈkærid ən ɪˈnɔrməs ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn ˈɪntu ðə rum
dialogue.zh: 道士们抬来一口巨大的油锅

dialogue.en: They placed it over the fire
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ pleɪst ɪt ˈoʊvər ðə ˈfaɪər

dialogue.en: I can sit on that frying pan all day and not get hurt at all
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn sɪt ɑn ðæt ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn ɔl deɪ ænd nɑt ɡɛt hɜrt æt ɔl
dialogue.zh: 我在那油锅里坐一整天也不会受伤

dialogue.en: But the Tang monk is mortal
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz ˈmɔrtəl

dialogue.en: He'll be burned to a crisp
dialogue.ipa: hil bi bɜrnd tu ə krɪsp

dialogue.en: He spotted a statue of a lion nearby
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈspɑtɪd ə ˈstæˌʧu ʌv ə ˈlaɪən ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 他瞥见附近有尊石狮雕像

dialogue.en: The monkey recited a quick spell
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki rəˈsaɪtəd ə kwɪk spɛl

dialogue.en: And made the statue look exactly like himself
dialogue.ipa: ænd meɪd ðə ˈstæ ˌʧu lʊk ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk hɪmˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 让雕像变得和自己一模一样

dialogue.en: Throw Sun Wukong into the frying pan
dialogue.ipa: θroʊ sʌn Wukong ˈɪntu ðə ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn

dialogue.en: The two priests tried to lift it
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu prists traɪd tu lɪft ɪt

dialogue.en: This monkey is much heavier than he looks
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ˈmʌŋki ɪz mʌʧ ˈhɛviər ðæn hi lʊks
dialogue.zh: 这猴子比看起来重多了
另一个道士也气喘吁吁地附和

dialogue.en: They finally dragged the statue to the frying pan and dropped it in
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈfaɪnəli dræɡd ðə ˈstæˌʧu tu ðə ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn ænd drɑpt ɪt ɪn
dialogue.zh: 他们终于把雕像拖到油锅边扔了进去

dialogue.en: The frying pan broke in half
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn broʊk ɪn hæf

dialogue.en: He made that statue look like himself
dialogue.ipa: hi meɪd ðæt ˈstæˌʧu lʊk laɪk hɪmˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 他把那尊雕像做得像他自己

dialogue.en: Do you really think he left us
dialogue.ipa: du ju ˈrɪli θɪŋk hi lɛft ʌs
dialogue.zh: 你真以为他丢下我们了吗

dialogue.en: He probably returned to the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈprɑbəbli rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: I'm sure he's playing in a field of flowers right now
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʃʊr hiz ˈpleɪɪŋ ɪn ə fild ʌv ˈflaʊərz raɪt naʊ
dialogue.zh: 我敢肯定他这会儿正在花丛里玩耍呢

dialogue.en: I don't think he would leave us
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt θɪŋk hi wʊd liv ʌs
dialogue.zh: 我觉得他不会丢下我们

dialogue.en: The Tang monk started to cry
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈstɑrtɪd tu kraɪ

dialogue.en: The great immortal shook with anger
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl ʃʊk wɪð ˈæŋɡər

dialogue.en: It's bad enough that sun Wukong wanted to escape
dialogue.ipa: ɪts bæd ɪˈnʌf ðæt sʌn wu kɔŋ ˈwɔntɪd tu ɪˈskeɪp
dialogue.zh: 那孙猴子想逃跑已经够糟了

dialogue.en: But did he really have to break my frying pan too
dialogue.ipa: bʌt dɪd hi ˈrɪli hæv tu breɪk maɪ ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn tu
dialogue.zh: 但他非得把我的锅也砸坏吗
我们要把他的同伴炸了

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But we must wait until the great immortal is asleep
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: You should have refused to steal it
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: But did he really have to break my frying pan too
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: It's bad enough that sun Wukong wanted to escape
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: The two priests tried to lift it
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's stop arguing and figure out how to escape
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Come down master
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: It's bad enough that there are dangers along the journey he said
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 31 Guanyin's Vase

dialogue.en: The two priests pushed the Tang monk toward the enormous frying pan
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu prists pʊʃt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk təˈwɔrd ði ɪˈnɔrməs ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn
dialogue.zh: 两个道士把唐僧推向那口巨大的油锅

dialogue.en: Wukong appeared and landed on the floor
dialogue.ipa: Wukong əˈpɪrd ænd ˈlændɪd ɑn ðə flɔr

dialogue.en: I was here the whole time
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz hir ðə hoʊl taɪm

dialogue.en: He gave Bojie a nasty look
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡeɪv Bojie ə ˈnæsti lʊk
dialogue.zh: 他恶狠狠地瞪了八戒一眼
我没有丢下你们自己逃跑

dialogue.en: Wukong turned to the great immortal
dialogue.ipa: Wukong tɜrnd tu ðə ɡreɪt ɪ ˈmɔrtəl

dialogue.en: Please don't harm the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: pliz doʊnt hɑrm ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: I will fix your ginseng tree
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl fɪks jʊər ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ tri

dialogue.en: But I need to get help
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ nid tu ɡɛt hɛlp

dialogue.en: He doesn't know how to fix the tree
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈdʌzənt noʊ haʊ tu fɪks ðə tri
dialogue.zh: 他根本不知道怎么修复那棵树

dialogue.en: The great immortal thought for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl θɔt fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt

dialogue.en: I will give you until the end of the day to fix my ginseng tree
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl ɡɪv ju ənˈtɪl ði ɛnd ʌv ðə deɪ tu fɪks maɪ ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ tri
dialogue.zh: 我给你一天的时间来修复我的人参树

dialogue.en: The Tang monk goes into the frying pan
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɡoʊz ˈɪntu ðə ˈfraɪɪŋ pæn

dialogue.en: I'll be back as soon as I can
dialogue.ipa: aɪl bi bæk æz sun æz aɪ kæn

dialogue.en: Wukong shot out of the abbey and was gone
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʃɑt aʊt ʌv ði ˈæbi ænd wʌz ɡɔn
dialogue.zh: 悟空冲出寺院,消失不见

dialogue.en: Wukong soared through the air until he came to Mount Putolaka
dialogue.ipa: Wukong sɔrd θru ði ɛr ənˈtɪl hi keɪm tu maʊnt Putolaka
dialogue.zh: 悟空腾云驾雾,直到抵达普陀落迦山

dialogue.en: Guanyin was meditating in her pagoda
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin wʌz ˈmɛdəˌteɪtɪŋ ɪn hɜr pəˈɡoʊdə
dialogue.zh: 观音正在她的宝塔中打坐

dialogue.en: A Daoist named the Great Immortal is going to fry the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈdaʊɪst neɪmd ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu fraɪ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 一个名叫大仙的道士要把唐僧给炸了

dialogue.en: I have until the end of the day to fix his ginseng tree
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv ən ˈtɪl ði ɛnd ʌv ðə deɪ tu fɪks hɪz ˈʤɪŋksɪŋ tri
dialogue.zh: 我必须在今天结束前修好他的人参果树

dialogue.en: She gave the monkey a suspicious look
dialogue.ipa: ʃi ɡeɪv ðə ˈmʌŋki ə sə ˈspɪʃəs lʊk
dialogue.zh: 她怀疑地看了猴子一眼

dialogue.en: That was a terrible thing to do Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðæt wʌz ə ˈtɛrəbəl θɪŋ tu du Wukong
dialogue.zh: 悟空,你做了件糟糕的事

dialogue.en: The Great Immortal's ginseng tree is older than heaven and earth
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəlz ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ tri ɪz ˈoʊldər ðæn ˈhɛvən ænd ɜrθ
dialogue.zh: 大仙的人参树比天地还要古老

dialogue.en: You must learn to control your anger
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst lɜrn tu kənˈtroʊl jʊər ˈæŋɡər
dialogue.zh: 你必须学会控制自己的怒气

dialogue.en: She went to a shelf and grabbed a vase
dialogue.ipa: ʃi wɛnt tu ə ʃɛlf ænd ɡræbd ə veɪs
dialogue.zh: 她走到架子前,拿起一个花瓶

dialogue.en: This vase is filled with magic dew
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs veɪs ɪz fɪld wɪð ˈmæʤɪk du
dialogue.zh: 这个花瓶里装满了神奇的露水

dialogue.en: Wukong and Guanyin arrived at the abbey
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd Guanyin əˈraɪvd æt ði ˈæbi
dialogue.zh: 悟空和观音抵达了寺院

dialogue.en: And Wu Jing to stand the tree back up
dialogue.ipa: ænd wu ʤɪŋ tu stænd ðə tri bæk ʌp
dialogue.zh: 和悟净把树重新立起来

dialogue.en: Guanyin rose into the air and poured the dew over the ginseng tree
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin roʊz ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd pɔrd ðə du ˈoʊvər ðə ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ tri
dialogue.zh: 观音升到空中,将露水洒向人参树

dialogue.en: As the dew droplets rolled over the branches
dialogue.ipa: æz ðə du ˈdrɑpləts roʊld ˈoʊvər ðə ˈbrænʧəz

dialogue.en: And new leaves and fruit grew
dialogue.ipa: ænd nu livz ænd frut ɡru
dialogue.zh: 长出了新的叶子和果实

dialogue.en: Soon the tree looked just as it had the day before
dialogue.ipa: sun ðə tri lʊkt ʤʌst æz ɪt hæd ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔr
dialogue.zh: 很快,这棵树看起来就和前一天一模一样

dialogue.en: The great immortal decided to host a feast
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl ˌdɪ ˈsaɪdɪd tu hoʊst ə fist
dialogue.zh: 大仙决定举办一场盛宴

dialogue.en: I would like to share some ginseng fruit with everyone here
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʊd laɪk tu ʃɛr sʌm ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ frut wɪð ˈɛvriˌwʌn hir
dialogue.zh: 我想和大家分享一些人参果。

dialogue.en: Everyone went back into the abbey
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn wɛnt bæk ˈɪntu ði ˈæbi

dialogue.en: The two priests brought in trays of ginseng fruits
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu prists brɔt ɪn treɪz ʌv ˈʤɪnˌsɛŋ fruts
dialogue.zh: 两位道士端来了几盘人参果。

dialogue.en: This fruit tastes wonderful if you eat it slowly
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs frut teɪsts ˈwʌndərfəl ɪf ju it ɪt ˈsloʊli
dialogue.zh: 这果子慢慢吃,味道可好了。

dialogue.en: Sorry I didn't believe you earlier
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɑri aɪ ˈdɪdənt bɪˈliv ju ˈɜrliər
dialogue.zh: 抱歉,我之前不该怀疑你。

dialogue.en: He took a bite of his fruit
dialogue.ipa: hi tʊk ə baɪt ʌv hɪz frut
dialogue.zh: 他咬了一口自己的果子。

dialogue.en: The Tang monk looked nervously at his fruit
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk lʊkt ˈnɜrvəsli æt hɪz frut
dialogue.zh: 唐僧紧张地看着自己的果子。

dialogue.en: The monk took a bite and smiled
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk tʊk ə baɪt ænd smaɪld
dialogue.zh: 唐僧咬了一口,露出了笑容。

dialogue.en: He looked at the jinxing fruit again
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt ðə ˈʤɪŋksɪŋ frut ə ˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: It doesn't look like a baby anymore
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ˈdʌzənt lʊk laɪk ə ˈbeɪbi ˌɛni ˈmɔr
dialogue.zh: 它看起来不再像个婴儿了。

dialogue.en: The next morning the travelers headed west along the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðə ˈtrævələrz ˈhɛdɪd wɛst əˈlɔŋ ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 第二天一早,师徒们沿着大路继续西行。

dialogue.en: Weeks went by as they continued their journey
dialogue.ipa: wiks wɛnt baɪ æz ðeɪ kənˈtɪnjud ðɛr ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 几周时间在旅途中悄然流逝。

dialogue.en: They walked through rain and sunshine
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɔkt θru reɪn ænd ˈsʌnˌʃaɪn

dialogue.en: An evil spirit named Lady Whitebone
dialogue.ipa: ən ˈivəl ˈspɪrət neɪmd ˈleɪdi Whitebone
dialogue.zh: 一个名叫白骨夫人的妖怪。

dialogue.en: Sat by the side of the road
dialogue.ipa: sæt baɪ ðə saɪd ʌv ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: She had been waiting by the road for years
dialogue.ipa: ʃi hæd bɪn ˈweɪtɪŋ baɪ ðə roʊd fɔr jɪrz

dialogue.en: On this day she sniffed the air and smiled
dialogue.ipa: ɑn ðɪs deɪ ʃi snɪft ði ɛr ænd smaɪld
dialogue.zh: 这天,她嗅了嗅空气,露出了微笑。

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is finally approaching
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz ˈfaɪnəli ə ˈproʊʧɪŋ

dialogue.zh: 这样我就能长生不老了。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The two priests pushed the Tang monk toward the enormous frying pan
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Guanyin was meditating in her pagoda
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: She had been waiting by the road for years
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: But I need to get help
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: A Daoist named the Great Immortal is going to fry the Tang monk
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I will fix your ginseng tree
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: This vase is filled with magic dew
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: It can bring spirit plants
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You must learn to control your anger
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: A Daoist named the Great Immortal is going to fry the Tang monk
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Stop
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That was a terrible thing to do Wukong
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you can't
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: A short while later
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: He doesn't know how to fix the tree
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: 比较级 + than / 比较级 and 比较级
grammar.description: 比较两者差异，或表达程度不断变化。
grammar.source: The Great Immortal's ginseng tree is older than heaven and earth
examples: Wukong is stronger than the demon.
This road is shorter than the other one.
The river is wider than before.
Bajie is hungrier than Wujing.
The mountain is higher than the hill.
The cave became darker and darker.
They walked faster and faster.
The sound grew louder and louder.
This plan is better than the first one.
The journey became more and more difficult.

You came back
I didn't escape without you
Wukong turned to the great immortal
The great immortal thought for a moment
I'll be back as soon as I can
Bajie shook his head
You must learn to control your anger
The Bodhisattva stood up
The great immortal decided to host a feast
Everyone went back into the abbey
He looked at Wukong
It doesn't look like a baby anymore
The next morning the travelers headed west along the road
They walked through rain and sunshine

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 32 Lady Whitebone

dialogue.en: Lady Whitebones sat by the road and sniffed the air again
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪdi Whitebones sæt baɪ ðə roʊd ænd snɪft ði ɛr əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 白骨夫人坐在路边,又嗅了嗅空气。

dialogue.en: The Tang monk has some powerful companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk hæz sʌm ˈpaʊərfəl kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 唐僧身边有几个厉害的同伴。

dialogue.en: Wukong saw a Peach Orchard thousands of miles away
dialogue.ipa: Wukong sɔ ə piʧ ˈɔrʧərd ˈθaʊzəndz ʌv maɪlz əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 悟空看到了千里之外的一片桃园。

dialogue.en: I'll be back in a minute
dialogue.ipa: aɪl bi bæk ɪn ə ˈmɪnət

dialogue.en: Soon after the monkey had left
dialogue.ipa: sun ˈæftər ðə ˈmʌŋki hæd lɛft

dialogue.en: A young woman came down the road
dialogue.ipa: ə jʌŋ ˈwʊmən keɪm daʊn ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 一位年轻女子沿着大路走来。

dialogue.en: He dropped all the peaches and pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi drɑpt ɔl ðə ˈpiʧəz ænd pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr
dialogue.zh: 他扔下所有桃子,抽出铁棒

dialogue.en: He struck at the young woman
dialogue.ipa: hi strʌk æt ðə jʌŋ ˈwʊmən

dialogue.en: You couldn't see that the woman was really a spirit who wanted to harm you
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈkʊdənt si ðæt ðə ˈwʊmən wʌz ˈrɪli ə ˈspɪrət hu ˈwɔntɪd tu hɑrm ju
dialogue.zh: 你看不出那女子实为想害你的妖精

dialogue.en: See he held up the bowl
dialogue.ipa: si hi hɛld ʌp ðə boʊl

dialogue.en: He used magic to turn the food into worms
dialogue.ipa: hi juzd ˈmæʤɪk tu tɜrn ðə fud ˈɪntu wɜrmz
dialogue.zh: 他施法把食物变成了虫子

dialogue.en: The pig looked at the ground where the woman had been and shook his head
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ lʊkt æt ðə ɡraʊnd wɛr ðə ˈwʊmən hæd bɪn ænd ʃʊk hɪz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 猪八戒看着女子刚才站的地方,摇了摇头

dialogue.en: There isn't anything left of her
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ˈɪzənt ˈɛniˌθɪŋ lɛft ʌv hɜr

dialogue.en: The monkey rolled on the ground as the Tang monk recited the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki roʊld ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd æz ðə tæŋ mʌŋk rəˈsaɪtəd ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl
dialogue.zh: 唐僧念起紧箍咒,猴子在地上打滚

dialogue.en: I didn't know you could do that master
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈdɪdənt noʊ ju kʊd du ðæt ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 师父,我不知道您还有这本事

dialogue.en: Just then an old woman came down the road
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn ən oʊld ˈwʊmən keɪm daʊn ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 就在这时,一位老妇人沿路走来

dialogue.en: The monk stopped reciting the spell
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk stɑpt riˈsaɪtɪŋ ðə spɛl

dialogue.en: She was bringing food to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ʃi wʌz ˈbrɪŋɪŋ fud tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: You should ask this monkey what happened to your daughter
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd æsk ðɪs ˈmʌŋki wɑt ˈhæpənd tu jʊər ˈdɔtər
dialogue.zh: 你该问问这猴子,你女儿怎么了

dialogue.en: Wukong looked at the old woman closely for a moment
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lʊkt æt ði oʊld ˈwʊmən ˈkloʊsli fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt
dialogue.zh: 悟空仔细打量了老妇人片刻

dialogue.en: Then he took out his iron bar and swung
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi tʊk aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd swʌŋ

dialogue.zh: 他又杀了一个无辜的人

dialogue.en: The Tang monk recited the spell again
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk rəˈsaɪtəd ðə spɛl əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: Wukong fell to the ground in pain
dialogue.ipa: Wukong fɛl tu ðə ɡraʊnd ɪn peɪn

dialogue.en: I'll recite the spell until your head explodes
dialogue.ipa: aɪl rəˈsaɪt ðə spɛl ən ˈtɪl jʊər hɛd ɪkˈsploʊdz
dialogue.zh: 我就念咒念到你脑袋爆炸

dialogue.en: Just then an old man came down the road
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn ən oʊld mæn keɪm daʊn ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 就在这时,一位老人沿路走来

dialogue.en: I'm looking for my wife and daughter
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔr maɪ waɪf ænd ˈdɔtər
dialogue.zh: 我在找我的妻子和女儿

dialogue.en: That's the evil spirit woman again
dialogue.ipa: ðæts ði ˈivəl ˈspɪrət ˈwʊmən ə ˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: But if I do hurt her
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ɪf aɪ du hɜrt hɜr

dialogue.en: The monk will make my head explode
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk wɪl meɪk maɪ hɛd ɪkˈsploʊd
dialogue.zh: 师父会让我的脑袋爆炸

dialogue.en: I must protect the Tang monk no matter what
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst prəˈtɛkt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk noʊ ˈmætər wɑt
dialogue.zh: 无论如何我必须保护唐僧

dialogue.en: Wukong whipped out his iron bar and swung
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wɪpt aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd swʌŋ

dialogue.en: There was a puff of smoke
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə pʌf ʌv smoʊk

dialogue.en: A skeleton lay on the ground
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈskɛlətən leɪ ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: See she was an evil skeleton spirit
dialogue.ipa: si ʃi wʌz ən ˈivəl ˈskɛlətən ˈspɪrət
dialogue.zh: 看,她是个邪恶的骷髅精

dialogue.en: I want you to leave Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt ju tu liv Wukong

dialogue.en: Now leave or I'll recite the spell again
dialogue.ipa: naʊ liv ɔr aɪl rəˈsaɪt ðə spɛl əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 现在离开,否则我又要念咒了

dialogue.en: If you really want me to leave I'll leave
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju ˈrɪli wɑnt mi tu liv aɪl liv
dialogue.zh: 如果你真的要我走,我就走

dialogue.en: But don't come looking for me when you need help
dialogue.ipa: bʌt doʊnt kʌm ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔr mi wɛn ju nid hɛlp
dialogue.zh: 但需要帮助时别来找我

dialogue.en: He leaped into the air and vanished
dialogue.ipa: hi lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd ˈvænɪʃt
dialogue.zh: 他纵身一跃,消失在空中

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Lady Whitebones sat by the road and sniffed the air again
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Wukong was flying fast
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: Soon after the monkey had left
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I need a disguise
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll be back in a minute
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Which was filled with worms
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: You couldn't see that the woman was really a spirit who wanted to harm you
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I must protect the Tang monk no matter what
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: You should ask this monkey what happened to your daughter
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: You couldn't see that the woman was really a spirit who wanted to harm you
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's stop for lunch
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There was a puff of smoke
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: You couldn't see that the woman was really a spirit who wanted to harm you
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you do
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When the smoke cleared
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: Why are you so cruel
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 33 Bajie takes a nap

dialogue.en: After the Tang monk sent Wukong away
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk sɛnt wu kɔŋ əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: He and the others continued west
dialogue.ipa: hi ænd ði ˈʌðərz kənˈtɪnjud wɛst

dialogue.en: Later that day they stopped to rest
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪtər ðæt deɪ ðeɪ stɑpt tu rɛst
dialogue.zh: 那天晚些时候,他们停下来休息

dialogue.en: Bajie sat down in the grass next to the road
dialogue.ipa: Bajie sæt daʊn ɪn ðə ɡræs nɛkst tu ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 八戒在路边的草地上坐下

dialogue.en: He let out a great big yawn
dialogue.ipa: hi lɛt aʊt ə ɡreɪt bɪɡ jɔn

dialogue.en: Why don't you go find us some food
dialogue.ipa: waɪ doʊnt ju ɡoʊ faɪnd ʌs sʌm fud
dialogue.zh: 你为什么不去给我们找点吃的

dialogue.en: Wu Jing and I will wait here
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ænd aɪ wɪl weɪt hir
dialogue.zh: 我和吴京会在这里等着

dialogue.en: After a few minutes of walking
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ə fju ˈmɪnəts ʌv ˈwɔkɪŋ

dialogue.en: I'm too tired to look for food
dialogue.ipa: aɪm tu ˈtaɪərd tu lʊk fɔr fud

dialogue.en: But if I go back now
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ɪf aɪ ɡoʊ bæk naʊ

dialogue.en: I'll tell him I searched everywhere but couldn't find any food
dialogue.ipa: aɪl tɛl hɪm aɪ sɜrʧt ˈɛvriˌwɛr bʌt ˈkʊdənt faɪnd ˈɛni fud
dialogue.zh: 我就说哪儿都找遍了也没找到吃的

dialogue.en: The pig lay down behind some bushes
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ leɪ daʊn bɪˈhaɪnd sʌm ˈbʊʃəz
dialogue.zh: 猪八戒往灌木丛后面一躺

dialogue.en: An hour later the Tang monk and Wu Jing were still waiting by the road
dialogue.ipa: ən ˈaʊər ˈleɪtər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd wu ʤɪŋ wɜr stɪl ˈweɪtɪŋ baɪ ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 一个时辰后唐僧和吴京还在路边等着

dialogue.en: What is taking Bajie so long
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɪz ˈteɪkɪŋ Bajie soʊ lɔŋ

dialogue.en: He probably found food and is now eating it all himself
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈprɑbəbli faʊnd fud ænd ɪz naʊ ˈitɪŋ ɪt ɔl hɪmˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 他准是找到吃的自己独吞了

dialogue.en: I'll go and look for him
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ ænd lʊk fɔr hɪm

dialogue.en: Wu Jing got up and headed down the road
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ɡɑt ʌp ænd ˈhɛdɪd daʊn ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: He did find food and he's not sharing it with us
dialogue.ipa: hi dɪd faɪnd fud ænd hiz nɑt ˈʃɛrɪŋ ɪt wɪð ʌs
dialogue.zh: 他果然找到吃的还不分给我们

dialogue.en: Meanwhile the Tang monk became bored
dialogue.ipa: ˈminˌwaɪl ðə tæŋ mʌŋk bɪˈkeɪm bɔrd

dialogue.en: He stood up to stretch his legs
dialogue.ipa: hi stʊd ʌp tu strɛʧ hɪz lɛɡz

dialogue.en: The monk walked quietly through the woods
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk wɔkt ˈkwaɪətli θru ðə wʊdz

dialogue.en: Admiring flowers and plants as he went
dialogue.ipa: ædˈmaɪrɪŋ ˈflaʊərz ænd plænts æz hi wɛnt

dialogue.en: He went deeper and deeper into the forest
dialogue.ipa: hi wɛnt ˈdipər ænd ˈdipər ˈɪntu ðə ˈfɔrəst

dialogue.en: Then in the midst of all the trees
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ɪn ðə mɪdst ʌv ɔl ðə triz

dialogue.en: This is a strange place for a pagoda
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ə streɪnʤ pleɪs fɔr ə pə ˈɡoʊdə

dialogue.en: Maybe we can all stay here tonight
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi wi kæn ɔl steɪ hir tə ˈnaɪt
dialogue.zh: 说不定今晚能在这儿歇脚

dialogue.en: The Tang monk went to the door of the pagoda and opened it
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɛnt tu ðə dɔr ʌv ðə pəˈɡoʊdə ænd ˈoʊpənd ɪt

dialogue.en: The monster had a purple beard and long
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər hæd ə ˈpɜrpəl bɪrd ænd lɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 这妖怪长着紫色的胡须和长长的

dialogue.en: The Tang monk tried to walk away
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk traɪd tu wɔk ə ˈweɪ

dialogue.en: The monster came closer and smiled
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər keɪm ˈkloʊsər ænd smaɪld
dialogue.zh: 妖怪凑近了些,露出笑容
妖怪的眼睛顿时亮了起来

dialogue.en: Meanwhile Wu Jing stomped toward Bajie's voice
dialogue.ipa: ˈminˌwaɪl wu ʤɪŋ stɑmpt təˈwɔrd Bajie's vɔɪs
dialogue.zh: 与此同时,武靖循着八戒的声音大步走去

dialogue.en: He peered behind some bushes and saw the pig fast asleep
dialogue.ipa: hi pɪrd bɪˈhaɪnd sʌm ˈbʊʃəz ænd sɔ ðə pɪɡ fæst əˈslip
dialogue.zh: 他拨开灌木丛窥视,发现那头猪正酣睡着

dialogue.en: He was talking in his sleep
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈtɔkɪŋ ɪn hɪz slip

dialogue.en: Wiping drool from the side of his mouth
dialogue.ipa: ˈwaɪpɪŋ drul frʌm ðə saɪd ʌv hɪz maʊθ

dialogue.en: How dare you sleep while we wait for you
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju slip waɪl wi weɪt fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 我们都在等你,你竟敢睡觉?

dialogue.en: Now let's go back to master
dialogue.ipa: naʊ lɛts ɡoʊ bæk tu ˈmæstər

dialogue.en: He followed Wu Jing back to the road
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈfɑloʊd wu ʤɪŋ bæk tu ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: Maybe he went for a walk
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi hi wɛnt fɔr ə wɔk

dialogue.en: He and Bajie wandered through the woods
dialogue.ipa: hi ænd Bajie ˈwɑndərd θru ðə wʊdz
dialogue.zh: 他和八戒在树林里四处寻找
很快,他们看到了一座宝塔

dialogue.en: Wu Jing told the monster who they were
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ toʊld ðə ˈmɑnstər hu ðeɪ wɜr
dialogue.zh: 武靖告诉了妖怪他们的身份

dialogue.en: I'm going to eat him for dinner
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu it hɪm fɔr ˈdɪnər

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Later that day they stopped to rest
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Soon he was snoring loudly
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: May I have more tofu
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: What is taking Bajie so long
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Wu Jing and I will wait here
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Maybe we can all stay here tonight
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: I'll tell him I searched everywhere but couldn't find any food
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: The Tang monk tried to walk away
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Now let's go back to master
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: But if I go back now
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When I wake up
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: How dare you sleep while we wait for you
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: What is taking Bajie so long
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: Why don’t we/you + 动词原形?
grammar.description: 以疑问形式提出建议，意思是“为什么不……呢”。
grammar.source: Why don't you go find us some food
examples: Why don't we follow the river?
Why don't we ask Wukong?
Why don't you wait here?
Why don't we look inside the cave?
Why don't we take a rest?
Why don't you tell the king?
Why don't we cross the bridge?
Why don't we call the others?
Why don't you bring some food?
Why don't we try another way?

grammar.pattern: be + too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示“太……而不能做某事”。
grammar.source: I'm too tired to look for food
examples: The box is too heavy to carry.
The river is too deep to cross.
Bajie is too tired to walk.
The cave is too dark to enter.
The wall is too high to climb.
The road is too narrow to ride on.
It is too late to leave.
The demon is too fast to catch.
The water is too cold to swim in.
The noise is too loud to ignore.

He let out a great big yawn
He got back up
Bajie looked around
I'm too tired to look for food
I'm too tired to look for food
He said to himself
But if I go back now
When I wake up
Wu Jing got up and headed down the road
He stood up to stretch his legs
Maybe we can all stay here tonight
The Tang monk tried to walk away
The Tang monk tried to walk away
The Tang monk turned around
The monster came closer and smiled
Bajie jumped to his feet
How dare you sleep while we wait for you

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 34 tricked by the Princess

dialogue.en: The Tang monk was tied up in a room
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz taɪd ʌp ɪn ə rum

dialogue.en: He heard his companions yelling at the monster
dialogue.ipa: hi hɜrd hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz ˈjɛlɪŋ æt ðə ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 他听到同伴们对着妖怪大喊大叫

dialogue.en: Hand over the Tang monk now
dialogue.ipa: hænd ˈoʊvər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk naʊ

dialogue.en: The Tang monk heard the sound of weapons clashing
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk hɜrd ðə saʊnd ʌv ˈwɛpənz ˈklæʃɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 唐僧听到兵器碰撞的声音

dialogue.en: A young woman entered the room
dialogue.ipa: ə jʌŋ ˈwʊmən ˈɛntərd ðə rum
dialogue.zh: 一位年轻女子走进房间

dialogue.en: That monster kidnapped me 13 years ago
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈmɑnstər ˈkɪdˌnæpt mi 13 jɪrz əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪十三年前绑架了我

dialogue.en: I wish I could help you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪʃ aɪ kʊd hɛlp ju

dialogue.en: He showed the young woman his ropes
dialogue.ipa: hi ʃoʊd ðə jʌŋ ˈwʊmən hɪz roʊps
dialogue.zh: 他给年轻女子看了看身上的绳索

dialogue.en: I can help you get free
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn hɛlp ju ɡɛt fri

dialogue.en: Will you deliver a letter to my parents
dialogue.ipa: wɪl ju dɪˈlɪvər ə ˈlɛtər tu maɪ ˈpɛrənts
dialogue.zh: 你能替我送封信给我的父母吗

dialogue.en: They're the king and queen of the precious image kingdom
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ðə kɪŋ ænd kwin ʌv ðə ˈprɛʃəs ˈɪməʤ ˈkɪŋdəm
dialogue.zh: 他们是宝象国的国王和王后

dialogue.en: My name is Princess Hundred Flowers
dialogue.ipa: maɪ neɪm ɪz ˈprɪnsɛs ˈhʌndrɪd ˈflaʊərz

dialogue.en: Bajie and Wu Jing were still fighting the monster
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ wɜr stɪl ˈfaɪtɪŋ ðə ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净还在和妖怪打斗

dialogue.en: I must ask you a favor
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst æsk ju ə ˈfeɪvər

dialogue.en: Right away the monster stopped fighting
dialogue.ipa: raɪt əˈweɪ ðə ˈmɑnstər stɑpt ˈfaɪtɪŋ

dialogue.en: What can I do for you my sweet
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kæn aɪ du fɔr ju maɪ swit
dialogue.zh: 亲爱的,我能为你做什么

dialogue.en: It makes me so sad to see him tied up
dialogue.ipa: ɪt meɪks mi soʊ sæd tu si hɪm taɪd ʌp
dialogue.zh: 看到他绑在那里让我很难过

dialogue.en: That monk isn't an ordinary monk
dialogue.ipa: ðæt mʌŋk ˈɪzənt ən ˈɔrdəˌnɛri mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 那和尚可不是普通的和尚

dialogue.en: Princess hundred flowers pretended to cry
dialogue.ipa: ˈprɪnsɛs ˈhʌndrɪd ˈflaʊərz priˈtɛndɪd tu kraɪ

dialogue.en: The monster held up his hands
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər hɛld ʌp hɪz hændz

dialogue.en: You know I only want you to be happy
dialogue.ipa: ju noʊ aɪ ˈoʊnli wɑnt ju tu bi ˈhæpi
dialogue.zh: 你知道我只希望你开心

dialogue.en: The monster followed the princess back inside
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər ˈfɑloʊd ðə ˈprɪnsɛs bæk ɪnˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 妖怪跟着公主回到了里面

dialogue.en: Bajie and Wu Jing looked at each other in confusion
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ lʊkt æt iʧ ˈʌðər ɪn kənˈfjuʒən
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净困惑地对视了一眼

dialogue.en: The monster is going to free him
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu fri hɪm

dialogue.en: A moment later the Tang monk came out
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk keɪm aʊt
dialogue.zh: 片刻之后,唐僧走了出来

dialogue.en: He said quietly to his companions
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd ˈkwaɪətli tu hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: The travelers reached the Palace of the Precious Image Kingdom
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz riʧt ðə ˈpæləs ʌv ðə ˈprɛʃəs ˈɪməʤ ˈkɪŋdəm
dialogue.zh: 旅行者们抵达了宝象国王宫

dialogue.en: The queen was reading the letter from her daughter
dialogue.ipa: ðə kwin wʌz ˈrɛdɪŋ ðə ˈlɛtər frʌm hɜr ˈdɔtər

dialogue.en: She's been a prisoner all this time
dialogue.ipa: ʃiz bɪn ə ˈprɪzənər ɔl ðɪs taɪm

dialogue.en: And I want that monster destroyed
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ wɑnt ðæt ˈmɑnstər dɪ ˈstrɔɪd

dialogue.en: How can we defeat such a powerful monster
dialogue.ipa: haʊ kæn wi dɪˈfit sʌʧ ə ˈpaʊərfəl ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 我们怎能打败如此强大的妖怪

dialogue.en: My two companions are powerful spirits
dialogue.ipa: maɪ tu kəmˈpænjənz ɑr ˈpaʊərfəl ˈspɪrɪts
dialogue.zh: 我的两位同伴是强大的神灵

dialogue.en: I'm sure they can rescue your daughter
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʃʊr ðeɪ kæn ˈrɛskju jʊər ˈdɔtər
dialogue.zh: 我相信他们能救出您的女儿

dialogue.en: Soon Bajie and Wu Jing were back at the pagoda
dialogue.ipa: sun Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ wɜr bæk æt ðə pəˈɡoʊdə
dialogue.zh: 很快,八戒和悟净回到了宝塔

dialogue.en: Get out here you rotten monster
dialogue.ipa: ɡɛt aʊt hir ju ˈrɑtən ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 滚出来,你这可恶的妖怪

dialogue.en: I let the monk go free
dialogue.ipa: aɪ lɛt ðə mʌŋk goʊ fri

dialogue.en: Why did you smash my door down
dialogue.ipa: waɪ dɪd ju smæʃ maɪ dɔr daʊn
dialogue.zh: 你们为什么砸坏我的门

dialogue.en: The king of the precious image kingdom sent us
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ ʌv ðə ˈprɛʃəs ˈɪməʤ ˈkɪŋdəm sɛnt ʌs
dialogue.zh: 宝象国的国王派我们来的

dialogue.en: You can't take the princess away
dialogue.ipa: ju kænt teɪk ðə ˈprɪnsɛs əˈweɪ

dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净发起了攻击
妖怪挡住了他们的武器

dialogue.en: They fought for over an hour
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ fɔt fɔr ˈoʊvər ən ˈaʊər

dialogue.en: The monster knocked out Wu Jing and tied him up
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər nɑkt aʊt wu ʤɪŋ ænd taɪd hɪm ʌp
dialogue.zh: 妖怪打晕了吴京,把他绑了起来

dialogue.en: He dragged Wu Jing into the pagoda
dialogue.ipa: hi dræɡd wu ʤɪŋ ˈɪntu ðə pə ˈɡoʊdə

dialogue.en: And locked him in a room
dialogue.ipa: ænd lɑkt hɪm ɪn ə rum
dialogue.zh: 并把他锁在一个房间里

dialogue.en: The king knows that the princess is here
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ noʊz ðæt ðə ˈprɪnsɛs ɪz hir

dialogue.en: He tapped his chin and thought
dialogue.ipa: hi tæpt hɪz ʧɪn ænd θɔt

dialogue.en: The princess must have asked that monk to go to the king
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈprɪnsɛs mʌst hæv æskt ðæt mʌŋk tu ɡoʊ tu ðə kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 公主一定是让那个和尚去找国王了

dialogue.en: His eyes became dark and angry
dialogue.ipa: hɪz aɪz bɪˈkeɪm dɑrk ænd ˈæŋɡri
dialogue.zh: 他的眼神变得阴沉而愤怒

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 35 a visit to the king

dialogue.en: I can't be angry with her
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt bi ˈæŋɡri wɪð hɜr

dialogue.en: He'll go back to the king
dialogue.ipa: hil ɡoʊ bæk tu ðə kɪŋ

dialogue.zh: 最后他想出了一个计划

dialogue.en: He went to the princess's room

dialogue.en: I'm going to visit your father
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ˈvɪzət jʊər ˈfɑðər

dialogue.ipa: sɛd ˈprɪnsɛs ˈhʌndrɪd ˈflaʊərz ɪn ʃɑk

dialogue.en: I'm going to tell him what a nice fellow I am
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu tɛl hɪm wɑt ə naɪs ˈfɛloʊ aɪ æm
dialogue.zh: 我要告诉他我是个多么好的人

dialogue.en: We can all be a happy family
dialogue.ipa: wi kæn ɔl bi ə ˈhæpi ˈfæməli
dialogue.zh: 我们可以成为幸福的一家人

dialogue.en: Before the princess could say another word

dialogue.zh: 公主还没来得及再说什么

dialogue.en: Bajie ran back to the precious image Kingdom
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ræn bæk tu ðə ˈprɛʃəs ˈɪməʤ ˈkɪŋdəm

dialogue.en: He told the king that he and Wu Jing couldn't save princess hundred flowers
dialogue.ipa: hi toʊld ðə kɪŋ ðæt hi ænd wu ʤɪŋ ˈkʊdənt seɪv ˈprɪnsɛs ˈhʌndrɪd ˈflaʊərz
dialogue.zh: 他告诉国王,他和吴京没能救出百花公主

dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmɛsənʤər ræn ˈɪntu ðə kɔrt

dialogue.ipa: jʊər sʌn ɪn lɔ ɪz hir tu si ju

dialogue.en: I don't have a son in law
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt hæv ə sʌn ɪn lɔ

dialogue.ipa: ə ˈhænsəm jʌŋ mæn wɔkt ˈɪntu ðə hɔl

dialogue.zh: 我救了她的命,赶走了老虎

dialogue.en: That Tiger has wanted revenge ever since
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈtaɪɡər hæz ˈwɔntɪd riˈvɛnʤ ˈɛvər sɪns

dialogue.zh: 他再次指向和尚,念动咒语

dialogue.en: Other monkeys and apes were nearby
dialogue.ipa: ˈʌðər ˈmʌŋkiz ænd eɪps wɜr ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 其他猴子和猿猴就在附近

dialogue.en: What are you doing here Bajie
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɑr ju ˈduɪŋ hir Bajie

dialogue.en: The pig looked at the ground
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ lʊkt æt ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: The Tang monk would like you to come back
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʊd laɪk ju tu kʌm bæk

dialogue.en: You told master to use the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: ju toʊld ˈmæstər tu juz ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl

dialogue.en: I should take out my iron bar and clobber you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʃʊd teɪk aʊt maɪ ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd ˈklɑbər ju
dialogue.zh: 我真该拿出我的铁棒揍你一顿

dialogue.en: I knew you were really just protecting master
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nu ju wɜr ˈrɪli ʤʌst prəˈtɛktɪŋ ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 我知道你其实是在保护师父

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is in danger big danger
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz ɪn ˈdeɪnʤər bɪɡ ˈdeɪnʤər

dialogue.en: A monster turned him into a tiger
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmɑnstər tɜrnd hɪm ˈɪntu ə ˈtaɪɡər
dialogue.zh: 一个妖怪把他变成了一只老虎

dialogue.en: Just tell the monster that you're friends with me
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst tɛl ðə ˈmɑnstər ðæt jʊr frɛndz wɪð mi
dialogue.zh: 你就告诉那妖怪,你是我的朋友

dialogue.en: He'll be scared and leave all of you alone
dialogue.ipa: hil bi skɛrd ænd liv ɔl ʌv ju əˈloʊn
dialogue.zh: 他会吓得不敢招惹你们的

dialogue.en: Oh I did tell him about you
dialogue.ipa: oʊ aɪ dɪd tɛl hɪm əˈbaʊt ju
dialogue.zh: 哦,我确实跟他提起过你

dialogue.en: He laughed and said that you're a tiny little coward
dialogue.ipa: hi læft ænd sɛd ðæt jʊr ə ˈtaɪni ˈlɪtəl ˈkaʊərd
dialogue.zh: 他大笑着说你是个胆小如鼠的小懦夫
悟空的眼中燃起了熊熊怒火

dialogue.en: The monster sat in the dining hall
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər sæt ɪn ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ hɔl

dialogue.en: Still disguised as a handsome young man
dialogue.ipa: stɪl dɪsˈɡaɪzd æz ə ˈhænsəm jʌŋ mæn
dialogue.zh: 仍然伪装成一位英俊的年轻人

dialogue.en: He was eating a meal with the king and the queen
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈitɪŋ ə mil wɪð ðə kɪŋ ænd ðə kwin
dialogue.zh: 他正与国王和王后共进晚餐

dialogue.en: A servant came in and handed a note to the young man
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈsɜrvənt keɪm ɪn ænd ˈhændɪd ə noʊt tu ðə jʌŋ mæn
dialogue.zh: 一个仆人走进来,递给年轻人一张纸条

dialogue.en: The young man read the note and stood up
dialogue.ipa: ðə jʌŋ mæn rid ðə noʊt ænd stʊd ʌp
dialogue.zh: 年轻人读完纸条后站了起来

dialogue.en: He ran out of the dining hall
dialogue.ipa: hi ræn aʊt ʌv ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ hɔl

dialogue.en: The servant watched the man leave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈsɜrvənt wɑʧt ðə mæn liv

dialogue.en: And the servant turned into Bajie
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈsɜrvənt tɜrnd ˈɪntu Bajie

dialogue.en: The monster is going to be so surprised
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu bi soʊ sərˈpraɪzd
dialogue.zh: 妖怪一定会大吃一惊的

dialogue.en: The young man ran outside and turned back into a monster
dialogue.ipa: ðə jʌŋ mæn ræn ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd tɜrnd bæk ˈɪntu ə ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 年轻人跑到外面,变回了妖怪的模样

dialogue.en: He flew through the air and returned to his pagoda
dialogue.ipa: hi flu θru ði ɛr ænd rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz pəˈɡoʊdə
dialogue.zh: 他腾空飞起,回到了自己的宝塔

dialogue.en: He burst through the door in a panic
dialogue.ipa: hi bɜrst θru ðə dɔr ɪn ə ˈpænɪk

dialogue.en: Then he saw Princess hundred flowers and relaxed
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi sɔ ˈprɪnsɛs ˈhʌndrɪd ˈflaʊərz ænd rɪˈlækst
dialogue.zh: 然后他看到了百花公主,这才松了口气

dialogue.en: I thought I'd lost you forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɔt aɪd lɔst ju fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: It said there was a monkey here
dialogue.ipa: ɪt sɛd ðɛr wʌz ə ˈmʌŋki hir

dialogue.en: And he was trying to destroy my pagoda
dialogue.ipa: ænd hi wʌz ˈtraɪɪŋ tu dɪ ˈstrɔɪ maɪ pəˈɡoʊdə
dialogue.zh: 他正试图毁掉我的宝塔
刚才确实有只猴子在这里

dialogue.en: You are not going to be happy about this
dialogue.ipa: ju ɑr nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu bi ˈhæpi əˈbaʊt ðɪs

dialogue.en: But he freed the purple spirit you had captured
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hi frid ðə ˈpɜrpəl ˈspɪrət ju hæd ˈkæpʧərd
dialogue.zh: 但他放走了你抓到的紫霞仙子

dialogue.en: The monkey did something else too
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki dɪd ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɛls tu
dialogue.zh: 那只猴子还做了别的事

dialogue.en: There was a flash of light
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə flæʃ ʌv laɪt

dialogue.en: Suddenly Wukong stood before the monster
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli wu kɔŋ stʊd bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 突然,悟空出现在妖怪面前

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Why won't Wukong help us
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: He was eating a meal with the king and the queen
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: But he freed the purple spirit you had captured
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: He told us not to look for him if we needed help
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: The monster is going to be so surprised
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll bet the monkey is really mad at me
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: And Wu Jing was captured
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You must get Wukong to come back
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: I should take out my iron bar and clobber you
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: The monster is going to be so surprised
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's go Bajie
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: It said there was a monkey here
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: He told us not to look for him if we needed help
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: The monster is going to be so surprised
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

You must get Wukong to come back

Standing up

The pig began to cry

The young man ran outside and turned back into a monster
