He looked around

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 37 missing from heaven

dialogue.en: King of the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: kɪŋ ʌv ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: I'm helping the Tang monk reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈhɛlpɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我在帮唐僧去西天取经

dialogue.en: I caused a lot of trouble in heaven
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kɑzd ə lɑt ʌv ˈtrʌbəl ɪn ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: Now I'm here to cause a lot of trouble for you
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪm hir tu kɑz ə lɑt ʌv ˈtrʌbəl fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 现在我要来给你添麻烦了

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar and swung it
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd swʌŋ ɪt
dialogue.zh: 悟空抽出铁棒挥舞起来

dialogue.en: He looked in every direction but didn't see the monster anywhere
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt ɪn ˈɛvəri dəˈrɛkʃən bʌt ˈdɪdənt si ðə ˈmɑnstər ˈɛniˌwɛr
dialogue.zh: 他四处张望,却不见妖怪踪影

dialogue.en: That monster said he remembered me
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈmɑnstər sɛd hi rɪ ˈmɛmbərd mi

dialogue.en: I'll go up there now to see if any spirits are missing
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ ʌp ðɛr naʊ tu si ɪf ˈɛni ˈspɪrɪts ɑr ˈmɪsɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 我这就上去看看有没有神仙下凡

dialogue.en: Wukong soared higher and higher until he reached the southern gate of heaven
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ sɔrd ˈhaɪər ænd ˈhaɪər ənˈtɪl hi riʧt ðə ˈsʌðərn ɡeɪt ʌv ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 悟空越飞越高,直到抵达南天门

dialogue.en: There's a monster on earth causing trouble for the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz ə ˈmɑnstər ɑn ɜrθ ˈkɑzɪŋ ˈtrʌbəl fɔr ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 下界有个妖怪在为难唐僧

dialogue.en: I think the monster is a spirit who escaped from heaven
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɪŋk ðə ˈmɑnstər ɪz ə ˈspɪrət hu ɪˈskeɪpt frʌm ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 我觉得那妖怪是从天宫逃下去的精怪

dialogue.en: The guard sent a messenger to check
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑrd sɛnt ə ˈmɛsənʤər tu ʧɛk

dialogue.en: A moment later the messenger returned
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər ðə ˈmɛsənʤər rɪˈtɜrnd

dialogue.zh: 一位天神随他一同前来

dialogue.en: You found the wood wolf star
dialogue.ipa: ju faʊnd ðə wʊd wʊlf stɑr

dialogue.en: The werewolf star is a wolf spirit who lives in heaven
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɛr ˌwʊlf stɑr ɪz ə wʊlf ˈspɪrət hu lɪvz ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 奎木狼是住在天宫的狼精

dialogue.en: And I've been looking all over for him
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪv bɪn ˈlʊkɪŋ ɔl ˈoʊvər fɔr hɪm

dialogue.en: The monster kidnapped a princess 13 years ago on Earth
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər ˈkɪdˌnæpt ə ˈprɪnsɛs 13 jɪrz əˈɡoʊ ɑn ɜrθ
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪十三年前在人间劫走了一位公主

dialogue.en: Thirteen years on earth is equal to 13 days in heaven
dialogue.ipa: ˈθɜrˈtin jɪrz ɑn ɜrθ ɪz ˈikwəl tu 13 deɪz ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 人间十三年相当于天宫十三天

dialogue.en: I'll help you catch the wood wolf star
dialogue.ipa: aɪl hɛlp ju kæʧ ðə wʊd wʊlf stɑr

dialogue.en: Wukong returned to earth with the god
dialogue.ipa: Wukong rɪˈtɜrnd tu ɜrθ wɪð ðə ɡɑd
dialogue.zh: 悟空与天神一同返回人间

dialogue.en: From the sky the god called down
dialogue.ipa: frʌm ðə skaɪ ðə ɡɑd kɔld daʊn

dialogue.en: Wukong saw a small splash in a river below
dialogue.ipa: Wukong sɔ ə smɔl splæʃ ɪn ə ˈrɪvər bɪˈloʊ
dialogue.zh: 悟空看见下方河中有水花溅起

dialogue.en: The monster turned into a wolf and flew up to the god
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə wʊlf ænd flu ʌp tu ðə ɡɑd
dialogue.zh: 妖怪变成一只狼,飞向天神

dialogue.en: He turned and led the wolf back up to heaven
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd ænd lɛd ðə wʊlf bæk ʌp tu ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 他转身带着狼返回天庭

dialogue.en: Wukong flew to the precious image kingdom and went into the palace
dialogue.ipa: Wukong flu tu ðə ˈprɛʃəs ˈɪməʤ ˈkɪŋdəm ænd wɛnt ˈɪntu ðə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 悟空飞到宝象国,进入宫殿

dialogue.en: A big Celebration was taking place
dialogue.ipa: ə bɪɡ ˌsɛləˈbreɪʃən wʌz ˈteɪkɪŋ pleɪs
dialogue.zh: 一场盛大的庆典正在进行

dialogue.en: The king and queen were both hugging their daughter
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ ænd kwin wɜr boʊθ ˈhʌɡɪŋ ðɛr ˈdɔtər
dialogue.zh: 国王和王后正拥抱着他们的女儿

dialogue.en: The princess saw Wukong and smiled
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈprɪnsɛs sɔ wu kɔŋ ænd smaɪld
dialogue.zh: 公主看见悟空,露出了微笑

dialogue.en: He's the monkey spirit who rescued Sha Wujing and me earlier
dialogue.ipa: hiz ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈspɪrət hu ˈrɛskjud ʃɑ Wujing ænd mi ˈɜrliər
dialogue.zh: 他就是之前救了沙悟净和我的猴精

dialogue.en: We can never thank you enough
dialogue.ipa: wi kæn ˈnɛvər θæŋk ju ɪˈnʌf

dialogue.en: You and your friends have made us very happy
dialogue.ipa: ju ænd jʊər frɛndz hæv meɪd ʌs ˈvɛri ˈhæpi
dialogue.zh: 你和你的朋友们让我们非常高兴

dialogue.ipa: sɛd wu kæŋ wɪð ə læf

dialogue.en: We save people from monsters and demons almost every day
dialogue.ipa: wi seɪv ˈpipəl frʌm ˈmɑnstərz ænd ˈdimənz ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˈɛvəri deɪ
dialogue.zh: 我们几乎每天都在从妖怪和恶魔手中救人

dialogue.en: The king looked at the ground
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ lʊkt æt ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.zh: 你的朋友们没告诉你吗

dialogue.en: That monster turned him into a tiger that's all
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈmɑnstər tɜrnd hɪm ˈɪntu ə ˈtaɪɡər ðæts ɔl
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪把他变成了老虎,仅此而已

dialogue.en: The king and queen led Wukong out of the hall
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ ænd kwin lɛd Wukong aʊt ʌv ðə hɔl
dialogue.zh: 国王和王后领着悟空走出大厅

dialogue.en: They went down a flight of stairs and arrived at the palace dungeon
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɛnt daʊn ə flaɪt ʌv stɛrz ænd əˈraɪvd æt ðə ˈpæləs ˈdʌnʤən
dialogue.zh: 他们走下一段楼梯,来到宫殿的地牢

dialogue.en: A large tiger sat in a cage
dialogue.ipa: ə lɑrʤ ˈtaɪɡər sæt ɪn ə keɪʤ
dialogue.zh: 一只大老虎坐在笼子里

dialogue.en: I'll change you back into yourself
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ʧeɪnʤ ju bæk ˈɪntu jərˈsɛlf

dialogue.en: Bright light surrounded the cage for a moment
dialogue.ipa: braɪt laɪt sə ˈraʊndɪd ðə keɪʤ fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt
dialogue.zh: 明亮的光芒瞬间笼罩了笼子

dialogue.en: Wukong grabbed the bars and twisted them apart
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ɡræbd ðə bɑrz ænd ˈtwɪstɪd ðɛm əˈpɑrt
dialogue.zh: 悟空抓住栏杆,将其扭开

dialogue.en: He took the monkey's hands in his own
dialogue.ipa: hi tʊk ðə ˈmʌŋkiz hændz ɪn hɪz oʊn

dialogue.en: I never should have told you to leave
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈnɛvər ʃʊd hæv toʊld ju tu liv

dialogue.en: Will you continue the journey with us
dialogue.ipa: wɪl ju kənˈtɪnju ðə ˈʤɜrni wɪð ʌs
dialogue.zh: 你愿意继续和我们一起旅行吗

dialogue.en: We will reach the western paradise together
dialogue.ipa: wi wɪl riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs təˈɡɛðər
dialogue.zh: 我们将一起抵达西天极乐世界

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The monster asked the monkey
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: A big Celebration was taking place
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I am Sun Wukong
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: I'll go up there now to see if any spirits are missing
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: You and your friends have made us very happy
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll go up there now to see if any spirits are missing
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: You will be punished
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We can never thank you enough
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: He must be from heaven
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: I never should have told you to leave
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Yes let's go
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Come up here at once
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's a monster on earth causing trouble for the Tang monk
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: I think the monster is a spirit who escaped from heaven
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: I'll go up there now to see if any spirits are missing
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 比较级 + than / 比较级 and 比较级
grammar.description: 比较两者差异，或表达程度不断变化。
grammar.source: Wukong soared higher and higher until he reached the southern gate of heaven
examples: Wukong is stronger than the demon.
This road is shorter than the other one.
The river is wider than before.
Bajie is hungrier than Wujing.
The mountain is higher than the hill.
The cave became darker and darker.
They walked faster and faster.
The sound grew louder and louder.
This plan is better than the first one.
The journey became more and more difficult.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 38 Bajie tries to sleep

dialogue.en: Time passed and it was soon spring
dialogue.ipa: taɪm pæst ænd ɪt wʌz sun sprɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 时光飞逝,转眼已是春天

dialogue.en: And birds swooped from tree to tree
dialogue.ipa: ænd bɜrdz swupt frʌm tri tu tri
dialogue.zh: 鸟儿在树丛间穿梭飞舞

dialogue.en: The road Wukong and the others were traveling began to go up a mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊd wu kæŋ ænd ði ˈʌðərz wɜr ˈtrævəlɪŋ bɪˈɡæn tu ɡoʊ ʌp ə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 悟空一行人走的道路开始向山上延伸

dialogue.en: Bajie go up the road and search the mountain
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ɡoʊ ʌp ðə roʊd ænd sɜrʧ ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 八戒,你沿路上山去探探路

dialogue.en: There might be a demon up there
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr maɪt bi ə ˈdimən ʌp ðɛr

dialogue.en: And I don't want master to get hurt
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ doʊnt wɑnt ˈmæstər tu ɡɛt hɜrt

dialogue.en: You make me do all the hard work
dialogue.ipa: ju meɪk mi du ɔl ðə hɑrd wɜrk

dialogue.en: He headed up the Mountain road
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈhɛdɪd ʌp ðə ˈmaʊntən roʊd

dialogue.en: Wukong turned to the Tang monk and Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: Wukong tɜrnd tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd wu ʤɪŋ

dialogue.en: I'm going to follow the pig
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ˈfɑloʊ ðə pɪɡ

dialogue.en: I want to make sure he really searches the mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt tu meɪk ʃʊr hi ˈrɪli ˈsɜrʧɪz ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: The monkey turned invisible and followed Bajie up the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki tɜrnd ɪnˈvɪzəbəl ænd ˈfɑloʊd Bajie ʌp ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 猴子隐去身形,尾随八戒上了山

dialogue.en: The pig walked for a few minutes
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ wɔkt fɔr ə fju ˈmɪnəts

dialogue.en: When he was sure his companions wouldn't hear him
dialogue.ipa: wɛn hi wʌz ʃʊr hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ˈwʊdənt hir hɪm

dialogue.en: You make me do all the hard work
dialogue.ipa: ju meɪk mi du ɔl ðə hɑrd wɜrk

dialogue.en: I'm not going to search this mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu sɜrʧ ðɪs ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: I'm going to take a nap instead
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu teɪk ə næp ɪnˈstɛd

dialogue.en: I'll lie and say I searched the mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪl laɪ ænd seɪ aɪ sɜrʧt ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: He lay down behind it and fell fast asleep
dialogue.ipa: hi leɪ daʊn bɪˈhaɪnd ɪt ænd fɛl fæst əˈslip
dialogue.zh: 往后面一躺就呼呼大睡

dialogue.en: The monkey turned himself into a woodpecker and pecked the log
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki tɜrnd hɪmˈsɛlf ˈɪntu ə ˈwʊdˌpɛkər ænd pɛkt ðə lɔɡ
dialogue.zh: 猴子变成啄木鸟去啄那木头

dialogue.en: Tap tap tap tap tap tap
dialogue.ipa: tæp tæp tæp tæp tæp tæp

dialogue.en: Tap tap tap tap tap tap
dialogue.ipa: tæp tæp tæp tæp tæp tæp

dialogue.en: Tap tap tap tap tap tap
dialogue.ipa: tæp tæp tæp tæp tæp tæp

dialogue.en: I can't even take a nap
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt ˈivɪn teɪk ə næp

dialogue.en: I guess I'll go back down
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɛs aɪl ɡoʊ bæk daʊn
wɛn Bajie faʊnd hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: Did you see any demons or monsters
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju si ˈɛni ˈdimənz ɔr ˈmɑnstərz

dialogue.en: Did you see any of them
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju si ˈɛni ʌv ðɛm

dialogue.en: You didn't search the mountain at all
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈdɪdənt sɜrʧ ðə ˈmaʊntən æt ɔl

dialogue.en: You should be ashamed of yourself bajie
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd bi əˈʃeɪmd ʌv jər ˈsɛlf bajie
dialogue.zh: 你应该感到羞愧 八戒

dialogue.en: Please go back and search the mountain Bajie
dialogue.ipa: pliz ɡoʊ bæk ænd sɜrʧ ðə ˈmaʊntən Bajie
dialogue.zh: 请回去搜山吧 八戒

dialogue.en: The pig headed back up the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ ˈhɛdɪd bæk ʌp ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: He had walked for a while when he saw a fox
dialogue.ipa: hi hæd wɔkt fɔr ə waɪl wɛn hi sɔ ə fɑks
dialogue.zh: 他走了一会儿 看见一只狐狸

dialogue.en: A robin flew past Bajie's head
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈrɑbən flu pæst Bajie's hɛd
dialogue.zh: 一只知更鸟从八戒头顶飞过

dialogue.en: As he waved the rake at the bird
dialogue.ipa: æz hi weɪvd ðə reɪk æt ðə bɜrd

dialogue.en: He got back up and stood still for a moment
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡɑt bæk ʌp ænd stʊd stɪl fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt
dialogue.zh: 他爬起来 静静地站了一会儿

dialogue.en: When he didn't see or hear Wukong
dialogue.ipa: wɛn hi ˈdɪdənt si ɔr hir Wukong

dialogue.en: Every time Bajie saw an animal
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvəri taɪm Bajie sɔ ən ˈænəməl

dialogue.en: He waved his Rake and yelled
dialogue.ipa: hi weɪvd hɪz reɪk ænd jɛld
dialogue.zh: 他都挥舞钉耙大喊大叫

dialogue.en: The pig soon came to a cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ sun keɪm tu ə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 猪八戒很快来到一个山洞前

dialogue.en: In front of the cave was a demon
dialogue.ipa: ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə keɪv wʌz ə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: I'm traveling to the western paradise with the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈtrævəlɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我正和唐僧一起去西天取经

dialogue.en: A smile curled along the demon's lips
dialogue.ipa: ə smaɪl kɜrld əˈlɔŋ ðə ˈdimənz lɪps
dialogue.zh: 妖怪的嘴角浮现出一丝微笑

dialogue.en: I have heard that anyone who eats the Tang monk will live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv hɜrd ðæt ˈɛniˌwʌn hu its ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɪl lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 我听说吃了唐僧肉就能长生不老

grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: You should be ashamed of yourself bajie
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: I want to make sure he really searches the mountain
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Get away from me Wukong
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That was me Bajie
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When he was sure his companions wouldn't hear him
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: He had walked for a while when he saw a fox
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: This pig is so lazy
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: Tell me who you are
examples: Do you know where the road ends?

Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 39 The Injured Monk

dialogue.en: Bajie waved his Rake at the demon Golden Horn
dialogue.ipa: Bajie weɪvd hɪz reɪk æt ðə ˈdimən ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn
dialogue.zh: 八戒挥动耙子朝妖怪金角打去

dialogue.en: You'll never harm the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: jul ˈnɛvər hɑrm ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: He was tied up in a dark cave
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz taɪd ʌp ɪn ə dɑrk keɪv
dialogue.zh: 他被绑在一个黑暗的山洞里

dialogue.en: Bajie is taking a long time to search the mountain
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ɪz ˈteɪkɪŋ ə lɔŋ taɪm tu sɜrʧ ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: He probably went back to sleep
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈprɑbəbli wɛnt bæk tu slip

dialogue.en: I should have followed him again
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʃʊd hæv ˈfɑloʊd hɪm əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: We'll find BA Jie along the way
dialogue.ipa: wil faɪnd bi-eɪ ʤi əˈlɔŋ ðə weɪ
dialogue.zh: 我们路上会找到八戒的
不过我们必须保持警惕

dialogue.en: We still don't know if there are any demons on this mountain
dialogue.ipa: wi stɪl doʊnt noʊ ɪf ðɛr ɑr ˈɛni ˈdimənz ɑn ðɪs ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 我们还不知道这山上有没有妖怪

dialogue.en: The group headed up the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup ˈhɛdɪd ʌp ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.zh: 很快,他们听到了一个声音

dialogue.en: He and his companions hurried ahead
dialogue.ipa: hi ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ˈhɜrid əˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 他和同伴们急忙赶上前去

dialogue.en: And found an old monk lying near the road
dialogue.ipa: ænd faʊnd ən oʊld mʌŋk ˈlaɪɪŋ nɪr ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 发现路边躺着一位老僧

dialogue.en: The Tang monk got down from his horse
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɡɑt daʊn frʌm hɪz hɔrs

dialogue.en: Of course we will help you
dialogue.ipa: ʌv kɔrs wi wɪl hɛlp ju

dialogue.en: How will I ever get back home
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl aɪ ˈɛvər ɡɛt bæk hoʊm

dialogue.en: How did your leg get hurt
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɪd jʊər lɛɡ ɡɛt hɜrt

dialogue.en: Wukong looked suspiciously at the man
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lʊkt səˈspɪʃəsli æt ðə mæn
dialogue.zh: 悟空怀疑地看着那个人

dialogue.en: I'm sure he wants to harm master
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʃʊr hi wɑnts tu hɑrm ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 我敢肯定他想伤害师父

dialogue.en: But I can't tell master that, he won't believe me
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ kænt tɛl ˈmæstər ðæt hi woʊnt bɪˈliv mi
dialogue.zh: 但我不能告诉师父,他不会相信我的。

dialogue.en: Please carry this poor monk down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: pliz ˈkæri ðɪs pʊr mʌŋk daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 请背这位可怜的和尚下山吧

dialogue.en: Wukong walked over and picked up the old monk
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wɔkt ˈoʊvər ænd pɪkt ʌp ði oʊld mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 悟空走过去背起了老和尚

dialogue.en: The group continued along the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup kənˈtɪnjud əˈlɔŋ ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: Letting the Tang monk and Wu Jing go ahead
dialogue.ipa: ˈlɛtɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd wu ʤɪŋ ɡoʊ əˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 让唐僧和悟净走在前面

dialogue.en: I know you're really a demon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ jʊr ˈrɪli ə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 我知道你其实是个妖怪

dialogue.en: And I know you want to eat the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ noʊ ju wɑnt tu it ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我也知道你想吃唐僧肉

dialogue.en: I don't know what you're talking about
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ wɑt jʊr ˈtɔkɪŋ əˈbaʊt

dialogue.en: I'm just a simple monk who was attacked by a tiger
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʤʌst ə ˈsɪmpəl mʌŋk hu wʌz əˈtækt baɪ ə ˈtaɪɡər
dialogue.zh: 我只是个被老虎袭击的普通和尚

dialogue.en: Do you know who I am
dialogue.ipa: du ju noʊ hu aɪ æm

dialogue.en: Heaven's entire army couldn't defeat me
dialogue.ipa: ˈhɛvənz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi ˈkʊdənt dɪˈfit mi

dialogue.en: You're going to wish you'd never tried to harm the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu wɪʃ jud ˈnɛvər traɪd tu hɑrm ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: He felt a heavy weight pressing down on him
dialogue.ipa: hi fɛlt ə ˈhɛvi weɪt ˈprɛsɪŋ daʊn ɑn hɪm
dialogue.zh: 他感到一股沉重的压力压在身上

dialogue.en: He glanced up and realized an entire mountain was balanced on top of his head
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡlænst ʌp ænd ˈriəˌlaɪzd ən ɪnˈtaɪər ˈmaʊntən wʌz ˈbælənst ɑn tɑp ʌv hɪz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 他抬头一看,发现整座山正压在他头顶

dialogue.en: So you're going to use magic tricks to trap me under a mountain
dialogue.ipa: soʊ jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu juz ˈmæʤɪk trɪks tu træp mi ˈʌndər ə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 所以你想用妖法把我压在山下

dialogue.en: Buddha himself once trapped me under a mountain
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə hɪm ˈsɛlf wʌns træpt mi ˈʌndər ə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: And I was able to lift it
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ wʌz ˈeɪbəl tu lɪft ɪt

dialogue.en: Now he had two mountains on top of him
dialogue.ipa: naʊ hi hæd tu ˈmaʊntənz ɑn tɑp ʌv hɪm
dialogue.zh: 现在他有两座大山压在身上

dialogue.en: This still isn't enough weight to stop me
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs stɪl ˈɪzənt ɪˈnʌf weɪt tu stɑp mi
dialogue.zh: 这点重量还不足以阻止我

dialogue.en: Now that the Tang monk isn't around
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ðæt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈɪzənt əˈraʊnd

dialogue.en: I should clobber you with my iron bar
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʃʊd ˈklɑbər ju wɪð maɪ ˈaɪərn bɑr
dialogue.zh: 我该用我的铁棒狠狠揍你一顿

dialogue.en: A third mountain appeared on top of the first two
dialogue.ipa: ə θɜrd ˈmaʊntən əˈpɪrd ɑn tɑp ʌv ðə fɜrst tu
dialogue.zh: 第三座大山出现在前两座之上

dialogue.en: And all three mountains crashed down on top of him
dialogue.ipa: ænd ɔl θri ˈmaʊntənz kræʃt daʊn ɑn tɑp ʌv hɪm
dialogue.zh: 三座大山轰然压在他身上

dialogue.en: There was a flash of light as he changed back into his demon form
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə flæʃ ʌv laɪt æz hi ʧeɪnʤd bæk ˈɪntu hɪz ˈdimən fɔrm
dialogue.zh: 一道闪光中他变回了妖怪的原形

dialogue.en: Wukong was the most powerful of these travelers
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wʌz ðə moʊst ˈpaʊərfəl ʌv ðiz ˈtrævələrz
dialogue.zh: 悟空是这群旅人中最强大的

dialogue.en: It will be easy to defeat Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wɪl bi ˈizi tu dɪˈfit wu ʤɪŋ

dialogue.en: Tonight I will dine on the Tang Monk
dialogue.ipa: təˈnaɪt aɪ wɪl daɪn ɑn ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 今晚我就要享用唐僧肉

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 40 The Magic Gourd

dialogue.en: Bajie was in the cave when the door opened
dialogue.ipa: Bajie wʌz ɪn ðə keɪv wɛn ðə dɔr ˈoʊpənd
dialogue.zh: 洞门打开时八戒正在洞里

dialogue.en: Dragging Wu Jing and the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ˈdræɡɪŋ wu ʤɪŋ ænd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Cried Bajie after the demons left
dialogue.ipa: kraɪd Bajie ˈæftər ðə ˈdimənz lɛft

dialogue.en: We don't know what happened to Wukong
dialogue.ipa: wi doʊnt noʊ wɑt ˈhæpənd tu wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 我们不知道悟空怎么样了

dialogue.en: In another room inside the cave
dialogue.ipa: ɪn əˈnʌðər rum ɪnˈsaɪd ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: Golden Horn talked to some smaller demons
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn tɔkt tu sʌm ˈsmɔlər ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 金角大王正和几个小妖说话

dialogue.en: When Golden Horn told them Wukong was trapped under three mountains
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn toʊld ðɛm Wukong wʌz træpt ˈʌndər θri ˈmaʊntənz
dialogue.zh: 当金角大王告诉他们悟空被压在三座山下时

dialogue.en: I'm afraid Sun Wukong might escape
dialogue.ipa: aɪm əˈfreɪd sʌn Wukong maɪt ɪˈskeɪp
dialogue.zh: 我担心孙悟空可能会逃脱

dialogue.en: He handed a gourd to one of the demons
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈhændəd ə gʊrd tu wʌn əv ðə ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 他把一个葫芦递给其中一个小妖

dialogue.en: Take this magic gourd to the monkey
dialogue.ipa: teɪk ðɪs ˈmædʒɪk ɡɔrd tu ðə ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 把这个魔葫芦拿去给猴子

dialogue.en: And he will be sucked into the gourd
dialogue.ipa: ænd hi wɪl bi sʌkt ˈɪntu ðə ɡɔrd

dialogue.en: After an hour he will turn into liquid
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ən ˈaʊər hi wɪl tɜrn ˈɪntu ˈlɪkwɪd
dialogue.zh: 一个时辰后他就会化成脓水

dialogue.en: Wukong pushed as hard as he could
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pʊʃt æz hɑrd æz hi kʊd

dialogue.en: But the mountains were too heavy
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈmaʊntənz wɜr tu ˈhɛvi

dialogue.en: How will I ever get out of this
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl aɪ ˈɛvər ɡɛt aʊt ʌv ðɪs

dialogue.en: He was about to push again when the mountains rose into the air
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz əˈbaʊt tu pʊʃ əˈɡɛn wɛn ðə ˈmaʊntənz roʊz ˈɪntu ði ɛr
dialogue.zh: 他正要再推,那些山却升到了空中

dialogue.en: Wukong jumped to his feet and looked around
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʤʌmpt tu hɪz fit ænd lʊkt əˈraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 悟空一跃而起,环顾四周

dialogue.en: I am the spirit of these mountains
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ðə ˈspɪrət ʌv ðiz ˈmaʊntənz

dialogue.en: I tried to stop that demon from taking my mountains
dialogue.ipa: aɪ traɪd tu stɑp ðæt ˈdimən frʌm ˈteɪkɪŋ maɪ ˈmaʊntənz
dialogue.zh: 我试图阻止那个妖怪夺走我的山

dialogue.en: The spirit bowed and then vanished with the mountains
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈspɪrət baʊd ænd ðɛn ˈvænɪʃt wɪð ðə ˈmaʊntənz
dialogue.zh: 山神鞠了一躬,然后随着山一起消失了

dialogue.en: Now I must find my companions
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪ mʌst faɪnd maɪ kəm ˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 现在我得找到我的同伴们

dialogue.en: I wonder where that demon lives
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈwʌndər wɛr ðæt ˈdimən lɪvz
dialogue.zh: 不知道那个妖怪住在哪里

dialogue.en: He spotted a small demon coming down the road
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈspɑtɪd ə smɔl ˈdimən ˈkʌmɪŋ daʊn ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 他看见一个小妖怪正沿着路走来

dialogue.en: The demon was carrying a Gourd
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdiːmən wʌz ˈkæriɪŋ ə ɡʊrd

dialogue.en: Wukong ducked behind a rock before the demon saw him
dialogue.ipa: Wukong dʌkt bɪˈhaɪnd ə rɑk bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈdimən sɔ hɪm
dialogue.zh: 悟空在妖怪看到他之前躲到了一块石头后面

dialogue.en: He probably knows the one who trapped me under the mountains
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈprɑbəbli noʊz ðə wʌn hu træpt mi ˈʌndər ðə ˈmaʊntənz
dialogue.zh: 他可能认识那个把我困在山下的家伙

dialogue.en: Wukong made himself look like a demon
dialogue.ipa: wu kæŋ meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk ə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 悟空把自己变成了妖怪的模样

dialogue.en: And stepped back onto the road
dialogue.ipa: ænd stɛpt bæk ˈɑntu ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: My master sent me to capture the Sun Wukong
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈmæstər sɛnt mi tu ˈkæpʧər ðə sʌn Wukong
dialogue.zh: 我师父派我来抓孙悟空

dialogue.en: And I don't like him at all
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ doʊnt laɪk hɪm æt ɔl
dialogue.zh: 而且我一点也不喜欢他

dialogue.en: But I can catch him myself quite easily
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ kæn kæʧ hɪm ˌmaɪ ˈsɛlf kwaɪt ˈizəli
dialogue.zh: 不过我自己抓他也很容易

dialogue.en: The demon showed Wukong his gourd
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ʃoʊd ˈwuːkɑːŋ hɪz ˈɡʊrd
dialogue.zh: 妖怪给悟空看了他的葫芦

dialogue.en: It can hold a demon or a spirit
dialogue.ipa: ɪt kæn hoʊld ə ˈdimən ɔr ə ˈspɪrət

dialogue.en: I just have to say Sun Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʤʌst hæv tu seɪ sʌn Wukong

dialogue.en: And he'll be sucked into it
dialogue.ipa: ænd hil bi sʌkt ˈɪntu ɪt

dialogue.en: After an hour he'll turn into liquid
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ən ˈaʊər hil tɜrn ˈɪntu ˈlɪkwɪd
dialogue.zh: 一个小时后他就会化成水

dialogue.en: He quickly plucked a hair and turned it into a gourd
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkwɪkli plʌkt ə hɛr ænd tɜrnd ɪt ˈɪntu ə gɔrd
dialogue.zh: 他迅速拔下一根毫毛,把它变成了一个葫芦

dialogue.en: He showed the Gourd to the demon
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈʃoʊd ðə gʊrd tu ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: It can hold all of heaven
dialogue.ipa: ɪt kæn hoʊld ɔl ʌv ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: I wish I had your gourd
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd jʊr ɡɔrd

dialogue.en: I might be willing to trade gourds with you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ maɪt bi ˈwɪlɪŋ tə treɪd ɡɔrdz wɪð ju
dialogue.zh: 我或许愿意跟你交换葫芦

dialogue.en: The demon gave Wukong a suspicious look
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ɡeɪv Wukong ə səˈspɪʃəs lʊk
dialogue.zh: 妖怪怀疑地看了悟空一眼

dialogue.en: How do I know you're telling the truth
dialogue.ipa: haʊ du aɪ noʊ jʊr ˈtɛlɪŋ ðə truθ
dialogue.zh: 我怎么知道你说的是真话

dialogue.en: Prove that your gourd can hold all of heaven
dialogue.ipa: pruːv ðæt jʊr ɡɔːrd kæn hoʊld ɔːl ʌv ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 证明你的葫芦能装下整个天

dialogue.en: The monkey recited a quick spell and left his body standing on the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki rəˈsaɪtəd ə kwɪk spɛl ænd lɛft hɪz ˈbɑdi ˈstændɪŋ ɑn ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 猴子念了个快咒,留下肉身站在路上

dialogue.en: He flew fast up to heaven
dialogue.ipa: hi flu fæst ʌp tu ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: I must make it look like heaven got sucked into this gourd
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst meɪk ɪt lʊk laɪk ˈhɛvən ɡɑt sʌkt ˈɪntu ðɪs ɡɔrd
dialogue.zh: 我得让天看起来像是被吸进了这个葫芦

dialogue.en: I'll ask the guard to close the gate and dim the stars
dialogue.ipa: aɪl æsk ðə ɡɑrd tu kloʊs ðə ɡeɪt ænd dɪm ðə stɑrz
dialogue.zh: 我要让守将关上大门,让星辰黯淡

dialogue.en: Then it will look like heaven's gone
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ɪt wɪl lʊk laɪk ˈhɛvənz ɡɔn
dialogue.zh: 这样天看起来就像消失了一样

dialogue.en: Said the guard at the southern gate of heaven
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə ɡɑrd æt ðə ˈsʌðərn ɡeɪt ʌv ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: I need to pretend that heaven has been sucked into a gourd
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid tu priˈtɛnd ðæt ˈhɛvən hæz bɪn sʌkt ˈɪntu ə ɡɔrd
dialogue.zh: 我需要假装天被吸进了一个葫芦里
当我说 ‘ 天 ’ 的时候

dialogue.en: Close the gate and dim the stars
dialogue.ipa: kloʊs ðə ɡeɪt ænd dɪm ðə stɑrz
dialogue.zh: 就关上大门,让星辰黯淡

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Bajie was in the cave when the door opened
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The demon was carrying a Gourd
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I am the spirit of these mountains
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: I need to pretend that heaven has been sucked into a gourd
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: After an hour he will turn into liquid
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: When Golden Horn told them Wukong was trapped under three mountains
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But I can catch him myself quite easily
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Now I must find my companions
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: I just have to say Sun Wukong
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: I tried to fight him
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's celebrate
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Take this magic gourd to the monkey
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: He probably knows the one who trapped me under the mountains
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: Bajie was in the cave when the door opened
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: We don't know what happened to Wukong
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: Wukong pushed as hard as he could
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 41 a trade

dialogue.en: Wukong was angry at the guard at the southern gate of heaven
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wʌz ˈæŋɡri æt ðə ɡɑrd æt ðə ˈsʌðərn ɡeɪt ʌv ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 悟空对南天门的守将很生气

dialogue.en: Why can't you close the gate and dim the stars
dialogue.ipa: waɪ kænt ju kloʊs ðə ɡeɪt ænd dɪm ðə stɑrz
dialogue.zh: 你为什么不能关上大门,让星辰黯淡

dialogue.en: I can do that only if I have permission from the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn du ðæt ˈoʊnli ɪf aɪ hæv pərˈmɪʃən frʌm ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 只有得到玉帝的许可,我才能这么做

dialogue.en: I'm trying to save the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈtraɪɪŋ tu seɪv ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: A demon is planning to eat him
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈdimən ɪz ˈplænɪŋ tu it hɪm

dialogue.en: Wukong's eyes became dark and angry
dialogue.ipa: Wukong's aɪz bɪˈkeɪm dɑrk ænd ˈæŋɡri
dialogue.zh: 悟空的眼神变得阴沉愤怒

dialogue.en: He pulled the iron bar out of his ear
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld ði ˈaɪərn bɑr aʊt ʌv hɪz ir

dialogue.en: A messenger ran into the Cloud Palace and bowed
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmɛsənʤər ræn ˈɪntu ðə klaʊd ˈpæləs ænd baʊd
dialogue.zh: 一个信使跑进云宫,躬身行礼

dialogue.en: Sun Wukong is at the southern gate of heaven your Majesty
dialogue.ipa: sʌn Wukong ɪz æt ðə ˈsʌðərn ɡeɪt ʌv ˈhɛvən jʊər ˈmæʤəsti

dialogue.en: He's going to destroy heaven if we don't do what he says
dialogue.ipa: hiz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu dɪˈstrɔɪ ˈhɛvən ɪf wi doʊnt du wɑt hi sɛz
dialogue.zh: 如果我们不照他说的做,他就要毁掉天庭

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor slammed his fist down
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər slæmd hɪz fɪst daʊn

dialogue.en: He wants us to close the gate and dim the stars
dialogue.ipa: hi wɑnts ʌs tu kloʊs ðə ɡeɪt ænd dɪm ðə stɑrz
dialogue.zh: 他要我们关上大门,让星辰黯淡

dialogue.en: He wants to pretend heaven got sucked into a gourd
dialogue.ipa: hi wɑnts tu priˈtɛnd ˈhɛvən ɡɑt sʌkt ˈɪntu ə ɡɔrd
dialogue.zh: 他想假装天被吸进了一个葫芦里

dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər lʊkt kən ˈfjuzd

dialogue.en: Why does he want to do that
dialogue.ipa: waɪ dʌz hi wɑnt tu du ðæt

dialogue.en: He just said he's trying to save the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: hi ʤʌst sɛd hiz ˈtraɪɪŋ tu seɪv ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 他只是说他在设法救唐僧

dialogue.en: You have my permission to close the gate and dim the stars
dialogue.ipa: ju hæv maɪ pərˈmɪʃən tu kloʊs ðə ɡeɪt ænd dɪm ðə stɑrz
dialogue.zh: 我准许你们关闭天门,熄灭星辰

dialogue.en: I don't want any more trouble from that monkey
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt ˈɛni mɔr ˈtrʌbəl frʌm ðæt ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 我不想再被那只猴子惹麻烦了

dialogue.en: The messenger returned to the gate
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɛsənʤər rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə ɡeɪt

dialogue.en: We will close the gate and dim the stars
dialogue.ipa: wi wɪl kloʊs ðə ɡeɪt ænd dɪm ðə stɑrz
dialogue.zh: 我们会关闭天门,熄灭星辰

dialogue.en: He put the iron bar back in his ear
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊt ði ˈaɪərn bɑr bæk ɪn hɪz ir

dialogue.zh: 等到我说 ‘ 天 ’ 的时候

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz ˈbɑdi
dialogue.zh: 悟空回到了他的身体里

dialogue.en: Which was still in disguise as a demon
dialogue.ipa: wɪʧ wʌz stɪl ɪn dɪsˈɡaɪz æz ə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 那身体仍伪装成妖怪的模样

dialogue.en: Now I will call to heaven
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪ wɪl kɔl tu ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: Said the monkey to the demon
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə ˈmʌŋki tu ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: The whole place will get sucked into this gourd
dialogue.ipa: ðə hoʊl pleɪs wɪl ɡɛt sʌkt ˈɪntu ðɪs ɡɔrd
dialogue.zh: 整个地方都会被吸进这个葫芦里

dialogue.en: Right away the sky went dark.Amazing.
dialogue.ipa: raɪt əˈweɪ ðə skaɪ wɛnt dɑrk
dialogue.zh: 天空立刻暗了下来。太神奇了

dialogue.en: All of heaven is now in that gourd
dialogue.ipa: ɔl ʌv ˈhɛvən ɪz naʊ ɪn ðæt ɡɔrd
dialogue.zh: 整个天现在都在那个葫芦里了

dialogue.en: Even the Cloud Palace is in here
dialogue.ipa: ˈivɪn ðə klaʊd ˈpæləs ɪz ɪn hir

dialogue.en: Now I will let heaven back out
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪ wɪl lɛt ˈhɛvən bæk aʊt

dialogue.en: He handed his gourd to Wukong
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈhændɪd hɪz ɡɔrd tu Wukong
dialogue.zh: 他把自己的葫芦递给了悟空

dialogue.en: Wukong gave the fake Gourd to the demon
dialogue.ipa: ˈwuːkɔːŋ ɡeɪv ðə feɪk ˈɡʊrd tuː ðə ˈdiːmən
dialogue.zh: 悟空把假葫芦给了妖怪

dialogue.en: Then he made the real gourd tiny
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi meɪd ðə riəl ɡɔrd ˈtaɪni

dialogue.en: And hid it in his robe
dialogue.ipa: ænd hɪd ɪt ɪn hɪz roʊb

dialogue.en: I'll try to capture heaven now
dialogue.ipa: aɪl traɪ tu ˈkæpʧər ˈhɛvən naʊ

dialogue.en: Wukong laughed and made the fake gourd disappear
dialogue.ipa: Wukong læft ænd meɪd ðə feɪk ɡɔrd ˌdɪsəˈpɪr
dialogue.zh: 悟空大笑一声,让假葫芦消失了

dialogue.en: I must tell the golden horn
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst tɛl ðə ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn

dialogue.en: Soon the road went up a mountain
dialogue.ipa: sun ðə roʊd wɛnt ʌp ə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: The demon ran into a cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ræn ˈɪntu ə keɪv

dialogue.en: Looking around at the group of demons
dialogue.ipa: ˈlʊkɪŋ əˈraʊnd æt ðə ɡrup ʌv ˈdimənz

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.zh: 立刻把我的朋友们还回来

dialogue.en: Or I'll clobber all of you
dialogue.ipa: ɔr aɪl ˈklɑbər ɔl ʌv ju
dialogue.zh: 否则我就把你们全都打趴下

dialogue.en: Wukong swung his iron bar at Golden Horn
dialogue.ipa: Wukong swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr æt ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn
dialogue.zh: 悟空挥动铁棒打向金角大王

dialogue.en: The demon stepped out of the way
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən stɛpt aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ

dialogue.en: And pulled a golden rope from his sleeve
dialogue.ipa: ænd pʊld ə ˈɡoʊldən roʊp frʌm hɪz sliv
dialogue.zh: 并从袖中抽出一根金绳

dialogue.en: The monkey tried to get out of the way
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki traɪd tu ɡɛt aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ

dialogue.en: The more Wukong tried to wriggle free
dialogue.ipa: ðə mɔr wu kɔŋ traɪd tu ˈrɪɡəl fri

dialogue.en: You'll never escape the golden rope
dialogue.ipa: jul ˈnɛvər ɪˈskeɪp ðə ˈɡoʊldən roʊp

dialogue.en: Tonight I will dine on the Tang Monk
dialogue.ipa: təˈnaɪt aɪ wɪl daɪn ɑn ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 今晚我就要享用唐僧肉了

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong was angry at the guard at the southern gate of heaven
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I can do that only if I have permission from the Jade Emperor
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: A demon is planning to eat him
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: We will close the gate and dim the stars
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: I was tricked
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Why can't you close the gate and dim the stars
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I must tell the golden horn
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: He wants to pretend heaven got sucked into a gourd
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: I'll try to capture heaven now
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's trade gourds
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Wait until I say heaven
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Which was still in disguise as a demon
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: I can do that only if I have permission from the Jade Emperor
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 42 Sun kong Wu

dialogue.en: Wukong struggled to free himself from the golden rope
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˈstrʌɡəld tu fri hɪmˈsɛlf frʌm ðə ˈɡoʊldən roʊp
dialogue.zh: 悟空挣扎着想从金绳中脱身

dialogue.en: The Gourd fell from his robe
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɔrd fɛl frəm hɪz roʊb
dialogue.zh: 葫芦从他的袍子里掉了出来

dialogue.en: Said golden horn picking it up
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn ˈpɪkɪŋ ɪt ʌp

dialogue.en: He dragged Wukong to a dark room in the cave and locked him in
dialogue.ipa: hi dræɡd Wukong tu ə dɑrk rum ɪn ðə keɪv ænd lɑkt hɪm ɪn
dialogue.zh: 他把悟空拖到山洞里的一个暗室,并把他锁在里面

dialogue.en: Right away Wukong made himself tiny and escaped
dialogue.ipa: raɪt əˈweɪ Wukong meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf ˈtaɪni ænd ɪˈskeɪpt

dialogue.en: He flew down a tunnel and squeezed through the cave's main door
dialogue.ipa: hi flu daʊn ə ˈtʌnəl ænd skwizd θru ðə keɪvz meɪn dɔr
dialogue.zh: 他飞下一条通道,挤过了山洞的正门

dialogue.en: He returned to his normal size
dialogue.ipa: hi rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz ˈnɔrməl saɪz

dialogue.en: He banged on the cave door
dialogue.ipa: hi bæŋd ɑn ðə keɪv dɔr

dialogue.en: The door flew open and golden horn appeared
dialogue.ipa: ðə dɔr flu ˈoʊpən ænd ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn əˈpɪrd
dialogue.zh: 门猛地打开,金角大王出现了

dialogue.en: But you look just like him
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju lʊk ʤʌst laɪk hɪm
dialogue.zh: 但你看起来和他一模一样

dialogue.en: Sun Wukong is my twin brother
dialogue.ipa: sʌn wu kɔŋ ɪz maɪ twɪn ˈbrʌðər
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空是我的孪生兄弟

dialogue.en: I know you captured my brother
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ ju ˈkæpʧərd maɪ ˈbrʌðər

dialogue.en: I'm not going to do that
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu du ðæt

dialogue.en: I was hoping to solve this problem without violence
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ˈhoʊpɪŋ tu sɑlv ðɪs ˈprɑbləm wɪˈθaʊt ˈvaɪələns
dialogue.zh: 我本希望不用武力解决这事

dialogue.en: He took the iron bar out of his ear
dialogue.ipa: hi tʊk ði ˈaɪərn bɑr aʊt ʌv hɪz ir
dialogue.zh: 他从耳朵里抽出金箍棒

dialogue.en: Golden horn had been holding the gourd behind his back the whole time
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn hæd bɪn ˈhoʊldɪŋ ðə ɡɔrd bɪˈhaɪnd hɪz bæk ðə hoʊl taɪm
dialogue.zh: 金角大王一直把葫芦藏在背后

dialogue.en: He quickly held it up and shouted
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkwɪkli hɛld ɪt ʌp ænd ˈʃaʊtɪd

dialogue.en: Wukong was sucked into the gourd
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wʌz sʌkt ˈɪntu ðə ɡɔrd

dialogue.en: Golden horn put a cap on the gourd and went back into his cave
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn pʊt ə kæp ɑn ðə ɡɔrd ænd wɛnt bæk ˈɪntu hɪz keɪv
dialogue.zh: 金角大王盖上葫芦塞,返回洞中

dialogue.en: Inside the gourd Wukong stamped his foot
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ɡɔrd wu kæŋ stæmpt hɪz fʊt
dialogue.zh: 葫芦里的悟空急得跺脚

dialogue.en: How will I get out of here
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl aɪ ɡɛt aʊt ʌv hir

dialogue.en: I know I won't turn into liquid because I going to live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ aɪ woʊnt tɜrn ˈɪntu ˈlɪkwɪd bɪˈkɔz aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 我知道自己不会化成脓水,因为我能长生不老

dialogue.en: But I still have to save my friends
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ stɪl hæv tu seɪv maɪ frɛndz

dialogue.en: He plucked a hair and made it look almost exactly like himself
dialogue.ipa: hi plʌkt ə hɛr ænd meɪd ɪt lʊk ˈɔlˌmoʊst ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk hɪmˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 他拔了根毫毛,变出个几乎和自己完全一样的假身

dialogue.en: The fake Wukong had no legs
dialogue.ipa: ðə feɪk Wukong hæd noʊ lɛɡz

dialogue.en: Next Wukong made a hair look like a puddle
dialogue.ipa: nɛkst Wukong meɪd ə hɛr lʊk laɪk ə ˈpʌdəl
dialogue.zh: 接着悟空又变出一滩水

dialogue.en: He placed the fake Wukong on the puddle
dialogue.ipa: hi pleɪst ðə feɪk Wukong ɑn ðə ˈpʌdəl
dialogue.zh: 他把假悟空放在水滩上

dialogue.en: Now it looked as if the fake Wukong's legs had turned into Liquid
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ɪt lʊkt æz ɪf ðə feɪk Wukong's lɛɡz hæd tɜrnd ˈɪntu ˈlɪkwɪd
dialogue.zh: 现在看起来就像假悟空的腿化成了水

dialogue.en: Then the monkey made himself very very tiny
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ðə ˈmʌŋki meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf ˈvɛri ˈvɛri ˈtaɪni
dialogue.zh: 然后猴子把自己变得极小极小

dialogue.en: Wukong went near the opening of the gourd and shouted
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wɛnt nɪr ði ˈoʊpənɪŋ ʌv ðə ɡɔrd ænd ˈʃaʊtɪd

dialogue.en: The gourd shot out light as golden horn removed the cap
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɔrd ʃɑt aʊt laɪt æz ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn riˈmuvd ðə kæp
dialogue.zh: 金角大王揭开葫芦塞时,葫芦射出光芒

dialogue.en: The tiny Wukong leaped out unseen
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪni Wukong lɛpt aʊt ən ˈsin
dialogue.zh: 微小的悟空趁机悄然跃出

dialogue.en: Golden horn peered into the gourd and saw the fake Wukong in the puddle
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn pɪrd ˈɪntu ðə ɡɔrd ænd sɔ ðə feɪk Wukong ɪn ðə ˈpʌdəl
dialogue.zh: 金角大王往葫芦里瞧,看见水滩上的假悟空

dialogue.en: The monkey's legs did turn into liquid
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋkiz lɛɡz dɪd tɜrn ˈɪntu ˈlɪkwɪd
dialogue.zh: 这猴子的腿果然化水了

dialogue.en: Soon his entire body will be liquid
dialogue.ipa: sun hɪz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈbɑdi wɪl bi ˈlɪkwɪd
dialogue.zh: 很快他全身都会化成水

dialogue.en: Golden horn laughed again and closed the gourd
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn læft əˈɡɛn ænd kloʊzd ðə ɡɔrd
dialogue.zh: 金角大王再次大笑,盖上了葫芦

dialogue.en: He put the gourd down and started eating
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊt ðə ɡɔrd daʊn ænd ˈstɑrtɪd ˈitɪŋ

dialogue.en: The real Wukong returned to his normal size
dialogue.ipa: ðə riəl Wukong rɪ ˈtɜrnd tu hɪz ˈnɔrməl saɪz

dialogue.en: And then made himself look like a demon
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk ə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: He walked over to golden horn
dialogue.ipa: hi wɔkt ˈoʊvər tu ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn

dialogue.en: Is Sun kongwu still in here
dialogue.ipa: ɪz sʌn kongwu stɪl ɪn hir

dialogue.en: He will turn completely into liquid soon
dialogue.ipa: hi wɪl tɜrn kəmˈplitli ˈɪntu ˈlɪkwɪd sun
dialogue.zh: 他很快就要完全化成水了

dialogue.en: I'm trying to eat my lunch
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈtraɪɪŋ tu it maɪ lʌnʧ
dialogue.zh: 我正想好好吃顿午饭呢

dialogue.en: Golden horn tilted his head to take a drink
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn ˈtɪltɪd hɪz hɛd tu teɪk ə drɪŋk
dialogue.zh: 金角大王歪头喝了一口

dialogue.en: Wukong slipped the gourd into his robe
dialogue.ipa: Wukong slɪpt ðə ɡɔrd ˈɪntu hɪz roʊb
dialogue.zh: 悟空把葫芦塞进了袍子里

dialogue.en: He quickly made a fake gourd with one of his hairs
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkwɪkli meɪd ə feɪk ɡɔrd wɪð wʌn ʌv hɪz hɛrz
dialogue.zh: 他迅速用一根毫毛变了个假葫芦

dialogue.en: He put it on the table and then ran outside
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊt ɪt ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl ænd ðɛn ræn ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 他把假葫芦放在桌上,然后跑了出去

dialogue.en: Wukong changed back into himself and then banged on the cave door again
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʧeɪnʤd bæk ˈɪntu hɪmˈsɛlf ænd ðɛn bæŋd ɑn ðə keɪv dɔr əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 悟空变回原形,再次敲响了洞门

dialogue.en: Golden horn threw the door open
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn θru ðə dɔr ˈoʊpən

dialogue.en: Golden horn held up the fake gourd
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn hɛld ʌp ðə feɪk ɡɔrd
dialogue.zh: 金角大王举起了假葫芦

dialogue.en: I have a gourd that looks just like that
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv ə ɡɔrd ðæt lʊks ʤʌst laɪk ðæt
dialogue.zh: 我也有个一模一样的葫芦

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The Gourd fell from his robe
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: I was hoping to solve this problem without violence
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: Golden horn had been holding the gourd behind his back the whole time
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Sun Wukong is my twin brother
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: How will I get out of here
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Wukong was sucked into the gourd
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: But I still have to save my friends
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Open up right now
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There was just one difference
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: I have a gourd that looks just like that
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: Now it looked as if the fake Wukong's legs had turned into Liquid
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: I know I won't turn into liquid because I going to live forever
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 43 a visit from laozi

dialogue.zh: 金角大王对悟空怒目而视

dialogue.en: I doubt you have a gourd like mine
dialogue.ipa: aɪ daʊt ju hæv ə ɡɔrd laɪk maɪn
dialogue.zh: 我不信你会有我这样的葫芦

dialogue.en: He held up the real gourd
dialogue.ipa: hi hɛld ʌp ðə riəl ɡɔrd

dialogue.en: The demon looked carefully at the gourd
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən lʊkt ˈkɛrfəli æt ðə ɡɔrd

dialogue.en: That does look like my gourd
dialogue.ipa: ðæt dʌz lʊk laɪk maɪ ɡɔrd

dialogue.zh: 但我的葫芦可是有法力的

dialogue.en: All I have to do is say the demon's name
dialogue.ipa: ɔl aɪ hæv tu du ɪz seɪ ðə ˈdimənz neɪm
dialogue.zh: 我只需喊出妖怪的名字

dialogue.en: The demon will get sucked in and then turn into liquid
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən wɪl ɡɛt sʌkt ɪn ænd ðɛn tɜrn ˈɪntu ˈlɪkwɪd
dialogue.zh: 妖怪就会被吸进去,然后化成水

dialogue.en: My gourd can do that too
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ɡɔrd kæn du ðæt tu

dialogue.en: Let's see whose gourd works better
dialogue.ipa: lɛts si huz ɡɔrd wɜrks ˈbɛtər
dialogue.zh: 咱们比比谁的葫芦更厉害
我忘了你叫什么名字了

dialogue.en: Golden horn held up his gourd
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔːrn hɛld ʌp hɪz ˈɡʊrd

dialogue.en: Golden horn looked at his gourd
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn lʊkt æt hɪz ɡɔrd

dialogue.zh: 为什么我的葫芦不灵了

dialogue.en: Instantly the demon was sucked into the gourd
dialogue.ipa: ˈɪnstəntli ðə ˈdimən wʌz sʌkt ˈɪntu ðə ɡɔrd
dialogue.zh: 妖怪瞬间被吸进了葫芦里

dialogue.en: Golden horn will soon be turned into liquid
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn wɪl sun bi tɜrnd ˈɪntu ˈlɪkwɪd
dialogue.zh: 金角很快就会被化成脓水

dialogue.en: He closed the gourd and ran into the cave
dialogue.ipa: hi kloʊzd ðə gʊrd ænd ræn ˈɪntu ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: The monkey waved his iron bar at them
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki weɪvd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr æt ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 猴子挥着铁棒朝他们打去

dialogue.en: Get out of here before I clobber you all
dialogue.ipa: ɡɛt aʊt ʌv hir bɪˈfɔr aɪ ˈklɑbər ju ɔl
dialogue.zh: 趁我没把你们全打趴下,赶紧滚

dialogue.en: The demon screamed and ran out of the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən skrimd ænd ræn aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 小妖们尖叫着逃出了山洞

dialogue.en: After a quick search of the cave
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ə kwɪk sɜrʧ ʌv ðə keɪv

dialogue.zh: 悟空找到了他的同伴们

dialogue.en: We thought you were trapped under mountains
dialogue.ipa: wi θɔt ju wɜr træpt ˈʌndər ˈmaʊntənz
dialogue.zh: 我们还以为你被压在山下了

dialogue.en: I was freed a couple of hours ago
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz frid ə ˈkʌpəl ʌv ˈaʊərz ə ˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 我几个小时前就脱身了

dialogue.en: What were you doing for all that time
dialogue.ipa: wɑt wɜr ju ˈduɪŋ fɔr ɔl ðæt taɪm
dialogue.zh: 那你这么长时间都在干嘛

dialogue.en: We were scared to death in here
dialogue.ipa: wi wɜr skɛrd tu dɛθ ɪn hir
dialogue.zh: 我们在这儿都快吓死了

dialogue.en: I couldn't free you right away
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈkʊdənt fri ju raɪt əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: I had to get rid of the demon first
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæd tu ɡɛt rɪd ʌv ðə ˈdimən fɜrst

dialogue.en: The monkey untied bajie and Wu jing
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ənˈtaɪd bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 猴子解开了八戒和悟净的绳子

dialogue.en: It's still early in the afternoon
dialogue.ipa: ɪts stɪl ˈɜrli ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnun
dialogue.zh: 现在还是下午早些时候

dialogue.en: I want to be as far from this mountain as I can by nighttime
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt tu bi æz fɑr frʌm ðɪs ˈmaʊntən æz aɪ kæn baɪ ˈnaɪtˌtaɪm
dialogue.zh: 我想在天黑前尽可能远离这座山

dialogue.en: The travelers hurried west along the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz ˈhɜrid wɛst əˈlɔŋ ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: They hadn't gone far when an old man approached them
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈhædənt ɡɔn fɑr wɛn ən oʊld mæn əˈproʊʧt ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 没走多远,一位老者朝他们走来

dialogue.en: I know you have my Gourd
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ ju hæv maɪ ɡɔrd
dialogue.zh: 我知道我的葫芦在你那儿。

dialogue.en: I don't know what you're talking about
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ wɑt jʊr ˈtɔkɪŋ əˈbaʊt

dialogue.en: There was a flash of light
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə flæʃ ʌv laɪt

dialogue.en: Then laozi the sage stood before the travelers
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn laozi ðə seɪʤ stʊd bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈtrævələrz
dialogue.zh: 接着,圣人老子便出现在旅人面前。

dialogue.ipa: ɡɪv mi maɪ ɡɔrd wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空,把我的葫芦还给我。

dialogue.en: Wukong took the gourd out of his robe and handed it to the sage
dialogue.ipa: ˈwuːkɔːŋ tʊk ðə ˈɡʊrd aʊt ʌv hɪz roʊb ænd ˈhændɪd ɪt tuː ðə seɪdʒ
dialogue.zh: 悟空从袍子里取出葫芦,递给了圣人。

dialogue.en: Why did that demon have your gourd
dialogue.ipa: waɪ dɪd ðæt ˈdimən hæv jʊər ɡɔrd
dialogue.zh: 那个妖怪怎么会有你的葫芦?

dialogue.en: I sent him here to cause trouble for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ sɛnt hɪm hir tu kɑz ˈtrʌbəl fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 我派他来给你们制造麻烦。

dialogue.en: Buddha wanted to make sure you are all serious about reaching the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə ˈwɔntɪd tu meɪk ʃʊr ju ɑr ɔl ˈsɪriəs əˈbaʊt ˈriʧɪŋ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 佛祖想确认你们是否真心前往西天。

dialogue.en: Golden horn is probably all liquid by now
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən hɔrn ɪz ˈprɑbəbli ɔl ˈlɪkwɪd baɪ naʊ
dialogue.zh: 金角现在大概已经化成水了吧。

dialogue.en: As night fell they arrived at a monastery
dialogue.ipa: æz naɪt fɛl ðeɪ əˈraɪvd æt ə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 夜幕降临时,他们抵达了一座寺院。

dialogue.en: After a small dinner with the monastery's monks
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ə smɔl ˈdɪnər wɪð ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛriz mʌŋks
dialogue.zh: 与寺中僧人简单用过斋饭后。

dialogue.en: The Tang monk was almost asleep when he heard a moaning sound from outside
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz ˈɔlˌmoʊst əˈslip wɛn hi hɜrd ə ˈmoʊnɪŋ saʊnd frʌm ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 唐僧刚要入睡,忽听外面传来一阵呻吟声。
房门缓缓吱呀一声开了。

dialogue.en: A man stood in the doorway dripping wet
dialogue.ipa: ə mæn stʊd ɪn ðə ˈdɔr ˌweɪ ˈdrɪpɪŋ wɛt
dialogue.zh: 一个浑身湿透的男子站在门口。

dialogue.en: He looked at the monk and held out his hands
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt ðə mʌŋk ænd hɛld aʊt hɪz hændz

There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That does look like my gourd
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: They hadn't gone far when an old man approached them
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I don't know what you're talking about
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.

We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.
