titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 44 the king's ghost

dialogue.en: The man walked into the Tang monk's room
dialogue.ipa: ðə mæn wɔkt ˈɪntu ðə tæŋ mʌŋks rum
dialogue.zh: 那男子走进了唐僧的房间。

dialogue.en: I'm king of the black rooster kingdom
dialogue.ipa: aɪm kɪŋ ʌv ðə blæk ˈrustər ˈkɪŋdəm

dialogue.en: My kingdom suffered a horrible drought five years ago
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈkɪŋdəm ˈsʌfərd ə ˈhɔrəbəl draʊt faɪv jɪrz əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 五年前,我的国家遭遇了一场可怕的旱灾。

dialogue.en: Crops wouldn't grow and my people were starving
dialogue.ipa: krɑps ˈwʊdənt ɡroʊ ænd maɪ ˈpipəl wɜr ˈstɑrvɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 庄稼无法生长,我的子民都在挨饿。

dialogue.en: One day a taoist arrived in the kingdom
dialogue.ipa: wʌn deɪ ə ˈdaʊɪst əˈraɪvd ɪn ðə ˈkɪŋdəm
dialogue.zh: 一天,一位道士来到了这个王国

dialogue.en: He said he had great powers and could pray for rain
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd hi hæd ɡreɪt ˈpaʊərz ænd kʊd preɪ fɔr reɪn
dialogue.zh: 他说自己法力高强,能够祈雨

dialogue.en: Did the daoist prayers bring rain
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ðə ˈdaʊɪst prɛrz brɪŋ reɪn
dialogue.zh: 道士的祈祷带来雨水了吗

dialogue.en: And our crops began to grow
dialogue.ipa: ænd ˈaʊər krɑps bɪˈɡæn tu ɡroʊ

dialogue.en: Said the Tang monk with a smile
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɪð ə smaɪl

dialogue.zh: 但随后他的笑容消失了

dialogue.en: Why do you need my help
dialogue.ipa: waɪ du ju nid maɪ hɛlp
dialogue.zh: 为什么需要我的帮助呢

dialogue.en: The king took a deep breath
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ tʊk ə dip brɛθ

dialogue.en: After the daoist brought the rain
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ðə ˈdaʊɪst brɔt ðə reɪn

dialogue.en: One day we were walking when I noticed a strange light coming from my well
dialogue.ipa: wʌn deɪ wi wɜr ˈwɔkɪŋ wɛn aɪ ˈnoʊtəst ə streɪnʤ laɪt ˈkʌmɪŋ frʌm maɪ wɛl
dialogue.zh: 有一天我们散步时,我注意到井里发出奇怪的光

dialogue.en: I went to the well and looked in
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɛnt tu ðə wɛl ænd lʊkt ɪn

dialogue.en: Suddenly I felt someone push me in
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli aɪ fɛlt ˈsʌmˌwʌn pʊʃ mi ɪn
dialogue.zh: 突然,我感到有人把我推了进去

dialogue.en: He had made the light with magic so he could trick me
dialogue.ipa: hi hæd meɪd ðə laɪt wɪð ˈmæʤɪk soʊ hi kʊd trɪk mi
dialogue.zh: 他用魔法制造了那道光,好骗我过去

dialogue.en: I fell deep into the water
dialogue.ipa: aɪ fɛl dip ˈɪntu ðə ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: And he sealed the well shut
dialogue.ipa: ænd hi sild ðə wɛl ʃʌt

dialogue.en: Tears came to the king's eyes
dialogue.ipa: tɛrz keɪm tu ðə kɪŋz aɪz

dialogue.en: My body is still down there
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈbɑdi ɪz stɪl daʊn ðɛr

dialogue.en: Your guards punished the daoist right
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ɡɑrdz ˈpʌnɪʃt ðə ˈdaʊɪst raɪt
dialogue.zh: 你的卫兵惩罚了那个道士,对吧

dialogue.en: The daoist made himself look like me
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdaʊɪst meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk mi
dialogue.zh: 道士把自己变成了我的模样

dialogue.en: And now everyone thinks he's the real king
dialogue.ipa: ænd naʊ ˈɛvriˌwʌn θɪŋks hiz ðə riəl kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 现在所有人都以为他才是真正的国王

dialogue.en: I've been in the land of darkness ever since
dialogue.ipa: aɪv bɪn ɪn ðə lænd ʌv ˈdɑrknəs ˈɛvər sɪns
dialogue.zh: 从那以后,我就一直待在阴间

dialogue.en: Tonight a spirit brought me to see you
dialogue.ipa: təˈnaɪt ə ˈspɪrət brɔt mi tu si ju
dialogue.zh: 今晚,一位神灵带我来见你

dialogue.en: He said you can help me
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd ju kæn hɛlp mi

dialogue.en: Yes but you're traveling with sun Wukong
dialogue.ipa: jɛs bʌt jʊr ˈtrævəlɪŋ wɪð sʌn wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 是的,但你和孙悟空同行

dialogue.ipa: sʌn wu kɔŋ ɪz ˈvɛri ˈpaʊərfəl

dialogue.en: Wukong can't charge into the palace and attack the daoist
dialogue.ipa: Wukong kænt ʧɑrʤ ˈɪntu ðə ˈpæləs ænd əˈtæk ðə ˈdaʊɪst
dialogue.zh: 悟空不能直接冲进宫殿攻击道士

dialogue.en: People will think the monkey is evil
dialogue.ipa: ˈpipəl wɪl θɪŋk ðə ˈmʌŋki ɪz ˈivəl
dialogue.zh: 人们会以为这猴子是邪恶的

dialogue.en: Attacking a king for no reason
dialogue.ipa: əˈtækɪŋ ə kɪŋ fɔr noʊ ˈrizən

dialogue.en: Can bring all of you into the palace
dialogue.ipa: kæn brɪŋ ɔl ʌv ju ˈɪntu ðə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 可以把你们都带进宫殿

dialogue.en: Then sun Wukong can fight the daoist in private
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn sʌn wu kɔŋ kæn faɪt ðə ˈdaʊɪst ɪn ˈpraɪvət
dialogue.zh: 然后孙悟空就可以私下与道士较量

dialogue.en: Where can we find the prince
dialogue.ipa: wɛr kæn wi faɪnd ðə prɪns
dialogue.zh: 我们在哪里能找到王子

dialogue.en: He will be out hunting tomorrow
dialogue.ipa: hi wɪl bi aʊt ˈhʌntɪŋ təˈmɑˌroʊ

dialogue.en: Tell him everything I told you
dialogue.ipa: tɛl hɪm ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ aɪ toʊld ju
dialogue.zh: 把我告诉你的一切都告诉他

dialogue.en: He thinks that Daoist is his father
dialogue.ipa: hi θɪŋks ðæt ˈdoʊɪst ɪz hɪz ˈfɑðər
dialogue.zh: 他认为道士是他的父亲

dialogue.en: The king held up a Jade coin
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ hɛld ʌp ə ʤeɪd kɔɪn

dialogue.en: This is the one royal treasure I still have
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ðə wʌn ˈrɔɪəl ˈtrɛʒər aɪ stɪl hæv
dialogue.zh: 这是我仅存的皇家宝物

dialogue.en: He'll know you're telling the truth
dialogue.ipa: hil noʊ jʊr ˈtɛlɪŋ ðə truθ
dialogue.zh: 他就会知道你说的是真话

dialogue.en: Suddenly the king looked at the door
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðə kɪŋ lʊkt æt ðə dɔr
ðə ˈspɪrət ɪz ˈkɔlɪŋ mi aɪ mʌst ɡoʊ

dialogue.en: The Tang monk called to his companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk kɔld tu hɪz kəmˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: The monk told them everything that the king had said
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk toʊld ðɛm ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ðæt ðə kɪŋ hæd sɛd
dialogue.zh: 和尚把国王所说的一切都告诉了他们

dialogue.en: he showed me a Jade coin
dialogue.ipa: hi ʃoʊd mi ə ʤeɪd kɔɪn

dialogue.en: I don't know where it is now though
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ wɛr ɪt ɪz naʊ ðoʊ
dialogue.zh: 但我不知道它现在在哪里

dialogue.en: He went outside and the others followed
dialogue.ipa: hi wɛnt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd ði ˈʌðərz ˈfɑloʊd
dialogue.zh: 他走了出去,其他人也跟着

dialogue.en: A Jade coin lay on the ground by the door
dialogue.ipa: ə ʤeɪd kɔɪn leɪ ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd baɪ ðə dɔr
dialogue.zh: 一枚玉币躺在门边的地上

dialogue.en: He saw a white rabbit and shot an arrow
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ ə waɪt ˈræbət ænd ʃɑt ən ˈæroʊ
dialogue.zh: 他看到一只白兔,射了一箭

dialogue.en: He missed and the rabbit ran
dialogue.ipa: hi mɪst ænd ðə ˈræbət ræn

dialogue.en: The Prince chased the rabbit as it ran into a monastery
dialogue.ipa: ðə prɪns ʧeɪst ðə ˈræbət æz ɪt ræn ˈɪntu ə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 王子追赶兔子,它跑进了一座寺院

dialogue.en: Inside the Prince saw a monk
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈsaɪd ðə prɪns sɔ ə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 在寺院里,王子看到一位和尚

dialogue.en: A pig and a purple spirit
dialogue.ipa: ə pɪɡ ænd ə ˈpɜrpəl ˈspɪrət
dialogue.zh: 一头猪和一个紫色的精灵

dialogue.en: Then the rabbit turned into a monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ðə ˈræbət tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 然后兔子变成了一只猴子
我们必须告诉你一些事

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The man walked into the Tang monk's room
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Crops wouldn't grow and my people were starving
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: He had made the light with magic so he could trick me
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Why do you need my help
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: The spirit is calling me
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: People will think the monkey is evil
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Don't be scared Prince
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: He said you can help me
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: He said he had great powers and could pray for rain
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I must go
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Tell him everything I told you
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who rushed into the room
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: One day we were walking when I noticed a strange light coming from my well
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: He had made the light with magic so he could trick me
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I don't know where it is now though
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 45 the treasure in the well

dialogue.en: The Tang monk introduced himself to the prince and then waved toward the others
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˌɪntrəˈdust hɪmˈsɛlf tu ðə prɪns ænd ðɛn weɪvd təˈwɔrd ði ˈʌðərz
dialogue.zh: 唐僧向王子介绍了自己,然后朝其他人挥了挥手

dialogue.en: We're going to the western paradise to get scriptures from Buddha
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs tu ɡɛt ˈskrɪpʧərz frʌm ˈbudə

dialogue.en: Why did the monkey lead me here
dialogue.ipa: waɪ dɪd ðə ˈmʌŋki lid mi hir

dialogue.en: The man ruling the black rooster kingdom is not really the king
dialogue.ipa: ðə mæn ˈrulɪŋ ðə blæk ˈrustər ˈkɪŋdəm ɪz nɑt ˈrɪli ðə kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 统治乌鸡国的并非真正的国王

dialogue.en: When the Tang monk's story was finished
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðə tæŋ mʌŋks ˈstɔri wʌz ˈfɪnɪʃt

dialogue.en: I will have you arrested for making up such a story
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl hæv ju əˈrɛstɪd fɔr ˈmeɪkɪŋ ʌp sʌʧ ə ˈstɔri
dialogue.zh: 编造这等故事,我定要将你捉拿

dialogue.en: The Tang monk reached into his robe
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk riʧt ˈɪntu hɪz roʊb

dialogue.en: He pulled out the Jade coin
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt ðə ʤeɪd kɔɪn

dialogue.en: Your father told me to show you this
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ˈfɑðər toʊld mi tu ʃoʊ ju ðɪs
dialogue.zh: 你父王嘱我将此物交予你看

dialogue.en: That coin belongs to my father
dialogue.ipa: ðæt kɔɪn bɪˈlɔŋz tu maɪ ˈfɑðər

dialogue.en: People thought that evil daoist was him
dialogue.ipa: ˈpipəl θɔt ðæt ˈivəl ˈdaʊɪst wʌz hɪm
dialogue.zh: 人们竟将那恶道当作了他

dialogue.en: We'll get rid of that fake king
dialogue.ipa: wil ɡɛt rɪd ʌv ðæt feɪk kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 我们自会除去那假国王

dialogue.en: Late that night Wukong lay awake
dialogue.ipa: leɪt ðæt naɪt Wukong leɪ əˈweɪk
dialogue.zh: 深夜时分,悟空辗转难眠

dialogue.en: We need proof that he killed the real king
dialogue.ipa: wi nid pruf ðæt hi kɪld ðə riəl kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 需寻得他谋害真王的证据

dialogue.en: He poked bajie who was fast asleep
dialogue.ipa: hi poʊkt bajie hu wʌz fæst ə ˈslip
dialogue.zh: 他捅了捅正酣睡如泥的八戒。

dialogue.en: They went outside and flew to the palace
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɛnt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd flu tu ðə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 二人出得门去,驾云径往王宫

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rʌʃt təˈwɔrd ə wɛl

dialogue.en: The treasure is in this well
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrɛʒər ɪz ɪn ðɪs wɛl

dialogue.en: Bajie peered down into the darkness
dialogue.ipa: Bajie pɪrd daʊn ˈɪntu ðə ˈdɑrknəs
dialogue.zh: 八戒探头望向幽暗的井底

dialogue.en: Is this the well the king was pushed into
dialogue.ipa: ɪz ðɪs ðə wɛl ðə kɪŋ wʌz pʊʃt ˈɪntu
dialogue.zh: 这莫非是那国王被推落的井

dialogue.en: The treasure is definitely down there though
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrɛʒər ɪz ˈdɛfənətli daʊn ðɛr ðoʊ

dialogue.en: How will we get it out
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl wi ɡɛt ɪt aʊt

dialogue.en: And the pig splashed into the water
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə pɪɡ splæʃt ˈɪntu ðə ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 猪八戒扑通一声掉进了水里。

dialogue.en: Find the treasure and I let you back up
dialogue.ipa: faɪnd ðə ˈtrɛʒər ænd aɪl lɛt ju bæk ʌp
dialogue.zh: 找到宝贝,我就让你上来。

dialogue.en: Until he arrived at a palace
dialogue.ipa: ənˈtɪl hi əˈraɪvd æt ə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 直到他来到一座宫殿前。

dialogue.en: I don't have any treasure for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt hæv ˈɛni ˈtrɛʒər fɔr ju

dialogue.en: Are you from the black rooster kingdom
dialogue.ipa: ɑr ju frʌm ðə blæk ˈrustər ˈkɪŋdəm

dialogue.en: My friends and I are helping the king of the black rooster kingdom
dialogue.ipa: maɪ frɛndz ænd aɪ ɑr ˈhɛlpɪŋ ðə kɪŋ ʌv ðə blæk ˈrustər ˈkɪŋdəm
dialogue.zh: 我和我的朋友们正在帮助乌鸡国的国王。

dialogue.en: The well dragon king led bajie into a room
dialogue.ipa: ðə wɛl ˈdræɡən kɪŋ lɛd bajie ˈɪntu ə rum
dialogue.zh: 井龙王领着八戒进了一个房间。

dialogue.en: The body of a man lay on a table
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈbɑdi ʌv ə mæn leɪ ɑn ə ˈteɪbəl
dialogue.zh: 一具男子的尸体躺在桌子上。

dialogue.en: This is the black rooster king's body
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ðə blæk ˈrustər kɪŋz ˈbɑdi
dialogue.zh: 这是乌鸡国国王的遗体。

dialogue.en: Please take it back with you
dialogue.ipa: pliz teɪk ɪt bæk wɪð ju

dialogue.en: Ba jie was furious that Wukong had tricked him
dialogue.ipa: Ba ʤi wʌz ˈfjʊriəs ðæt wu kɔŋ hæd trɪkt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 八戒对悟空骗他下来感到非常愤怒。

dialogue.en: He lifted the king's body and headed back to the well
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈlɪftɪd ðə kɪŋz ˈbɑdi ænd ˈhɛdɪd bæk tu ðə wɛl
dialogue.zh: 他扛起国王的遗体,返回井口。

dialogue.en: The Tang monk looked at the king's body
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk lʊkt æt ðə kɪŋz ˈbɑdi

dialogue.en: I wish we could bring him back to life
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪʃ wi kʊd brɪŋ hɪm bæk tu laɪf
dialogue.zh: 真希望能让他起死回生。

dialogue.en: Wukong can bring him back to life
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ kæn brɪŋ hɪm bæk tu laɪf

dialogue.en: Please bring him back to life right away
dialogue.ipa: pliz brɪŋ hɪm bæk tu laɪf raɪt əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: I don't know how to do that
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ haʊ tu du ðæt
dialogue.zh: 我可不知道该怎么做到

dialogue.en: He can bring the king back to life
dialogue.ipa: hi kæn brɪŋ ðə kɪŋ bæk tu laɪf

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Asked the prince
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: Ba jie was furious that Wukong had tricked him
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: We need proof that he killed the real king
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: My friends and I are helping the king of the black rooster kingdom
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I will have you arrested for making up such a story
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: When the Tang monk's story was finished
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Wukong can bring him back to life
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: I wish we could bring him back to life
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Your story must be true
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Leave me alone sleeping
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: I know where there's treasure
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: He poked bajie who was fast asleep
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When the Tang monk's story was finished
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I know where there's treasure
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

collocations.context: What's going on
I will have you arrested for making up such a story
He pulled out the Jade coin
He began to cry
We'll get rid of that fake king
Bajie wake up
Find the treasure and I let you back up
He looked up
You came from the well
He said to himself
The next morning
The Tang monk looked at the king's body
Please bring him back to life right away
He just doesn't want to

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 46 one thousand pills

dialogue.en: The Tang monk glared at Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɡlɛrd æt wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: Ba jie says you can bring the king back to life
dialogue.ipa: Ba ʤi sɛz ju kæn brɪŋ ðə kɪŋ bæk tu laɪf
dialogue.zh: 八戒说你能让国王复活

dialogue.en: Wukong shot a look at ba jie
dialogue.ipa: wu kæŋ ʃɑt ə lʊk æt ba ʤi

dialogue.en: Who was trying not to laugh
dialogue.ipa: hu wʌz ˈtraɪɪŋ nɑt tu læf
dialogue.zh: 八戒正强忍着不笑出来

dialogue.en: He makes pills that can make people live forever
dialogue.ipa: hi meɪks pɪlz ðæt kæn meɪk ˈpipəl lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 他炼制能让人长生不老的仙丹

dialogue.en: Maybe he makes pills that can bring people back to life
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi hi meɪks pɪlz ðæt kæn brɪŋ ˈpipəl bæk tu laɪf
dialogue.zh: 或许他也有能让人起死回生的丹药

dialogue.en: Laozi was busy working on a potion
dialogue.ipa: Laozi wʌz ˈbɪzi ˈwɜrkɪŋ ɑn ə ˈpoʊʃən
dialogue.zh: 太上老君正忙着炼制一剂仙药

dialogue.en: Steam rose from the bubbling cauldron
dialogue.ipa: stim roʊz frʌm ðə ˈbʌbəlɪŋ ˈkɑldrən
dialogue.zh: 沸腾的丹炉冒出缕缕蒸汽

dialogue.en: Suddenly Wukong burst into the room
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli Wukong bɜrst ˈɪntu ðə rum

dialogue.en: What are you doing here Wukong
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɑr ju ˈduɪŋ hir wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: You're supposed to be helping the Tang monk reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: jʊr səˈpoʊzd tu bi ˈhɛlpɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 你不是应该帮唐僧去西天取经吗

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wɔkt əˈraʊnd ðə rum
dialogue.zh: 悟空在房间里踱来踱去

dialogue.en: Looking at all the bottles and equipment
dialogue.ipa: ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ɔl ðə ˈbɑtəlz ænd ɪˈkwɪpmənt
dialogue.zh: 打量着所有的瓶瓶罐罐和器具

dialogue.en: I'm still helping the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪm stɪl ˈhɛlpɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: We're helping a king right now though
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈhɛlpɪŋ ə kɪŋ raɪt naʊ ðoʊ
dialogue.zh: 不过眼下我们正在帮助一位国王

dialogue.en: He poked a blue bottle filled with liquid
dialogue.ipa: hi poʊkt ə blu ˈbɑtəl fɪld wɪð ˈlɪkwɪd
dialogue.zh: 他戳了戳一个装满液体的蓝色瓶子

dialogue.en: Laozi looked up from his potion
dialogue.ipa: Laozi lʊkt ʌp frʌm hɪz ˈpoʊʃən
dialogue.zh: 太上老君从药炉前抬起头来

dialogue.en: Just tell me why you're here
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst tɛl mi waɪ jʊr hir
dialogue.zh: 直接告诉我你来这儿的目的

dialogue.en: I need pills that will bring someone back to life
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid pɪlz ðæt wɪl brɪŋ ˈsʌmˌwʌn bæk tu laɪf
dialogue.zh: 我需要能让人起死回生的丹药

dialogue.en: Give me one thousand of them
dialogue.ipa: ɡɪv mi wʌn ˈθaʊzənd ʌv ðɛm

dialogue.en: Laozi stopped what he was doing and walked over to Wukong
dialogue.ipa: Lauce stɑpt wɑt hi wʌz ˈduɪŋ ænd wɔkt ˈoʊvər tu wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 太上老君停下手中的活儿,走到悟空面前

dialogue.en: How dare you tell me to give you one thousand pills
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju tɛl mi tu ɡɪv ju wʌn ˈθaʊzənd pɪlz
dialogue.zh: 你竟敢让我给你一千颗仙丹

dialogue.en: Get out of here right now
dialogue.ipa: ɡɛt aʊt ʌv hir raɪt naʊ

dialogue.en: I don't really need one thousand pills
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt ˈrɪli nid wʌn ˈθaʊzənd pɪlz
dialogue.zh: 其实我不需要一千颗仙丹

dialogue.en: Laozi squeezed his hands into fists
dialogue.ipa: Laoai skwizd hɪz hændz ˈɪntu fɪsts

dialogue.en: I'm not giving you any pills
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈɡɪvɪŋ ju ˈɛni pɪlz
dialogue.zh: 我一颗仙丹都不会给你

dialogue.en: Now that I think about it
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ðæt aɪ θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ɪt

dialogue.en: I don't need one hundred pills
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt nid wʌn ˈhʌndrɪd pɪlz
dialogue.zh: 我也不需要一百颗仙丹

dialogue.en: I really just need one pill
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈrɪli ʤʌst nid wʌn pɪl
dialogue.zh: 其实我只需要一颗仙丹

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ saɪd ænd ðɛn lɛft
dialogue.zh: 悟空叹了口气,转身离去

dialogue.en: Laozi went back to his potion and stirred
dialogue.ipa: Laozi wɛnt bæk tu hɪz ˈpoʊʃən ænd stɜrd
dialogue.zh: 老君回到丹炉旁继续搅拌

dialogue.en: That monkey will definitely come back and cause trouble
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈmʌŋki wɪl ˈdɛfənətli kʌm bæk ænd kɑz ˈtrʌbəl
dialogue.zh: 那猴子肯定会回来捣乱

dialogue.en: I should just give him a pill
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʃʊd ʤʌst ɡɪv hɪm ə pɪl
dialogue.zh: 我还是给他一颗仙丹吧

dialogue.en: The sage opened a jar and took out a pill
dialogue.ipa: ðə seɪʤ ˈoʊpənd ə ʤɑr ænd tʊk aʊt ə pɪl
dialogue.zh: 老君打开丹瓶,取出一颗仙丹

dialogue.en: He went outside and found Wukong waiting for him
dialogue.ipa: hi wɛnt ˈaʊt ˈsaɪd ænd faʊnd wu kɔŋ ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr hɪm
dialogue.zh: 他走到外面,发现悟空正在等他

dialogue.en: I was just trying to decide what sort of trouble I could cause for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ʤʌst ˈtraɪɪŋ tu ˌdɪˈsaɪd wɑt sɔrt ʌv ˈtrʌbəl aɪ kʊd kɑz fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 我正琢磨着该怎么给你添乱呢

dialogue.ipa: Wukong rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə ˈmɑnə ˌstɛri

dialogue.en: Everyone watched as the monkey put the pill in the king's mouth
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn wɑʧt æz ðə ˈmʌŋki pʊt ðə pɪl ɪn ðə kɪŋz maʊθ
dialogue.zh: 众人看着猴子将仙丹放入国王口中

dialogue.en: And then his eyes popped open
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn hɪz aɪz pɑpt ˈoʊpən
dialogue.zh: 接着他猛然睁开了双眼

dialogue.en: The king sat up and looked at Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ sæt ʌp ænd lʊkt æt Wukong
dialogue.zh: 国王坐起身来,望向悟空

dialogue.en: He turned and saw the prince standing nearby
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd ænd sɔ ðə prɪns ˈstændɪŋ ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 他转过头,看见王子站在一旁

dialogue.en: He took his father's hands and bowed his head
dialogue.ipa: hi tʊk hɪz ˈfɑðərz hændz ænd baʊd hɪz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 他握住父亲的双手,低下了头

dialogue.en: It's time for you to return to your palace
dialogue.ipa: ɪts taɪm fɔr ju tu rɪˈtɜrn tu jʊər ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: The Prince led everyone to the palace
dialogue.ipa: ðə prɪns lɛd ˈɛvriˌwʌn tu ðə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 王子带领众人前往宫殿

dialogue.en: They walked past guards and went into the throne room
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɔkt pæst ɡɑrdz ænd wɛnt ˈɪntu ðə θroʊn rum
dialogue.zh: 他们经过卫兵,走进了王座大厅

dialogue.en: The Prince kneeled down before the Daoist
dialogue.ipa: ðə prɪns nild daʊn bɪ ˈfɔr ðə ˈdaʊɪst
dialogue.zh: 王子在道士面前跪了下来

dialogue.en: He is going to the western paradise to get scriptures from Buddha
dialogue.ipa: hi ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs tu ɡɛt ˈskrɪpʧərz frʌm ˈbudə

dialogue.en: The daoist looked at a person standing near them
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdaʊɪst lʊkt æt ə ˈpɜrsən ˈstændɪŋ nɪr ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 道士看向站在他们附近的一个人

dialogue.en: The person was wearing a hood
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈpɜrsən wʌz ˈwɛrɪŋ ə hʊd

dialogue.en: Who is that man wearing the hood
dialogue.ipa: hu ɪz ðæt mæn ˈwɛrɪŋ ðə hʊd

dialogue.en: The man pulled the hood back and showed his face
dialogue.ipa: ðə mæn pʊld ðə hʊd bæk ænd ʃoʊd hɪz feɪs
dialogue.zh: 那人掀开兜帽,露出了脸

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar and leaped toward the Daoist
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd lɛpt təˈwɔrd ðə ˈdaʊɪst
dialogue.zh: 悟空抽出铁棒,向道士扑去

dialogue.en: The daoist snapped his fingers and vanished
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdaʊɪst snæpt hɪz ˈfɪŋɡərz ænd ˈvænɪʃt
dialogue.zh: 道士打了个响指,消失不见了

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said the monk
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Who was trying not to laugh
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I need pills that will bring someone back to life
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: He is going to the western paradise to get scriptures from Buddha
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll ask laozi for help
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Ba jie says you can bring the king back to life
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: I was just trying to decide what sort of trouble I could cause for you
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: I should just give him a pill
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: He is going to the western paradise to get scriptures from Buddha
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Give me one thousand of them
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who was trying not to laugh
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: Please do so now
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: Just tell me why you're here
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 47 two Tang monks

dialogue.en: Wukong ran outside and shot into the air
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ræn ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd ʃɑt ˈɪntu ði ɛr
dialogue.zh: 悟空跑到外面,腾空而起

dialogue.en: Then he heard a shout from inside the palace
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi hɜrd ə ʃaʊt frʌm ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 这时他听到宫殿里传来一声喊叫

dialogue.en: Two Tang monks stood side by side
dialogue.ipa: tu tæŋ mʌŋks stʊd saɪd baɪ saɪd

dialogue.en: Which one of you is the real Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wɪʧ wʌn ʌv ju ɪz ðə riəl tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 你们俩谁是真正的唐僧

dialogue.en: The other monk glared at the first one
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðər mʌŋk ɡlɛrd æt ðə fɜrst wʌn
dialogue.zh: 另一个和尚瞪着第一个

dialogue.en: The first monk looked at Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə fɜrst mʌŋk lʊkt æt wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: I am the real Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ðə riəl tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: I am the real Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ðə riəl tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Angry Wukong pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ˈæŋɡri wu kɔŋ pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Which one of you is the real Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wɪʧ wʌn ʌv ju ɪz ðə riəl tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 你们俩谁是真正的唐僧

dialogue.en: Both Tang monks fell to their knees
dialogue.ipa: boʊθ tæŋ mʌŋks fɛl tu ðɛr niz

dialogue.en: He turned to Bajie and Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd tu Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ

dialogue.en: The two Tang monk should recite the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu tæŋ mʌŋk ʃʊd rəˈsaɪt ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl
dialogue.zh: 让两个唐僧都念紧箍咒

dialogue.en: Guan Yin and Buddha know the spell
dialogue.ipa: Guan jɪn ænd ˈbudə noʊ ðə spɛl

dialogue.en: We'll know right away which Tang monk is fake
dialogue.ipa: wil noʊ raɪt əˈweɪ wɪʧ tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz feɪk
dialogue.zh: 我们立刻就能知道哪个唐僧是假的

dialogue.en: You just want to see me in pain
dialogue.ipa: ju ʤʌst wɑnt tu si mi ɪn peɪn

dialogue.en: But it is a good idea
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ɪt ɪz ə ɡʊd aɪˈdiə

dialogue.en: Ba Jie and Wu Jing stood near the monks master
dialogue.ipa: Ba ʤi ænd wu ʤɪŋ stʊd nɪr ðə mʌŋks ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净站到两位师父身旁

dialogue.en: And Wukong fell to the floor
dialogue.ipa: ænd wu kɔŋ fɛl tu ðə flɔr

dialogue.en: Bajie watched the Tang monks carefully
dialogue.ipa: Baojie wɑʧt ðə tæŋ mʌŋks ˈkɛrfəli
dialogue.zh: 八戒仔细观察着两个唐僧

dialogue.en: One of them was reciting the spell
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ʌv ðɛm wʌz riˈsaɪtɪŋ ðə spɛl

dialogue.en: This is the fake Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ðə feɪk tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: The real monk stopped reciting the spell
dialogue.ipa: ðə riəl mʌŋk stɑpt ri ˈsaɪtɪŋ ðə spɛl

dialogue.en: Bajie and Wu Jing tried to grab the fake monk
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ traɪd tu ɡræb ðə feɪk mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净试图抓住假唐僧

dialogue.en: But the monk changed into a green lion
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə mʌŋk ʧeɪnʤd ˈɪntu ə ɡrin ˈlaɪən
dialogue.zh: 但那唐僧变成了一头青狮

dialogue.en: And ran out of the throne room
dialogue.ipa: ænd ræn aʊt ʌv ðə θroʊn rum

dialogue.en: He and his companions chase the lion
dialogue.ipa: hi ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ʧeɪs ðə ˈlaɪən
dialogue.zh: 他和同伴们追赶着狮子

dialogue.en: The lion leaped into the air
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈlaɪən lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr

dialogue.en: Wukong and the others shot after him
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd ði ˈʌðərz ʃɑt ˈæftər hɪm

dialogue.en: And soon they had the lion surrounded
dialogue.ipa: ænd sun ðeɪ hæd ðə ˈlaɪən səˈraʊndɪd
dialogue.zh: 很快他们就把狮子包围了

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar and raised it to strike
dialogue.ipa: Wukong pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd reɪzd ɪt tu straɪk
dialogue.zh: 悟空抽出铁棒举起来要打

dialogue.en: Just then a deep voice called out
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn ə dip vɔɪs kɔld aʊt
dialogue.zh: 就在这时一个深沉的声音喊道

dialogue.en: This green lion is my pet
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɡrin ˈlaɪən ɪz maɪ pɛt

dialogue.en: The king of the Black Rooster kingdom was cruel to someone many years ago
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ ʌv ðə blæk ˈrustər ˈkɪŋdəm wʌz ˈkruəl tu ˈsʌm ˌwʌn ˈmɛni jɪrz əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 乌鸡国国王多年前曾对某人施以暴行

dialogue.en: So my lion came to earth to punish him
dialogue.ipa: soʊ maɪ ˈlaɪən keɪm tu ɜrθ tu ˈpʌnɪʃ hɪm
dialogue.zh: 所以我的狮子下凡来惩罚他

dialogue.en: The king's punishment is over now
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋz ˈpʌnɪʃmənt ɪz ˈoʊvər naʊ
dialogue.zh: 如今国王的惩罚期已满

dialogue.en: The bodhisattva and the lion disappeared above the clouds
dialogue.ipa: ðə boʊ dhisattva ænd ðə ˈlaɪən ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd əˈbʌv ðə klaʊdz
dialogue.zh: 菩萨与狮子在云端之上消失无踪

dialogue.en: The king of the Black Rooster kingdom hosted a feast
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ ʌv ðə blæk ˈrustər ˈkɪŋdəm ˈhoʊstɪd ə fist

dialogue.en: He turned to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: I hope you will reach the western paradise very soon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp ju wɪl riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs ˈvɛri sun
dialogue.zh: 愿你们早日抵达西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: One day Wukong saw a mysterious red cloud over the mountains ahead
dialogue.ipa: wʌn deɪ wu kɔŋ sɔ ə mɪsˈtɪriəs rɛd klaʊd ˈoʊvər ðə ˈmaʊntənz əˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 一日悟空望见前方山峦上空有朵诡异的红云

dialogue.en: I thought I saw a red cloud
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɔt aɪ sɔ ə rɛd klaʊd
dialogue.zh: 方才似乎瞥见一朵红云

dialogue.en: Wukong saw the red cloud again
dialogue.ipa: Wukong sɔ ðə rɛd klaʊd əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 悟空再次看见那朵红云

dialogue.en: He held up his hand for the others to stop
dialogue.ipa: hi hɛld ʌp hɪz hænd fɔr ði ˈʌðərz tu stɑp

dialogue.en: The red cloud disappeared once again
dialogue.ipa: ðə rɛd klaʊd ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd wʌns əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: And Wukong started to walk again
dialogue.ipa: ænd wu kɔŋ ˈstɑrtɪd tu wɔk ə ˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: But then the red cloud reappeared
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðɛn ðə rɛd klaʊd ˌriəˈpɪrd

dialogue.en: Wukong should we keep going or not
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʃʊd wi kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɔr nɑt
dialogue.zh: 悟空 咱们到底走是不走

grammar.source: The two Tang monk should recite the tight headband spell
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: You just want to see me in pain
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: Bajie and Wu Jing tried to grab the fake monk
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Get him
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There are two Tang monks
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So my lion came to earth to punish him
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 48 The Scared Boy

dialogue.en: A red cloud keeps appearing over those mountains
dialogue.ipa: ə rɛd klaʊd kips əˈpɪrɪŋ ˈoʊvər ðoʊz ˈmaʊntənz
dialogue.zh: 那片山头上反复出现红云

dialogue.en: There must be a demon ahead
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr mʌst bi ə ˈdimən əˈhɛd

dialogue.en: The road leads right into those mountains
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊd lidz raɪt ˈɪntu ðoʊz ˈmaʊntənz

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar and held it up
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd hɛld ɪt ʌp
dialogue.zh: 他抽出金箍棒横在身前

dialogue.en: Wu Jing held up his spear
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ hɛld ʌp hɪz spɪr

dialogue.en: And Ba Jie held up his rake
dialogue.ipa: ænd Ba ʤi hɛld ʌp hɪz reɪk

dialogue.en: A red demon sat on a mountain peak
dialogue.ipa: ə rɛd ˈdimən sæt ɑn ə ˈmaʊntən pik

dialogue.zh: 正窥视着渐行渐近的取经人

dialogue.en: The Tang monk has finally arrived in my mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk hæz ˈfaɪnəli əˈraɪvd ɪn maɪ ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 唐僧终于来到我的山头了

dialogue.en: I've heard that eating just one bite of him will make me live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪv hɜrd ðæt ˈitɪŋ ʤʌst wʌn baɪt ʌv hɪm wɪl meɪk mi lɪv fə ˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 听说只要吃他一口肉就能长生不老

dialogue.en: The demon looked at the travelers again
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən lʊkt æt ðə ˈtrævələrz əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: The monk's companions have their weapons out
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋks kəm ˈpænjənz hæv ðɛr ˈwɛpənz aʊt
dialogue.zh: 唐僧的同伴们都亮出了兵器

dialogue.en: They probably saw my red cloud
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈprɑbəbli sɔ maɪ rɛd klaʊd
dialogue.zh: 他们大概是看见我的红云了

dialogue.en: I'll have to trick them with a disguise
dialogue.ipa: aɪl hæv tu trɪk ðɛm wɪð ə dɪs ˈɡaɪz
dialogue.zh: 我得用个伪装来骗过他们

dialogue.en: The demon made himself look like a scared little boy
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk ə skɛrd ˈlɪtəl bɔɪ
dialogue.zh: 妖怪把自己变成个受惊的小男孩模样

dialogue.en: Then he went down to the road
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi wɛnt daʊn tu ðə roʊd

dialogue.zh: 很快行路者们就靠近了

dialogue.en: The Tang monk saw the boy and got down from his horse
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk sɔ ðə bɔɪ ænd ɡɑt daʊn frʌm hɪz hɔrs
dialogue.zh: 唐僧看见男孩便下了马

dialogue.en: The Tang monk scowled at the monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk skaʊld æt ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: He's just a scared little boy
dialogue.ipa: hiz ʤʌst ə skɛrd ˈlɪtəl bɔɪ
dialogue.zh: 他只是个受惊的小男孩

dialogue.en: He turned back to the boy
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd bæk tu ðə bɔɪ

dialogue.en: My family was attacked by robbers
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈfæməli wʌz əˈtækt baɪ ˈrɑbərz

dialogue.en: I won't let you eat the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ woʊnt lɛt ju it ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: You always fall for demons' tricks
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈɔlˌweɪz fɔl fɔr ˈdimənz trɪks

dialogue.en: Or I'll recite the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: ɔr aɪl rəˈsaɪt ðə taɪt ˈhɛd ˌbænd spɛl

dialogue.en: Wukong glared angrily at the boy
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ɡlɛrd ˈæŋɡrəli æt ðə bɔɪ
dialogue.zh: 悟空怒气冲冲地瞪着男孩

dialogue.en: But he didn't say another word
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hi ˈdɪdənt seɪ əˈnʌðər wɜrd

dialogue.en: The Tang monk helped the boy to stand up
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk hɛlpt ðə bɔɪ tu stænd ʌp

dialogue.en: The Tang monk waved Wukong over
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk weɪvd wu kɔŋ ˈoʊvər

dialogue.en: And don't be mean to him
dialogue.ipa: ænd doʊnt bi min tu hɪm

dialogue.en: With Wukong carrying the boy on his back
dialogue.ipa: wɪð WuKong ˈkæriɪŋ ðə bɔɪ ɑn hɪz bæk

dialogue.en: And soon his companions were far ahead
dialogue.ipa: ænd sun hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz wɜr fɑr əˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 很快,他的同伴们就远远地走在了前面

dialogue.ipa: sɛd wu kɔŋ tu ðə bɔɪ

dialogue.en: I don't know what you're talking about
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ wɑt jʊr ˈtɔkɪŋ əˈbaʊt

dialogue.en: Uprooting trees and almost knocking over Wukong
dialogue.ipa: əˈprutɪŋ triz ænd ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˈnɑkɪŋ ˈoʊvər wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 连根拔起树木,几乎将悟空吹倒

dialogue.en: I know that you're making this wind blow
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ ðæt jʊr ˈmeɪkɪŋ ðɪs wɪnd bloʊ
dialogue.zh: 我知道是你在兴风作浪

dialogue.en: Use all the magic you want
dialogue.ipa: juz ɔl ðə ˈmæʤɪk ju wɑnt
dialogue.zh: 尽管使出你所有的法术吧

dialogue.en: You won't be able to blow me away
dialogue.ipa: ju woʊnt bi ˈeɪbəl tu bloʊ mi ə ˈweɪ

dialogue.en: I once defeated Heaven's entire army
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌns dɪˈfitɪd ˈhɛvənz ɪn ˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi

dialogue.en: The road now ran along the edge of a cliff
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊd naʊ ræn əˈlɔŋ ði ɛʤ ʌv ə klɪf
dialogue.zh: 道路此刻沿着悬崖边缘延伸

dialogue.en: I'll throw you over the edge of this cliff
dialogue.ipa: aɪl θroʊ ju ˈoʊvər ði ɛʤ ʌv ðɪs klɪf

dialogue.en: Then I'll just tell the Tang monk you ran away
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn aɪl ʤʌst tɛl ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ju ræn əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 那我就告诉唐僧你逃跑了

dialogue.en: The monkey tried to grab the boy from his back
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki traɪd tu ɡræb ðə bɔɪ frʌm hɪz bæk
dialogue.zh: 猴子试图从背上抓住那男孩

dialogue.en: And rushed ahead to find his friends master
dialogue.ipa: ænd rʌʃt əˈhɛd tu faɪnd hɪz frɛndz ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 急忙冲上前去寻找他的朋友和师父

dialogue.en: Trying to see through the dust
dialogue.ipa: ˈtraɪɪŋ tu si θru ðə dʌst

dialogue.en: He saw Bajie and Wu Jing lying by the road
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ ˈlaɪɪŋ baɪ ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 他看到八戒和悟净躺在路边

dialogue.ipa: wu kæŋ lʊkt ˈfræntəkəli ə ˈraʊnd

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: He said
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I know what you are
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I've heard that eating just one bite of him will make me live forever
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: My family was attacked by robbers
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Can you walk
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: There must be a demon ahead
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: I'll have to trick them with a disguise
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: The monkey tried to grab the boy from his back
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's all go home
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Be quiet Wukong
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That was some wind
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When the wind stopped
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I know what you are
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

Said the pig getting up

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 49 Red Boy

dialogue.en: We should all go home and forget about reaching the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wi ʃʊd ɔl ɡoʊ hoʊm ænd fərˈɡɛt əˈbaʊt ˈriʧɪŋ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我们都该回家去,别再想什么西天取经了。

dialogue.en: I'll return to my cave and take a nice long nap
dialogue.ipa: aɪl rɪˈtɜrn tu maɪ keɪv ænd teɪk ə naɪs lɔŋ næp
dialogue.zh: 我要回我的山洞,好好睡个长觉。

dialogue.en: I wasn't serious about going home
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈwɑzənt ˈsɪriəs əˈbaʊt ˈɡoʊɪŋ hoʊm
dialogue.zh: 我说要回家不是认真的。

dialogue.en: How many times have I warned him about demons
dialogue.ipa: haʊ ˈmɛni taɪmz hæv aɪ wɔrnd hɪm əˈbaʊt ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 我警告过他多少次提防妖怪?

dialogue.en: If he had listened to me earlier
dialogue.ipa: ɪf hi hæd ˈlɪsənd tu mi ˈɜrliər

dialogue.en: We need to figure out where the demon took him
dialogue.ipa: wi nid tu ˈfɪɡjər aʊt wɛr ðə ˈdimən tʊk hɪm
dialogue.zh: 我们得弄清妖怪把他抓去哪儿了。

dialogue.en: The monkey closed his eyes and muttered some words
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki kloʊzd hɪz aɪz ænd ˈmʌtərd sʌm wɜrdz

dialogue.en: I am the spirit of this mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ðə ˈspɪrət ʌv ðɪs ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Our master was kidnapped by a demon
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər ˈmæstər wʌz ˈkɪd ˌnæpt baɪ ə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 我们师父被妖怪抓走了。

dialogue.en: We think the demon lives near here
dialogue.ipa: wi θɪŋk ðə ˈdimən lɪvz nɪr hir
dialogue.zh: 我们觉得那妖怪就住在附近,

dialogue.en: Your master was probably kidnapped by Red Boy
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ˈmæstər wʌz ˈprɑbəbli ˈkɪdˌnæpt baɪ rɛd bɔɪ
dialogue.zh: 令师恐怕是被红孩儿掳去了。

dialogue.en: His cave is near the peak of that mountain
dialogue.ipa: hɪz keɪv ɪz nɪr ðə pik ʌv ðæt ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 他的洞府就在那座山的峰顶附近。

dialogue.en: The spirit pointed to a nearby mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈspɪrət ˈpɔɪntɪd tu ə ˈnɪrˈbaɪ ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 土地指向附近的一座山。

dialogue.en: His father is the Bull Demon King
dialogue.ipa: hɪz ˈfɑðər ɪz ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ

dialogue.en: One of the most horrible demons ever
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ʌv ðə moʊst ˈhɔrəbəl ˈdimənz ˈɛvər
dialogue.zh: 那可是世上最可怕的妖魔之一。

dialogue.en: A smile spread across Wukong's face
dialogue.ipa: ə smaɪl sprɛd əˈkrɔs wu kɔŋz feɪs

dialogue.en: Everyone looked at the monkey in surprise
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn lʊkt æt ðə ˈmʌŋki ɪn sərˈpraɪz
dialogue.zh: 众人都惊讶地看着猴子。

dialogue.en: The bull Demon King is an old friend of mine
dialogue.ipa: ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ ɪz ən oʊld frɛnd ʌv maɪn

dialogue.en: Before I caused trouble in heaven
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈfɔr aɪ kɑzd ˈtrʌbəl ɪn ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: I was friends with a group of demon kings
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz frɛndz wɪð ə ɡrup ʌv ˈdimən kɪŋz
dialogue.zh: 曾与几位魔王结为兄弟。

dialogue.en: The bull demon king was one of them
dialogue.ipa: ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ wʌz wʌn ʌv ðɛm

dialogue.en: When I tell Red Boy who I am
dialogue.ipa: wɛn aɪ tɛl rɛd bɔɪ hu aɪ æm
dialogue.zh: 待我告诉红孩儿我的身份

dialogue.en: He'll release the Tang monk right away
dialogue.ipa: hil riˈlis ðə tæŋ mʌŋk raɪt ə ˈweɪ

dialogue.en: The three travelers said goodbye to the spirit
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri ˈtrævələrz sɛd ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ tu ðə ˈspɪrət

dialogue.en: They came to a cave near the peak
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ keɪm tu ə keɪv nɪr ðə pik
dialogue.zh: 他们来到峰顶附近的一处洞府

dialogue.en: I need to speak with you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid tu spik wɪð ju

dialogue.en: I'm not going to return the Tang monk to you
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu rɪ ˈtɜrn ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tu ju
dialogue.zh: 我绝不会把唐僧还给你们

dialogue.en: I'm going to eat him and live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu it hɪm ænd lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: Now go away before I get very angry
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ɡoʊ əˈweɪ bɪˈfɔr aɪ ɡɛt ˈvɛri ˈæŋɡri
dialogue.zh: 趁我还没发火赶紧滚开

dialogue.en: You don't realize whom you're talking to
dialogue.ipa: ju doʊnt ˈriəˌlaɪz hum jʊr ˈtɔkɪŋ tu
dialogue.zh: 你可知自己在与谁说话

dialogue.en: Your father and I are old friends
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ˈfɑðər ænd aɪ ɑr oʊld frɛndz

dialogue.en: I don't care who you are
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt kɛr hu ju ɑr

dialogue.en: Now all of you get off my mountain
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ɔl ʌv ju ɡɛt ɔf maɪ ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 现在全都给我离开此山

dialogue.en: I was hoping we could solve this problem nicely
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ˈhoʊpɪŋ wi kʊd sɑlv ðɪs ˈprɑbləm ˈnaɪsli
dialogue.zh: 本指望我们能好生解决此事

dialogue.en: He removed the iron bar from his ear
dialogue.ipa: hi riˈmuvd ði ˈaɪərn bɑr frʌm hɪz ir

dialogue.en: Do you think I'm scared of your little weapon
dialogue.ipa: du ju θɪŋk aɪm skɛrd ʌv jʊər ˈlɪtəl ˈwɛpən
dialogue.zh: 你以为我会怕你这小玩意儿

dialogue.en: This iron bar is a treasure from heaven
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ˈaɪərn bɑr ɪz ə ˈtrɛʒər frʌm ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: It was used to measure the oceans and rivers
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz juzd tu ˈmɛʒər ði ˈoʊʃənz ænd ˈrɪvərz

dialogue.en: It is very powerful and can do whatever I tell it to do
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈpaʊərfəl ænd kæn du ˌwʌˈtɛvər aɪ tɛl ɪt tu du
dialogue.zh: 威力无穷且随我心意变化

dialogue.en: The monkey puffed out his chest
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki pʌft aʊt hɪz ʧɛst

dialogue.en: Now return the Tang monk at once
dialogue.ipa: naʊ rɪˈtɜrn ðə tæŋ mʌŋk æt wʌns

dialogue.en: Or I'll destroy your entire mountain
dialogue.ipa: ɔr aɪl dɪˈstrɔɪ jʊər ɪnˈtaɪər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 否则我将荡平你这整座山

dialogue.en: I also have a powerful weapon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ hæv ə ˈpaʊərfəl ˈwɛpən

dialogue.en: The demon punched himself in the nose
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən pʌnʧt hɪmˈsɛlf ɪn ðə noʊz
dialogue.zh: 那妖精朝自己鼻梁猛捶一拳
浓烟顿时从鼻孔喷涌而出

dialogue.en: And fire shot from his mouth
dialogue.ipa: ænd ˈfaɪər ʃɑt frʌm hɪz maʊθ
dialogue.zh: 火焰从他口中喷涌而出

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said Bajie
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: I was hoping we could solve this problem nicely
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: If he had listened to me earlier
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Wukong is right
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: He wouldn't have been kidnapped
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll return to my cave and take a nice long nap
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: He wouldn't have been kidnapped
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We can't go home
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: I was hoping we could solve this problem nicely
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: We should all go home and forget about reaching the western paradise
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Open up Red Boy
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That is good news
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If he had listened to me earlier
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When I tell Red Boy who I am
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: But we don't know where
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

He looked at Wukong

And he began to laugh
