It is very powerful and can do whatever I tell it to do
Now return the Tang monk at once
A moment later

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 50 Magic Fire

dialogue.en: Wukong and his companions ran back down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ræn bæk daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 悟空和同伴们跑下山去
红孩儿的火焰威力强大

dialogue.en: Wu Jing looked up at the mountain peak
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ lʊkt ʌp æt ðə ˈmaʊntən pik

dialogue.en: The fire is dying down now
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈfaɪər ɪz ˈdaɪɪŋ daʊn naʊ

dialogue.en: Looking at the last few wisps of smoke
dialogue.ipa: ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ðə læst fju wɪsps ʌv smoʊk

dialogue.en: But he'll use it again if we go back up there
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hil juz ɪt əˈɡɛn ɪf wi ɡoʊ bæk ʌp ðɛr
dialogue.zh: 但如果我们再上去,他还会用火的

dialogue.en: Then if he makes fire again
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ɪf hi meɪks ˈfaɪər əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: We can just put it out
dialogue.ipa: wi kæn ʤʌst pʊt ɪt aʊt

dialogue.en: I know who can help us
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ hu kæn hɛlp ʌs

dialogue.en: The monkey shot into the air and flew away
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ʃɑt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd flu əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 猴子纵身一跃飞向空中

dialogue.en: The Dragon King of the Eastern Sea was with him
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ʌv ði ˈistərn si wʌz wɪð hɪm
dialogue.zh: 东海龙王与他一同前来

dialogue.en: Wukong introduced the Dragon King to Ba Jie and Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˌɪntrəˈdust ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ tu Ba ʤi ænd wu ʤɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空向八戒和悟净介绍了龙王

dialogue.en: And get Red Boy to come out
dialogue.ipa: ænd ɡɛt rɛd bɔɪ tu kʌm aʊt

dialogue.en: As soon as he makes his fire
dialogue.ipa: æz sun æz hi meɪks hɪz ˈfaɪər

dialogue.en: The Dragon King flew up into the sky
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ flu ʌp ˈɪntu ðə skaɪ

dialogue.en: Wukong and the others returned to the cave
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd ði ˈʌðərz rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 悟空和其他人返回洞穴

dialogue.en: The monkey pounded on the cave door
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈpaʊndɪd ɑn ðə keɪv dɔr

dialogue.en: The door flew open and Red Boy ran outside
dialogue.ipa: ðə dɔr flu ˈoʊpən ænd rɛd bɔɪ ræn ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 门猛地打开,红孩儿跑了出来

dialogue.en: Release the Tang monk right now
dialogue.ipa: riˈlis ðə tæŋ mʌŋk raɪt naʊ

dialogue.en: He made a fist and punched himself in the nose
dialogue.ipa: hi meɪd ə fɪst ænd pʌnʧt hɪmˈsɛlf ɪn ðə noʊz
dialogue.zh: 他握紧拳头,一拳打在自己的鼻子上

dialogue.en: Smoke and fire poured from his face again
dialogue.ipa: smoʊk ænd ˈfaɪər pɔrd frʌm hɪz feɪs əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 烟与火再次从他脸上喷涌而出

dialogue.en: Thunder rumbled as dark clouds filled the sky
dialogue.ipa: ˈθʌndər ˈrʌmbəld æz dɑrk klaʊdz fɪld ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 雷声隆隆,乌云布满天空

dialogue.en: The fire however didn't go out
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈfaɪər ˌhaʊˈɛvər ˈdɪdənt ɡoʊ aʊt

dialogue.en: Instead it grew bigger and bigger
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈstɛd ɪt ɡru ˈbɪɡər ænd ˈbɪɡər

dialogue.en: He saw Bajie and Wu Jing running away
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ ˈrʌnɪŋ əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 他看到八戒和悟净正在逃跑

dialogue.en: The monkey tried to get to the cave door
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki traɪd tu ɡɛt tu ðə keɪv dɔr

dialogue.en: But the smoke was too thick
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə smoʊk wʌz tu θɪk

dialogue.en: He tripped on a rock and tumbled down the side of the mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi trɪpt ɑn ə rɑk ænd ˈtʌmbəld daʊn ðə saɪd əv ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 他被石头绊倒,从山坡上滚了下去。

dialogue.en: Wukong landed in a river and floated downstream
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈlændɪd ɪn ə ˈrɪvər ænd ˈfloʊtɪd ˈdaʊnˈstrim
dialogue.zh: 悟空掉进一条河里,顺流而下

dialogue.en: Finally he washed up on the Riverbank
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪnəli hi wɑʃt ʌp ɑn ðə ˈrɪvərˌbæŋk
dialogue.zh: 最终他被冲到了河岸上

dialogue.en: BA Jie and Wu Jing rushed over to the monkey
dialogue.ipa: bi-eɪ ʤi ænd wu ʤɪŋ rʌʃt ˈoʊvər tu ðə ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净急忙跑到猴子身边

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ɑr ju ɔl raɪt

dialogue.en: That fire is no ordinary fire
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈfaɪər ɪz noʊ ˈɔrdəˌnɛri ˈfaɪər

dialogue.en: Red Boy still has the Tang monk in his cave
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ stɪl hæz ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪn hɪz keɪv
dialogue.zh: 红孩儿还把唐僧关在他的洞里

dialogue.en: You breathe in a lot of smoke
dialogue.ipa: ju brið ɪn ə lɑt ʌv smoʊk

dialogue.en: But go straight to Guan Yin
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ɡoʊ streɪt tu Guan jɪn
dialogue.zh: 但要直接去找观音菩萨

dialogue.en: Meanwhile Red Boy was sitting on his mountain peak
dialogue.ipa: ˈminˌwaɪl rɛd bɔɪ wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ ɑn hɪz ˈmaʊntən pik
dialogue.zh: 与此同时,红孩儿正坐在他的山顶上

dialogue.en: My fire was too powerful for Sun Wukong and his friends
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈfaɪər wʌz tu ˈpaʊərfəl fɔr sʌn wu kɔŋ ænd hɪz frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 我的火对孙悟空和他的朋友们来说太强大了
妖怪拍了拍自己的肚子

dialogue.en: And that is good because I am hungry
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðæt ɪz ɡʊd bɪˈkɔz aɪ æm ˈhʌŋɡri

dialogue.en: I'll go inside now and start cooking the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ ɪn ˈsaɪd naʊ ænd stɑrt ˈkʊkɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我现在要进去开始煮唐僧了

dialogue.en: The demon stood up to leave when he spotted something in the sky
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən stʊd ʌp tu liv wɛn hi ˈspɑtɪd ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 妖怪站起来准备离开,这时他注意到天空中有东西

dialogue.en: Red boy thought for a minute
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ θɔt fɔr ə ˈmɪnət

dialogue.en: The Bodhisattva Guan Yin lives on Mount Potalaka
dialogue.ipa: ðə Bodhisattva Guan jɪn lɪvz ɑn maʊnt Potalaka
dialogue.zh: 观音菩萨住在南海的普陀山上

dialogue.en: The pig must be going to ask her for help
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ mʌst bi ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu æsk hɜr fɔr hɛlp
dialogue.zh: 这头猪一定是想去找她帮忙

dialogue.en: The demon recited a quick spell
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən rəˈsaɪtəd ə kwɪk spɛl

dialogue.en: Now Red Boy looked exactly like Guan Yin
dialogue.ipa: naʊ rɛd bɔɪ lʊkt ɪɡ ˈzæktli laɪk Guan jɪn
dialogue.zh: 此刻红孩儿变得和观音一模一样

dialogue.en: BA Jie soared through the sky on his cloud
dialogue.ipa: bi-eɪ ʤi sɔrd θru ðə skaɪ ɑn hɪz klaʊd

dialogue.en: He saw Guan Yin coming toward him
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ Guan jɪn ˈkʌmɪŋ təˈwɔrd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 他看见观音朝自己走来

dialogue.en: Cried the pig with a smile
dialogue.ipa: kraɪd ðə pɪɡ wɪð ə smaɪl

dialogue.en: I was just coming to see you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ʤʌst ˈkʌmɪŋ tu si ju

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong and his companions ran back down the mountain
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Meanwhile Red Boy was sitting on his mountain peak
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: We need water
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: The fire is dying down now
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: But he'll use it again if we go back up there
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We can just put it out
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: It must be magic fire
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: The monkey tried to get to the cave door
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Go back up the mountain
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: I know who can help us
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: But he'll use it again if we go back up there
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When he returned
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: And that is good because I am hungry
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: I think so
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I know who can help us
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: 比较级 + than / 比较级 and 比较级
grammar.description: 比较两者差异，或表达程度不断变化。
grammar.source: Instead it grew bigger and bigger
examples: Wukong is stronger than the demon.
This road is shorter than the other one.
The river is wider than before.
Bajie is hungrier than Wujing.
The mountain is higher than the hill.
The cave became darker and darker.
They walked faster and faster.
The sound grew louder and louder.
This plan is better than the first one.
The journey became more and more difficult.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 51 Guanyin becomes angry

dialogue.en: Bajie didn't know Guan Yin was really Red Boy in disguise
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ˈdɪdənt noʊ Guan jɪn wʌz ˈrɪli rɛd bɔɪ ɪn dɪsˈɡaɪz
dialogue.zh: 八戒不知观音实为红孩儿所变

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is in trouble
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz ɪn ˈtrʌbəl

dialogue.en: Said the pig to the fake Guan Yin
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə pɪɡ tu ðə feɪk Guan jɪn

dialogue.en: A demon named Red Boy is planning to eat him
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈdimən neɪmd rɛd bɔɪ ɪz ˈplænɪŋ tu it hɪm
dialogue.zh: 有个叫红孩儿的妖怪想吃他

dialogue.en: I doubt he'll harm the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ daʊt hil hɑrm ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Let's go to Red Boy's cave and talk to him
dialogue.ipa: lɛts ɡoʊ tu rɛd bɔɪz keɪv ænd tɔk tu hɪm
dialogue.zh: 我们去红孩儿的洞府和他谈谈

dialogue.en: Bajie and the fake Guanyin flew to Red Boy's cave
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd ðə feɪk Guanyin flu tu rɛd bɔɪz keɪv
dialogue.zh: 八戒与假观音飞往红孩儿洞府

dialogue.en: Red Boy returned to his normal appearance
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz ˈnɔrməl əˈpɪrəns

dialogue.en: And then sneaked up behind Bajie
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn snikt ʌp bɪˈhaɪnd Bajie

dialogue.en: He threw a sack over the pig
dialogue.ipa: hi θru ə sæk ˈoʊvər ðə pɪɡ

dialogue.en: I'm not Guan Yin you fool
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt Guan jɪn ju ful

dialogue.en: The demon locked Bajie in a room
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən lɑkt Bajie ɪn ə rum

dialogue.en: He probably stopped to take a nap
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈprɑbəbli stɑpt tu teɪk ə næp
dialogue.zh: 怕是又找地方打盹去了

dialogue.en: I'm going to sneak into Red Boy's cave
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu snik ˈɪntu rɛd bɔɪz keɪv

dialogue.en: I want to make sure the Tang monk is still alive
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt tu meɪk ʃʊr ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz stɪl əˈlaɪv

dialogue.en: Then I'll go to Guan Yin myself
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn aɪl ɡoʊ tu Guan jɪn ˌmaɪˈsɛlf

dialogue.en: The monkey turned himself into a bee
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki tɜrnd hɪmˈsɛlf ˈɪntu ə bi

dialogue.en: He slipped through the cave door
dialogue.ipa: hi slɪpt θru ðə keɪv dɔr

dialogue.en: And flew down a long tunnel
dialogue.ipa: ænd flu daʊn ə lɔŋ ˈtʌnəl
dialogue.zh: 并飞入一条长长的隧道

dialogue.en: Soon he heard the Tang monk crying
dialogue.ipa: sun hi hɜrd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈkraɪɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 很快他听到了唐僧的哭声

dialogue.en: But at least he's still alive
dialogue.ipa: bʌt æt list hiz stɪl əˈlaɪv

dialogue.en: The monkey then heard a shout
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ðɛn hɜrd ə ʃaʊt
dialogue.zh: 猴子随即听到一声呼喊

dialogue.en: How dare you make yourself look like Guan Yin and fool me
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju meɪk jərˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk Guan jɪn ænd ful mi
dialogue.zh: 竟敢扮作观音的模样来骗我

dialogue.en: Bajie didn't take a nap after all
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ˈdɪdənt teɪk ə næp ˈæftər ɔl

dialogue.en: I must go to the real Guan Yin right away
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst ɡoʊ tu ðə riəl Guan jɪn raɪt əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 我得马上去找真正的观音

dialogue.en: The monkey flew out of the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki flu aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: And told Wu Jing what he'd just Learned
dialogue.ipa: ænd toʊld wu ʤɪŋ wɑt hid ʤʌst lɜrnd
dialogue.zh: 将刚才的见闻告诉了悟净

dialogue.en: Then he jumped onto a cloud and headed south
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ʤʌmpt ˈɑntu ə klaʊd ænd ˈhɛdɪd saʊθ
dialogue.zh: 随即跳上云头向南飞去

dialogue.en: He found Guan Yin in her pagoda
dialogue.ipa: hi faʊnd Guan jɪn ɪn hɜr pə ˈɡoʊdə
dialogue.zh: 他在宝塔中找到了观音

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ waɪ ɑr ju hir

dialogue.en: The Tang monk was caught by a demon named Red Boy
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz kɑt baɪ ə ˈdimən neɪmd rɛd bɔɪ
dialogue.zh: 唐僧被一个叫红孩儿的妖怪抓走了

dialogue.en: The demon makes magic fire that water can't put out
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən meɪks ˈmæʤɪk ˈfaɪər ðæt ˈwɔtər kænt pʊt aʊt
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪会施水浇不灭的魔火

dialogue.en: Bajie was on his way here to ask for your help
dialogue.ipa: Bajie wʌz ɑn hɪz weɪ hir tu æsk fɔr jʊər hɛlp
dialogue.zh: 八戒本要来此向您求助

dialogue.en: But the demon made himself look like you and tricked the pig
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈdimən meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk ju ænd trɪkt ðə pɪɡ
dialogue.zh: 但妖怪变成您的模样骗过了那呆子

dialogue.en: Guan Yin's face burned with anger
dialogue.ipa: Guan jɪnz feɪs bɜrnd wɪð ˈæŋɡər

dialogue.en: How dare that demon make himself look like me
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ðæt ˈdimən meɪk hɪmˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk mi
dialogue.zh: 这妖怪竟敢冒充我的模样

dialogue.en: The Bodhisattva grabbed a vase and stormed outside
dialogue.ipa: ðə Bodhisattva ɡræbd ə veɪs ænd stɔrmd ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 菩萨抓起净瓶疾步而出

dialogue.en: She threw the vase down into the ocean
dialogue.ipa: ʃi θru ðə veɪs daʊn ˈɪntu ði ˈoʊʃən

dialogue.en: Where it sank beneath the waves
dialogue.ipa: wɛr ɪt sæŋk bɪˈniθ ðə weɪvz

dialogue.en: That vase was a Buddhist treasure
dialogue.ipa: ðæt veɪs wʌz ə ˈbudəst ˈtrɛʒər

dialogue.en: Why did you throw it away
dialogue.ipa: waɪ dɪd ju θroʊ ɪt əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: A minute later the water rumbled
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmɪnət ˈleɪtər ðə ˈwɔtər ˈrʌmbəld

dialogue.en: It was atop the shell of a giant turtle
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz əˈtɑp ðə ʃɛl ʌv ə ˈʤaɪənt ˈtɜrtəl
dialogue.zh: 正驮在一只巨龟的背壳上

dialogue.en: The turtle came onto the shore and bowed its head
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtɜrtəl keɪm ˈɑntu ðə ʃɔr ænd baʊd ɪts hɛd
dialogue.zh: 巨龟游上岸边低头行礼

dialogue.en: Go down and get the vase Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ɡoʊ daʊn ænd ɡɛt ðə veɪs wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: The monkey ran down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ræn daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: And tried to pick up the vase
dialogue.ipa: ænd traɪd tu pɪk ʌp ðə veɪs

dialogue.en: Wukong grunted and used all of his strength
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈɡrʌntɪd ænd juzd ɔl ʌv hɪz strɛŋkθ
dialogue.zh: 悟空闷哼一声使出全力

dialogue.en: But no matter how hard he tried
dialogue.ipa: bʌt noʊ ˈmætər haʊ hɑrd hi traɪd

dialogue.en: He couldn't lift the vase at all
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkʊdənt lɪft ðə veɪs æt ɔl

dialogue.en: That vase just traveled around the world
dialogue.ipa: ðæt veɪs ʤʌst ˈtrævəld əˈraʊnd ðə wɜrld
dialogue.zh: 那个花瓶刚刚环游了世界

dialogue.en: Through all the oceans and rivers
dialogue.ipa: θru ɔl ði ˈoʊʃənz ænd ˈrɪvərz
dialogue.zh: 穿越了所有的海洋与河流

dialogue.en: It now holds an ocean's worth of water
dialogue.ipa: ɪt naʊ hoʊldz ən ˈoʊʃənz wɜrθ ʌv ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 它现在盛满了足以媲美海洋的水量

dialogue.en: The water will put out Red Boy's fire
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔtər wɪl pʊt aʊt rɛd bɔɪz ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 这水能熄灭红孩儿的火焰

dialogue.en: Guanyin picked up the vase with one hand
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin pɪkt ʌp ðə veɪs wɪð wʌn hænd

dialogue.en: She held up her other hand
dialogue.ipa: ʃi hɛld ʌp hɜr ˈʌðər hænd

dialogue.en: And they turned into a large lotus platform
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðeɪ tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə lɑrʤ ˈloʊtəs ˈplætˌfɔrm
dialogue.zh: 宝剑便化作一座巨大的莲台

dialogue.en: I have what I need now
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv wɑt aɪ nid naʊ

grammar.source: Master is scared
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 52 an ocean from a vase

dialogue.en: Wukong and Guan Yin stood on the lotus platform above Red Boy's mountain
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd Guan jɪn stʊd ɑn ðə ˈloʊtəs ˈplætˌfɔrm ə ˈbʌv rɛd bɔɪz ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 悟空与观音立于红孩儿山巅的莲台之上
现在就去攻打红孩儿吧

dialogue.en: There's a lot of water in this vase
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz ə lɑt ʌv ˈwɔtər ɪn ðɪs veɪs

dialogue.en: I don't want any animals harmed when I pour it out
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt ˈɛni ˈænəməlz hɑrmd wɛn aɪ pɔr ɪt aʊt
dialogue.zh: 倾泻之时,我不愿伤及任何生灵

dialogue.en: A moment later the local spirit arrived
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər ðə ˈloʊkəl ˈspɪrət əˈraɪvd
dialogue.zh: 片刻后,当地山神应召而至

dialogue.en: What can I do for you
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kæn aɪ du fɔr ju

dialogue.en: I'm going to pour magic water around Red Boy's mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu pɔr ˈmæʤɪk ˈwɔtər əˈraʊnd rɛd bɔɪz ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 我将围绕红孩儿之山倾注神水

dialogue.en: Please make sure all the animals are far, far away from the mountain
dialogue.ipa: pliːz meɪk ʃʊr ɔːl ði ˈænəməlz ɑːr fɑːr fɑːr əˈweɪ frəm ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 务必确保所有动物都远离那座山

dialogue.en: The spirit flew down to Earth
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈspɪrət flu daʊn tu ɜrθ
wu kɔŋ wɑʧt ðə ɡraʊnd bɪˈloʊ

dialogue.en: First he saw some small animals scurry out from under bushes
dialogue.ipa: fɜrst hi sɔ sʌm smɔl ˈænəməlz ˈskɜri aʊt frʌm ˈʌndər ˈbʊʃəz
dialogue.zh: 先是瞧见小兽从灌木丛中窜出

dialogue.en: Then tigers Bears and other large animals
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ˈtaɪɡərz bɛrz ænd ˈʌðər lɑrdʒ ˈænəməlz
dialogue.zh: 然后老虎、熊和其他大型动物

dialogue.en: Soon there wasn't a single animal
dialogue.ipa: sun ðɛr ˈwɑzənt ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈænəməl

dialogue.en: Now I can pour the water out
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪ kæn pɔr ðə ˈwɔtər aʊt

dialogue.en: And rolling waves of water poured out
dialogue.ipa: ænd ˈroʊlɪŋ weɪvz ʌv ˈwɔtər pɔrd aʊt

dialogue.en: The waves washed down the slopes of the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə weɪvz wɑʃt daʊn ðə sloʊps ʌv ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: The water level rose higher and higher
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔtər ˈlɛvəl roʊz ˈhaɪər ænd ˈhaɪər

dialogue.en: Only the top of the mountain was above water
dialogue.ipa: ˈoʊnli ðə tɑp ʌv ðə ˈmaʊntən wʌz əˈbʌv ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: Wukong go down there and get the demon to come out
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ɡoʊ daʊn ðɛr ænd ɡɛt ðə ˈdimən tu kʌm aʊt
dialogue.zh: 悟空,下去把妖怪引出来

dialogue.en: Lead him up here to me
dialogue.ipa: lid hɪm ʌp hir tu mi

dialogue.en: Wukong jumped down to the mountain
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ʤʌmpt daʊn tu ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar and swung it
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd swʌŋ ɪt

dialogue.en: The door to the cave exploded
dialogue.ipa: ðə dɔr tu ðə keɪv ɪkˈsploʊdɪd

dialogue.en: Red boy ran out of the cave looking furious
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ ræn aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfjʊriəs
dialogue.zh: 红孩儿怒气冲冲地冲出山洞

dialogue.en: And I'll smash you if you don't release my friends
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪl smæʃ ju ɪf ju doʊnt riˈlis maɪ frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 不放出我的朋友,连你一起砸

dialogue.en: Red boy laughed and then punched himself in the nose
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ læft ænd ðɛn pʌnʧt hɪmˈsɛlf ɪn ðə noʊz
dialogue.zh: 红孩儿大笑,随即朝自己鼻子捶了一拳

dialogue.en: Why didn't my fire magic work
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ˈdɪdənt maɪ ˈfaɪər ˈmæʤɪk wɜrk

dialogue.en: Then he noticed the ocean surrounding his mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ˈnoʊtəst ði ˈoʊʃən səˈraʊndɪŋ hɪz ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 这时他才注意到山周围的海水

dialogue.en: Brought here by the Bodhisattva Guan Yin
dialogue.ipa: brɔt hir baɪ ðə Bodhisattva Guan jɪn

dialogue.en: You can't make fire anywhere near it
dialogue.ipa: ju kænt meɪk ˈfaɪər ˈɛniˌwɛr nɪr ɪt
dialogue.zh: 在这附近你根本生不起火

dialogue.en: Red boy stabbed at Wukong with his lance
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ stæbd æt wu kɔŋ wɪð hɪz læns

dialogue.en: The monkey blocked the lance with his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki blɑkt ðə læns wɪð hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Red Boy grunted and stabbed again
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ ˈɡrʌntɪd ænd stæbd ə ˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 红孩儿哼了一声再次刺来

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Nearly knocking the lance from Red Boy's hands
dialogue.ipa: ˈnɪrli ˈnɑkɪŋ ðə læns frʌm rɛd bɔɪz hændz
dialogue.zh: 差点把红孩儿的长枪震脱手

dialogue.ipa: ðə tu fɔt ənˈtɪl wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: Leaped into the air Red Boy
dialogue.ipa: lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr rɛd bɔɪ

dialogue.en: Up into the sky they flew
dialogue.ipa: ʌp ˈɪntu ðə skaɪ ðeɪ flu

dialogue.en: Red Boy kept jabbing his lance at Wukong
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ kɛpt ˈʤæbɪŋ hɪz læns æt wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 红孩儿不断朝悟空突刺

dialogue.en: The monkey blocked it with his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki blɑkt ɪt wɪð hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Wukong hurried toward Guan Yin on the lotus platform
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈhɜrid təˈwɔrd Guan jɪn ɑn ðə ˈloʊtəs ˈplætˌfɔrm
dialogue.zh: 悟空急向莲台上的观音飞去

dialogue.en: He flew fast and ducked behind her
dialogue.ipa: hi flu fæst ænd dʌkt bɪˈhaɪnd hɜr

dialogue.en: When Red Boy saw the Bodhisattva
dialogue.ipa: wɛn rɛd bɔɪ sɔ ðə Bodhisattva

dialogue.en: What are you doing here Bodhisattva
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɑr ju ˈduɪŋ hir Bodhisattva

dialogue.en: Guan Yin stared back at the demon
dialogue.ipa: Guan jɪn stɛrd bæk æt ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: But she didn't say a word
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ʃi ˈdɪdənt seɪ ə wɜrd

dialogue.en: Did Wukong ask you to come here
dialogue.ipa: dɪd wu kɔŋ æsk ju tu kʌm hir

dialogue.en: Guan Yin continued to stare silently at Red Boy
dialogue.ipa: Guan jɪn kən ˈtɪnjud tu stɛr ˈsaɪləntli æt rɛd bɔɪ
dialogue.zh: 观音继续默默凝视着红孩儿

dialogue.en: He raised his lance and shot toward Guan Yin
dialogue.ipa: hi reɪzd hɪz læns ænd ʃɑt təˈwɔrd Guan jɪn
dialogue.zh: 他举起长矛朝观音刺去

dialogue.en: I guess she was scared of me
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɛs ʃi wʌz skɛrd ʌv mi

dialogue.en: He looked at the empty lotus platform
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt ði ˈɛmpti ˈloʊtəs ˈplætˌfɔrm

dialogue.en: He couldn't defeat my fire magic
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkʊdənt dɪˈfit maɪ ˈfaɪər ˈmæʤɪk
dialogue.zh: 他破不了我的三昧真火

dialogue.en: So he asked Guan Yin for help
dialogue.ipa: soʊ hi æskt Guan jɪn fɔr hɛlp

dialogue.en: She ran away as soon as I raised my weapon
dialogue.ipa: ʃi ræn əˈweɪ æz sun æz aɪ reɪzd maɪ ˈwɛpən
dialogue.zh: 我刚举起兵器她就逃了

dialogue.en: Now this Buddha's treasure is mine
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ðɪs ˈbudəz ˈtrɛʒər ɪz maɪn

dialogue.en: Red Boy sat down on the platform
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ sæt daʊn ɑn ðə ˈplæt ˌfɔrm

dialogue.en: Instantly the platform turned back into swords
dialogue.ipa: ˈɪnstəntli ðə ˈplæt ˌfɔrm tɜrnd bæk ˈɪntu sɔrdz

dialogue.en: Sharp points stuck at him on all sides
dialogue.ipa: ʃɑrp pɔɪnts stʌk æt hɪm ɑn ɔl saɪdz
dialogue.zh: 四面八方的利刃直指其身

grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。

examples: Wukong could see the palace below.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形

examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That is magic water
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.

The guard who saw the demon shouted.

The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。

examples: If it rains, we will stay here.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果

examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.

grammar.pattern: Why don’t we/you + 动词原形?

grammar.source: Why don't you speak
examples: Why don't we follow the river?
Why don't we ask Wukong?
Why don't you wait here?
Why don't we look inside the cave?
Why don't we take a rest?
Why don't you tell the king?
Why don't we cross the bridge?
Why don't we call the others?
Why don't you bring some food?
Why don't we try another way?

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I asked why you're here
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: 比较级 + than / 比较级 and 比较级
grammar.description: 比较两者差异，或表达程度不断变化。
grammar.source: The water level rose higher and higher
examples: Wukong is stronger than the demon.
This road is shorter than the other one.
The river is wider than before.
Bajie is hungrier than Wujing.
The mountain is higher than the hill.
The cave became darker and darker.
They walked faster and faster.
The sound grew louder and louder.
This plan is better than the first one.
The journey became more and more difficult.

collocations.context: Holding up a hand
A moment later the local spirit arrived
Please make sure all the animals are far, far away from the mountain
Please make sure all the animals are far, far away from the mountain
The water level rose higher and higher
He pulled out his iron bar and swung it
Did Wukong ask you to come here
Guan Yin continued to stare silently at Red Boy
He looked at the empty lotus platform
She ran away as soon as I raised my weapon
She ran away as soon as I raised my weapon
Red Boy sat down on the platform
Instantly the platform turned back into swords

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 53 The Man in the canoe

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pikt æt rɛd bɔɪ
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空偷眼瞧着红孩儿

dialogue.en: The demon was trapped by the swords
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən wʌz træpt baɪ ðə sɔrdz

dialogue.zh: 刃尖尽数对准他的面门

dialogue.en: Get these swords away from me
dialogue.ipa: ɡɛt ðiz sɔrdz əˈweɪ frʌm mi

dialogue.en: Red Boy's eyes blazed with anger
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪz aɪz bleɪzd wɪð ˈæŋɡər

dialogue.zh: 红孩儿朝观音猛冲过去

dialogue.en: Wukong jumped in front of him
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʤʌmpt ɪn frʌnt ʌv hɪm

dialogue.en: The monkey was about to strike the demon
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki wʌz əˈbaʊt tu straɪk ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 猴子正要挥棒击打妖魔

dialogue.en: When Guanyin held up five metal bands
dialogue.ipa: wɛn Guanyin hɛld ʌp faɪv ˈmɛtəl bændz

dialogue.en: She threw them at Red Boy
dialogue.ipa: ʃi θru ðɛm æt rɛd bɔɪ

dialogue.en: Instantly they clamped around his head
dialogue.ipa: ˈɪnstəntli ðeɪ klæmpt ə ˈraʊnd hɪz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 金箍瞬间锁住他的头颅

dialogue.en: How dare you try to attack me
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju traɪ tu əˈtæk mi

dialogue.en: Red Boy glared at Guan Yin
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ ɡlɛrd æt Guan jɪn

dialogue.en: Wukong raised his iron bar to strike him
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ reɪzd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr tu straɪk hɪm

dialogue.en: I will take him back to Mount Putuo to be my student
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl teɪk hɪm bæk tu maʊnt Putuo tu bi maɪ ˈstudənt
dialogue.zh: 我要带他回普陀山做我的弟子

dialogue.en: Guanyin took the vase down to earth
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin tʊk ðə veɪs daʊn tu ɜrθ

dialogue.en: She recited a spell, and all the water flowed back into the vase
dialogue.ipa: ʃi rəˈsaɪtəd ə spɛl ænd ɔl ði ænd ɔl ðə ˈwɔtər floʊd bæk ˈɪntu ðə veɪs
dialogue.zh: 她念了句咒语,所有的水就都流回了花瓶里。

dialogue.en: She then led Red Boy toward the south
dialogue.ipa: ʃi ðɛn lɛd rɛd bɔɪ təˈwɔrd ðə saʊθ
dialogue.zh: 随后她领着红孩儿向南行去

dialogue.en: Wukong went into Red Boy's cave and freed the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wɛnt ˈɪntu rɛd bɔɪz keɪv ænd frid ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 悟空进入红孩儿的洞府救出了唐僧

dialogue.en: Then he found Ba Jie and freed him
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi faʊnd Ba ʤi ænd frid hɪm
dialogue.zh: 接着找到八戒并解开了他的束缚

dialogue.en: The three of them went down the mountain and found Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri ʌv ðɛm wɛnt daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən ænd faʊnd wu ʤɪŋ

dialogue.en: They traveled for weeks and then months
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈtrævəld fɔr wiks ænd ðɛn mʌnθs
dialogue.zh: 他们跋涉了数周又数月

dialogue.en: One day they came to a wide river
dialogue.ipa: wʌn deɪ ðeɪ keɪm tu ə waɪd ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 一日,他们来到一条宽阔的大河前

dialogue.en: I can't believe we have to cross another river
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt bɪˈliv wi hæv tu krɔs əˈnʌðər ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 真不敢相信又要过河了

dialogue.en: There are many rivers between here and the west
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ɑr ˈmɛni ˈrɪvərz bɪˈtwin hir ænd ðə wɛst
dialogue.zh: 从此处到西天还要经过许多河流

dialogue.en: We'll have to cross them all
dialogue.ipa: wil hæv tu krɔs ðɛm ɔl

dialogue.en: How will we cross this one
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl wi krɔs ðɪs wʌn

dialogue.en: A small canoe came into view
dialogue.ipa: ə smɔl kəˈnu keɪm ˈɪntu vju

dialogue.en: A man paddled it toward the travelers
dialogue.ipa: ə mæn ˈpædəld ɪt təˈwɔrd ðə ˈtrævələrz
dialogue.zh: 船夫划着船朝旅人们驶来

dialogue.en: He stared at the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: hi stɛrd æt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Called the man as he came closer
dialogue.ipa: kɔld ðə mæn æz hi keɪm ˈkloʊsər du

dialogue.en: Do you all need a ride across the river
dialogue.ipa: du ju ɔl nid ə raɪd əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: We were just wondering how we would get across
dialogue.ipa: wi wɜr ʤʌst ˈwʌndərɪŋ haʊ wi wʊd ɡɛt əˈkrɔs

dialogue.en: We're going to the west to get scriptures from Buddha
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə wɛst tu ɡɛt ˈskrɪpʧərz frʌm ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 我们要去西天拜佛求经

dialogue.en: You must be the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst bi ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: I've heard you would pass through this area eventually
dialogue.ipa: aɪv hɜrd ju wʊd pæs θru ðɪs ˈɛriə ɪˈvɛnʧəwəli
dialogue.zh: 早听说您终会途经此地

dialogue.en: Said the man with a smile
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə mæn wɪð ə smaɪl

dialogue.en: He glanced down at his canoe
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡlænst daʊn æt hɪz kəˈnu

dialogue.en: I would be happy to take you all across
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʊd bi ˈhæpi tu teɪk ju ɔl əˈkrɔs

dialogue.en: My canoe is not very big
dialogue.ipa: maɪ kəˈnu ɪz nɑt ˈvɛri bɪɡ

dialogue.en: I can take only two passengers at a time
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn teɪk ˈoʊnli tu ˈpæsənʤərz æt ə taɪm

dialogue.en: Something about the man didn't look quite right
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌmθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə mæn ˈdɪdənt lʊk kwaɪt raɪt
dialogue.zh: 这个人看起来有点不对劲

dialogue.en: The monkey was about to say something when Bajie stepped forward
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki wʌz əˈbaʊt tu seɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋ wɛn Bajie stɛpt ˈfɔrwərd
dialogue.zh: 猴子正要开口,八戒却抢先一步

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and I will go first
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd aɪ wɪl ɡoʊ fɜrst

dialogue.en: Master I don't think this is a good idea
dialogue.ipa: ˈmæstər aɪ doʊnt θɪŋk ðɪs ɪz ə ɡʊd aɪˈdiə
dialogue.zh: 师父,我觉得这不是个好主意

dialogue.ipa: ju ˈnɛvər trʌst ˈpipəl wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空,你总是不相信别人

dialogue.en: This kind man is willing to help us cross the river
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs kaɪnd mæn ɪz ˈwɪlɪŋ tu hɛlp ʌs krɔs ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 这位好心人愿意帮我们渡河

dialogue.en: The monkey bit his lip as the monk
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki bɪt hɪz lɪp æz ðə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 猴子咬着嘴唇,看着师父

dialogue.en: And bajie climbed into the canoe
dialogue.ipa: ænd bajie klaɪmd ˈɪntu ðə kəˈnu
dialogue.zh: 和八戒一起爬上了独木舟

dialogue.en: And the man paddled away from shore
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə mæn ˈpædəld ə ˈweɪ frʌm ʃɔr
dialogue.zh: 那人划着船离开了岸边

dialogue.en: Wukong watched the canoe glide across the river
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wɑʧt ðə kəˈnu ɡlaɪd əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 悟空看着独木舟滑过河面

dialogue.en: When it was about halfway across
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ɪt wʌz əˈbaʊt ˈhæˈfweɪ ə ˈkrɔs

dialogue.en: Am I imagining things or is the canoe sinking
dialogue.ipa: æm aɪ ɪˈmæʤənɪŋ θɪŋz ɔr ɪz ðə kəˈnu ˈsɪŋkɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 是我眼花了吗,船是不是在下沉?

dialogue.en: The two of them watched as the canoe slipped under the surface of the water
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ʌv ðɛm wɑʧt æz ðə kəˈnu slɪpt ˈʌndər ðə ˈsɜrfəs ʌv ðə ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 两人眼睁睁看着独木舟沉入水底

dialogue.en: That man kidnapped master and Bajie
dialogue.ipa: ðæt mæn ˈkɪdˌnæpt ˈmæstər ænd Bajie
dialogue.zh: 那人绑架了师父和八戒
我就知道他看起来可疑

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The demon was trapped by the swords
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I can't believe we have to cross another river
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: This kind man is willing to help us cross the river
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Then I'll release you
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: The demon was trapped by the swords
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can't believe we have to cross another river
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You must become a Buddhist
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: I can't believe we have to cross another river
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: How dare you try to attack me
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Get these swords away from me
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There are many rivers between here and the west
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When Guanyin held up five metal bands
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

collocations.context: All pointed at his face
Wukong jumped in front of him
When Guanyin held up five metal bands
How dare you try to attack me
One day they came to a wide river
I can't believe we have to cross another river
Called the man as he came closer
Master I don't think this is a good idea
This kind man is willing to help us cross the river
They sat down

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 54 the River God

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ stɛrd æt ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: I should have stopped master from getting in that canoe
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʃʊd hæv stɑpt ˈmæstər frʌm ˈɡɛtɪŋ ɪn ðæt kəˈnu
dialogue.zh: 我本该阻止师父上船的

dialogue.en: But whenever I warn him about someone
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wɛˈnɛvər aɪ wɔrn hɪm əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmˌwʌn
dialogue.zh: 但每次我提醒他要提防某人

dialogue.en: I'll find out where that man took our friends
dialogue.ipa: aɪl faɪnd aʊt wɛr ðæt mæn tʊk ˈaʊər frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 我去查查那人把我们的朋友带去哪儿了

dialogue.en: The Purple Spirit dived into the river
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈpɜrpəl ˈspɪrət daɪvd ˈɪntu ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: He soon came to a palace
dialogue.ipa: hi sun keɪm tu ə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 他很快来到一座宫殿前

dialogue.en: A sign on the gate read
dialogue.ipa: ə saɪn ɑn ðə ɡeɪt rid

dialogue.en: Home of the Black River God
dialogue.ipa: hoʊm ʌv ðə blæk ˈrɪvər ɡɑd

dialogue.en: Wu Jing tapped on the door with his spear
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ tæpt ɑn ðə dɔr wɪð hɪz spɪr

dialogue.en: And the other is a pig
dialogue.ipa: ænd ði ˈʌðər ɪz ə pɪɡ

dialogue.en: They were kidnapped by a man
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɜr ˈkɪdˌnæpt baɪ ə mæn

dialogue.en: I plan to eat the Tang monk and live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪ plæn tu it ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 我打算吃掉唐僧,以求长生不老

dialogue.en: Wu Jing struck the lizard with his spear
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ strʌk ðə ˈlɪzərd wɪð hɪz spɪr

dialogue.en: Blocking the spear with his tail
dialogue.ipa: ˈblɑkɪŋ ðə spɪr wɪð hɪz teɪl

dialogue.en: The force nearly knocked Wu Jing over
dialogue.ipa: ðə fɔrs ˈnɪrli nɑkt wu ʤɪŋ ˈoʊvər
dialogue.zh: 那股力量差点把悟净掀翻

dialogue.en: Right away the lizard was on top of him
dialogue.ipa: raɪt əˈweɪ ðə ˈlɪzərd wʌz ɑn tɑp ʌv hɪm
dialogue.zh: 蜥蜴立刻扑到了他身上

dialogue.en: Wu Jing swung his spear and then swam upward
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ swʌŋ hɪz spɪr ænd ðɛn swæm ˈʌpwərd
dialogue.zh: 悟净挥舞长矛,然后向上游去

dialogue.en: He splashed out of the river and landed next to Wukong
dialogue.ipa: hi splæʃt aʊt ʌv ðə ˈrɪvər ænd ˈlændɪd nɛkst tu Wukong
dialogue.zh: 他冲出河面,落在悟空身旁

dialogue.en: There's a lizard demon down there
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz ə ˈlɪzərd ˈdimən daʊn ðɛr

dialogue.en: Wukong was about to respond when he noticed someone nearby
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wʌz əˈbaʊt tu rɪˈspɑnd wɛn hi ˈnoʊtəst ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈnɪr ˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 悟空正要回答,却注意到附近有人

dialogue.en: The man from the canoe was walking toward them
dialogue.ipa: ðə mæn frʌm ðə kəˈnu wʌz ˈwɔkɪŋ təˈwɔrd ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 独木舟上的那个人正朝他们走来

dialogue.en: The monkey pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: How dare you kidnap our friends
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju ˈkɪdˌnæp ˈaʊər frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 你竟敢绑架我们的朋友

dialogue.en: The man fell to his knees shaking
dialogue.ipa: ðə mæn fɛl tu hɪz niz ˈʃeɪkɪŋ

dialogue.en: I am the Black River God
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ðə blæk ˈrɪvər ɡɑd

dialogue.en: But that lizard pretended he was me
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðæt ˈlɪzərd priˈtɛndɪd hi wʌz mi

dialogue.en: Wukong put the iron bar back in his ear
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pʊt ði ˈaɪərn bɑr bæk ɪn hɪz ir

dialogue.en: do you know who the lizard is
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd du ju noʊ hu ðə ˈlɪzərd ɪz

dialogue.en: He looked even more frightened now
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt ˈivɪn mɔr ˈfraɪtənd naʊ
dialogue.zh: 他现在看起来更加害怕了

dialogue.en: But his uncle is the mighty dragon king of the Eastern sea
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hɪz ˈʌŋkəl ɪz ðə ˈmaɪti ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ʌv ði ˈistərn si
dialogue.zh: 但他的舅舅是东海强大的龙王

dialogue.en: That Dragon is a friend of mine
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈdræɡən ɪz ə frɛnd ʌv maɪn

dialogue.en: He's also a bit scared of me
dialogue.ipa: hiz ˈɔlsoʊ ə bɪt skɛrd ʌv mi

dialogue.en: I'll go have a talk with him
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ hæv ə tɔk wɪð hɪm

dialogue.en: The monkey was at the Dragon King's palace
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki wʌz æt ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋz ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 猴子来到了龙王的宫殿

dialogue.en: What can I do for you
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kæn aɪ du fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 有什么我能为你效劳的

dialogue.en: Why did you let your nephew take over the Black River
dialogue.ipa: waɪ dɪd ju lɛt jʊər ˈnɛfju teɪk ˈoʊvər ðə blæk ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 你为什么让你的外甥霸占黑河

dialogue.en: A lizard demon took over the Black River
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈlɪzərd ˈdimən tʊk ˈoʊvər ðə blæk ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 一条蜥蜴精霸占了黑河

dialogue.en: And now he's planning to eat the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ænd naʊ hiz ˈplænɪŋ tu it ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 现在他正打算吃掉唐僧

dialogue.en: Wukong and the dragon flew back to the Black River
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd ðə ˈdræɡən flu bæk tu ðə blæk ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: Nephew come out of that river at once
dialogue.ipa: ˈnɛfju kʌm aʊt ʌv ðæt ˈrɪvər æt wʌns

dialogue.en: The lizard leaped from the river
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈlɪzərd lɛpt frʌm ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: It's nice of you to visit
dialogue.ipa: ɪts naɪs ʌv ju tu ˈvɪzət

dialogue.en: I'm here to take you to the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: aɪm hir tu teɪk ju tu ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 我是来带你去见玉帝的

dialogue.en: He followed his uncle up into the sky
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈfɑloʊd hɪz ˈʌŋkəl ʌp ˈɪntu ðə skaɪ

dialogue.en: The river god appeared from the water
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈrɪvər ɡɑd əˈpɪrd frʌm ðə ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and bajie were with him
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd bajie wɜr wɪð hɪm
dialogue.zh: 唐僧和八戒和他在一起

dialogue.en: But we still need to cross your river
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wi stɪl nid tu krɔs jʊər ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 但我们还需要过你的河

dialogue.en: The travelers walked across the muddy riverbed and continued west
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz wɔkt əˈkrɔs ðə ˈmʌdi ˈrɪvərˌbɛd ænd kənˈtɪnjud wɛst
dialogue.zh: 旅行者们走过泥泞的河床,继续向西

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: I should have stopped master from getting in that canoe
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The man from the canoe was walking toward them
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: What do you want
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: I should have stopped master from getting in that canoe
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll find out where that man took our friends
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: They were kidnapped by a man
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: What can I do for you
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: I should have stopped master from getting in that canoe
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Open up
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's a lizard demon down there
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: Wukong was about to respond when he noticed someone nearby
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I'll find out where that man took our friends
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 55 the monks and the cart

dialogue.en: The travelers had camped for a night in the woods
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz hæd kæmpt fɔr ə naɪt ɪn ðə wʊdz
dialogue.zh: 旅行们在树林里露营了一夜

dialogue.en: The Tang monk woke up and stretched
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk woʊk ʌp ænd strɛʧt

dialogue.en: Wu Jing opened his eyes and yawned
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ˈoʊpənd hɪz aɪz ænd jɔnd
dialogue.zh: 悟净睁开眼睛打了个哈欠

dialogue.en: Let me sleep just a few more hours
dialogue.ipa: lɛt mi slip ʤʌst ə fju mɔr ˈaʊərz

dialogue.en: The pig got to his feet
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ ɡɑt tu hɪz fit

dialogue.zh: 我们肩负着神圣的使命

dialogue.en: The Tang Empire will have the true scriptures
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpaɪər wɪl hæv ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz

dialogue.en: You should be happy to do all this work
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd bi ˈhæpi tu du ɔl ðɪs wɜrk
dialogue.zh: 你应该为做这些事感到高兴

dialogue.en: They went through a valley and over some hills
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɛnt θru ə ˈvæli ænd ˈoʊvər sʌm hɪlz
dialogue.zh: 他们穿过山谷,翻过几座山丘

dialogue.en: Later that afternoon they heard yelling
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪtər ðæt ˌæftərˈnun ðeɪ hɜrd ˈjɛlɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 当天下午晚些时候,他们听到叫喊声

dialogue.en: It sounds like some people are in trouble
dialogue.ipa: ɪt saʊndz laɪk sʌm ˈpipəl ɑr ɪn ˈtrʌbəl
dialogue.zh: 听起来像是有人遇到麻烦了

dialogue.en: The monkey leaped into the air and looked around
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd lʊkt əˈraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 猴子纵身跃到空中,环顾四周

dialogue.en: He saw a group of Buddhist monks pushing a cart up a steep hill
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ ə ɡrup ʌv ˈbudəst mʌŋks ˈpʊʃɪŋ ə kɑrt ʌp ə stip hɪl
dialogue.zh: 他看到一群和尚正推着车往陡峭的山坡上走

dialogue.en: The cart was loaded with big stones
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɑrt wʌz ˈloʊdɪd wɪð bɪɡ stoʊnz

dialogue.zh: 和尚们看起来苦不堪言

dialogue.en: Their robes were dirty and ripped
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr roʊbz wɜr ˈdɜrti ænd rɪpt

dialogue.en: They were dressed in fine clothes
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɜr drɛst ɪn faɪn kloʊðz

dialogue.en: They struggled to move the cart faster
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈstrʌɡəld tu muv ðə kɑrt ˈfæstər
dialogue.zh: 他们挣扎着想把车推得更快些

dialogue.en: Why are those monks pushing that cart
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɑr ðoʊz mʌŋks ˈpʊʃɪŋ ðæt kɑrt
dialogue.zh: 那些和尚为什么在推车

dialogue.en: And why are they scared of the Taoists
dialogue.ipa: ænd waɪ ɑr ðeɪ skɛrd ʌv ðə ˈdaʊəsts
dialogue.zh: 他们又为什么怕那些道士

dialogue.en: The monkey waited for the Daoist to leave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈweɪtɪd fɔr ðə ˈdaʊɪst tu liv

dialogue.en: Then he made himself look like a Buddhist monk
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk ə ˈbudəst mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 然后他把自己变成了一个和尚的模样

dialogue.en: Walking toward the group of monks
dialogue.ipa: ˈwɔkɪŋ təˈwɔrd ðə ɡrup ʌv mʌŋks

dialogue.en: Why are you pushing this cart
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɑr ju ˈpʊʃɪŋ ðɪs kɑrt

dialogue.en: The monks stopped pushing the cart and turned toward Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋks stɑpt ˈpʊʃɪŋ ðə kɑrt ænd tɜrnd təˈwɔrd wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 和尚们停下推车,转向悟空

dialogue.en: You should leave before you're discovered
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd liv bɪˈfɔr jʊr dɪ ˈskʌvərd
dialogue.zh: 你最好在被发现之前离开

dialogue.en: People from different religions can still get along
dialogue.ipa: ˈpipəl frʌm ˈdɪfərənt riˈlɪʤənz kæn stɪl ɡɛt əˈlɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 不同宗教的人也能和睦相处
这里的佛教徒备受虐待

dialogue.en: The Daoists make us do hard work
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdaʊɪsts meɪk ʌs du hɑrd wɜrk
dialogue.zh: 道士们让我们干苦力活

dialogue.en: Why do the Daoists treat you so badly
dialogue.ipa: waɪ du ðə ˈdaʊɪsts trit ju soʊ ˈbædli
dialogue.zh: 道士们为何如此苛待你们

dialogue.en: Years ago this kingdom had a drought
dialogue.ipa: jɪrz əˈɡoʊ ðɪs ˈkɪŋdəm hæd ə draʊt
dialogue.zh: 多年前这个王国遭遇旱灾

dialogue.en: Buddhist monks prayed to Buddha for rain
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudəst mʌŋks preɪd tu ˈbudə fɔr reɪn

dialogue.en: One day a powerful Daoist arrived
dialogue.ipa: wʌn deɪ ə ˈpaʊərfəl ˈdaʊɪst ə ˈraɪvd
dialogue.zh: 有一天来了一位法力高强的道士

dialogue.en: He recited prayers and right away rain fell
dialogue.ipa: hi rəˈsaɪtəd prɛrz ænd raɪt əˈweɪ reɪn fɛl
dialogue.zh: 他念诵祷文,雨水即刻降下

dialogue.en: Since then Daoists have been in charge
dialogue.ipa: sɪns ðɛn ˈdaʊɪsts hæv bɪn ɪn ʧɑrʤ
dialogue.zh: 自那以后便由道士掌权

dialogue.en: They destroyed all the Buddhist monasteries and statues
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ dɪ ˈstrɔɪd ɔl ðə ˈbudəst ˈmɑnəˌstɛriz ænd ˈstæˌʧuz
dialogue.zh: 他们捣毁了所有佛寺和佛像

dialogue.en: Those Daoists can't get away with this
dialogue.ipa: ðoʊz ˈdaʊɪsts kænt ɡɛt ə ˈweɪ wɪð ðɪs
dialogue.zh: 那些道士不能逍遥法外

dialogue.en: The Daoists won't treat us this way forever
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdaʊɪsts woʊnt trit ʌs ðɪs weɪ fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 道士不会永远这样对待我们

dialogue.en: The spirit of the planet Venus visited us in a dream one night
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈspɪrət ʌv ðə ˈplænət ˈvinəs ˈvɪzɪtɪd ʌs ɪn ə drim wʌn naɪt
dialogue.zh: 太白金星曾托梦给我们

dialogue.en: He said that one day someone would come along to save us
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd ðæt wʌn deɪ ˈsʌmˌwʌn wʊd kʌm əˈlɔŋ tu seɪv ʌs
dialogue.zh: 他说总有一天会有人来拯救我们

dialogue.en: Who is going to save you
dialogue.ipa: hu ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu seɪv ju
hɪz neɪm ɪz sʌn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: He is so powerful that Heaven's entire army couldn't defeat him
dialogue.ipa: hi ɪz soʊ ˈpaʊərfəl ðæt ˈhɛvənz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi ˈkʊdənt dɪˈfit hɪm
dialogue.zh: 他神通广大,连天庭全军都奈何不了他

dialogue.ipa: aɪv hɜrd ʌv sʌn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: And it's true that he's very powerful
dialogue.ipa: ænd ɪts tru ðæt hiz ˈvɛri ˈpaʊərfəl

dialogue.en: Did Venus tell you what he looks like
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ˈvinəs tɛl ju wɑt hi lʊks laɪk
dialogue.zh: 金星告诉你们他长什么样了吗

dialogue.en: So you'll recognize him if you see him
dialogue.ipa: soʊ jul ˈrɛkəɡˌnaɪz hɪm ɪf ju si hɪm
dialogue.zh: 所以你们见到他就能认出来

dialogue.en: A moment later he was a monkey again
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər hi wʌz ə ˈmʌŋki əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 转眼间他又变回了猴子模样

dialogue.en: They all fell to their knees and bowed
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ɔl fɛl tu ðɛr niz ænd baʊd

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The Tang monk woke up and stretched
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: The travelers had camped for a night in the woods
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。

examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 56 The Tiger Immortal

dialogue.en: Wukong led the monks to his companions
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lɛd ðə mʌŋks tu hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空领着僧人们去见他的同伴

dialogue.en: The monks told the Tang monk everything that they had told Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋks toʊld ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ðæt ðeɪ hæd toʊld wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 僧人们将告诉悟空的一切原原本本告诉了唐僧

dialogue.en: I'll deal with the tiger immortal in the morning
dialogue.ipa: aɪl dil wɪð ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 明早我来对付那虎力大仙

dialogue.en: The monks knew of an empty building nearby
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋks nu ʌv ən ˈɛmpti ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 僧人们知道附近有座空楼
他们带着行旅者前往那里

dialogue.en: And everyone went to sleep for the night
dialogue.ipa: ænd ˈɛvriˌwʌn wɛnt tu slip fɔr ðə naɪt

dialogue.en: The next morning Wukong woke up early
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ Wukong woʊk ʌp ˈɜrli
dialogue.zh: 次日清晨,悟空早早醒来

dialogue.en: Someone was pounding on the door of the building
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌmˌwʌn wʌz ˈpaʊndɪŋ ɑn ðə dɔr ʌv ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ

dialogue.en: The Tang monk's eyes popped open
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋks aɪz pɑpt ˈoʊpən

dialogue.en: He and all the other monks trembled with fear
dialogue.ipa: hi ænd ɔl ði ˈʌðər mʌŋks ˈtrɛmbəld wɪð fɪr
dialogue.zh: 他和所有僧人都吓得浑身发抖

dialogue.en: Wu Jing and Ba Jie drew their weapons
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ænd Ba ʤi dru ðɛr ˈwɛpənz

dialogue.en: And you should be ashamed of yourself
dialogue.ipa: ænd ju ʃʊd bi əˈʃeɪmd ʌv jərˈsɛlf

dialogue.en: Just because you're a little powerful
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst bɪˈkɔz jʊr ə ˈlɪtəl ˈpaʊərfəl

dialogue.en: You think you can treat the Buddhist monks badly
dialogue.ipa: ju θɪŋk ju kæn trit ðə ˈbudəst mʌŋks ˈbædli
ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl lʊkt ə ˈfɛndɪd

dialogue.en: You're not as powerful as I am
dialogue.ipa: jʊr nɑt æz ˈpaʊərfəl æz aɪ æm

dialogue.en: Did you know that the Jade Emperor is afraid of me
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju noʊ ðæt ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər ɪz əˈfreɪd ʌv mi

dialogue.en: I once defeated his entire army
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌns dɪˈfitɪd hɪz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 我曾打败过他十万天兵

dialogue.en: The Tiger Immortal puffed out his chest
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl pʌft aʊt hɪz ʧɛst

dialogue.en: I doubt you can do that
dialogue.ipa: aɪ daʊt ju kæn du ðæt

dialogue.en: Well then let's have a contest
dialogue.ipa: wɛl ðɛn lɛts hæv ə ˈkɑntɛst

dialogue.en: Whoever summons more rain is the winner
dialogue.ipa: huˈɛvər ˈsʌmənz mɔr reɪn ɪz ðə ˈwɪnər

dialogue.en: I'll let you and all the monks go free
dialogue.ipa: aɪl lɛt ju ænd ɔl ðə mʌŋks ɡoʊ fri
dialogue.zh: 我就放你和所有和尚自由

dialogue.en: You must stay here and be my slaves
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst steɪ hir ænd bi maɪ sleɪvz
dialogue.zh: 你们必须留在这里做我的奴隶

dialogue.en: The Tiger immortal LED everyone into town
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl lɛd ˈɛvriˌwʌn ˈɪntu taʊn
dialogue.zh: 虎力大仙领着众人进了城

dialogue.en: In the center of town was a Daoist altar
dialogue.ipa: ɪn ðə ˈsɛntər ʌv taʊn wʌz ə ˈdaʊɪst ˈɔltər

dialogue.en: And papers with magic writing were on the altar
dialogue.ipa: ænd ˈpeɪpərz wɪð ˈmæʤɪk ˈraɪtɪŋ wɜr ɑn ði ˈɔltər
dialogue.zh: 还有写着符咒的纸都摆在坛上

dialogue.en: A crowd of people arrived to see what was going on
dialogue.ipa: ə kraʊd ʌv ˈpipəl əˈraɪvd tu si wɑt wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn

dialogue.en: The Tang monk shook his head
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ʃʊk hɪz hɛd
wu kɔŋ wɪl wɪn ðɪs ˈkɑntɛst
dialogue.zh: 悟空肯定会赢这场比试

dialogue.en: But what if he doesn't win
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wɑt ɪf hi ˈdʌzənt wɪn

dialogue.en: Forced to work for the Tiger immortal
dialogue.ipa: fɔrst tu wɜrk fɔr ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪ ˈmɔrtəl

dialogue.en: We'll never reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wil ˈnɛvər riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs

dialogue.en: The true scriptures will never get to the Tang empire
dialogue.ipa: ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz wɪl ˈnɛvər ɡɛt tu ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpaɪər
dialogue.zh: 真经也永远传不到大唐

dialogue.en: The monk buried his face in his hands
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ˈbɛrid hɪz feɪs ɪn hɪz hændz

dialogue.en: We have nothing to worry about
dialogue.ipa: wi hæv ˈnʌθɪŋ tu ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt
wu kɔŋ stʊd baɪ ðɛm ˈsmaɪlɪŋ

dialogue.en: I will now pray to heaven for rain
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl naʊ preɪ tu ˈhɛvən fɔr reɪn

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal lit the incense and then sat down
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪ ˈmɔrtəl lɪt ði ɪnˈsɛns ænd ðɛn sæt daʊn
dialogue.zh: 虎力大仙点燃香烛后坐下

dialogue.en: He closed his eyes and began to recite a spell
dialogue.ipa: hi kloʊzd hɪz aɪz ænd bɪˈɡæn tu rəˈsaɪt ə spɛl

dialogue.en: Next he lit one of the papers on fire
dialogue.ipa: nɛkst hi lɪt wʌn ʌv ðə ˈpeɪpərz ɑn ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 接着他点燃了一张符纸

dialogue.en: Soon all of the papers were gone
dialogue.ipa: sun ɔl ʌv ðə ˈpeɪpərz wɜr ɡɔn
dialogue.zh: 很快所有符纸都烧尽了

dialogue.en: The Tiger immortal lifted the stone tablet
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl ˈlɪftɪd ðə stoʊn ˈtæblət

dialogue.en: There was a gasp from the crowd
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə ɡæsp frʌm ðə kraʊd

dialogue.en: Wukong looked up at the sky
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt ʌp æt ðə skaɪ

dialogue.en: Wind blew and dark clouds moved in
dialogue.ipa: wɪnd blu ænd dɑrk klaʊdz muvd ɪn
dialogue.zh: 风吹云涌 乌云压境

dialogue.en: The monkey recited a quick spell and then left his body
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki rəˈsaɪtəd ə kwɪk spɛl ænd ðɛn lɛft hɪz ˈbɑdi
dialogue.zh: 猴子念了个诀,魂魄离体而去

dialogue.en: He found the old woman of the wind fanning the clouds
dialogue.ipa: hi faʊnd ði oʊld ˈwʊmən ʌv ðə wɪnd ˈfænɪŋ ðə klaʊdz
dialogue.zh: 他看见风婆婆正在扇云

dialogue.en: The dragon King of the Eastern sea was approaching
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ʌv ði ˈistərn si wʌz əˈproʊʧɪŋ

The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you win
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.

If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When that one went out
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.

When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因

grammar.source: Just because you're a little powerful
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.

He returned because he forgot the map.

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 57 a guessing game

dialogue.en: Said the old woman of the wind
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ði oʊld ˈwʊmən ʌv ðə wɪnd

dialogue.en: Someone on earth just prayed for it
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɑn ɜrθ ʤʌst preɪd fɔr ɪt

dialogue.en: And the Jade emperor heard the prayers
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər hɜrd ðə prɛrz

dialogue.en: Added the Dragon king of the eastern sea
dialogue.ipa: ˈædɪd ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ ʌv ði ˈistərn si

dialogue.en: The person who recited the prayers is bad
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈpɜrsən hu rəˈsaɪtəd ðə prɛrz ɪz bæd

dialogue.en: And he plans to make the Tang monk a slave
dialogue.ipa: ænd hi plænz tu meɪk ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ə sleɪv

dialogue.en: We all want the Tang monk to reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wi ɔl wɑnt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tu riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我们都盼着唐僧能到西天

dialogue.en: But we must obey the Jade Emperor's orders
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wi mʌst oʊˈbeɪ ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərərz ˈɔrdərz
dialogue.zh: 但我们必须听从玉帝旨意

dialogue.en: I'll go back down to the ground now
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ bæk daʊn tu ðə ɡraʊnd naʊ

dialogue.en: When I raise my iron bar
dialogue.ipa: wɛn aɪ reɪz maɪ ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: The woman and the dragon king agreed to wait a moment
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwʊmən ænd ðə ˈdræɡən kɪŋ əˈɡrid tu weɪt ə ˈmoʊmənt
dialogue.zh: 风婆婆和龙王答应稍等

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz ˈbɑdi

dialogue.en: And the tiger immortal shook with anger
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl ʃʊk wɪð ˈæŋɡər

dialogue.en: You couldn't even summon one drop
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈkʊdənt ˈivɪn ˈsʌmən wʌn drɑp

dialogue.en: You had a chance to summon rain
dialogue.ipa: ju hæd ə ʧæns tu ˈsʌmən reɪn

dialogue.en: The monkey raised his iron bar into the air
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki reɪzd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ˈɪntu ði ɛr

dialogue.en: Now all the Buddhist monks will be free
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ɔl ðə ˈbudəst mʌŋks wɪl bi fri
dialogue.zh: 现在所有僧人都将获得自由

dialogue.en: And we can continue our journey
dialogue.ipa: ænd wi kæn kənˈtɪnju ˈaʊər ˈʤɜrni

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal stomped over to Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl stɑmpt ˈoʊvər tu wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 虎力大仙跺着脚走向悟空

dialogue.en: Why would you want another contest
dialogue.ipa: waɪ wʊd ju wɑnt əˈnʌðər ˈkɑntɛst

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal ignored the monkey's question
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪ ˈmɔrtəl ɪɡˈnɔrd ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ˈkwɛsʧən
dialogue.zh: 虎力大仙没理会猴子的问题

dialogue.en: I challenge the Tang monk to a guessing game
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈʧælənʤ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tu ə ˈɡɛsɪŋ ɡeɪm

dialogue.en: The Tang monk's mouth fell open
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋks maʊθ fɛl ˈoʊpən

dialogue.en: Said the monkey with a smile
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə ˈmʌŋki wɪð ə smaɪl

dialogue.en: Wukong why did you agree to this contest
dialogue.ipa: Wukong waɪ dɪd ju ə ˈɡri tu ðɪs ˈkɑntɛst

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal soon came back with a small box
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪ ˈmɔrtəl sun keɪm bæk wɪð ə smɔl bɑks
dialogue.zh: 虎力大仙很快捧着个小盒子回来

dialogue.en: If you can guess what's in this box
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju kæn ɡɛs wʌts ɪn ðɪs bɑks

dialogue.en: I will let you all go free
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl lɛt ju ɔl ɡoʊ fri
dialogue.zh: 我便放你们所有人离开

dialogue.en: As the Tang monk stared at the box
dialogue.ipa: æz ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stɛrd æt ðə bɑks

dialogue.en: He made the hair look like himself
dialogue.ipa: hi meɪd ðə hɛr lʊk laɪk hɪmˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 将毫毛变作自己的模样

dialogue.en: Then he made himself tiny and squeezed through a crack in the box
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf ˈtaɪni ænd skwizd θru ə kræk ɪn ðə bɑks

dialogue.en: Inside the box was a ripe peach
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bɑks wʌz ə raɪp piʧ

dialogue.en: A moment later he was standing next to the Tang monk again
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər hi wʌz ˈstændɪŋ nɛkst tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 转眼他已回到唐僧身旁

dialogue.en: Wukong leaned toward the monk and whispered
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lind tə ˈwɔrd ðə mʌŋk ænd ˈwɪspərd

dialogue.en: I think it's a peach pit
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɪŋk ɪts ə piʧ pɪt

dialogue.en: It's not just a peach pit
dialogue.ipa: ɪts nɑt ʤʌst ə piʧ pɪt

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal opened the box and showed it to everyone
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl ˈoʊpənd ðə bɑks ænd ʃoʊd ɪt tu ˈɛvriˌwʌn
dialogue.zh: 虎力大仙打开盒子,展示给大家看

dialogue.en: He looked in the box and gasped
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt ɪn ðə bɑks ænd ɡæspt
dialogue.zh: 他往盒子里一看,倒吸一口凉气

dialogue.en: I guess we can leave now
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɛs wi kæn liv naʊ
dialogue.zh: 我想我们现在可以走了

dialogue.en: Yes but we should eat some dinner first
dialogue.ipa: jɛs bʌt wi ʃʊd it sʌm ˈdɪnər fɜrst
dialogue.zh: 是的,不过我们应该先吃点晚饭

dialogue.en: All this talk about peaches has made me hungry
dialogue.ipa: ɔl ðɪs tɔk əˈbaʊt ˈpiʧəz hæz meɪd mi ˈhʌŋɡri
dialogue.zh: 说了这么多桃子的事,我都饿了

dialogue.en: Wukong looked at the Tiger immortal
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt æt ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪ ˈmɔrtəl

dialogue.en: You will set the Buddhist monks free now right
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl sɛt ðə ˈbudəst mʌŋks fri naʊ raɪt
dialogue.zh: 你现在会放了那些和尚吧,对吧

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal glared at the monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl ɡlɛrd æt ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: I challenge you to another contest
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈʧælənʤ ju tu əˈnʌðər ˈkɑntɛst

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said the old woman of the wind
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.

Bajie found some food.

The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: A moment later he was standing next to the Tang monk again
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I want another contest
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: All this talk about peaches has made me hungry
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。

examples: Wukong will protect the monk.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。

examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。

examples: Wukong could see the palace below.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
