titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 58 The Meditation Contest

dialogue.en: I challenge you to a meditation contest
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈʧælənʤ ju tu ə ˌmɛdə ˈteɪʃən ˈkɑntɛst

dialogue.en: Whoever can meditate the longest without moving is the winner
dialogue.ipa: huˈɛvər kæn ˈmɛdəˌteɪt ðə ˈlɔŋɡəst wɪˈθaʊt ˈmuvɪŋ ɪz ðə ˈwɪnər
dialogue.zh: 谁能打坐最久不动,谁就赢

dialogue.en: I used to meditate a lot
dialogue.ipa: aɪ juzd tu ˈmɛdəˌteɪt ə lɑt

dialogue.en: But I haven't done it lately
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ ˈhævənt dʌn ɪt ˈleɪtli

dialogue.en: This contest will be easy for me
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ˈkɑntɛst wɪl bi ˈizi fɔr mi
dialogue.zh: 这场比赛对我来说轻而易举

dialogue.en: This won't be an ordinary meditation contest
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs woʊnt bi ən ˈɔrdəˌnɛri ˌmɛdəˈteɪʃən ˈkɑntɛst
dialogue.zh: 这可不是普通的坐禅比赛

dialogue.en: We will float in the air and meditate
dialogue.ipa: wi wɪl floʊt ɪn ði ɛr ænd ˈmɛdə ˌteɪt

dialogue.en: Now the Tang monk looked nervous
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk lʊkt ˈnɜrvəs
dialogue.zh: 这下唐僧看起来紧张了

dialogue.en: But before the monk could answer
dialogue.ipa: bʌt bɪˈfɔr ðə mʌŋk kʊd ˈænsər

dialogue.en: Wukong clapped him on the back
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ klæpt hɪm ɑn ðə bæk

dialogue.en: Of course the Tang monk can float in the air
dialogue.ipa: ʌv kɔrs ðə tæŋ mʌŋk kæn floʊt ɪn ði ɛr
dialogue.zh: 唐僧当然也能浮在空中

dialogue.en: Then he whispered into the monk's ear
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ˈwɪspərd ˈɪntu ðə mʌŋks ir
dialogue.zh: 然后他凑到和尚耳边低语

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal and the Tang monk went in front of the crowd
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl ænd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɛnt ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə kraʊd
dialogue.zh: 虎力大仙和唐僧走到众人面前

dialogue.en: They sat down with their legs crossed and their palms facing up
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ sæt daʊn wɪð ðɛr lɛɡz krɔst ænd ðɛr pɑmz ˈfeɪsɪŋ ʌp
dialogue.zh: 他们盘腿坐下,掌心向上

dialogue.en: They closed their eyes and started meditating
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ kloʊzd ðɛr aɪz ænd ˈstɑrtɪd ˈmɛdəˌteɪtɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 他们闭上眼睛开始打坐

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal slowly floated up into the air
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪ ˈmɔrtəl ˈsloʊli ˈfloʊtɪd ʌp ˈɪntu ði ɛr
dialogue.zh: 虎力大仙缓缓浮到空中

dialogue.en: He just needs some help from me
dialogue.ipa: hi ʤʌst nidz sʌm hɛlp frʌm mi

dialogue.en: And then blew toward the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn blu təˈwɔrd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: The monk lifted off the ground
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ˈlɪftɪd ɔf ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: Soon was floating next to the tiger immortal
dialogue.ipa: sun wʌz ˈfloʊtɪŋ nɛkst tu ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl
dialogue.zh: 很快便浮在虎力大仙旁边

dialogue.en: I think master will win this contest
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɪŋk ˈmæstər wɪl wɪn ðɪs ˈkɑntɛst
dialogue.zh: 我觉得师父会赢得这场比试

dialogue.en: I'm pretty good at meditating too
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈprɪti ɡʊd æt ˈmɛdəˌteɪtɪŋ tu

dialogue.en: I could have competed in this contest
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kʊd hæv kəmˈpitɪd ɪn ðɪs ˈkɑntɛst
dialogue.zh: 这比试我本来也能参加

dialogue.en: It would take a lot of magic to lift you bajie
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʊd teɪk ə lɑt ʌv ˈmæʤɪk tu lɪft ju bajie
dialogue.zh: 要让你八戒浮起来可得费不少法力

dialogue.en: If the monk moves at all
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ðə mʌŋk muvz æt ɔl

dialogue.en: Wukong looked up at the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt ʌp æt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: I think he has an itch
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɪŋk hi hæz ən ɪʧ

dialogue.en: Wukong became invisible and flew up to the monk
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ bɪ ˈkeɪm ɪnˈvɪzəbəl ænd flu ʌp tu ðə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 悟空隐去身形飞向和尚

dialogue.en: A flea was crawling on the monk's head
dialogue.ipa: ə fli wʌz ˈkrɔlɪŋ ɑn ðə mʌŋks hɛd
dialogue.zh: 一只跳蚤正在和尚头上爬动

dialogue.en: Why would a flea be on the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: waɪ wʊd ə fli bi ɑn ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 跳蚤怎么会跑到唐僧身上

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal must have used magic to put this flea here
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl mʌst hæv juzd ˈmæʤɪk tu pʊt ðɪs fli hir
dialogue.zh: 肯定是虎力大仙施法把跳蚤弄来的

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ brʌʃt ðə fli əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: And scratched the Tang monk's head
dialogue.ipa: ænd skræʧt ðə tæŋ mʌŋks hɛd

dialogue.en: Now I'll teach the Tiger Immortal a lesson
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪl tiʧ ðə ˈtaɪɡər ən ˈmɔrtəl ə ˈlɛsən
dialogue.zh: 现在该教训教训那个虎力大仙了

dialogue.en: The monkey plucked one of his hairs
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki plʌkt wʌn ʌv hɪz hɛrz

dialogue.en: And turned it into a centipede
dialogue.ipa: ænd tɜrnd ɪt ˈɪntu ə ˈsɛntɪˌpid

dialogue.en: He dropped the centipede onto the tiger immortal's head
dialogue.ipa: hi drɑpt ðə ˈsɛntɪˌpid ˈɑntu ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəlz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 他将蜈蚣丢到虎力大仙头上

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal's ear twitched as the centipede crawled over it
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəlz ir twɪʧt æz ðə ˈsɛntɪˌpid krɔld ˈoʊvər ɪt
dialogue.zh: 蜈蚣爬过耳朵时,虎力大仙的耳朵抽动了一下

dialogue.en: Then the centipede crawled along his mouth
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ðə ˈsɛntɪˌpid krɔld əˈlɔŋ hɪz maʊθ
dialogue.zh: 接着蜈蚣沿着他的嘴边爬行

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal's lip curled slightly
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəlz lɪp kɜrld ˈslaɪtli
dialogue.zh: 虎力大仙的嘴唇微微卷起

dialogue.en: Next the centipede crawled on the tiger immortal's nose
dialogue.ipa: nɛkst ðə ˈsɛntɪˌpid krɔld ɑn ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəlz noʊz
dialogue.zh: 随后蜈蚣爬上了虎力大仙的鼻梁

dialogue.en: He lost his concentration and fell
dialogue.ipa: hi lɔst hɪz ˌkɑnsənˈtreɪʃən ænd fɛl

dialogue.en: Hitting the ground with a puff of smoke
dialogue.ipa: ˈhɪtɪŋ ðə ɡraʊnd wɪð ə pʌf ʌv smoʊk
dialogue.zh: 砰地一声砸在地上腾起一股烟尘

dialogue.en: A dead tiger lay on the ground
dialogue.ipa: ə dɛd ˈtaɪɡər leɪ ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: Wukong and the Tang monk came back down
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk keɪm bæk daʊn

dialogue.en: Daoists and Buddhists all stared at one another
dialogue.ipa: ˈdaʊɪsts ænd ˈbudəsts ɔl stɛrd æt wʌn əˈnʌðər

dialogue.en: The tiger immortal was just an evil tiger spirit
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtaɪɡər ɪˈmɔrtəl wʌz ʤʌst ən ˈivəl ˈtaɪɡər ˈspɪrət
dialogue.zh: 虎力大仙本是害人的虎妖

dialogue.en: I want you Daoists to treat the Buddhists kindly
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt ju ˈdaʊɪsts tu trit ðə ˈbudəsts ˈkaɪndli
dialogue.zh: 我要你们道士善待佛门弟子

dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌbɑdi ʃʊd lɪv tə ˈɡɛðər ˈpisfəli

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said the Tiger immortal
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Soon was floating next to the tiger immortal
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: But I haven't done it lately
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Master's face is twitching
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: I could have competed in this contest
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: This contest will be easy for me
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Whoever can meditate the longest without moving is the winner
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: But before the monk could answer
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: The tiger immortal must have used magic to put this flea here
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: Everybody should live together peacefully
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's start the contest
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Wait here
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If the monk moves at all
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When the smoke cleared
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I wonder what's wrong
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: Whoever + 从句 + 谓语
grammar.description: whoever 表示“无论谁、任何……的人”，整个从句可在句中作主语。
grammar.source: Whoever can meditate the longest without moving is the winner
examples: Whoever finds the key can open the door.
Whoever reaches the top first will win.
Whoever tells the truth will be forgiven.
Whoever helps the monk will receive thanks.
Whoever crosses the river must be careful.
Whoever sees Wukong should call me.
Whoever solves the problem can lead the team.
Whoever enters the cave must carry a light.
Whoever finishes early may rest.
Whoever brings the map will show us the way.

collocations.context: We will float in the air and meditate
Of course the Tang monk can float in the air
The tiger immortal and the Tang monk went in front of the crowd
They sat down with their legs crossed and their palms facing up
They closed their eyes and started meditating
He just needs some help from me
Wukong looked up at the Tang monk
Wukong and the Tang monk came back down
Daoists and Buddhists all stared at one another

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 59 scared villagers

dialogue.en: Can we please stop to rest
dialogue.ipa: kæn wi pliz stɑp tu rɛst

dialogue.zh: 有一天八戒哼哼唧唧地说

dialogue.en: The group had spent the morning walking down a long mountain trail
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup hæd spɛnt ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈwɔkɪŋ daʊn ə lɔŋ ˈmaʊntən treɪl
dialogue.zh: 一行人清晨起就在漫长的山道上行走

dialogue.en: We'll rest in a little while bajie
dialogue.ipa: wil rɛst ɪn ə ˈlɪtəl waɪl bajie
dialogue.zh: 再走一会儿就休息 八戒

dialogue.en: The travelers started to hear the sound of rushing water
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz ˈstɑrtɪd tu hir ðə saʊnd ʌv ˈrʌʃɪŋ ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 师徒们渐渐听到湍急的水声

dialogue.en: The trail went around a hill
dialogue.ipa: ðə treɪl wɛnt əˈraʊnd ə hɪl

dialogue.en: A moment later the travelers saw the river
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər ðə ˈtrævələrz sɔ ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 片刻之后,旅人们看见了河流

dialogue.en: How will we cross this river
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl wi krɔs ðɪs ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 我们该怎么过这条河呢

dialogue.en: I can't see the other side
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt si ði ˈʌðər saɪd

dialogue.en: Wukong leaped into the air and looked around
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd lʊkt əˈraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 悟空纵身跃到空中四下张望

dialogue.en: Maybe someone there has a boat
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi ˈsʌmˌwʌn ðɛr hæz ə boʊt

dialogue.en: The group walked to the village
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup wɔkt tu ðə ˈvɪləʤ

dialogue.en: A few villagers peeked out of windows and from behind doors
dialogue.ipa: ə fju ˈvɪlɪʤərz pikt aʊt ʌv ˈwɪndoʊz ænd frʌm bɪˈhaɪnd dɔrz
dialogue.zh: 几个村民从窗户和门后偷偷张望

dialogue.en: A man was getting water from a well
dialogue.ipa: ə mæn wʌz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈwɔtər frʌm ə wɛl
dialogue.zh: 有个男人正在井边打水

dialogue.en: The man dropped his bucket down the well and spun around
dialogue.ipa: ðə mæn drɑpt hɪz ˈbʌkət daʊn ðə wɛl ænd spʌn əˈraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 水桶掉进井里,他猛地转过身来

dialogue.en: We're traveling to the western paradise to get scriptures from Buddha
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈtrævəlɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs tu ɡɛt ˈskrɪpʧərz frʌm ˈbudə

dialogue.en: We need a boat to get across the river
dialogue.ipa: wi nid ə boʊt tu ɡɛt əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: But someone in the village might
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɪn ðə ˈvɪləʤ maɪt

dialogue.en: The travelers followed Chen to his home
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz ˈfɑloʊd ʧɛn tu hɪz hoʊm
dialogue.zh: 旅人们跟着陈先生来到他家

dialogue.en: Inside they sat down as Chen boiled water for tea
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈsaɪd ðeɪ sæt daʊn æz ʧɛn bɔɪld ˈwɔtər fɔr ti
dialogue.zh: 进屋坐下后,陈先生烧水准备沏茶

dialogue.en: Why does everyone in this village seem so scared
dialogue.ipa: waɪ dʌz ˈɛvri ˌwʌn ɪn ðɪs ˈvɪləʤ sim soʊ skɛrd
dialogue.zh: 为什么村里人都显得这么害怕

dialogue.en: It's just that life is very bad in this village
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ʤʌst ðæt laɪf ɪz ˈvɛri bæd ɪn ðɪs ˈvɪləʤ
dialogue.zh: 只是我们村的日子过得太苦了

dialogue.en: He demanded that we give him a child
dialogue.ipa: hi dɪˈmændɪd ðæt wi ɡɪv hɪm ə ʧaɪld
dialogue.zh: 他要求我们给他一个孩子
他就会毁掉我们整个村子

dialogue.en: Chen burst into tears all over again
dialogue.ipa: ʧɛn bɜrst ˈɪntu tɛrz ɔl ˈoʊvər ə ˈɡɛn
wu kɔŋ ˈɡɪɡəld ænd ðɛn læft

dialogue.en: The Tang monk glared at the monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɡlɛrd æt ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: You should recite the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd rəˈsaɪt ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl

dialogue.en: I'm not laughing at you sir
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈlæfɪŋ æt ju sɜr

dialogue.en: I'm laughing because today is the luckiest day of your life
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈlæfɪŋ bɪˈkɔz təˈdeɪ ɪz ðə ˈlʌkiəst deɪ ʌv jʊər laɪf
dialogue.zh: 我笑是因为今天是您一生中最幸运的日子

dialogue.en: You've probably never heard of me
dialogue.ipa: juv ˈprɑbəbli ˈnɛvər hɜrd ʌv mi

dialogue.en: But I am Sun Wukong the Monkey King
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ æm sʌn wu kɔŋ ðə ˈmʌŋki kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 但我就是齐天大圣孙悟空

dialogue.en: I once defeated the Jade Emperor's entire army
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌns dɪˈfitɪd ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərərz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 我曾打败过玉皇大帝的整支天兵

dialogue.en: And tomorrow I will save your son's life
dialogue.ipa: ænd təˈmɑˌroʊ aɪ wɪl seɪv jʊər sʌnz laɪf
dialogue.zh: 明天我便会救您儿子的命
是的,而且是很厉害的神仙

dialogue.en: I need to look at him
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid tu lʊk æt hɪm

dialogue.en: Chen left the room for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ʧɛn lɛft ðə rum fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt

dialogue.en: A small boy was with him
dialogue.ipa: ə smɔl bɔɪ wʌz wɪð hɪm
wu kɔŋ wɔkt əˈraʊnd ðə bɔɪ
dialogue.zh: 悟空绕着男孩走了一圈

dialogue.en: Finally the monkey folded his arms and said
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪnəli ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈfoʊldɪd hɪz ɑrmz ænd sɛd

dialogue.en: The next morning the boy climbed onto a small platform
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðə bɔɪ klaɪmd ˈɑntu ə smɔl ˈplætˌfɔrm
dialogue.zh: 第二天早上,男孩爬上了一座小平台

dialogue.en: Several villagers carried the platform to the edge of the river
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɛvrəl ˈvɪlɪʤərz ˈkærid ðə ˈplætˌfɔrm tu ði ɛʤ ʌv ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 几个村民将平台抬到河边

dialogue.en: They placed the platform on the ground and then backed away
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ pleɪst ðə ˈplætˌfɔrm ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd ænd ðɛn bækt əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 他们把平台放在地上,然后退开

dialogue.en: For a moment everything was quiet
dialogue.ipa: fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ wʌz ˈkwaɪət

dialogue.en: The boy sat alone on the platform
dialogue.ipa: ðə bɔɪ sæt əˈloʊn ɑn ðə ˈplæt ˌfɔrm

dialogue.en: A fierce looking demon emerged from the cloud
dialogue.ipa: ə fɪrs ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈdimən ɪˈmɜrʤd frʌm ðə klaʊd
dialogue.zh: 一个面目狰狞的妖怪从云中现身

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 60 Snow

dialogue.en: The demon eyed the smiling boy suspiciously
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən aɪd ðə ˈsmaɪlɪŋ bɔɪ səˈspɪʃəsli
dialogue.zh: 妖怪怀疑地打量着微笑的男孩

dialogue.en: The demon hesitated for a moment and then moved closer
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ˈhɛzɪˌteɪtɪd fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt ænd ðɛn muvd ˈkloʊsər
dialogue.zh: 妖怪犹豫了一下 然后凑近了些

dialogue.en: Suddenly the boy changed into Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðə bɔɪ ʧeɪnʤd ˈɪntu wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: The monkey pulled out his iron bar and swung
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd swʌŋ
dialogue.zh: 猴子抽出铁棒挥了过去

dialogue.en: And you should be ashamed of yourself
dialogue.ipa: ænd ju ʃʊd bi əˈʃeɪmd ʌv jərˈsɛlf

dialogue.en: What kind of monster eats children
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kaɪnd ʌv ˈmɑnstər its ˈʧɪldrən

dialogue.en: I thought you were trapped under a mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɔt ju wɜr træpt ˈʌndər ə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: I'm traveling to the western paradise with the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈtrævəlɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我正护送唐僧去西天取经

dialogue.en: The demon spun around and disappeared
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən spʌn ə ˈraʊnd ænd ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd

dialogue.en: The monkey returned to Chen's home and told everyone what had happened
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki rɪˈtɜrnd tu ʧɛnz hoʊm ænd toʊld ˈɛvriˌwʌn wɑt hæd ˈhæpənd
dialogue.zh: 猴子回到陈家 告诉了大家发生的事

dialogue.en: I still have my son said Chen
dialogue.ipa: aɪ stɪl hæv maɪ sʌn sɛd ʧɛn
dialogue.zh: 我儿子才平安无事 陈先生说

dialogue.en: But I believe the demon now wants to capture the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ bɪˈliv ðə ˈdimən naʊ wɑnts tu ˈkæpʧər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 但我估计那妖怪现在想抓唐僧

dialogue.en: So in the morning we must find a boat and leave
dialogue.ipa: soʊ ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ wi mʌst faɪnd ə boʊt ænd liv
dialogue.zh: 所以明早我们必须找船离开

dialogue.en: Meanwhile the demon was deep under the water
dialogue.ipa: ˈminˌwaɪl ðə ˈdimən wʌz dip ˈʌndər ðə ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 与此同时 妖怪正深藏水底

dialogue.en: I must capture the Tang monk and eat him
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst ˈkæpʧər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd it hɪm
dialogue.zh: 我一定要抓住唐僧吃了他

dialogue.en: It won't be easy with that monkey around
dialogue.ipa: ɪt woʊnt bi ˈizi wɪð ðæt ˈmʌŋki əˈraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 有那只猴子在可不容易

dialogue.en: Late that night a cold wind blew
dialogue.ipa: leɪt ðæt naɪt ə koʊld wɪnd blu

dialogue.en: A snowflake drifted to the ground
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈsnoʊˌfleɪk ˈdrɪftɪd tu ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: He looked at Wukong and Wujing
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt Wukong ænd Wujing

dialogue.en: Both of them were sleeping soundly
dialogue.ipa: boʊθ ʌv ðɛm wɜr ˈslipɪŋ ˈsaʊndli

dialogue.en: Their blankets must be warmer than mine
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ˈblæŋkəts mʌst bi ˈwɔrmər ðæn maɪn
dialogue.zh: 他们的毯子肯定比我的暖和

dialogue.en: In the morning Wukong woke up shivering
dialogue.ipa: ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ wu kɔŋ woʊk ʌp ˈʃɪvərɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 早上悟空冻得直哆嗦地醒来

dialogue.en: That was a terrible night's sleep
dialogue.ipa: ðæt wʌz ə ˈtɛrəbəl naɪts slip

dialogue.en: He looked down at his body
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt daʊn æt hɪz ˈbɑdi
dialogue.zh: 他低头看了看自己身上

dialogue.en: Why is it so cold and in here
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɪz ɪt soʊ koʊld ænd ɪn hir

dialogue.en: The pig was tucked cosily under three blankets
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ wʌz tʌkt ˈkoʊsɪli ˈʌndər θri ˈblæŋkəts
dialogue.zh: 那头猪正舒舒服服裹着三条毯子

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ɡeɪv hɪm ə kɪk

dialogue.en: Why is it so cold anyway
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɪz ɪt soʊ koʊld ˈɛniˌweɪ

dialogue.en: He looked out the window and gasped
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt aʊt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ænd ɡæspt
dialogue.zh: 他望向窗外,倒吸一口凉气

dialogue.en: They woke the Tang monk and Chen
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ woʊk ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd ʧɛn
dialogue.zh: 他们叫醒了唐僧和陈先生

dialogue.en: A thick blanket of snow covered the entire village
dialogue.ipa: ə θɪk ˈblæŋkət ʌv snoʊ ˈkʌvərd ði ɪnˈtaɪər ˈvɪləʤ
dialogue.zh: 厚厚的积雪覆盖了整个村庄

dialogue.en: It would be dangerous to cross the river in this weather
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʊd bi ˈdeɪnʤərəs tu krɔs ðə ˈrɪvər ɪn ðɪs ˈwɛðər
dialogue.zh: 这种天气过河太危险了

dialogue.en: You should stay here until the snow melts
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd steɪ hir ənˈtɪl ðə snoʊ mɛlts

dialogue.en: Maybe we can walk across it
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi wi kæn wɔk əˈkrɔs ɪt
dialogue.zh: 说不定我们能走着过去

dialogue.en: The travelers thanked Chen and said goodbye
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz θæŋkt ʧɛn ænd sɛd ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 师徒们谢过陈先生便告辞了

dialogue.en: Soon they were standing at the edge of the frozen river
dialogue.ipa: sun ðeɪ wɜr ˈstændɪŋ æt ði ɛʤ ʌv ðə ˈfroʊzən ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 很快他们就站在了冰封的河岸边

dialogue.en: I wonder if it's safe to walk on
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈwʌndər ɪf ɪts seɪf tu wɔk ɑn
dialogue.zh: 不知道踩上去安不安全

dialogue.en: I'll test it with my rake
dialogue.ipa: aɪl tɛst ɪt wɪð maɪ reɪk

dialogue.en: The pig walked onto the ice and raised his rake
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ wɔkt ˈɑntu ði aɪs ænd reɪzd hɪz reɪk
dialogue.zh: 猪八戒走上冰面,举起了他的耙子。

dialogue.en: He brought the Rake down hard
dialogue.ipa: hi brɔt ðə reɪk daʊn hɑrd
dialogue.zh: 他用力将耙子砸了下去。

dialogue.en: The traveler stepped onto the ice and started walking
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələr stɛpt ˈɑntu ði aɪs ænd ˈstɑrtɪd ˈwɔkɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 旅人踏上冰面,开始行走。

dialogue.en: The Riverbank was no longer in sight
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈrɪvərˌbæŋk wʌz noʊ ˈlɔŋɡər ɪn saɪt
dialogue.zh: 河岸已消失在视野之外。

dialogue.en: Suddenly there was a rumbling sound
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðɛr wʌz ə ˈrʌmbəlɪŋ saʊnd
dialogue.zh: 突然传来一阵隆隆的声响。
冰面猛然裂开一道大口子。

There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That was a terrible night's sleep
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: I wonder if it's safe to walk on
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: Because of you
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So in the morning we must find a boat and leave
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

collocations.context: I plan to eat you
The demon hesitated for a moment and then moved closer
The monkey pulled out his iron bar and swung
Because of you
Thank you
So in the morning we must find a boat and leave
He said to himself
He looked at Wukong and Wujing
In the morning Wukong woke up shivering
He looked down at his body
He looked out the window and gasped
You should stay here until the snow melts
I wonder if it's safe to walk on
The Riverbank was no longer in sight

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 61 The Demon Under the ice

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr

dialogue.en: His three companions and the horse fell into the water with a splash
dialogue.ipa: hɪz θri kəmˈpænjənz ænd ðə hɔrs fɛl ˈɪntu ðə ˈwɔtər wɪð ə splæʃ
dialogue.zh: 他的三位同伴和马匹扑通一声掉进了水里。

dialogue.en: Below the ice the Tang monk struggled as the demon carried him deep underwater
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈloʊ ði aɪs ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈstrʌɡəld æz ðə ˈdimən ˈkærid hɪm dip ˈʌndərˌwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 冰面之下,妖怪正挟持着唐僧向深水处游去,唐僧奋力挣扎。

dialogue.en: You all fell for my trick
dialogue.ipa: ju ɔl fɛl fɔr maɪ trɪk

dialogue.en: I froze the river and waited for you to cross it
dialogue.ipa: aɪ froʊz ðə ˈrɪvər ænd ˈweɪtɪd fɔr ju tu krɔs ɪt
dialogue.zh: 我冻住了河面,就等你们过河。

dialogue.en: As soon as your friends leave
dialogue.ipa: æz sun æz jʊər frɛndz liv

dialogue.en: I will eat you and live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl it ju ænd lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: A sign over the door read
dialogue.ipa: ə saɪn ˈoʊvər ðə dɔr rid

dialogue.en: The demon went inside and locked the monk in a stone box
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən wɛnt ɪnˈsaɪd ænd lɑkt ðə mʌŋk ɪn ə stoʊn bɑks
dialogue.zh: 妖怪走了进去,把和尚锁进了一个石匣里。

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ peɪst bæk ænd fɔrθ

dialogue.en: The ice didn't crack by accident
dialogue.ipa: ði aɪs ˈdɪdənt kræk baɪ ˈæksədənt

dialogue.en: I'm sure it was the demon
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʃʊr ɪt wʌz ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: The demon probably caused this strange cold weather too
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ˈprɑbəbli kɑzd ðɪs streɪnʤ koʊld ˈwɛðər tu
dialogue.zh: 这反常的寒冷天气恐怕也是那妖怪搞的鬼。

dialogue.en: I can't believe we fell for his trick
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt bɪˈliv wi fɛl fɔr hɪz trɪk
dialogue.zh: 真不敢相信我们竟中了他的诡计。

dialogue.en: We must save the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst seɪv ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Wukong stopped pacing and looked at his companions
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ stɑpt ˈpeɪsɪŋ ænd lʊkt æt hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空停下脚步,看着他的同伴们。

dialogue.en: My powers aren't very strong underwater
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈpaʊərz ˈɑrənt ˈvɛri strɔŋ ˈʌndərˌwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 我在水下的本事不太强。

dialogue.en: You two must go down there and get the demon to come back up
dialogue.ipa: ju tu mʌst ɡoʊ daʊn ðɛr ænd ɡɛt ðə ˈdimən tu kʌm bæk ʌp
dialogue.zh: 你们两个必须下去,把妖怪引上来。

dialogue.en: Wu Jing and Ba Jie nodded and dived into the river
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ænd Ba ʤi ˈnɑdɪd ænd daɪvd ˈɪntu ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 悟净和八戒点了点头,一头扎进河里。
他们很快发现了一座宫殿。

dialogue.en: Wu Jing read the sign over the door
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ rid ðə saɪn ˈoʊvər ðə dɔr

dialogue.en: I wonder if the demon is in here
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈwʌndər ɪf ðə ˈdimən ɪz ɪn hir
dialogue.zh: 不知道妖怪是不是在里面。

dialogue.en: Ba Jie knocked on the door
dialogue.ipa: Ba ʤi nɑkt ɑn ðə dɔr

dialogue.en: The door opened and the demon stepped out
dialogue.ipa: ðə dɔr ˈoʊpənd ænd ðə ˈdimən stɛpt aʊt

dialogue.en: He was holding a large hammer
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈhoʊldɪŋ ə lɑrʤ ˈhæmər

dialogue.zh: 是不是你抓走了我们的师父?

dialogue.en: And I plan to eat him
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ plæn tu it hɪm

dialogue.en: The demon tried to close the door
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən traɪd tu kloʊs ðə dɔr

dialogue.en: But Wu Jing stopped the door with his spear
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wu ʤɪŋ stɑpt ðə dɔr wɪð hɪz spɪr
dialogue.zh: 但悟净用他的长矛抵住了门。

dialogue.en: The demon blocked the rake with his hammer
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən blɑkt ðə reɪk wɪð hɪz ˈhæmər
dialogue.zh: 妖怪用锤子挡住了钉耙。

dialogue.en: Fish and other creatures fled as the three spirits fought
dialogue.ipa: fɪʃ ænd ˈʌðər ˈkriʧərz flɛd æz ðə θri ˈspɪrɪts fɔt
dialogue.zh: 三个精怪打斗时,鱼和其他生物纷纷逃窜。

dialogue.en: Swimming after them toward the surface
dialogue.ipa: ˈswɪmɪŋ ˈæftər ðɛm tə ˈwɔrd ðə ˈsɜrfəs

dialogue.en: The demon jumped out of the water and onto the ice
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ʤʌmpt aʊt ʌv ðə ˈwɔtər ænd ˈɑntu ði aɪs
dialogue.zh: 妖怪跳出水面,落在冰上。

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wʌz ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr hɪm

dialogue.en: The monkey swung his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: More cracks formed in the ice
dialogue.ipa: mɔr kræks fɔrmd ɪn ði aɪs
dialogue.zh: 冰面上出现了更多裂缝。

dialogue.en: Weapons clashed as the spirits fought on the breaking ice
dialogue.ipa: ˈwɛpənz klæʃt æz ðə ˈspɪrɪts fɔt ɑn ðə ˈbreɪkɪŋ aɪs
dialogue.zh: 精怪们在碎裂的冰面上激战,兵器相交。

dialogue.en: He slid across the ice and slammed into Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: hi slɪd əˈkrɔs ði aɪs ænd slæmd ˈɪntu wu ʤɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 他在冰面上滑倒,撞上了悟净。

dialogue.en: The purple spirit slipped and fell
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈpɜrpəl ˈspɪrət slɪpt ænd fɛl

dialogue.en: The demon laughed and dived back under the ice
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən læft ænd daɪvd bæk ˈʌndər ði aɪs
dialogue.zh: 妖怪大笑着,又钻回冰下。

dialogue.en: BA Jie and Wu Jing stood back up
dialogue.ipa: bi-eɪ ʤi ænd wu ʤɪŋ stʊd bæk ʌp

dialogue.en: We must stop him before he eats the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst stɑp hɪm bɪˈfɔr hi its ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我们必须在他吃掉唐僧之前阻止他。

dialogue.en: Go back down there and try to lead him up here again
dialogue.ipa: ɡoʊ bæk daʊn ðɛr ænd traɪ tu lid hɪm ʌp hir əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 再下去一趟,设法把他引到这里来

dialogue.en: Wu Jing and Bajie dived into the river
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ænd Bajie daɪvd ˈɪntu ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: They found a huge pile of rocks blocking the door
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ faʊnd ə hjuʤ paɪl ʌv rɑks ˈblɑkɪŋ ðə dɔr
dialogue.zh: 发现一大堆石头堵住了门

dialogue.en: Bajie struck the rocks with his rake
dialogue.ipa: Bajie strʌk ðə rɑks wɪð hɪz reɪk

dialogue.en: The rake bounced off the rock pile
dialogue.ipa: ðə reɪk baʊnst ɔf ðə rɑk paɪl
dialogue.zh: 钉耙从石堆上弹了回来

dialogue.en: The rocks didn't move at all
dialogue.ipa: ðə rɑks ˈdɪdənt muv æt ɔl

dialogue.en: Wu Jing stabbed at the rocks with his spear
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ stæbd æt ðə rɑks wɪð hɪz spɪr

dialogue.en: What kind of rocks are these
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kaɪnd ʌv rɑks ɑr ðiz

dialogue.en: Maybe they're held in place with magic
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi ðɛr hɛld ɪn pleɪs wɪð ˈmæʤɪk
dialogue.zh: 说不定是被法术固定住的

dialogue.en: They returned to the surface of the river and told Wukong about the rocks
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə ˈsɜrfəs ʌv ðə ˈrɪvər ænd toʊld Wukong əˈbaʊt ðə rɑks
dialogue.zh: 他们回到河面,将石头的事告诉了悟空

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: His three companions and the horse fell into the water with a splash
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: He was holding a large hammer
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I wonder if the demon is in here
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I will eat you and live forever
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Bajie pretended to be scared
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can't believe we fell for his trick
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We must save the Tang monk
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: The demon tried to close the door
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Open up
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: I wonder if the demon is in here
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When they reached the palace
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: As soon as your friends leave
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.

collocations.context: His three companions and the horse fell into the water with a splash
Bajie climbed back out coughing
I froze the river and waited for you to cross it
As soon as your friends leave
He made a fist
Wukong stopped pacing and looked at his companions
You two must go down there and get the demon to come back up
And I plan to eat him
Now go away
The demon tried to close the door
Go back down there and try to lead him up here again

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 62 the goldfish in the basket

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈlændɪd ɑn maʊnt Potalaka

dialogue.en: A young man was meditating in the garden
dialogue.ipa: ə jʌŋ mæn wʌz ˈmɛdə ˌteɪtɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈɡɑrdən
dialogue.zh: 一位青年正在花园中打坐

dialogue.en: He glanced up at the monkey
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡlænst ʌp æt ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: It's good to see you again Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ɡʊd tu si ju əˈɡɛn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: How do you know my name
dialogue.ipa: haʊ du ju noʊ maɪ neɪm

dialogue.en: Wukong stared for a moment and then gasped
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ stɛrd fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt ænd ðɛn ɡæspt
dialogue.zh: 悟空凝视片刻,突然倒吸一口气

dialogue.en: You look like a kind spirit now
dialogue.ipa: ju lʊk laɪk ə kaɪnd ˈspɪrət naʊ
dialogue.zh: 你现在看起来像个善灵了

dialogue.en: I'm not an evil demon anymore
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ən ˈivəl ˈdimən ˌɛniˈmɔr
dialogue.zh: 我不再是邪恶的妖魔了

dialogue.en: And I have you to thank for that
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ hæv ju tu θæŋk fɔr ðæt

dialogue.en: You brought Guan Yin to me
dialogue.ipa: ju brɔt Guan jɪn tu mi
dialogue.zh: 是你把观音带到了我面前

dialogue.en: She has taught me all about Buddhism
dialogue.ipa: ʃi hæz tɔt mi ɔl əˈbaʊt ˈbudɪzəm

dialogue.en: You and I have a lot in common
dialogue.ipa: ju ænd aɪ hæv ə lɑt ɪn ˈkɑmən

dialogue.zh: 如今我们都成了佛门弟子

dialogue.en: Guanyin came over holding a basket
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin keɪm ˈoʊvər ˈhoʊldɪŋ ə ˈbæskət
dialogue.zh: 观音拿着篮子走了过来

dialogue.en: I knew you would come here today
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nu ju wʊd kʌm hir təˈdeɪ

dialogue.en: I've been working on this basket all morning
dialogue.ipa: aɪv bɪn ˈwɜrkɪŋ ɑn ðɪs ˈbæskət ɔl ˈmɔrnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 我整个上午都在编这个篮子

dialogue.en: A look of confusion spread across the monkey's face
dialogue.ipa: ə lʊk ʌv kənˈfjuʒən sprɛd əˈkrɔs ðə ˈmʌŋkiz feɪs
dialogue.zh: 猴子脸上露出困惑的表情
可它是用来做什么的呢

dialogue.en: I will catch the demon with it
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl kæʧ ðə ˈdimən wɪð ɪt

dialogue.en: Wukong returned to the river with Guan Yin
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə ˈrɪvər wɪð Guan jɪn

dialogue.en: The bodhisattva used a rope to lower the basket into the river
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈboʊtmən juzd ə roʊp tu ˈloʊər ðə ˈbæskət ˈɪntu ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 船夫用绳子把篮子沉入河中

dialogue.en: She recited a spell and then waited
dialogue.ipa: ʃi rəˈsaɪtəd ə spɛl ænd ðɛn ˈweɪtɪd
dialogue.zh: 她念了咒语,然后静静等待

dialogue.en: After a moment she pulled the basket out of the water
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ə ˈmoʊmənt ʃi pʊld ðə ˈbæskət aʊt ʌv ðə ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 过了一会儿,她把篮子从水里提了出来

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt ɪn ðə ˈbæskət

dialogue.en: A small goldfish was flopping around in it
dialogue.ipa: ə smɔl ˈɡoʊldˌfɪʃ wʌz ˈflɑpɪŋ əˈraʊnd ɪn ɪt
dialogue.zh: 一条小金鱼正在里面扑腾

dialogue.en: I guess you need to try again Bodhisattva
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɛs ju nid tu traɪ ə ˈɡɛn Bodhisattva
dialogue.zh: 菩萨,看来您得再试一次了

dialogue.en: It usually lives in my lotus pond
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ˈjuʒəwəli lɪvz ɪn maɪ ˈloʊtəs pɑnd
dialogue.zh: 它平时住在我莲花池里

dialogue.en: The pond is near my garden
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɑnd ɪz nɪr maɪ ˈɡɑrdən

dialogue.en: After years of listening to my lessons
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər jɪrz ʌv ˈlɪsənɪŋ tu maɪ ˈlɛsənz

dialogue.en: It escaped to earth a few days ago
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ɪˈskeɪpt tu ɜrθ ə fju deɪz ə ˈɡoʊ

dialogue.en: I had been wondering where it was
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæd bɪn ˈwʌndərɪŋ wɛr ɪt wʌz

dialogue.en: That means it's been on earth for a few years
dialogue.ipa: ðæt minz ɪts bɪn ɑn ɜrθ fɔr ə fju jɪrz
dialogue.zh: 那说明它已在人间待了好几年

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is safe now
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz seɪf naʊ

dialogue.en: You may go free him and continue your journey to the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ju meɪ ɡoʊ fri hɪm ænd kənˈtɪnju jʊər ˈʤɜrni tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 你可以去救他出来,继续西行之路

dialogue.en: And Wukong swam down to the palace
dialogue.ipa: ænd wu kɔŋ swæm daʊn tu ðə ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: Now that the goldfish was gone
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ðæt ðə ˈɡoʊldˌfɪʃ wʌz ɡɔn

dialogue.en: The monkey smashed the rocks with his iron bar and went inside
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki smæʃt ðə rɑks wɪð hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd wɛnt ɪnˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 猴子用铁棒砸开石头闯了进去

dialogue.en: He got the monk out of the box and carried him out of the river
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡɑt ðə mʌŋk aʊt ʌv ðə bɑks ænd ˈkærid hɪm aʊt ʌv ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 他把唐僧从箱中救出,带离河底

dialogue.en: By now all the villagers had heard that Wukong had saved Chen's son
dialogue.ipa: baɪ naʊ ɔl ðə ˈvɪlɪʤərz hæd hɜrd ðæt wu kɔŋ hæd seɪvd ʧɛnz sʌn
dialogue.zh: 此时村民们已听说悟空救了陈家的儿子

dialogue.en: Stay for as long as you like
dialogue.ipa: steɪ fɔr æz lɔŋ æz ju laɪk

dialogue.en: But we can stay only one more night to rest
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wi kæn steɪ ˈoʊnli wʌn mɔr naɪt tu rɛst
dialogue.zh: 但我们只能再留一晚休息

dialogue.en: In the morning we must leave
dialogue.ipa: ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ wi mʌst liv

dialogue.en: We still have far to travel
dialogue.ipa: wi stɪl hæv fɑr tu ˈtrævəl
dialogue.zh: 我们还有很长的路要走

dialogue.en: The villagers held a feast for the travelers that evening
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈvɪlɪʤərz hɛld ə fist fɔr ðə ˈtrævələrz ðæt ˈivnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 当晚村民们为旅人设宴款待

dialogue.en: By the time everyone went to sleep
dialogue.ipa: baɪ ðə taɪm ˈɛvriˌwʌn wɛnt tu slip

dialogue.en: The next morning the travelers woke to the sound of chopping
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðə ˈtrævələrz woʊk tu ðə saʊnd ʌv ˈʧɑpɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 第二天早上,旅人们被砍伐声唤醒

dialogue.en: They went to the river and found a very busy scene
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɛnt tu ðə ˈrɪvər ænd faʊnd ə ˈvɛri ˈbɪzi sin
dialogue.zh: 他们走到河边,看到一片繁忙景象

dialogue.en: Several men were chopping down trees
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɛvrəl mɛn wɜr ˈʧɑpɪŋ daʊn triz

dialogue.en: We're building a boat for you
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈbɪldɪŋ ə boʊt fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 我们在为你们造一艘船
一个面带笑容的人说道

dialogue.en: He and his companion sat down by the water to wait
dialogue.ipa: hi ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjən sæt daʊn baɪ ðə ˈwɔtər tu weɪt
dialogue.zh: 他和同伴们坐在水边等待

dialogue.en: Suddenly there was a rumble and waves splashed onto the shore
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðɛr wʌz ə ˈrʌmbəl ænd weɪvz splæʃt ˈɑntu ðə ʃɔr
dialogue.zh: 突然传来一阵轰鸣,浪花拍打上岸

dialogue.en: Everyone stared in fear as a large creature rose from the waves
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn stɛrd ɪn fɪr æz ə lɑrʤ ˈkriʧər roʊz frʌm ðə weɪvz
dialogue.zh: 众人惊恐地注视着,一个巨大的生物从波浪中升起

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: A young man was meditating in the garden
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: A young man was meditating in the garden
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: I had been wondering where it was
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: How do you know my name
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I will catch the demon with it
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Wukong was puzzled
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But we can stay only one more night to rest
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: In the morning we must leave
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's go
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Stay for as long as you like
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's no rush to leave
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That means it's been on earth for a few years
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When the travelers returned
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So was its magic
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: Stay for as long as you like
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 63 a question for Buddha

dialogue.en: The Tang monk jumped to his feet as the villagers hid behind trees
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ʤʌmpt tu hɪz fit æz ðə ˈvɪlɪʤərz hɪd bɪˈhaɪnd triz
dialogue.zh: 唐僧一跃而起,村民们则躲到树后

dialogue.en: Wukong Wu Jing and BA Jie pulled out their weapons
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wu ʤɪŋ ænd bi-eɪ ʤi pʊld aʊt ðɛr ˈwɛpənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空、悟净和八戒抽出武器

dialogue.en: A large shell rose from the water
dialogue.ipa: ə lɑrʤ ʃɛl roʊz frʌm ðə ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 一个巨大的甲壳从水中升起

dialogue.en: The turtle bowed its head toward Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtɜrtəl baʊd ɪts hɛd təˈwɔrd wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: That demon had taken over my house and river
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈdimən hæd ˈteɪkən ˈoʊvər maɪ haʊs ænd ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪霸占了我的家和这条河

dialogue.en: Thank you for getting rid of him
dialogue.ipa: θæŋk ju fɔr ˈɡɛtɪŋ rɪd ʌv hɪm

dialogue.en: The turtle then looked at the villagers
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtɜrtəl ðɛn lʊkt æt ðə ˈvɪlɪʤərz

dialogue.en: You don't need to make a boat
dialogue.ipa: ju doʊnt nid tu meɪk ə boʊt

dialogue.en: I can take the travelers across the river
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn teɪk ðə ˈtrævələrz əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: I'm from the Tang empire and
dialogue.ipa: aɪm frʌm ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpaɪər ænd

dialogue.en: You're traveling to the western paradise to get scriptures from Buddha
dialogue.ipa: jʊr ˈtrævəlɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs tu ɡɛt ˈskrɪpʧərz frʌm ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 你正前往西天极乐世界向佛祖求取真经

dialogue.en: I knew you would cross my river eventually
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nu ju wʊd krɔs maɪ ˈrɪvər ɪˈvɛnʧəwəli
dialogue.zh: 我知道你终会经过我的河流

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ aɪd ðə ˈtɜrtəl sə ˈspɪʃəsli
dialogue.zh: 悟空怀疑地打量着乌龟

dialogue.en: How do we know we can trust you
dialogue.ipa: haʊ du wi noʊ wi kæn trʌst ju
dialogue.zh: 我们怎么知道能信任你

dialogue.en: Demons all along the way are waiting for my master to pass by
dialogue.ipa: ˈdimənz ɔl əˈlɔŋ ðə weɪ ɑr ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr maɪ ˈmæstər tu pæs baɪ
dialogue.zh: 沿途的妖怪都在等着我师父经过

dialogue.en: They all want to eat him
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ɔl wɑnt tu it hɪm

dialogue.en: I promise I won't hurt the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈprɑməs aɪ woʊnt hɜrt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: I want to help him reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt tu hɛlp hɪm riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我想帮助他抵达西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: The traveler stepped onto the turtle's shell
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələr stɛpt ˈɑntu ðə ˈtɜrtəlz ʃɛl
dialogue.zh: 旅行者踏上了乌龟的背壳

dialogue.en: The villagers came out from behind the trees and waved
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈvɪlɪʤərz keɪm aʊt frʌm bɪˈhaɪnd ðə triz ænd weɪvd
dialogue.zh: 村民们从树后走出来挥手告别

dialogue.en: Please visit us on your way home
dialogue.ipa: pliz ˈvɪzət ʌs ɑn jʊər weɪ hoʊm
dialogue.zh: 请你们回家路上再来做客
我们一定会的 我保证

dialogue.en: Soon the turtle was far from shore
dialogue.ipa: sun ðə ˈtɜrtəl wʌz fɑr frʌm ʃɔr
dialogue.zh: 很快乌龟就离岸很远了

dialogue.en: The turtle glanced back at the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtɜrtəl ɡlænst bæk æt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 乌龟回头瞥了唐僧一眼

dialogue.en: Excuse me but can you do me a favor
dialogue.ipa: ɪkˈskjus mi bʌt kæn ju du mi ə ˈfeɪvər
dialogue.zh: 打扰了 能请您帮个忙吗

dialogue.en: What do you need me to do
dialogue.ipa: wɑt du ju nid mi tu du

dialogue.en: I have been a good Buddhist for over a thousand years
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv bɪn ə ɡʊd ˈbudəst fɔr ˈoʊvər ə ˈθaʊzənd jɪrz

dialogue.en: But sadly I'm still just a turtle
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ˈsædli aɪm stɪl ʤʌst ə ˈtɜrtəl
dialogue.zh: 但遗憾的是我仍只是只乌龟

dialogue.en: Can you ask Buddha when I will be reborn as a human
dialogue.ipa: kæn ju æsk ˈbudə wɛn aɪ wɪl bi ˈriˈbɔrn æz ə ˈhjumən
dialogue.zh: 您能否问问佛祖我何时能转世为人

dialogue.en: The turtle reached the other side of the river
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtɜrtəl riʧt ði ˈʌðər saɪd ʌv ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: The traveler stepped onto dry land
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələr stɛpt ˈɑntu draɪ lænd
dialogue.zh: 旅行者踏上了干燥的陆地

dialogue.en: Please don't forget to ask Buddha about me
dialogue.ipa: pliz doʊnt fərˈɡɛt tu æsk ˈbudə əˈbaʊt mi
dialogue.zh: 请别忘了替我向佛祖询问

dialogue.en: The turtle disappeared under the water
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtɜrtəl ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd ˈʌndər ðə ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: The Tang monk climbed onto the horse
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk klaɪmd ˈɑntu ðə hɔrs

dialogue.en: And the group continued on the road
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ɡrup kənˈtɪnjud ɑn ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: As usual Bajie soon started complaining
dialogue.ipa: æz ˈjuʒəwəl Bajie sun ˈstɑrtɪd kəmˈpleɪnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 和往常一样 八戒很快就开始抱怨

dialogue.en: I wish we could ride that turtle the whole way to the west
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪʃ wi kʊd raɪd ðæt ˈtɜrtəl ðə hoʊl weɪ tu ðə wɛst
dialogue.zh: 真希望我们能骑着那只乌龟一路到西天

dialogue.en: Be happy that the road is flat here
dialogue.ipa: bi ˈhæpi ðæt ðə roʊd ɪz flæt hir
dialogue.zh: 庆幸这儿的路还算平坦吧

dialogue.en: They walked for another couple of hours
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɔkt fɔr əˈnʌðər ˈkʌpəl ʌv ˈaʊərz

dialogue.en: The roads started to go up a mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊdz ˈstɑrtɪd tu ɡoʊ ʌp ə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: A cold wind whipped past them
dialogue.ipa: ə koʊld wɪnd wɪpt pæst ðɛm

dialogue.en: Higher up the mountain was a large monastery
dialogue.ipa: ˈhaɪər ʌp ðə ˈmaʊntən wʌz ə lɑrʤ ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 山腰高处有座宏伟的寺院
或许我们能在那里歇歇脚

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt æt ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri

dialogue.en: A dark mist hung over it
dialogue.ipa: ə dɑrk mɪst hʌŋ ˈoʊvər ɪt

dialogue.en: I can see things that humans can't see
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn si θɪŋz ðæt ˈhjumənz kænt si
dialogue.zh: 我能看见凡人看不见的东西

dialogue.en: And I see a dark mist hanging over that monastery
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ si ə dɑrk mɪst ˈhæŋɪŋ ˈoʊvər ðæt ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 我看见有团黑雾罩着那座寺院

dialogue.en: A demon could be in there
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈdimən kʊd bi ɪn ðɛr

dialogue.en: There was a sudden growling sound
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə ˈsʌdən ˈɡroʊlɪŋ saʊnd

dialogue.en: Wukong looked around to see what had caused it
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt ə ˈraʊnd tu si wɑt hæd kɑzd ɪt
dialogue.zh: 悟空环顾四周想找出声音来源
八戒拍了拍自己的肚子

dialogue.en: We should just go to that monastery
dialogue.ipa: wi ʃʊd ʤʌst ɡoʊ tu ðæt ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 我们还是去那座寺院吧

dialogue.en: I will find food for us
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl faɪnd fud fɔr ʌs

dialogue.en: He looked at the monk and warned him again
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt ðə mʌŋk ænd wɔrnd hɪm əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 他看向和尚再次警告道

dialogue.en: Do not go to that monastery
dialogue.ipa: du nɑt ɡoʊ tu ðæt ˈmɑnəˌstɛri

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The Tang monk jumped to his feet as the villagers hid behind trees
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: That demon had taken over my house and river
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I know who you are
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Demons all along the way are waiting for my master to pass by
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: I have been a good Buddhist for over a thousand years
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: We will I promise
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can take the travelers across the river
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: I wish we could ride that turtle the whole way to the west
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: We should just go to that monastery
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: They all want to eat him
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Stop complaining
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There was a sudden growling sound
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: I can see things that humans can't see
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: Can you ask Buddha when I will be reborn as a human
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I know who you are
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

Of course

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 64 Magnificent Silk Vests

dialogue.en: I hope that monkey finds a lot of food
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp ðæt ˈmʌŋki faɪndz ə lɑt ʌv fud
dialogue.zh: 希望那猴子能找到好多吃的

dialogue.en: The Tang monk shivered and hugged himself
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈʃɪvərd ænd hʌɡd hɪmˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 唐僧打了个寒颤抱住自己

dialogue.en: He looked up at the monastery again and then back at his companions
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt ʌp æt ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri əˈɡɛn ænd ðɛn bæk æt hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 他又抬头望了望寺院,然后看向同伴们

dialogue.en: Do you two believe there are demons up there
dialogue.ipa: du ju tu bɪˈliv ðɛr ɑr ˈdimənz ʌp ðɛr
dialogue.zh: 你们俩相信那里有妖怪吗

dialogue.en: He's always worried that we'll bump into a demon
dialogue.ipa: hiz ˈɔlˌweɪz ˈwɜrid ðæt wil bʌmp ˈɪntu ə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 他总是担心我们会撞见妖怪

dialogue.en: Wu Jing looked at the monastery again
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ lʊkt æt ðə ˈmɑnə ˌstɛri əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: That place looks perfectly safe to me
dialogue.ipa: ðæt pleɪs lʊks ˈpɜrfəktli seɪf tu mi

dialogue.en: Maybe the monks there will take us in
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi ðə mʌŋks ðɛr wɪl teɪk ʌs ɪn
dialogue.zh: 也许寺里的和尚会收留我们

dialogue.en: It would be nice to get out of this cold
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʊd bi naɪs tu ɡɛt aʊt ʌv ðɪs koʊld

dialogue.en: Who cares what that monkey thinks
dialogue.ipa: hu kɛrz wɑt ðæt ˈmʌŋki θɪŋks
dialogue.zh: 谁在乎那只猴子怎么想

dialogue.en: Let's go up there get warm
dialogue.ipa: lɛts ɡoʊ ʌp ðɛr ɡɛt wɔrm

dialogue.en: The Tang monk climbed back onto the horse
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk klaɪmd bæk ˈɑntu ðə hɔrs

dialogue.en: And the three travelers headed toward the monastery
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə θri ˈtrævələrz ˈhɛdɪd təˈwɔrd ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 三位旅人朝着寺院走去

dialogue.en: Maybe the monks didn't hear me
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi ðə mʌŋks ˈdɪdənt hir mi

dialogue.en: Maybe they're all in the kitchen cooking food
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi ðɛr ɔl ɪn ðə ˈkɪʧən ˈkʊkɪŋ fud
dialogue.zh: 说不定他们都在厨房做饭呢

dialogue.en: With noodles boiling and vegetables sizzling
dialogue.ipa: wɪð ˈnudəlz ˈbɔɪlɪŋ ænd ˈvɛʤtəbəlz ˈsɪzəlɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 面条咕嘟咕嘟煮着,蔬菜刺啦刺啦响

dialogue.en: A kitchen can be quite noisy
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈkɪʧən kæn bi kwaɪt ˈnɔɪzi

dialogue.zh: 猪八戒的肚子又叫了起来

dialogue.en: I'll go in and find out
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ ɪn ænd faɪnd aʊt

dialogue.en: He opened the door and stepped inside
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈoʊpənd ðə dɔr ænd stɛpt ɪnˈsaɪd

dialogue.en: The monastery was dark and silent
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri wʌz dɑrk ænd ˈsaɪlənt

dialogue.en: He walked down a long hallway
dialogue.ipa: hi wɔkt daʊn ə lɔŋ ˈhɔlˌweɪ
dialogue.zh: 他沿着长长的走廊走去

dialogue.en: Then he saw a room that was lit up
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi sɔ ə rum ðæt wʌz lɪt ʌp
dialogue.zh: 这时他看见一间亮着灯的房间

dialogue.en: Bright sunlight was streaming through a window and onto a table
dialogue.ipa: braɪt ˈsʌnˌlaɪt wʌz ˈstrimɪŋ θru ə ˈwɪndoʊ ænd ˈɑntu ə ˈteɪbəl
dialogue.zh: 明亮的阳光透过窗户洒在桌子上

dialogue.en: On the table were three silk vests
dialogue.ipa: ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl wɜr θri sɪlk vɛsts
dialogue.zh: 桌上摆着三件丝绸背心
这些背心看起来真华丽

dialogue.en: Then he grabbed the vests and hurried back outside
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ɡræbd ðə vɛsts ænd ˈhɜrid bæk ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 然后抓起背心匆匆回到外面

dialogue.en: He said to the monk and Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd tu ðə mʌŋk ænd wu ʤɪŋ

dialogue.en: Bajie handed a vest to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ˈhændɪd ə vɛst tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 八戒递给唐僧一件背心

dialogue.en: You must return those vests right away
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst rɪˈtɜrn ðoʊz vɛsts raɪt əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 你们必须立刻归还那些背心

dialogue.en: We can return the vests before we leave
dialogue.ipa: wi kæn rɪˈtɜrn ðə vɛsts bɪ ˈfɔr wi liv
dialogue.zh: 我们可以在离开前归还背心

dialogue.en: We'll never get the true scriptures from Buddha if you steal
dialogue.ipa: wil ˈnɛvər ɡɛt ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz frʌm ˈbudə ɪf ju stil
dialogue.zh: 如果你们偷窃,我们永远得不到佛祖的真经

dialogue.en: Master you don't have to wear your vest
dialogue.ipa: ˈmæstər ju doʊnt hæv tu wɛr jʊər vɛst
dialogue.zh: 师父,您不用穿您的背心

dialogue.en: He put his arm through the armhole
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊt hɪz ɑrm θru ði armhole

dialogue.en: Bajie put his other arm through
dialogue.ipa: Bajie pʊt hɪz ˈʌðər ɑrm θru
dialogue.zh: 八戒把另一只胳膊也伸了进去

dialogue.en: Wu Jing began buttoning his vest
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ bɪˈɡæn ˈbʌtənɪŋ hɪz vɛst
dialogue.zh: 悟净开始扣背心的扣子

dialogue.en: They both fell to the ground
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ boʊθ fɛl tu ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: Trying desperately to take the vests off
dialogue.ipa: ˈtraɪɪŋ ˈdɛspərətli tu teɪk ðə vɛsts ɔf

dialogue.en: A demon with one big horn rushed over
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈdimən wɪð wʌn bɪɡ hɔrn rʌʃt ˈoʊvər
dialogue.zh: 一只长着大角的妖怪冲了过来

dialogue.en: He looked at Bajie and Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ

dialogue.en: And then turned to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn tɜrnd tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Said the monk shaking with fear
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə mʌŋk ˈʃeɪkɪŋ wɪð fɪr

dialogue.en: I'm traveling to the west for
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈtrævəlɪŋ tu ðə wɛst fɔr

dialogue.en: The demon clasped his hands together
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən klæspt hɪz hændz təˈɡɛðər

The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: Master you don't have to wear your vest
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's go up there get warm
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: Do you two believe there are demons up there
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That settles it
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: We'll never get the true scriptures from Buddha if you steal
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When they got there
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: I'm so cold
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.
