titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 65 The Metal Ring

dialogue.en: The demon tied up the Tang monk in a dark room
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən taɪd ʌp ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪn ə dɑrk rum
dialogue.zh: 妖怪把唐僧绑在一间暗室里

dialogue.en: That demon dragged in Bajie and Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈdimən dræɡd ɪn Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪拖进了八戒和悟净

dialogue.en: They were still trapped in the vests
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɜr stɪl træpt ɪn ðə vɛsts

dialogue.en: The demon dumped them in a corner and approached the monk
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən dʌmpt ðɛm ɪn ə ˈkɔrnər ænd əˈproʊʧt ðə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 妖怪把他们扔在角落,朝和尚走去

dialogue.en: I've been hoping you would pass my mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪv bɪn ˈhoʊpɪŋ ju wʊd pæs maɪ ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 我一直盼着你经过我的山

dialogue.en: The demon said with an evil smile
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən sɛd wɪð ən ˈivəl smaɪl

dialogue.en: We're trying to reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈtraɪɪŋ tu riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我们正要去往西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: I also know that I'll live forever if I eat you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ noʊ ðæt aɪl lɪv fəˈrɛvər ɪf aɪ it ju
dialogue.zh: 我还知道吃了你就能长生不老

dialogue.en: Demanded Wu Jing from the corner
dialogue.ipa: dɪˈmændɪd wu ʤɪŋ frʌm ðə ˈkɔrnər

dialogue.en: The demon turned to face him
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən tɜrnd tu feɪs hɪm

dialogue.en: Our friend will find us soon
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər frɛnd wɪl faɪnd ʌs sun
dialogue.zh: 我们的朋友很快就会找到我们

dialogue.en: And when he learns that you kidnapped us
dialogue.ipa: ænd wɛn hi lɜrnz ðæt ju ˈkɪdˌnæpt ʌs
dialogue.zh: 等他发现你绑架了我们
他会把你的整座山都毁掉

dialogue.ipa: hɪz neɪm ɪz sʌn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: Is he the Sun Wukong who cause trouble in heaven
dialogue.ipa: ɪz hi ðə sʌn wu kɔŋ hu kɑz ˈtrʌbəl ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 是那个大闹天宫的孙悟空吗
妖怪的声音听起来有些紧张

dialogue.en: Heaven's entire army couldn't defeat him
dialogue.ipa: ˈhɛvənz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi ˈkʊdənt dɪˈfit hɪm

dialogue.en: Even the Jade Emperor is afraid of him
dialogue.ipa: ˈivɪn ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər ɪz əˈfreɪd ʌv hɪm

dialogue.en: Well I'm not afraid of him
dialogue.ipa: wɛl aɪm nɑt əˈfreɪd ʌv hɪm

dialogue.en: The demon walked out of the room
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən wɔkt aʊt ʌv ðə rum

dialogue.en: Once he was away from the others though
dialogue.ipa: wʌns hi wʌz əˈweɪ frʌm ði ˈʌðərz ðoʊ

dialogue.en: I'm going to need my special weapon to defeat him
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu nid maɪ ˈspɛʃəl ˈwɛpən tu dɪˈfit hɪm
dialogue.zh: 我得用我的法宝才能打败他

dialogue.en: Revealing a metal ring around his arm
dialogue.ipa: rɪˈvilɪŋ ə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ əˈraʊnd hɪz ɑrm
dialogue.zh: 露出了手臂上的金属环

dialogue.en: Wukong returned to where he left his friends
dialogue.ipa: Wukong rɪˈtɜrnd tu wɛr hi lɛft hɪz frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 悟空回到了他留下同伴的地方

dialogue.en: He looked up toward the monastery
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt ʌp təˈwɔrd ðə ˈmɑnə ˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 他抬头望向寺院的方向

dialogue.en: In its place was a dark cave
dialogue.ipa: ɪn ɪts pleɪs wʌz ə dɑrk keɪv
dialogue.zh: 取而代之的是一个黑暗的山洞

dialogue.en: A demon must have made it to trick people
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈdimən mʌst hæv meɪd ɪt tu trɪk ˈpipəl
dialogue.zh: 肯定是妖怪变出来骗人的

dialogue.en: Why don't my friends believe me when I warn them about demons
dialogue.ipa: waɪ doʊnt maɪ frɛndz bɪˈliv mi wɛn aɪ wɔrn ðɛm əˈbaʊt ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 为什么我警告朋友们有妖怪时,他们都不相信我?

dialogue.en: He put down the food and rushed to the cave
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊt daʊn ðə fud ænd rʌʃt tu ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: I'll turn this entire mountain into a pile of rubble
dialogue.ipa: aɪl tɜrn ðɪs ɪn ˈtaɪər ˈmaʊntən ˈɪntu ə paɪl ʌv ˈrʌbəl
dialogue.zh: 我就把整座山夷为平地。

dialogue.en: And one horned buffalo stepped out
dialogue.ipa: ænd wʌn hɔrnd ˈbʌfəˌloʊ stɛpt aʊt
dialogue.zh: 一只独角水牛走了出来。

dialogue.en: One horned buffalo folded his arms
dialogue.ipa: wʌn hɔrnd ˈbʌfəˌloʊ ˈfoʊldɪd hɪz ɑrmz

dialogue.en: I'm not going to release your friends
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu riˈlis jʊər frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 我不会放了你的朋友们。

dialogue.en: They stole my valuable silk vests
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ stoʊl maɪ ˈvæljəbəl sɪlk vɛsts
dialogue.zh: 他们偷了我珍贵的丝绸背心。

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is a good and honest man
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz ə ɡʊd ænd ˈɑnəst mæn
dialogue.zh: 唐僧是个善良诚实的人。

dialogue.en: I can't believe you would even suggest
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt bɪˈliv ju wʊd ˈivɪn səɡˈʤɛst
dialogue.zh: 我简直不敢相信你居然会这么说。

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar and swung it at the demon
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd swʌŋ ɪt æt ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 悟空抽出铁棒,朝妖怪挥去。

dialogue.en: One horn buffalo dodged the bar
dialogue.ipa: wʌn hɔrn ˈbʌfəˌloʊ dɑʤd ðə bɑr

dialogue.en: Rocks exploded and tumbled down the mountain slope
dialogue.ipa: rɑks ɪk ˈsploʊdɪd ænd ˈtʌmbəld daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən sloʊp
ðə ˈdimən ɡlɛrd æt wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor might fear you
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər maɪt fɪr ju

dialogue.en: And the monkey swung his iron bar again
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈmʌŋki swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: The demon blocked it with his arm
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən blɑkt ɪt wɪð hɪz ɑrm

dialogue.en: He fell to his knees and turned his back to the monkey
dialogue.ipa: hi fɛl tu hɪz niz ænd tɜrnd hɪz bæk tu ðə ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 他跪倒在地,背对着猴子。

dialogue.en: My iron bar is not an ordinary weapon
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈaɪərn bɑr ɪz nɑt ən ˈɔrdəˌnɛri ˈwɛpən
dialogue.zh: 我的铁棒可不是普通兵器。

dialogue.en: He noticed the demon reaching up his sleeve
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈnoʊtəst ðə ˈdimən ˈriʧɪŋ ʌp hɪz sliv
dialogue.zh: 他注意到妖怪正伸手进袖子。

dialogue.en: Instantly Wukong felt himself being pulled toward the ring
dialogue.ipa: ˈɪnstəntli wu kɔŋ fɛlt hɪmˈsɛlf ˈbiɪŋ pʊld təˈwɔrd ðə rɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空瞬间感到自己被拉向那个环

dialogue.en: The monkey leaped into the air
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr

dialogue.en: But the bar was wrenched from his hands
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə bɑr wʌz rɛnʧt frʌm hɪz hændz
dialogue.zh: 但铁棒从他手中被猛地夺走

dialogue.en: It flew into the metal ring and vanished
dialogue.ipa: ɪt flu ˈɪntu ðə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ ænd ˈvænɪʃt
dialogue.zh: 它飞入金属环中消失了

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: They were still trapped in the vests
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.

The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I know where you're going
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.

This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: A demon must have made it to trick people
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I also know that I'll live forever if I eat you
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: But the bar was wrenched from his hands
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can't believe you would even suggest
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Heaven's entire army couldn't defeat him
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: A demon must have made it to trick people
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Open up
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who is your friend
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: I also know that I'll live forever if I eat you
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: And when he learns that you kidnapped us
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I know where you're going
examples: Do you know where the road ends?

He asked when Wukong would return.

Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 66 help from heaven

dialogue.en: One horn buffalo went back into his cave and slammed the door shut
dialogue.ipa: wʌn hɔrn ˈbʌfəˌloʊ wɛnt bæk ˈɪntu hɪz keɪv ænd slæmd ðə dɔr ʃʌt
dialogue.zh: 独角牛精回到洞里,砰地关上了门

dialogue.en: What am I going to do
dialogue.ipa: wɑt æm aɪ ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu du

dialogue.en: That demon said he remembered me
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈdimən sɛd hi rɪ ˈmɛmbərd mi

dialogue.en: He also mentioned the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈɔlsoʊ ˈmɛnʃənd ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər

dialogue.en: Maybe that demon escaped from heaven
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi ðæt ˈdimən ɪ ˈskeɪpt frʌm ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 也许那妖怪是从天宫逃出来的

dialogue.en: The monkey shot into the sky and soon arrived at the southern gate of heaven
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ʃɑt ˈɪntu ðə skaɪ ænd sun əˈraɪvd æt ðə ˈsʌðərn ɡeɪt ʌv ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 猴子直冲云霄,很快到了南天门

dialogue.en: He told the guard everything that had happened
dialogue.ipa: hi toʊld ðə ɡɑrd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ðæt hæd ˈhæpənd
dialogue.zh: 他把发生的一切都告诉了守门天将

dialogue.en: The guard sent a messenger to see if any spirits were missing from heaven
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑrd sɛnt ə ˈmɛsənʤər tu si ɪf ˈɛni ˈspɪrɪts wɜr ˈmɪsɪŋ frʌm ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 天将派信使去查看天宫是否有仙灵失踪

dialogue.en: The messenger returned quickly with a warrior
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɛsənʤər rɪ ˈtɜrnd ˈkwɪkli wɪð ə ˈwɔriər
dialogue.zh: 信使很快带着一位神将返回

dialogue.en: The warrior held a large sword
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔriər hɛld ə lɑrʤ sɔrd

dialogue.en: But I will arrest one horn buffalo for you
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ wɪl əˈrɛst wʌn hɔrn ˈbʌfəˌloʊ fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 但我会为你捉拿独角牛精

dialogue.en: Wukong returned to earth with the warrior
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu ɜrθ wɪð ðə ˈwɔriər
dialogue.zh: 悟空与神将一同返回凡间

dialogue.en: The warrior banged on the cave door
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔriər bæŋd ɑn ðə keɪv dɔr

dialogue.en: The demon came outside and eyed the warrior
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən keɪm ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd aɪd ðə ˈwɔriər
dialogue.zh: 妖怪走出来,打量着神将

dialogue.en: The warrior puffed out his chest
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔriər pʌft aʊt hɪz ʧɛst

dialogue.en: How dare you tell me to go away
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju tɛl mi tu ɡoʊ əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: He pointed his sword at the demon
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈpɔɪntɪd hɪz sɔrd æt ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: If you don't come with me
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju doʊnt kʌm wɪð mi

dialogue.en: One horned buffalo held up the metal ring and
dialogue.ipa: wʌn hɔrnd ˈbʌfə ˌloʊ hɛld ʌp ðə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ ænd

dialogue.en: The warrior's sword flew into it
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔriərz sɔrd flu ˈɪntu ɪt

dialogue.en: The warrior's face fell as he looked at his empty hand
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔriərz feɪs fɛl æz hi lʊkt æt hɪz ˈɛmpti hænd
dialogue.zh: 神将看着空空的双手,脸色一沉

dialogue.en: The demon laughed and went back into his cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən læft ænd wɛnt bæk ˈɪntu hɪz keɪv
sɛd ðə ˈwɔriər tu wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: They returned to heaven and bowed before the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ rɪˈtɜrnd tu ˈhɛvən ænd baʊd bɪˈfɔr ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 他们返回天宫,拜见玉帝

dialogue.en: But the demons stole my sword
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈdimənz stoʊl maɪ sɔrd

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor turned to his general
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər tɜrnd tu hɪz ˈʤɛnərəl
dialogue.zh: 玉皇大帝转向他的将军

dialogue.en: Send a fire god to earth with these two
dialogue.ipa: sɛnd ə ˈfaɪər ɡɑd tu ɜrθ wɪð ðiz tu
dialogue.zh: 派一位火神带着这两人下凡

dialogue.en: A fire god joined Wukong and the warrior
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈfaɪər ɡɑd ʤɔɪnd wu kæŋ ænd ðə ˈwɔriər
dialogue.zh: 一位火神加入了吴刚和战士的行列

dialogue.en: I'll arrest the demon for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪl əˈrɛst ðə ˈdimən fɔr ju

dialogue.en: The three of them went down to earth and landed on the mountain
dialogue.ipa: Thei θri ʌv ðɛm wɛnt daʊn tu ɜrθ ænd ˈlændɪd ɑn ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 他们三人下凡,降落在山上

dialogue.en: The fire god stood in front of the cave door
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈfaɪər ɡɑd stʊd ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə keɪv dɔr

dialogue.en: He held up his fire spear and shouted
dialogue.ipa: hi hɛld ʌp hɪz ˈfaɪər spɪr ænd ˈʃaʊtɪd
dialogue.zh: 他举起火焰长矛,高声喊道

dialogue.en: The cave door opened and the demon stepped outside
dialogue.ipa: ðə keɪv dɔr ˈoʊpənd ænd ðə ˈdimən stɛpt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 洞门打开,妖怪走了出来

dialogue.en: I'm a fire god sent by the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ə ˈfaɪər ɡɑd sɛnt baɪ ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 我是玉皇大帝派来的火神

dialogue.en: The fire god threw the flaming spear at the demon
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈfaɪər ɡɑd θru ðə ˈfleɪmɪŋ spɪr æt ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 火神将火焰长矛掷向妖怪

dialogue.en: But once again the demon held up the metal ring
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wʌns əˈɡɛn ðə ˈdimən hɛld ʌp ðə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 但妖怪再次举起了金属环

dialogue.en: The demon returned to his cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz keɪv

dialogue.en: The three of them returned to heaven and bowed before the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri ʌv ðɛm rɪˈtɜrnd tu ˈhɛvən ænd baʊd bɪˈfɔr ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər
dialogue.zh: 他们三人返回天庭,跪拜在玉皇大帝面前

dialogue.en: One horned buffalo is very powerful
dialogue.ipa: wʌn hɔrnd ˈbʌfəˌloʊ ɪz ˈvɛri ˈpaʊərfəl

dialogue.en: I wasn't able to arrest him
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈwɑzənt ˈeɪbəl tu əˈrɛst hɪm

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor sighed and turned to his general
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər saɪd ænd tɜrnd tu hɪz ˈʤɛnərəl
dialogue.zh: 玉皇大帝叹了口气,转向他的将军

dialogue.en: Send a thunder god with them this time
dialogue.ipa: sɛnd ə ˈθʌndər ɡɑd wɪð ðɛm ðɪs taɪm
dialogue.zh: 这次派一位雷神跟他们一起去

dialogue.en: Wukong watched as the thunder god approached the cave door
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wɑʧt æz ðə ˈθʌndər ɡɑd əˈproʊʧt ðə keɪv dɔr
dialogue.zh: 吴空看着雷神走近洞穴门

dialogue.en: The demon's metal ring is very dangerous
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimənz ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ ɪz ˈvɛri ˈdeɪnʤərəs
dialogue.zh: 妖怪的金属环非常危险

dialogue.en: He turned to the cave door and boomed
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd tu ðə keɪv dɔr ænd bumd
dialogue.zh: 他转向洞穴门,发出雷鸣般的声音

dialogue.en: The cave door opened and one horned buffalo stepped outside
dialogue.ipa: ðə keɪv dɔr ˈoʊpənd ænd wʌn ænd wʌn hɔrnd ˈbʌfəˌloʊ stɛpt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 洞门打开,一只独角牛走了出来。

dialogue.en: The thunder god instantly hurled his thunderbolts at the demon
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈθʌndər ɡɑd ˈɪnstəntli hɜrld hɪz ˈθʌndərˌbɔlts æt ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 雷神瞬间向妖怪投掷出雷电

dialogue.en: One horn buffalo held up the metal ring and whoosh
dialogue.ipa: wʌn hɔrn ˈbʌfəˌloʊ hɛld ʌp ðə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ ænd wuʃ
dialogue.zh: 独角牛举起金属环,嗖的一声

dialogue.en: The demon looked around at everyone and laughed
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən lʊkt əˈraʊnd æt ˈɛvriˌwʌn ænd læft
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪环顾四周,哈哈大笑起来

dialogue.en: Thank you for all the weapons
dialogue.ipa: θæŋk ju fɔr ɔl ðə ˈwɛpənz
dialogue.zh: 多谢你们送来的这些兵器

dialogue.en: He went back into his cave and slammed the door shut again
dialogue.ipa: hi wɛnt bæk ˈɪntu hɪz keɪv ænd slæmd ðə dɔr ʃʌt əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 他转身回到洞里,砰的一声又把门关上了

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: One horn buffalo went back into his cave and slammed the door shut
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The guard sent a messenger to see if any spirits were missing from heaven
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: He told the guard everything that had happened
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: What do you want
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Nobody is missing from heaven
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: But I will arrest one horn buffalo for you
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Open up one horned buffalo
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: He told the guard everything that had happened
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: The guard sent a messenger to see if any spirits were missing from heaven
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 67 The Master Thief

dialogue.en: What are we going to do now
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɑr wi ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu du naʊ

dialogue.en: One horn buffalo stole all our weapons
dialogue.ipa: wʌn hɔrn ˈbʌfəˌloʊ stoʊl ɔl ˈaʊər ˈwɛpənz
dialogue.zh: 独角牛把咱们的兵器全偷走了

dialogue.en: We can't go back to the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: wi kænt ɡoʊ bæk tu ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər

dialogue.en: He'll be angry if he finds out we couldn't arrest the demon
dialogue.ipa: hil bi ˈæŋɡri ɪf hi faɪndz aʊt wi ˈkʊdənt əˈrɛst ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 要是他知道咱们抓不住妖怪,肯定会大发雷霆

dialogue.en: It's getting dark out almost nighttime
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ˈɡɛtɪŋ dɑrk aʊt ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˈnaɪtˌtaɪm
dialogue.zh: 天快黑了,眼看就要入夜

dialogue.en: Maybe one of us can sneak into the cave and steal that metal ring
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi wʌn ʌv ʌs kæn snik ˈɪntu ðə keɪv ænd stil ðæt ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 要不咱们谁溜进洞去,把那金环偷回来

dialogue.en: I know who's perfect for that job
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ huz ˈpɜrˌfɪkt fɔr ðæt ʤɑb
dialogue.zh: 我知道谁最适合干这活儿

dialogue.en: The others all looked at the god
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðərz ɔl lʊkt æt ðə ɡɑd
dialogue.zh: 众神齐刷刷看向那位神仙

dialogue.en: One of us is a master thief
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ʌv ʌs ɪz ə ˈmæstər θif

dialogue.en: He once stole all the peaches from the Royal Peach Garden
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌns stoʊl ɔl ðə ˈpiʧəz frʌm ðə ˈrɔɪəl piʧ ˈɡɑrdən
dialogue.zh: 他当年把蟠桃园的仙桃偷了个精光

dialogue.ipa: naʊ ˈɛvriˌwʌn lʊkt æt wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 这下所有人都看向了悟空

dialogue.en: But I know now that stealing is wrong
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ noʊ naʊ ðæt ˈstilɪŋ ɪz rɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 但现在我知道偷盗是不对的

dialogue.en: However I will steal that metal ring because I need to save the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ˌhaʊˈɛvər aɪ wɪl stil ðæt ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ bɪˈkɔz aɪ nid tu seɪv ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 不过为了救唐僧,这金环我偷定了

dialogue.en: The monkey turned himself into a tiny bug and flew into the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki tɜrnd hɪmˈsɛlf ˈɪntu ə ˈtaɪni bʌɡ ænd flu ˈɪntu ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 猴子摇身变成小虫,飞进了山洞

dialogue.en: He went down a long dark tunnel followed by another tunnel
dialogue.ipa: hi wɛnt daʊn ə lɔŋ dɑrk ˈtʌnəl ˈfɑloʊd baɪ əˈnʌðər ˈtʌnəl
dialogue.zh: 他穿过一条幽暗的长隧道,又钻进另一条通道

dialogue.en: Then he heard one horned buffalo
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi hɜrd wʌn hɔrnd ˈbʌfəˌloʊ
dialogue.zh: 这时他听见了独角牛的声音

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ flu təˈwɔrd ðə vɔɪs

dialogue.en: The demon was sitting on the edge of a bed talking to himself
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ ɑn ði ɛʤ ʌv ə bɛd ˈtɔkɪŋ tu hɪmˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪正坐在床边自言自语

dialogue.en: The metal ring was still on his arm
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ wʌz stɪl ɑn hɪz ɑrm

dialogue.en: Said the demon with a yawn
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə ˈdimən wɪð ə jɔn

dialogue.en: I hope I can eat the Tang monk tomorrow
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp aɪ kæn it ðə tæŋ mʌŋk təˈmɑˌroʊ
dialogue.zh: 但愿明天能吃上唐僧肉

dialogue.en: I couldn't eat him today because of that annoying monkey and his friends from heaven
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈkʊdənt it hɪm təˈdeɪ bɪˈkɔz ʌv ðæt ə ˈnɔɪɪŋ ˈmʌŋki ænd hɪz frɛndz frʌm ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 今天都怪那烦人的猴子和天兵天将,害我没吃成

dialogue.en: The demon lay down and was soon asleep
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən leɪ daʊn ænd wʌz sun əˈslip
dialogue.zh: 妖怪躺下不久便睡着了

dialogue.en: Wukong flew over and landed on the demon's arm
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ flu ˈoʊvər ænd ˈlændɪd ɑn ðə ˈdimənz ɑrm
dialogue.zh: 悟空飞过去落在妖怪胳膊上

dialogue.en: He'll get itchy and have to take off the metal ring
dialogue.ipa: hil ɡɛt ˈɪʧi ænd hæv tu teɪk ɔf ðə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 他痒得受不了,自然会把金环摘下来

dialogue.en: Wukong bit the demon's arm again and again
dialogue.ipa: Wukong bɪt ðə ˈdimənz ɑrm əˈɡɛn ænd əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 悟空对着妖怪的胳膊咬了一遍又一遍

dialogue.en: The demon rolled over and mumbled in his sleep
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən roʊld ˈoʊvər ænd ˈmʌmbəld ɪn hɪz slip
dialogue.zh: 妖怪翻了个身,在梦里嘟囔着

dialogue.en: But he didn't take off the metal ring
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hi ˈdɪdənt teɪk ɔf ðə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ

dialogue.en: He was about to leave the room when he spotted some things in the corner
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz əˈbaʊt tu liv ðə rum wɛn hi ˈspɑtɪd sʌm θɪŋz ɪn ðə ˈkɔrnər
dialogue.zh: 他正要离开房间,却瞥见角落里有些东西

dialogue.en: Quietly he changed back into himself
dialogue.ipa: ˈkwaɪətli hi ʧeɪnʤd bæk ˈɪntu hɪmˈsɛlf

dialogue.en: He made his iron bar small and put it in his ear
dialogue.ipa: hi meɪd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr smɔl ænd pʊt ɪt ɪn hɪz ir
dialogue.zh: 他将铁棒变小塞进耳朵

dialogue.en: Then he grabbed the flaming spear
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ɡræbd ðə ˈfleɪmɪŋ spɪr

dialogue.en: Outside the cave the others were waiting
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ðə keɪv ði ˈʌðərz wɜr ˈweɪtɪŋ

dialogue.en: I hope Wukong steals that metal ring
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp wu kɔŋ stilz ðæt ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 但愿悟空能偷到那金刚琢

dialogue.en: I'm so angry at that demon
dialogue.ipa: aɪm soʊ ˈæŋɡri æt ðæt ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪真令我火冒三丈

dialogue.en: I can't believe he stole my fire spear
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt bɪˈliv hi stoʊl maɪ ˈfaɪər spɪr
dialogue.zh: 他竟敢盗走我的火尖枪

dialogue.en: The thunder god held up a hand
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈθʌndər ɡɑd hɛld ʌp ə hænd

dialogue.en: The three of them held their breath
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri ʌv ðɛm hɛld ðɛr brɛθ

dialogue.en: When they saw Wukong peek out
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðeɪ sɔ wu kɔŋ pik aʊt

dialogue.en: The monkey held up the weapons
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki hɛld ʌp ðə ˈwɛpənz

dialogue.en: The thunder god clapped the monkey on the back
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈθʌndər ɡɑd klæpt ðə ˈmʌŋki ɑn ðə bæk
dialogue.zh: 雷神拍了拍猴子的后背

dialogue.en: The warrior held up his sword
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɔriər hɛld ʌp hɪz sɔrd

dialogue.en: We can easily defeat the demon now
dialogue.ipa: wi kæn ˈizəli dɪˈfit ðə ˈdimən naʊ
dialogue.zh: 现在轻易就能降服那妖怪

dialogue.en: The monkey banged on the cave door
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki bæŋd ɑn ðə keɪv dɔr

dialogue.en: Get out here right now or we'll destroy your entire mountain
dialogue.ipa: ɡɛt aʊt hir raɪt naʊ ɔr wil dɪˈstrɔɪ jʊər ɪnˈtaɪər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 再不现身就把你这山头夷为平地
妖怪打着哈欠走出洞门

dialogue.en: How dare you steal from me
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ju stil frʌm mi

dialogue.en: He held up the metal ring
dialogue.ipa: hi hɛld ʌp ðə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ

dialogue.en: The weapons were sucked into it once again
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɛpənz wɜr sʌkt ˈɪntu ɪt wʌns əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 那些武器再次被吸了进去

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Cried Wukong
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The demon was sitting on the edge of a bed talking to himself
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: We need a different plan
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: The door is opening
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: He'll be angry if he finds out we couldn't arrest the demon
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: They were relieved
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We can't go back to the Jade Emperor
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: He'll be angry if he finds out we couldn't arrest the demon
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: He'll get itchy and have to take off the metal ring
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Get out here right now or we'll destroy your entire mountain
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: He'll be angry if he finds out we couldn't arrest the demon
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: He was about to leave the room when he spotted some things in the corner
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: However I will steal that metal ring because I need to save the Tang monk
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: I'm so angry at that demon
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I know who's perfect for that job
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 68 The Woman in the crowd

dialogue.en: Wukong stared at the cave door shocked
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ stɛrd æt ðə keɪv dɔr ʃɑkt

dialogue.en: One horned buffalo stole our weapons again
dialogue.ipa: wʌn hɔrnd ˈbʌfəˌloʊ stoʊl ˈaʊər ˈwɛpənz əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 独角牛又把我们的武器偷走了

dialogue.en: This demon's powers are stronger than any I've seen before
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ˈdimənz ˈpaʊərz ɑr ˈstrɔŋər ðæn ˈɛni aɪv sin bɪˈfɔr
dialogue.zh: 这妖怪的法力比我以前见过的任何妖怪都强

dialogue.en: I know one person who can definitely defeat him
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ wʌn ˈpɜrsən hu kæn ˈdɛfənətli dɪˈfit hɪm
dialogue.zh: 我知道有一个人肯定能打败他

dialogue.en: The monkey leaped onto a cloud
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lɛpt ˈɑntu ə klaʊd

dialogue.en: He arrived at the thunderclap monastery
dialogue.ipa: hi əˈraɪvd æt ðə thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri

dialogue.en: A guard at the gate stopped him
dialogue.ipa: ə ɡɑrd æt ðə ɡeɪt stɑpt hɪm

dialogue.en: I need to ask Buddha for help
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid tu æsk ˈbudə fɔr hɛlp

dialogue.en: It's about the Tang monk's journey
dialogue.ipa: ɪts əˈbaʊt ðə tæŋ mʌŋks ˈʤɜrni

dialogue.en: The guard waved the monkey through
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑrd weɪvd ðə ˈmʌŋki θru
dialogue.zh: 守卫挥手让猴子进去了

dialogue.en: Wukong entered the monastery and bowed before Buddha
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈɛntərd ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri ænd baʊd bɪˈfɔr ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 悟空进入寺院,向佛祖行礼

dialogue.en: I know why you're here Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ waɪ jʊr hir wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 我知道你为什么来,悟空

dialogue.en: I also know who the demon is
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ noʊ hu ðə ˈdimən ɪz

dialogue.en: You must go to laozi for help
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst ɡoʊ tu laozi fɔr hɛlp
dialogue.zh: 你必须去找太上老君帮忙

dialogue.en: He won't be happy to see me
dialogue.ipa: hi woʊnt bi ˈhæpi tu si mi

dialogue.en: When Wukong arrived at Laozi's house
dialogue.ipa: wɛn wu kɔŋ əˈraɪvd æt Laozi's haʊs
dialogue.zh: 当悟空到达太上老君的住处时

dialogue.ipa: wɑt du ju wɑnt wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: Buddha told me to come here
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə toʊld mi tu kʌm hir

dialogue.en: The Tang monk was captured by a demon called one Horned Buffalo
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz ˈkæpʧərd baɪ ə ˈdimən kɔld wʌn hɔrnd ˈbʌfə ˌloʊ
dialogue.zh: 唐僧被一个叫独角牛的妖怪抓走了

dialogue.en: And he's planning to eat the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ænd hiz ˈplænɪŋ tu it ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Your buffalo also has a metal ring
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ˈbʌfəˌloʊ ˈɔlsoʊ hæz ə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ

dialogue.en: Every time we try to fight him
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvəri taɪm wi traɪ tu faɪt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 每次我们试图和他打斗

dialogue.en: The ring sucks in our weapons
dialogue.ipa: ðə rɪŋ sʌks ɪn ˈaʊər ˈwɛpənz
dialogue.zh: 那环就把我们的武器吸走了

dialogue.en: The sage went into another room
dialogue.ipa: ðə seɪʤ wɛnt ˈɪntu əˈnʌðər rum
dialogue.zh: 圣人走进了另一个房间

dialogue.en: Wukong and laozi return to the mountain
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd laozi rɪˈtɜrn tu ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空和老子回到了山上

dialogue.en: And one horned buffalo stepped outside
dialogue.ipa: ænd wʌn hɔrnd ˈbʌfəˌloʊ stɛpt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd

dialogue.en: His face fell when he saw laozi
dialogue.ipa: hɪz feɪs fɛl wɛn hi sɔ laozi
dialogue.zh: 看到老子时,他的脸色立刻变了

dialogue.en: Laozi raised the fan and brought it down fast
dialogue.ipa: Laozi reɪzd ðə fæn ænd brɔt ɪt daʊn fæst
dialogue.zh: 老子举起扇子,迅速挥下

dialogue.en: A fierce wind nearly knocked over one horn buffalo
dialogue.ipa: ə fɪrs wɪnd ˈnɪrli nɑkt ˈoʊvər wʌn hɔrn ˈbʌfəˌloʊ
dialogue.zh: 一阵狂风差点把独角牛吹倒

dialogue.en: The demon pulled off the metal ring and flung it at laozi
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən pʊld ɔf ðə ˈmɛtəl rɪŋ ænd flʌŋ ɪt æt laozi
dialogue.zh: 妖怪扯下金属环,朝老子扔去

dialogue.en: The sage caught it and brought the fan down once more
dialogue.ipa: ðə seɪʤ kɑt ɪt ænd brɔt ðə fæn daʊn wʌns mɔr
dialogue.zh: 圣人接住了它,再次挥下扇子

dialogue.en: The wind knocked over the demon
dialogue.ipa: ðə wɪnd nɑkt ˈoʊvər ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: And he turned into a large green buffalo
dialogue.ipa: ænd hi tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə lɑrʤ ɡrin ˈbʌfəˌloʊ
dialogue.zh: 他变成了一头巨大的青牛

dialogue.en: The buffalo stood up and snorted
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈbʌfəˌloʊ stʊd ʌp ænd ˈsnɔrtɪd

dialogue.en: Laozi tucked the fan and the ring into his robe
dialogue.ipa: Laozi tʌkt ðə fæn ænd ðə rɪŋ ˈɪntu hɪz roʊb
dialogue.zh: 老子把扇子和环塞进袍子里

dialogue.en: Then he climbed onto the buffalo
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi klaɪmd ˈɑntu ðə ˈbʌfəˌloʊ

dialogue.en: And rode up into the sky
dialogue.ipa: ænd roʊd ʌp ˈɪntu ðə skaɪ
wu kɔŋ wɛnt ˈɪntu ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: And the warrior and two gods followed
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈwɔriər ænd tu ɡɑdz ˈfɑloʊd
dialogue.zh: 武士和两位天神也跟着进去了
他们很快找到了自己的武器

dialogue.en: The gods and I will return to heaven now
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑdz ænd aɪ wɪl rɪ ˈtɜrn tu ˈhɛvən naʊ
dialogue.zh: 我和天神们现在要回天上了

dialogue.en: Good luck with your journey Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ɡʊd lʌk wɪð jʊər ˈʤɜrni wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空,祝你们旅途顺利

dialogue.en: Wukong found his companions deep in the cave
dialogue.ipa: Wukong faʊnd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz dip ɪn ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空在洞穴深处找到了他的同伴们

dialogue.en: I was busy fighting a demon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ˈbɪzi ˈfaɪtɪŋ ə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: But next time I tell you to stay away from a place
dialogue.ipa: bʌt nɛkst taɪm aɪ tɛl ju tu steɪ əˈweɪ frʌm ə pleɪs
dialogue.zh: 但下次我让你们远离某个地方时

dialogue.en: The travelers arrived at a busy city
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz əˈraɪvd æt ə ˈbɪzi ˈsɪti
dialogue.zh: 旅行者们抵达了一座繁华的城市

dialogue.en: The streets were filled with people selling vegetables
dialogue.ipa: ðə strits wɜr fɪld wɪð ˈpipəl ˈsɛlɪŋ ˈvɛʤtəbəlz
dialogue.zh: 街道上挤满了卖蔬菜的人

dialogue.en: An old woman was stirring a large pot of soup
dialogue.ipa: ən oʊld ˈwʊmən wʌz ˈstɜrɪŋ ə lɑrʤ pɑt ʌv sup
dialogue.zh: 一位老妇人正在搅拌一大锅汤
其他食物在火上滋滋作响

dialogue.en: Suddenly a young woman rushed out of the crowd
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ə jʌŋ ˈwʊmən rʌʃt aʊt ʌv ðə kraʊd
dialogue.zh: 突然,一位年轻女子从人群中冲了出来

dialogue.en: She threw her arms around the monk
dialogue.ipa: ʃi θru hɜr ɑrmz əˈraʊnd ðə mʌŋk

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 69 The Stabbing Pain

dialogue.en: And she kidnapped the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ænd ʃi ˈkɪdˌnæpt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: And Bajie and Wu Jing followed
dialogue.ipa: ænd Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ ˈfɑloʊd

dialogue.en: The monkey saw a dark cloud speeding toward a mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki sɔ ə dɑrk klaʊd ˈspidɪŋ təˈwɔrd ə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 猴子看到一团乌云正急速飞向一座山

dialogue.en: Which disappeared when it reached the mountain
dialogue.ipa: wɪʧ ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd wɛn ɪt riʧt ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 云到达山边时便消失了

dialogue.en: They soon arrived at the mountain and found a cave
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ sun ə ˈraɪvd æt ðə ˈmaʊntən ænd faʊnd ə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 他们很快赶到山上,发现了一个洞穴

dialogue.en: Wukong pounded on the cave door
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈpaʊndɪd ɑn ðə keɪv dɔr

dialogue.en: Why are you pounding on my door
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɑr ju ˈpaʊndɪŋ ɑn maɪ dɔr

dialogue.en: Don't tell me what to do
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt tɛl mi wɑt tu du

dialogue.en: Blocking his iron bar and striking back with fury
dialogue.ipa: ˈblɑkɪŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd ˈstraɪkɪŋ bæk wɪð ˈfjʊri
dialogue.zh: 挡住了他的铁棒,并愤怒地反击

dialogue.en: Even Buddha is afraid of me
dialogue.ipa: ˈivɪn ˈbudə ɪz əˈfreɪd ʌv mi

dialogue.en: Bajie tried to hit her with his Rake but missed
dialogue.ipa: Bajie traɪd tu hɪt hɜr wɪð hɪz reɪk bʌt mɪst
dialogue.zh: 八戒用耙子打她,却打空了

dialogue.en: The woman was now spinning faster and faster
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwʊmən wʌz naʊ ˈspɪnɪŋ ˈfæstər ænd ˈfæstər
wu kɔŋ lɛpt æt ðə ˈwʊmən

dialogue.en: Suddenly he felt a stabbing pain
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli hi fɛlt ə ˈstæbɪŋ peɪn

dialogue.en: Bajie and Wu Jing stared after Wukong in shock
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ stɛrd ˈæftər wu kæŋ ɪn ʃɑk
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净震惊地望着悟空跑远

dialogue.en: The woman went back into her cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwʊmən wɛnt bæk ˈɪntu hɜr keɪv
dialogue.zh: 那女子回到了她的洞里

dialogue.en: Nothing hurts him except for the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: ˈnʌθɪŋ hɜrts hɪm ɪkˈsɛpt fɔr ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl
dialogue.zh: 除了紧箍咒,没什么能伤到他

dialogue.en: They went down the mountain and found the monkey crouching by a stream
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɛnt daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən ænd faʊnd ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈkraʊʧɪŋ baɪ ə strim
dialogue.zh: 他们下山,发现猴子蹲在小溪边

dialogue.en: He was still holding his head
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz stɪl ˈhoʊldɪŋ hɪz hɛd

dialogue.en: That woman stabbed me in the head
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈwʊmən stæbd mi ɪn ðə hɛd

dialogue.en: You're always bragging about how tough you are
dialogue.ipa: jʊr ˈɔlˌweɪz ˈbræɡɪŋ əˈbaʊt haʊ tʌf ju ɑr

dialogue.en: Now you're crying about getting stabbed in the head
dialogue.ipa: naʊ jʊr ˈkraɪɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈɡɛtɪŋ stæbd ɪn ðə hɛd
dialogue.zh: 现在被刺了下头就哭哭啼啼

dialogue.en: Let me see where she stabbed you
dialogue.ipa: lɛt mi si wɛr ʃi stæbd ju
dialogue.zh: 让我看看她刺中你哪儿了

dialogue.en: He just wants us to feel bad for him
dialogue.ipa: hi ʤʌst wɑnts ʌs tu fil bæd fɔr hɪm
dialogue.zh: 他就是想让我们同情他

dialogue.en: The monkey glared at the pig
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ɡlɛrd æt ðə pɪɡ

dialogue.en: The pain is going away now though
dialogue.ipa: ðə peɪn ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ əˈweɪ naʊ ðoʊ

dialogue.en: Let's go back up there and fight her again
dialogue.ipa: lɛts ɡoʊ bæk ʌp ðɛr ænd faɪt hɜr əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: The three companions returned to the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri kəmˈpænjənz rɪ ˈtɜrnd tu ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 三个同伴回到了山洞前

dialogue.en: I don't want you getting hurt again
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt ju ˈɡɛtɪŋ hɜrt ə ˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: The pig hit the door with his Rake
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ hɪt ðə dɔr wɪð hɪz reɪk

dialogue.en: Or we'll smash your entire mountain
dialogue.ipa: ɔr wil smæʃ jʊər ɪnˈtaɪər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 不然我们就砸平你这整座山

dialogue.en: The woman spun around faster and faster
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwʊmən spʌn ə ˈraʊnd ˈfæstər ænd ˈfæstər

dialogue.en: Bajie and Wu Jing tried to strike her with their weapons
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ traɪd tu straɪk hɜr wɪð ðɛr ˈwɛpənz
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净试图用兵器攻击她

dialogue.en: But the woman was too fast
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈwʊmən wʌz tu fæst
wu kɔŋ reɪzd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Waiting for a good moment to strike
dialogue.ipa: ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr ə ɡʊd ˈmoʊmənt tu straɪk

dialogue.en: He covered his nose and ran back down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkʌvərd hɪz noʊz ænd ræn bæk daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: The woman spun toward Wukong and Wujing
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwʊmən spʌn tə ˈwɔrd wu kɔŋ ænd Wujing
dialogue.zh: 那女人转向悟空和悟净

dialogue.en: They turned and ran back down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ tɜrnd ænd ræn bæk daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Bajie was huddled on the ground
dialogue.ipa: Bajie wʌz ˈhʌdəld ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: You didn't believe me when I got hurt
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈdɪdənt bɪˈliv mi wɛn aɪ ɡɑt hɜrt

dialogue.en: We still have to save the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wi stɪl hæv tu seɪv ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: The Bodhisattva was walking toward the group
dialogue.ipa: ðə Bodhisattva wʌz ˈwɔkɪŋ təˈwɔrd ðə ɡrup

dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈwʊmən ɪz ə ˈskɔrpiən ˈspɪrət

dialogue.en: What did she stab us with anyway
dialogue.ipa: wɑt dɪd ʃi stæb ʌs wɪð ˈɛniˌweɪ
dialogue.zh: 她到底用什么刺了我们

dialogue.en: It was her stinger that stabbed you
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz hɜr ˈstɪŋər ðæt stæbd ju
dialogue.zh: 是她的毒刺刺中了你们

dialogue.en: Thinking about the pain he'd felt
dialogue.ipa: ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə peɪn hid fɛlt

dialogue.en: Even Buddha is afraid of her
dialogue.ipa: ˈivɪn ˈbudə ɪz əˈfreɪd ʌv hɜr

dialogue.en: He was teaching his students one day and saw that scorpion creeping toward him
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈtiʧɪŋ hɪz ˈstudənts wʌn deɪ ænd sɔ ðæt ˈskɔrpiən ˈkripɪŋ təˈwɔrd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 一日他正在讲经,忽见那蝎子精朝他爬来

dialogue.en: He tried to move it away
dialogue.ipa: hi traɪd tu muv ɪt əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: He told his guards to capture the scorpion
dialogue.ipa: hi toʊld hɪz ɡɑrdz tu ˈkæpʧər ðə ˈskɔrpiən

dialogue.en: What are we going to do then
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɑr wi ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu du ðɛn

dialogue.en: We must save the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst seɪv ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Go to heaven and ask the Star Lord for help
dialogue.ipa: ɡoʊ tu ˈhɛvən ænd æsk ðə stɑr lɔrd fɔr hɛlp
dialogue.zh: 去天庭请昴日星官相助

dialogue.en: The Bodhisattva then disappeared in a flash of light
dialogue.ipa: ðə Bodhisattva ðɛn ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd ɪn ə flæʃ ʌv laɪt
dialogue.zh: 菩萨随即化作一道金光消失

dialogue.en: Wukong stood at the southern gate of heaven
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ stʊd æt ðə ˈsʌðərn ɡeɪt ʌv ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: I must speak with the Star Lord
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst spik wɪð ðə stɑr lɔrd

dialogue.en: The guard told Wukong the way to the Star Lord's palace
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑrd toʊld wu kɔŋ ðə weɪ tu ðə stɑr lɔrdz ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 天将给悟空指了星官宫殿的去处

dialogue.en: The monkey knocked on the palace door
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki nɑkt ɑn ðə ˈpæləs dɔr

dialogue.en: What can I do for you
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kæn aɪ du fɔr ju

dialogue.en: I'm traveling to the western paradise with the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈtrævəlɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: But he was captured by a demon
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hi wʌz ˈkæpʧərd baɪ ə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: Guan Yin said you can help me
dialogue.ipa: Guan jɪn sɛd ju kæn hɛlp mi
dialogue.zh: 观音菩萨说您能降服此怪

dialogue.en: I don't know why you need my help
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ waɪ ju nid maɪ hɛlp

dialogue.en: What kind of demon is it
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kaɪnd ʌv ˈdimən ɪz ɪt

dialogue.en: Wukong led the Star Lord out of heaven and down to earth
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lɛd ðə stɑr lɔrd aʊt ʌv ˈhɛvən ænd daʊn tu ɜrθ
dialogue.zh: 悟空引星官出了天门直往下界

dialogue.en: Where Bajie was still rubbing his nose
dialogue.ipa: wɛr Bajie wʌz stɪl ˈrʌbɪŋ hɪz noʊz
dialogue.zh: 见八戒正揉着鼻子等候

dialogue.en: The Star Lord is here to help us
dialogue.ipa: ðə stɑr lɔrd ɪz hir tu hɛlp ʌs

dialogue.en: The Star Lord looked at Bajie's nose
dialogue.ipa: ðə stɑr lɔrd lʊkt æt Bajie's noʊz

dialogue.en: I can heal that for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn hil ðæt fɔr ju

dialogue.en: Bajie walked over to the Star Lord
dialogue.ipa: Bajie wɔkt ˈoʊvər tu ðə stɑr lɔrd

dialogue.en: Who then blew on the pig's nose
dialogue.ipa: hu ðɛn blu ɑn ðə pɪɡz noʊz
dialogue.zh: 星君对着猪鼻子吹了口气

dialogue.en: But the stinger didn't leave a Mark on me
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈstɪŋər ˈdɪdənt liv ə mɑrk ɑn mi
dialogue.zh: 但那毒刺没在我身上留下痕迹

dialogue.en: I'm much more powerful than the pig
dialogue.ipa: aɪm mʌʧ mɔr ˈpaʊərfəl ðæn ðə pɪɡ

dialogue.en: I have special magic that I'll use to defeat the Scorpion
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv ˈspɛʃəl ˈmæʤɪk ðæt aɪl juz tu dɪˈfit ðə ˈskɔrpiən
dialogue.zh: 我有特殊法术能降服那蝎子精

dialogue.en: You just need to get her to come outside
dialogue.ipa: ju ʤʌst nid tu ɡɛt hɜr tu kʌm ˈaʊtˈsaɪd

dialogue.en: Everyone went up to the cave
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn wɛnt ʌp tu ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: Bajie and Wu Jing hid behind some rocks
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ hɪd bɪˈhaɪnd sʌm rɑks
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净躲在岩石后面

dialogue.en: Wukong stood in front of the cave entrance and shouted
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ stʊd ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə keɪv ˈɛntrəns ænd ˈʃaʊtɪd

dialogue.en: Then he ran as fast as he could away from the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ræn æz fæst æz hi kʊd əˈweɪ frʌm ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 随即他飞快地逃离洞口

dialogue.en: The woman rushed out of the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwʊmən rʌʃt aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: Suddenly the Star Lord turned into an enormous rooster
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðə stɑr lɔrd tɜrnd ˈɪntu ən ɪˈnɔrməs ˈrustər
dialogue.zh: 突然星君化作一只巨大的公鸡

dialogue.en: And the sound echoed through the mountains
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə saʊnd ˈɛkoʊd θru ðə ˈmaʊntənz

dialogue.en: The woman screamed and held her hands over her ears
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwʊmən skrimd ænd hɛld hɜr hændz ˈoʊvər hɜr ɪrz

dialogue.en: And the woman disappeared in a puff of smoke
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈwʊmən ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd ɪn ə pʌf ʌv smoʊk
dialogue.zh: 女子在一阵烟雾中消失无踪

dialogue.en: In her place was a dead scorpion
dialogue.ipa: ɪn hɜr pleɪs wʌz ə dɛd ˈskɔrpiən
dialogue.zh: 原地只留下一只死蝎子

dialogue.en: He found the Tang monk sitting at a table
dialogue.ipa: hi faʊnd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈsɪtɪŋ æt ə ˈteɪbəl

dialogue.en: As long as I'm protecting you
dialogue.ipa: æz lɔŋ æz aɪm prəˈtɛktɪŋ ju

dialogue.en: No demon will ever harm you
dialogue.ipa: noʊ ˈdimən wɪl ˈɛvər hɑrm ju

dialogue.en: The Tang monk shook his head
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ʃʊk hɪz hɛd

dialogue.en: That woman didn't want to harm me
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈwʊmən ˈdɪdənt wɑnt tu hɑrm mi

dialogue.en: But I told her that I'm a Buddhist monk and I will never marry
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ toʊld hɜr ðæt aɪm ə ˈbudəst mʌŋk ænd aɪ wɪl ˈnɛvər ˈmɛri
dialogue.zh: 但我告诉她,我乃出家之人,终身不娶

dialogue.en: My only goal is to reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈoʊnli ɡoʊl ɪz tu riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我的唯一目标就是抵达西天极乐世界

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said Guanyin
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: He was teaching his students one day and saw that scorpion creeping toward him
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: She is very dangerous
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I have special magic that I'll use to defeat the Scorpion
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: But he was captured by a demon
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You cannot go back to that cave
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Then he ran as fast as he could away from the cave
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But we must go back
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: That woman didn't want to harm me
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: He tried to move it away
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Go to heaven and ask the Star Lord for help
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: It was her stinger that stabbed you
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: A little while later
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I don't know why you need my help
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: Then he ran as fast as he could away from the cave
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.

Guanyin shook her head

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 71 money

dialogue.zh: 我们很快会停下来吃午饭

dialogue.en: I'm eager to reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈiɡər tu riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs

dialogue.en: Master I don't know why you're still going there
dialogue.ipa: ˈmæstər aɪ doʊnt noʊ waɪ jʊr stɪl ˈɡoʊɪŋ ðɛr
dialogue.zh: 师父,我不明白您为何还要去那里

dialogue.en: You should have married that scorpion spirit instead
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd hæv ˈmɛrid ðæt ˈskɔrpiən ˈspɪrət ɪnˈstɛd
dialogue.zh: 您当初还不如娶了那个蝎子精

dialogue.en: I would have gladly married her
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʊd hæv ˈɡlædli ˈmɛrid hɜr

dialogue.en: I doubt she would have married you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ daʊt ʃi wʊd hæv ˈmɛrid ju
dialogue.zh: 我怀疑她会不会愿意嫁给你
大家都笑了,包括八戒自己

dialogue.en: They had continued for another hour
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ hæd kənˈtɪnjud fɔr ə ˈnʌðər ˈaʊər

dialogue.zh: 这时猪八戒又抱怨起来

dialogue.en: We'll stop at the next village
dialogue.ipa: wil stɑp æt ðə nɛkst ˈvɪləʤ
dialogue.zh: 我们到下个村子就休息

dialogue.en: I hope we reach the next village soon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp wi riʧ ðə nɛkst ˈvɪləʤ sun
dialogue.zh: 希望我们能快点到下个村子

dialogue.en: I know how we can get there soon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ haʊ wi kæn ɡɛt ðɛr sun
dialogue.zh: 我知道怎么才能快点到

dialogue.ipa: sɛd wu kɔŋ wɪð ə læf

dialogue.en: Which shot forward. Wu kong! cried the Tang Monk, hanging on tightly.
dialogue.zh: 马便向前冲去。悟空!唐僧叫道,紧紧地抓着马。

dialogue.en: When the horse finally stopped running
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðə hɔrs ˈfaɪnəli stɑpt ˈrʌnɪŋ

dialogue.en: The monk was far ahead of his companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk wʌz fɑr ə ˈhɛd ʌv hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 唐僧已远远领先于同伴们

dialogue.en: A group of nasty looking men stood in front of him
dialogue.ipa: ə ɡrup ʌv ˈnæsti ˈlʊkɪŋ mɛn stʊd ɪn frʌnt ʌv hɪm
dialogue.zh: 一群面目狰狞的人挡在他面前

dialogue.en: Said a man with an ax
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ə mæn wɪð ən æks
dialogue.zh: 一个拿着斧头的人说道

dialogue.en: The Tang monk shook with fear
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ʃʊk wɪð fɪr
wu kɔŋ wʌz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈrʌnɪŋ ˈoʊvər

dialogue.en: Don't you dare harm my master
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt ju dɛr hɑrm maɪ ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 你们敢伤害我师父试试

dialogue.ipa: maɪ neɪm ɪz sʌn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: I'm not going to give you money
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ɡɪv ju ˈmʌni

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Which quickly grew to the height of a person
dialogue.ipa: wɪʧ ˈkwɪkli ɡru tu ðə haɪt ʌv ə ˈpɜrsən

dialogue.en: The monkey stood the bar on the ground
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki stʊd ðə bɑr ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: If you can pick this up
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju kæn pɪk ðɪs ʌp

dialogue.en: We'll give you all of our money
dialogue.ipa: wil ɡɪv ju ɔl ʌv ˈaʊər ˈmʌni
dialogue.zh: 我们就把所有的钱都给你

dialogue.en: Said the man with an ax
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə mæn wɪð ən æks

dialogue.en: I'm sure I can pick that bar up
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʃʊr aɪ kæn pɪk ðæt bɑr ʌp
dialogue.zh: 我肯定能拿起那根铁棒

dialogue.en: The man put down the ax
dialogue.ipa: ðə mæn pʊt daʊn ði æks

dialogue.en: He grasped the bar with his hands and tried to lift it
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡræspt ðə bɑr wɪð hɪz hændz ænd traɪd tu lɪft ɪt
dialogue.zh: 他双手握住铁棒,试图把它举起来

dialogue.en: He tried to lift the bar again
dialogue.ipa: hi traɪd tu lɪft ðə bɑr əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: Sweat poured down his red face
dialogue.ipa: swɛt pɔrd daʊn hɪz rɛd feɪs
dialogue.zh: 汗水从他通红的脸上淌下来

dialogue.en: He lifted the bar over his head and twirled it around
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈlɪftɪd ðə bɑr ˈoʊvər hɪz hɛd ænd twɜrld ɪt əˈraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 他把铁棒举过头顶,挥舞旋转
他的眼中闪过愤怒的光芒

dialogue.en: He got ready to strike the man
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡɑt ˈrɛdi tu straɪk ðə mæn

dialogue.en: The man took a step back
dialogue.ipa: ðə mæn tʊk ə stɛp bæk

dialogue.en: Suddenly the Bar dropped from Wukong's hands
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðə bɑrd drɑpt frʌm wu kɔŋz hændz
dialogue.zh: 突然,铁棒从悟空手中掉落

dialogue.en: He fell to his knees as the Tang monk quietly recited the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: hi fɛl tu hɪz niz æz ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈkwaɪətli rəˈsaɪtəd ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl
dialogue.zh: 他跪倒在地,唐僧正轻声念着紧箍咒

dialogue.en: The robbers glanced at one another and then ran away
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈrɑbərz ɡlænst æt wʌn əˈnʌðər ænd ðɛn ræn əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 强盗们互相看了一眼,然后逃跑了

dialogue.en: When the monk stopped reciting the spell
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðə mʌŋk stɑpt ri ˈsaɪtɪŋ ðə spɛl

dialogue.en: I destroy demons all the time
dialogue.ipa: aɪ dɪˈstrɔɪ ˈdimənz ɔl ðə taɪm

dialogue.en: But you must not hurt people
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju mʌst nɑt hɜrt ˈpipəl

dialogue.en: I can't bring you to the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt brɪŋ ju tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我不能带你去西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: Or I'll recite the tight headband spell until your head explodes
dialogue.ipa: ɔr aɪl rəˈsaɪt ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl ənˈtɪl jʊər hɛd ɪkˈsploʊdz
dialogue.zh: 否则我就念紧箍咒,直到你的脑袋炸开

dialogue.en: Wukong could see that the monk wasn't going to change his mind
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ kʊd si ðæt ðə mʌŋk ˈwɑzənt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ʧeɪnʤ hɪz maɪnd
dialogue.zh: 悟空看出师父心意已决

dialogue.en: The monkey leaped into the air and was gone
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd wʌz ɡɔn

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said the Tang monk
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: They were going to
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: They had continued for another hour
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I want to keep moving
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: You should have married that scorpion spirit instead
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: We'll stop for lunch soon
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: My legs are tired
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Can we stop walking
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Wukong could see that the monk wasn't going to change his mind
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You must not hurt people
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: You should have married that scorpion spirit instead
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: I want to keep moving
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: He grasped the bar with his hands and tried to lift it
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's make a bet then
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Give us all your money
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you can pick this up
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 72 a surprise at the Fruit and Flower Mountain

dialogue.en: Wukong went straight to Mount potalaka
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wɛnt streɪt tu maʊnt potalaka

dialogue.en: The Bodhisattva Guan Yin was in her garden
dialogue.ipa: ðə Bodhisattva Guan jɪn wʌz ɪn hɜr ˈɡɑrdən
dialogue.zh: 观音菩萨正在她的园中

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ θru ʌp hɪz hændz

dialogue.en: He was mad because I was going to hurt some robbers
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz mæd bɪˈkɔz aɪ wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu hɜrt sʌm ˈrɑbərz
dialogue.zh: 就因为我打算教训几个强盗,他就大发雷霆

dialogue.en: It's wrong to hurt people Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ɪts rɔŋ tu hɜrt ˈpipəl wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: I hurt demons all the time
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hɜrt ˈdimənz ɔl ðə taɪm

dialogue.en: And you're doing a good thing when you get rid of them
dialogue.ipa: ænd jʊr ˈduɪŋ ə ɡʊd θɪŋ wɛn ju ɡɛt rɪd ʌv ðɛm

dialogue.en: But you must not hurt people
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju mʌst nɑt hɜrt ˈpipəl

dialogue.en: The monkey sat down and put his head in his hands
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki sæt daʊn ænd pʊt hɪz hɛd ɪn hɪz hændz

dialogue.en: Now I'll never reach the western paradise with the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪl ˈnɛvər riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 这下我永远没法陪唐僧去西天取经了

dialogue.en: You will still help the Tang monk reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl stɪl hɛlp ðə tæŋ mʌŋk riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 你仍会助唐僧抵达西天

dialogue.en: He will need your help soon
dialogue.ipa: hi wɪl nid jʊər hɛlp sun
dialogue.zh: 他很快会需要你的帮助

dialogue.en: In the meantime you may stay here with me
dialogue.ipa: ɪn ðə ˈminˌtaɪm ju meɪ steɪ hir wɪð mi
dialogue.zh: 在此期间,你可以留在我这里

dialogue.en: The Tang monk climbed down from his horse and stretched
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk klaɪmd daʊn frʌm hɪz hɔrs ænd strɛʧt

dialogue.en: The horse drank from a stream while BA Jie looked in a bag
dialogue.ipa: ðə hɔrs dræŋk frʌm ə strim waɪl bi-eɪ ʤi lʊkt ɪn ə bæɡ
dialogue.zh: 白马在溪边饮水,八戒则翻看着行李袋

dialogue.en: We'll have to beg for food somewhere
dialogue.ipa: wil hæv tu bɛɡ fɔr fud ˈsʌm ˌwɛr
dialogue.zh: 我们得找个地方讨点吃的

dialogue.en: Master you wait here while BA Jie and I find a village
dialogue.ipa: ˈmæstər ju weɪt hir waɪl bi-eɪ ʤi ænd aɪ faɪnd ə ˈvɪləʤ
dialogue.zh: 师父,您在这儿等着,我和八戒去找个村子

dialogue.en: The monk's two companions flew off
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋks tu kəmˈpænjənz flu ɔf
dialogue.zh: 和尚的两个同伴飞走了

dialogue.en: The monk sat down in the grass next to the road and closed his eyes
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk sæt daʊn ɪn ðə ɡræs nɛkst tu ðə roʊd ænd kloʊzd hɪz aɪz
dialogue.zh: 和尚在路边的草地上坐下,闭上了眼睛

dialogue.en: He had nearly dozed off when he heard a voice
dialogue.ipa: hi hæd ˈnɪrli doʊzd ɔf wɛn hi hɜrd ə vɔɪs
dialogue.zh: 他几乎要打盹时,听到一个声音

dialogue.en: The Tang monk glared at the monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɡlɛrd æt ðə ˈmʌŋki
waɪ ɑr ju hir wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: The monkey fell to his knees
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki fɛl tu hɪz niz

dialogue.en: Please let me join you again
dialogue.ipa: pliz lɛt mi ʤɔɪn ju əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 请让我再跟您一起走吧

dialogue.en: You can't go to the western paradise with me
dialogue.ipa: ju kænt ɡoʊ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs wɪð mi

dialogue.en: Now leave before I recite the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: naʊ liv bɪˈfɔr aɪ rəˈsaɪt ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl
dialogue.zh: 现在就走,不然我念紧箍咒了

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar which quickly grew
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr wɪʧ ˈkwɪkli ɡru
dialogue.zh: 他抽出铁棒,铁棒迅速变长

dialogue.en: Before the monk could recite the spell
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈfɔr ðə mʌŋk kʊd rəˈsaɪt ðə spɛl

dialogue.en: Quickly the monkey grabbed the bags and then vanished
dialogue.ipa: ˈkwɪkli ðə ˈmʌŋki ɡræbd ðə bæɡz ænd ðɛn ˈvænɪʃt
dialogue.zh: 猴子迅速抓起包裹,然后消失了

dialogue.en: Wu Jing and BA Jie soon returned
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ænd bi-eɪ ʤi sun rɪ ˈtɜrnd
dialogue.zh: 吴京和八戒很快回来了

dialogue.en: They found the Tang monk sitting by the road rubbing his head
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ faʊnd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈsɪtɪŋ baɪ ðə roʊd ˈrʌbɪŋ hɪz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 他们发现唐僧坐在路边揉着头

dialogue.en: He begged me to let him join us again
dialogue.ipa: hi bɛɡd mi tu lɛt hɪm ʤɔɪn ʌs əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 他求我让他再跟我们一起走

dialogue.en: We can't let him get away with this
dialogue.ipa: wi kænt lɛt hɪm ɡɛt əˈweɪ wɪð ðɪs
dialogue.zh: 我们不能就这么放过他

dialogue.en: To the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: tu ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: I'll go there and deal with him
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ ðɛr ænd dil wɪð hɪm

dialogue.en: Bajie gave Wujing directions to the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ɡeɪv Wujing dəˈrɛkʃənz tu ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 八戒给吴京指了去花果山的路

dialogue.en: He found Wukong near the waterfall
dialogue.ipa: hi faʊnd wu kɔŋ nɪr ðə ˈwɔtər ˌfɔl
dialogue.zh: 他在瀑布附近找到了悟空

dialogue.en: The monkey looked at Wu Jing blankly
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lʊkt æt wu ʤɪŋ ˈblæŋkli

dialogue.en: We were traveling to the west together
dialogue.ipa: wi wɜr ˈtrævəlɪŋ tu ðə wɛst təˈɡɛðər

dialogue.en: I'm going to the west but not with you
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə wɛst bʌt nɑt wɪð ju
dialogue.zh: 我要去西天,但不是和你一起

dialogue.en: He pointed to a group of figures
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈpɔɪntɪd tu ə ɡrup ʌv ˈfɪɡjərz

dialogue.en: A monk who looked exactly like the Tang monk sat on a horse
dialogue.ipa: ə mʌŋk hu lʊkt ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk ðə tæŋ mʌŋk sæt ɑn ə hɔrs
dialogue.zh: 一位与唐僧一模一样的和尚坐在马上

dialogue.en: A pig stood next to the horse
dialogue.ipa: ə pɪɡ stʊd nɛkst tu ðə hɔrs

dialogue.en: Just then he saw a purple figure walk over to the horse
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn hi sɔ ə ˈpɜrpəl ˈfɪɡjər wɔk ˈoʊvər tu ðə hɔrs
dialogue.zh: 就在这时,他看到一个紫色的身影走向马匹
悟净震惊地倒吸一口气
