Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You can't go to the western paradise with me
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Before the monk could recite the spell
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But you must not hurt people
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: We'll have to beg for food somewhere
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: I wanted to earn forgiveness
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: He was mad because I was going to hurt some robbers
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's rest here
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: A monk who looked exactly like the Tang monk sat on a horse
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: And you're doing a good thing when you get rid of them
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: The horse drank from a stream while BA Jie looked in a bag
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: He was mad because I was going to hurt some robbers
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: You know who I am
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

And you're doing a good thing when you get rid of them

He started to cry

You will still help the Tang monk reach the western paradise
In the meantime you may stay here with me

We'll have to beg for food somewhere

The monk sat down in the grass next to the road and closed his eyes
Please let me join you again

Asked BA Jie looking around
We can't let him get away with this
He pointed to a group of figures
Just then he saw a purple figure walk over to the horse

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 73 Two Wukongs

dialogue.en: Wu Jing watched as the fake Wu Jing fed the horse some hay
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ wɑʧt æz ðə feɪk wu ʤɪŋ fɛd ðə hɔrs sʌm heɪ
dialogue.zh: 悟净看着假悟净给马喂了些干草

dialogue.en: I don't know how you made fake versions of us Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ haʊ ju meɪd feɪk ˈvɜrʒənz ʌv ʌs wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 我不知道你是怎么造出我们的假版本的,悟空

dialogue.en: But you won't get the true scriptures without the real Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju woʊnt ɡɛt ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz wɪˈθaʊt ðə riəl tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 但没有真正的唐僧,你得不到真经

dialogue.en: Wujing leaped into the air and flew south
dialogue.ipa: Wujing lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd flu saʊθ
dialogue.zh: 悟净跃向空中,向南飞去

dialogue.en: I'll tell the bodhisattva what Wukong is doing
dialogue.ipa: aɪl tɛl ðə bodhisattva wɑt wu kɔŋ ɪz ˈduɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 我要去告诉菩萨悟空在做什么

dialogue.en: When Wu jing arrived at Mount Potala
dialogue.ipa: wɛn wu ʤɪŋ əˈraɪvd æt maʊnt Potala

dialogue.en: Wukong was meditating in the Bodhisattva's garden
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wʌz ˈmɛdəˌteɪtɪŋ ɪn ðə Bodhisattva's ˈɡɑrdən
dialogue.zh: 悟空正在菩萨的花园里打坐

dialogue.en: How did you get here so fast
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɪd ju ɡɛt hir soʊ fæst
dialogue.zh: 你怎么这么快就到了这里

dialogue.en: Guan Yin came out of her pagoda
dialogue.ipa: Guan jɪn keɪm aʊt ʌv hɜr pə ˈɡoʊdə
dialogue.zh: 观音从她的宝塔中走出来

dialogue.en: Wu Jing what are you doing here
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ wɑt ɑr ju ˈduɪŋ hir

dialogue.en: Bodhisattva I must speak with you
dialogue.ipa: Bodhisattva aɪ mʌst spik wɪð ju

dialogue.en: Wukong has made fake versions of me
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ hæz meɪd feɪk ˈvɜrʒənz ʌv mi

dialogue.en: He's planning to make the journey without us
dialogue.ipa: hiz ˈplænɪŋ tu meɪk ðə ˈʤɜrni wɪˈθaʊt ʌs
dialogue.zh: 他计划不带我们自己去西天取经

dialogue.en: Wu Jing glanced at the monkey
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ɡlænst æt ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: I just saw him on the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʤʌst sɔ hɪm ɑn ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 我刚才还在花果山上看见他

dialogue.en: I don't know how he got here before me
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ haʊ hi ɡɑt hir bɪˈfɔr mi
dialogue.zh: 不知道他怎么比我先到了这里

dialogue.en: Wukong has been here the whole time
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ hæz bɪn hir ðə hoʊl taɪm

dialogue.en: Someone is pretending to be me
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɪz priˈtɛndɪŋ tu bi mi

dialogue.en: And he's living on my mountain
dialogue.ipa: ænd hiz ˈlɪvɪŋ ɑn maɪ ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Wukong and Wu Jing soon arrived on the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd wu ʤɪŋ sun əˈraɪvd ɑn ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 悟空和悟净很快便抵达了花果山

dialogue.en: The monkey's eyes burned with anger when he saw the fake Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋkiz aɪz bɜrnd wɪð ˈæŋɡər wɛn hi sɔ ðə feɪk wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 猴子一看到假悟空,眼中便燃起了怒火

dialogue.en: King of the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: kɪŋ ʌv ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: King of the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: kɪŋ ʌv ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: The fake Wukong pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə feɪk wu kɔŋ pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr
dialogue.zh: 假悟空也抽出了他的铁棒

dialogue.en: And so did the fake Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ænd soʊ dɪd ðə feɪk wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: The ground shook as the iron bars crashed into each other
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡraʊnd ʃʊk æz ði ˈaɪərn bɑrz kræʃt ˈɪntu iʧ ˈʌðər
dialogue.zh: 铁棒相撞,震得大地颤动

dialogue.en: The two monkeys fought with fury
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ˈmʌŋkiz fɔt wɪð ˈfjʊri

dialogue.en: Wu Jing watched as one Wukong struck the other
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ wɑʧt æz wʌn wu kɔŋ strʌk ði ˈʌðər
dialogue.zh: 悟净看着一个悟空击向另一个

dialogue.en: The other Wukong blocked the bar and swung back
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðər wu kɔŋ blɑkt ðə bɑr ænd swʌŋ bæk
dialogue.zh: 另一个悟空格挡开铁棒并反击回去

dialogue.en: Wu Jing raised his spear and was about to enter the fight
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ reɪzd hɪz spɪr ænd wʌz əˈbaʊt tu ˈɛntər ðə faɪt
dialogue.zh: 悟净举起长枪,准备加入战斗

dialogue.en: Wu Jing looked from one Wukong to the other
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ lʊkt frʌm wʌn Wukong tu ði ˈʌðər
dialogue.zh: 悟净的目光在两个悟空之间来回移动

dialogue.ipa: hu ɪz ðə riəl wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: Shouted one Wukong as he struck at the other
dialogue.ipa: ˈʃaʊtɪd wʌn wu kɔŋ æz hi strʌk æt ði ˈʌðər
dialogue.zh: 一个悟空一边攻击另一个,一边喊道
两只猴子立刻停止了打斗

dialogue.en: They looked at the purple spirit
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ lʊkt æt ðə ˈpɜrpəl ˈspɪrət

dialogue.en: I don't know which one of you is the real Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ wɪʧ wʌn ʌv ju ɪz ðə riəl wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 我不知道你们哪个才是真正的悟空

dialogue.en: Guan Yin will be able to tell who is who
dialogue.ipa: Guan jɪn wɪl bi ˈeɪbəl tu tɛl hu ɪz hu
dialogue.zh: 观音菩萨能分辨出谁是谁

dialogue.en: I will return to the Tang monk to tell him what's going on
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl rɪˈtɜrn tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tu tɛl hɪm wʌts ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn
dialogue.zh: 我会回去告诉唐僧发生了什么

dialogue.en: The two Wukongs glanced at each other
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu wu kɔŋz ɡlænst æt iʧ ˈʌðər
dialogue.zh: 两个悟空互相看了一眼

dialogue.en: Guan Yin will easily see that I am the real Wukong
dialogue.ipa: Guan jɪn wɪl ˈizəli si ðæt aɪ æm ðə riəl wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 观音菩萨一眼就能看出我才是真的悟空

dialogue.en: Guan Yin will easily see that I am the real Wukong
dialogue.ipa: Guan jɪn wɪl ˈizəli si ðæt aɪ æm ðə riəl wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 观音菩萨一眼就能看出我才是真的悟空

dialogue.en: Soon the two Wukong stood before Guanyin
dialogue.ipa: sun ðə tu wu kæŋ stʊd bɪˈfɔr Guanyin
dialogue.zh: 很快,两个悟空站在了观音面前

dialogue.en: She looked carefully at each one
dialogue.ipa: ʃi lʊkt ˈkɛrfəli æt iʧ wʌn

dialogue.en: I can't tell which one of you is the real Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt tɛl wɪʧ wʌn ʌv ju ɪz ðə riəl wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 我分不出你们哪个才是真正的悟空

dialogue.en: One Wukong took a deep breath
dialogue.ipa: wʌn Wukong tʊk ə dip brɛθ

dialogue.en: The spell will work only with my headband
dialogue.ipa: ðə spɛl wɪl wɜrk ˈoʊnli wɪð maɪ ˈhɛdˌbænd
dialogue.zh: 只有我的头箍才会起效

dialogue.en: The spell will only work with my headband
dialogue.ipa: ðə spɛl wɪl ˈoʊnli wɜrk wɪð maɪ ˈhɛdˌbænd
dialogue.zh: 只有我的头箍才会起效

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: I don't know how you made fake versions of us Wukong
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Wukong was meditating in the Bodhisattva's garden
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I'll tell the bodhisattva what Wukong is doing
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: I'll tell the bodhisattva what Wukong is doing
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: Wukong has made fake versions of me
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll tell the bodhisattva what Wukong is doing
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Wu Jing was surprised
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: She can stop him
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Bodhisattva I must speak with you
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Stop fighting
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who is the real Wukong
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When Wu jing arrived at Mount Potala
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 74 curious ear

dialogue.en: Guanyin recited the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin rəˈsaɪtəd ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl

dialogue.en: Both Wukongs fell to the ground
dialogue.ipa: boʊθ wu kɔŋz fɛl tu ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: And the two monkeys stood back up
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə tu ˈmʌŋkiz stʊd bæk ʌp
dialogue.zh: 两只猴子重新站了起来

dialogue.en: I still don't know which of you is the real Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ stɪl doʊnt noʊ wɪʧ ʌv ju ɪz ðə riəl wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 我还是不知道你们哪个才是真正的悟空

dialogue.en: You should both go to heaven
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd boʊθ ɡoʊ tu ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: The real Wukong used to live there
dialogue.ipa: ðə riəl wu kɔŋ juzd tu lɪv ðɛr
dialogue.zh: 真正的悟空曾在那里住过

dialogue.en: Maybe the Jade Emperor can tell who is who
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər kæn tɛl hu ɪz hu
dialogue.zh: 也许玉帝能分辨出谁是谁

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor will see that this monkey is a fake
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər wɪl si ðæt ðɪs ˈmʌŋki ɪz ə feɪk
dialogue.zh: 玉帝会看出这只猴子是假的

dialogue.en: He tried to strike the other Wukong
dialogue.ipa: hi traɪd tu straɪk ði ˈʌðər wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 他试图攻击另一个悟空

dialogue.en: But that one dodged the blow and swung back
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðæt wʌn dɑʤd ðə bloʊ ænd swʌŋ bæk
dialogue.zh: 但那个躲开了攻击并反击回来

dialogue.en: The two monkeys were still fighting when they arrived at the southern gate of heaven
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ˈmʌŋkiz wɜr stɪl ˈfaɪtɪŋ wɛn ðeɪ ə ˈraɪvd æt ðə ˈsʌðərn ɡeɪt ʌv ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 两只猴子打到南天门时仍在激战

dialogue.en: I must speak with the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst spik wɪð ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər

dialogue.en: He pointed at the other monkey
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈpɔɪntɪd æt ði ˈʌðər ˈmʌŋki
aɪm nɑt ə feɪk wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: I must speak with the Jade Emperor
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst spik wɪð ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər

dialogue.en: The guard allowed both Wukongs to enter heaven
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑrd əˈlaʊd boʊθ wu kɔŋz tu ˈɛntər ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 守卫放两个悟空都进了天庭

dialogue.en: Spirits and gods bled as the two Wukongs fought all over heaven
dialogue.ipa: ˈspɪrɪts ænd ɡɑdz blɛd æz ðə tu WuKongs fɔt ɔl ˈoʊvər ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 两只悟空打遍天庭,神仙们纷纷挂彩

dialogue.en: The monkeys knocked over statues and trees
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋkiz nɑkt ˈoʊvər ˈstæˌʧuz ænd triz
dialogue.zh: 猴子们撞翻了神像和树木

dialogue.en: They stormed into the Cloud Palace
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ stɔrmd ˈɪntu ðə klaʊd ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: When the Jade Emperor saw them
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər sɔ ðɛm
sɛd wʌn ʌv ðə wu kɔŋz

dialogue.en: Let me get a good look at you
dialogue.ipa: lɛt mi ɡɛt ə ɡʊd lʊk æt ju

dialogue.en: The two Wukong stood still as the Jade Emperor looked carefully at them
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu wu kɔŋ stʊd stɪl æz ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər lʊkt ˈkɛrfəli æt ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 两只悟空站定不动,玉帝仔细端详着他们

dialogue.en: I can't tell who is who
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt tɛl hu ɪz hu

dialogue.en: One of the Wukong swung at the other with his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ʌv ðə Wukong swʌŋ æt ði ˈʌðər wɪð hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr
dialogue.zh: 一个悟空挥起铁棒打向另一个

dialogue.en: The other Wukong blocked the bar and swung back
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðər wu kɔŋ blɑkt ðə bɑr ænd swʌŋ bæk
dialogue.zh: 另一个悟空堵住棍子,反手挥了回去

dialogue.ipa: wʌn wu kɔŋ ɪz bæd ɪˈnʌf

dialogue.en: I don't want two of you around
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tu ʌv ju əˈraʊnd

dialogue.en: The two monkeys kept fighting as they headed out of the palace
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ˈmʌŋkiz kɛpt ˈfaɪtɪŋ æz ðeɪ ˈhɛdɪd aʊt ʌv ðə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 两只猴子边打边冲出宫殿

dialogue.en: The spirit of the planet Venus followed them
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈspɪrət ʌv ðə ˈplænət ˈvinəs ˈfɑloʊd ðɛm

dialogue.en: Both monkeys stopped to look at him
dialogue.ipa: boʊθ ˈmʌŋkiz stɑpt tu lʊk æt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 两只猴子停下来看着他

dialogue.en: Go to the land of darkness
dialogue.ipa: ɡoʊ tu ðə lænd ʌv ˈdɑrknəs

dialogue.en: Maybe the judge of the dead can tell you apart
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi ðə ʤʌʤ ʌv ðə dɛd kæn tɛl ju əˈpɑrt

dialogue.en: Soon the two Wukongs were standing before the judge of the dead
dialogue.ipa: sun ðə tu wu kɔŋz wɜr ˈstændɪŋ bɪˈfɔr ðə ʤʌʤ ʌv ðə dɛd
dialogue.zh: 很快两只悟空就站在了阎王面前

dialogue.ipa: sɛd wʌn ʌv ðə wu kɔŋz

dialogue.en: Maybe it will have some information about the fake Sun Wukongs
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi ɪt wɪl hæv sʌm ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən əˈbaʊt ðə feɪk sʌn wu kɔŋz
dialogue.zh: 或许上面有假孙悟空的记录

dialogue.en: The judge nodded and opened the directory
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤʌʤ ˈnɑdɪd ænd ˈoʊpənd ðə dəˈrɛktəri

dialogue.en: He turned the pages of the giant book
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd ðə ˈpeɪʤəz ʌv ðə ˈʤaɪənt bʊk

dialogue.en: There's no fake Sun Wukong' in the directory
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz noʊ feɪk sʌn wu kɔŋ ɪn ðə dəˈrɛktəri
dialogue.zh: 生死簿上没有假孙悟空的记录

dialogue.en: But I have no idea which one of you is the real Wukong
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ hæv noʊ aɪˈdiə wɪʧ wʌn ʌv ju ɪz ðə riəl wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 我也分不清谁是真悟空

dialogue.en: A spirit was sitting at a nearby desk
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈspɪrət wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ æt ə ˈnɪr ˈbaɪ dɛsk
dialogue.zh: 一位仙吏坐在旁边的案桌前

dialogue.en: And a small beast crept out from under the desk
dialogue.ipa: ænd ə smɔl bist krɛpt aʊt frʌm ˈʌndər ðə dɛsk
dialogue.zh: 一只小兽从案桌下匍匐而出

dialogue.en: Curious ear can tell the true from the false
dialogue.ipa: ˈkjʊriəs ir kæn tɛl ðə tru frʌm ðə fɔls

dialogue.en: The beast stared hard at the two Wukongs
dialogue.ipa: ðə bist stɛrd hɑrd æt ðə tu wu kɔŋz
dialogue.zh: 神兽紧紧盯着两只悟空

dialogue.en: I know who the fake Sun Wukong is
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ hu ðə feɪk sʌn Wukong ɪz

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 75 battle of the Wukongs

dialogue.en: The two Wukong stared at curious ear
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu wu kɔŋ stɛrd æt ˈkjʊriəs ir

dialogue.en: I know which of you is the fake sun wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ wɪʧ ʌv ju ɪz ðə feɪk sʌn wukong
dialogue.zh: 我知道你们当中谁是假孙悟空

dialogue.en: But I won't say who it is
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ woʊnt seɪ hu ɪt ɪz

dialogue.en: The fake sun wukong has all the same powers as the real one
dialogue.ipa: ðə feɪk sʌn wukong hæz ɔl ðə seɪm ˈpaʊərz æz ðə riəl wʌn
dialogue.zh: 假孙悟空拥有和真身完全一样的神通

dialogue.en: He could destroy the entire palace
dialogue.ipa: hi kʊd dɪˈstrɔɪ ði ɪnˈtaɪər ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: I could destroy this whole palace if I wanted to
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kʊd dɪˈstrɔɪ ðɪs hoʊl ˈpæləs ɪf aɪ ˈwɔntɪd tu
dialogue.zh: 只要我愿意,就能摧毁这座宫殿

dialogue.en: You mean I could destroy it
dialogue.ipa: ju min aɪ kʊd dɪˈstrɔɪ ɪt

dialogue.en: The two Wukongs began swinging their iron bars at each other
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu wu kɔŋz bɪˈɡæn ˈswɪŋɪŋ ðɛr ˈaɪərn bɑrz æt iʧ ˈʌðər
dialogue.zh: 两个悟空开始挥舞铁棒互相攻击

dialogue.en: Cried the judge of the dead
dialogue.ipa: kraɪd ðə ʤʌʤ ʌv ðə dɛd

dialogue.en: You'll turn this whole palace down
dialogue.ipa: jul tɜrn ðɪs hoʊl ˈpæləs daʊn
dialogue.zh: 你们会把整座宫殿掀翻的

dialogue.en: He'll be able to see which of you is the real Wukong
dialogue.ipa: hil bi ˈeɪbəl tu si wɪʧ ʌv ju ɪz ðə riəl wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 他能看出你们谁是真悟空

dialogue.en: And he's powerful enough to destroy the fake one
dialogue.ipa: ænd hiz ˈpaʊərfəl ɪˈnʌf tu dɪˈstrɔɪ ðə feɪk wʌn
dialogue.zh: 而且他法力高强,足以消灭假的那个

dialogue.en: That's because you know Buddha is going to see who you really are
dialogue.ipa: ðæts bɪˈkɔz ju noʊ ˈbudə ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu si hu ju ˈrɪli ɑr
dialogue.zh: 那是因为你知道佛祖会看穿你的真面目

dialogue.en: He swung his iron bar furiously
dialogue.ipa: hi swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ˈfjʊriəsli

dialogue.en: Cried the judge of the dead
dialogue.ipa: kraɪd ðə ʤʌʤ ʌv ðə dɛd

dialogue.en: The two Wukongs left the land of darkness
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu wu kɔŋz lɛft ðə lænd ʌv ˈdɑrknəs

dialogue.en: Clouds swirled and thunder boomed as the two mighty spirits battled across the sky
dialogue.ipa: klaʊdz swɜrld ænd ˈθʌndər bumd æz ðə tu ˈmaɪti ˈspɪrɪts ˈbætəld əˈkrɔs ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 云层翻涌,雷声轰鸣,两个强大的神灵在空中激战

dialogue.en: They soon arrived in the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ sun əˈraɪvd ɪn ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 他们很快抵达了西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: A guard rushed out of the thunderclap monastery
dialogue.ipa: ə ɡɑrd rʌʃt aʊt ʌv ðə thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 一名守卫从雷音寺冲了出来

dialogue.en: The two Wukongs landed in front of the guard
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu wu kɔŋz ˈlændɪd ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə ɡɑrd
dialogue.zh: 两个悟空降落在守卫面前

dialogue.ipa: sɛd wʌn ʌv ðə wu kɔŋz

dialogue.en: I must speak with Buddha right away
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst spik wɪð ˈbudə raɪt ə ˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 我必须立刻与佛祖谈谈

dialogue.en: The other Wukong scratched his head
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðər wu kɔŋ skræʧt hɪz hɛd

dialogue.en: We can just come back another time
dialogue.ipa: wi kæn ʤʌst kʌm bæk ə ˈnʌðər taɪm

dialogue.en: The first Wukong shot a look at the other
dialogue.ipa: ðə fɜrst wu kɔŋ ʃɑt ə lʊk æt ði ˈʌðər
dialogue.zh: 第一个悟空瞪了另一个一眼

dialogue.en: But you must behave yourselves while inside
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju mʌst bɪˈheɪv jʊrˈsɛlvz waɪl ɪnˈsaɪd

dialogue.en: As the first Wukong started to enter the monastery
dialogue.ipa: æz ðə fɜrst wu kɔŋ ˈstɑrtɪd tu ˈɛntər ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 当第一个悟空正要踏入寺院时

dialogue.en: He grabbed the other monkey by the arm and dragged him into the monastery
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡræbd ði ˈʌðər ˈmʌŋki baɪ ði ɑrm ænd dræɡd hɪm ˈɪntu ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 他抓住另一只猴子的胳膊,硬把他拖进了寺院

dialogue.en: The other Wukong hesitated a moment and then bowed also
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðər wu kɔŋ ˈhɛzɪˌteɪtɪd ə ˈmoʊmənt ænd ðɛn baʊd ˈɔlsoʊ
dialogue.zh: 另一个悟空犹豫片刻,也跟着行了礼

dialogue.en: I must ask for your help
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst æsk fɔr jʊər hɛlp

dialogue.en: I know why you're here Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ waɪ jʊr hir wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空,我知道你为何而来

dialogue.en: He looked at the other monkey
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt ði ˈʌðər ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: And I know that you are a fake
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ noʊ ðæt ju ɑr ə feɪk
dialogue.zh: 我也知道你是个冒牌货

dialogue.en: The other Wukong gasped and then vanished
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðər wu kɔŋ ɡæspt ænd ðɛn ˈvænɪʃt
dialogue.zh: 另一个悟空倒吸一口气,随即消失无踪

dialogue.en: Buddha held a bowl up in the air and then placed it upside down on a table
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə hɛld ə boʊl ʌp ɪn ði ɛr ænd ðɛn pleɪst ɪt ˈʌp ˈsaɪd daʊn ɑn ə ˈteɪbəl
dialogue.zh: 佛祖将一只钵盂举到空中,然后倒扣在桌上

dialogue.en: I've trapped the fake Wukong under this bowl
dialogue.ipa: aɪv træpt ðə feɪk wu kɔŋ ˈʌndər ðɪs boʊl
dialogue.zh: 我已将那假悟空困在此钵之下

dialogue.en: A tiny monkey spirit lay on the table
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈtaɪni ˈmʌŋki ˈspɪrət leɪ ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl
dialogue.zh: 桌上趴着一只小小的猴精

dialogue.en: He was a monkey who became an evil spirit
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ə ˈmʌŋki hu bɪ ˈkeɪm ən ˈivəl ˈspɪrət
dialogue.zh: 这是只堕入邪道的猴子

dialogue.en: He wanted to be you because you're so powerful
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈwɔntɪd tu bi ju bɪˈkɔz jʊr soʊ ˈpaʊərfəl
dialogue.zh: 他想变成你,因为你法力高强

dialogue.en: Many spirits want to be me
dialogue.ipa: ˈmɛni ˈspɪrɪts wɑnt tu bi mi
dialogue.zh: 想变成我的精怪可多了

dialogue.en: The monkey thanked Buddha and then flew back to mount Potalaka
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki θæŋkt ˈbudə ænd ðɛn flu bæk tu maʊnt Potalaka
dialogue.zh: 猴子谢过佛祖,便飞回了普陀山

dialogue.en: Guanyin decided it was time for Wukong to rejoin his companions on the journey
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin ˌdɪˈsaɪdɪd ɪt wʌz taɪm fɔr wu kɔŋ tu riˈʤɔɪn hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ɑn ðə ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 观音觉得是时候让悟空重回取经队伍了

dialogue.en: She and the monkey found the Tang monk and the others along the road to the west
dialogue.ipa: ʃi ænd ðə ˈmʌŋki faʊnd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd ði ˈʌðərz əˈlɔŋ ðə roʊd tu ðə wɛst
dialogue.zh: 她与猴子在西行路上找到了唐僧一行人

dialogue.en: The bodhisattva told the Tang monk that it wasn't Wukong who'd attacked him
dialogue.ipa: ðə bodhisattva toʊld ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ðæt ɪt ˈwɑzənt wu kɔŋ hud əˈtækt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 菩萨告诉唐僧,袭击他的并非悟空

dialogue.en: You must keep Wukong with you
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst kip Wukong wɪð ju

dialogue.en: I'll make sure the Tang monk reaches the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪl meɪk ʃʊr ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈriʧəz ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我定会确保唐僧抵达西天。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Shouted one monkey
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I know which of you is the fake sun wukong
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: That's because you know Buddha is going to see who you really are
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: He'll be angry
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Buddha can help you
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: He could destroy the entire palace
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I must speak with Buddha right away
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: He wanted to be you because you're so powerful
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: That's because you know Buddha is going to see who you really are
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Get out
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There are two of you
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If I point him out
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When Buddha lifted the bowl
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: But you must behave yourselves while inside
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: That's because you know Buddha is going to see who you really are
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: He wanted to be you because you're so powerful
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 76 the iron immortal

dialogue.en: Wukong was once again traveling west with the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wʌz wʌns əˈɡɛn ˈtrævəlɪŋ wɛst wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: While I was at mount Potalaka
dialogue.ipa: waɪl aɪ wʌz æt maʊnt pohloka

dialogue.en: I realize now that it's wrong to harm people
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈriəˌlaɪz naʊ ðæt ɪts rɔŋ tu hɑrm ˈpipəl
dialogue.zh: 如今我明白害人是不对的。

dialogue.en: I won't ever do it again
dialogue.ipa: aɪ woʊnt ˈɛvər du ɪt əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: Not much has changed since I left
dialogue.ipa: nɑt mʌʧ hæz ʧeɪnʤd sɪns aɪ lɛft
dialogue.zh: 我离开后,大家还是老样子。

dialogue.en: Bajie still complains all the time
dialogue.ipa: Bajie stɪl kəmˈpleɪnz ɔl ðə taɪm

dialogue.en: Maybe we should take a break
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi wi ʃʊd teɪk ə breɪk

dialogue.en: But I don't understand why it's so hot
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ doʊnt ˌʌndərˈstænd waɪ ɪts soʊ hɑt
dialogue.zh: 但我不明白为何如此炎热。

dialogue.en: The travelers soon reached a village
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz sun riʧt ə ˈvɪləʤ
dialogue.zh: 一行人很快抵达了一个村庄。

dialogue.en: An old man offered to take them in for the night
dialogue.ipa: ən oʊld mæn ˈɔfərd tu teɪk ðɛm ɪn fɔr ðə naɪt
dialogue.zh: 一位老人主动提出收留他们过夜。

dialogue.en: Later that evening they were all eating dinner
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪtər ðæt ˈivnɪŋ ðeɪ wɜr ɔl ˈitɪŋ ˈdɪnər
dialogue.zh: 当晚稍晚,他们正一起吃晚饭。

dialogue.en: Is it always so hot here
dialogue.ipa: ɪz ɪt ˈɔlˌweɪz soʊ hɑt hir

dialogue.en: The mountain of flames is near here
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmaʊntən ʌv fleɪmz ɪz nɪr hir

dialogue.en: Well I'll be happy when we continue on our journey
dialogue.ipa: wɛl aɪl bi ˈhæpi wɛn wi kənˈtɪnju ɑn ˈaʊər ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 唉,等我们继续上路时我就开心了。

dialogue.en: Then we can get away from this heat
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn wi kæn ɡɛt əˈweɪ frʌm ðɪs hit
dialogue.zh: 那样就能摆脱这酷热了。

dialogue.en: We're going to the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs

dialogue.en: You can't travel west from here
dialogue.ipa: ju kænt ˈtrævəl wɛst frʌm hir

dialogue.en: Everyone stopped eating and looked at the old man
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn stɑpt ˈitɪŋ ænd lʊkt æt ði oʊld mæn
dialogue.zh: 所有人都停下吃饭,看向老人。

dialogue.en: The mountain of flames is to the west
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmaʊntən ʌv fleɪmz ɪz tu ðə wɛst

dialogue.en: The old man shook his head
dialogue.ipa: ði oʊld mæn ʃʊk hɪz hɛd

dialogue.en: All the land around the mountain is covered in flames
dialogue.ipa: ɔl ðə lænd əˈraʊnd ðə ˈmaʊntən ɪz ˈkʌvərd ɪn fleɪmz
dialogue.zh: 山周围的土地全被火焰覆盖了

dialogue.en: The land stretches far to the north and the south
dialogue.ipa: ðə lænd ˈstrɛʧəz fɑr tu ðə nɔrθ ænd ðə saʊθ
dialogue.zh: 这片土地向北向南延伸得很远

dialogue.en: Then we must wait for a strong rainstorm
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn wi mʌst weɪt fɔr ə strɔŋ ˈreɪnˌstɔrm
dialogue.zh: 那我们必须等一场大暴雨

dialogue.en: That will put out the flames
dialogue.ipa: ðæt wɪl pʊt aʊt ðə fleɪmz

dialogue.en: There is just one spirit who can put them out
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ɪz ʤʌst wʌn ˈspɪrət hu kæn pʊt ðɛm aʊt
dialogue.zh: 只有一位神仙能扑灭它们

dialogue.en: She has a special fan that can put out the flames
dialogue.ipa: ʃi hæz ə ˈspɛʃəl fæn ðæt kæn pʊt aʊt ðə fleɪmz
dialogue.zh: 她有一把特殊的扇子能扑灭火焰

dialogue.en: It's made from a plantain leaf
dialogue.ipa: ɪts meɪd frʌm ə ˈplæntən lif

dialogue.en: Where does the iron immortal live
dialogue.ipa: wɛr dʌz ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl lɪv

dialogue.en: I'll demand that she put out the flames
dialogue.ipa: aɪl dɪˈmænd ðæt ʃi pʊt aʊt ðə fleɪmz

dialogue.en: Wukong folded his arms in front of his chest
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈfoʊldɪd hɪz ɑrmz ɪn frʌnt ʌv hɪz ʧɛst

dialogue.en: I am as powerful as a god
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm æz ˈpaʊərfəl æz ə ɡɑd

dialogue.en: Just tell me where she lives
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst tɛl mi wɛr ʃi lɪvz
dialogue.zh: 只管告诉我她住在哪儿

dialogue.en: The old man told Wukong where the iron immortal lived
dialogue.ipa: ði oʊld mæn toʊld Wukong wɛr ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl lɪvd
dialogue.zh: 老人告诉了悟空铁扇仙的住处

dialogue.en: The monkey leaped into the air
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr

dialogue.en: Wukong was soon on the iron immortal's mountain
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wʌz sun ɑn ði ˈaɪrəni ɪˈmɔrtəlz ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 悟空很快来到了铁扇仙的山上

dialogue.en: He found a cave door and knocked
dialogue.ipa: hi faʊnd ə keɪv dɔr ænd nɑkt
dialogue.zh: 他找到一扇洞门敲了敲

dialogue.en: The door flew open and a tall woman appeared
dialogue.ipa: ðə dɔr flu ˈoʊpən ænd ə tɔl ˈwʊmən əˈpɪrd
dialogue.zh: 门猛地打开,出现一个高大的女子

dialogue.en: I need to borrow your fan
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid tu ˈbɑˌroʊ jʊər fæn

dialogue.en: The iron immortal glared at the monkey
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ˈmeɪdən ɡlɛrd æt ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: My husband is the bull demon king
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈhʌzbənd ɪz ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ

dialogue.en: Who used to be your friend
dialogue.ipa: hu juzd tu bi jʊər frɛnd

dialogue.en: And our son is red boy
dialogue.ipa: ænd ˈaʊər sʌn ɪz rɛd bɔɪ

dialogue.en: Red boy is a prisoner of the bodhisattva guan Yin
dialogue.ipa: rɛd bɔɪ ɪz ə ˈprɪzənər ʌv ðə bodhisattva guan jɪn
dialogue.zh: 红孩儿是观音菩萨的囚徒

dialogue.en: Can I please just borrow your fan for a little while
dialogue.ipa: kæn aɪ pliz ʤʌst ˈbɑˌroʊ jʊər fæn fɔr ə ˈlɪtəl waɪl
dialogue.zh: 我能借你的扇子用一小会儿吗?

dialogue.en: Can I speak with the bull demon king
dialogue.ipa: kæn aɪ spik wɪð ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ

dialogue.en: I'm not leaving until I borrow your
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈlivɪŋ ənˈtɪl aɪ ˈbɑˌroʊ jʊər
dialogue.zh: 不借到你的扇子我绝不走

dialogue.en: The Iron Immortal waved the fan
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl weɪvd ðə fæn

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong was once again traveling west with the Tang monk
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: It is hot
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: Not much has changed since I left
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Well I'll be happy when we continue on our journey
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: All the land around the mountain is covered in flames
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Can we please slow down
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Then we must wait for a strong rainstorm
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: Maybe we should take a break
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Open up
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There is just one spirit who can put them out
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That will put out the flames
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: Well I'll be happy when we continue on our journey
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: While I was at mount Potalaka
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: Because of you
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: But I don't understand why it's so hot
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: Just tell me where she lives
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

collocations.context: Then we can get away from this heat
Everyone stopped eating and looked at the old man
The old man shook his head
Then we must wait for a strong rainstorm
It's made from a plantain leaf
Wukong stood up
She won't listen to you
Wukong folded his arms in front of his chest
Because of you

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 77 the magic fan

dialogue.en: The wind from the fan carried Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə wɪnd frʌm ðə fæn ˈkærid wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: He was far from the iron immortal's mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz fɑr frʌm ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəlz ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Wukong looked around and saw a mountain nearby
dialogue.ipa: Wukong lʊkt əˈraʊnd ænd sɔ ə ˈmaʊntən ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 悟空环顾四周,看到附近有座山

dialogue.en: Maybe he can help me deal with the iron immortal
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi hi kæn hɛlp mi dil wɪð ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl
dialogue.zh: 也许他能帮我对付铁扇仙

dialogue.en: He was able to stop the great king yellow wind's wind magic
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈeɪbəl tu stɑp ðə ɡreɪt kɪŋ ˈjɛloʊ wɪndz wɪnd ˈmæʤɪk
dialogue.zh: 他曾能制止黄风大王的狂风法术

dialogue.en: The monkey went to Lingji's Pagoda
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki wɛnt tu Lingji's pə ˈɡoʊdə

dialogue.en: The bodhisattva was sitting in his garden
dialogue.ipa: ðə bodhisattva wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ ɪn hɪz ˈɡɑrdən
dialogue.zh: 菩萨正坐在他的花园里

dialogue.en: It's good to see you again
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ɡʊd tu si ju əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: I was just about to have tea
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ʤʌst əˈbaʊt tu hæv ti

dialogue.en: Wukong and Ling Ji sat outside drinking tea
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd lɪŋ ʤi sæt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ˈdrɪŋkɪŋ ti
dialogue.zh: 悟空和灵吉坐在外面喝茶

dialogue.en: The monkey told the bodhisattva everything that had happened with the iron immortal
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki toʊld ðə bodhisattva ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ðæt hæd ˈhæpənd wɪð ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl
dialogue.zh: 猴子把与铁扇仙发生的一切都告诉了菩萨

dialogue.en: The bodhisattva handed a small stone to Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə bodhisattva ˈhændɪd ə smɔl stoʊn tu wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 菩萨递给悟空一块小石头

dialogue.en: Keep this magic stone in your pocket
dialogue.ipa: kip ðɪs ˈmæʤɪk stoʊn ɪn jʊər ˈpɑkət
dialogue.zh: 把这颗神石放在口袋里

dialogue.en: It will stop the wind from blowing you away
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wɪl stɑp ðə wɪnd frʌm ˈbloʊɪŋ ju əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: Would you like to stay for lunch
dialogue.ipa: wʊd ju laɪk tu steɪ fɔr lʌnʧ

dialogue.en: I must get back to my companions
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst ɡɛt bæk tu maɪ kəm ˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 我必须回到我的同伴那里去

dialogue.en: I need to get that fan from the iron immortal so we can continue west
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid tu ɡɛt ðæt fæn frʌm ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl soʊ wi kæn kənˈtɪnju wɛst
dialogue.zh: 我得从铁扇仙那里拿到那把扇子,我们才能继续西行

dialogue.en: Wukong returned to the iron immortal's cave door
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rɪ ˈtɜrnd tu ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəlz keɪv dɔr
dialogue.zh: 悟空回到了铁扇仙的洞门前

dialogue.en: The Iron Immortal came out and wrinkled her nose
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪ ˈmɔrtəl keɪm aʊt ænd ˈrɪŋkəld hɜr noʊz
dialogue.zh: 铁扇仙走出来,皱起了鼻子

dialogue.en: I thought I got rid of you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɔt aɪ ɡɑt rɪd ʌv ju

dialogue.en: I'll just have to wave harder this time
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ʤʌst hæv tu weɪv ˈhɑrdər ðɪs taɪm
dialogue.zh: 这次我得扇得更用力些

dialogue.en: The woman waved the fan furiously
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwʊmən weɪvd ðə fæn ˈfjʊriəsli
dialogue.zh: 那女人疯狂地挥舞着扇子

dialogue.en: A terrible wind blew past Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈtɛrəbəl wɪnd blu pæst wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 一阵狂风从悟空身边刮过

dialogue.en: The Iron Immortal's eyes burned with anger
dialogue.ipa: ðə lron ɪˈmɔrtəlz aɪz bɜrnd wɪð ˈæŋɡər

dialogue.en: The bodhisattva Lin Ji gave me a magic stone
dialogue.ipa: ðə bodhisattva lɪn ʤi ɡeɪv mi ə ˈmæʤɪk stoʊn
dialogue.zh: 灵吉菩萨给了我一颗神石

dialogue.en: Your fan can't blow me away now
dialogue.ipa: jʊər fæn kænt bloʊ mi əˈweɪ naʊ
dialogue.zh: 现在你的扇子可吹不走我了

dialogue.en: The monkey pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: The iron Immortal shot back into her cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔːrtəl ʃɑːt bæk ˈɪntuː hɜːr keɪv
dialogue.zh: 铁扇仙迅速退回了她的洞里

dialogue.en: Before she could shut the door
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈfɔr ʃi kʊd ʃʌt ðə dɔr
wu kɔŋ tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə ˈkrɪkət

dialogue.en: He quickly leaped into the cave
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkwɪkli lɛpt ˈɪntu ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: Silently he followed the Iron Immortal along a tunnel
dialogue.ipa: ˈsaɪləntli hi ˈfɑloʊd ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl əˈlɔŋ ə ˈtʌnəl
dialogue.zh: 他悄无声息地跟着铁扇仙穿过一条隧道

dialogue.en: When the woman reached a room
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðə ˈwʊmən riʧt ə rum
dialogue.zh: 当那女人走进一个房间时

dialogue.en: She tucked the fan into her robe
dialogue.ipa: ʃi tʌkt ðə fæn ˈɪntu hɜr roʊb
dialogue.zh: 她把扇子塞进了袍子里

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ɪz ə ˈhɔrəbəl ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 悟空真是个可恶的猴子

dialogue.en: He forced my poor baby red boy to become good
dialogue.ipa: hi fɔrst maɪ pʊr ˈbeɪbi rɛd bɔɪ tu bɪˈkʌm ɡʊd
dialogue.zh: 他逼我那可怜的红孩儿改邪归正

dialogue.en: Then he demanded to borrow my precious fan
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi dɪˈmændɪd tu ˈbɑˌroʊ maɪ ˈprɛʃəs fæn
dialogue.zh: 现在又非要借我宝贵的扇子

dialogue.en: The Iron Immortal reached for a cup of water
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl riʧt fɔr ə kʌp ʌv ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 铁扇仙伸手去拿一杯水

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ʧeɪnʤd bæk ˈɪntu hɪm ˈsɛlf

dialogue.en: The iron Immortal fell to her knees
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl fɛl tə hər niz

dialogue.en: And I won't stop punching and kicking until you give me that fan
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ woʊnt stɑp ˈpʌnʧɪŋ ænd ˈkɪkɪŋ ənˈtɪl ju ɡɪv mi ðæt fæn
dialogue.zh: 你不把扇子给我,我就一直打下去

dialogue.en: Wukong leaped out through the woman's nose and returned to his normal size
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lɛpt aʊt θru ðə ˈwʊmənz noʊz ænd rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz ˈnɔrməl saɪz
dialogue.zh: 悟空从女子鼻中跃出,恢复了原形

dialogue.en: The iron immortal climbed back to her feet
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl klaɪmd bæk tu hɜr fit

dialogue.en: She reached into her robe and pulled out a fan
dialogue.ipa: ʃi riʧt ˈɪntu hɜr roʊb ænd pʊld aʊt ə fæn
dialogue.zh: 她伸手入袍,取出一把扇子

dialogue.en: Wukong found his companions in the village with the old man
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ faʊnd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ɪn ðə ˈvɪləʤ wɪð ði oʊld mæn
dialogue.zh: 悟空在村里与老者处找到了同伴们

dialogue.en: The monkey explained how he'd tricked the iron immortal
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ɪkˈspleɪnd haʊ hid trɪkt ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl
dialogue.zh: 猴子讲述了自己如何智取铁扇仙

dialogue.en: Now we can continue our journey
dialogue.ipa: naʊ wi kæn kənˈtɪnju ˈaʊər ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 如今我们可以继续上路了

dialogue.en: They all thanked the old man and then headed west
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ɔl θæŋkt ði oʊld mæn ænd ðɛn ˈhɛdɪd wɛst
dialogue.zh: 众人谢过老者,朝西行去

dialogue.en: They came to the top of a hill and saw the mountain of flames
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ keɪm tu ðə tɑp ʌv ə hɪl ænd sɔ ðə ˈmaʊntən ʌv fleɪmz
dialogue.zh: 他们来到山巅,望见了火焰山

dialogue.en: Fire covered all the land around it
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪər ˈkʌvərd ɔl ðə lænd əˈraʊnd ɪt
dialogue.zh: 烈火吞噬着四周的土地

dialogue.en: The monkey waved the fan hard
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki weɪvd ðə fæn hɑrd

dialogue.en: A strong wind blew toward the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ə strɔŋ wɪnd blu təˈwɔrd ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Suddenly there was a roar as the flames grew bigger
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðɛr wʌz ə rɔr æz ðə fleɪmz ɡru ˈbɪɡər

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: He was far from the iron immortal's mountain
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The bodhisattva was sitting in his garden
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: The monkey told the bodhisattva everything that had happened with the iron immortal
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 78 tricked again and again

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt æt ðə fæn

dialogue.en: The Iron Immortal must have tricked me
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl mʌst hæv trɪkt mi

dialogue.en: The travelers backed away as the fire burned hotter
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz bækt əˈweɪ æz ðə ˈfaɪər bɜrnd ˈhɑtər
dialogue.zh: 火势愈烈,行旅们连连后退

dialogue.en: We can't go through that fire
dialogue.ipa: wi kænt ɡoʊ θru ðæt ˈfaɪər

dialogue.en: We'll write a letter to Buddha explaining what happened
dialogue.ipa: wil raɪt ə ˈlɛtər tu ˈbudə ɪkˈspleɪnɪŋ wɑt ˈhæpənd
dialogue.zh: 给佛祖修书说明原委便是

dialogue.en: I used to be friends with the Iron Immortal's husband
dialogue.ipa: aɪ juzd tu bi frɛndz wɪð ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəlz ˈhʌzbənd
dialogue.zh: 我早年与铁扇仙的夫君

dialogue.en: The Iron Immortal was in her cave when she heard a knock
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl wʌz ɪn hɜr keɪv wɛn ʃi hɜrd ə nɑk
dialogue.zh: 铁扇仙正在洞中,忽闻叩门声

dialogue.en: She walked quietly to the door and peeked outside
dialogue.ipa: ʃi wɔkt ˈkwaɪətli tu ðə dɔr ænd pikt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 她悄悄走到门边,向外窥探

dialogue.en: When she saw the bull Demon King
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ʃi sɔ ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ

dialogue.en: She smiled and opened the door
dialogue.ipa: ʃi smaɪld ænd ˈoʊpənd ðə dɔr

dialogue.en: I used to be friends with him
dialogue.ipa: aɪ juzd tu bi frɛndz wɪð hɪm

dialogue.en: It would have been nice to see him again
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʊd hæv bɪn naɪs tu si hɪm əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 要是能再见他一面就好了

dialogue.en: You told me that you never really liked him
dialogue.ipa: ju toʊld mi ðæt ju ˈnɛvər ˈrɪli laɪkt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 你之前明明告诉我你从没真正喜欢过他

dialogue.en: He demanded I let him borrow my fan
dialogue.ipa: hi dɪˈmændɪd aɪ lɛt hɪm ˈbɑ ˌroʊ maɪ fæn
dialogue.zh: 他非要我借芭蕉扇给他

dialogue.en: You didn't give it to him did you
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈdɪdənt ɡɪv ɪt tu hɪm dɪd ju

dialogue.en: I gave him a fake fan that looks just like the real one
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡeɪv hɪm ə feɪk fæn ðæt lʊks ʤʌst laɪk ðə riəl wʌn
dialogue.zh: 我给了他一把和真扇子一模一样的假扇子

dialogue.en: Wukong is very smart and very powerful
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ɪz ˈvɛri smɑrt ænd ˈvɛri ˈpaʊərfəl
dialogue.zh: 悟空非常聪明,法力高强

dialogue.en: And then he'll come back here
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn hil kʌm bæk hir
dialogue.zh: 然后他还会再找上门来

dialogue.en: The iron immortal opened a chest and took out the fan
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl ˈoʊpənd ə ʧɛst ænd tʊk aʊt ðə fæn
dialogue.zh: 铁扇公主打开箱子,取出了芭蕉扇

dialogue.en: She handed it to her husband
dialogue.ipa: ʃi ˈhændɪd ɪt tu hɜr ˈhʌzbənd

dialogue.en: Suddenly light sparkled and Wukong stood in front of her
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli laɪt ˈspɑrkəld ænd wu kɔŋ stʊd ɪn frʌnt ʌv hɜr
dialogue.zh: 突然金光一闪,悟空出现在她面前

dialogue.en: The monkey laughed and ran out of the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki læft ænd ræn aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 猴子大笑着跑出了山洞

dialogue.en: The iron immortal stamped her foot
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl stæmpt hɜr fʊt

dialogue.en: She was still angry when her husband came home
dialogue.ipa: ʃi wʌz stɪl ˈæŋɡri wɛn hɜr ˈhʌzbənd keɪm hoʊm
dialogue.zh: 丈夫回家时她还在生气

dialogue.en: Said the bull demon king with a big smile
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ wɪð ə bɪɡ smaɪl
dialogue.zh: 牛魔王笑容满面地说道
但他的笑容随即消失了

dialogue.en: Your friend Sun Wukong was here
dialogue.ipa: jʊər frɛnd sʌn wu kɔŋ wʌz hir
dialogue.zh: 你的朋友孙悟空来过了

dialogue.en: Even before he defeated Red Boy
dialogue.ipa: ˈivɪn bɪˈfɔr hi dɪˈfitɪd rɛd bɔɪ
dialogue.zh: 早在他收服红孩儿之前
我就从没真正喜欢过他

dialogue.en: Well you'll like him even less now
dialogue.ipa: wɛl jul laɪk hɪm ˈivɪn lɛs naʊ
dialogue.zh: 哼,现在你只会更讨厌他

dialogue.en: That fan's wind magic is powerful
dialogue.ipa: ðæt fænz wɪnd ˈmæʤɪk ɪz ˈpaʊərfəl
dialogue.zh: 那把扇子的风系法术威力强大

dialogue.en: How did the monkey steal it
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɪd ðə ˈmʌŋki stil ɪt

dialogue.en: He tricked me into giving it to him
dialogue.ipa: hi trɪkt mi ˈɪntu ˈɡɪvɪŋ ɪt tu hɪm

dialogue.en: He made himself look like you
dialogue.ipa: hi meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk ju
dialogue.zh: 他把自己变得跟你一模一样

dialogue.en: I will find that rotten monkey
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl faɪnd ðæt ˈrɑtən ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.zh: 我会把你的扇子夺回来

dialogue.en: The Bull Demon King stomped out of the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ stɑmpt aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 牛魔王跺着脚冲出山洞

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wɔkt əˈlɔŋ ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: He was still laughing about how he'd tricked the iron immortal
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz stɪl ˈlæfɪŋ əˈbaʊt haʊ hid trɪkt ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl
dialogue.zh: 他还在为骗过铁扇仙的事发笑
这时他看见八戒走了过来

dialogue.en: I was coming to help you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ˈkʌmɪŋ tu hɛlp ju

dialogue.en: Thanks but I don't need help
dialogue.ipa: θæŋks bʌt aɪ doʊnt nid hɛlp
dialogue.zh: 谢了,不过我不需要帮忙

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ hɛld ʌp ðə fæn

dialogue.en: I tricked the Iron Immortal and got the real fan this time
dialogue.ipa: aɪ trɪkt ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl ænd ɡɑt ðə riəl fæn ðɪs taɪm
dialogue.zh: 我骗了铁扇仙,这次拿到了真扇子

dialogue.en: I can carry it for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn ˈkæri ɪt fɔr ju

dialogue.en: Said Wukong as he handed the fan to Bajie
dialogue.ipa: sɛd wu kɔŋ æz hi ˈhændɪd ðə fæn tu Bajie
dialogue.zh: 悟空说着把扇子递给八戒

dialogue.en: The monkey patted his friend on the shoulder
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈpætɪd hɪz frɛnd ɑn ðə ˈʃoʊldər
dialogue.zh: 猴子拍了拍朋友的肩膀

dialogue.en: Now let's get back to master
dialogue.ipa: naʊ lɛts ɡɛt bæk tu ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 现在咱们回师父那儿去吧

dialogue.en: Suddenly there was a flash of light
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðɛr wʌz ə flæʃ ʌv laɪt

dialogue.en: A second later the bull Demon King stood next to Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈsɛkənd ˈleɪtər ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ stʊd nɛkst tu wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 转眼间牛魔王就站在了悟空身旁

dialogue.en: There was another flash and the demon was gone
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə ˈnʌðər flæʃ ænd ðə ˈdimən wʌz ɡɔn
dialogue.zh: 又是一道闪光,妖怪消失不见了

Now let's get back to master

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 79 The Mountain of flames

dialogue.en: The bull demon king tricked me
dialogue.ipa: ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ trɪkt mi

dialogue.en: The monkey rushed back to the cave and smashed the door
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki rʌʃt bæk tu ðə keɪv ænd smæʃt ðə dɔr
dialogue.zh: 猴子冲回山洞砸烂了大门

dialogue.en: The bull demon king ran outside
dialogue.ipa: ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ ræn ˈaʊtˈsaɪd

dialogue.en: Give me that fan right now
dialogue.ipa: ɡɪv mi ðæt fæn raɪt naʊ

dialogue.en: Or I'll destroy the rest of your mountain
dialogue.ipa: ɔr aɪl dɪˈstrɔɪ ðə rɛst ʌv jʊər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 否则我就毁掉你剩下的山

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ʧɑrʤd təˈwɔrd ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: The demon turned into a crane and flew away
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə kreɪn ænd flu əˈweɪ
dialogue.zh: 妖怪变成一只仙鹤飞走了

dialogue.en: He's not the only one who can turn into other animals
dialogue.ipa: hiz nɑt ði ˈoʊnli wʌn hu kæn tɜrn ˈɪntu ˈʌðər ˈænəməlz
dialogue.zh: 会变身的可不只他一个

dialogue.en: Wukong turned into a Phoenix and shot after the crane
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə ˈfinɪks ænd ʃɑt ˈæftər ðə kreɪn
dialogue.zh: 悟空变成凤凰追向仙鹤

dialogue.en: He swooped down at the crane
dialogue.ipa: hi swupt daʊn æt ðə kreɪn

dialogue.en: The crane dipped lower and Wukong missed
dialogue.ipa: ðə kreɪn dɪpt ˈloʊər ænd wu kɔŋ mɪst
dialogue.zh: 仙鹤急坠而下,悟空扑了个空

dialogue.en: He looked down and saw an antelope grazing in a field
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt daʊn ænd sɔ ən ˈæntəˌloʊp ˈɡreɪzɪŋ ɪn ə fild
dialogue.zh: 他低头看见田野里有只羚羊在吃草

dialogue.en: Wukong landed and turned into a tiger
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈlændɪd ænd tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə ˈtaɪɡər

dialogue.en: He crept through the tall grass
dialogue.ipa: hi krɛpt θru ðə tɔl ɡræs

dialogue.en: When he got close to the antelope
dialogue.ipa: wɛn hi ɡɑt kloʊs tu ði ˈæntə ˌloʊp

dialogue.en: And the antelope turned into a huge white bull
dialogue.ipa: ænd ði ˈæntəˌloʊp tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə hjuʤ waɪt bʊl
dialogue.zh: 羚羊化作一头巨大的白牛

dialogue.en: The bull flew up into the sky and Wukong followed
dialogue.ipa: ðə bʊl flu ʌp ˈɪntu ðə skaɪ ænd wu kɔŋ ˈfɑloʊd
dialogue.zh: 白牛腾空而起,悟空紧随其后

dialogue.en: He had almost caught up to the bull
dialogue.ipa: hi hæd ˈɔlˌmoʊst kɑt ʌp tu ðə bʊl

dialogue.en: It was a soldier from heaven
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz ə ˈsoʊlʤər frʌm ˈhɛvən

dialogue.en: The Jade Emperor sent us to help you
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər sɛnt ʌs tu hɛlp ju

dialogue.en: More soldiers rushed toward the bull
dialogue.ipa: mɔr ˈsoʊlʤərz rʌʃt təˈwɔrd ðə bʊl

dialogue.en: The bull spun around and flew the other way
dialogue.ipa: ðə bʊl spʌn əˈraʊnd ænd flu ði ˈʌðər weɪ

dialogue.en: But other soldiers appeared and blocked the bull's path
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ˈʌðər ˈsoʊlʤərz əˈpɪrd ænd blɑkt ðə bʊlz pæθ
dialogue.zh: 但其他天兵现身拦住了去路

dialogue.en: Wukong watched as soldiers surrounded the bull
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wɑʧt æz ˈsoʊlʤərz səˈraʊndɪd ðə bʊl
dialogue.zh: 悟空看着天兵围住白牛

dialogue.en: Their swords and spears all pointed at the bull
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr sɔrdz ænd spɪrz ɔl ˈpɔɪntɪd æt ðə bʊl
dialogue.zh: 刀枪剑戟齐齐指向白牛

dialogue.en: The bull Demon King returned to his demon form
dialogue.ipa: ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz ˈdimən fɔrm

dialogue.en: The iron immortal was rushing toward the soldiers
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪ ˈmɔrtəl wʌz ˈrʌʃɪŋ təˈwɔrd ðə ˈsoʊlʤərz

dialogue.en: He didn't mean to be evil
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈdɪdənt min tu bi ˈivəl

dialogue.en: We won't harm you if you're truly sorry for being evil
dialogue.ipa: wi woʊnt hɑrm ju ɪf jʊr ˈtruli ˈsɑri fɔr ˈbiɪŋ ˈivəl

dialogue.en: But right now you're stopping the Tang monk from continuing his journey
dialogue.ipa: bʌt raɪt naʊ jʊr ˈstɑpɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk frʌm kənˈtɪnjuɪŋ hɪz ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 但如今你阻挠唐僧西行

dialogue.ipa: sʌn wu kɔŋ nidz jʊər fæn
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空需要你的芭蕉扇

dialogue.en: The iron Immortal handed the fan to the soldier
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈaɪərn ɪˈmɔrtəl ˈhændɪd ðə fæn tə ðə ˈsoʊlʤər
dialogue.zh: 铁扇公主将宝扇递给天兵

dialogue.en: My husband and I will be good Buddhists from now on
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈhʌzbənd ænd aɪ wɪl bi ɡʊd ˈbudəsts frʌm naʊ ɑn
dialogue.zh: 从今往后,我和我丈夫会好好信佛

dialogue.en: The soldier looked at the bull demon king
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈsoʊlʤər lʊkt æt ðə bʊl ˈdimən kɪŋ

dialogue.en: You two may return to your cave
dialogue.ipa: ju tu meɪ rɪˈtɜrn tu jʊər keɪv
dialogue.zh: 你们俩可以回洞府去了

dialogue.en: But you must stay out of trouble from now on
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju mʌst steɪ aʊt ʌv ˈtrʌbəl frʌm naʊ ɑn
dialogue.zh: 但从今往后必须安分守己

dialogue.en: The demon and his wife bowed and left
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ænd hɪz waɪf baʊd ænd lɛft
dialogue.zh: 牛魔王和妻子鞠躬离去

dialogue.en: The soldier handed the fan to Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈsoʊlʤər ˈhændɪd ðə fæn tu wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 士兵将芭蕉扇递给悟空

dialogue.en: It's good that you'll be the one to put out the mountain of flames Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ɡʊd ðæt jul bi ðə wʌn tu pʊt aʊt ðə ˈmaʊntən ʌv fleɪmz wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 由你来熄灭火焰山的火再好不过了,悟空

dialogue.en: You're the one who caused the fire
dialogue.ipa: jʊr ðə wʌn hu kɑzd ðə ˈfaɪər

dialogue.en: It was when Laozi tried to burn you up in his pot
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz wɛn Laozi traɪd tu bɜrn ju ʌp ɪn hɪz pɑt
dialogue.zh: 当年老君将你投入炼丹炉焚烧

dialogue.en: You leaped out of the pot
dialogue.ipa: ju lɛpt aʊt ʌv ðə pɑt

dialogue.en: Disturbing the fire in his workroom
dialogue.ipa: dɪˈstɜrbɪŋ ðə ˈfaɪər ɪn hɪz ˈwɜr ˌkrum
dialogue.zh: 踢翻了他丹房里的炉火

dialogue.en: A burning Ember fell to earth that day and started the fire on the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈbɜrnɪŋ ˈɛmbər fɛl tu ɜrθ ðæt deɪ ænd ˈstɑrtɪd ðə ˈfaɪər ɑn ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 一块燃烧的炭火那日坠入凡间,点燃了这座山

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt æt ðə fæn

dialogue.en: I'll be happy to put out the fire
dialogue.ipa: aɪl bi ˈhæpi tu pʊt aʊt ðə ˈfaɪər
wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə ˈvɪləʤ

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and his companions were at the old man's house again
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz wɜr æt ði oʊld mænz haʊs əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 唐僧师徒再次来到老者家中

dialogue.en: Once again they thanked the man and followed the road up the hill
dialogue.ipa: wʌns əˈɡɛn ðeɪ θæŋkt ðə mæn ænd ˈfɑloʊd ðə roʊd ʌp ðə hɪl
dialogue.zh: 他们再次谢过老人,沿山路前行

dialogue.en: At the top they looked at the mountain of flames
dialogue.ipa: æt ðə tɑp ðeɪ lʊkt æt ðə ˈmaʊntən ʌv fleɪmz

dialogue.en: Wukong lifted the fan and waved it
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈlɪftɪd ðə fæn ænd weɪvd ɪt

dialogue.en: And Wukong saw the valley start to turn green
dialogue.ipa: ænd wu kɔŋ sɔ ðə ˈvæli stɑrt tu tɜrn ɡrin
dialogue.zh: 悟空看见山谷开始泛绿

dialogue.en: And small flowers popped up here and there
dialogue.ipa: ænd smɔl ˈflaʊərz pɑpt ʌp hir ænd ðɛr

dialogue.en: Birds sang in the branches as other animals ran through the grass
dialogue.ipa: bɜrdz sæŋ ɪn ðə ˈbrænʧəz æz ˈʌðər ˈænəməlz ræn θru ðə ɡræs
dialogue.zh: 鸟雀枝头鸣唱,走兽草间奔跃

dialogue.en: He had done evil things a long time ago
dialogue.ipa: hi hæd dʌn ˈivəl θɪŋz ə lɔŋ taɪm əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 他很久以前犯下的过错

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong was furious
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The iron immortal was rushing toward the soldiers
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: He had done evil things a long time ago
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Sun Wukong needs your fan
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Or I'll destroy the rest of your mountain
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Wukong was confused
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: He's not the only one who can turn into other animals
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But you must stay out of trouble from now on
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: It was when Laozi tried to burn you up in his pot
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Give me that fan right now
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: He's not the only one who can turn into other animals
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: We won't harm you if you're truly sorry for being evil
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When Wukong looked back
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.
