titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 80 the Small Thunderclap Monastery

dialogue.en: One afternoon Wukong and his companions were resting by a stream
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ˌæftərˈnun wu kɔŋ ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz wɜr ˈrɛstɪŋ baɪ ə strim
dialogue.zh: 某个午后,悟空师徒正在溪边休息

dialogue.en: They were eating peaches and berries
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɜr ˈitɪŋ ˈpiʧəz ænd ˈbɛriz

dialogue.en: We must be getting close to the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst bi ˈɡɛtɪŋ kloʊs tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我们一定快接近西天极乐世界了

dialogue.en: I feel like we've been traveling for thousands of years
dialogue.ipa: aɪ fil laɪk wiv bɪn ˈtrævəlɪŋ fɔr ˈθaʊzəndz ʌv jɪrz
dialogue.zh: 我感觉像是走了几千年

dialogue.en: We still have a long way to go
dialogue.ipa: wi stɪl hæv ə lɔŋ weɪ tu ɡoʊ

dialogue.en: Eventually we'll arrive in the western Paradise and climb up the Spirit Mountain
dialogue.ipa: ɪˈvɛnʧəwəli wil əˈraɪv ɪn ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs ænd klaɪm ʌp ðə ˈspɪrət ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 终有一日我们会抵达西天,登上灵山

dialogue.en: The Tang monk took a bite of his peach
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tʊk ə baɪt ʌv hɪz piʧ

dialogue.en: The Thunderclap Monastery must be wonderful to see
dialogue.ipa: ðə Thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri mʌst bi ˈwʌndərfəl tu si

dialogue.en: So we're going to have to climb a mountain at the end of this journey
dialogue.ipa: soʊ wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu hæv tu klaɪm ə ˈmaʊntən æt ði ɛnd ʌv ðɪs ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 看来这趟旅程最后还得爬山

dialogue.en: Just thinking about that makes me tired
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðæt meɪks mi ˈtaɪərd

dialogue.en: I really hope the journey ends soon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈrɪli hoʊp ðə ˈʤɜrni ɛndz sun
dialogue.zh: 我真希望旅程快点结束

dialogue.en: Said Wu Jing with a serious look
dialogue.ipa: sɛd wu ʤɪŋ wɪð ə ˈsɪriəs lʊk

dialogue.en: I'm just tired of hearing you complain
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʤʌst ˈtaɪərd ʌv ˈhirɪŋ ju kəmˈpleɪn
dialogue.zh: 我只是听腻了你的抱怨

dialogue.en: Everyone was quiet for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn wʌz ˈkwaɪət fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt

dialogue.en: Then Wu Jing's face broke into a smile
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn wu ʤɪŋz feɪs broʊk ˈɪntu ə smaɪl
dialogue.zh: 接着悟净脸上绽开笑容

dialogue.en: I'd like to find a village or a monastery before dark
dialogue.ipa: aɪd laɪk tu faɪnd ə ˈvɪləʤ ɔr ə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri bɪˈfɔr dɑrk
dialogue.zh: 我想在天黑前找到村庄或寺庙

dialogue.en: They were traveling up a Mountain Road
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɜr ˈtrævəlɪŋ ʌp ə ˈmaʊntən roʊd

dialogue.en: The road curved around a bend
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊd kɜrvd əˈraʊnd ə bɛnd

dialogue.en: Ahead they could see a small monastery
dialogue.ipa: əˈhɛd ðeɪ kʊd si ə smɔl ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
ɪz ðæt ðə thunderclap ˈmɑnə ˌstɛri

dialogue.en: Golden light is shining from it
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən laɪt ɪz ˈʃaɪnɪŋ frʌm ɪt
dialogue.zh: 有金光从那里散发出来

dialogue.ipa: ɪts nɑt ðə thunderclap ˈmɑnə ˌstɛri

dialogue.en: We're not even in the western paradise yet
dialogue.ipa: wir nɑt ˈivɪn ɪn ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs jɛt

dialogue.en: The monkey peered at the monastery for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki pɪrd æt ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt

dialogue.en: I see dark clouds over the monastery
dialogue.ipa: aɪ si dɑrk klaʊdz ˈoʊvər ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 我看见寺庙上空有乌云

dialogue.en: The travelers continued walking along the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz kənˈtɪnjud ˈwɔkɪŋ əˈlɔŋ ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: Soon they were standing in front of the monastery
dialogue.ipa: sun ðeɪ wɜr ˈstændɪŋ ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 很快他们便站在寺庙门前

dialogue.en: A sign over the door read Small Thunderclap Monastery
dialogue.ipa: ə saɪn ˈoʊvər ðə dɔr rid smɔl Thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 门匾上写着 “ 小雷音寺 ”

dialogue.en: This monastery must belong to Buddha
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ˈmɑnəˌstɛri mʌst bɪ ˈlɔŋ tu ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 这寺庙定是佛陀的道场

dialogue.en: Golden light is shining from this monastery
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡoʊldən laɪt ɪz ˈʃaɪnɪŋ frʌm ðɪs ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 这座寺院正散发着金光

dialogue.en: It must be an important place
dialogue.ipa: ɪt mʌst bi ən ɪmˈpɔrtənt pleɪs
dialogue.zh: 这一定是个重要的地方

dialogue.en: The monk opened the monastery's door and entered
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ˈoʊpənd ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛriz dɔr ænd ˈɛntərd
dialogue.zh: 僧人打开寺门走了进去

dialogue.en: Wukong sighed and went in after them
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ saɪd ænd wɛnt ɪn ˈæftər ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 悟空叹了口气,也跟着进去了

dialogue.en: This place was definitely not what it seemed
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs pleɪs wʌz ˈdɛfənətli nɑt wɑt ɪt simd
dialogue.zh: 这地方绝对不像表面看起来那么简单

dialogue.en: The monkey pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: The group entered the building's main hall
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup ˈɛntərd ðə ˈbɪldɪŋz meɪn hɔl
dialogue.zh: 一行人走进了建筑的主殿

dialogue.en: A large golden statue of Buddha sat before them
dialogue.ipa: ə lɑrʤ ˈɡoʊldən ˈstæˌʧu ʌv ˈbudə sæt bɪˈfɔr ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 一尊巨大的金色佛像端坐在他们面前

dialogue.en: Do you see that statue Wukong
dialogue.ipa: du ju si ðæt ˈstæˌʧu wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空,你看到那尊佛像了吗

dialogue.en: This is a real Buddhist monastery
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ɪz ə riəl ˈbudəst ˈmɑnəˌstɛri

dialogue.zh: 突然,一个声音轰鸣响起

dialogue.en: Who dares to enter without bowing to Buddha
dialogue.ipa: hu dɛrz tu ˈɛntər wɪˈθaʊt ˈboʊɪŋ tu ˈbudə

dialogue.en: The Tang monk trembled with fear
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈtrɛmbəld wɪð fɪr

dialogue.en: He fell to his knees and bowed
dialogue.ipa: hi fɛl tu hɪz niz ænd baʊd

dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净也拜了下去

dialogue.en: I can see that you're really a
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn si ðæt jʊr ˈrɪli eɪ
dialogue.zh: 我看得出来,你其实是个

dialogue.en: Before the monkey could finish yelling a large pair of symbols fell from above
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈmʌŋki kʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈjɛlɪŋ ə lɑrʤ pɛr ʌv ˈsɪmbəlz fɛl frʌm əˈbʌv
dialogue.zh: 猴子还没喊完,一对巨大的钹从上方落下

dialogue.en: They slammed together sealing Wukong inside
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ slæmd tə ˈɡɛðər ˈsilɪŋ wu kɔŋ ɪnˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 它们猛地合在一起,将悟空封在了里面

dialogue.en: And the statue turned into a demon with yellow eyebrows
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈstæˌʧu tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə ˈdimən wɪð ˈjɛloʊ ˈaɪˌbraʊz
dialogue.zh: 那尊佛像变成了一个黄眉妖怪

dialogue.en: The demon stood up and smiled
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən stʊd ʌp ænd smaɪld

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: One afternoon Wukong and his companions were resting by a stream
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: One afternoon Wukong and his companions were resting by a stream
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I feel like we've been traveling for thousands of years
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Golden light is shining from it
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Eventually we'll arrive in the western Paradise and climb up the Spirit Mountain
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can see that you're really a
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Ahead they could see a small monastery
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We must be getting close to the western paradise
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: We should go
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: So we're going to have to climb a mountain at the end of this journey
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's keep walking
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Hold on
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Just thinking about that makes me tired
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So we're going to have to climb a mountain at the end of this journey
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: Why don’t we/you + 动词原形?
grammar.description: 以疑问形式提出建议，意思是“为什么不……呢”。
grammar.source: Why don't you bow
examples: Why don't we follow the river?
Why don't we ask Wukong?
Why don't you wait here?
Why don't we look inside the cave?
Why don't we take a rest?
Why don't you tell the king?
Why don't we cross the bridge?
Why don't we call the others?
Why don't you bring some food?
Why don't we try another way?

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 81 help from a dragon

dialogue.en: Bajie and Wujing swung their weapons at the demon
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ænd Wujing swʌŋ ðɛr ˈwɛpənz æt ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟净挥起兵器向妖怪打去

dialogue.en: I'm much too powerful for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪm mʌʧ tu ˈpaʊərfəl fɔr ju

dialogue.en: He heard grunts and the sounds of weapons clashing
dialogue.ipa: hi hɜrd ɡrʌnts ænd ðə saʊndz ʌv ˈwɛpənz ˈklæʃɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 他听见闷哼和武器碰撞的声音

dialogue.en: The monkey punched and kicked the inside of the symbols for hours
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki pʌnʧt ænd kɪkt ði ɪnˈsaɪd ʌv ðə ˈsɪmbəlz fɔr ˈaʊərz
dialogue.zh: 猴子对着符咒内部拳打脚踢了好几个小时

dialogue.en: But the two symbols would not come apart
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə tu ˈsɪmbəlz wʊd nɑt kʌm əˈpɑrt
dialogue.zh: 但两道符咒就是分不开

dialogue.en: How will I get out of here
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wɪl aɪ ɡɛt aʊt ʌv hir

dialogue.en: The monkey was about to strike the symbols again when he heard a voice
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki wʌz əˈbaʊt tu straɪk ðə ˈsɪmbəlz əˈɡɛn wɛn hi hɜrd ə vɔɪs
dialogue.zh: 猴子正要再次击打符咒时,听到了一个声音

dialogue.en: The Jade emperor sent me to help you
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər sɛnt mi tu hɛlp ju

dialogue.en: I'll wedge my horn between the symbols and pry them apart
dialogue.ipa: aɪl wɛʤ maɪ hɔrn bɪˈtwin ðə ˈsɪmbəlz ænd praɪ ðɛm əˈpɑrt
dialogue.zh: 我会把角楔进符咒之间撬开它们

dialogue.en: Slowly the dragon's horn poked through
dialogue.ipa: ˈsloʊli ðə ˈdræɡənz hɔrn poʊkt θru

dialogue.en: But the symbols were still tightly clasped together
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈsɪmbəlz wɜr stɪl ˈtaɪtli klæspt təˈɡɛðər
dialogue.zh: 但符咒仍然紧紧扣在一起

dialogue.en: Maybe we could find another way to pry the symbols apart
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi wi kʊd faɪnd əˈnʌðər weɪ tu praɪ ðə ˈsɪmbəlz əˈpɑrt
dialogue.zh: 也许我们可以另想办法撬开符咒

dialogue.en: Wukong turned his iron bar into a drill
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ tɜrnd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ˈɪntu ə drɪl

dialogue.en: He made a hole in the Dragon's horn
dialogue.ipa: hi meɪd ə hoʊl ɪn ðə ˈdræɡənz hɔrn

dialogue.en: Then he made himself tiny and climbed into the hole
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf ˈtaɪni ænd klaɪmd ˈɪntu ðə hoʊl
dialogue.zh: 然后把自己变小爬进了洞里

dialogue.en: The dragon pulled and pulled and finally got his horn out
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən pʊld ænd pʊld ænd ˈfaɪnəli ɡɑt hɪz hɔrn aʊt
dialogue.zh: 龙使劲拉扯,终于把角抽了出来

dialogue.en: The monkey jumped out of the hole and returned to his normal size
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ʤʌmpt aʊt ʌv ðə hoʊl ænd rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz ˈnɔrməl saɪz
dialogue.zh: 猴子跳出洞口恢复了原形

dialogue.en: Now we must free my friends
dialogue.ipa: naʊ wi mʌst fri maɪ frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 现在我们必须救出我的朋友

dialogue.en: Then he turned toward the symbols and raised his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi tɜrnd təˈwɔrd ðə ˈsɪmbəlz ænd reɪzd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr
dialogue.zh: 接着,他转向那些符号,举起了他的铁棒

dialogue.en: The demon stormed into the room
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən stɔrmd ˈɪntu ðə rum

dialogue.en: How do you know my name
dialogue.ipa: haʊ du ju noʊ maɪ neɪm

dialogue.en: I've been waiting for you and the Tang monk to pass by my mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪv bɪn ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr ju ænd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tu pæs baɪ maɪ ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 我一直在等你和唐僧路过我的山

dialogue.en: I plan to go to the western paradise and get the true scriptures myself
dialogue.ipa: aɪ plæn tu ɡoʊ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs ænd ɡɛt ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz ˌmaɪˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 我打算自己去西天取真经

dialogue.en: The monkey and the dragon charged toward the demon
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ænd ðə ˈdræɡən ʧɑrʤd təˈwɔrd ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 猴子和龙一起冲向妖怪

dialogue.en: The demon pulled a cloth from his robe and threw it
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən pʊld ə klɔθ frʌm hɪz roʊb ænd θru ɪt
dialogue.zh: 妖怪从袍子里扯出一块布扔了出去

dialogue.en: The cloth wrapped around Wukong and the dragon
dialogue.ipa: ðə klɔθ ræpt əˈraʊnd wu kɔŋ ænd ðə ˈdræɡən

dialogue.en: Soon they were tied up in a room
dialogue.ipa: sun ðeɪ wɜr taɪd ʌp ɪn ə rum
dialogue.zh: 很快他们就被绑在了一个房间里

dialogue.en: And Wu jing were also in the room
dialogue.ipa: ænd wu ʤɪŋ wɜr ˈɔlsoʊ ɪn ðə rum

dialogue.en: Their bags were lying in a corner
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr bæɡz wɜr ˈlaɪɪŋ ɪn ə ˈkɔrnər
dialogue.zh: 他们的行李堆在一个角落

dialogue.en: I'm sorry for not believing you Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈsɑri fɔr nɑt bɪˈlivɪŋ ju wu kæŋ
dialogue.zh: 对不起,悟空,我不该不相信你

dialogue.en: You suspected this place was dangerous
dialogue.ipa: ju səˈspɛktɪd ðɪs pleɪs wʌz ˈdeɪnʤərəs

dialogue.en: We must escape as soon as the demon goes back to sleep
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst ɪˈskeɪp æz sun æz ðə ˈdimən ɡoʊz bæk tu slip
dialogue.zh: 我们必须趁妖怪回去睡觉时尽快逃走

dialogue.en: He plans to get the true scriptures himself
dialogue.ipa: hi plænz tu ɡɛt ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz hɪmˈsɛlf

dialogue.en: The group waited for a while
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup ˈweɪtɪd fɔr ə waɪl

dialogue.en: Finally Wukong made himself tiny and slipped out from his ropes
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪnəli wu kɔŋ meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf ˈtaɪni ænd slɪpt aʊt frʌm hɪz roʊps
dialogue.zh: 终于,悟空把自己变小,从绳索中滑了出来

dialogue.en: He untied his companions and the dragon
dialogue.ipa: hi ənˈtaɪd hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz ænd ðə ˈdræɡən
dialogue.zh: 他解开了同伴和龙的束缚

dialogue.en: They tiptoed through the monastery and were soon outside
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈtɪpˌtoʊd θru ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri ænd wɜr sun ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 他们蹑手蹑脚地穿过寺院,很快就到了外面

dialogue.en: Wukong looked at ba jie and frowned
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt æt ba ʤi ænd fraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 悟空看着八戒,皱起了眉头

dialogue.en: Master's special robe is in one of those bags
dialogue.ipa: ˈmæstərz ˈspɛʃəl roʊb ɪz ɪn wʌn ʌv ðoʊz bæɡz
dialogue.zh: 师父的袈裟就在其中一个袋子里

dialogue.en: I'll go back in and get them
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ bæk ɪn ænd ɡɛt ðɛm

dialogue.en: The monkey quietly hurried back to the room and grabbed the bags
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈkwaɪətli ˈhɜrid bæk tu ðə rum ænd ɡræbd ðə bæɡz
dialogue.zh: 猴子悄悄溜回房间,一把抓起袋子

dialogue.en: He tripped and knocked over a statue
dialogue.ipa: hi trɪpt ænd nɑkt ˈoʊvər ə ˈstæˌʧu
dialogue.zh: 他绊了一跤,撞倒了一尊雕像

dialogue.en: From another room yellow brow shouted
dialogue.ipa: frʌm əˈnʌðər rum ˈjɛloʊ braʊ ˈʃaʊtɪd
dialogue.zh: 黄眉从另一间屋子喊道

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The demon laughed
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Their bags were lying in a corner
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I have a different idea
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: The demon is sleeping
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: How will I get out of here
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Soon they were tied up in a room
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can't escape
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Maybe we could find another way to pry the symbols apart
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Now we must free my friends
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: We have to be quiet
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's go
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Wait here
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: Then there was silence
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who is that
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: The monkey was about to strike the symbols again when he heard a voice
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: The group waited for a while
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 82 The Magic Cloth

dialogue.en: The monkey jumped back to his feet and ran fast out of the monastery
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ʤʌmpt bæk tu hɪz fit nd ræn fæst aʊt ʌv ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 猴子一跃而起,飞快地跑出寺院

dialogue.en: The monkey looked at his empty hands
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lʊkt æt hɪz ˈɛmpti hændz
dialogue.zh: 猴子看着自己空空的双手

dialogue.en: He heard footsteps approaching from inside the monastery
dialogue.ipa: hi hɜrd ˈfʊtˌstɛps əˈproʊʧɪŋ frʌm ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 他听到寺院里传来脚步声

dialogue.en: We can't worry about the bags now
dialogue.ipa: wi kænt ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt ðə bæɡz naʊ

dialogue.en: He helped the Tang monk up onto the horse
dialogue.ipa: hi hɛlpt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ʌp ˈɑntu ðə hɔrs

dialogue.en: The group hurried down the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup ˈhɜrid daʊn ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: They hadn't gotten far before yellow brows flew over them
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈhædənt ˈɡɑtən fɑr bɪˈfɔr ˈjɛloʊ braʊz flu ˈoʊvər ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 没跑多远,黄眉就飞到了他们头顶

dialogue.en: And you will not be going to the west
dialogue.ipa: ænd ju wɪl nɑt bi ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə wɛst

dialogue.en: And I will be the one to get the true scriptures
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ wɪl bi ðə wʌn tu ɡɛt ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz

dialogue.en: Wukong Bajie and Wujing pulled out their weapons
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ Bajie ænd Wujing pʊld aʊt ðɛr ˈwɛpənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空、八戒和悟净亮出兵器

dialogue.en: The gold dragon bared its claws
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡoʊld ˈdræɡən bɛrd ɪts klɔz

dialogue.en: Do you really think you can fight me
dialogue.ipa: du ju ˈrɪli θɪŋk ju kæn faɪt mi

dialogue.en: He reached into his robe and pulled out the cloth
dialogue.ipa: hi riʧt ˈɪntu hɪz roʊb ænd pʊld aʊt ðə klɔθ
dialogue.zh: 他伸手从袍子里掏出那块布

dialogue.en: Bajie lowered his Rake and laughed
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ˈloʊərd hɪz reɪk ænd læft

dialogue.en: And all you have is a piece of cloth
dialogue.ipa: ænd ɔl ju hæv ɪz ə pis ʌv klɔθ

dialogue.en: Yellow brows threw the cloth toward the group
dialogue.ipa: ˈjɛloʊ braʊz θru ðə klɔθ təˈwɔrd ðə ɡrup

dialogue.en: The monkey leaped up to the sky just before the cloth wrapped around his companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lɛpt ʌp tu ðə skaɪ ʤʌst bɪˈfɔr ðə klɔθ ræpt əˈraʊnd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 就在那块布要裹住他的同伴们时,猴子一跃而起飞向天空

dialogue.en: Quickly the demon grabbed the cloth
dialogue.ipa: ˈkwɪkli ðə ˈdimən ɡræbd ðə klɔθ
dialogue.zh: 妖怪迅速抓住了那块布

dialogue.en: He ran back into his monastery and slammed the door shut
dialogue.ipa: hi ræn bæk ˈɪntu hɪz ˈmɑnəˌstɛri ænd slæmd ðə dɔr ʃʌt
dialogue.zh: 他跑回寺庙,砰地一声关上了门

dialogue.en: Wukong sat down on a cloud to think
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ sæt daʊn ɑn ə klaʊd tu θɪŋk

dialogue.en: How could he rescue his companions
dialogue.ipa: haʊ kʊd hi ˈrɛskju hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: I can't ask the Jade Emperor for help
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt æsk ðə ʤeɪd ˈɛmpərər fɔr hɛlp

dialogue.en: He already sent the Gold Dragon
dialogue.ipa: hi ɔlˈrɛdi sɛnt ðə ɡoʊld ˈdræɡən

dialogue.en: Maybe I can ask Guan Yin for help
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi aɪ kæn æsk Guan jɪn fɔr hɛlp
dialogue.zh: 也许我可以请观音菩萨帮忙

dialogue.en: As Wukong was wondering what to do
dialogue.ipa: æz wu kɔŋ wʌz ˈwʌndərɪŋ wɑt tu du
dialogue.zh: 正当悟空不知如何是好时

dialogue.en: And the other was a serpent
dialogue.ipa: ænd ði ˈʌðər wʌz ə ˈsɜrpənt

dialogue.en: The two spirits each carried a sword and a shield
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ˈspɪrɪts iʧ ˈkærid ə sɔrd ænd ə ʃild
dialogue.zh: 两个精灵各持一剑一盾

dialogue.en: We heard the Tang monk was captured by a demon called Yellow Brows
dialogue.ipa: wi hɜrd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz ˈkæpʧərd baɪ ə ˈdimən kɔld ˈjɛloʊ braʊz
dialogue.zh: 我们听说唐僧被一个叫黄眉的妖怪抓走了

dialogue.en: He quickly told them what had happened
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkwɪkli toʊld ðɛm wɑt hæd ˈhæpənd
dialogue.zh: 他迅速将发生的事情告诉了他们

dialogue.en: Let's go to the monastery now
dialogue.ipa: lɛts ɡoʊ tu ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri naʊ

dialogue.en: Yellow brows won't be able to fight all three of us
dialogue.ipa: ˈjɛloʊ braʊz woʊnt bi ˈeɪbəl tu faɪt ɔl θri ʌv ʌs
dialogue.zh: 黄眉不可能打得过我们三个

dialogue.en: We are much too powerful for him
dialogue.ipa: wi ɑr mʌʧ tu ˈpaʊərfəl fɔr hɪm

dialogue.en: Wukong led the two spirits down to the monastery
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lɛd ðə tu ˈspɪrɪts daʊn tu ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 悟空带着两个精灵降落到寺庙前

dialogue.en: just be careful of his cloth
dialogue.ipa: ˈfæstər ʤʌst bi ˈkɛrfəl ʌv hɪz klɔθ

dialogue.en: He'll try to capture us with it
dialogue.ipa: hil traɪ tu ˈkæpʧər ʌs wɪð ɪt
dialogue.zh: 他会试图用它来抓我们

dialogue.en: Wukong banged on the monastery door
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ bæŋd ɑn ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri dɔr

dialogue.en: Then I'll smash your entire mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn aɪl smæʃ jʊər ɪnˈtaɪər ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Yellow brow stepped out and threw the cloth
dialogue.ipa: ˈjɛloʊ braʊ stɛpt aʊt ænd θru ðə klɔθ
dialogue.zh: 黄眉走出来,扔出了那块布

dialogue.en: The monkey jumped out of the way
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ʤʌmpt aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ

dialogue.en: But the turtle and serpent weren't fast enough
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈtɜrtəl ænd ˈsɜrpənt ˈwɜrənt fæst ɪˈnʌf

dialogue.en: The demon grabbed the bundle and went back into the monastery
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ɡræbd ðə ˈbʌndəl ænd wɛnt bæk ˈɪntu ðə ˈmɑnə ˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 抓起那团包裹,回到了寺庙里

dialogue.en: Wukong flew back up into the sky
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ flu bæk ʌp ˈɪntu ðə skaɪ

dialogue.en: He sat on a cloud and mourned
dialogue.ipa: hi sæt ɑn ə klaʊd ænd mɔrnd

dialogue.en: He was still thinking when he heard a voice
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz stɪl ˈθɪŋkɪŋ wɛn hi hɜrd ə vɔɪs
dialogue.zh: 他正想着,突然听到一个声音

dialogue.en: Wukong looked toward the voice and saw a man with a big belly
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt təˈwɔrd ðə vɔɪs ænd sɔ ə mæn wɪð ə bɪɡ ˈbɛli
dialogue.zh: 悟空朝声音望去,看见一个大肚子的男人

dialogue.en: Do you know who I am
dialogue.ipa: du ju noʊ hu aɪ æm

dialogue.en: And I've come to help you
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪv kʌm tu hɛlp ju

The demon was defeated by Wukong.

The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We can't worry about the bags now
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: How could he rescue his companions
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I must have dropped them
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: We have to go quickly
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: He'll try to capture us with it
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's go to the monastery now
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Run faster bajie
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who was just captured again
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.

The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.

The cave that they found was dark.

The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 83 the melon field

dialogue.en: Are you sure you can help
dialogue.ipa: ɑr ju ʃʊr ju kæn hɛlp
wu kɔŋ æskt ðə ˈbudə maitreya

dialogue.en: He captured everyone with a magic cloth
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkæpʧərd ˈɛvriˌwʌn wɪð ə ˈmæʤɪk klɔθ
dialogue.zh: 他用一块魔布抓住了所有人

dialogue.en: He trapped me in a pair of cymbals
dialogue.ipa: hi træpt mi ɪn ə pɛr əv ˈsɪmbəlz
dialogue.zh: 他用一对铙钹困住了我

dialogue.en: He used to be my student
dialogue.ipa: hi juzd tu bi maɪ ˈstudənt

dialogue.en: The cloth and symbols are precious Buddhist treasures that he stole from me
dialogue.ipa: ðə klɔθ ænd ˈsɪmbəlz ɑr ˈprɛʃəs ˈbudəst ˈtrɛʒərz ðæt hi stoʊl frʌm mi
dialogue.zh: 那块布和铙钹是他从我这里偷走的珍贵佛宝

dialogue.en: Wukong stormed up to the monastery door again
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ stɔrmd ʌp tu ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri dɔr əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 悟空再次冲到了寺院门前

dialogue.en: Return my friends or I smash your entire mountain
dialogue.ipa: rɪˈtɜrn maɪ frɛndz ɔr aɪl smæʃ jʊər ɪnˈtaɪər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 还我朋友,否则我就砸烂你整座山

dialogue.en: Do you know how powerful I am
dialogue.ipa: du ju noʊ haʊ ˈpaʊərfəl aɪ æm

dialogue.en: You just think you are because you have that cloth
dialogue.ipa: ju ʤʌst θɪŋk ju ɑr bɪˈkɔz ju hæv ðæt klɔθ
dialogue.zh: 你只是因为有那块布才自以为了不起

dialogue.en: I bet you're too scared to fight me without it
dialogue.ipa: aɪ bɛt jʊr tu skɛrd tu faɪt mi wɪˈθaʊt ɪt
dialogue.zh: 我打赌你没了它就不敢跟我打

dialogue.en: He went back inside and came back a moment later
dialogue.ipa: hi wɛnt bæk ɪnˈsaɪd ænd keɪm bæk ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈleɪtər
dialogue.zh: 他走回里面,片刻后又出来了

dialogue.en: He was holding a heavy wooden club
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈhoʊldɪŋ ə ˈhɛvi ˈwʊdən klʌb
dialogue.zh: 他拿着一根沉重的木棒

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar as the demon rushed toward him
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr æz ðə ˈdimən rʌʃt təˈwɔrd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 悟空抽出铁棒,妖怪朝他冲来

dialogue.en: Their weapons smashed together again and again
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ˈwɛpənz smæʃt təˈɡɛðər əˈɡɛn ænd əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 他们的武器一次又一次地猛烈碰撞

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ tʊk smɔl stɛps ˈbækwərd

dialogue.en: Slowly he moved the fight away from the monastery
dialogue.ipa: ˈsloʊli hi muvd ðə faɪt əˈweɪ frʌm ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri
dialogue.zh: 他慢慢将打斗引离寺院

dialogue.en: Soon they were fighting in the valley at the bottom of the mountain
dialogue.ipa: sun ðeɪ wɜr ˈfaɪtɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈvæli æt ðə ˈbɑtəm ʌv ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 很快他们就在山脚下的山谷中交战起来

dialogue.en: Wukong took another swing at yellow brows
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ tʊk əˈnʌðər swɪŋ æt ˈjɛloʊ braʊz
dialogue.zh: 悟空又朝黄眉挥了一棒

dialogue.en: And then pretended to be scared
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn priˈtɛndɪd tu bi skɛrd
ðə ˈdimən ræn ˈæftər wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: The monkey ran through some woods and into a melon field
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ræn θru sʌm wʊdz ænd ˈɪntu ə ˈmɛlən fild
dialogue.zh: 猴子穿过一片树林,跑进了一块瓜田

dialogue.en: Then the demon noticed all the melons
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ðə ˈdimən ˈnoʊtəst ɔl ðə ˈmɛlənz
dialogue.zh: 这时妖怪注意到了满地的瓜
一个农夫正在附近干活

dialogue.en: Give me one of your melons
dialogue.ipa: ɡɪv mi wʌn ʌv jʊər ˈmɛlənz

dialogue.en: The farmer put down his rake and smiled
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈfɑrmər pʊt daʊn hɪz reɪk ænd smaɪld

dialogue.en: He walked over to the demon
dialogue.ipa: hi wɔkt ˈoʊvər tu ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: I'll find a nice ripe melon for you
dialogue.ipa: aɪl faɪnd ə naɪs raɪp ˈmɛlən fɔr ju
dialogue.zh: 我给你找个熟透的好瓜

dialogue.en: Finally he held up a ripe melon
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪnəli hi hɛld ʌp ə raɪp ˈmɛlən
dialogue.zh: 最后,他举起一个熟透的瓜

dialogue.en: Yellow brows lifted the melon to take a bite
dialogue.ipa: ˈjɛloʊ braʊz ˈlɪftɪd ðə ˈmɛlən tu teɪk ə baɪt

dialogue.en: Suddenly the melon shrank to the size of a Berry
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðə ˈmɛlən ʃræŋk tu ðə saɪz ʌv ə ˈbɛri
dialogue.zh: 突然,那瓜缩成了浆果大小

dialogue.en: It leaped out of his hand and went right down his throat
dialogue.ipa: ɪt lɛpt aʊt ʌv hɪz hænd ænd wɛnt raɪt daʊn hɪz θroʊt
dialogue.zh: 它从他手中跳起,径直钻进了他的喉咙

dialogue.en: The demon fell to his knees
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən fɛl tu hɪz niz

dialogue.en: What was wrong with that melon
dialogue.ipa: wɑt wʌz rɔŋ wɪð ðæt ˈmɛlən

dialogue.en: Then he noticed the farmer was gone
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ˈnoʊtəst ðə ˈfɑrmər wʌz ɡɔn
dialogue.zh: 这时他注意到农夫不见了

dialogue.en: Yellow brows pulled the cloth from his robe and handed it to maitreya
dialogue.ipa: ˈjɛloʊ braʊz pʊld ðə klɔθ frʌm hɪz roʊb ænd ˈhændɪd ɪt tu maitreya
dialogue.zh: 黄眉从袍子里抽出那块布,递给了弥勒佛

dialogue.en: You may come out now Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ju meɪ kʌm aʊt naʊ wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空,你现在可以出来了

dialogue.en: A tiny Wukong leaped from the demon's nose
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈtaɪni wu kɔŋ lɛpt frʌm ðə ˈdimənz noʊz
dialogue.zh: 一个小小的悟空从妖怪的鼻子里跳了出来

dialogue.en: Maitreya threw the cloth at yellow brows
dialogue.ipa: Maitreya θru ðə klɔθ æt ˈjɛloʊ braʊz

dialogue.en: It wrapped around the demon and became small
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ræpt əˈraʊnd ðə ˈdimən ænd bɪˈkeɪm smɔl
dialogue.zh: 它缠绕住恶魔并缩小了

dialogue.en: Maitreya put the bundle into a pocket
dialogue.ipa: Maitreya pʊt ðə ˈbʌndəl ˈɪntu ə ˈpɑkət
dialogue.zh: 弥勒佛将包裹放入口袋

dialogue.en: Wukong returned to his normal size
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz ˈnɔrməl saɪz

dialogue.en: He and maitreya went to the monastery
dialogue.ipa: hi ænd maitreya wɛnt tu ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri

dialogue.en: Wukong untied his companions and the other spirits
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ən ˈtaɪd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ænd ði ˈʌðər ˈspɪrɪts
dialogue.zh: 悟空解开了同伴和其他精怪的束缚

dialogue.en: The dragon the turtle and the serpent
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdræɡən ðə ˈtɜrtəl ænd ðə ˈsɜrpənt

dialogue.en: Thanked the monkey and flew away
dialogue.ipa: θæŋkt ðə ˈmʌŋki ænd flu ə ˈweɪ

dialogue.en: I'm sorry for not believing you when you warned us about this place
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈsɑri fɔr nɑt bɪˈlivɪŋ ju wɛn ju wɔrnd ʌs əˈbaʊt ðɪs pleɪs
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉当初你警告我们此地危险时,我没有相信你

dialogue.en: Maybe you'll believe me one of these days master
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi jul bɪ ˈliv mi wʌn ʌv ðiz deɪz ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 也许总有一天师父会相信我的

dialogue.en: The travelers went outside and continued west
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz wɛnt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ænd kənˈtɪnjud wɛst
dialogue.zh: 师徒们走出寺院继续西行

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong asked the Buddha maitreya
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: He was holding a heavy wooden club
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Do you know how powerful I am
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll tell you my plan
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: And then pretended to be scared
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Are you sure you can help
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We must capture yellow brows
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Get back here coward
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: I'm sorry for not believing you when you warned us about this place
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: You just think you are because you have that cloth
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: Do you know how powerful I am
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.

He asked when Wukong would return.

The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: be + too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 84 the Sad King

dialogue.en: All this food looks so good
dialogue.ipa: ɔl ðɪs fud lʊks soʊ ɡʊd
dialogue.zh: 这些食物看起来真诱人

dialogue.en: The travelers were walking through a city in the Scarlet Kingdom
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz wɜr ˈwɔkɪŋ θru ə ˈsɪti ɪn ðə ˈskɑrlət ˈkɪŋdəm
dialogue.zh: 师徒们正行走在朱紫国的街市上

dialogue.en: The streets were lined with people selling food and other goods
dialogue.ipa: ðə strits wɜr laɪnd wɪð ˈpipəl ˈsɛlɪŋ fud ænd ˈʌðər ɡʊdz
dialogue.zh: 街道两旁满是叫卖食物和货物的商贩

dialogue.en: He pointed to a crowd of people reading a sign on a wall
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈpɔɪntɪd tu ə kraʊd ʌv ˈpipəl ˈrɛdɪŋ ə saɪn ɑn ə wɔl
dialogue.zh: 他指向一群正在看墙上告示的人

dialogue.en: The travelers walked over to the crowd
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz wɔkt ˈoʊvər tu ðə kraʊd

dialogue.en: The king of the Scarlet Kingdom is seeking help
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ ʌv ðə ˈskɑrlət ˈkɪŋdəm ɪz ˈsikɪŋ hɛlp
dialogue.zh: 朱紫国国王正在寻求帮助

dialogue.en: Anyone who can defeat demons must report to the royal palace
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛniˌwʌn hu kæn dɪˈfit ˈdimənz mʌst rɪˈpɔrt tu ðə ˈrɔɪəl ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 凡能降妖除魔者须即刻前往王宫禀报

dialogue.en: I don't want to delay our journey
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tu dɪˈleɪ ˈaʊər ˈʤɜrni

dialogue.en: But you three can defeat demons
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ju θri kæn dɪˈfit ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 但你们三个能降服妖魔

dialogue.en: We must report to the palace
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst rɪˈpɔrt tu ðə ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: I hope they have food at the palace
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp ðeɪ hæv fud æt ðə ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: The travelers arrived at the palace gate
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz əˈraɪvd æt ðə ˈpæləs ɡeɪt

dialogue.en: Who then led them into the court
dialogue.ipa: hu ðɛn lɛd ðɛm ˈɪntu ðə kɔrt
dialogue.zh: 卫兵随即引他们进入大殿

dialogue.en: The king sat on his throne
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ sæt ɑn hɪz θroʊn

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is here to see you
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz hir tu si ju

dialogue.en: He says his companions can defeat demons
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛz hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz kæn dɪˈfit ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 他说他的同伴能降妖除魔

dialogue.en: The king looked up but didn't say anything
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ lʊkt ʌp bʌt ˈdɪdənt seɪ ˈɛniˌθɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 国王抬起头,却一言不发

dialogue.en: The guard whispered to the travelers
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑrd ˈwɪspərd tu ðə ˈtrævələrz
dialogue.zh: 卫兵对旅人们低声耳语

dialogue.en: If you can help him please do
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju kæn hɛlp hɪm pliz du
dialogue.zh: 若您能相助,恳请施以援手

dialogue.en: Wukong walked up to the king
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wɔkt ʌp tu ðə kɪŋ

dialogue.en: King of the Fruit and Flower Mountain
dialogue.ipa: kɪŋ ʌv ðə frut ænd ˈflaʊər ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: You need someone who can defeat demons
dialogue.ipa: ju nid ˈsʌmˌwʌn hu kæn dɪˈfit ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 您需要能降服妖魔之人

dialogue.en: Suddenly the king covered his face with his hands and burst out crying
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðə kɪŋ ˈkʌvərd hɪz feɪs wɪð hɪz hændz ænd bɜrst aʊt ˈkraɪɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 突然,国王双手掩面,放声大哭

dialogue.en: Wukong ignored the monk and looked at the king
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ɪɡ ˈnɔrd ðə mʌŋk ænd lʊkt æt ðə kɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空没理会唐僧,看向国王

dialogue.en: But if you want my help
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ɪf ju wɑnt maɪ hɛlp

dialogue.en: You must stay calm and explain everything to me
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst steɪ kɑm ænd ɪkˈspleɪn ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ tu mi
dialogue.zh: 您必须冷静下来,把一切原委告诉我

dialogue.en: The king sniffed and sat up straight
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ snɪft ænd sæt ʌp streɪt
dialogue.zh: 国王吸了吸鼻子,坐直身子

dialogue.en: He pulled out a handkerchief and blew his nose
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt ə ˈhæŋkərʧɪf ænd blu hɪz noʊz
dialogue.zh: 他掏出手帕擤了擤鼻子

dialogue.en: I will tell you what happened
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl tɛl ju wɑt ˈhæpənd
dialogue.zh: 我这就告诉你发生了什么

dialogue.en: The demon of power attacked our kingdom
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈpaʊər ə ˈtækt ˈaʊər ˈkɪŋdəm

dialogue.en: I sent soldiers to fight the demon and bring back my wife
dialogue.ipa: aɪ sɛnt ˈsoʊlʤərz tu faɪt ðə ˈdimən ænd brɪŋ bæk maɪ waɪf
dialogue.zh: 我派兵讨伐妖魔,想夺回妻子

dialogue.en: But the demon was too powerful
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə ˈdimən wʌz tu ˈpaʊərfəl

dialogue.en: The king got up and walked to a window
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ ɡɑt ʌp ænd wɔkt tu ə ˈwɪndoʊ

dialogue.en: He pointed to a mountain in the distance
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈpɔɪntɪd tu ə ˈmaʊntən ɪn ðə ˈdɪstəns

dialogue.en: The demon lives on that mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən lɪvz ɑn ðæt ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Wukong clapped the king on the back
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ klæpt ðə kɪŋ ɑn ðə bæk
dialogue.zh: 悟空拍了拍国王的后背

dialogue.en: You can stop being sad now
dialogue.ipa: ju kæn stɑp ˈbiɪŋ sæd naʊ

dialogue.en: Please take care of my companions
dialogue.ipa: pliz teɪk kɛr ʌv maɪ kəm ˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: Wukong landed on the Demon's Mountain
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈlændɪd ɑn ðə ˈdimənz ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Several small demons were standing outside a cave entrance
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɛvrəl smɔl ˈdimənz wɜr ˈstændɪŋ ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ə keɪv ˈɛntrəns
dialogue.zh: 几个小妖正站在一个山洞入口外

dialogue.en: Return the queen or I'll destroy all of you
dialogue.ipa: rɪˈtɜrn ðə kwin ɔr aɪl dɪ ˈstrɔɪ ɔl ʌv ju
dialogue.zh: 把王后交出来,否则我就把你们全灭了

dialogue.en: Cried the small demons as they ran into the cave
dialogue.ipa: kraɪd ðə smɔl ˈdimənz æz ðeɪ ræn ˈɪntu ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 小妖们一边跑进山洞一边哭喊

dialogue.en: Wukong heard another voice inside the cave
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ hɜrd əˈnʌðər vɔɪs ɪnˈsaɪd ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 悟空听到洞里传来另一个声音

dialogue.en: We must return the queen or he'll destroy all of us
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst rɪ ˈtɜrn ðə kwin ɔr hil dɪˈstrɔɪ ɔl ʌv ʌs
dialogue.zh: 我们必须把王后交出去,不然他会把我们全杀光

dialogue.en: A large demon with broad shoulders came out of the cave
dialogue.ipa: ə lɑrʤ ˈdimən wɪð brɔd ˈʃoʊldərz keɪm aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 一个肩膀宽阔的大妖从洞里走了出来

dialogue.en: I am the demon of power
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈpaʊər

dialogue.en: Do you know who I am
dialogue.ipa: du ju noʊ hu aɪ æm
ænd sænd wɪpt pæst wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 沙尘从悟空身边呼啸而过

dialogue.en: The monkey coughed as sand flew up his nose
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki kɔft æz sænd flu ʌp hɪz noʊz
dialogue.zh: 沙子飞进鼻子,猴子咳嗽起来

dialogue.en: He covered his face and leaped off the mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkʌvərd hɪz feɪs ænd lɛpt ɔf ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 他捂住脸,纵身跳离了这座山

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The travelers were walking through a city in the Scarlet Kingdom
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The travelers were walking through a city in the Scarlet Kingdom
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I hope they have food at the palace
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: The king of the Scarlet Kingdom is seeking help
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll never oh
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: The streets were lined with people selling food and other goods
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Anyone who can defeat demons must report to the royal palace
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Anyone who can defeat demons must report to the royal palace
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: I don't want to delay our journey
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Stop thinking about food Bajie
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's a monkey outside
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Anyone who can defeat demons must report to the royal palace
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you can help him please do
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: All this food looks so good
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: Do you know who I am
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 85 Fire Smoke and sand

dialogue.en: Wukong landed on another mountain peak
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈlændɪd ɑn ə ˈnʌðər ˈmaʊntən pik
dialogue.zh: 悟空落在另一座山峰上

dialogue.en: That fire and smoke were awful
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈfaɪər ænd smoʊk wɜr ˈɑfəl

dialogue.en: And the sand went right in my nose
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə sænd wɛnt raɪt ɪn maɪ noʊz
dialogue.zh: 沙子还直接钻进了我的鼻子

dialogue.en: He looked at the demon of Powers Mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈpaʊərz ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: The fire and smoke were now gone
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈfaɪər ænd smoʊk wɜr naʊ ɡɔn
dialogue.zh: 火和烟现在已经消失了

dialogue.en: Wukong was about to return to that mountain
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wʌz əˈbaʊt tu rɪˈtɜrn tu ðæt ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: The demon will just use the same trick again
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən wɪl ʤʌst juz ðə seɪm trɪk əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪肯定又会用同样的把戏

dialogue.en: I'll sneak into his cave and look around
dialogue.ipa: aɪl snik ˈɪntu hɪz keɪv ænd lʊk əˈraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 我要溜进他的洞里查看一番

dialogue.en: Maybe I can find out how he created the fire
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi aɪ kæn faɪnd aʊt haʊ hi kriˈeɪtɪd ðə ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 也许我能发现他是怎么制造出火焰的

dialogue.en: Wukong turned into a bug and flew back to the demon's mountain
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə bʌɡ ænd flu bæk tu ðə ˈdimənz ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 悟空变成一只小虫,飞回了妖怪的山

dialogue.en: He went into the cave and flew down a long dark tunnel
dialogue.ipa: hi wɛnt ˈɪntu ðə keɪv ænd flu daʊn ə lɔŋ dɑrk ˈtʌnəl
dialogue.zh: 他进入山洞,沿着一条又长又黑的隧道飞下去

dialogue.en: He soon found a brightly lit bedroom filled with nice furniture and fancy decorations
dialogue.ipa: hi sun faʊnd ə ˈbraɪtli lɪt ˈbɛˌdrum fɪld wɪð naɪs ˈfɜrnɪʧər ænd ˈfænsi ˌdɛkəˈreɪʃənz
dialogue.zh: 很快,他发现了一个灯火通明的卧室,里面摆满了精美的家具和豪华的装饰

dialogue.en: In a corner a woman sat in a chair
dialogue.ipa: ɪn ə ˈkɔrnər ə ˈwʊmən sæt ɪn ə ʧɛr
dialogue.zh: 角落里,一个女人坐在椅子上

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ tɜrnd bæk ˈɪntu hɪmˈsɛlf
maɪ neɪm ɪz sʌn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: Your husband sent me to rescue you
dialogue.ipa: jʊər ˈhʌzbənd sɛnt mi tu ˈrɛskju ju

dialogue.en: The queen's face broke into a smile
dialogue.ipa: ðə kwinz feɪs broʊk ˈɪntu ə smaɪl

dialogue.en: The demon who kidnapped me is horrible
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən hu ˈkɪdˌnæpt mi ɪz ˈhɔrəbəl
dialogue.zh: 绑架我的妖怪太可怕了

dialogue.en: He said he loves me and wants to marry me
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd hi lʌvz mi ænd wɑnts tu ˈmɛri mi

dialogue.en: The queen started to cry again
dialogue.ipa: ðə kwin ˈstɑrtɪd tu kraɪ əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: But first I must figure out how he creates the fire
dialogue.ipa: bʌt fɜrst aɪ mʌst ˈfɪɡjər aʊt haʊ hi kriˈeɪts ðə ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 但首先,我得弄清楚他是怎么制造火焰的

dialogue.en: And the third bell makes sand
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə θɜrd bɛl meɪks sænd

dialogue.en: He wears them around his neck
dialogue.ipa: hi wɛrz ðɛm əˈraʊnd hɪz nɛk

dialogue.en: Tonight I'll steal those bells from the demon
dialogue.ipa: təˈnaɪt aɪl stil ðoʊz bɛlz frʌm ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 今晚我就去偷妖怪的铃铛

dialogue.en: I'll come back and rescue you
dialogue.ipa: aɪl kʌm bæk ænd ˈrɛskju ju

dialogue.en: The monkey turned back into a bug
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki tɜrnd bæk ˈɪntu ə bʌɡ
dialogue.zh: 猴子又变成了一只小虫

dialogue.en: Soon he found a second bedroom
dialogue.ipa: sun hi faʊnd ə ˈsɛkənd ˈbɛ ˌdrum
dialogue.zh: 很快,他找到了第二个卧室

dialogue.en: This one was dark and gloomy
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs wʌn wʌz dɑrk ænd ˈɡlumi

dialogue.en: This must be the demon's bedroom
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs mʌst bi ðə ˈdimənz ˈbɛ ˌdrum

dialogue.en: I'll wait here until the demon goes to sleep
dialogue.ipa: aɪl weɪt hir ənˈtɪl ðə ˈdimən ɡoʊz tu slip
dialogue.zh: 我就在这儿等到妖怪睡着

dialogue.en: He landed on the ceiling and waited
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈlændɪd ɑn ðə ˈsilɪŋ ænd ˈweɪtɪd
dialogue.zh: 他落在天花板上等待着

dialogue.en: The demon of power came into the room
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈpaʊər keɪm ˈɪntu ðə rum

dialogue.en: Wukong could see the bells tied around the demon's neck
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ kʊd si ðə bɛlz taɪd əˈraʊnd ðə ˈdimənz nɛk
dialogue.zh: 悟空看到妖怪脖子上系着的铃铛

dialogue.en: The demon climbed into bed and closed his eyes
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən klaɪmd ˈɪntu bɛd ænd kloʊzd hɪz aɪz
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪爬上床,闭上了眼睛

dialogue.en: He plucked a few of his hairs
dialogue.ipa: hi plʌkt ə fju ʌv hɪz hɛrz

dialogue.en: The fleas landed on the demon's neck and began biting
dialogue.ipa: ðə fliz ˈlændɪd ɑn ðə ˈdimənz nɛk ænd bɪˈɡæn ˈbaɪtɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 跳蚤落在妖怪的脖子上开始叮咬

dialogue.en: The demon scratched at his neck and rolled over
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən skræʧt æt hɪz nɛk ænd roʊld ˈoʊvər
dialogue.zh: 妖怪抓挠着脖子翻了个身

dialogue.en: Then he scratched some more and more
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi skræʧt sʌm mɔr ænd mɔr

dialogue.en: Why is my neck so itchy
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɪz maɪ nɛk soʊ ˈɪʧi

dialogue.zh: 也许是这些铃铛的缘故

dialogue.en: I'll take them off while I sleep
dialogue.ipa: aɪl teɪk ðɛm ɔf waɪl aɪ slip
dialogue.zh: 我睡觉时把它们摘下来吧

dialogue.en: The demon laid the three bells on a table
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən leɪd ðə θri bɛlz ɑn ə ˈteɪbəl
dialogue.zh: 妖怪将三个铃铛放在桌上

dialogue.en: A few minutes later he was snoring again
dialogue.ipa: ə fju ˈmɪnəts ˈleɪtər hi wʌz ˈsnɔrɪŋ əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 几分钟后他又打起了呼噜

dialogue.en: The fleas turn back into hairs and return to Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə fliz tɜrn bæk ˈɪntu hɛrz ænd rɪˈtɜrn tu wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 跳蚤变回毫毛回到了悟空身上

dialogue.en: Next the monkey turn the hairs into three fake bells
dialogue.ipa: nɛkst ðə ˈmʌŋki tɜrn ðə hɛrz ˈɪntu θri feɪk bɛlz
dialogue.zh: 接着猴子把毫毛变成三个假铃铛

dialogue.en: He put them on the table and stuck the real bells in his robe
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊt ðɛm ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl ænd stʌk ðə riəl bɛlz ɪn hɪz roʊb
dialogue.zh: 他将假铃铛放在桌上,真铃铛藏进衣袍

dialogue.en: He looked at the sleeping demon
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt æt ðə ˈslipɪŋ ˈdimən

dialogue.en: It's too dangerous to use these bells inside
dialogue.ipa: ɪts tu ˈdeɪnʤərəs tu juz ðiz bɛlz ɪnˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 在洞里用这些铃铛太危险

dialogue.en: I'll get the demon to come outside
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡɛt ðə ˈdimən tu kʌm ˈaʊt ˈsaɪd

dialogue.en: Wukong became invisible and ran back through the tunnel
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ bɪˈkeɪm ɪnˈvɪzəbəl ænd ræn bæk θru ðə ˈtʌnəl
dialogue.zh: 悟空隐身穿过隧道往回跑

dialogue.en: A guard was sleeping next to the cave entrance
dialogue.ipa: ə ɡɑrd wʌz ˈslipɪŋ nɛkst tu ðə keɪv ˈɛntrəns
dialogue.zh: 一个守卫正在洞口旁睡觉
悟空悄悄从他身边溜过
我就把整座山砸个粉碎

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: That fire and smoke were awful
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: She was crying
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: He said he loves me and wants to marry me
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: The demon will just use the same trick again
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Maybe I can find out how he created the fire
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Wukong could see the bells tied around the demon's neck
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But first I must figure out how he creates the fire
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: He said he loves me and wants to marry me
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: The demon who kidnapped me is horrible
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you don't
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: A little while later
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: Why is my neck so itchy
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: Maybe I can find out how he created the fire
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: be + too + 形容词 + to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示“太……而不能做某事”。
grammar.source: It's too dangerous to use these bells inside
examples: The box is too heavy to carry.
The river is too deep to cross.
Bajie is too tired to walk.
The cave is too dark to enter.
The wall is too high to climb.
The road is too narrow to ride on.
It is too late to leave.
The demon is too fast to catch.
The water is too cold to swim in.
The noise is too loud to ignore.

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 86 magic bells

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈʃaʊtɪd ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: He shouted all kinds of insults about the demon of power
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈʃaʊtɪd ɔl kaɪndz ʌv ɪnˈsʌlts əˈbaʊt ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈpaʊər
dialogue.zh: 他把那大力妖怪骂得狗血淋头

dialogue.en: Inside the cave the guard woke up
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈsaɪd ðə keɪv ðə ɡɑrd woʊk ʌp

dialogue.en: He ran to the demon's bedroom
dialogue.ipa: hi ræn tu ðə ˈdimənz ˈbɛˌdrum

dialogue.en: It's the middle of the night
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ðə ˈmɪdəl ʌv ðə naɪt

dialogue.en: He said we must return the queen
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd wi mʌst rɪˈtɜrn ðə kwin
dialogue.zh: 他说我们必须交出王后
他就要砸平我们整座山

dialogue.en: He also yelled some terrible things about you
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈɔlsoʊ jɛld sʌm ˈtɛrəbəl θɪŋz əˈbaʊt ju
dialogue.zh: 他还说了许多辱骂您的难听话

dialogue.en: The demon of power climbed out of bed and grabbed the fake bells
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈpaʊər klaɪmd aʊt ʌv bɛd ænd ɡræbd ðə feɪk bɛlz
dialogue.zh: 大力妖怪爬下床抓起假铃铛

dialogue.en: I'll chase the monkey away with my fire smoke and sand again
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ʧeɪs ðə ˈmʌŋki əˈweɪ wɪð maɪ ˈfaɪər smoʊk ænd sænd əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 我再放火喷烟扬沙赶走那猴子

dialogue.en: He tied the bells around his neck and went outside
dialogue.ipa: hi taɪd ðə bɛlz əˈraʊnd hɪz nɛk ænd wɛnt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 他将铃铛系在颈间向外走去

dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ɡlɛrd æt wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: He reached for the bells around his neck
dialogue.ipa: hi riʧt fɔr ðə bɛlz ə ˈraʊnd hɪz nɛk
dialogue.zh: 他伸手去摸脖子上的铃铛

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ priˈtɛndɪd tu bi sər ˈpraɪzd

dialogue.en: I have bells just like those
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv bɛlz ʤʌst laɪk ðoʊz
dialogue.zh: 我也有跟你一样的铃铛

dialogue.en: The demon squinted at the monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ˈskwɪntɪd æt ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: I doubt your bells are like mine
dialogue.ipa: aɪ daʊt jʊər bɛlz ɑr laɪk maɪn
dialogue.zh: 我不信你的铃铛能跟我的一样

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ hɛld ʌp ðə bɛlz

dialogue.en: The demon peered at them for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən pɪrd æt ðɛm fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt
dialogue.zh: 妖怪仔细端详了一会儿

dialogue.en: Those bells do look like mine
dialogue.ipa: ðoʊz bɛlz du lʊk laɪk maɪn
dialogue.zh: 这些铃铛看起来确实像我的
但我的铃铛可是有法力的

dialogue.en: My bells can do that too
dialogue.ipa: maɪ bɛlz kæn du ðæt tu

dialogue.en: The demon of power looks surprised
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ʌv ˈpaʊər lʊks sər ˈpraɪzd

dialogue.en: Let's compare bells to see whose work better
dialogue.ipa: lɛts kəmˈpɛr bɛlz tu si huz wɜrk ˈbɛtər
dialogue.zh: 咱们比比看谁的铃铛更厉害

dialogue.en: He looked closely at the bells
dialogue.ipa: hi lʊkt ˈkloʊsli æt ðə bɛlz

dialogue.zh: 昨天这些铃铛还好好的

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ traɪd nɑt tu læf

dialogue.en: Let's see if my bells work
dialogue.ipa: lɛts si ɪf maɪ bɛlz wɜrk

dialogue.en: Smoke and sand rush toward the demon
dialogue.ipa: smoʊk ænd sænd rʌʃ tə ˈwɔrd ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: He covered his face and fell to the ground
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkʌvərd hɪz feɪs ænd fɛl tu ðə ɡraʊnd

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar and got ready to strike
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd ɡɑt ˈrɛdi tu straɪk
dialogue.zh: 悟空抽出铁棒,准备出击

dialogue.en: The monkey looked up and saw guan Yin coming down from the sky
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lʊkt ʌp ænd sɔ guan jɪn ˈkʌmɪŋ daʊn frʌm ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 猴子抬头一看,只见观音从天而降

dialogue.en: I was just going to destroy this demon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ʤʌst ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu dɪ ˈstrɔɪ ðɪs ˈdimən

dialogue.en: The bodhisattva looked at the demon
dialogue.ipa: ðə bodhisattva lʊkt æt ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: And the demon turned into a huge wolf
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈdimən tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə hjuʤ wʊlf

dialogue.en: Guanyin climbed onto the wolf's back
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin klaɪmd ˈɑntu ðə wʊlfs bæk

dialogue.en: She looked at the wolf's neck and then at Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ʃi lʊkt æt ðə wʊlfs nɛk ænd ðɛn æt wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 她看了看狼的脖子,又看向悟空

dialogue.ipa: ɡɪv mi ðə bɛlz wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: Wukong held the bells behind his back
dialogue.ipa: Wukong hɛld ðə bɛlz bɪ ˈhaɪnd hɪz bæk

dialogue.en: My wolf wears a set of three bells
dialogue.ipa: maɪ wʊlf wɛrz ə sɛt ʌv θri bɛlz
dialogue.zh: 我的狼戴着一套三个铃铛

dialogue.en: You could not have defeated the wolf without them
dialogue.ipa: ju kʊd nɑt hæv dɪˈfitɪd ðə wʊlf wɪˈθaʊt ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 没有它们,你不可能打败这头狼

dialogue.en: I have no idea what you're
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv noʊ aɪˈdiə wɑt jʊr

dialogue.en: Or I'll recite the tight headband spell
dialogue.ipa: ɔr aɪl rəˈsaɪt ðə taɪt ˈhɛd ˌbænd spɛl

dialogue.zh: 他不好意思地咧嘴笑了

dialogue.en: Guanyin tied the bells around the wolf's neck and then rode up into the sky
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin taɪd ðə bɛlz əˈraʊnd ðə wʊlfs nɛk ænd ðɛn roʊd ʌp ˈɪntu ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 观音将铃铛系在狼脖子上,然后乘狼飞向天空

dialogue.en: The king and Queen were reunited
dialogue.ipa: ðə kɪŋ ænd kwin wɜr ˌriuˈnaɪtɪd

dialogue.en: Thank you for rescuing the Queen sun wukong
dialogue.ipa: θæŋk ju fɔr ˈrɛskjuɪŋ ðə kwin sʌn wukong
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你救了王后,孙悟空

dialogue.en: Tonight we will hold a feast to thank you and your companions
dialogue.ipa: təˈnaɪt wi wɪl hoʊld ə fist tu θæŋk ju ænd jʊər kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 今晚我们将设宴感谢你和你的同伴

dialogue.en: That night the Royal banquet hall was filled with people
dialogue.ipa: ðæt naɪt ðə ˈrɔɪəl ˈbæŋkwət hɔl wʌz fɪld wɪð ˈpipəl
dialogue.zh: 当晚,皇家宴会厅里坐满了人

dialogue.en: Servants carried trays filled with rice
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɜrvənts ˈkærid treɪz fɪld wɪð raɪs
dialogue.zh: 仆人们端着装满米饭的托盘

dialogue.en: Bajie ate everything in front of him
dialogue.ipa: Bajie eɪt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɪn frʌnt ʌv hɪm
dialogue.zh: 八戒吃光了面前的所有东西

dialogue.en: Would you like more steamed buns
dialogue.ipa: wʊd ju laɪk mɔr stimd bʌnz

dialogue.en: Just put food in front of me and I eat it
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst pʊt fud ɪn frʌnt ʌv mi ænd aɪl it ɪt
dialogue.zh: 只要把食物放在我面前,我就会吃

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong shouted outside the cave
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
