titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 87 the three young women

dialogue.en: Wukong and his companions were walking through a forest
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz wɜr ˈwɔkɪŋ θru ə ˈfɔrəst
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空和同伴们正穿过一片森林

dialogue.en: I'm glad the road goes through this shady forest
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ɡlæd ðə roʊd ɡoʊz θru ðɪs ˈʃeɪdi ˈfɔrəst
dialogue.zh: 我很高兴这条路穿过这片阴凉的森林

dialogue.en: The sun is very hot this morning
dialogue.ipa: ðə sʌn ɪz ˈvɛri hɑt ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 今天早上的太阳很毒辣

dialogue.en: It's nice to walk in the shade
dialogue.ipa: ɪts naɪs tu wɔk ɪn ðə ʃeɪd
wu kɔŋ lʊkt əˈraʊnd sə ˈspɪʃəsli
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空警惕地环顾四周

dialogue.en: He knew that forests were often filled with dangers
dialogue.ipa: hi nu ðæt ˈfɔrəsts wɜr ˈɔfən fɪld wɪð ˈdeɪnʤərz
dialogue.zh: 他知道森林里常常充满危险

dialogue.en: Suddenly Bajie fell flat on his face
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli Bajie fɛl flæt ɑn hɪz feɪs
dialogue.zh: 突然,猪八戒脸朝下摔了一跤

dialogue.en: He climbed back to his feet and rubbed his nose
dialogue.ipa: hi klaɪmd bæk tu hɪz fit ænd rʌbd hɪz noʊz

dialogue.en: The traveler soon came to a wall running along the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələr sun keɪm tu ə wɔl ˈrʌnɪŋ əˈlɔŋ ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 一行人很快来到一道沿路延伸的围墙前

dialogue.en: Behind the wall they could see the roof of a house
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈhaɪnd ðə wɔl ðeɪ kʊd si ðə ruf ʌv ə haʊs
dialogue.zh: 透过围墙,他们能看到一座房子的屋顶

dialogue.en: The monkey peeked over the wall
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki pikt ˈoʊvər ðə wɔl

dialogue.en: Three young women were laughing and kicking a ball around
dialogue.ipa: θri jʌŋ ˈwɪmən wɜr ˈlæfɪŋ ænd ˈkɪkɪŋ ə bɔl əˈraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 三个年轻女子正笑着踢球玩耍

dialogue.en: Let's ask them for some food
dialogue.ipa: lɛts æsk ðɛm fɔr sʌm fud
dialogue.zh: 我们去向她们讨点食物吧

dialogue.en: The pig headed toward the gate
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ ˈhɛdɪd təˈwɔrd ðə ɡeɪt

dialogue.en: I will speak to the women
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl spik tu ðə ˈwɪmən

dialogue.zh: 你们三个可能会吓到她们
你是一头会说话的大猪

dialogue.en: Wu Jing you're big and purple
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ jʊr bɪɡ ænd ˈpɜrpəl
dialogue.zh: 悟净,你身材高大,肤色发紫

dialogue.ipa: ænd wu kɔŋ jʊr ˈskɛri səm ˈtaɪmz
dialogue.zh: 而悟空,你有时候挺吓人的

dialogue.en: The Tang monk opened the gate and went through
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈoʊpənd ðə ɡeɪt ænd wɛnt θru

dialogue.en: What can we do for you
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kæn wi du fɔr ju

dialogue.en: I'm wondering if you could spare some food for my companions and me
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf ju kʊd spɛr sʌm fud fɔr maɪ kəmˈpænjənz ænd mi
dialogue.zh: 我在想,你们能否施舍些食物给我和我的同伴们

dialogue.en: Of course we can spare some food
dialogue.ipa: ʌv kɔrs wi kæn spɛr sʌm fud
dialogue.zh: 我们当然可以施舍些食物

dialogue.en: The three young women led the Tang monk into their house
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri jʌŋ ˈwɪmən lɛd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈɪntu ðɛr haʊs
dialogue.zh: 三个年轻女子领着唐僧进了她们的屋子

dialogue.en: As soon as the monk entered
dialogue.ipa: æz sun æz ðə mʌŋk ˈɛntərd

dialogue.en: The interior of the house was dark and dreary
dialogue.ipa: ði ɪnˈtɪriər ʌv ðə haʊs wʌz dɑrk ænd ˈdrɪri

dialogue.en: Dust covered everything and cobwebs hung from the walls
dialogue.ipa: dʌst ˈkʌvərd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ænd ˈkɑˌbwɛbz hʌŋ frʌm ðə wɔlz
dialogue.zh: 到处覆盖着灰尘,墙上挂着蜘蛛网

dialogue.en: Why are you walking through our forest today
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɑr ju ˈwɔkɪŋ θru ˈaʊər ˈfɔrəst təˈdeɪ
dialogue.zh: 你今天为何要穿过我们的森林

dialogue.en: The Tang monk looked around nervously
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk lʊkt ə ˈraʊnd ˈnɜrvəsli

dialogue.en: I'm going to the western paradise to
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs tu

dialogue.en: The Tang monk took a step back
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tʊk ə stɛp bæk

dialogue.en: All three women reached behind their heads
dialogue.ipa: ɔl θri ˈwɪmən riʧt bɪ ˈhaɪnd ðɛr hɛdz
dialogue.zh: 三个女子都伸手到脑后

dialogue.en: They began to pull out long strands of spider silk
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ bɪˈɡæn tu pʊl aʊt lɔŋ strændz ʌv ˈspaɪdər sɪlk
dialogue.zh: 她们开始抽出长长的蛛丝

dialogue.en: Swiftly they moved toward the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ˈswɪftli ðeɪ muvd tə ˈwɔrd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.zh: 师父怎么这么久还没出来

dialogue.en: The monk's companions were waiting outside in the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋks kəmˈpænjənz wɜr ˈweɪtɪŋ ˈaʊtˈsaɪd ɪn ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 和尚的同伴们正在外面的路上等着

dialogue.en: The Tang monk wouldn't do that Bajie
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈwʊdənt du ðæt Bajie
dialogue.zh: 八戒,唐僧不会那样做的

dialogue.en: The two of them went to the gate
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ʌv ðɛm wɛnt tu ðə ɡeɪt

dialogue.en: The house is covered in spiderwebs
dialogue.ipa: ðə haʊs ɪz ˈkʌvərd ɪn spiderwebs
wu kɔŋ kɪkt ɪn ðə ɡeɪt

dialogue.en: And they rushed toward the house
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðeɪ rʌʃt təˈwɔrd ðə haʊs

dialogue.en: The monkey banged on the door
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki bæŋd ɑn ðə dɔr

dialogue.en: Shooting sticky webs at Wukong and BA Jie
dialogue.ipa: ˈʃutɪŋ ˈstɪki wɛbz æt wu kɔŋ ænd bi-eɪ ʤi
dialogue.zh: 向悟空和八戒喷射粘稠的蛛网。
猪八戒挥舞着他的钉耙。

dialogue.en: And soon the weapon was stuck to his head
dialogue.ipa: ænd sun ðə ˈwɛpən wʌz stʌk tu hɪz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 很快武器就粘在了他的头上。

dialogue.en: But more webs flew toward him
dialogue.ipa: bʌt mɔr wɛbz flu təˈwɔrd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 但更多的蛛网朝他飞来。

dialogue.en: And he fell to the ground
dialogue.ipa: ænd hi fɛl tu ðə ɡraʊnd

The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I wonder who lives here
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

collocations.context: Wukong and his companions were walking through a forest
I'm glad the road goes through this shady forest
Wukong looked around suspiciously
He climbed back to his feet and rubbed his nose
That's a good idea
I'll go talk to them
He looked at his companions
I will speak to the women
Of course we can spare some food
As soon as the monk entered
The Tang monk took a step back
They began to pull out long strands of spider silk
They began to pull out long strands of spider silk
I want to be there
Bajie turned to run

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 88 the priest plan

dialogue.en: Spiderwebs now covered the pig so he couldn't move at all
dialogue.ipa: Spiderwebs naʊ ˈkʌvərd ðə pɪɡ soʊ hi ˈkʊdənt muv æt ɔl
dialogue.zh: 蜘蛛网现在完全覆盖了猪八戒,他动弹不得。

dialogue.en: He swung his iron bar furiously at the young women
dialogue.ipa: hi swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ˈfjʊriəsli æt ðə jʌŋ ˈwɪmən
dialogue.zh: 他愤怒地挥舞铁棒砸向那些年轻女子。

dialogue.en: The monkey is a powerful spirit
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ɪz ə ˈpaʊərfəl ˈspɪrət
dialogue.zh: 这猴子是个厉害的精怪。

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ræn ˈɪntu ðə haʊs

dialogue.en: He saw a large form wrapped in spider webs in a corner
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ ə lɑrʤ fɔrm ræpt ɪn ˈspaɪdər wɛbz ɪn ə ˈkɔrnər
dialogue.zh: 他看到一个角落里有个被蜘蛛网包裹的巨大身形。

dialogue.en: He quickly pulled off the webs
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkwɪkli pʊld ɔf ðə wɛbz

dialogue.en: Those women were planning to eat me
dialogue.ipa: ðoʊz ˈwɪmən wɜr ˈplænɪŋ tu it mi

dialogue.zh: 那些女人现在已经走了。

dialogue.en: The pig was a real hero
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ wʌz ə riəl ˈhɪroʊ

dialogue.en: Said the Tang monk as they went outside
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk æz ðeɪ wɛnt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 唐僧一边往外走一边说

dialogue.en: Still struggling to get out of the webs
dialogue.ipa: stɪl ˈstrʌɡəlɪŋ tu ɡɛt aʊt ʌv ðə wɛbz
dialogue.zh: 还在挣扎着想要挣脱蛛网

dialogue.en: The road left the forest and headed up a mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊd lɛft ðə ˈfɔrəst ænd ˈhɛdɪd ʌp ə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 道路离开森林,延伸向一座山

dialogue.en: The travelers arrived at a taoist abbey
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz əˈraɪvd æt ə ˈdaʊɪst ˈæbi
dialogue.zh: 一行人来到了一座道观
也许我们可以在这里休息一下

dialogue.en: Come in and make yourselves at home
dialogue.ipa: kʌm ɪn ænd meɪk jʊrˈsɛlvz æt hoʊm

dialogue.en: The priest led them to a sitting area
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist lɛd ðɛm tu ə ˈsɪtɪŋ ˈɛriə
dialogue.zh: 道士领他们到休息区坐下

dialogue.en: The priest observed as everyone sat down
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist əbˈzɜrvd æz ˈɛvriˌwʌn sæt daʊn
dialogue.zh: 待众人落座后,道士观察着说道

dialogue.en: The Tang monk opened his mouth to answer
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈoʊpənd hɪz maʊθ tu ˈænsər

dialogue.en: We're on our way to visit friends
dialogue.ipa: wir ɑn ˈaʊər weɪ tu ˈvɪzət frɛndz

dialogue.en: I have plenty of food too
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv ˈplɛnti ʌv fud tu

dialogue.en: I will prepare a meal for us
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl priˈpɛr ə mil fɔr ʌs
dialogue.zh: 我来为大家准备一顿饭

dialogue.en: The priest stood up and left the room
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist stʊd ʌp ænd lɛft ðə rum
dialogue.zh: 道士站起身离开了房间

dialogue.en: Wukong why did you lie to the priest
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ waɪ dɪd ju laɪ tu ðə prist
dialogue.zh: 悟空,你为什么要对道士撒谎

dialogue.en: We shouldn't tell everyone we meet that you're the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wi ˈʃʊdənt tɛl ˈɛvriˌwʌn wi mit ðæt jʊr ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我们不该逢人就说你是唐僧

dialogue.en: You almost got eaten just this morning
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈɔlˌmoʊst ɡɑt ˈitən ʤʌst ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 今天早上您就差点被吃掉

dialogue.en: The priest was in the kitchen boiling water for tea
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist wʌz ɪn ðə ˈkɪʧən ˈbɔɪlɪŋ ˈwɔtər fɔr ti
dialogue.zh: 道士正在厨房烧水泡茶

dialogue.en: He was looking for rice when he realized he wasn't alone
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔr raɪs wɛn hi ˈriəˌlaɪzd hi ˈwɑzənt əˈloʊn
dialogue.zh: 他正找米时,意识到自己并非独自一人

dialogue.en: The three young women stood nearby
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri jʌŋ ˈwɪmən stʊd ˈnɪr ˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 三位年轻女子站在附近
而且她们看起来怒气冲冲

dialogue.en: We caught the Tang monk this morning
dialogue.ipa: wi kɑt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 我们今天早上抓到了唐僧

dialogue.en: But we had to flee our house
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wi hæd tu fli ˈaʊər haʊs
dialogue.zh: 但我们不得不逃离家园

dialogue.en: A monkey and a pig attacked us
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈmʌŋki ænd ə pɪɡ əˈtækt ʌs
dialogue.zh: 一只猴子和一头猪袭击了我们

dialogue.en: There's a monk with three companions
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz ə mʌŋk wɪð θri kəm ˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 有个和尚带着三个同伴

dialogue.en: One is a monkey and another is a pig
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ɪz ə ˈmʌŋki ænd ə ˈnʌðər ɪz ə pɪɡ
dialogue.zh: 一个是猴子,另一个是猪

dialogue.en: An evil smile flashed across the priest's face
dialogue.ipa: ən ˈivəl smaɪl flæʃt əˈkrɔs ðə prists feɪs
dialogue.zh: 道士脸上闪过一丝邪恶的笑容
这样我们都能长生不老

dialogue.en: The first woman now looked worried
dialogue.ipa: ðə fɜrst ˈwʊmən naʊ lʊkt ˈwɜrid
dialogue.zh: 第一个妇人现在面露忧色

dialogue.en: But how will we defeat the monk's companions
dialogue.ipa: bʌt haʊ wɪl wi dɪ ˈfit ðə mʌŋks kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 但我们怎么打败和尚的同伴呢

dialogue.en: The priest went to a cabinet and pulled out a small bottle
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist wɛnt tu ə ˈkæbənət ænd pʊld aʊt ə smɔl ˈbɑtəl
dialogue.zh: 道士走到柜子前,拿出一个小瓶子

dialogue.en: I'll add this poison to their tea
dialogue.ipa: aɪl æd ðɪs ˈpɔɪzən tu ðɛr ti
dialogue.zh: 我要把这毒药下到他们的茶里

dialogue.en: The priest returned to the travelers
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə ˈtrævələrz

dialogue.en: The meal will be ready soon
dialogue.ipa: ðə mil wɪl bi ˈrɛdi sun

dialogue.en: Wukong looked at the priest and suddenly felt suspicious
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt æt ðə prist ænd ˈsʌdənli fɛlt səˈspɪʃəs
dialogue.zh: 悟空看着道士,突然心生疑虑

dialogue.en: There was something evil behind the man's smile
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈivəl bɪˈhaɪnd ðə mænz smaɪl
dialogue.zh: 那人的笑容背后藏着邪恶

dialogue.en: The monkey glanced at his tea
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ɡlænst æt hɪz ti
dialogue.zh: 猴子瞥了一眼自己的茶

dialogue.en: Wu jing and ba jie were already sipping their tea
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ænd ba ʤi wɜr ɔlˈrɛdi ˈsɪpɪŋ ðɛr ti
dialogue.zh: 悟净和八戒已经在喝茶了

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Cried bajie
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Those women were planning to eat me
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: The monkey is a powerful spirit
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I will prepare a meal for us
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Maybe we can rest here
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Spiderwebs now covered the pig so he couldn't move at all
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We must leave
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: We shouldn't tell everyone we meet that you're the Tang monk
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: But we had to flee our house
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Help
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's a monk with three companions
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That would be wonderful
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: He was looking for rice when he realized he wasn't alone
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: Spiderwebs now covered the pig so he couldn't move at all
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

collocations.context: Wukong ran into the house
Thank you Wukong
Still struggling to get out of the webs
Come in and make yourselves at home
The priest observed as everyone sat down
The priest stood up and left the room
He was looking for rice when he realized he wasn't alone
But we had to flee our house
The priest went to a cabinet and pulled out a small bottle
Wukong looked at the priest and suddenly felt suspicious

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 89 many eyes

dialogue.en: Wukong gasped as his companions began to look ill
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ɡæspt æz hɪz kəmˈpænjənz bɪˈɡæn tu lʊk ɪl
dialogue.zh: 悟空倒吸一口凉气,因为同伴们开始显得不适

dialogue.en: The Tang monk's head bobbed forward
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋks hɛd bɑbd ˈfɔrwərd

dialogue.en: And his teacup dropped from his hand
dialogue.ipa: ænd hɪz ˈtiˌkʌp drɑpt frʌm hɪz hænd

dialogue.en: The monk toppled to the floor
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ˈtɑpəld tu ðə flɔr

dialogue.en: Wu Jing and BA Jie passed out too
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ænd bi-eɪ ʤi pæst aʊt tu
dialogue.zh: 吴静和八戒也昏了过去

dialogue.en: Wukong jumped to his feet and pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ʤʌmpt tu hɪz fit ænd pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr
dialogue.zh: 悟空一跃而起,抽出他的铁棒

dialogue.en: Just then a door burst open
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn ə dɔr bɜrst ˈoʊpən
dialogue.zh: 就在这时,一扇门猛地打开

dialogue.en: And the three women ran into the room
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə θri ˈwɪmən ræn ˈɪntu ðə rum

dialogue.en: He leaped out of the way as the women shot webs at him
dialogue.ipa: hi lɛpt aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ æz ðə ˈwɪmən ʃɑt wɛbz æt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 当女人们向他射出蛛网时,他跳开躲避

dialogue.en: Did a flip in the air
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ə flɪp ɪn ði ɛr

dialogue.en: And landed directly behind the women
dialogue.ipa: ænd ˈlændɪd dəˈrɛktli bɪ ˈhaɪnd ðə ˈwɪmən
dialogue.zh: 直接落在了女人们的身后

dialogue.en: Furiously he slammed his iron bar down
dialogue.ipa: ˈfjʊriəsli hi slæmd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr daʊn

dialogue.en: There was a puff of smoke
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə pʌf ʌv smoʊk

dialogue.en: A dead spider lay where one of the women had been
dialogue.ipa: ə dɛd ˈspaɪdər leɪ wɛr wʌn ʌv ðə ˈwɪmən hæd bɪn
dialogue.zh: 其中一个女人所在的地方躺着一只死蜘蛛

dialogue.en: The other two women stared in horror
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðər tu ˈwɪmən stɛrd ɪn ˈhɔrər
dialogue.zh: 另外两个女人惊恐地瞪大眼睛

dialogue.en: He knocked flying webs out of his way and then
dialogue.ipa: hi nɑkt ˈflaɪɪŋ wɛbz aʊt ʌv hɪz weɪ ænd ðɛn
dialogue.zh: 他打飞了袭来的蛛网,然后

dialogue.en: In their places lay dead spiders
dialogue.ipa: ɪn ðɛr ˈpleɪsəz leɪ dɛd ˈspaɪdərz
dialogue.zh: 她们的位置上躺着死蜘蛛

dialogue.en: Those spider spirits were my dear friends
dialogue.ipa: ðoʊz ˈspaɪdər ˈspɪrɪts wɜr maɪ dɪr frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 那些蜘蛛精是我亲爱的朋友

dialogue.en: Revealing a body covered in eyes
dialogue.ipa: rɪˈvilɪŋ ə ˈbɑdi ˈkʌvərd ɪn aɪz

dialogue.en: Suddenly blinding light shot from the many eyes
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ˈblaɪndɪŋ laɪt ʃɑt frʌm ðə ˈmɛni aɪz
dialogue.zh: 突然,许多眼睛射出刺眼的光芒

dialogue.en: He covered his own eyes and ran all over the room
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkʌvərd hɪz oʊn aɪz ænd ræn ɔl ˈoʊvər ðə rum
dialogue.zh: 他捂住自己的眼睛,在房间里四处乱跑

dialogue.en: But he couldn't escape the blinding light
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hi ˈkʊdənt ɪˈskeɪp ðə ˈblaɪndɪŋ laɪt
dialogue.zh: 但他无法逃脱那刺眼的光芒

dialogue.en: Finally he slammed his iron bar into the abbey's stone floor
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪnəli hi slæmd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ˈɪntu ði ˈæbiz stoʊn flɔr
dialogue.zh: 最后,他将铁棒砸向庵堂的石地板

dialogue.en: The monkey jumped in and turned into a mole
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ʤʌmpt ɪn ænd tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə moʊl
dialogue.zh: 猴子跳了进去,变成了一只鼹鼠

dialogue.en: He tunneled until he was sure he was far from the abbey
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈtʌnəld ənˈtɪl hi wʌz ʃʊr hi wʌz fɑr frʌm ði ˈæbi
dialogue.zh: 他一直挖掘,直到确定自己远离了庵堂

dialogue.en: When Wukong popped up out of the ground
dialogue.ipa: wɛn wu kæŋ pɑpt ʌp aʊt ʌv ðə ɡraʊnd
dialogue.zh: 当吴康从地里钻出来时

dialogue.en: Bright light was shining from the abbey
dialogue.ipa: braɪt laɪt wʌz ˈʃaɪnɪŋ frʌm ði ˈæbi

dialogue.en: The light burned the monkey's eyes
dialogue.ipa: ðə laɪt bɜrnd ðə ˈmʌŋkiz aɪz
dialogue.zh: 那光芒依然灼痛猴子的眼睛

dialogue.en: I have no way to save my friends
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv noʊ weɪ tu seɪv maɪ frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 我没办法救我的朋友们

dialogue.en: That priest's light is too powerful
dialogue.ipa: ðæt prists laɪt ɪz tu ˈpaʊərfəl

dialogue.en: He sobbed and sobbed until he heard a voice say
dialogue.ipa: hi sɑbd ænd sɑbd ənˈtɪl hi hɜrd ə vɔɪs seɪ
dialogue.zh: 他不停地抽泣,直到听见一个声音说

dialogue.en: A tall woman was standing over him
dialogue.ipa: ə tɔl ˈwʊmən wʌz ˈstændɪŋ ˈoʊvər hɪm
dialogue.zh: 一位高大的女子正站在他身旁

dialogue.en: That priest is a centipede spirit
dialogue.ipa: ðæt prist ɪz ə ˈsɛntɪˌpid ˈspɪrət

dialogue.en: Called the demon lord of many eyes
dialogue.ipa: kɔld ðə ˈdimən lɔrd ʌv ˈmɛni aɪz

dialogue.en: I am the only one who can defeat him
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ði ˈoʊnli wʌn hu kæn dɪˈfit hɪm

dialogue.en: Pralambra pulled a small needle from her sleeve
dialogue.ipa: Prombra pʊld ə smɔl ˈnidəl frʌm hɜr sliv
dialogue.zh: 普贤从袖中取出一根小针

dialogue.en: Turning she threw the needle into the beams of light
dialogue.ipa: ˈtɜrnɪŋ ʃi θru ðə ˈnidəl ˈɪntu ðə bimz ʌv laɪt

dialogue.en: The sound thundered in the sky
dialogue.ipa: ðə saʊnd ˈθʌndərd ɪn ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 空中响起雷鸣般的巨响

dialogue.en: And the beams of light vanished
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə bimz ʌv laɪt ˈvænɪʃt

dialogue.en: Wukong and pralambra returned to the abbey
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd pralambra rɪˈtɜrnd tu ði ˈæbi

dialogue.en: The priest lay shaking on the floor
dialogue.ipa: ðə prist leɪ ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ɑn ðə flɔr
dialogue.zh: 道士瘫倒在地不停颤抖

dialogue.en: All of his eyes were squeezed shut
dialogue.ipa: ɔl ʌv hɪz aɪz wɜr skwizd ʃʌt
dialogue.zh: 他所有的眼睛都紧紧闭着

dialogue.en: pralambra pointed her finger at the priest
dialogue.ipa: Prombra ˈpɔɪntɪd hɜr ˈfɪŋɡər æt ðə prist

dialogue.en: And he turned into a giant centipede
dialogue.ipa: ænd hi tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə ˈʤaɪənt ˈsɛntɪˌpid
dialogue.zh: 他顿时化作一条巨大蜈蚣

dialogue.en: Palambra took a bottle out of her sleeve
dialogue.ipa: Palambra tʊk ə ˈbɑtəl aʊt ʌv hɜr sliv
dialogue.zh: 普贤从袖中取出一个瓶子

dialogue.en: These pills will cure your companions
dialogue.ipa: ðiz pɪlz wɪl kjʊr jʊər kəm ˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 这些丹药能救你的同伴

dialogue.en: I will take the centipede with me to be punished
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə ˈsɛntɪˌpid wɪð mi tu bi ˈpʌnɪʃt
dialogue.zh: 我将带走这蜈蚣施以惩戒

dialogue.en: The journey has been easy lately
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈʤɜrni hæz bɪn ˈizi ˈleɪtli

dialogue.en: Said the Tang monk one day
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌn deɪ

dialogue.en: It's been weeks since any demons tried to eat master
dialogue.ipa: ɪts bɪn wiks sɪns ˈɛni ˈdimənz traɪd tu it ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 已有多日无妖魔想吃师父了

dialogue.en: The western paradise is still far away
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs ɪz stɪl fɑr əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: We'll face many more dangers before we get there
dialogue.ipa: wil feɪs ˈmɛni mɔr ˈdeɪnʤərz bɪˈfɔr wi ɡɛt ðɛr
dialogue.zh: 抵达之前必逢更多艰险

dialogue.en: Just then a man appeared up ahead
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn ə mæn əˈpɪrd ʌp ə ˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 恰在此时,前方出现一人

dialogue.en: He was waving his arms frantically
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ˈweɪvɪŋ hɪz ɑrmz ˈfræntəkəli

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong gasped as his companions began to look ill
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Bright light was shining from the abbey
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: A dead spider lay where one of the women had been
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I have no way to save my friends
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: The journey has been easy lately
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: You will regret destroying them
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: All of his eyes were squeezed shut
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I am the only one who can defeat him
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: But he couldn't escape the blinding light
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: It's been weeks since any demons tried to eat master
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There was a puff of smoke
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: I am the only one who can defeat him
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When it cleared
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 90 the Demon's Plan

dialogue.en: The man on the road continued to wave a warning
dialogue.ipa: ðə mæn ɑn ðə roʊd kənˈtɪnjud tu weɪv ə ˈwɔrnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 路上那人仍不停挥手示警

dialogue.en: The Tang monk fell from his horse
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk fɛl frʌm hɪz hɔrs

dialogue.en: Wu Jing rushed over to help him stand up
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ rʌʃt ˈoʊvər tu hɛlp hɪm stænd ʌp
dialogue.zh: 悟净赶忙冲过去扶他站起来

dialogue.en: I'll ask that man what sort of danger is up ahead
dialogue.ipa: aɪl æsk ðæt mæn wɑt sɔrt ʌv ˈdeɪnʤər ɪz ʌp əˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 我去问问那人前面有什么危险

dialogue.en: The monkey walked toward the man
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki wɔkt təˈwɔrd ðə mæn

dialogue.en: Wukong could tell that he was not an ordinary man
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ kʊd tɛl ðæt hi wʌz nɑt ən ˈɔrdəˌnɛri mæn
sɛd wu kɔŋ wɪð ə smaɪl

dialogue.en: The spirit of the planet Venus
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈspɪrət ʌv ðə ˈplænət ˈvinəs

dialogue.en: I came in disguise to warn you Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ keɪm ɪn dɪsˈɡaɪz tu wɔrn ju wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 我化身前来是为了警告你,悟空
前面有三个法力高强的妖怪

dialogue.en: The first is a lion demon
dialogue.ipa: ðə fɜrst ɪz ə ˈlaɪən ˈdimən

dialogue.en: The second is an elephant demon
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈsɛkənd ɪz ən ˈɛləfənt ˈdimən

dialogue.en: And the third is a raptor demon
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə θɜrd ɪz ə ˈræptər ˈdimən

dialogue.en: But I'm not worried about three silly demons
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪm nɑt ˈwɜrid ə ˈbaʊt θri ˈsɪli ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 但我可不怕三个蠢妖怪

dialogue.en: The three demons command a demon army
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri ˈdimənz kə ˈmænd ə ˈdimən ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 这三个妖怪统领着一支妖军

dialogue.en: But even an entire army of demons doesn't worry me
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ˈivɪn ən ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi ʌv ˈdimənz ˈdʌzənt ˈwɜri mi
dialogue.zh: 但就算是一整支妖军我也不怕

dialogue.ipa: ˈvɛri wɛl wu kɔŋ ɡʊd lʌk

dialogue.en: The monkey walked back to his companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki wɔkt bæk tu hɪz kəmˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: Asked the Tang monk still scared
dialogue.ipa: æskt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stɪl skɛrd
dialogue.zh: 唐僧仍心有余悸地问道

dialogue.en: How can you not be worried
dialogue.ipa: haʊ kæn ju nɑt bi ˈwɜrid

dialogue.en: I once defeated Heaven's entire army
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌns dɪˈfitɪd ˈhɛvənz ɪn ˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 我曾打败过整个天兵天将

dialogue.en: Yes we all know about that Wukong
dialogue.ipa: jɛs wi ɔl noʊ əˈbaʊt ðæt wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 是的,我们都知道那个孙悟空。

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is with us
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz wɪð ʌs

dialogue.zh: 我们必须确保他的安全。

dialogue.en: Yes and I'd like to be safe too
dialogue.ipa: jɛs ænd aɪd laɪk tu bi seɪf tu

dialogue.en: We can't let the demons harm master
dialogue.ipa: wi kænt lɛt ðə ˈdimənz hɑrm ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 我们不能让妖怪伤害师父。

dialogue.en: He gave a sideways glance at Bajie and smirked
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡeɪv ə ˈsaɪ ˌdweɪz ɡlæns æt Bajie ænd smɜrkt
dialogue.zh: 他斜眼瞥了八戒一眼,咧嘴笑了。

dialogue.en: I'll check out the mountain to see how big the demon army is
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ʧɛk aʊt ðə ˈmaʊntən tu si haʊ bɪɡ ðə ˈdimən ˈɑrmi ɪz
dialogue.zh: 我去山上探探,看看妖怪的军队有多大。

dialogue.en: The monkey flew to the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki flu tu ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Several demons were talking in front of a cave
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɛvrəl ˈdimənz wɜr ˈtɔkɪŋ ɪn frʌnt ʌv ə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 几个妖怪正在一个山洞前交谈。

dialogue.en: They were dressed like military officers
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɜr drɛst laɪk ˈmɪlə ˌtɛri ˈɔfəsərz

dialogue.en: Wukong spied on them from behind a rock
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ spaɪd ɑn ðɛm frʌm bɪˈhaɪnd ə rɑk
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空躲在岩石后面窥视他们。

dialogue.en: The Tang monk will be coming over our mountain soon
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɪl bi ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈoʊvər ˈaʊər ˈmaʊntən sun
dialogue.zh: 唐僧很快就会经过我们的山。

dialogue.en: Our leaders want all the troops to watch for him
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər ˈlidərz wɑnt ɔl ðə trups tu wɑʧ fɔr hɪm
dialogue.zh: 我们的首领命令所有部队都留意他。

dialogue.en: I hope we catch the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp wi kæʧ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我希望我们能抓住唐僧。

dialogue.en: I've heard that anyone who eats him will live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪv hɜrd ðæt ˈɛniˌwʌn hu its hɪm wɪl lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 我听说吃了他的肉就能长生不老。

dialogue.en: How dare they plan to eat master
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɛr ðeɪ plæn tu it ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 他们竟敢计划吃掉师父。

dialogue.en: But who will get to eat the monk
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hu wɪl ɡɛt tu it ðə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 但谁能吃到那个和尚呢?

dialogue.en: There are thousands of troops in our army
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ɑr ˈθaʊzəndz ʌv trups ɪn ˈaʊər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 我们的军队有成千上万的士兵。

dialogue.en: We'll all get to eat him
dialogue.ipa: wil ɔl ɡɛt tu it hɪm

dialogue.en: Our leaders promised to share him with the entire army
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər ˈlidərz ˈprɑməst tu ʃɛr hɪm wɪð ði ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 我们的首领承诺会和全军分享他。

dialogue.en: The other officers nodded and smiled
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðər ˈɔfəsərz ˈnɑdɪd ænd smaɪld

dialogue.en: That was very kind of our leaders
dialogue.ipa: ðæt wʌz ˈvɛri kaɪnd ʌv ˈaʊər ˈlidərz

dialogue.en: The monk is just a man
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ɪz ʤʌst ə mæn

dialogue.en: I've heard that the Tang monk isn't alone
dialogue.ipa: aɪv hɜrd ðæt ðə tæɡ mʌŋk ˈɪzənt əˈloʊn
dialogue.zh: 我听说唐僧不是一个人。

dialogue.ipa: sʌn wu kɔŋ ɪz wɪð hɪm

dialogue.en: He's the spirit who defeated Heaven's entire army
dialogue.ipa: hiz ðə ˈspɪrət hu dɪˈfitɪd ˈhɛvənz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 他就是那个打败了天宫全军的神灵。

dialogue.en: Wukong beamed proudly when he heard that
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ bimd ˈpraʊdli wɛn hi hɜrd ðæt
dialogue.zh: 悟空听了这话,得意地笑了起来

dialogue.ipa: doʊnt ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt sʌn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: Just tell the troops to watch for the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst tɛl ðə trups tu wɑʧ fɔr ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 只要告诉部队留意唐僧就行

dialogue.en: The monkey made himself look like a demon general
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki meɪd hɪmˈsɛlf lʊk laɪk ə ˈdimən ˈʤɛnərəl
dialogue.zh: 猴子把自己变成了一个妖怪将军的模样

dialogue.en: Then he stepped out from behind the rock and hurried over to the officers
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi stɛpt aʊt frʌm bɪˈhaɪnd ðə rɑk ænd ˈhɜrid ˈoʊvər tu ði ˈɔfəsərz
dialogue.zh: 然后他从岩石后面走出来,匆匆走向那些军官

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is heading toward our mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz ˈhɛdɪŋ təˈwɔrd ˈaʊər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 唐僧正朝我们山这边来

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词

The door was locked from inside.

Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形

examples: We should follow the river.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句

When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序

The king asked where the demon lived.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 91 the Demon Officers

dialogue.en: The demon general looked at Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ˈʤɛnərəl lʊkt æt Wukong

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is heading toward our mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz ˈhɛdɪŋ təˈwɔrd ˈaʊər ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 唐僧正朝我们山这边来

dialogue.en: Unfortunately there's also some bad news
dialogue.ipa: ənˈfɔrʧənətli ðɛrz ˈɔlsoʊ sʌm bæd nuz
wu kɔŋ priˈtɛndɪd tu lʊk ˈwɜrid
dialogue.zh: 悟空假装露出担忧的神色

dialogue.en: The Tang monk has three companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk hæz θri kəm ˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: One is a big purple fellow
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ɪz ə bɪɡ ˈpɜrpəl ˈfɛloʊ
dialogue.zh: 一个是个紫色的大个子

dialogue.en: Another is a pig who appears to be quite lazy
dialogue.ipa: əˈnʌðər ɪz ə pɪɡ hu əˈpɪrz tu bi kwaɪt ˈleɪzi
dialogue.zh: 另一个是头猪,看起来相当懒

dialogue.en: The general narrowed his eyes at Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈʤɛnərəl ˈnɛroʊd hɪz aɪz æt wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 将军眯起眼睛看着悟空

dialogue.en: The third companion is a monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðə θɜrd kəmˈpænjən ɪz ə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: I believe he is Sun Wukong
dialogue.ipa: aɪ bɪˈliv hi ɪz sʌn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: I was afraid that monkey was traveling with the monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ə ˈfreɪd ðæt ˈmʌŋki wʌz ˈtrævəlɪŋ wɪð ðə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我就怕那只猴子跟着和尚一起

dialogue.en: What does Sun Wukong look like
dialogue.ipa: wɑt dʌz sʌn Wukong lʊk laɪk

dialogue.en: He has fiery red eyes and sharp fangs
dialogue.ipa: hi hæz ˈfaɪəri rɛd aɪz ænd ʃɑrp fæŋz
dialogue.zh: 他有火红的眼睛和锋利的獠牙

dialogue.en: There's no need to worry about some silly monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz noʊ nid tu ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt sʌm ˈsɪli ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 没必要担心什么傻猴子

dialogue.en: I don't care what he did five humdred years ago
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt kɛr wɑt hi dɪd faɪv humdred jɪrz əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 我才不管他五百年前干了什么
我们有一支强大的军队
我听到那只猴子在说话

dialogue.en: He said he hopes there's an entire demon army on this mountain
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd hi hoʊps ðɛrz ən ɪnˈtaɪər ˈdimən ˈɑrmi ɑn ðɪs ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 他说他希望这座山上有一整支妖怪军队

dialogue.en: He said destroying demons is good exercise
dialogue.ipa: hi sɛd dɪˈstrɔɪɪŋ ˈdimənz ɪz ɡʊd ˈɛksərˌsaɪz
dialogue.zh: 他说消灭妖怪是很好的锻炼

dialogue.en: He has a magic iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi hæz ə ˈmæʤɪk ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: He can make it big enough to crush our entire army with one strike
dialogue.ipa: hi kæn meɪk ɪt bɪɡ ɪˈnʌf tu krʌʃ ˈaʊər ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi wɪð wʌn straɪk
dialogue.zh: 他能把它变得足够大,一击就能摧毁我们整支军队

dialogue.en: But he doesn't plan to do that
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hi ˈdʌzənt plæn tu du ðæt

dialogue.en: What does he plan to do
dialogue.ipa: wɑt dʌz hi plæn tu du

dialogue.en: He pledged to crush one demon at a time
dialogue.ipa: hi plɛʤd tu krʌʃ wʌn ˈdimən æt ə taɪm
dialogue.zh: 他发誓要一次消灭一个妖怪

dialogue.en: That way he'll get more exercise
dialogue.ipa: ðæt weɪ hil ɡɛt mɔr ˈɛksərˌsaɪz
dialogue.zh: 那样他就能得到更多锻炼
妖怪们的脸色变得苍白

dialogue.en: The other demons nodded in agreement
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈʌðər ˈdimənz ˈnɑdɪd ɪn əˈɡrimənt
dialogue.zh: 其他妖怪纷纷点头表示同意

dialogue.en: You can all stick around if you want to
dialogue.ipa: ju kæn ɔl stɪk əˈraʊnd ɪf ju wɑnt tu
dialogue.zh: 如果你们愿意,都可以留下来
一个队长露出惊讶的表情

dialogue.en: What about eating the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wɑt əˈbaʊt ˈitɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Don't you want to live forever
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt ju wɑnt tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: I heard our three leaders talking privately
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hɜrd ˈaʊər θri ˈlidərz ˈtɔkɪŋ ˈpraɪvətli
dialogue.zh: 我听到我们三位首领私下交谈

dialogue.en: They don't plan to share the Tang monk with us
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ doʊnt plæn tu ʃɛr ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɪð ʌs
dialogue.zh: 他们不打算和我们分享唐僧

dialogue.en: They're going to eat him themselves
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu it hɪm ðɛm ˈsɛlvz

dialogue.en: If our leaders won't share the Tang monk with us
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ˈaʊər ˈlidərz woʊnt ʃɛr ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɪð ʌs
dialogue.zh: 如果我们的首领不和我们分享唐僧

dialogue.en: Let's gather the troops and leave this place
dialogue.ipa: lɛts ˈɡæðər ðə trups ænd liv ðɪs pleɪs
dialogue.zh: 我们集合部队离开这里

dialogue.en: Soon Wukong could see the demon army marching away in the valley below
dialogue.ipa: sun wu kɔŋ kʊd si ðə ˈdimən ˈɑrmi ˈmɑrʧɪŋ əˈweɪ ɪn ðə ˈvæli bɪˈloʊ
dialogue.zh: 很快,悟空就看到妖怪军队在山谷下撤离

dialogue.en: I got rid of the army
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɑt rɪd ʌv ði ˈɑrmi

dialogue.en: Now I'll deal with the three demon leaders
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪl dil wɪð ðə θri ˈdimən ˈlidərz
dialogue.zh: 现在我要对付那三个妖怪首领

dialogue.en: He came to a large room
dialogue.ipa: hi keɪm tu ə lɑrʤ rum

dialogue.zh: 三个巨大的妖怪 —— 一头狮子

dialogue.en: And a raptor sat on thrones
dialogue.ipa: ænd ə ˈræptər sæt ɑn θroʊnz
dialogue.zh: 和一只猛禽坐在宝座上

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is heading toward the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz ˈhɛdɪŋ təˈwɔrd ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: Tell the troops to capture him
dialogue.ipa: tɛl ðə trups tu ˈkæpʧər hɪm

dialogue.en: The Tang monk is traveling with Sun Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪz ˈtrævəlɪŋ wɪð sʌn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: The troops were afraid of the monkey
dialogue.ipa: ðə trups wɜr əˈfreɪd ʌv ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: So it's true that Sun Wukong is with the monk
dialogue.ipa: soʊ ɪts tru ðæt sʌn wu kɔŋ ɪz wɪð ðə mʌk
dialogue.zh: 看来孙悟空真的和那和尚在一起

dialogue.en: We should leave the Tang monk alone
dialogue.ipa: wi ʃʊd liv ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ə ˈloʊn

dialogue.en: We don't need an army to fight a monkey
dialogue.ipa: wi doʊnt nid ən ˈɑrmi tu faɪt ə ˈmʌŋki
dialogue.zh: 对付一只猴子,我们不需要动用军队

dialogue.en: We'll capture the Tang monk ourselves
dialogue.ipa: wil ˈkæpʧər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk aʊərˈsɛlvz

dialogue.en: Sun Wukong defeated Heaven's entire army
dialogue.ipa: sʌn wu kɔŋ dɪˈfitɪd ˈhɛvənz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空曾打败过整个天兵天将

dialogue.en: I'll shout at anyone I want to
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ʃaʊt æt ˈɛniˌwʌn aɪ wɑnt tu

dialogue.zh: 很快他就笑得前仰后合

dialogue.en: The demons stopped arguing and stared at him
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimənz stɑpt ˈɑrɡjuɪŋ ænd stɛrd æt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 妖怪们停止争吵,盯着他看

dialogue.en: The monkey looked down and saw that his disguise was gone
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lʊkt daʊn ænd sɔ ðæt hɪz dɪsˈɡaɪz wʌz ɡɔn
dialogue.zh: 猴子低头一看,发现自己的伪装消失了

Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: Don't you want to live forever
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's gather the troops and leave this place
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Tell the troops to capture him
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: Unfortunately there's also some bad news
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who was still in disguise
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: You can all stick around if you want to
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So it's true that Sun Wukong is with the monk
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: be + 形容词 + enough + to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示“足够……可以做某事”；enough 放在形容词后面。
grammar.source: He can make it big enough to crush our entire army with one strike
examples: Wukong is strong enough to lift the rock.
The rope is long enough to reach the ground.
She is brave enough to enter the cave.
The water is shallow enough to cross.
Bajie is tall enough to reach the branch.
The room is large enough to hold everyone.
He is old enough to travel alone.
The light is bright enough to guide us.
They are careful enough to climb safely.
Are you ready enough to begin?

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 92 The Lion Demon

dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛləfənt ˈpɔɪntɪd æt wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: Wukong shot out of the cave as fast as he could
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ʃɑt aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv æz fæst æz hi kʊd
dialogue.zh: 悟空以最快速度冲出山洞

dialogue.en: He didn't stop running until he was far from the cave
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈdɪdənt stɑp ˈrʌnɪŋ ənˈtɪl hi wʌz fɑr frʌm ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 直到远离山洞,他才停下脚步

dialogue.en: I guess when I laughed I broke my concentration
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɛs wɛn aɪ læft aɪ broʊk maɪ ˌkɑnsənˈtreɪʃən
dialogue.zh: 我想是我笑的时候分了神

dialogue.en: That must have made my disguise vanish
dialogue.ipa: ðæt mʌst hæv meɪd maɪ dɪsˈɡaɪz ˈvænɪʃ
dialogue.zh: 这肯定让我的伪装消失了

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: Is there an army up ahead
dialogue.ipa: ɪz ðɛr ən ˈɑrmi ʌp əˈhɛd

dialogue.en: I scared away the entire army
dialogue.ipa: aɪ skɛrd əˈweɪ ði ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 我把整个军队都吓跑了

dialogue.en: But there are still three powerful demons on the mountain
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðɛr ɑr stɪl θri ˈpaʊərfəl ˈdimənz ɑn ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 但山上还有三个厉害的妖怪

dialogue.en: They plan to capture master and
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ plæn tu ˈkæpʧər ˈmæstər ænd

dialogue.en: We won't let those demons harm you
dialogue.ipa: wi woʊnt lɛt ðoʊz ˈdimənz hɑrm ju
dialogue.zh: 我们不会让那些妖怪伤害您的

dialogue.en: But we do have to destroy them before we cross the mountain
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wi du hæv tu dɪˈstrɔɪ ðɛm bɪˈfɔr wi krɔs ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 但翻山之前,我们确实得除掉他们

dialogue.en: It's good that we discovered their plan before we went up the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ɡʊd ðæt wi dɪˈskʌvərd ðɛr plæn bɪˈfɔr wi wɛnt ʌp ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 幸好上山前我们发现了他们的计划

dialogue.en: Wukong turned to BA Jie and Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ tɜrnd tu bi-eɪ ʤi ænd wu ʤɪŋ

dialogue.en: Someone needs to help me get rid of the demons
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌmˌwʌn nidz tu hɛlp mi ɡɛt rɪd ʌv ðə ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 得有人帮我除掉这些妖怪

dialogue.en: I'll stay here and look after the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪl steɪ hir ænd lʊk ˈæftər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Wukong and BA Jie went to the cave entrance
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd bi-eɪ ʤi wɛnt tu ðə keɪv ˈɛntrəns

dialogue.en: The monkey pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: What are you going to say
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɑr ju ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu seɪ

dialogue.en: I'll just ask them nicely to leave
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ʤʌst æsk ðɛm ˈnaɪsli tu liv
dialogue.zh: 我就客气地请他们离开

dialogue.en: He turned to the cave entrance
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd tu ðə keɪv ˈɛntrəns

dialogue.en: Or we'll knock it down and crush all three of you
dialogue.ipa: ɔr wil nɑk ɪt daʊn ænd krʌʃ ɔl θri ʌv ju
dialogue.zh: 否则我们就推倒山,把你们三个都压扁

dialogue.en: For a moment everything was quiet
dialogue.ipa: fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ wʌz ˈkwaɪət

dialogue.en: Then the lion stepped out of the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ðə ˈlaɪən stɛpt aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 接着狮子从洞里走了出来

dialogue.en: He towered over the monkey and the pig
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈtaʊərd ˈoʊvər ðə ˈmʌŋki ænd ðə pɪɡ
dialogue.zh: 他居高临下地俯视着猴子和猪

dialogue.en: Why are you out here yelling
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɑr ju aʊt hir ˈjɛlɪŋ

dialogue.en: And the raptor must leave this mountain at once
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈræptər mʌst liv ðɪs ˈmaʊntən æt wʌns
dialogue.zh: 还有大鹏必须马上离开这座山

dialogue.en: I know you're planning to capture and eat the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ jʊr ˈplænɪŋ tu ˈkæpʧər ænd it ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我知道你们计划抓唐僧来吃

dialogue.en: We haven't touched the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wi ˈhævənt tʌʧt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: You scared away our entire army
dialogue.ipa: ju skɛrd əˈweɪ ˈaʊər ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 你吓跑了我们整支军队

dialogue.en: He raised his iron bar and charged toward the lion
dialogue.ipa: hi reɪzd hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr ænd ʧɑrʤd təˈwɔrd ðə ˈlaɪən

dialogue.en: The lion opened his mouth wide
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈlaɪən ˈoʊpənd hɪz maʊθ waɪd

dialogue.zh: 露出巨大而锋利的獠牙

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.zh: 狮子猛扑过来,一口吞下

dialogue.en: Bajie's face went white with horror
dialogue.ipa: Bajie's feɪs wɛnt waɪt wɪð ˈhɔrər
ðæt ˈlaɪən ʤʌst ˈswɑloʊd wu Koang
dialogue.zh: 那狮子把悟空吞下去了

dialogue.en: The pig ran as fast as he could
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ ræn æz fæst æz hi kʊd

dialogue.en: He didn't stop running until he reached Wu Jing and the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈdɪdənt stɑp ˈrʌnɪŋ ənˈtɪl hi riʧt wu ʤɪŋ ænd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 他一直跑到悟净和唐僧面前才停下

dialogue.en: We should all just go home
dialogue.ipa: wi ʃʊd ɔl ʤʌst ɡoʊ hoʊm

dialogue.en: Meanwhile the lion went back into the cave
dialogue.ipa: ˈminˌwaɪl ðə ˈlaɪən wɛnt bæk ˈɪntu ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 与此同时,狮子回到了洞里

dialogue.en: His chest was puffed out and he wore a big smile
dialogue.ipa: hɪz ʧɛst wʌz pʌft aʊt ænd hi wɔr ə bɪɡ smaɪl
dialogue.zh: 他挺着胸膛,脸上挂着大大的笑容

dialogue.en: Did you scare away Sun Wukong
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju skɛr əˈweɪ sʌn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.zh: 狮子拍了拍自己的肚子

dialogue.en: He's probably still alive inside you
dialogue.ipa: hiz ˈprɑbəbli stɪl əˈlaɪv ɪnˈsaɪd ju
dialogue.zh: 他可能还在你肚子里活着

dialogue.en: It's nice and warm in here
dialogue.ipa: ɪts naɪs ænd wɔrm ɪn hir

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 93 a problem for the lion demon

dialogue.en: The elephant and the raptor stared at the lion
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛləfənt ænd ðə ˈræptər stɛrd æt ðə ˈlaɪən

dialogue.en: Sun wukong is alive inside you
dialogue.ipa: sʌn wukong ɪz əˈlaɪv ɪnˈsaɪd ju
dialogue.zh: 孙悟空就在你体内活着

dialogue.en: The lion sat down on his throne
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈlaɪən sæt daʊn ɑn hɪz θroʊn

dialogue.en: The monkey is talking inside you
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ɪz ˈtɔkɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd ju
dialogue.zh: 那猴子正在你肚子里说话

dialogue.en: It doesn't bother me at all
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ˈdʌzənt ˈbɑðər mi æt ɔl

dialogue.en: Who wants to hear a story
dialogue.ipa: hu wɑnts tu hir ə ˈstɔri

dialogue.en: The elephant shook his head slowly
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛləfənt ʃʊk hɪz hɛd ˈsloʊli

dialogue.en: What if the monkey never stops talking
dialogue.ipa: wɑt ɪf ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈnɛvər stɑps ˈtɔkɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 要是那猴子说个没完怎么办

dialogue.en: But I just turn one of my hairs into a stove
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪl ʤʌst tɜrn wʌn ʌv maɪ hɛrz ˈɪntu ə stoʊv
dialogue.zh: 我只需拔根毫毛变个炉灶

dialogue.en: I'll cook a nice meal in here
dialogue.ipa: aɪl kʊk ə naɪs mil ɪn hir

dialogue.en: If that monkey fires up a stove
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ðæt ˈmʌŋki ˈfaɪərz ʌp ə stoʊv

dialogue.en: It will make you very hot
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wɪl meɪk ju ˈvɛri hɑt

dialogue.en: Plus it will create lots of smoke
dialogue.ipa: plʌs ɪt wɪl kriˈeɪt lɑts ʌv smoʊk

dialogue.en: The smoke will fill your head
dialogue.ipa: ðə smoʊk wɪl fɪl jʊər hɛd

dialogue.en: At last the lion was starting to look nervous
dialogue.ipa: æt læst ðə ˈlaɪən wʌz ˈstɑrtɪŋ tu lʊk ˈnɜrvəs
dialogue.zh: 狮子终于开始显得紧张了

dialogue.ipa: aɪd ˈbɛtər kɑf aʊt wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 我最好把孙悟空咳出来

dialogue.en: The lion went to the middle of the room
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈlaɪən wɛnt tu ðə ˈmɪdəl ʌv ðə rum

dialogue.en: But still Wukong stayed inside him
dialogue.ipa: bʌt stɪl wu kɔŋ steɪd ɪnˈsaɪd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 但悟空仍待在他肚子里

dialogue.en: I'm going to practice my fighting skills
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ˈpræktəs maɪ ˈfaɪtɪŋ skɪlz

dialogue.en: Wukong punched and kicked inside the lion
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pʌnʧt ænd kɪkt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈlaɪən
dialogue.zh: 悟空在狮子肚子里拳打脚踢

dialogue.en: The lion fell to his knees
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈlaɪən fɛl tu hɪz niz

dialogue.en: I'll come out if you promise to let us cross the mountain safely
dialogue.ipa: aɪl kʌm aʊt ɪf ju ˈprɑməs tu lɛt ʌs krɔs ðə ˈmaʊntən ˈseɪfli
dialogue.zh: 只要你保证让我们安全过山,我就出来

dialogue.en: The lion looked up at the raptor and the elephant
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈlaɪən lʊkt ʌp æt ðə ˈræptər ænd ði ˈɛləfənt
dialogue.zh: 狮子抬头看向大鹏和大象

dialogue.en: Wukong started the climb up the lion's throat
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ˈstɑrtɪd ðə klaɪm ʌp ðə ˈlaɪənz θroʊt
dialogue.zh: 悟空开始顺着狮子的喉咙往上爬

dialogue.en: Just as he reached the lion's mouth
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst æz hi riʧt ðə ˈlaɪənz maʊθ
dialogue.zh: 就在他快到狮子嘴边时

dialogue.en: When Wukong tries to come out of your mouth
dialogue.ipa: wɛn wu kɔŋ traɪz tu kʌm aʊt ʌv jʊər maʊθ
dialogue.zh: 等悟空要从你嘴里出来时

dialogue.en: Chomp him quickly before he can fight back
dialogue.ipa: ʧɑmp hɪm ˈkwɪkli bɪ ˈfɔr hi kæn faɪt bæk

dialogue.en: Don't they realize I can hear them
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt ðeɪ ˈriəˌlaɪz aɪ kæn hir ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 难道不知道我能听见吗

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: Wukong heard the three demons snickering
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ hɜrd ðə θri ˈdimənz ˈsnɪkərɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 悟空听到三个妖怪在偷笑

dialogue.en: He held out the iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi hɛld aʊt ði ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: The lion bit down hard on the bar
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈlaɪən bɪt daʊn hɑrd ɑn ðə bɑr

dialogue.en: A tooth shattered into tiny pieces
dialogue.ipa: ə tuθ ˈʃætərd ˈɪntu ˈtaɪni ˈpisəz

dialogue.zh: 泪水顺着他的脸颊流下

dialogue.en: He rolled around on the floor holding his paws over his mouth
dialogue.ipa: hi roʊld əˈraʊnd ɑn ðə flɔr ˈhoʊldɪŋ hɪz pɔz ˈoʊvər hɪz maʊθ
dialogue.zh: 他在地上打滚,用爪子捂着嘴
我听到你们在窃窃私语

dialogue.en: I won't try to bite you again
dialogue.ipa: aɪ woʊnt traɪ tu baɪt ju əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: You'd better not try any more tricks
dialogue.ipa: jud ˈbɛtər nɑt traɪ ˈɛni mɔr trɪks

dialogue.en: Wukong popped out of the lion's nose
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pɑpt aʊt ʌv ðə ˈlaɪənz noʊz
dialogue.zh: 悟空从狮子的鼻子里跳了出来

dialogue.en: He glared at the demons for a moment
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡlɛrd æt ðə ˈdimənz fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt

dialogue.en: And then walked out of the cave
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn wɔkt aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: As soon as the monkey was gone
dialogue.ipa: æz sun æz ðə ˈmʌŋki wʌz ɡɔn

dialogue.en: The elephant turned to the other two demons
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛləfənt tɜrnd tu ði ˈʌðər tu ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 大象转向另外两个妖怪

dialogue.en: I have a new plan for capturing the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv ə nu plæn fɔr ˈkæpʧərɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我有一个捉拿唐僧的新计划

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said the raptor
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: At last the lion was starting to look nervous
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Sun wukong is alive inside you
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: The monkey is talking inside you
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: You'll never get any sleep
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Chomp him quickly before he can fight back
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: Who wants to hear a story
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: When Wukong tries to come out of your mouth
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's make a deal
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who wants to hear a story
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: What if the monkey never stops talking
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When Wukong tries to come out of your mouth
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I know what to do
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: As soon as the monkey was gone
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 94 The Elephant Demon

dialogue.en: The lion demon rubbed his aching mouth
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈlaɪən ˈdimən rʌbd hɪz ˈeɪkɪŋ maʊθ
dialogue.zh: 狮子精揉着疼痛的嘴巴

dialogue.en: Let's leave the Tang monk alone
dialogue.ipa: lɛts liv ðə tæŋ mʌŋk əˈloʊn

dialogue.en: The elephant demon waved his hand
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛləfənt ˈdimən weɪvd hɪz hænd

dialogue.en: I'm not afraid of that silly monkey
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt əˈfreɪd ʌv ðæt ˈsɪli ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: I have a perfect plan to defeat him and capture the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv ə ˈpɜrˌfɪkt plæn tu dɪˈfit hɪm ænd ˈkæpʧər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我有一个完美的计划,可以打败他并捉住唐僧

dialogue.en: The last time you had a plan
dialogue.ipa: ðə læst taɪm ju hæd ə plæn

dialogue.en: I wound up with a broken tooth
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wund ʌp wɪð ə ˈbroʊkən tuθ
wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: He heard BA Jie and Wu Jing arguing
dialogue.ipa: hi hɜrd bi-eɪ ʤi ænd wu ʤɪŋ ˈɑrɡjuɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 他听到八戒和悟净在争吵
我们正在进行重要的旅程

dialogue.en: But Wukong got eaten by the lion demon
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wu kɔŋ ɡɑt ˈitən baɪ ðə ˈlaɪən ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 但悟空被狮子精吃掉了

dialogue.en: We'll never get to the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wil ˈnɛvər ɡɛt tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs

dialogue.en: I beat up that lion's insides and broke one of his teeth
dialogue.ipa: aɪ bit ʌp ðæt ˈlaɪənz ɪnˈsaɪdz ænd broʊk wʌn ʌv hɪz tiθ
dialogue.zh: 我把那狮子的内脏打了个稀烂,还打掉了他一颗牙

dialogue.en: The demons are scared of me now
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimənz ɑr skɛrd ʌv mi naʊ
dialogue.zh: 那些妖怪现在都怕我了

dialogue.en: They promised to let us cross their mountain safely
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈprɑməst tu lɛt ʌs krɔs ðɛr ˈmaʊntən ˈseɪfli
dialogue.zh: 他们答应让我们安全过山

dialogue.en: Wujing helped the monk climb onto the horse
dialogue.ipa: Wujng hɛlpt ðə mʌŋk klaɪm ˈɑntu ðə hɔrs

dialogue.en: They hadn't gone far when they saw a large figure ahead
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈhædənt ɡɔn fɑr wɛn ðeɪ sɔ ə lɑrʤ ˈfɪɡjər əˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 他们没走多远,就看到前方有个巨大的身影

dialogue.ipa: sɛd wu kɔŋ wɪð ə fraʊn
wu kɔŋ tɜrnd tu bi-eɪ ʤi

dialogue.en: I've been dealing with these demons all day
dialogue.ipa: aɪv bɪn ˈdilɪŋ wɪð ðiz ˈdimənz ɔl deɪ
dialogue.zh: 我跟这些妖怪打了一整天了

dialogue.en: It's your turn to fight them
dialogue.ipa: ɪts jʊər tɜrn tu faɪt ðɛm

dialogue.en: The pig charged toward the elephant
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ ʧɑrʤd təˈwɔrd ði ˈɛləfənt

dialogue.en: Bajie jumped out of the way
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ʤʌmpt aʊt ʌv ðə weɪ

dialogue.en: The elephant jerked his head and his trunk shot out
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛləfənt ʤɜrkt hɪz hɛd ænd hɪz trʌŋk ʃɑt aʊt
dialogue.zh: 大象猛地一甩头,鼻子伸了出来

dialogue.en: Before BA Jie could duck the trunk wrapped tightly around his body
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈfɔr bi-eɪ ʤi kʊd dʌk ðə trʌŋk ræpt ˈtaɪtli əˈraʊnd hɪz ˈbɑdi
dialogue.zh: 八戒还没来得及躲闪,鼻子就紧紧缠住了他的身体

dialogue.en: As the elephant ran off with Bajie
dialogue.ipa: æz ði ˈɛləfənt ræn ɔf wɪð Bajie

dialogue.en: The monkey turned to his companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki tɜrnd tu hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz

dialogue.en: Wukong returned to the Demon's Cave and turned into a fly
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə ˈdimənz keɪv ænd tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə flaɪ
dialogue.zh: 悟空回到妖怪洞,变成了一只苍蝇

dialogue.en: He found BA Jie deep inside the cave
dialogue.ipa: hi faʊnd bi-eɪ ʤi dip ɪnˈsaɪd ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 他在洞穴深处找到了八戒

dialogue.en: Floating in a tub of salt water
dialogue.ipa: ˈfloʊtɪŋ ɪn ə tʌb ʌv sɔlt ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: Wukong changed back into himself and untied his companion
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ʧeɪnʤd bæk ˈɪntu hɪmˈsɛlf ænd ənˈtaɪd hɪz kəmˈpænjən
dialogue.zh: 悟空变回原形,解开了同伴的束缚

dialogue.en: Those demons were planning to pickle me
dialogue.ipa: ðoʊz ˈdimənz wɜr ˈplænɪŋ tu ˈpɪkəl mi
dialogue.zh: 那些妖怪打算把我腌了

dialogue.en: The elephant's trunk wrapped tightly around Wukong's chest
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛləfənts trʌŋk ræpt ˈtaɪtli əˈraʊnd wu kɔŋz ʧɛst
dialogue.zh: 大象的鼻子紧紧缠住了悟空的胸口

dialogue.en: Then the elephant stepped out of a dark corner
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ði ˈɛləfənt stɛpt aʊt ʌv ə dɑrk ˈkɔrnər
dialogue.zh: 接着大象从黑暗的角落走了出来

dialogue.en: I knew you'd come to save your friend
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nu jud kʌm tu seɪv jʊər frɛnd
dialogue.zh: 我就知道你会来救你的朋友

dialogue.en: Now you can't protect the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: naʊ ju kænt prəˈtɛkt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 现在你没法保护唐僧了

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋz ɑrmz wɜr stɪl fri

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: He slammed it down on the elephant's trunk
dialogue.ipa: hi slæmd ɪt daʊn ɑn ði ˈɛləfənts trʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 他猛地砸向大象的鼻子

dialogue.en: He released Wukong and fell backward
dialogue.ipa: hi riˈlist wu kɔŋ ænd fɛl ˈbækwərd

dialogue.en: His trunk had a horrible purple bruise
dialogue.ipa: hɪz trʌŋk hæd ə ˈhɔrəbəl ˈpɜrpəl bruz
dialogue.zh: 他的鼻子上有一块可怕的紫色瘀伤

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ muvd təˈwɔrd ði ˈɛləfənt

dialogue.en: We'll let the Tang monk cross the mountain
dialogue.ipa: wil lɛt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk krɔs ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: The monkey glared at the elephant for a moment
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ɡlɛrd æt ði ˈɛləfənt fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt

dialogue.en: Then he put the iron bar away
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi pʊt ði ˈaɪərn bɑr əˈweɪ

dialogue.en: You'd better not trick us again
dialogue.ipa: jud ˈbɛtər nɑt trɪk ʌs əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: Wukong and Bajie left the cave and returned to their companions
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd Bajie lɛft ðə keɪv ænd rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðɛr kəm ˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空和八戒离开山洞,回到了同伴身边

dialogue.en: The group continued over the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup kənˈtɪnjud ˈoʊvər ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: As the travelers came around a bend
dialogue.ipa: æz ðə ˈtrævələrz keɪm ə ˈraʊnd ə bɛnd
dialogue.zh: 当旅人们转过一个弯时

dialogue.en: They saw the lion and the elephant
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ sɔ ðə ˈlaɪən ænd ði ˈɛləfənt
dialogue.zh: 他们看见了狮子和那头大象

dialogue.en: The two demons were blocking the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ˈdimənz wɜr ˈblɑkɪŋ ðə roʊd

dialogue.zh: 悟空跺着脚朝他们走去

dialogue.en: The raptor had grabbed the monkey's companions with its talons
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈræptər hæd ɡræbd ðə ˈmʌŋkiz kəmˈpænjənz wɪð ɪts ˈtælənz
dialogue.zh: 那只猛禽用爪子抓住了猴子的同伴们

dialogue.en: With a powerful flap of its wings
dialogue.ipa: wɪð ə ˈpaʊərfəl flæp ʌv ɪts wɪŋz

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他

The demon ran into the cave.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Those demons were planning to pickle me
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.

The children were playing by the river.

Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。

examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Wukong is dangerous
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形

examples: Wukong will protect the monk.

I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 95 the raptor demon

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and Wujing were tied up inside the demon's cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd Wujing wɜr taɪd ʌp ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈdimənz keɪv
dialogue.zh: 唐僧和悟净被绑在妖怪的山洞里

dialogue.en: Floating in the tub of salt water again
dialogue.ipa: ˈfloʊtɪŋ ɪn ðə tʌb ʌv sɔlt ˈwɔtər əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: The three demons talked in another room
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri ˈdimənz tɔkt ɪn ə ˈnʌðər rum
dialogue.zh: 三个妖怪在另一个房间里交谈

dialogue.en: That pig will taste wonderful once he's pickled
dialogue.ipa: ðæt pɪɡ wɪl teɪst ˈwʌndərfəl wʌns hiz ˈpɪkəld
dialogue.zh: 那头猪腌好后味道一定很棒

dialogue.en: But the main course is a Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə meɪn kɔrs ɪz ə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: It will be nice to live forever
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wɪl bi naɪs tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 能长生不老真是太好了

dialogue.en: Let's fry the monk with garlic and spices
dialogue.ipa: lɛts fraɪ ðə mʌŋk wɪð ˈɡɑrlɪk ænd ˈspaɪsəz
dialogue.zh: 我们用大蒜和香料来炸这个和尚吧

dialogue.en: I'll go see what we have in the kitchen
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ si wɑt wi hæv ɪn ðə ˈkɪʧən
dialogue.zh: 我去厨房看看有什么材料

dialogue.en: Wukong will certainly try to rescue his friends
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wɪl ˈsɜrtənli traɪ tu ˈrɛskju hɪz frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 悟空肯定会想办法救他的朋友们
他摸了摸自己断掉的牙齿

dialogue.en: I don't want that to happen
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt wɑnt ðæt tu ˈhæpən
dialogue.zh: 我可不想那样的事发生

dialogue.en: The elephant looked at his bruised trunk
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛləfənt lʊkt æt hɪz bruzd trʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 大象看着自己淤青的鼻子

dialogue.en: Well this time I have a plan
dialogue.ipa: wɛl ðɪs taɪm aɪ hæv ə plæn

dialogue.en: We'll tell every demon nearby that we've already eaten the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wil tɛl ˈɛvəri ˈdimən ˈnɪrˈbaɪ ðæt wiv ɔlˈrɛdi ˈitən ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 告诉附近所有的妖怪,我们已经吃了唐僧

dialogue.en: He'll give up hope and leave the area
dialogue.ipa: hil ɡɪv ʌp hoʊp ænd liv ði ˈɛriə
dialogue.zh: 他就会放弃希望离开这里

dialogue.en: Wukong sat next to the road
dialogue.ipa: Wukong sæt nɛkst tu ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: I'll go into that cave and rescue my friends
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ ˈɪntu ðæt keɪv ænd ˈrɛskju maɪ frɛndz
dialogue.zh: 我要冲进那个山洞救出我的朋友

dialogue.en: I'll clobber them with my iron bar
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ˈklɑbər ðɛm wɪð maɪ ˈaɪərn bɑr
dialogue.zh: 我就用金箍棒狠狠揍他们

dialogue.en: Even if they cry and promise not to hurt us
dialogue.ipa: ˈivɪn ɪf ðeɪ kraɪ ænd ˈprɑməs nɑt tu hɜrt ʌs
dialogue.zh: 就算他们哭着保证不再伤害我们

dialogue.en: He saw two thieves coming down the road
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ tu θivz ˈkʌmɪŋ daʊn ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 他看见两个盗贼沿路走来

dialogue.en: He hid behind a rock and waited for the thieves to pass by
dialogue.ipa: hi hɪd bɪˈhaɪnd ə rɑk ænd ˈweɪtɪd fɔr ðə θivz tu pæs baɪ
dialogue.zh: 他躲在一块岩石后面,等着盗贼经过

dialogue.en: It would be nice to live forever
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʊd bi naɪs tu lɪv fəˈrɛvər

dialogue.en: The two fiends continued along the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu findz kənˈtɪnjud ə ˈlɔŋ ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 两个小妖继续沿路走着

dialogue.en: I couldn't protect you and now you'll never reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈkʊdənt prəˈtɛkt ju ænd naʊ jul ˈnɛvər riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrə ˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我没能保护好你,如今你再也到不了西天极乐世界了

dialogue.en: Wukong buried his head in his hands and cried for a long time
dialogue.ipa: Wukong ˈbɛrid hɪz hɛd ɪn hɪz hændz ænd kraɪd fɔr ə lɔŋ taɪm
dialogue.zh: 悟空双手抱头痛哭了许久

dialogue.en: Finally he stood up and wiped away the tears
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪnəli hi stʊd ʌp ænd waɪpt əˈweɪ ðə tɛrz
dialogue.zh: 最终他站起身,擦干了眼泪

dialogue.en: I know what I must do
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ wɑt aɪ mʌst du
dialogue.zh: 我知道自己必须做什么

dialogue.en: The monkey leaped into the air and headed west
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki lɛpt ˈɪntu ði ɛr ænd ˈhɛdɪd wɛst
dialogue.zh: 猴子纵身跃向空中,朝西飞去

dialogue.en: He arrived at the thunderclap monastery
dialogue.ipa: hi əˈraɪvd æt ðə thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri

dialogue.en: And a guard let him enter
dialogue.ipa: ænd ə ɡɑrd lɛt hɪm ˈɛntər

dialogue.en: Wukong went before Buddha and bowed
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ wɛnt bɪˈfɔr ˈbudə ænd baʊd
dialogue.zh: 悟空来到佛祖面前躬身行礼

dialogue.en: The monkey burst into tears again
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki bɜrst ˈɪntu tɛrz əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: I can see everything in the universe
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn si ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈjunə ˌvɜrs

dialogue.en: I know exactly who those demons are and what they did
dialogue.ipa: aɪ noʊ ɪɡˈzæktli hu ðoʊz ˈdimənz ɑr ænd wɑt ðeɪ dɪd
dialogue.zh: 我早已知晓那些妖魔的来历与所为

dialogue.en: They tricked you into thinking they'd eaten the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ trɪkt ju ˈɪntu ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ðeɪd ˈitən ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 他们设计让你以为唐僧已被吞食

dialogue.en: They wanted you to give up hope
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈwɔntɪd ju tu ɡɪv ʌp hoʊp

dialogue.en: Wukong swung his iron bar at the cave entrance
dialogue.ipa: Wukong swʌŋ hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr æt ðə keɪv ˈɛntrəns
dialogue.zh: 悟空挥起金箍棒砸向洞门

dialogue.en: And the three demons ran outside
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə θri ˈdimənz ræn ˈaʊt ˈsaɪd

dialogue.en: Suddenly he looked up and saw an enormous figure
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli hi lʊkt ʌp ænd sɔ ən ɪˈnɔrməs ˈfɪɡjər
dialogue.zh: 忽然他抬头望见一尊巍峨巨影

dialogue.en: The lion and the elephant trembled with fear
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈlaɪən ænd ði ˈɛləfənt ˈtrɛmbəld wɪð fɪr
dialogue.zh: 狮象二妖吓得浑身战栗

dialogue.en: Light flashed as Buddha turned the two demons into ordinary animals
dialogue.ipa: laɪt flæʃt æz ˈbudə tɜrnd ðə tu ˈdimənz ˈɪntu ˈɔrdəˌnɛri ˈænəməlz
dialogue.zh: 佛光闪现间,两只妖魔已化作寻常走兽

dialogue.en: Only the raptor demon wasn't scared
dialogue.ipa: ˈoʊnli ðə ˈræptər ˈdimən ˈwɑzənt skɛrd

dialogue.en: And the bird was paralyzed in midair
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə bɜrd wʌz ˈpɛrəˌlaɪzd ɪn ˈmɪˈdɛr
dialogue.zh: 大鹏便僵在半空动弹不得

dialogue.en: You may free your companions now
dialogue.ipa: ju meɪ fri jʊər kəmˈpænjənz naʊ
dialogue.zh: 现在你可去解救同伴了

dialogue.en: I will see you when you reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl si ju wɛn ju riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 待你抵达西天极乐时,我自会相见
