When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: I wonder who they are
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

collocations.context: Wukong will certainly try to rescue his friends
The elephant looked at his bruised trunk
Well this time I have a plan
Thinking about what to do
The monkey said to himself
The monkey stood up
He hid behind a rock and waited for the thieves to pass by
I couldn't protect you and now you'll never reach the western paradise
And a guard let him enter
The monkey burst into tears again
Wukong looked up
Thank you Buddha

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 96 wind and fog

dialogue.en: I hope we reach the western paradise soon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp wi riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs sun
dialogue.zh: 希望我们能早日抵达西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: This journey has been very dangerous
dialogue.ipa: ðɪs ˈʤɜrni hæz bɪn ˈvɛri ˈdeɪnʤərəs

dialogue.en: Those three demons tried to pickle me
dialogue.ipa: ðoʊz θri ˈdimənz traɪd tu ˈpɪkəl mi
dialogue.zh: 那三个妖怪还想把我腌成咸菜

dialogue.en: Wukong what happened to those demons
dialogue.ipa: wu kæŋ wɑt ˈhæpənd tu ðoʊz ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空,那些妖怪后来怎么样了

dialogue.en: Thank you again for saving us
dialogue.ipa: θæŋk ju əˈɡɛn fɔr ˈseɪvɪŋ ʌs

dialogue.en: Buddha did most of the work
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə dɪd moʊst ʌv ðə wɜrk

dialogue.en: The group felt a strong wind blow down from the mountains up ahead
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup fɛlt ə strɔŋ wɪnd bloʊ daʊn frʌm ðə ˈmaʊntənz ʌp ə ˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 一行人感到一阵狂风从前方的山间吹下

dialogue.en: A dark fog filled the sky and then disappeared
dialogue.ipa: ə dɑrk fɑɡ fɪld ðə skaɪ ænd ðɛn ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd
dialogue.zh: 黑雾弥漫天际,随后又消散无踪

dialogue.en: What caused that wind and fog
dialogue.ipa: wɑt kɑzd ðæt wɪnd ænd fɑɡ
dialogue.zh: 这阵风和雾是怎么回事

dialogue.en: I'm sure it was something harmless
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʃʊr ɪt wʌz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈhɑrmləs
dialogue.zh: 肯定不是什么危险的东西

dialogue.en: The monkey walked up the road and around a bend
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki wɔkt ʌp ðə roʊd ænd əˈraʊnd ə bɛnd
dialogue.zh: 猴子沿路前行,转过一个弯

dialogue.en: He heard laughter and looked up
dialogue.ipa: hi hɜrd ˈlæftər ænd lʊkt ʌp

dialogue.en: A fat monster was sitting on the edge of a cliff
dialogue.ipa: ə fæt ˈmɑnstər wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ ɑn ði ɛʤ ʌv ə klɪf
dialogue.zh: 一个胖妖怪正坐在悬崖边上

dialogue.en: Several little demons sat next to the monster
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɛvrəl ˈlɪtəl ˈdimənz sæt nɛkst tu ðə ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 几个小妖坐在妖怪身旁

dialogue.en: Wukong flew up to get a closer look
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ flu ʌp tu ɡɛt ə ˈkloʊsər lʊk

dialogue.en: The fat monster appeared to be concentrating
dialogue.ipa: ðə fæt ˈmɑnstər ə ˈpɪrd tu bi ˈkɑnsənˌtreɪtɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 那胖妖怪似乎在凝神运气

dialogue.en: A burp as loud as thunder blew down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ə bɜrp æz laʊd æz ˈθʌndər blu daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 一声雷鸣般的饱嗝从山上轰然响起

dialogue.en: That was your best burp yet
dialogue.ipa: ðæt wʌz jʊər bɛst bɜrp jɛt
dialogue.zh: 这是你打得最响的嗝了

dialogue.en: Yes I proud of that one
dialogue.ipa: jɛs aɪm praʊd ʌv ðæt wʌn

dialogue.zh: 再给我们看看吐雾的本事

dialogue.en: He covered one nostril with a finger
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈkʌvərd wʌn ˈnɑstrɪl wɪð ə ˈfɪŋɡər
dialogue.zh: 他用手指按住一个鼻孔

dialogue.en: Closed his eyes and blew hard
dialogue.ipa: kloʊzd hɪz aɪz ænd blu hɑrd

dialogue.en: Dark fog poured out of his other nostril
dialogue.ipa: dɑrk fɑɡ pɔrd aʊt ʌv hɪz ˈʌðər ˈnɑstrɪl
dialogue.zh: 黑雾从他另一个鼻孔喷涌而出

dialogue.en: More wind blew down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: mɔr wɪnd blu daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: There was a roar of laughter
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə rɔr ʌv ˈlæftər

dialogue.en: One demon nearly fell off the cliff
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ˈdimən ˈnɪrli fɛl ɔf ðə klɪf
dialogue.zh: 一只妖怪差点摔下悬崖

dialogue.en: I'm not worried about these demons
dialogue.ipa: aɪm nɑt ˈwɜrid əˈbaʊt ðiz ˈdimənz

dialogue.zh: 他们虽令人作呕,但并无危险

dialogue.en: It does give me an idea though
dialogue.ipa: ɪt dʌz ɡɪv mi ən aɪˈdiə ðoʊ
dialogue.zh: 不过这倒让我有了个主意

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空回到了同伴们身边

dialogue.en: Who were waiting alongside the road
dialogue.ipa: hu wɜr ˈweɪtɪŋ əˈlɔŋˈsaɪd ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: Then the monkey pulled bajie aside
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ðə ˈmʌŋki pʊld bajie ə ˈsaɪd
dialogue.zh: 接着猴子把八戒拉到一旁

dialogue.en: The people there are preparing a huge feast
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈpipəl ðɛr ɑr pri ˈpɛrɪŋ ə hjuʤ fist
dialogue.zh: 那里的人正在准备丰盛的宴席
我看到了蔬菜、面条、豆腐

dialogue.en: Steamed buns and all sorts of delicious food
dialogue.ipa: stimd bʌnz ænd ɔl sɔrts ʌv dɪˈlɪʃəs fud

dialogue.en: I thought maybe you'd like to go before us and start eating
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɔt ˈmeɪbi jud laɪk tu ɡoʊ bɪˈfɔr ʌs ænd stɑrt ˈitɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 我想你或许愿意先去吃个痛快

dialogue.en: Thank you for thinking of me Wukong
dialogue.ipa: θæŋk ju fɔr ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ʌv mi Wukong

dialogue.en: I am rather hungry right now
dialogue.ipa: aɪ æm ˈræðər ˈhʌŋɡri raɪt naʊ

dialogue.en: The pig turned to the Tang Monk
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ tɜrnd tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Master I think I should go ahead and check the mountain too
dialogue.ipa: ˈmæstər aɪ θɪŋk aɪ ʃʊd ɡoʊ əˈhɛd ænd ʧɛk ðə ˈmaʊntən tu
dialogue.zh: 师父,我觉得我也该去前面探探山

dialogue.en: And I like to be extra safe
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪd laɪk tu bi ˈɛkstrə seɪf

dialogue.zh: 真让我刮目相看啊,八戒

dialogue.en: Thank you for doing extra work
dialogue.ipa: θæŋk ju fɔr ˈduɪŋ ˈɛkstrə wɜrk

dialogue.en: And then headed up the road
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛn ˈhɛdɪd ʌp ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: Then he blew more fog from one nostril
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi blu mɔr fɑɡ frʌm wʌn ˈnɑstrɪl
dialogue.zh: 接着他从一个鼻孔喷出更多雾气
妖怪们发出癫狂的笑声

dialogue.en: Suddenly there was a loud rumbling sound
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðɛr wʌz ə laʊd ˈrʌmbəlɪŋ saʊnd

dialogue.en: The monster patted his big belly
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər ˈpætɪd hɪz bɪɡ ˈbɛli
dialogue.zh: 妖怪拍了拍自己的大肚子

dialogue.en: The demons looked at one another
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimənz lʊkt æt wʌn ə ˈnʌðər

dialogue.en: Let's go down to the road and find some people to eat
dialogue.ipa: lɛts ɡoʊ daʊn tu ðə roʊd ænd faɪnd sʌm ˈpipəl tu it
dialogue.zh: 我们下山到那条路上去,找些人来吃。

dialogue.en: The demons cheered and followed the monster down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimənz ʧɪrd ænd ˈfɑloʊd ðə ˈmɑnstər daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 小妖们欢呼着,跟着那妖怪下了山。

dialogue.en: When they got to the road
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðeɪ ɡɑt tu ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: They made themselves look like people
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ meɪd ðɛmˈsɛlvz lʊk laɪk ˈpipəl
dialogue.zh: 他们把自己伪装成人的模样。

dialogue.en: The next time someone comes along this road
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst taɪm ˈsʌmˌwʌn kʌmz əˈlɔŋ ðɪs roʊd
dialogue.zh: 下次有人经过这条路时

dialogue.en: Then a large pig came around the bend
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ə lɑrʤ pɪɡ keɪm ə ˈraʊnd ðə bɛnd
dialogue.zh: 接着,一头大猪从拐弯处走了过来。

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said the Tang monk
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: It was nothing master
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Did you see any demons
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: The people there are preparing a huge feast
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: This journey has been very dangerous
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll go check
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: I'm sure they were punished
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But we must protect you
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: Master I think I should go ahead and check the mountain too
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: Those three demons tried to pickle me
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's go down to the road and find some people to eat
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Show us the fog again
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There was a roar of laughter
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: That was your best burp yet
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When they got to the road
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词 + as
grammar.description: 表示两者在某方面程度相同；否定形式表示“不如……”。
grammar.source: A burp as loud as thunder blew down the mountain
examples: Wukong is as quick as the wind.
The cave is as dark as night.
Bajie is not as careful as Wujing.
The river is as wide as the road.
This box is as heavy as that one.
The demon ran as fast as a horse.
The palace is as beautiful as a dream.
Today is as hot as yesterday.
The second path is not as long as the first.
She spoke as calmly as the monk.

collocations.context: I hope we reach the western paradise soon
Those three demons tried to pickle me
Thank you again for saving us
The monkey walked up the road and around a bend
He heard laughter and looked up
Closed his eyes and blew hard
Wukong shook his head
He said to himself
Thank you for thinking of me Wukong
The pig turned to the Tang Monk
I trust Wukong of course
The demons looked at one another
The demons looked at one another
The monster stood up
They made themselves look like people
They made themselves look like people
The next time someone comes along this road

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 97 Bajie and the monster

dialogue.en: Bajie took a step back as a dark mist surrounded the people on the road
dialogue.ipa: Bajie tʊk ə stɛp bæk æz ə dɑrk mɪst səˈraʊndɪd ðə ˈpipəl ɑn ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 当一团黑雾笼罩了路上的人们时,八戒后退了一步。

dialogue.en: He saw they were really a monster and several little demons
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ ðeɪ wɜr ˈrɪli ə ˈmɑnstər ænd ˈsɛvrəl ˈlɪtəl ˈdimənz
dialogue.zh: 他看见他们其实是一个妖怪和几个小妖。

dialogue.en: Yes you are here for the feast pig
dialogue.ipa: jɛs ju ɑr hir fɔr ðə fist pɪɡ
dialogue.zh: 没错,你就是来赴宴的猪。

dialogue.en: We're going to eat you for lunch
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu it ju fɔr lʌnʧ
dialogue.zh: 我们要把你当午餐吃了。

dialogue.en: Bajie raised his Rake and swung as the monster approached
dialogue.ipa: Bajie reɪzd hɪz reɪk ænd swʌŋ æz ðə ˈmɑnstər əˈproʊʧt
dialogue.zh: 当妖怪逼近时,八戒举起钉耙挥了过去。

dialogue.en: The demons rushed toward the cake from all sides
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimənz rʌʃt təˈwɔrd ðə keɪk frʌm ɔl saɪdz
dialogue.zh: 小妖们从四面八方冲向这顿美餐。

dialogue.en: That rotten monkey lied to me
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈrɑtən ˈmʌŋki laɪd tu mi
dialogue.zh: 那只该死的猴子骗了我!

dialogue.en: He spun around and knocked over two demons with his Rake
dialogue.ipa: hi spʌn əˈraʊnd ænd nɑkt ˈoʊvər tu ˈdimənz wɪð hɪz reɪk
dialogue.zh: 他转身用钉耙打倒了两个小妖。

dialogue.en: Bajie blocked the punch with his Rake
dialogue.ipa: Bajie blɑkt ðə pʌnʧ wɪð hɪz reɪk
dialogue.zh: 八戒用钉耙挡住了这一拳。

dialogue.en: Ba Jie kicked a demon sneaking up behind him
dialogue.ipa: Ba ʤi kɪkt ə ˈdimən ˈsnikɪŋ ʌp bɪˈhaɪnd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 八戒踢飞了一个从背后偷袭他的小妖。

dialogue.en: That monkey is always causing problems
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈmʌŋki ɪz ˈɔlˌweɪz ˈkɑzɪŋ ˈprɑbləmz

dialogue.en: He slammed the Rake down on another demon
dialogue.ipa: hi slæmd ðə reɪk daʊn ɑn əˈnʌðər ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 他把钉耙重重地砸在另一个小妖身上。

dialogue.en: So what if I like to eat
dialogue.ipa: soʊ wɑt ɪf aɪ laɪk tu it

dialogue.en: Did he really have to trick me
dialogue.ipa: dɪd hi ˈrɪli hæv tu trɪk mi

dialogue.en: Bajie thrust his Rake toward him
dialogue.ipa: Bajie θrʌst hɪz reɪk təˈwɔrd hɪm

dialogue.en: He doesn't need to eat as much as I do
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈdʌzənt nid tu it æz mʌʧ æz aɪ du
dialogue.zh: 他不需要像我吃那么多。

dialogue.en: Are you talking about Sun Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ɑr ju ˈtɔkɪŋ əˈbaʊt sʌn wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: The monkey who defeated Heaven's entire army five hundred years ago
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki hu dɪˈfitɪd ˈhɛvənz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi faɪv ˈhʌndrɪd jɪrz əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 就是五百年前大闹天宫的那只猴子?

dialogue.en: I've heard he's traveling with the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪv hɜrd hiz ˈtrævəlɪŋ wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我听说他正和唐僧一起取经呢。

dialogue.en: You must be traveling with the Tang monk too
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst bi ˈtrævəlɪŋ wɪð ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tu
dialogue.zh: 你肯定也是和唐僧一起赶路的

dialogue.en: Why are you interested in the monk
dialogue.ipa: waɪ ɑr ju ˈɪntrɪstɪd ɪn ðə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 你为什么对那和尚感兴趣

dialogue.en: I've heard that anyone who eats the Tang monk will live forever
dialogue.ipa: aɪv hɜrd ðæt ˈɛniˌwʌn hu its ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wɪl lɪv fəˈrɛvər
dialogue.zh: 我听说吃了唐僧肉就能长生不老

dialogue.en: Bajie ran from the demons and back to his companions
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ræn frʌm ðə ˈdimənz ænd bæk tu hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 八戒从妖怪那里逃回同伴身边

dialogue.en: How was the feast BA Jie
dialogue.ipa: haʊ wʌz ðə fist bi-eɪ ʤi

dialogue.en: He turned to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: Wukong told me there was a feast up ahead
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ toʊld mi ðɛr wʌz ə fist ʌp əˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 悟空告诉我前面有宴席

dialogue.en: But instead it was a group of demons and a monster
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ɪnˈstɛd ɪt wʌz ə ɡrup ʌv ˈdimənz ænd ə ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 结果却是一群妖怪和一个怪物

dialogue.en: Bajie I thought you were going to check the mountain
dialogue.ipa: Bajie aɪ θɔt ju wɜr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ʧɛk ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 八戒,我以为你是去探山的

dialogue.en: Instead you went to look for a feast
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈstɛd ju wɛnt tu lʊk fɔr ə fist

dialogue.en: You should be ashamed of yourself
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd bi əˈʃeɪmd ʌv jərˈsɛlf

dialogue.en: By now Wukong was rolling on the ground laughing
dialogue.ipa: baɪ naʊ wu kɔŋ wʌz ˈroʊlɪŋ ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd ˈlæfɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 此时悟空正笑得在地上打滚

dialogue.en: I should recite the tight headband spell to punish you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʃʊd rə ˈsaɪt ðə taɪt ˈhɛdˌbænd spɛl tu ˈpʌnɪʃ ju
dialogue.zh: 我该念紧箍咒来惩罚你

dialogue.en: You knew there were demons and a monster ahead
dialogue.ipa: ju nu ðɛr wɜr ˈdimənz ænd ə ˈmɑnstər əˈhɛd
dialogue.zh: 你明知前面有妖怪和怪物

dialogue.en: You should have said something Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃʊd hæv sɛd ˈsʌmθɪŋ wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: I admit I knew about the demons and the monster
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ədˈmɪt aɪ nu əˈbaʊt ðə ˈdimənz ænd ðə ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 我承认我知道有妖怪和怪物

dialogue.en: And now they're planning to eat master
dialogue.ipa: ænd naʊ ðɛr ˈplænɪŋ tu it ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 现在他们还计划吃掉师父

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ hɛld ʌp hɪz hændz

dialogue.en: You have nothing to worry about
dialogue.ipa: ju hæv ˈnʌθɪŋ tu ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt

dialogue.en: We must capture the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst ˈkæpʧər ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: The monster said to the demons
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər sɛd tu ðə ˈdimənz

dialogue.en: Did you know that he once defeated Heaven's entire army
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju noʊ ðæt hi wʌns dɪˈfitɪd ˈhɛvənz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi
dialogue.zh: 你知道吗,他曾打败过整个天兵天将
另一个小妖急忙跑过来

dialogue.en: I just spied on the travelers
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ʤʌst spaɪd ɑn ðə ˈtrævələrz
dialogue.zh: 我刚去探了探那些取经人的底细

dialogue.en: The Tang monk has three spirit companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk hæz θri ˈspɪrət kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 那唐僧有三个有法力的徒弟

dialogue.en: I have a plan to lure the spirits away from the monk
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hæv ə plæn tu lʊr ðə ˈspɪrɪts əˈweɪ frʌm ðə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 我有个计策,能把那几个徒弟从唐僧身边引开

dialogue.en: The demon told the monster his plan
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən toʊld ðə ˈmɑnstər hɪz plæn
dialogue.zh: 小妖把自己的计划告诉了妖怪

dialogue.en: A big smile spread across the monster's face
dialogue.ipa: ə bɪɡ smaɪl sprɛd ə ˈkrɔs ðə ˈmɑnstərz feɪs
dialogue.zh: 妖怪脸上绽开了大大的笑容

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Bajie took a step back as a dark mist surrounded the people on the road
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: The monkey was laughing
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Yes you are here for the feast pig
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: You should have said something Wukong
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I've heard that anyone who eats the Tang monk will live forever
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: You should be ashamed of yourself
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: You must be traveling with the Tang monk too
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: You should be ashamed of yourself
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: Did he really have to trick me
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: They wanted to eat me
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: Bajie I thought you were going to check the mountain
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: They tried to eat me
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: Wukong told me there was a feast up ahead
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: The monkey who defeated Heaven's entire army five hundred years ago
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: So what if I like to eat
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When the mist cleared
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 98 three fights

dialogue.en: Wukong and his companions walked on the mountain road
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz wɔkt ɑn ðə ˈmaʊntən roʊd
dialogue.zh: 悟空和同伴们走在山路上

dialogue.en: The monkey watched carefully for the monster and demons
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki wɑʧt ˈkɛrfəli fɔr ðə ˈmɑnstər ænd ˈdimənz

dialogue.en: Suddenly a demon charged toward the group
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ə ˈdimən ʧɑrʤd təˈwɔrd ðə ɡrup
dialogue.zh: 突然,一个小妖冲向一行人

dialogue.en: The demon stepped off the road and headed down the slope of the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən stɛpt ɔf ðə roʊd ænd ˈhɛdɪd daʊn ðə sloʊp ʌv ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 小妖离开山路,往山坡下跑去

dialogue.en: Bajie raced after the demon and was soon out of sight
dialogue.ipa: Bajie reɪst ˈæftər ðə ˈdimən ænd wʌz sun aʊt ʌv saɪt
dialogue.zh: 八戒紧追小妖,很快就不见了踪影

dialogue.en: Wukong heard grunts and clashing weapons
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ hɜrd ɡrʌnts ænd ˈklæʃɪŋ ˈwɛpənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空听到哼哼声和兵器碰撞声

dialogue.en: But he couldn't see the fight
dialogue.ipa: bʌt hi ˈkʊdənt si ðə faɪt

dialogue.en: The demon climbed back onto the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən klaɪmd bæk ˈɑntu ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: The monkey charged toward the demon
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ʧɑrʤd təˈwɔrd ðə ˈdimən

dialogue.en: Wukong fought with all his strength
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ fɔt wɪð ɔl hɪz strɛŋkθ

dialogue.en: Again the demon left the road and headed down the mountain
dialogue.ipa: əˈɡɛn ðə ˈdimən lɛft ðə roʊd ænd ˈhɛdɪd daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 小妖再次离开山路,往山下跑去

dialogue.en: The monkey and the demon disappeared down the slope of the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ænd ðə ˈdimən ˌdɪsəˈpɪrd daʊn ðə sloʊp ʌv ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 猴子和妖怪消失在山坡下

dialogue.en: Do you think Wukong can defeat that demon
dialogue.ipa: du ju θɪŋk wu kɔŋ kæn dɪˈfit ðæt ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 你觉得悟空能打败那妖怪吗

dialogue.en: I wonder what happened to Bajie though
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈwʌndər wɑt ˈhæpənd tu Bajie ðoʊ
dialogue.zh: 不过我在想八戒怎么样了

dialogue.en: How did you get past Wukong
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɪd ju ɡɛt pæst wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: Wu jing raised his spear and attacked the demon
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ reɪzd hɪz spɪr ænd əˈtækt ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 吴京举起长矛向妖怪刺去

dialogue.en: The two fought kicking up dust and rocks
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu fɔt ˈkɪkɪŋ ʌp dʌst ænd rɑks
dialogue.zh: 两人打得尘土飞扬,碎石四溅

dialogue.en: Wujing struck the demon across the legs
dialogue.ipa: Wujing strʌk ðə ˈdimən əˈkrɔs ðə lɛɡz
dialogue.zh: 悟净一杖打在妖怪腿上

dialogue.en: The demon tumbled down the mountainside
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ˈtʌmbəld daʊn ðə ˈmaʊntənˌsaɪd

dialogue.en: The Tang monk stood in the road
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stʊd ɪn ðə roʊd

dialogue.en: For a moment everything was quiet
dialogue.ipa: fɔr ə ˈmoʊmənt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ wʌz ˈkwaɪət

dialogue.en: Then he heard footsteps behind him
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi hɜrd ˈfʊtˌstɛps bɪˈhaɪnd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 接着他听到身后传来脚步声

dialogue.en: The monk turned around and gasped
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk tɜrnd əˈraʊnd ænd ɡæspt
dialogue.zh: 和尚转身倒吸一口凉气

dialogue.en: A huge fat monster was smiling wickedly at him
dialogue.ipa: ə hjuʤ fæt ˈmɑnstər wʌz ˈsmaɪlɪŋ ˈwɪkɪdli æt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 一个肥胖的巨怪正对他狞笑

dialogue.en: When Wukong returned to the road
dialogue.ipa: wɛn wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə roʊd

dialogue.zh: 发现只有八戒独自一人
这头猪看起来心烦意乱

dialogue.en: Where are master and Wu jing
dialogue.ipa: wɛr ɑr ˈmæstər ænd wu ʤɪŋ

dialogue.en: I defeated that demon and then came back here
dialogue.ipa: aɪ dɪˈfitɪd ðæt ˈdimən ænd ðɛn keɪm bæk hir
dialogue.zh: 我打败了那个妖怪然后回到这里

dialogue.en: He came back here and I had to fight him
dialogue.ipa: hi keɪm bæk hir ænd aɪ hæd tu faɪt hɪm
dialogue.zh: 他回到这里,我还得跟他打一场

dialogue.en: I was fighting with the demon until just a few moments ago
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ˈfaɪtɪŋ wɪð ðə ˈdimən ənˈtɪl ʤʌst ə fju ˈmoʊmənts əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 我刚才一直在和妖怪打斗

dialogue.en: Do you really expect me to believe that
dialogue.ipa: du ju ˈrɪli ɪkˈspɛkt mi tu bɪ ˈliv ðæt
dialogue.zh: 你真指望我相信这话吗

dialogue.en: I was just fighting with the demon
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ʤʌst ˈfaɪtɪŋ wɪð ðə ˈdimən
dialogue.zh: 我刚刚还在和妖怪交手

dialogue.en: Wu jing returned to the road annoyed
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ rɪˈtɜrnd tu ðə roʊd ə ˈnɔɪd

dialogue.en: How did that demon get past you two
dialogue.ipa: haʊ dɪd ðæt ˈdimən ɡɛt pæst ju tu
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪怎么绕过你们俩的

dialogue.en: The demon didn't get past me
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈdimən ˈdɪdənt ɡɛt pæst mi

dialogue.en: I was fighting with him until just a moment ago
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ˈfaɪtɪŋ wɪð hɪm ənˈtɪl ʤʌst ə ˈmoʊmənt əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 我刚才一直在和他打斗

dialogue.en: After you chased him down the slope
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ju ʧeɪst hɪm daʊn ðə sloʊp

dialogue.en: How could we be so stupid
dialogue.ipa: haʊ kʊd wi bi soʊ ˈstupɪd

dialogue.en: They lured us away one by one
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ lʊrd ʌs əˈweɪ wʌn baɪ wʌn

dialogue.zh: 很可能就是那个胖妖怪

dialogue.en: Grabbed master while we were gone
dialogue.ipa: ɡræbd ˈmæstər waɪl wi wɜr ɡɔn
dialogue.zh: 趁我们不在时抓走了师父

dialogue.en: That Monster must have a cave nearby
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈmɑnstər mʌst hæv ə keɪv ˈnɪrˈbaɪ
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪的洞穴肯定就在附近

dialogue.en: The three companions searched the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə θri kəm ˈpænjənz sɜrʧt ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 三位同伴搜遍了整座山
很快他们就发现了一个洞穴

dialogue.en: Do you think this is the monster's cave
dialogue.ipa: du ju θɪŋk ðɪs ɪz ðə ˈmɑnstərz keɪv
dialogue.zh: 你们觉得这是妖怪的洞府吗

dialogue.en: He raised his rake and knocked a hole in the door
dialogue.ipa: hi reɪzd hɪz reɪk ænd nɑkt ə hoʊl ɪn ðə dɔr
dialogue.zh: 他举起钉耙,在门上砸出一个窟窿

dialogue.en: Then he shouted into the hole
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ˈʃaʊtɪd ˈɪntu ðə hoʊl

dialogue.en: A demon inside the cave shrieked and ran into a kitchen
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈdimən ɪnˈsaɪd ðə keɪv ʃrikt ænd ræn ˈɪntu ə ˈkɪʧən
dialogue.zh: 洞里一个小妖尖叫着跑进厨房

dialogue.en: The Monster was grinding spices with a mortar and pestle
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər wʌz ˈɡraɪndɪŋ ˈspaɪsəz wɪð ə ˈmɔrtər ænd pestle
dialogue.zh: 那妖怪正用杵臼研磨香料

dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈoʊnli əˈfreɪd ʌv wu kɔŋ
ˈʃaʊtɪd wu kɔŋ θru ðə hoʊl

dialogue.en: The monster dropped the mortar and pestle
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər drɑpt ðə ˈmɔrtər ænd pestle
dialogue.zh: 妖怪手里的杵臼应声落地

dialogue.en: Then he cleared his throat and shouted
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi klɪrd hɪz θroʊt ænd ˈʃaʊtɪd

dialogue.en: We already ate the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wi ɔlˈrɛdi eɪt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 唐僧已经被我们吃下肚了

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong and his companions walked on the mountain road
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: A huge fat monster was smiling wickedly at him
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: Do you think Wukong can defeat that demon
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll fight this demon
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Wu jing was shocked
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: Do you think Wukong can defeat that demon
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: But he couldn't see the fight
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: That Monster must have a cave nearby
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: He came back here and I had to fight him
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's find it
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Stay here everyone
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There were three
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who cares
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When Wukong returned to the road
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: Grabbed master while we were gone
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: How could we be so stupid
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

collocations.context: Wukong and his companions walked on the mountain road
Stay here everyone
Bajie raced after the demon and was soon out of sight
A moment later
The demon climbed back onto the road
Without waiting for an answer
For a moment everything was quiet
The monk turned around and gasped
I defeated that demon and then came back here
He came back here and I had to fight him
Wukong made a fist
We'll find out
A demon inside the cave shrieked and ran into a kitchen

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 99 squire kou's vow

dialogue.en: The monster yelled from inside the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɑnstər jɛld frʌm ɪn ˈsaɪd ðə keɪv

dialogue.en: So you might as well leave
dialogue.ipa: soʊ ju maɪt æz wɛl liv

dialogue.en: Bajie fell to his knees and cried
dialogue.ipa: Bajie fɛl tu hɪz niz ænd kraɪd

dialogue.en: Wujing wiped tears from his eyes
dialogue.ipa: Wujing waɪpt tɛrz frʌm hɪz aɪz
wu kɔŋ fraʊnd æt hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 悟空对着两个师弟皱起眉头

dialogue.en: I can't believe you two believe that monster
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kænt bɪˈliv ju tu bɪ ˈliv ðæt ˈmɑnstər
dialogue.zh: 真不敢相信你们竟信了那妖怪的鬼话

dialogue.en: The monkey turned into a moth and flew into the cave
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə mɔθ ænd flu ˈɪntu ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 猴子化作飞蛾钻进了洞穴

dialogue.en: He soon found the Tang monk tied up in a dark room
dialogue.ipa: hi sun faʊnd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk taɪd ʌp ɪn ə dɑrk rum
dialogue.zh: 很快就在暗室里找到了被捆住的唐僧

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ tɜrnd bæk ˈɪntu hɪmˈsɛlf

dialogue.zh: 猴子解开了师父的绳索

dialogue.en: The sound of snoring drifted into the room
dialogue.ipa: ðə saʊnd ʌv ˈsnɔrɪŋ ˈdrɪftɪd ˈɪntu ðə rum

dialogue.en: My spell put the monster and demons to sleep
dialogue.ipa: maɪ spɛl pʊt ðə ˈmɑnstər ænd ˈdimənz tu slip
dialogue.zh: 我的咒语让妖怪和恶魔都睡着了

dialogue.en: Wukong and the monk came out of the cave
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd ðə mʌŋk keɪm aʊt ʌv ðə keɪv
dialogue.zh: 悟空和和尚从洞里走了出来

dialogue.en: Ba jie and Wu jing were thrilled
dialogue.ipa: Ba ʤi ænd wu ʤɪŋ wɜr θrɪld

dialogue.zh: 我们还以为您被吃掉了

dialogue.en: Now I going to make sure these villains never bother anyone again
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu meɪk ʃʊr ðiz ˈvɪlənz ˈnɛvər ˈbɑðər ˈɛniˌwʌn ə ˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 现在我要确保这些恶棍再也不会打扰任何人

dialogue.en: He pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: It grew until it was the size of a very tall tree
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ɡru ənˈtɪl ɪt wʌz ðə saɪz ʌv ə ˈvɛri tɔl tri
dialogue.zh: 它一直长到像一棵非常高的树那么大

dialogue.en: With one swing Wukong smashed the entire cave
dialogue.ipa: wɪð wʌn swɪŋ wu kɔŋ smæʃt ði ɪnˈtaɪər keɪv
dialogue.zh: 悟空一挥棒,整个洞穴都被砸碎了

dialogue.en: Rocks exploded and fell on top of one another
dialogue.ipa: rɑks ɪkˈsploʊdɪd ænd fɛl ɑn tɑp ʌv wʌn əˈnʌðər

dialogue.en: Wukong looked at the rubble and smiled
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lʊkt æt ðə ˈrʌbəl ænd smaɪld

dialogue.en: And the travelers arrived in a small town
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈtrævələrz ə ˈraɪvd ɪn ə smɔl taʊn
dialogue.zh: 旅行者们到达了一个小镇
八戒的肚子咕咕叫得很响

dialogue.en: I guess we should look for food
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ɡɛs wi ʃʊd lʊk fɔr fud
dialogue.zh: 我想我们应该去找点吃的

dialogue.en: They saw an old monk walking down a street
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ sɔ ən oʊld mʌŋk ˈwɔkɪŋ daʊn ə strit
dialogue.zh: 他们看到一位老和尚走在街上

dialogue.en: Do you know where we can beg for some food
dialogue.ipa: du ju noʊ wɛr wi kæn bɛɡ fɔr sʌm fud
dialogue.zh: 您知道我们可以在哪里化缘吗

dialogue.en: The squire made a vow to feed ten thousand Buddhist monks
dialogue.ipa: ðə skwaɪr meɪd ə vaʊ tu fid tɛn ˈθaʊzənd ˈbudəst mʌŋks
dialogue.zh: 员外许愿要供养一万名佛教僧侣

dialogue.en: He will surely give you some food
dialogue.ipa: hi wɪl ˈʃʊrli ɡɪv ju sʌm fud
dialogue.zh: 他一定会给你们一些食物

dialogue.en: He gave the Tang monk directions to the house
dialogue.ipa: hi ɡeɪv ðə tæŋ mʌŋk dəˈrɛkʃənz tu ðə haʊs
dialogue.zh: 他给唐僧指了去那房子的路

dialogue.en: The travelers arrived at the squire's gate
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz əˈraɪvd æt ðə skwaɪrz ɡeɪt
dialogue.zh: 旅行者们到达了员外家门口

dialogue.en: And a servant let them in
dialogue.ipa: ænd ə ˈsɜrvənt lɛt ðɛm ɪn
dialogue.zh: 一个仆人让他们进去了

dialogue.en: The squire's house was very large and fancy
dialogue.ipa: ðə skwaɪrz haʊs wʌz ˈvɛri lɑrʤ ænd ˈfænsi
dialogue.zh: 员外的房子非常大且华丽

dialogue.en: The travelers sat with the squire in a large room
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz sæt wɪð ðə skwaɪr ɪn ə lɑrʤ rum
dialogue.zh: 旅行者和员外坐在一个大房间里

dialogue.en: A servant brought tea and snacks
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈsɜrvənt brɔt ti ænd snæks
dialogue.zh: 一个仆人端来了茶和点心

dialogue.en: Thank you for inviting us in squire
dialogue.ipa: θæŋk ju fɔr ɪnˈvaɪtɪŋ ʌs ɪn skwaɪr
dialogue.zh: 谢谢您邀请我们进来,员外

dialogue.en: We heard that you made a vow to feed ten thousand monks
dialogue.ipa: wi hɜrd ðæt ju meɪd ə vaʊ tu fid tɛn ˈθaʊzənd mʌŋks
dialogue.zh: 我们听说你曾发愿要供养一万名僧人

dialogue.en: I've made plenty of money during my life
dialogue.ipa: aɪv meɪd ˈplɛnti ʌv ˈmʌni ˈdʊrɪŋ maɪ laɪf

dialogue.en: But I want to do good deeds as well
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ wɑnt tu du ɡʊd didz æz wɛl

dialogue.en: I hope to be reborn one day as a bodhisattva or even a Buddha
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp tu bi ˈriˈbɔrn wʌn deɪ æz ə bodhisattva ɔr ˈivɪn ə ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 希望有朝一日能转世为菩萨,甚至成佛

dialogue.en: I can easily eat as much food as ten thousand monks
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn ˈizəli it æz mʌʧ fud æz tɛn ˈθaʊzənd mʌŋks
dialogue.zh: 我一个人就能吃下一万个僧人的饭量
今天确实是我的好日子

dialogue.en: Last night I checked to see how many monks I fed
dialogue.ipa: læst naɪt aɪ ʧɛkt tu si haʊ ˈmɛni mʌŋks aɪv fɛd
dialogue.zh: 昨晚我清点了一下已经供养过的僧人数量

dialogue.en: So far I fed nine thousand nine hundred ninety six monks
dialogue.ipa: soʊ fɑr aɪv fɛd naɪn ˈθaʊzənd naɪn ˈhʌndrɪd ˈnaɪnti sɪks mʌŋks
dialogue.zh: 到目前为止,我已经供养了九千九百九十六位僧人

dialogue.en: I need to feed only four more in order to fulfill my vow
dialogue.ipa: aɪ nid tu fid ˈoʊnli fɔr mɔr ɪn ˈɔrdər tu fʊlˈfɪl maɪ vaʊ
dialogue.zh: 只需再供养四位,就能完成我的誓愿了

dialogue.en: A smile spread across his face
dialogue.ipa: ə smaɪl sprɛd əˈkrɔs hɪz feɪs

dialogue.en: And there are four of you
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɛr ɑr fɔr ʌv ju

dialogue.en: Everybody in the town was invited
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌbɑdi ɪn ðə taʊn wʌz ɪn ˈvaɪtɪd

dialogue.en: The traveler sat with the squire and his wife lady kou
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələr sæt wɪð ðə skwaɪr ænd hɪz waɪf ˈleɪdi kou
dialogue.zh: 师徒四人与寇员外及其夫人寇氏同席而坐

dialogue.en: Bajie drooled as he gazed at all of the wonderful food on the table
dialogue.ipa: Bajie druld æz hi ɡeɪzd æt ɔl ʌv ðə ˈwʌndərfəl fud ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl
dialogue.zh: 八戒盯着桌上琳琅满目的美食,口水直流

dialogue.en: I don't know what to eat first
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt noʊ wɑt tu it fɜrst
dialogue.zh: 我都不知道该先吃哪样了

dialogue.en: As they ate squire kou leaned toward the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: æz ðeɪ eɪt skwaɪr kou lind təˈwɔrd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 用餐时,寇员外凑近唐僧

dialogue.en: So where are you and your companions going
dialogue.ipa: soʊ wɛr ɑr ju ænd jʊər kəmˈpænjənz ˈɡoʊɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 敢问诸位高僧要往何处去

dialogue.en: We're traveling to the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈtrævəlɪŋ tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我们正要前往西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: We're going to fetch the true scriptures from Buddha
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu fɛʧ ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz frʌm ˈbudə

The travelers crossed the river.

examples: Wukong will protect the monk.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Ba jie and Wu jing were thrilled
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。

examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.

Bajie can carry the box.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。

examples: We must leave before dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。

examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.

The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.

The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: But I want to do good deeds as well
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形

grammar.source: Let's go
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.

Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。

examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。

examples: There is a temple on the hill.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。

examples: If it rains, we will stay here.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果

The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 100 a Terrible Robbery

dialogue.en: The traveler stayed at Squire kou's house
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələr steɪd æt skwaɪr kou's haʊs
dialogue.zh: 师徒四人一直住在寇员外府上

dialogue.en: Every time they tried to leave
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvəri taɪm ðeɪ traɪd tu liv

dialogue.en: The squire begged them to stay longer
dialogue.ipa: ðə skwaɪr bɛɡd ðɛm tu steɪ ˈlɔŋɡər
dialogue.zh: 寇员外都恳求他们再多住些时日

dialogue.en: The Tang monk insisted on leaving
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɪnˈsɪstɪd ɑn ˈlivɪŋ

dialogue.en: We'll never fetch the true scriptures if we stay here
dialogue.ipa: wil ˈnɛvər fɛʧ ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz ɪf wi steɪ hir
dialogue.zh: 若再滞留此地,我们永远也取不到真经

dialogue.en: Having you as guests is a good deed
dialogue.ipa: ˈhævɪŋ ju æz ɡɛsts ɪz ə ɡʊd did
dialogue.zh: 能招待你们就是莫大的功德

dialogue.en: He took a bite of a peach
dialogue.ipa: hi tʊk ə baɪt ʌv ə piʧ

dialogue.zh: 我们必须继续我们的旅程
你们这些和尚真是忘恩负义

dialogue.en: We have fed you and taken care of you
dialogue.ipa: wi hæv fɛd ju ænd ˈteɪkən kɛr ʌv ju
dialogue.zh: 我们供你们吃喝,照顾你们

dialogue.en: Yet you can't wait to leave
dialogue.ipa: jɛt ju kænt weɪt tu liv
dialogue.zh: 可你们却迫不及待要离开

dialogue.en: But we cannot stay any longer
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wi ˈkænɑt steɪ ˈɛni ˈlɔŋɡər

dialogue.en: After breakfast Wu Jing got the horse from Squire kou's stable
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ˈbrɛkfəst wu ʤɪŋ ɡɑt ðə hɔrs frʌm skwaɪr kou's ˈsteɪbəl
dialogue.zh: 早餐后,悟净从寇家的马厩里牵来了马

dialogue.en: The Tang monk thanked Squire and Lady kou
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk θæŋkt skwaɪr ænd ˈleɪdi kou
dialogue.zh: 唐僧向寇员外和寇夫人道谢

dialogue.en: The next morning Lady kou ran into the town's courthouse
dialogue.ipa: ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈleɪdi kou ræn ˈɪntu ðə taʊnz ˈkɔrtˌhaʊs
dialogue.zh: 第二天早上,寇夫人跑进了镇上的衙门

dialogue.en: I must speak with the judge
dialogue.ipa: aɪ mʌst spik wɪð ðə ʤʌʤ

dialogue.en: Robbers broke into our house last night
dialogue.ipa: ˈrɑbərz broʊk ˈɪntu ˈaʊər haʊs læst naɪt
dialogue.zh: 昨晚有强盗闯进了我们家
寇夫人上气不接下气地说道

dialogue.en: They stole many valuable items and two of our horses
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ stoʊl ˈmɛni ˈvæljəbəl ˈaɪtəmz ænd tu ʌv ˈaʊər ˈhɔrsəz
dialogue.zh: 他们偷走了许多贵重物品和我们的两匹马

dialogue.en: Squire kou tried to stop them
dialogue.ipa: skwaɪr kou traɪd tu stɑp ðɛm

dialogue.en: And I know who they are
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ noʊ hu ðeɪ ɑr

dialogue.zh: 寇夫人咬牙切齿地说道

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and his companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəm ˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 就是唐僧和他的同伴们

dialogue.en: The judge turned to a soldier
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤʌʤ tɜrnd tu ə ˈsoʊlʤər

dialogue.en: Gather some soldiers and arrest the Tang monk and his companions
dialogue.ipa: ˈɡæðər sʌm ˈsoʊlʤərz ænd əˈrɛst ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 召集一些士兵,去逮捕唐僧和他的同伴

dialogue.en: I'm glad we're headed west again
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ɡlæd wir ˈhɛdɪd wɛst əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 我很高兴我们又重新上路西行了

dialogue.en: Said the Tang monk as the travelers walked
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk æz ðə ˈtrævələrz wɔkt

dialogue.en: I'm eager to reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈiɡər tu riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 我渴望早日到达西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: We were delayed at Squire kou's house for too long
dialogue.ipa: wi wɜr dɪ ˈleɪd æt skwaɪr kou's haʊs fɔr tu lɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 我们在寇员外家耽搁太久了
我们本应该多待些时日的

dialogue.en: Suddenly a group of men stepped onto the road
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ə ɡrup ʌv mɛn stɛpt ˈɑntu ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 突然,一群人拦在了路上

dialogue.en: Their horses carried several large bundles
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ˈhɔrsəz ˈkærid ˈsɛvrəl lɑrʤ ˈbʌndəlz
dialogue.zh: 他们的马匹驮着好几个大包裹

dialogue.en: Wukong pulled out his iron bar
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pʊld aʊt hɪz ˈaɪərn bɑr

dialogue.en: I'm just going to talk to them master
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ʤʌst ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu tɔk tu ðɛm ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 师父,我只是去跟他们谈谈

dialogue.en: He turned to the man who had shouted
dialogue.ipa: hi tɜrnd tu ðə mæn hu hæd ˈʃaʊtɪd
dialogue.zh: 他转向那个喊话的男人

dialogue.en: We're going to beat up all of you
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu bit ʌp ɔl ʌv ju
dialogue.zh: 我们就要把你们全都揍一顿

dialogue.en: You don't realize who I am
dialogue.ipa: ju doʊnt ˈriəˌlaɪz hu aɪ æm

dialogue.en: I'm Sun Wukong the Monkey King
dialogue.ipa: aɪm sʌn wu kɔŋ ðə ˈmʌŋki kɪŋ

dialogue.en: I don't care who you are
dialogue.ipa: aɪ doʊnt kɛr hu ju ɑr

dialogue.en: Last night we robbed a very wealthy squire
dialogue.ipa: læst naɪt wi rɑbd ə ˈvɛri ˈwɛlθi skwaɪr
dialogue.zh: 昨晚我们抢劫了一个非常富有的乡绅

dialogue.en: The Tang monk raised his eyebrows
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk reɪzd hɪz ˈaɪ ˌbraʊz
wu kɔŋ ˈkwɪkli rəˈsaɪtəd ə spɛl
dialogue.zh: 悟空迅速念了一句咒语

dialogue.en: Wu Jing rushed to the horses and opened one of the bundles
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ rʌʃt tu ðə ˈhɔrsəz ænd ˈoʊpənd wʌn ʌv ðə ˈbʌndəlz
dialogue.zh: 悟净冲到马匹旁,打开了一个包裹

dialogue.en: These items belong to Squire kou
dialogue.ipa: ðiz ˈaɪtəmz bɪˈlɔŋ tu skwaɪr kou

dialogue.en: The Tang monk bit his lip
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk bɪt hɪz lɪp

dialogue.en: Squire kou is a good man
dialogue.ipa: skwaɪr kou ɪz ə ɡʊd mæn

dialogue.zh: 我们必须归还他的财物

dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈrɑbərz bɪˈkeɪm ən ˈfroʊzɪn

dialogue.en: The monkey grew large and fire burned in his eyes
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ɡru lɑrʤ ænd ˈfaɪər bɜrnd ɪn hɪz aɪz
dialogue.zh: 猴子身形变大,眼中燃起火焰

dialogue.en: The robber screamed and ran away
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈrɑbər skrimd ænd ræn ə ˈweɪ

dialogue.en: The travelers headed back toward town with the squire's horses
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz ˈhɛdɪd bæk təˈwɔrd taʊn wɪð ðə skwaɪrz ˈhɔrsəz
dialogue.zh: 一行人牵着员外的马匹返回城镇

dialogue.en: Soon they saw a group of soldiers on horseback
dialogue.ipa: sun ðeɪ sɔ ə ɡrup ʌv ˈsoʊlʤərz ɑn ˈhɔrsˌbæk
dialogue.zh: 很快他们看到一群骑兵

dialogue.en: Those soldiers are riding toward us
dialogue.ipa: ðoʊz ˈsoʊlʤərz ɑr ˈraɪdɪŋ tə ˈwɔrd ʌs
dialogue.zh: 那些士兵正朝我们骑来

dialogue.en: One of the soldiers pointed a sword at the travelers
dialogue.ipa: wʌn ʌv ðə ˈsoʊlʤərz ˈpɔɪntɪd ə sɔrd æt ðə ˈtrævələrz
dialogue.zh: 一名士兵用剑指向旅人们

The monk must remain calm.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: We should have stayed longer
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: Every time they tried to leave
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Give us your money
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: He turned to the man who had shouted
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: We'll never fetch the true scriptures if we stay here
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: So do the horses
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序
grammar.description: 疑问词从句放在 know、wonder、ask、find out 等词后面时使用陈述语序。
grammar.source: And I know who they are
examples: Do you know where the road ends?
I wonder what is inside the box.
Can you tell me who called out?
We need to find out why the gate is closed.
She knows where the key is.
He asked when Wukong would return.
I do not know how they crossed the river.
They wondered who would lead the group.
Please tell me what happened here.
The king asked where the demon lived.

collocations.context: Every time they tried to leave
