The next morning Lady kou ran into the town's courthouse
Lady kou burst into tears
The judge turned to a soldier
I'm eager to reach the western paradise
Suddenly a group of men stepped onto the road
Wukong pulled out his iron bar
I'm just going to talk to them master
Get out of here
The robber screamed and ran away

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 101 arrested

dialogue.en: Soldiers were bringing the travelers back to the town
dialogue.ipa: ˈsoʊlʤərz wɜr ˈbrɪŋɪŋ ðə ˈtrævələrz bæk tu ðə taʊn
dialogue.zh: 士兵们正押着旅人们返回镇上

dialogue.en: You robbed squire kou's house last night
dialogue.ipa: jʊ rɑbd skwaɪr kou's haʊs læst naɪt
dialogue.zh: 你们昨晚抢劫了寇员外的家

dialogue.en: You had all the stolen items
dialogue.ipa: ju hæd ɔl ðə ˈstoʊlən ˈaɪtəmz

dialogue.en: You also had the two horses that were stolen from his stable
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈɔlsoʊ hæd ðə tu ˈhɔrsəz ðæt wɜr ˈstoʊlən frʌm hɪz ˈsteɪbəl
dialogue.zh: 还有他马厩里被偷的两匹马也在你们那儿

dialogue.en: We got everything from the real robbers
dialogue.ipa: wi ɡɑt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ frʌm ðə riəl ˈrɑbərz
dialogue.zh: 这些东西是我们从真强盗那儿得来的

dialogue.en: We were going to return it all to squire kou
dialogue.ipa: wi wɜr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu rɪˈtɜrn ɪt ɔl tu skwaɪr kou
dialogue.zh: 我们正打算全部归还给寇员外

dialogue.en: You got everything from the real robbers
dialogue.ipa: ju ɡɑt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ frʌm ðə riəl ˈrɑbərz
dialogue.zh: 你们从真强盗那儿得来的

dialogue.en: Tell me where are the real robbers now
dialogue.ipa: tɛl mi wɛr ɑr ðə riəl ˈrɑbərz naʊ
dialogue.zh: 那告诉我真强盗现在在哪儿

dialogue.en: Oh that was very kind of you
dialogue.ipa: oʊ ðæt wʌz ˈvɛri kaɪnd ʌv ju

dialogue.en: Wukong could tell that the soldier didn't believe him
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ kʊd tɛl ðæt ðə ˈsoʊlʤər ˈdɪdənt bɪˈliv hɪm
dialogue.zh: 悟空能看出士兵不相信他

dialogue.en: By now they had reached the town
dialogue.ipa: baɪ naʊ ðeɪ hæd riʧt ðə taʊn

dialogue.en: A crowd of people had gathered to watch
dialogue.ipa: ə kraʊd ʌv ˈpipəl hæd ˈɡæðərd tu wɑʧ

dialogue.en: The soldiers brought the travelers into the courthouse
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈsoʊlʤərz brɔt ðə ˈtrævələrz ˈɪntu ðə ˈkɔrtˌhaʊs
dialogue.zh: 士兵们将旅人们带入公堂

dialogue.en: The judge frowned at the monk and the others
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤʌʤ fraʊnd æt ðə mʌŋk ænd ði ˈʌðərz
dialogue.zh: 法官对着和尚等人皱起眉头

dialogue.en: We're making an important journey to visit Buddha
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈmeɪkɪŋ ən ɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈʤɜrni tu ˈvɪzət ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 我们正进行重要的旅程去拜见佛祖

dialogue.en: Buddha doesn't allow killers in the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə ˈdʌzənt əˈlaʊ ˈkɪlərz ɪn ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 佛祖不会允许杀人者进入西方极乐世界

dialogue.en: The Tang monk's face went pale
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋks feɪs wɛnt peɪl

dialogue.en: The judge narrowed his eyes at the monk
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤʌʤ ˈnɛroʊd hɪz aɪz æt ðə mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 法官眯起眼睛盯着和尚

dialogue.en: And lady kou saw you do it
dialogue.ipa: ænd ˈleɪdi kou sɔ ju du ɪt
dialogue.zh: 寇夫人看见你做了这件事

dialogue.en: The travelers were shoved into a jail cell
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz wɜr ʃʌvd ˈɪntu ə ʤeɪl sɛl
dialogue.zh: 旅行者们被推进了牢房

dialogue.en: And the door was slammed shut
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə dɔr wʌz slæmd ʃʌt

dialogue.en: The Tang monk started to cry
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈstɑrtɪd tu kraɪ

dialogue.zh: 唐僧露出了感激的神情
我们必须证明自己的清白

dialogue.en: That night Wukong turned into a bee and flew out of the jail and to squire kou's house
dialogue.ipa: ðæt naɪt wu kɔŋ tɜrnd ˈɪntu ə bi ænd flu aʊt ʌv ðə ʤeɪl ænd tu skwaɪr kou's haʊs
dialogue.zh: 那天晚上,悟空变成一只蜜蜂飞出牢房,飞到了寇员外的家

dialogue.en: He found lady kou mourning over a coffin
dialogue.ipa: hi faʊnd ˈleɪdi kou ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈoʊvər ə ˈkɔfɪn
dialogue.zh: 他发现寇夫人正在一口棺材前哀悼

dialogue.en: The monkey changed back into himself and hid behind a curtain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ʧeɪnʤd bæk ˈɪntu hɪmˈsɛlf ænd hɪd bɪˈhaɪnd ə ˈkɜrtən
dialogue.zh: 猴子变回原形,躲在了帘子后面

dialogue.en: Imitating the squire's voice he said
dialogue.ipa: ˈɪməˌteɪtɪŋ ðə skwaɪrz vɔɪs hi sɛd
dialogue.zh: 他模仿着员外的声音说道

dialogue.en: My lady it's me your husband
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈleɪdi ɪts mi jʊər ˈhʌzbənd

dialogue.en: Why did you tell the judge that the Tang monk and his companions killed me
dialogue.ipa: waɪ dɪd ju tɛl ðə ʤʌʤ ðæt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz kɪld mi
dialogue.zh: 你为什么要告诉法官是唐僧和他的同伴杀了我?

dialogue.ipa: aɪ aɪ wʌz ˈæŋɡri wɪð ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 我 ...... 我对他们很生气

dialogue.en: You wanted them to stay here
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈwɔntɪd ðɛm tu steɪ hir

dialogue.en: That was an insult to us
dialogue.ipa: ðæt wʌz ən ˈɪnˌsʌlt tu ʌs

dialogue.en: You have done a terrible thing
dialogue.ipa: ju hæv dʌn ə ˈtɛrəbəl θɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 你做了一件非常糟糕的事

dialogue.en: The walls of the house shook
dialogue.ipa: ðə wɔlz ʌv ðə haʊs ʃʊk

dialogue.en: Tomorrow you must tell the judge that the Tang monk and his companions are innocent
dialogue.ipa: təˈmɑˌroʊ ju mʌst tɛl ðə ʤʌʤ ðæt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ɑr ˈɪnəsənt
dialogue.zh: 明天你必须告诉法官,唐僧和他的同伴是无辜的

dialogue.en: I will haunt you for the rest of your life
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl hɔnt ju fɔr ðə rɛst ʌv jʊər laɪf

dialogue.en: Tears poured from the woman's eyes
dialogue.ipa: tɛrz pɔrd frʌm ðə ˈwʊmənz aɪz
dialogue.zh: 泪水从女人的眼中涌出

dialogue.en: I will talk to the judge tomorrow ,I promise
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl tɔk tu ðə ʤʌʤ təˈmɑˌroʊ aɪ ˈprɑməs
dialogue.zh: 我明天会去和法官说的,我保证

dialogue.en: Wukong flew back to the courthouse
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ flu bæk tu ðə ˈkɔrt ˌhaʊs

dialogue.en: He saw the judge sitting at a desk reading some papers
dialogue.ipa: hi sɔ ðə ʤʌʤ ˈsɪtɪŋ æt ə dɛsk ˈrɛdɪŋ sʌm ˈpeɪpərz
dialogue.zh: 他看见法官正坐在桌边读着一些文件

dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ flu ˈoʊvər ðə ruf

dialogue.en: Then he turned into an enormous spirit body and lowered one foot
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi tɜrnd ˈɪntu ən ɪˈnɔrməs ˈspɪrət ˈbɑdi ænd ˈloʊərd wʌn fʊt
dialogue.zh: 然后他变成了一个巨大的灵体,降下了一只脚

dialogue.en: When the judge saw the giant foot he gasped
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðə ʤʌʤ sɔ ðə ˈʤaɪənt fʊt hi ɡæspt
dialogue.zh: 当法官看到那只巨脚时,他倒吸了一口凉气

dialogue.en: The paper spell from his hands
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈpeɪpər spɛl frʌm hɪz hændz

dialogue.zh: 悟空的声音如雷般响起

dialogue.en: And I was sent here by Buddha
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ wʌz sɛnt hir baɪ ˈbudə

dialogue.en: The Tang monk didn't kill squire kou
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ˈdɪdənt kɪl skwaɪr kou

dialogue.en: The monk is on an important journey
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ɪz ɑn ən ɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 这位僧人肩负着重要的使命

dialogue.en: If you don't free him and his companions
dialogue.ipa: ɪf ju doʊnt fri hɪm ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 如果你不释放他和他的同伴

dialogue.en: I will lower my other foot
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl ˈloʊər maɪ ˈʌðər fʊt

dialogue.en: Then I will stomp all over this town until there is nothing left
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn aɪ wɪl stɑmp ɔl ˈoʊvər ðɪs taʊn ənˈtɪl ðɛr ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ lɛft
dialogue.zh: 然后我会把整个镇子踩得片甲不留

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said the Tang monk
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Soldiers were bringing the travelers back to the town
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: By now they had reached the town
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: You wanted them to stay here
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Then I will stomp all over this town until there is nothing left
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: You have done a terrible thing
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I'll find out tonight
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: The travelers were shoved into a jail cell
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We can't go to jail
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: Wukong could tell that the soldier didn't believe him
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We must prove our innocence
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: We were going to return it all to squire kou
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Tell me where are the real robbers now
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: Then I will stomp all over this town until there is nothing left
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: You also had the two horses that were stolen from his stable
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: If you don't
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

collocations.context: I let them go
By now they had reached the town
We're making an important journey to visit Buddha
The judge shook his head
The Tang monk started to cry
I'll find out tonight
Thank you Wukong
That night Wukong turned into a bee and flew out of the jail and to squire kou's house
You wanted them to stay here
I will talk to the judge tomorrow ,I promise
Wukong flew back to the courthouse
Wukong flew over the roof

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 102 the prisoners are released

dialogue.en: Lady kou ran into the courthouse early the next morning
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪdi kou ræn ˈɪntu ðə ˈkɔrtˌhaʊs ˈɜrli ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 第二天一早,寇夫人冲进了衙门

dialogue.en: She told the judge that she had lied the day before
dialogue.ipa: ʃi toʊld ðə ʤʌʤ ðæt ʃi hæd laɪd ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔr
dialogue.zh: 告诉法官她前一天撒了谎

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and his companions are innocent
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ɑr ˈɪnəsənt
dialogue.zh: 唐僧和他的同伴是无辜的

dialogue.en: I was going to release the prisoners this morning
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu riˈlis ðə ˈprɪzənərz ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 我今早本就打算释放囚犯

dialogue.en: He explained how the wandering spirit had visited him the night before
dialogue.ipa: hi ɪkˈspleɪnd haʊ ðə ˈwɑndərɪŋ ˈspɪrət hæd ˈvɪzɪtɪd hɪm ðə naɪt bɪˈfɔr
dialogue.zh: 他解释了昨晚游魂如何来找过他

dialogue.en: My husband visited me last night
dialogue.ipa: maɪ ˈhʌzbənd ˈvɪzɪtɪd mi læst naɪt
dialogue.zh: 我丈夫昨晚也来找我了

dialogue.en: We must release the prisoners at once
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst riˈlis ðə ˈprɪzənərz æt wʌns
dialogue.zh: 我们必须立刻释放囚犯

dialogue.en: They hurried to the Tang monk's cell
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ ˈhɜrid tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋks sɛl
dialogue.zh: 他们急忙赶到唐僧的牢房

dialogue.en: A guard swung open the cell door
dialogue.ipa: ə ɡɑrd swʌŋ ˈoʊpən ðə sɛl dɔr
dialogue.zh: 一名守卫猛地打开了牢门

dialogue.en: I'm glad to be out of there
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ɡlæd tu bi aʊt ʌv ðɛr
ðə bɛdz wɜr ˈvɛri ən ˈkʌmfərtəbəl

dialogue.en: Lady kou bowed to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪdi kou baʊd tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 寇夫人向唐僧鞠躬致歉

dialogue.en: I framed you for killing my husband
dialogue.ipa: aɪ freɪmd ju fɔr ˈkɪlɪŋ maɪ ˈhʌzbənd
dialogue.zh: 我诬陷你杀害了我的丈夫

dialogue.en: It was a terrible thing to do
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz ə ˈtɛrəbəl θɪŋ tu du
dialogue.zh: 我做了件非常糟糕的事

dialogue.en: It was a really terrible thing to do
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz ə ˈrɪli ˈtɛrəbəl θɪŋ tu du
dialogue.zh: 这确实是件非常糟糕的事

dialogue.en: The Tang monk put his hand on the monkey's shoulder
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk pʊt hɪz hænd ɑn ðə ˈmʌŋkiz ˈʃoʊldər
dialogue.zh: 唐僧把手放在猴子的肩膀上

dialogue.en: The squire was a kind man
dialogue.ipa: ðə skwaɪr wʌz ə kaɪnd mæn

dialogue.en: His death is a terrible tragedy
dialogue.ipa: hɪz dɛθ ɪz ə ˈtɛrəbəl ˈtræʤədi
dialogue.zh: 他的去世是一场巨大的悲剧

dialogue.en: I can probably bring him back to life
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn ˈprɑbəbli brɪŋ hɪm bæk tu laɪf
dialogue.zh: 我或许能让他起死回生

dialogue.en: Lady kou and the judge were shocked
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪdi kou ænd ðə ʤʌʤ wɜr ʃɑkt
dialogue.zh: 寇夫人和法官都震惊了

dialogue.en: Wukong brought the king of the black rooster Kingdom back to life
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ brɔt ðə kɪŋ ʌv ðə blæk ˈrustər ˈkɪŋdəm bæk tu laɪf
dialogue.zh: 悟空曾让乌鸡国国王起死回生

dialogue.en: The sage laozi helped you that time
dialogue.ipa: ðə seɪʤ laozi hɛlpt ju ðæt taɪm
dialogue.zh: 那次是太上老君帮了你

dialogue.en: Will you ask him for help again
dialogue.ipa: wɪl ju æsk hɪm fɔr hɛlp əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: I'll go to the land of darkness and talk to the judge of the dead instead
dialogue.ipa: aɪl ɡoʊ tu ðə lænd ʌv ˈdɑrknəs ænd tɔk tu ðə ʤʌʤ ʌv ðə dɛd ɪnˈstɛd
dialogue.zh: 我还是去阴曹地府找阎王谈谈吧

dialogue.en: When Wukong entered the palace of darkness
dialogue.ipa: wɛn wu kɔŋ ˈɛntərd ðə ˈpæləs ʌv ˈdɑrknəs

dialogue.en: The judge of the dead frowned
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤʌʤ ʌv ðə dɛd fraʊnd
waɪ ɑr ju hir wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: You already made yourself immortal by crossing out your name in the directory
dialogue.ipa: ju ɔlˈrɛdi meɪd jərˈsɛlf ɪˈmɔrtəl baɪ ˈkrɔsɪŋ aʊt jʊər neɪm ɪn ðə dəˈrɛktəri
dialogue.zh: 你早已在生死簿上勾销名字,得了长生不老

dialogue.en: I wondered if you would remember that
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈwʌndərd ɪf ju wʊd rɪ ˈmɛmbər ðæt
dialogue.zh: 我还以为你记得这事呢

dialogue.en: I'm looking for squire kou's name
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔr skwaɪr kou's neɪm

dialogue.en: The judge opened the directory and flipped through some pages
dialogue.ipa: ðə ʤʌʤ ˈoʊpənd ðə dəˈrɛktəri ænd flɪpt θru sʌm ˈpeɪʤəz
dialogue.zh: 阎王翻开生死簿,翻了几页

dialogue.en: He now works for the bodhisattva Dayuan in the Jade Palace
dialogue.ipa: hi naʊ wɜrks fɔr ðə bodhisattva Dayuan ɪn ðə ʤeɪd ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 如今在玉华宫为大愿菩萨当差

dialogue.en: It's here in the land of darkness
dialogue.ipa: ɪts hir ɪn ðə lænd ʌv ˈdɑrknəs

dialogue.en: Wukong went to the Jade Palace
dialogue.ipa: Wukong wɛnt tu ðə ʤeɪd ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: Two nights ago a friend of mine
dialogue.ipa: tu naɪts əˈɡoʊ ə frɛnd ʌv maɪn

dialogue.en: Squire kou was killed and brought here
dialogue.ipa: skwaɪr kou wʌz kɪld ænd brɔt hir
dialogue.zh: 寇员外遇害被带到了这里

dialogue.en: I would like to bring him back to earth
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʊd laɪk tu brɪŋ hɪm bæk tu ɜrθ
ðə bodhisattva reɪzd ən ˈaɪ ˌbraʊ

dialogue.en: You want him to return to life
dialogue.ipa: ju wɑnt hɪm tu rɪˈtɜrn tu laɪf

dialogue.en: I'm helping the Tang monk reach the western paradise to fetch the true scriptures
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈhɛlpɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrə ˌdaɪs tu fɛʧ ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz
dialogue.zh: 我正护送唐僧前往西天取真经

dialogue.en: The squire was very kind to us
dialogue.ipa: ðə skwaɪr wʌz ˈvɛri kaɪnd tu ʌs
dialogue.zh: 寇员外待我们十分仁厚

dialogue.en: The squire may return to earth until it's time for him to come back here
dialogue.ipa: ðə skwaɪr meɪ rɪˈtɜrn tu ɜrθ ənˈtɪl ɪts taɪm fɔr hɪm tu kʌm bæk hir
dialogue.zh: 寇员外可暂返阳间,待命数尽时再归此地

dialogue.en: The bodhisttva brought Wukong to an office
dialogue.ipa: ðə bodhisttva brɔt wu kɔŋ tu ən ˈɔfəs
dialogue.zh: 菩萨引悟空来到一处官署

dialogue.en: Squire kou was sitting behind a large desk smiling
dialogue.ipa: skwaɪr kou wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ bɪˈhaɪnd ə lɑrʤ dɛsk ˈsmaɪlɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 寇员外正坐在大案后含笑

dialogue.en: His eyes sparkled when he saw Wukong
dialogue.ipa: hɪz aɪz ˈspɑrkəld wɛn hi sɔ wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 见到悟空时他眼睛一亮

dialogue.en: It's good to see you Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ɡʊd tu si ju wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: I'm taking you back to earth
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ˈteɪkɪŋ ju bæk tu ɜrθ

dialogue.en: You'll return to your job here
dialogue.ipa: jul rɪˈtɜrn tu jʊər ʤɑb hir
dialogue.zh: 你便会回到这里继续任职

dialogue.en: The squire came out from behind his desk and bowed
dialogue.ipa: ðə skwaɪr keɪm aʊt frʌm bɪˈhaɪnd hɪz dɛsk ænd baʊd
dialogue.zh: 寇员外从桌后走出,躬身行礼

dialogue.en: But I would love to see my wife and friends again
dialogue.ipa: bʌt aɪ wʊd lʌv tu si maɪ waɪf ænd frɛndz əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 但我仍渴望再见妻儿与友人一面

dialogue.en: Wukong moved closer to the squire
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ muvd ˈkloʊsər tu ðə skwaɪr

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Lady kou ran into the courthouse early the next morning
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: I was going to release the prisoners this morning
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: She told the judge that she had lied the day before
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: You want him to return to life
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Will you ask him for help again
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Lady kou and the judge were shocked
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: I can probably bring him back to life
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We must release the prisoners at once
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示已经计划、打算做某事，也可根据迹象预测即将发生的事。
grammar.source: I was going to release the prisoners this morning
examples: Wukong is going to enter the cave.
They are going to leave tomorrow.
I am going to ask the king.
Bajie is going to cook dinner.
We are going to cross the river.
The guards are going to open the gate.
It is going to rain.
She is going to tell the truth.
The demon is going to attack.
You are going to hear an amazing story.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: I wondered if you would remember that
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: When Wukong entered the palace of darkness
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 103 The Land of the west

dialogue.en: Wukong returned from the land of darkness
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ rɪˈtɜrnd frʌm ðə lænd ʌv ˈdɑrknəs

dialogue.en: Lady kou brought the travelers back to her house
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪdi kou brɔt ðə ˈtrævələrz bæk tu hɜr haʊs
dialogue.zh: 寇夫人将取经人迎回府中

dialogue.en: Inside the coffin the squire's body was grey and lifeless
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈkɔfɪn ðə skwaɪrz ˈbɑdi wʌz ɡreɪ ænd ˈlaɪfləs
dialogue.zh: 棺椁内的员外身躯灰败毫无生气

dialogue.en: Wukong leaned over the coffin and recited a spell
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ lind ˈoʊvər ðə ˈkɔfɪn ænd rəˈsaɪtəd ə spɛl
dialogue.zh: 悟空俯身棺前诵念真言

dialogue.en: Lady kou gasped as color returned to her husband's face
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪdi kou ɡæspt æz ˈkʌlər rɪˈtɜrnd tu hɜr ˈhʌzbəndz feɪs
dialogue.zh: 眼见丈夫面色渐复红润,寇夫人倒抽一口气

dialogue.en: The squire is coming back to life
dialogue.ipa: ðə skwaɪr ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ bæk tu laɪf

dialogue.en: Maybe the squire will thank us with a big feast
dialogue.ipa: ˈmeɪbi ðə ˈskwaɪər wɪl θæŋk ʌs wɪð ə bɪɡ fiːst
dialogue.zh: 说不定乡绅会设宴重谢我们

dialogue.en: Squire kou sat up and smiled
dialogue.ipa: skwaɪr kou sæt ʌp ænd smaɪld
dialogue.zh: 寇员外坐起身展颜而笑

dialogue.en: He climbed out of the coffin and turned to his wife
dialogue.ipa: hi klaɪmd aʊt ʌv ðə ˈkɔfɪn ænd tɜrnd tu hɪz waɪf

dialogue.en: That night Squire and Lady kou held a feast to thank Wukong
dialogue.ipa: ðæt naɪt skwaɪr ænd ˈleɪdi kou hɛld ə fist tu θæŋk wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 当夜寇员外夫妇设宴酬谢悟空

dialogue.en: And the next morning they let the travelers leave without any argument
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə nɛkst ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðeɪ lɛt ðə ˈtrævələrz liv wɪˈθaʊt ˈɛni ˈɑrɡjəmənt
dialogue.zh: 翌日清晨他们未加挽留便送取经人启程

dialogue.en: Called Lady kou as they departed
dialogue.ipa: kɔld ˈleɪdi kou æz ðeɪ dɪˈpɑrtɪd

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and his companions traveled for many more months
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz ˈtrævəld fɔr ˈmɛni mɔr mʌnθs
dialogue.zh: 唐僧师徒又跋涉了数月之久

dialogue.en: One day the road went into a beautiful land
dialogue.ipa: wʌn deɪ ðə roʊd wɛnt ˈɪntu ə ˈbjutəfəl lænd
dialogue.zh: 一日道路延伸至风光旖旎之地

dialogue.en: There were flowers and magnificent trees
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wɜr ˈflaʊərz ænd mæɡˈnɪfəsənt triz
dialogue.zh: 但见繁花似锦古木参天

dialogue.en: People smiled at the travelers and offered food
dialogue.ipa: ˈpipəl smaɪld æt ðə ˈtrævələrz ænd ˈɔfərd fud
dialogue.zh: 路人皆向取经者微笑赠食

dialogue.en: The Tang monk stared in amazement
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stɛrd ɪn ə ˈmeɪzmənt

dialogue.en: We are very close to the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: wi ɑr ˈvɛri kloʊs tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs

dialogue.en: A woman held out a basket of plums
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈwʊmən hɛld aʊt ə ˈbæskət ʌv plʌmz
dialogue.zh: 有位妇人递来一篮梅子

dialogue.en: Pointing to a row of tall buildings
dialogue.ipa: ˈpɔɪntɪŋ tu ə roʊ ʌv tɔl ˈbɪldɪŋz

dialogue.en: The road led through a large gate in the abbey
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊd lɛd θru ə lɑrʤ ɡeɪt ɪn ði ˈæbi
dialogue.zh: 道路穿过寺院的一扇大门

dialogue.en: At the gate the monk got down from his horse
dialogue.ipa: æt ðə ɡeɪt ðə mʌŋk ɡɑt daʊn frʌm hɪz hɔrs
dialogue.zh: 在门口,和尚从马上下来
一个年轻人向他们打招呼

dialogue.en: He waved toward the rest of the group
dialogue.ipa: hi weɪvd təˈwɔrd ðə rɛst ʌv ðə ɡrup
dialogue.zh: 他朝队伍的其他成员挥了挥手

dialogue.en: I was starting to think that the bodhisattva guan Yin had tricked me
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ˈstɑrtɪŋ tu θɪŋk ðæt ðə bodhisattva guan jɪn hæd trɪkt mi
dialogue.zh: 我开始以为观音菩萨骗了我

dialogue.en: She told me you would arrive in a year or so
dialogue.ipa: ʃi toʊld mi ju wʊd ə ˈraɪv ɪn ə jɪr ɔr soʊ
dialogue.zh: 她告诉我你们大约一年后就会到

dialogue.en: But that was over 10 years ago
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðæt wʌz ˈoʊvər 10 jɪrz əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 但那已经是十多年前的事了

dialogue.en: I wanted to arrive much sooner
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈwɔntɪd tu əˈraɪv mʌʧ ˈsunər

dialogue.en: But we faced many dangers and delays along the way
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wi feɪst ˈmɛni ˈdeɪnʤərz ænd dɪˈleɪz əˈlɔŋ ðə weɪ
dialogue.zh: 但我们在路上遇到了许多危险和耽搁

dialogue.en: And this place wasn't very easy to find either
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɪs pleɪs ˈwɑzənt ˈvɛri ˈizi tu faɪnd ˈiðər
dialogue.zh: 而且这地方也不太好找

dialogue.en: I'm the great immortal of the Golden Head
dialogue.ipa: aɪm ðə ɡreɪt ɪˈmɔrtəl ʌv ðə ˈɡoʊldən hɛd

dialogue.en: And this abbey is my home
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðɪs ˈæbi ɪz maɪ hoʊm

dialogue.en: Beyond it lies the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: bɪˈɑnd ɪt laɪz ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrə ˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 过了这里就是西方极乐世界

dialogue.en: Come inside and rest before you continue
dialogue.ipa: kʌm ɪnˈsaɪd ænd rɛst bɪˈfɔr ju kənˈtɪnju
dialogue.zh: 进来休息一下再继续赶路吧

dialogue.en: Servants filled tubs with warm perfumed water
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɜrvənts fɪld tʌbz wɪð wɔrm pərˈfjumd ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 仆人们用温暖的香水注满浴桶

dialogue.en: It feels good to get clean
dialogue.ipa: ɪt filz ɡʊd tu ɡɛt klin

dialogue.en: I haven't had a bath in months
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈhævənt hæd ə bæθ ɪn mʌnθs
dialogue.zh: 我已经好几个月没洗澡了

dialogue.en: Now we won't have to cover our noses when you're near
dialogue.ipa: naʊ wi woʊnt hæv tu ˈkʌvər ˈaʊər ˈnoʊzɪz wɛn jʊr nɪr
dialogue.zh: 现在你靠近时我们就不用捂着鼻子了

dialogue.en: Bajie snorted and splashed water at Wukong
dialogue.ipa: Bajie ˈsnɔrtɪd ænd splæʃt ˈwɔtər æt wu kɔŋ
dialogue.zh: 八戒哼了一声,朝悟空泼水

dialogue.en: After their baths the Tang monk put on the Buddhist robe Guan Yin had given him
dialogue.ipa: ˈæftər ðɛr bæθs ðə tæŋ mʌŋk pʊt ɑn ðə ˈbudəst roʊb Guan jɪn hæd ˈɡɪvən hɪm
dialogue.zh: 洗完澡后,唐僧穿上了观音赐予的袈裟

dialogue.en: Then the travelers enjoyed a large meal with the immortal
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn ðə ˈtrævələrz ɛnˈʤɔɪd ə lɑrʤ mil wɪð ði ɪˈmɔrtəl
dialogue.zh: 随后旅行者们与大仙享用了一顿丰盛的餐食

dialogue.en: Servants brought trays loaded with noodles
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɜrvənts brɔt treɪz ˈloʊdɪd wɪð ˈnudəlz
dialogue.zh: 仆人们端来装满面条的托盘

dialogue.en: In the morning the immortal led the group out the back door of the abbey
dialogue.ipa: ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ði ɪˈmɔrtəl lɛd ðə ɡrup aʊt ðə bæk dɔr ʌv ði ˈæbi
dialogue.zh: 早晨,大仙带领众人从寺院后门出去

dialogue.en: Through a land even more beautiful and magical
dialogue.ipa: θru ə lænd ˈivɪn mɔr ˈbjutəfəl ænd ˈmæʤɪkəl
dialogue.zh: 穿过一片更加美丽神奇的土地

dialogue.en: Birds sang as animals leaped playfully through the flowers
dialogue.ipa: bɜrdz sæŋ æz ˈænəməlz lɛpt ˈpleɪfəli θru ðə ˈflaʊərz
dialogue.zh: 鸟儿歌唱,动物在花丛中嬉戏跳跃

dialogue.ipa: ˈbrɪljənt laɪt ˈspɑrkəld ɑn ˈɛvri ˌθɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 灿烂的光芒在万物上闪烁

dialogue.en: In the distance stood a huge mountain
dialogue.ipa: ɪn ðə ˈdɪstəns stʊd ə hjuʤ ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 远处矗立着一座巨大的山

dialogue.en: Its peak was hidden by clouds
dialogue.ipa: ɪts pik wʌz ˈhɪdən baɪ klaʊdz

dialogue.en: The Tang monk stared silently at the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stɛrd ˈsaɪləntli æt ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 唐僧静静地凝视着那座山

dialogue.en: Wukong put his hand on the monk's shoulder
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pʊt hɪz hænd ɑn ðə mʌŋks ˈʃoʊldər
dialogue.zh: 悟空把手搭在和尚的肩膀上
这才是灵山主人的气魄

dialogue.en: We're almost at the end of our journey
dialogue.ipa: wir ˈɔlˌmoʊst æt ði ɛnd ʌv ˈaʊər ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 我们的旅程就快结束了

dialogue.en: A smile spread across the monk's face
dialogue.ipa: ə smaɪl sprɛd əˈkrɔs ðə mʌŋks feɪs
dialogue.zh: 和尚的脸上绽开了笑容

dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz θæŋkt ði ɪ ˈmɔrtəl

dialogue.en: The steep slopes of the Spirit Mountain towered over them
dialogue.ipa: ðə stip sloʊps ʌv ðə ˈspɪrət ˈmaʊntən ˈtaʊərd ˈoʊvər ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 灵山陡峭的山坡高耸在他们上方

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong returned from the land of darkness
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: I was starting to think that the bodhisattva guan Yin had tricked me
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: I was starting to think that the bodhisattva guan Yin had tricked me
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: We are in the west
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: The squire is coming back to life
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: Maybe the squire will thank us with a big feast
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: Its peak was hidden by clouds
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: Now we won't have to cover our noses when you're near
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: I wanted to arrive much sooner
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Look up ahead
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There were flowers and magnificent trees
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: But that was over 10 years ago
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: Now we won't have to cover our noses when you're near
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: She told me you would arrive in a year or so
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 104 The Tang Monk and the river

dialogue.en: Wukong and his companions walked through the western Paradise
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz wɔkt θru ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrə ˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 悟空和他的同伴们穿行在西天极乐世界

dialogue.en: The road weave through a field of flowers and toward the Spirit Mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə roʊd wiv θru ə fild ʌv ˈflaʊərz ænd təˈwɔrd ðə ˈspɪrət ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 道路蜿蜒穿过一片花田,通向灵山

dialogue.en: Bajie looked up at the huge mountain and shook his head
dialogue.ipa: Bajie lʊkt ʌp æt ðə hjuʤ ˈmaʊntən ænd ʃʊk hɪz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 八戒抬头望着那座大山,摇了摇头

dialogue.en: It won't be easy to climb that
dialogue.ipa: ɪt woʊnt bi ˈizi tu klaɪm ðæt

dialogue.en: Don't ask me to carry you
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt æsk mi tu ˈkæri ju

dialogue.en: The traveler soon arrived at a river with a strong current
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələr sun əˈraɪvd æt ə ˈrɪvər wɪð ə strɔŋ ˈkɜrənt
dialogue.zh: 旅人们很快来到一条水流湍急的河边
浪涛拍打着嶙峋的岩石

dialogue.en: But we must cross it to get to the Spirit Mountain
dialogue.ipa: bʌt wi mʌst krɔs ɪt tu ɡɛt tu ðə ˈspɪrət ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 但我们必须渡过它才能到达灵山

dialogue.en: We will never be able to cross this river safely
dialogue.ipa: wi wɪl ˈnɛvər bi ˈeɪbəl tu krɔs ðɪs ˈrɪvər ˈseɪfli
dialogue.zh: 我们永远不可能安全渡过这条河

dialogue.en: A thin log lay across the river
dialogue.ipa: ə θɪn lɔɡ leɪ əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 一根细长的原木横跨在河面上

dialogue.en: It wobbled and shook as the water rushed under it
dialogue.ipa: ɪt ˈwɑbəld ænd ʃʊk æz ðə ˈwɔtər rʌʃt ˈʌndər ɪt
dialogue.zh: 水流在下方奔涌,原木随之摇晃颤动

dialogue.en: The Tang monk looked at the log
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk lʊkt æt ðə lɔɡ

dialogue.en: We can't walk across that log
dialogue.ipa: wi kænt wɔk əˈkrɔs ðæt lɔɡ
dialogue.zh: 我们不能从那根原木上走过去

dialogue.en: But that log is the only way to reach the Spirit Mountain
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðæt lɔɡ ɪz ði ˈoʊnli weɪ tu riʧ ðə ˈspɪrət ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 但那根原木是通往灵山的唯一途径

dialogue.en: You must believe that it's safe watch me
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst bɪˈliv ðæt ɪts seɪf wɑʧ mi
dialogue.zh: 你们必须相信它是安全的,看我的

dialogue.en: The monkey hopped onto the log and ran across the river and back
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki hɑpt ˈɑntu ðə lɔɡ ænd ræn əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər ænd bæk
dialogue.zh: 猴子跳到原木上,跑过河又跑了回来

dialogue.ipa: ju doʊnt weɪ mʌʧ wu kɔŋ

dialogue.en: But if I step on that log
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ɪf aɪ stɛp ɑn ðæt lɔɡ

dialogue.en: We must walk across the log
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst wɔk əˈkrɔs ðə lɔɡ
dialogue.zh: 我们必须从原木上走过去

dialogue.en: He pulled the Tang monk toward the log
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊld ðə tæŋ mʌŋk tə ˈwɔrd ðə lɔɡ
dialogue.zh: 他将唐僧拉向那根木头

dialogue.en: Don't make me walk across that
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt meɪk mi wɔk əˈkrɔs ðæt

dialogue.en: I'll fall into the river and drown
dialogue.ipa: aɪl fɔl ˈɪntu ðə ˈrɪvər ænd draʊn

dialogue.en: Let's just fly over the river
dialogue.ipa: lɛts ʤʌst flaɪ ˈoʊvər ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: We could carry master and the horse
dialogue.ipa: wi kʊd ˈkæri ˈmæstər ænd ðə hɔrs
dialogue.zh: 我们可以驮着师父和马

dialogue.en: The Tang monk must make the entire journey by himself
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk mʌst meɪk ði ɪnˈtaɪər ˈʤɜrni baɪ hɪmˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 唐僧必须全程自己走完

dialogue.en: Buddha won't allow master to have the true scriptures if he doesn't take every step himself
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə woʊnt əˈlaʊ ˈmæstər tu hæv ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz ɪf hi ˈdʌzənt teɪk ˈɛvəri stɛp hɪmˈsɛlf
dialogue.zh: 如果师父不亲自走每一步,佛祖不会让他得到真经

dialogue.en: Just then an old man appeared in a boat
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn ən oʊld mæn ə ˈpɪrd ɪn ə boʊt
dialogue.zh: 就在这时,一位老人驾着小船出现了

dialogue.en: I can take you across the river
dialogue.ipa: aɪ kæn teɪk ju əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: My companion wanted me to walk across that log but
dialogue.ipa: maɪ kəm ˈpænjən ˈwɔntɪd mi tu wɔk əˈkrɔs ðæt lɔɡ bʌt
dialogue.zh: 我的同伴想让我走那根木头,但是

dialogue.en: There's something wrong with your boat
dialogue.ipa: ðɛrz ˈsʌmθɪŋ rɔŋ wɪð jʊər boʊt

dialogue.en: Water is flowing right through it
dialogue.ipa: ˈwɔtər ɪz ˈfloʊɪŋ raɪt θru ɪt

dialogue.en: The Tang monk stepped into the boat
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stɛpt ˈɪntu ðə boʊt

dialogue.en: He was shocked to find that he didn't sink
dialogue.ipa: hi wʌz ʃɑkt tu faɪnd ðæt hi ˈdɪdənt sɪŋk
dialogue.zh: 他惊讶地发现自己并没有沉下去

dialogue.en: He sat on the edge of the boat as Wu Jing led the horse aboard
dialogue.ipa: hi sæt ɑn ði ɛʤ ʌv ðə boʊt æz wu ʤɪŋ lɛd ðə hɔrs əˈbɔrd
dialogue.zh: 他坐在船边,悟净牵着马上了船

dialogue.ipa: Ba ʤi ænd wu kɔŋ ˈfɑloʊd
dialogue.zh: 八戒和悟空也跟了上来

dialogue.en: The boat glided swiftly across the river
dialogue.ipa: ðə boʊt ˈɡlaɪdɪd ˈswɪftli ə ˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: The Tang monk looked at the water and saw a body floating downstream
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk lʊkt æt ðə ˈwɔtər ænd sɔ ə ˈbɑdi ˈfloʊtɪŋ ˈdaʊnˈstrim
dialogue.zh: 唐僧看向水面,看到一具尸体顺流而下

dialogue.en: Wukong put his hand on the monk's shoulder and smiled
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ pʊt hɪz hænd ɑn ðə mʌŋks ˈʃoʊldər ænd smaɪld
dialogue.zh: 悟空把手放在和尚的肩膀上,笑了

dialogue.en: The Tang monk looked at the body more carefully
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk lʊkt æt ðə ˈbɑdi mɔr ˈkɛrfəli
dialogue.zh: 唐僧更仔细地看了看那具躯体

dialogue.en: It was wearing the same Buddhist robe that he was wearing
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz ˈwɛrɪŋ ðə seɪm ˈbudəst roʊb ðæt hi wʌz ˈwɛrɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 它穿着和他一样的僧袍

dialogue.en: You got rid of your mortal body master
dialogue.ipa: ju ɡɑt rɪd ʌv jʊər ˈmɔrtəl ˈbɑdi ˈmæstər

dialogue.en: The boat soon reached the other riverbank
dialogue.ipa: ðə boʊt sun riʧt ði ˈʌðər ˈrɪvərˌbæŋk

dialogue.en: As they walked up the slope of the Spirit Mountain
dialogue.ipa: æz ðeɪ wɔkt ʌp ðə sloʊp ʌv ðə ˈspɪrət ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 当他们走上灵山的山坡时

dialogue.en: The Tang monk laughed in amazement
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk læft ɪn ə ˈmeɪzmənt

dialogue.en: I feel like I could run right up this mountain
dialogue.ipa: aɪ fil laɪk aɪ kʊd rʌn raɪt ʌp ðɪs ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 仿佛能一口气跑上山去

dialogue.en: Everybody laughed as they continued up the mountain
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvri ˌbɑdi læft æz ðeɪ kənˈtɪnjud ʌp ðə ˈmaʊntən
dialogue.zh: 众人笑着继续向山上走去

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Wukong and his companions walked through the western Paradise
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: It was wearing the same Buddhist robe that he was wearing
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I believe Wukong
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Water is flowing right through it
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: A man has drowned
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: We will never be able to cross this river safely
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: He was shocked to find that he didn't sink
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We can't walk across that log
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: We could carry master and the horse
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But we must cross it to get to the Spirit Mountain
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's just go home
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Look over there
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's something wrong with your boat
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: But if I step on that log
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: 原因, so + 结果
grammar.description: so 表示“所以”，连接前面的原因和后面的结果。
grammar.source: I feel so light
examples: It was dark, so they stopped for the night.
The river was deep, so Wukong built a bridge.
Bajie was hungry, so he looked for food.
The gate was locked, so they waited outside.
The demon was strong, so Wukong used magic.
It began to rain, so they entered the cave.
The monk was tired, so they took a rest.
The guards heard a noise, so they ran to the gate.
The road was blocked, so they chose another path.
The villagers were safe, so everyone relaxed.

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 105 The Thunderclap Monastery

dialogue.en: The travelers walked up the Spirit Mountain
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz wɔkt ʌp ðə ˈspɪrət ˈmaʊntən

dialogue.en: The mountain slopes were covered in pine trees
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmaʊntən sloʊps wɜr ˈkʌvərd ɪn paɪn triz

dialogue.en: Birds sang and small animals ran by
dialogue.ipa: bɜrdz sæŋ ænd smɔl ˈænəməlz ræn baɪ

dialogue.en: The Tang monk stopped walking and turned to his companions
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stɑpt ˈwɔkɪŋ ænd tɜrnd tu hɪz kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 唐僧停步转身面向同伴

dialogue.en: I want to thank you all
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɑnt tu θæŋk ju ɔl

dialogue.en: You have helped me to reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ju hæv hɛlpt mi tu riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 是你们助我抵达西天乐土

dialogue.en: You saved me from demons countless times
dialogue.ipa: ju seɪvd mi frʌm ˈdimənz ˈkaʊntləs taɪmz
dialogue.zh: 无数次将我从妖魔手中解救

dialogue.en: I couldn't have gotten here without you
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈkʊdənt hæv ˈɡɑtən hir wɪˈθaʊt ju
dialogue.zh: 若无你们,我绝无可能至此

dialogue.en: You don't need to thank us master
dialogue.ipa: ju doʊnt nid tu θæŋk ʌs ˈmæstər

dialogue.en: You helped me to be good
dialogue.ipa: ju hɛlpt mi tu bi ɡʊd

dialogue.en: Now I will earn forgiveness for the evil things I did long ago
dialogue.ipa: naʊ aɪ wɪl ɜrn fərˈɡɪvnəs fɔr ði ˈivəl θɪŋz aɪ dɪd lɔŋ əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 如今我将赎清往日罪孽

dialogue.en: And I will earn forgiveness for breaking that glass in heaven
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ wɪl ɜrn fərˈɡɪvnəs fɔr ˈbreɪkɪŋ ðæt ɡlæs ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 我也将弥补打碎天庭琉璃的过错

dialogue.en: I will earn forgiveness for causing trouble in heaven too
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl ɜrn fərˈɡɪvnəs fɔr ˈkɑzɪŋ ˈtrʌbəl ɪn ˈhɛvən tu

dialogue.zh: 还有我在天庭惹的祸事也要偿还

dialogue.en: He waved a hand toward the horse
dialogue.ipa: hi weɪvd ə hænd təˈwɔrd ðə hɔrs

dialogue.en: That horse is really a dragon
dialogue.ipa: ðæt hɔrs ɪz ˈrɪli ə ˈdræɡən

dialogue.en: He accidentally set fire to his father's palace
dialogue.ipa: hi ˌæksəˈdɛntəli sɛt ˈfaɪər tu hɪz ˈfɑðərz ˈpæləs

dialogue.en: They continued up the mountain and were soon surrounded by clouds
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ kənˈtɪnjud ʌp ðə ˈmaʊntən ænd wɜr sun səˈraʊndɪd baɪ klaʊdz
dialogue.zh: 他们继续登山,很快便隐入云霭之中

dialogue.en: Bright light shone from the Thunderclap monastery above
dialogue.ipa: braɪt laɪt ʃoʊn frʌm ðə Thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri əˈbʌv
dialogue.zh: 明亮的光芒从上方雷音寺照射下来

dialogue.en: The travelers arrived at an enormous gate
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz əˈraɪvd æt ən ɪˈnɔrməs ɡeɪt
dialogue.zh: 旅人们抵达了一扇巨大的门前

dialogue.en: The Thunderclap monastery's towers and arches sparkled with bright light
dialogue.ipa: ðə Thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛriz ˈtaʊərz ænd ˈɑrʧəz ˈspɑrkəld wɪð braɪt laɪt
dialogue.zh: 雷音寺的塔楼与拱门闪耀着明亮的光芒

dialogue.en: Said the monk to the guards
dialogue.ipa: sɛd ðə mʌŋk tu ðə ɡɑrdz

dialogue.en: And I'm here to receive the true scriptures from Buddha
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪm hir tu rəˈsiv ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz frʌm ˈbudə

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and his companions reached a large hall
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz riʧt ə lɑrʤ hɔl
dialogue.zh: 唐僧与同伴们来到一座宏伟的大殿

dialogue.en: Buddha sat at the opposite end of the hall
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə sæt æt ði ˈɑpəzət ɛnd ʌv ðə hɔl
dialogue.zh: 佛祖端坐在大殿的另一端

dialogue.en: Other Buddhas and bodhisattvas stood behind him
dialogue.ipa: ˈʌðər ˈbudəz ænd boʊdɪˈsɑtvəs stʊd bɪˈhaɪnd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 其他佛与菩萨侍立其后

dialogue.en: Guan Yin was standing next to Buddha and smiling
dialogue.ipa: Guan jɪn wʌz ˈstændɪŋ nɛkst tu ˈbudə ænd ˈsmaɪlɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 观音正站在佛祖身旁微笑

dialogue.en: You have all traveled far and faced many challenges
dialogue.ipa: ju hæv ɔl ˈtrævəld fɑr ænd feɪst ˈmɛni ˈʧælənʤɪz
dialogue.zh: 你们远道而来,历经重重磨难

dialogue.en: He wiped a tear from his eye
dialogue.ipa: hi waɪpt ə tɛr frʌm hɪz aɪ

dialogue.en: It was an honor to make the journey
dialogue.ipa: ɪt wʌz ən ˈɑnər tu meɪk ðə ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 能踏上此途是我们的荣幸

dialogue.en: Servants brought a meal to the travelers
dialogue.ipa: ˈsɜrvənts brɔt ə mil tu ðə ˈtrævələrz
dialogue.zh: 侍从为旅人们端来斋饭

dialogue.en: When the travelers were done eating
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ðə ˈtrævələrz wɜr dʌn ˈitɪŋ

dialogue.en: A guard led them to a large room filled with magical light and mist
dialogue.ipa: ə ɡɑrd lɛd ðɛm tu ə lɑrʤ rum fɪld wɪð ˈmæʤɪkəl laɪt ænd mɪst
dialogue.zh: 一名守卫引领他们来到充满灵光雾霭的宏大殿堂

dialogue.en: Inside the chest were countless scrolls
dialogue.ipa: ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ʧɛst wɜr ˈkaʊntləs skroʊlz

dialogue.en: The true scriptures are written on these scrolls
dialogue.ipa: ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz ɑr ˈrɪtən ɑn ðiz skroʊlz
dialogue.zh: 真经便记载在这些卷轴之上

dialogue.en: He picked out three scrolls and handed them to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: hi pɪkt aʊt θri skroʊlz ænd ˈhændɪd ðɛm tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk
dialogue.zh: 他选出三卷经书递给唐僧

dialogue.en: The monk gazed at the scrolls
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ɡeɪzd æt ðə skroʊlz

dialogue.en: Then he handed them to Wu Jing and BaJie
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ˈhændɪd ðɛm tu wu ʤɪŋ ænd BaJie
dialogue.zh: 随后将经卷递给悟净与八戒

dialogue.en: The two spirits carefully wrapped the scrolls and placed them in a bag
dialogue.ipa: ðə tu ˈspɪrɪts ˈkɛrfəli ræpt ðə skroʊlz ænd pleɪst ðɛm ɪn ə bæɡ
dialogue.zh: 两位弟子仔细包裹经卷,装入行囊

dialogue.en: Again the travelers bowed before Buddha
dialogue.ipa: əˈɡɛn ðə ˈtrævələrz baʊd bɪˈfɔr ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 旅人们再次向佛祖行礼

dialogue.en: Take the true scriptures back to the Tang Empire
dialogue.ipa: teɪk ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz bæk tu ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpaɪər

dialogue.en: Don't tell me what to do
dialogue.ipa: doʊnt tɛl mi wɑt tu du

dialogue.en: The scriptures will teach the people there to be good and to treat each other kindly
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈskrɪpʧərz wɪl tiʧ ðə ˈpipəl ðɛr tu bi ɡʊd ænd tu trit iʧ ˈʌðər ˈkaɪndli
dialogue.zh: 这些经文将教导那里的人们向善,并友善相待

dialogue.en: But take good care of the scriptures
dialogue.ipa: bʌt teɪk ɡʊd kɛr ʌv ðə ˈskrɪpʧərz
dialogue.zh: 但要好好保管这些经文

dialogue.en: You shall come back here to receive your rewards
dialogue.ipa: ju ʃæl kʌm bæk hir tu rəˈsiv jʊər rɪˈwɔrdz
dialogue.zh: 你应回到这里来领取奖赏

dialogue.en: We will protect the scriptures with our lives
dialogue.ipa: wi wɪl prəˈtɛkt ðə ˈskrɪpʧərz wɪð ˈaʊər lɪvz
dialogue.zh: 我们会用生命保护经文

dialogue.en: A guard offered to carry the travelers to the Tang empire
dialogue.ipa: ə ɡɑrd ˈɔfərd tu ˈkæri ðə ˈtrævələrz tu ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpaɪər
dialogue.zh: 一位守卫主动提出载旅行者们去大唐帝国

dialogue.en: The guard recited a spell and then flew out of the monastery with the travelers
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑrd rəˈsaɪtəd ə spɛl ænd ðɛn flu aʊt ʌv ðə ˈmɑnəˌstɛri wɪð ðə ˈtrævələrz
dialogue.zh: 守卫念了一个咒语,然后带着旅行者们飞出了寺院

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and his companions have done well
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz hæv dʌn wɛl
dialogue.zh: 唐僧和他的同伴们做得很好

dialogue.en: Wukong especially has Learned a lot during the journey
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ əˈspɛʃli hæz lɜrnd ə lɑt ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 悟空尤其在这段旅程中学到了很多

dialogue.en: I believe he is now a good Buddhist
dialogue.ipa: aɪ bɪˈliv hi ɪz naʊ ə ɡʊd ˈbudəst
dialogue.zh: 我相信他现在是一位好的佛教徒

dialogue.en: Just then a messenger ran into the hall
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn ə ˈmɛsənʤər ræn ˈɪntu ðə hɔl
dialogue.zh: 就在这时,一位信使跑进了大殿

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句

examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句

examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + 疑问词 + 陈述语序

titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 106 the question

dialogue.en: Guanyin looked at the messenger in surprise
dialogue.ipa: Guanyin lʊkt æt ðə ˈmɛsənʤər ɪn sərˈpraɪz

dialogue.en: He needs to face one hundred challenges
dialogue.ipa: hi nidz tu feɪs wʌn ˈhʌndrɪd ˈʧælənʤɪz
dialogue.zh: 他需要面对一百个挑战

dialogue.en: I was just looking at the list of challenges he's faced
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌz ʤʌst ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ðə lɪst ʌv ˈʧælənʤɪz hiz feɪst
dialogue.zh: 我刚才查看了一下他面临的挑战清单

dialogue.en: There are only 99 challenges on the list
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr ɑr ˈoʊnli 99 ˈʧælənʤɪz ɑn ðə lɪst
dialogue.zh: 清单上只有九十九个挑战

dialogue.en: He must face one more challenge to become a Buddha
dialogue.ipa: hi mʌst feɪs wʌn mɔr ˈʧælənʤ tu bɪˈkʌm ə ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 他必须再面对一个挑战才能成佛

dialogue.en: The travelers were flying back east
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz wɜr ˈflaɪɪŋ bæk ist

dialogue.en: The guard from the thunderclap monastery was using a spell to carry them
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑrd frʌm ðə thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri wʌz ˈjuzɪŋ ə spɛl tu ˈkæri ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 雷音寺的守卫正在用咒语载着他们

dialogue.en: I wish the whole journey had been this easy
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪʃ ðə hoʊl ˈʤɜrni hæd bɪn ðɪs ˈizi
dialogue.zh: 真希望整个旅程都这么轻松

dialogue.en: Master was still mortal before we reached the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: ˈmæstər wʌz stɪl ˈmɔrtəl bɪˈfɔr wi riʧt ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 师父在我们到达西天之前还是凡人
那时候他不能被载着飞

dialogue.en: We'll reach the Tang Empire soon
dialogue.ipa: wil riʧ ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpaɪər sun
dialogue.zh: 我们很快就要到达大唐帝国了

dialogue.en: Just then a messenger caught up with them
dialogue.ipa: ʤʌst ðɛn ə ˈmɛsənʤər kɑt ʌp wɪð ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 就在这时,一位信使追上了他们

dialogue.en: The messenger whispered something in the guard's ear
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmɛsənʤər ˈwɪspərd ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn ðə ɡɑrdz ir
dialogue.zh: 信使在守卫耳边低语了几句

dialogue.en: The guard glanced quickly at the travelers
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡɑrd ɡlænst ˈkwɪkli æt ðə ˈtrævələrz
dialogue.zh: 守卫迅速瞥了旅行者们一眼

dialogue.en: Then he looked back at the messenger and nodded
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi lʊkt bæk æt ðə ˈmɛsənʤər ænd ˈnɑdɪd
dialogue.zh: 然后他回头看向信使,点了点头

dialogue.en: And the travelers fell from the sky
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈtrævələrz fɛl frʌm ðə skaɪ

dialogue.en: They slammed into the ground next to a wide river
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ slæmd ˈɪntu ðə ɡraʊnd nɛkst tu ə waɪd ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 他们重重地摔在一条宽阔的河流旁边

dialogue.en: Wukong stood up and saw the guard and messenger flying back west
dialogue.ipa: WuKong stʊd ʌp ænd sɔ ðə ɡɑrd ænd ˈmɛsənʤər ˈflaɪɪŋ bæk wɛst
dialogue.zh: 悟空站起身,看到守卫和信使正往西飞回去

dialogue.en: The Tang monk stood up and brushed dirt from his robe
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk stʊd ʌp ænd brʌʃt dɜrt frʌm hɪz roʊb
dialogue.zh: 唐僧站起来,掸去僧袍上的尘土

dialogue.en: Why did the guard drop us
dialogue.ipa: waɪ dɪd ðə ɡɑrd drɑp ʌs
dialogue.zh: 守卫为什么把我们扔下来

dialogue.en: He thinks it's funny to drop people
dialogue.ipa: hi θɪŋks ɪts ˈfʌni tu drɑp ˈpipəl
dialogue.zh: 他觉得把人扔下来很好玩

dialogue.en: The pig waved his fist at the guard
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ weɪvd hɪz fɪst æt ðə ɡɑrd
dialogue.zh: 猪八戒对着守卫挥舞拳头

dialogue.en: Wukong turned slowly to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ tɜrnd ˈsloʊli tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: I think I know why he dropped us master
dialogue.ipa: aɪ θɪŋk aɪ noʊ waɪ hi drɑpt ʌs ˈmæstər
dialogue.zh: 师父,我想我知道他为什么扔下我们了

dialogue.en: You must face 100 challenges in order to become a Buddha
dialogue.ipa: ju mʌst feɪs 100 ˈʧælənʤɪz ɪn ˈɔrdər tu bɪˈkʌm ə ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 你必须经历一百次磨难才能成佛

dialogue.en: You probably got to the western paradise before you'd faced all of them
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈprɑbəbli ɡɑt tu ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs bɪˈfɔr jud feɪst ɔl ʌv ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 你可能还没经历完所有磨难就到了西天

dialogue.en: So other bad things must happen now
dialogue.ipa: soʊ ˈʌðər bæd θɪŋz mʌst ˈhæpən naʊ
dialogue.zh: 所以现在肯定还会有其他坏事发生

dialogue.en: I hope there won't be too many more problems
dialogue.ipa: aɪ hoʊp ðɛr woʊnt bi tu ˈmɛni mɔr ˈprɑbləmz
dialogue.zh: 希望不会再有太多麻烦了

dialogue.en: The first problem is crossing this river
dialogue.ipa: ðə fɜrst ˈprɑbləm ɪz ˈkrɔsɪŋ ðɪs ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 第一个问题就是渡过这条河

dialogue.en: We must have crossed it during the journey west
dialogue.ipa: wi mʌst hæv krɔst ɪt ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ˈʤɜrni wɛst
dialogue.zh: 我们西行途中一定渡过这条河

dialogue.en: Suddenly a large form rose from the river
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ə lɑrʤ fɔrm roʊz frʌm ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 突然,一个巨大的身影从河中升起

dialogue.en: You carried us over this river many years ago
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈkærid ʌs ˈoʊvər ðɪs ˈrɪvər ˈmɛni jɪrz əˈɡoʊ
dialogue.zh: 多年前你曾载我们渡过这条河

dialogue.en: And I will gladly carry you across again
dialogue.ipa: ænd aɪ wɪl ˈɡlædli ˈkæri ju əˈkrɔs əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 我很乐意再载你们一次

dialogue.en: And the turtle started across the river
dialogue.ipa: ænd ðə ˈtɜrtəl ˈstɑrtɪd əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər

dialogue.en: Wu Jing and BA Jie soon fell asleep while Wukong meditated
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ænd bi-eɪ ʤi sun fɛl əˈslip waɪl wu kɔŋ ˈmɛdəˌteɪtɪd
dialogue.zh: 悟净和八戒很快睡着了,悟空则在打坐

dialogue.en: The Tang monk stayed awake too sitting near the turtle's head
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk steɪd əˈweɪk tu ˈsɪtɪŋ nɪr ðə ˈtɜrtəlz hɛd
dialogue.zh: 唐僧也醒着,坐在乌龟头附近

dialogue.en: Did you reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrə ˌdaɪs

dialogue.en: We are now returning to the east so I can deliver the true scriptures
dialogue.ipa: wi ɑr naʊ rɪˈtɜrnɪŋ tu ði ist soʊ aɪ kæn dɪˈlɪvər ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz
dialogue.zh: 我们如今正返回东土,好让我奉上真经

dialogue.en: Did you ask Buddha when I would be reborn as a human
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju æsk ˈbudə wɛn aɪ wʊd bi ˈriˈbɔrn æz ə ˈhjumən
dialogue.zh: 你可曾向佛祖问过我何时能转世为人

dialogue.en: He had forgotten to ask the turtle's question
dialogue.ipa: hi hæd fərˈɡɑtən tu æsk ðə ˈtɜrtəlz ˈkwɛsʧən

dialogue.en: The turtle suddenly dived under the water
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtɜrtəl ˈsʌdənli daɪvd ˈʌndər ðə ˈwɔtər

dialogue.en: Wukong's eyes flew open as he hit the cold water
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋz aɪz flu ˈoʊpən æz hi hɪt ðə koʊld ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 悟空坠入冷水时猛然睁眼

dialogue.en: Bajie Wu jing and the horse quickly flew across the river
dialogue.ipa: Bajie wu ʤɪŋ ænd ðə hɔrs ˈkwɪkli flu əˈkrɔs ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 八戒、悟净与白马迅疾飞渡过河

dialogue.en: But the Tang monk was thrashing furiously in the rushing water
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə tæŋ mʌŋk wʌz ˈθræʃɪŋ ˈfjʊriəsli ɪn ðə ˈrʌʃɪŋ ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 但唐僧却在激流中拼命挣扎

dialogue.en: Wukong cast a spell and lifted the monk and the bag from the river
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ kæst ə spɛl ænd ˈlɪftɪd ðə mʌŋk ænd ðə bæɡ frʌm ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 悟空念动咒语将师父与经袋提出河面

dialogue.en: When everyone was on dry land
dialogue.ipa: wɛn ˈɛvriˌwʌn wʌz ɑn draɪ lænd

dialogue.en: The monkey turned the bag upside down
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki tɜrnd ðə bæɡ ˈʌpˈsaɪd daʊn

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: He must face one more challenge to become a Buddha
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Help
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There are only 99 challenges on the list
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who was now far away
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: When + 从句, 主句
grammar.description: when 引导时间状语从句，说明主句动作发生的时间。
grammar.source: Did you ask Buddha when I would be reborn as a human
examples: When the sun rose, they continued the journey.
When Wukong returned, everyone was relieved.
When the gate opened, the guards stepped back.
When it stopped raining, they crossed the river.
When the monk spoke, everyone listened.
When night came, they found a place to rest.
When Bajie saw the food, he smiled.
When the demon appeared, Wukong raised his staff.
When they reached the village, the people welcomed them.
When the story ended, the children cheered.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: Wu Jing and BA Jie soon fell asleep while Wukong meditated
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

The travelers were flying back east
Just then a messenger caught up with them
Then he looked back at the messenger and nodded
Wukong stood up and saw the guard and messenger flying back west
The monkey shook his head
You carried us over this river many years ago
