titleEn: Journey to the West Chapter 107 nothing is perfect

dialogue.en: The travelers laid the soaked scrolls on some rocks
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz leɪd ðə soʊkt skroʊlz ɑn sʌm rɑks
dialogue.zh: 行旅们将湿透的经卷铺在岩石上

dialogue.en: The sun will dry them out
dialogue.ipa: ðə sʌn wɪl draɪ ðɛm aʊt

dialogue.zh: 若是真经损毁了该如何是好

dialogue.en: He sat down and put his head in his hands
dialogue.ipa: hi sæt daʊn ænd pʊt hɪz hɛd ɪn hɪz hændz

dialogue.en: I wish I'd remembered to ask Buddha the turtle's question
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪʃ aɪd rɪˈmɛmbərd tu æsk ˈbudə ðə ˈtɜrtəlz ˈkwɛsʧən
dialogue.zh: 早知该记得替老龟问佛祖的

dialogue.en: Who cares if you forgot the turtle's question
dialogue.ipa: hu kɛrz ɪf ju fərˈɡɑt ðə ˈtɜrtəlz ˈkwɛsʧən
dialogue.zh: 忘了老龟的事有何打紧

dialogue.en: That turtle had no right to dump us in the water
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈtɜrtəl hæd noʊ raɪt tu dʌmp ʌs ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər
dialogue.zh: 那老龟也不该将我们掀落水中

dialogue.en: Dumping us in the water was rude
dialogue.ipa: ˈdʌmpɪŋ ʌs ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər wʌz rud

dialogue.en: The journey back east is becoming just as difficult as the journey west
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈʤɜrni bæk ist ɪz bɪˈkʌmɪŋ ʤʌst æz ˈdɪfəkəlt æz ðə ˈʤɜrni wɛst
dialogue.zh: 这东归之路竟与西行时一般艰难

dialogue.en: The travelers turned and saw a man hurrying toward them
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz tɜrnd ænd sɔ ə mæn ˈhɜriɪŋ təˈwɔrd ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 众人回首见一男子疾步而来

dialogue.en: It's good to see you again
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ɡʊd tu si ju əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: It's good to see all of you
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ɡʊd tu si ɔl ʌv ju

dialogue.en: Did you reach the western paradise
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju riʧ ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrə ˌdaɪs
dialogue.zh: 你们到达西天极乐世界了吗

dialogue.en: The land is filled with beauty
dialogue.ipa: ðə lænd ɪz fɪld wɪð ˈbjuti

dialogue.en: Chen noticed the scrolls lying on the rocks
dialogue.ipa: ʧɛn ˈnoʊtəst ðə skroʊlz ˈlaɪɪŋ ɑn ðə rɑks
dialogue.zh: 陈注意到经卷散落在岩石上

dialogue.en: Rocks and his eyes went wide
dialogue.ipa: rɑks ænd hɪz aɪz wɛnt waɪd
dialogue.zh: 岩石,他的眼睛睁得大大的

dialogue.en: A giant turtle dumped us in the river
dialogue.ipa: ə ˈʤaɪənt ˈtɜrtəl dʌmpt ʌs ɪn ðə ˈrɪvər
dialogue.zh: 一只巨龟把我们掀进了河里

dialogue.en: You can dry the true scriptures by my fire
dialogue.ipa: ju kæn draɪ ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz baɪ maɪ ˈfaɪər
dialogue.zh: 你们可以用我的火烘干真经

dialogue.en: Everyone in the village will be excited to see the travelers who met Buddha
dialogue.ipa: ˈɛvriˌwʌn ɪn ðə ˈvɪləʤ wɪl bi ɪkˈsaɪtɪd tu si ðə ˈtrævələrz hu mɛt ˈbudə
dialogue.zh: 村里所有人都会为见到遇见佛祖的旅人而兴奋不已

dialogue.en: Wu Jing started gathering the wet scriptures
dialogue.ipa: wu ʤɪŋ ˈstɑrtɪd ˈɡæðərɪŋ ðə wɛt ˈskrɪpʧərz
dialogue.zh: 悟净开始收拾湿透的经卷

dialogue.en: The pig grabbed a scroll and pulled
dialogue.ipa: ðə pɪɡ ɡræbd ə skroʊl ænd pʊld
dialogue.zh: 猪妖抓起一卷经用力一拉

dialogue.en: But it was stuck to a rock
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ɪt wʌz stʌk tu ə rɑk

dialogue.en: The corner of the scroll tore off
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈkɔrnər ʌv ðə skroʊl tɔr ɔf
dialogue.zh: 经卷的一角被撕了下来

dialogue.en: Bajie stared in horror at the torn scroll
dialogue.ipa: Bajie stɛrd ɪn ˈhɔrər æt ðə tɔrn skroʊl
dialogue.zh: 八戒惊恐地盯着撕破的经卷

dialogue.en: The monkey gently piped the rest of the scroll off the rock
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈʤɛntli paɪpt ðə rɛst ʌv ðə skroʊl ɔf ðə rɑk
dialogue.zh: 猴子轻轻地把经卷的其余部分从岩石上揭下来

dialogue.en: The monk gave Wukong a confused look
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ɡeɪv wu kɔŋ ə kənˈfjuzd lʊk
dialogue.zh: 唐僧困惑地看了悟空一眼

dialogue.en: The Tang monk shook his head
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ʃʊk hɪz hɛd

dialogue.en: We all know he's not perfect
dialogue.ipa: wi ɔl noʊ hiz nɑt pərˈfɛkt
dialogue.zh: 我们都知道他并不完美

dialogue.en: Nothing on earth or in heaven is perfect
dialogue.ipa: ˈnʌθɪŋ ɑn ɜrθ ɔr ɪn ˈhɛvən ɪz ˈpɜrˌfɪkt
dialogue.zh: 天地间没有什么是完美的

dialogue.en: So why should the true scriptures be any different
dialogue.ipa: soʊ waɪ ʃʊd ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz bi ˈɛni ˈdɪfərənt

dialogue.en: They'll teach the people of the east how to be good and avoid suffering
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪl tiʧ ðə ˈpipəl ʌv ði ist haʊ tu bi ɡʊd ænd əˈvɔɪd ˈsʌfərɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 它们将教导东土百姓向善避苦

dialogue.en: They will also teach the people that nothing needs to be perfect
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ wɪl ˈɔlsoʊ tiʧ ðə ˈpipəl ðæt ˈnʌθɪŋ nidz tu bi ˈpɜrˌfɪkt
dialogue.zh: 也会告诉人们万物不必追求完美

dialogue.en: The travelers finished gathering the scrolls and followed Chen back to the village
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz ˈfɪnɪʃt ˈɡæðərɪŋ ðə skroʊlz ænd ˈfɑloʊd ʧɛn bæk tu ðə ˈvɪləʤ
dialogue.zh: 取经人收齐经卷后,跟着陈老爷回到村庄

dialogue.en: People came out of their homes to see the travelers
dialogue.ipa: ˈpipəl keɪm aʊt ʌv ðɛr hoʊmz tu si ðə ˈtrævələrz
dialogue.zh: 村民们纷纷走出家门围观取经人

dialogue.en: It's wonderful to see you all again
dialogue.ipa: ɪts ˈwʌndərfəl tu si ju ɔl əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 能再见到各位真是太好了

dialogue.en: Soon a crowd was following the Tang monk and his companions to Chen's house
dialogue.ipa: sun ə kraʊd wʌz ˈfɑloʊɪŋ ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz tu ʧɛnz haʊs
dialogue.zh: 很快人群便簇拥着唐僧师徒前往陈宅

dialogue.en: That evening the villagers held a big feast
dialogue.ipa: ðæt ˈivnɪŋ ðə ˈvɪlɪʤərz hɛld ə bɪɡ fist
dialogue.zh: 当晚村民设下盛大宴席

dialogue.en: Later that night Wukong and the Tang monk sat talking
dialogue.ipa: ˈleɪtər ðæt naɪt wu kɔŋ ænd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk sæt ˈtɔkɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 夜深时分,悟空与唐僧坐着闲聊

dialogue.en: The villagers will want to see the true scriptures
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈvɪlɪʤərz wɪl wɑnt tu si ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz

dialogue.en: They'll become jealous that we have them
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪl bɪˈkʌm ˈʤɛləs ðæt wi hæv ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 难免会因我们持有经书而生妒心

dialogue.en: He remembered the priest who tried to kill the Tang monk and steal the robe
dialogue.ipa: hi rɪˈmɛmbərd ðə prist hu traɪd tu kɪl ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd stil ðə roʊb
dialogue.zh: 他想起当年那位企图杀害唐僧抢夺袈裟的僧人

dialogue.en: Let's sneak away now while the villagers are asleep
dialogue.ipa: lɛts snik ə ˈweɪ naʊ waɪl ðə ˈvɪlɪʤərz ɑr əˈslip
dialogue.zh: 趁村民熟睡时悄悄走吧

dialogue.en: The monk and the monkey woke up Bajie and Wu Jing
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk ænd ðə ˈmʌŋki woʊk ʌp Bajie ænd wu ʤɪŋ
dialogue.zh: 唐僧与猴子叫醒了八戒和悟净

dialogue.en: The group snuck out of Chen's house and headed east
dialogue.ipa: ðə ɡrup snʌk aʊt ʌv ʧɛnz haʊs ænd ˈhɛdɪd ist
dialogue.zh: 一行人潜出陈宅向东行进

dialogue.en: But the light from the full moon lit up the road
dialogue.ipa: bʌt ðə laɪt frʌm ðə fʊl mun lɪt ʌp ðə roʊd
dialogue.zh: 但满月清辉照亮了道路

dialogue.en: Suddenly the guard from the thunderclap monastery appeared
dialogue.ipa: ˈsʌdənli ðə ɡɑrd frʌm ðə thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri əˈpɪrd
dialogue.zh: 雷音寺的护法突然现身

dialogue.en: I will become a Buddha at last
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl bɪˈkʌm ə ˈbudə æt læst

dialogue.en: Once again the travelers flew toward the east
dialogue.ipa: wʌns əˈɡɛn ðə ˈtrævələrz flu təˈwɔrd ði ist
dialogue.zh: 取经人再度腾云向东飞去

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: Said Wukong
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，常用来交代另一个动作发生时的背景。
grammar.source: Soon a crowd was following the Tang monk and his companions to Chen's house
examples: Wukong was flying through the clouds.
The monk was reading a scripture.
Bajie was looking for food.
Wujing was carrying the luggage.
The demons were waiting outside.
They were walking toward the village.
The king was sitting in the hall.
The children were playing by the river.
It was raining on the mountain.
Everyone was watching the fight.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: They'll become jealous that we have them
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: The journey back east is becoming just as difficult as the journey west
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: You have faced 100 challenges
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: The sun will dry them out
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: The land is filled with beauty
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + can/cannot + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示能力、许可或可能性；can 后接动词原形。
grammar.source: But as you can see
examples: Wukong can fly through the clouds.
Can you open the door?
Bajie can carry the box.
We can rest here.
They cannot cross the river.
The monk can read the scripture.
Can I ask a question?
You can follow this path.
The demon cannot escape.
Everyone can help.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + must/mustn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示必须、强烈推断或禁止，后接动词原形。
grammar.source: We must leave soon
examples: We must leave before dark.
You must tell the truth.
The travelers must cross the mountain.
Wukong must protect his master.
Bajie must carry the bags.
They must not enter the cave.
The guards must watch the gate.
I must find another way.
The monk must remain calm.
Everyone must work together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: So why should the true scriptures be any different
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + want/wants/wanted to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示想要做某事。第三人称单数现在时使用 wants。
grammar.source: The villagers will want to see the true scriptures
examples: I want to see the palace.
Wukong wants to find the demon.
The monk wants to continue the journey.
Bajie wants to eat some fruit.
They want to cross the bridge.
We want to help the villagers.
She wants to speak to the king.
The guards wanted to catch the thief.
He wants to learn magic.
Everyone wants to go home.

grammar.pattern: try/tries/tried to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示努力或尝试做某事。
grammar.source: He remembered the priest who tried to kill the Tang monk and steal the robe
examples: Wukong tried to open the door.
They tried to cross the river.
Bajie tries to lift the rock.
I will try to help you.
The demon tried to escape.
She tried to warn the guards.
We tried to find another path.
The monk tried to remain calm.
He tried to remember the spell.
Everyone tried to push the cart.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Let's sneak away now while the villagers are asleep
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.description: 省略主语 you，以动词原形开头，用于命令、请求、提醒或建议。
grammar.source: Tell me something master
examples: Look at the sky.
Wait by the gate.
Follow the path.
Tell me the truth.
Bring the map with you.
Stand back from the river.
Listen to the monk.
Open the wooden box.
Come back before dark.
Be careful on the bridge.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: Who cares if you forgot the turtle's question
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: What if they're ruined
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

collocations.context: He sat down and put his head in his hands
Did you reach the western paradise
I'll help you
Of course not
The Tang monk shook his head
Nothing on earth or in heaven is perfect
Nothing on earth or in heaven is perfect
They'll teach the people of the east how to be good and avoid suffering
People came out of their homes to see the travelers
The villagers will want to see the true scriptures
He remembered the priest who tried to kill the Tang monk and steal the robe
The monk and the monkey woke up Bajie and Wu Jing
I will become a Buddha at last

titleEn: Journey to the west chapter 108 rewards

dialogue.en: The travelers flew through the sky over the Tang empire
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz flu θru ðə skaɪ ˈoʊvər ðə tæŋ ˈɛmpaɪər

dialogue.en: Tears of happiness rolled down the Tang monk's cheeks
dialogue.ipa: tɛrz ʌv ˈhæpinəs roʊld daʊn ðə tæŋ mʌŋks ʧiks
dialogue.zh: 喜悦的泪水划过唐僧脸颊

dialogue.en: I will wait here while you all deliver the true scriptures
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl weɪt hir waɪl ju ɔl dɪˈlɪvər ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz
dialogue.zh: 我在此等候,你们去呈递真经吧

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and his companions went down to earth and entered the palace
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz wɛnt daʊn tu ɜrθ ænd ˈɛntərd ðə ˈpæləs
dialogue.zh: 唐僧师徒降下云头进入宫殿

dialogue.en: For many years I wondered if I'd ever see you again
dialogue.ipa: fɔr ˈmɛni jɪrz aɪ ˈwʌndərd ɪf aɪd ˈɛvər si ju əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 这些年朕总想着能否再见你一面

dialogue.en: Did you get the true scriptures
dialogue.ipa: dɪd ju ɡɛt ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz

dialogue.en: The journey took much longer than I expected
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈʤɜrni tʊk mʌʧ ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn aɪ ɪkˈspɛktɪd
dialogue.zh: 这段旅程比我预想的要长得多

dialogue.en: Then he noticed the monk's companions
dialogue.ipa: ðɛn hi ˈnoʊtəst ðə mʌŋks kəmˈpænjənz
dialogue.zh: 接着他注意到了僧人的同伴们

dialogue.en: I once defeated heaven's entire army
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʌns dɪˈfitɪd ˈhɛvənz ɪn ˈtaɪər ˈɑrmi

dialogue.en: They protected me during the journey
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ prəˈtɛktɪd mi ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 他们在旅途中保护了我

dialogue.en: I couldn't have reached the western paradise without them
dialogue.ipa: aɪ ˈkʊdənt hæv riʧt ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs wɪˈθaʊt ðɛm
dialogue.zh: 没有他们,我无法抵达西天

dialogue.en: The emperor bowed to Wukong and the others
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛmpərər baʊd tu wu kɔŋ ænd ði ˈʌðərz
dialogue.zh: 皇帝向悟空等人鞠躬致意

dialogue.ipa: wɛl wu ʤɪŋ ænd aɪ wɜr

dialogue.en: Ba jie complained the entire time
dialogue.ipa: Ba ʤi kəmˈpleɪnd ði ɪnˈtaɪər taɪm

dialogue.en: There was a huge feast that night
dialogue.ipa: ðɛr wʌz ə hjuʤ fist ðæt naɪt
dialogue.zh: 当晚举行了盛大的宴会

dialogue.en: The emperor asked the monk many questions about the journey
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛmpərər æskt ðə mʌŋk ˈmɛni ˈkwɛsʧənz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈʤɜrni
dialogue.zh: 皇帝向僧人询问了许多旅途中的事

dialogue.en: He listened in amazement to the monk's stories
dialogue.ipa: hi ˈlɪsənd ɪn ə ˈmeɪzmənt tu ðə mʌŋks ˈstɔriz
dialogue.zh: 他惊叹地听着僧人的故事

dialogue.en: I will build a magnificent pagoda
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wɪl bɪld ə mæɡˈnɪfəsənt pə ˈɡoʊdə
dialogue.zh: 我将建造一座宏伟的宝塔

dialogue.en: The true scriptures will be kept safe inside it
dialogue.ipa: ðə tru ˈskrɪpʧərz wɪl bi kɛpt seɪf ɪnˈsaɪd ɪt

dialogue.en: He put his hand on the monk's shoulder
dialogue.ipa: hi pʊt hɪz hænd ɑn ðə mʌŋks ˈʃoʊldər

dialogue.en: You will always be remembered as the brave monk who traveled to the west
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl ˈɔlˌweɪz bi rɪˈmɛmbərd æz ðə breɪv mʌŋk hu ˈtrævəld tu ðə wɛst
dialogue.zh: 你将永远被铭记为西行取经的勇敢僧人

dialogue.en: Our people won't have to suffer anymore
dialogue.ipa: ˈaʊər ˈpipəl woʊnt hæv tu ˈsʌfər ˌɛniˈmɔr
dialogue.zh: 我们的百姓将不再受苦

dialogue.en: The emperor asked the monk to read from the scriptures
dialogue.ipa: ði ˈɛmpərər æskt ðə mʌŋk tu rid frʌm ðə ˈskrɪpʧərz

dialogue.en: I would be happy to read from them
dialogue.ipa: aɪ wʊd bi ˈhæpi tu rid frʌm ðɛm

dialogue.en: The monk sat on a platform
dialogue.ipa: ðə mʌŋk sæt ɑn ə ˈplætˌfɔrm

dialogue.en: Where the scriptures had been placed in baskets
dialogue.ipa: wɛr ðə ˈskrɪpʧərz hæd bɪn pleɪst ɪn ˈbæskəts
dialogue.zh: 经文已被安放在竹篮中

dialogue.en: The Tang monk and his companions rose into the sky
dialogue.ipa: ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ænd hɪz kəmˈpænjənz roʊz ˈɪntu ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 唐僧与同伴们升向天空

dialogue.en: We should return to the thunderclap monastery
dialogue.ipa: wi ʃʊd rɪˈtɜrn tu ðə thunderclap ˈmɑnəˌstɛri

dialogue.en: The travelers were soon bowing before Buddha again
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈtrævələrz wɜr sun ˈboʊɪŋ bɪˈfɔr ˈbudə əˈɡɛn
dialogue.zh: 取经人很快再次跪拜在佛祖面前

dialogue.en: Other buddhas and bodhisattvas stood behind him
dialogue.ipa: ˈʌðər ˈbudəz ænd boʊdɪˈsɑtvəs stʊd bɪˈhaɪnd hɪm
dialogue.zh: 其他佛与菩萨立于其后

dialogue.en: You carried the Tang monk on the journey
dialogue.ipa: ju ˈkærid ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ɑn ðə ˈʤɜrni

dialogue.en: And earned forgiveness for your crimes
dialogue.ipa: ænd ɜrnd fərˈɡɪvnəs fɔr jʊər kraɪmz

dialogue.en: You will now be a golden dragon in heaven
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl naʊ bi ə ˈɡoʊldən ˈdræɡən ɪn ˈhɛvən
dialogue.zh: 如今你将成为天界的金龙

dialogue.en: Light flashed as a large golden dragon soared into the sky
dialogue.ipa: laɪt flæʃt æz ə lɑrʤ ˈɡoʊldən ˈdræɡən sɔrd ˈɪntu ðə skaɪ
dialogue.zh: 金光闪动间,一条巨大的金龙腾空而起

dialogue.en: You too have earned forgiveness for your past crimes
dialogue.ipa: ju tu hæv ɜrnd fərˈɡɪvnəs fɔr jʊər pæst kraɪmz

dialogue.en: You will now be a golden deity
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl naʊ bi ə ˈɡoʊldən ˈdiəti
dialogue.zh: 如今你将成为金身罗汉

dialogue.en: You will be janitor of the altars
dialogue.ipa: ju wɪl bi ˈʤænətər ʌv ði ˈɔltərz

dialogue.en: An important deity who looks after Buddhist altars
dialogue.ipa: ən ɪmˈpɔrtənt ˈdiəti hu lʊks ˈæftər ˈbudəst ˈɔltərz
dialogue.zh: 成为守护佛坛的重要神祇

dialogue.en: Buddha next turned to the Tang monk
dialogue.ipa: ˈbudə nɛkst tɜrnd tu ðə tæŋ mʌŋk

dialogue.en: The people in the east will never have to suffer again
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈpipəl ɪn ði ist wɪl ˈnɛvər hæv tu ˈsʌfər əˈɡɛn

dialogue.en: You made a journey that no other person could make
dialogue.ipa: ju meɪd ə ˈʤɜrni ðæt noʊ ˈʌðər ˈpɜrsən kʊd meɪk
dialogue.zh: 你完成了无人能及的旅程

dialogue.en: Finally Buddha turned to the monkey
dialogue.ipa: ˈfaɪnəli ˈbudə tɜrnd tu ðə ˈmʌŋki

dialogue.en: Your crimes long ago were terrible
dialogue.ipa: jʊər kraɪmz lɔŋ əˈɡoʊ wɜr ˈtɛrəbəl

dialogue.en: But since then you have used your tremendous powers to do good deeds
dialogue.ipa: bʌt sɪns ðɛn ju hæv juzd jʊər trəˈmɛndəs ˈpaʊərz tu du ɡʊd didz
dialogue.zh: 但此后你以通天本领行善积德

dialogue.en: You too are now a Buddha
dialogue.ipa: ju tu ɑr naʊ ə ˈbudə

dialogue.en: The monkey suddenly noticed that his head felt different
dialogue.ipa: ðə ˈmʌŋki ˈsʌdənli ˈnoʊtəst ðæt hɪz hɛd fɛlt ˈdɪfərənt
dialogue.zh: 猴子忽然察觉头顶异样

dialogue.en: Wukong and the Tang monk joined the other buddhas and bodhisattvas
dialogue.ipa: wu kɔŋ ænd ðə tæŋ mʌŋk ʤɔɪnd ði ˈʌðər ˈbudəz ænd boʊdɪˈsɑtvəs
dialogue.zh: 悟空与唐僧与众佛菩萨相聚

dialogue.en: They have been in the western paradise ever since
dialogue.ipa: ðeɪ hæv bɪn ɪn ðə ˈwɛstərn ˈpɛrəˌdaɪs ˈɛvər sɪns
dialogue.zh: 自此永驻西方极乐净土

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.description: 讲述过去发生并结束的动作，是故事叙述中最常用的时态。
grammar.source: The travelers flew through the sky over the Tang empire
examples: The monkey opened the door.
The travelers crossed the river.
The demon ran into the cave.
Wukong looked at the sky.
The monk asked a question.
Bajie found some food.
They climbed the mountain.
The king gave them a map.
Everyone heard a loud noise.
The group continued its journey.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示在另一个过去动作或时间之前已经完成的动作。
grammar.source: Where the scriptures had been placed in baskets
examples: The travelers had left before sunrise.
Wukong had seen the demon before.
The monk had finished his meal.
Bajie had found the hidden door.
They had reached the village by noon.
The king had heard the news already.
She had hidden the key in the box.
We had visited the temple once before.
He had learned the spell from his teacher.
The rain had stopped before morning.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + 动词原形/第三人称单数
grammar.description: 表示事实、习惯、状态或经常发生的动作。第三人称单数通常在动词后加 s 或 es。
grammar.source: I see the emperor's palace
examples: Wukong knows many magic spells.
The monk wants to reach the West.
Bajie likes good food.
Wujing carries the luggage.
They travel together.
I know the answer.
We need more water.
The king lives in the palace.
This road leads to the mountain.
The river flows through the valley.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词 ing
grammar.description: 表示现在或当前一段时间正在发生的动作。
grammar.source: Buddha is waiting for you
examples: Wukong is looking for the demon.
The monk is resting under a tree.
Bajie is eating a peach.
Wujing is carrying the bags.
They are crossing the bridge.
I am waiting for you.
We are following the river.
The king is speaking to his guards.
The demons are hiding in the cave.
It is getting dark.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.description: 表示过去发生但与现在有关的动作或结果。
grammar.source: I couldn't have reached the western paradise without them
examples: Wukong has found the cave.
The monk has finished his meal.
Bajie has lost his rake.
They have reached the village.
I have seen this demon before.
We have crossed the river.
The king has opened the gate.
She has hidden the treasure.
The guards have caught the thief.
The rain has stopped.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示将来的动作、临时决定、承诺或预测。
grammar.source: I will wait here while you all deliver the true scriptures
examples: Wukong will protect the monk.
They will leave tomorrow.
I will show you the way.
We will cross the river together.
The king will send more guards.
Bajie will carry the food.
The demon will return at night.
She will open the gate.
It will rain soon.
You will understand one day.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + be + 过去分词
grammar.description: 强调动作的承受者；be 动词随时态和主语变化，后接过去分词。
grammar.source: You will always be remembered as the brave monk who traveled to the west
examples: The monk was captured by the demon.
The door was locked from inside.
The cave was filled with smoke.
The treasure was hidden under the floor.
The guards were sent to the gate.
The travelers were invited into the palace.
The bridge was destroyed by the flood.
The demon was defeated by Wukong.
The message was delivered at noon.
The village was surrounded by mountains.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + could/couldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 可表示过去的能力、可能性或较委婉的请求和建议。
grammar.source: I couldn't have reached the western paradise without them
examples: Wukong could see the palace below.
They could hear a strange sound.
The monk could not find the path.
Could you show me the way?
We could wait until morning.
Bajie could carry the luggage.
The demon could change its shape.
She could swim across the river.
Could they come back safely?
You could try another plan.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + should/shouldn’t + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示建议、责任或较弱的推断。
grammar.source: We should return to the thunderclap monastery
examples: We should follow the river.
You should be careful.
Wukong should ask for help.
The monk should rest for a while.
Bajie should not eat so much.
They should leave before sunset.
The guards should close the gate.
I should try a different plan.
She should tell the king.
Everyone should stay together.

grammar.pattern: 主语 + have/has/had to + 动词原形
grammar.description: 表示因规则或客观情况而“不得不、必须”做某事。
grammar.source: Our people won't have to suffer anymore
examples: We have to cross the river.
Wukong has to protect the monk.
Bajie had to carry the luggage.
They have to leave now.
I have to find the key.
The guards have to watch the gate.
She has to tell the truth.
The king had to make a decision.
You have to wait here.
Everyone has to follow the rules.

grammar.pattern: Let’s + 动词原形
grammar.description: Let’s 是 Let us 的缩写，用于邀请别人一起做某事或提出共同建议。
grammar.source: Yes let's go
examples: Let's follow the river.
Let's climb the mountain.
Let's ask Wukong.
Let's wait for the others.
Let's find a safe place.
Let's go back to the village.
Let's help the monk.
Let's look inside the cave.
Let's take a short rest.
Let's try another way.

grammar.pattern: There + be + 名词 + 地点
grammar.description: 表示某处存在某人或某物，be 动词根据时态和名词单复数变化。
grammar.source: There's no need to apologize
examples: There is a temple on the hill.
There are two guards at the gate.
There was a boat near the river.
There were many people in the hall.
There has been a strange noise.
There had been a bridge here.
There is some food in the bag.
There are clouds above the mountain.
There was no light in the cave.
There will be a meeting tomorrow.

grammar.pattern: 名词 + who/that/which + 从句
grammar.description: 用 who、that 或 which 补充说明前面的名词。who 常指人，which 常指物。
grammar.source: You will always be remembered as the brave monk who traveled to the west
examples: The monkey who jumped first was brave.
The road that leads west is very long.
The temple which stood on the hill was old.
The guard who saw the demon shouted.
The key that opens the door is missing.
The fruit which grew on the tree was sweet.
The man who helped them was a farmer.
The cave that they found was dark.
The river which crossed the valley was wide.
The voice that called out belonged to Wukong.

grammar.pattern: If + 条件, 主句
grammar.description: if 引导条件，说明在某种条件下会出现的结果。
grammar.source: For many years I wondered if I'd ever see you again
examples: If it rains, we will stay here.
If you see the demon, call Wukong.
If they cross the river, they will reach the village.
If Bajie is hungry, he will look for food.
If the gate is open, we can go inside.
If you tell the truth, the king will help you.
If the road is blocked, we must find another way.
If the monk agrees, we will leave tomorrow.
If the guards come, the demon will run away.
If you are tired, take a rest.

grammar.pattern: While + 进行中的动作, 主句
grammar.description: while 表示“当……时”，常连接两个同时进行的动作。
grammar.source: I will wait here while you all deliver the true scriptures
examples: While the monk was resting, Wukong watched the road.
While they were walking, it began to rain.
Bajie ate while the others talked.
While the guards were sleeping, the demon escaped.
Wujing waited while Wukong explored the cave.
While the king was speaking, everyone listened.
The birds sang while the sun was rising.
While we are here, we should help the villagers.
She found the key while she was cleaning.
While the river was rising, they built a raft.

grammar.pattern: 主句 + because + 原因
grammar.description: because 引导原因，回答“为什么”。
grammar.source: Because of you
examples: They stopped because the road was blocked.
Wukong smiled because he had a plan.
Bajie was tired because he had walked all day.
The villagers hid because the demon was nearby.
We waited because it was raining.
The king was pleased because the travelers helped him.
She shouted because she saw a snake.
The gate was closed because it was late.
He returned because he forgot the map.
Everyone cheered because the demon was defeated.

Our people won't have to suffer anymore
Buddha is waiting for you
You will now be a golden dragon in heaven
Thank you Buddha
An important deity who looks after Buddhist altars
Buddha next turned to the Tang monk
You made a journey that no other person could make
Your crimes long ago were terrible
They have been in the western paradise ever since
